text.body:
//śrīḥ//
mahākaviśrībhavabhūtipraṇītaṃṣṭamālatīmādhavam/ śrīpūrṇasarasvatīpraṇītarasamañjaryākhyavyākhyopetam/
astu hastimukhaṃ vastu saccidānandavigraham| pratyūhavyūhavihativahanāya sadā mama|| 1
yasya bhāsā jagadbhāti yadbhāsā bhāti tanmahaḥ| avidyāvidviṣe tasmai śrīpūrṇajyotiṣe namaḥ|| 2
śirasa iva galantīmantarabhyudgirantīsurasaritamudārāṃ vākchalādānanena| dahatu bhavabhayaṃ sā mūrtiraiśī munīnāṃ daharakuharalīlādakṣiṇā dakṣiṇā vaḥ||3
yadgītārthaśravaṇarasato dhvastamohāndhakāraḥkṛṣṇānandī trijagati naro jiṣṇubhūyaṃ jihīte| svasminneva prakaṭitamahāviśvarūpaṃ tadekaṃ pūrṇajyotiḥ sphuratu hṛdi me puṇḍarīkāyatākṣam|| 4
cinmahodadhikallolastanmaho vitanotu vaḥ| stanandhayaṃ yaśodāyā dhanañjayadhanaṃ jayam//5// bhavasamabhavabhūtiprājyavaidagdhyasīmniṣṭaprakaraṇatilake'smin mālatīmādhavākhye/ vivaraṇakṛtināmnā kartumīhe vigāhaṃṣṭatanutaraguṇagṛhyāstatra santo ramantām//6// skhalitamiha yadi syādarthataḥ śabdato vāṣṭaśrutapariṇatadhīkāstatsamādadhyurāryāḥ/
sapadi pipatiṣūṇāṃ saṅkaṭe śailaśṛṅgeṣṭadadati suhṛda eva prauḍhahastāvalambam//7// vaktuṃ śakyo'rthavistāro na vinā vistaraṃ girām/
ataḥ prathanadoṣo'smin sahyaḥ sahṛdayaiḥ svayam//8// mālatīmādhavasyoccairāmodaṃ svaṃ vivṛṇvatī/
dhāryā sahṛdayaiḥ prītyā vyākhyeyaṃ ``rasamañjarī''//9// prathamaṃ prabandhamukhalakṣaṇeritāṃ paradevatāsmaraṇamaṅgalādikāṃ rasikān prati prakaraṇakriyonmukhaḥ kavirāṭ karoti bhavabhūtirāśiṣaṃ - sānandamityādi/ ānandasahitamityāhananakriyāviśeṣaṇam/
``ajasramāsphālitavallakīguṇakṣatojjvalāṅguṣṭhanakhāṃśubhinnayā/'' iti/ ``amandamārabdhamṛdaṅgavādye'' iti/
``tāmbūlīpaṭalaiḥ pinaddhaphalitavyānamrapūgadrumāḥ''/
ityādivat/ ānandatāṇḍavoddaṇḍakhaṇḍaparaśuparicaryāvasaralābhamuditahṛdayaṃ yathā tathetyarthaḥ/ nandī parameśvarapārṣadamukhyo nandīśvaraḥ/ āhatastāḍitaḥ murava ānaddhavādyaviśeṣaḥ/ āhūtaḥ snigdhagambhīramuravaravaśravaṇānantarameva jaladabṛṃhitaśaṅkayā saharṣaṃ samāgatatvādākārita ivetyutprekṣā/ na ca muravaravetyatra prasiddhidhutadoṣaprasaṅgaḥ / ``ghanaravā naravāhanasampadaḥ'' iti raghuvaṃśe/ ``pratidiśaṃ kriyate kalabhai ravaḥ'', ``balākrāntaṃ krīḍaddviradamathitorvīruharavaiḥ'' iti ca māghakāvye/ ``ṇamaha a jassa phuḍaravaṃ'', ``ṇiāravāhi phuḍaṇintajasaṇighghosaṃ'' iti ca setau/ kāvyāntareṣvapi mahākaviprayogaśatairaduṣṭatvanirṇayāt/ lakṣaṇataḥ prayogasya balīyastvācca/ ata eva hi tathāmnātamapi kavibhiranādṛtamityaprayuktasya duṣṭatvābhidhānam/ kaumāraḥ vāhanatvena subrahmaṇyasya parigrahaḥ/ barhī mayūraḥ, tasmādyastrāsaḥ, tato hetoḥ/ nāsāgrarandhraṃ hastāgravivaram/ gajānāṃ hastasyaiva nāsātvāt/ ``nāganāsoruḥ'' ityādiprayogāt/ viśati pravekṣyati/ vartamānasāmīpye śatā/ phaṇipatau vāsukau śivasevāsannihita ityarthāt/ kaumārabarhītyanena tadīyadurvilasitasya śarveṇāpi durvāratvaṃ dyotyate/ bhogasaṅkocaḥ phaṇamukulīkāraḥ praveśasaukaryārthaḥ/
``bhogo rājye dhane saukhye pālanābhyavahārayoḥ/
phaṇe dehe ca sarpasya veśyādīnāṃ bhṛtāvapi//'' iti vaijayantī/ uḍḍīnāḥ utpatitāḥ/ ``ḍīṅ vihāyasā gatau'' ityasmānniṣṭhāntam/ mukharitāḥ vācālitāḥ kakubho diśo yābhiḥ/ ghaṭṭanaṃ śuṇḍādaṇḍena dharaṇimaṇḍalāsphālanam/ vyastaṃ vighaṭitasandhibandhanam/ viśvaṃ brahmāṇḍam/ evaṃ vaināyakyaḥ, bhaktajanavighnavinayanād vināyako gaṇapatiḥ, tatsambandhinyaḥ/ ``ṭiṭṭhā[ḍhā]ṇañ--'' (4-1-15) ityādinā ṅīp/ vadanavidhutayaḥ mukhakampanāni/ dhunoteḥ ``striyāṃ ktin'' (3-3-14) iti ktin/ bahuvacanena nivāraṇāya kriyāsamabhihāraḥ prakāśyate/ phīṭkāravatyaḥ phīḍiti kuto'pi kāraṇād vyākulitānāṃ karikalabhānāṃ śabdānukāraḥ/ yathā kādambaryāṃ ``bhītakaripotaphīṭkārapīvaraḥ'' iti/ bhūmimatup/ atra ``vṛddhirādaic'' (1-1-1) itivat sānandamiti maṅgalaśabdopakramānnandinaḥ parameśvaramūrtibhedasya tadāhatamuravoktisāmarthyāgūritanaṭanāṭyākṣiptasya parameśvarasya kaumāreti prastutasya kumārasya prādhānyena padyapratipādyasya vināyakasya cānusandhānāt sahṛdayānuddiśya cāśīrvacanādabhimatārthasiddhaye mahākavinā paramaṃ maṅgalaṃ prayuktamiti veditavyam/ na ca mantavyaṃ, nāsāgrarandhrapraveśaprasaṅgato bhujaṅgapateramaṅgalabhūtaṃ mataṅgajamukhasya kimapi vyasanamādau kavinā sūcitamiti/ tatprasaṅgopādhinā bhagavato vināyakasya lokottareṇa rūpeṇa varṇitatvāttatraiva ca tātparyāt/ lakṣayojanonnateramarorvībhṛtaḥ śarvadhanuṣo maurvīpadamanubhūya garvitasya darvīkarapateḥ praveśāya pātālagahvaramiva puṣkaravivaraṃ tāvat puṣkalam/ etena śiṣṭaḥ śarīrābhogo vyākhyāta iti/ vadanavidhutigrahaṇena yasya kasyāpi paradevatāvyāpārasya bhaktaparirakṣaṇasāmarthyaṃ prakāśyate/ pāntu - aniṣṭanivāraṇeneṣṭaparipūraṇena ca rakṣantu/ atra sānandamiti śailādeḥ śivaviṣayo bhāvo dhvanyate/ trāsāditi phaṇipatigato bhayānakarasaḥ/ vadanavidhutaya iti vināyakagato raudrarasaḥ/ gaṇḍoḍḍīnetyādibhirakāṇḍakopatāṇḍavitena jagadaṇḍamapi khaṇḍayituṃ paṇḍitasya praṇatajanaparitrāṇe kiyān prayāsa iti vastusāmarthyātiśayayogāt devatāntarebhyo vyatireka iti vyatirekālaṅkāraśca/ tataśca trividhadhvanivyāptiṃ svaprabandhasya gandhayati kaviḥ/ ``pāntu vaḥ'' iti kaverdevatāviṣayo bhāvaḥ prakāśyate/ atra vikṛtadviradasvabhāvavarṇanāt svabhāvoktiḥ/ tatsvabhāvasphuṭībhāvāt bhāvikālaṅkāraḥ//1//
pratyūhanirasanaucityādvināyakamukhenāśiṣaṃ prayujyādhunā sūtradhāradvārā svābhimataparadevatāmukhena tribhiḥ padyairāśiṣaṃ prayuṅkte kaviḥ - nāndyante sūtradhāraḥ cūḍāpīḍetyādi/ nāndīprayogāvasāne sūtradhāraḥ praviśyāheti nāṭakanyāyādāpatati/ sūtraṃ bharatamunipraṇītaṃ nāṭakādilakṣaṇagranthaṃ dhārayatīti sūtradhāraḥ/ ``dhṛṅ dhāraṇe'' ityasmāt karmaṇyupapadasamāsaḥ/ nāndī nāma pūrvaraṅgavidhāne pratyāhārādiprarocanāntadvāviṃśatyaṅgataraṅgite yavanikāntargatena sūtradhāreṇa maṅgalārthaṃ kartavyaḥ prayogaviśeṣaḥ/ yathoktaṃ kohalena``devatādinamaskāramaṅgalārambhapāṭhanam/
nāṭyādau śasyate yattu sā nāndī kathitā budhaiḥ//'' iti/ nāndīśabdaśca bhaṭṭaghasyunā ``ṇadi stutau'' ityasmāt pṛṣodarāditvāt sādhitaḥ/ tathā bādarāyaṇaḥ``yadyapyaṅgāni bhūyāṃsi pūrvaraṅgasya nāṭake/
tathāpyavaśyakartavyā nāndī vighnapraśāntaye//'' iti/ tasyāścotthāpanaparivartananāndīprarocanākhyāni catvāryaṅgāni/ tathāha bharataḥ``yasmādutthāpayantyādau prayogaṃ nāndipāṭhakāḥ/
tasmādutthāpanaṃ jñeyaṃ vāgaṅgavyaktikārakam//
yasmācca lokapālānāṃ parivṛtya caturdiśam/
vandanāṃ saṃprakurvanti tasmāt syāt parivartanam//
āśīrvacanasaṃyuktā yasmānnityaṃ bhavediha/
devadvijanṛpādīnāṃ tasmānnāndīti śabdyate//
siddhenāmantraṇaṃ yā tu vijñeyā sā prarocanā/
siddhastrivikrame viṣṇuḥ siddhaḥ krauñcapade guhaḥ//'' ityādi/ tādṛśyā nāndyā ante avasāne nāndīsūtradhāre niṣkrānte sati sthāpakasūtradhāraḥ praviśyāhetyarthaḥ/ yathoktaṃ bharatena ``prayujya raṅgaṃ niṣkrāmet sūtradhāraḥ sahānugaḥ/
sthāpakaḥ praviśettatra sūtradhārasamākṛtiḥ//'' iti/ nāndī ca dvividhā ``pūrvaraṅge prayojyaikā sthāpanāyāmathāparā/'' sā cāvaśyaṃ candranāmāṅkitā prayoktavyeti kavisampradāyaḥ/ praviṣṭaśca sthāpakaḥ padāṣṭakaviśiṣṭāmindupadamudritāṃ nāndīṃ prayuṅkte - cūḍāpīḍetyādi/ yathāha bharataḥ ``sūtradhāraḥ paṭhettatra madhyamasvaramāśritām/
nāndīṃ padairdvādaśabhiraṣṭabhirvāpyalaṅkṛtām//'' iti/ cūḍā śikhā/
``cūḍā keśī keśapāśī śikhaṇḍī kamujā śikhā/'' iti vaijayantī/ cūḍāśabdenātra jaṭābandho lakṣyate, śiro vā/
``yātyastācalacūḍamudritamadhucchatracchaviścandramāḥ/'' itivat/ āpīḍaḥ śekharaḥ/
``athāpīḍe vataṃsottaṃsaśekharāḥ/'' iti vaijayantī/ saṃkulaṃ sambhrāntam/
``prāyo vayasi bāhulye tulyānaśanamṛtyuṣu/'' iti vaijayantī/ kapilatayā prabhābāhulyena ca vidyutprāyāstaṭittulyāḥ nayanodaraprabhāmilitāśca dyutayo yāsām/ akaṭhoro navodbhinnaḥ sandigdhaḥ saṃśayitaḥ/ bhujaṅgavallī latāvad drāghīyān sarpaḥ, tasya valayaṃ vartulīkṛtaḥ śarīrasanniveśaḥ, tadeva srak mālā tayā naddho baddho jūṭaḥ samūho yāsām/ tvāmityanenaucityāt sabhāpatiḥ sambodhyate, vaḥ ityanena yathā sāmājikāḥ/ atra ca galadvārividyududyotaketakodbhedavallīvalayapratipādanājjaladasamayavirājinīnāṃ vanarājīnāṃ pratibhānena jaṭānāṃ tābhirupamānopameyabhāvaḥ kalpyaḥ/ tataśca yathā tādṛśyo vanarājayaḥ sakalajantusantāpahāriṇyastathā tathāvidhāḥ parameśvarasya jaṭā apītyupamālaṅkāreṇa vyaṅgyena dyotyate/ svabhāvoktiratrālaṅkāraḥ//2//
dantaśreṇiṣvityādi/ bahuvacanaṃ kapālānāṃ bāhulyāt/ saṅgalatkalakalena prasaratkolāhalena praluṭhanena kṣubhitāḥ/ ghrāṇanetraśrotravivareṣu tiryakpravartaneṣu, udgatabudbudaṃ yathā tathā dhvananaśīlāḥ/ gaṇḍagranthiḥ kapolāsthisthapuṭam/ jarjaraśikhāḥ viśīrṇāgrāḥ/ cūḍāsravantyūrmayaḥ maulinadītaraṅgāḥ/ ``bhaṅgastaraṅga ūrmirvā'' ityukterubhayaliṅgatā/ ``brahmakapālakandarabhuvi spandolbaṇāḥ'' iti pāṭhaḥ/ atītānāṃ bahūnāṃ caturmukhānāṃ śiraḥkapālānyeva kandarā giriguhāḥ, tadvat gambhīratvāt/ tadbhuvi tatsthāne pravartanoddhatāḥ/ ``spadi kiñciccalane'' ityātmanepadī/ ``kandaraparispande''ti tu pāṭhe kapālānāṃ vṛttyantaritatvena dantaśreṇyādayaḥ kena sambadhyerannityabhavanmatayogadoṣaprasaṅgaḥ/ atra haṭhātkāranirjiteṣvariṣu mahadāśrayagarvitānāṃ durvilasitāni durvārāṇi kathaṃ varṇyantāmiti vastunā vastu vyajyate/ ullekho'trālaṅkāraḥ, viṣayabhedenānekadhātvollekhanāt//3//
pakṣmālīpiṅgalimna ityādi/ yasya locanasya, pakṣmālī nayanapāli[ḥ] romapaṅktistasyāḥ piṅgalimā kapilavarṇaḥ/ kaṇaḥ binduḥ/ mūrtavastustokatvābhidhāyinā kaṇaśabdenāmūrte piṅgalimastokatve vyavahārāllakṣaṇāmūlo'yaṃ dhvaniḥ/ kṛtsno bhūto bhavan bhāvī ca sarvaḥ samuditaḥ/ atra kāryabhūtasya kṛtsnataḍitsamūhakaṇībhāvasyāprastutasya sambhāvanena kāraṇabhūtaḥ pakṣmālīpiṅgalimno bāhulyadurnirīkṣaprabhatvādiratiśayaḥ prastuto gamyate iti kāryāt kāraṇapratītirūpeyamaprastutapraśaṃsā/ brahmāṇḍaṃ pañcāśatkoṭiyojanavistāracaturdaśabhuvananirbharagarbhaṃ mahadādiviśeṣāntakalpyaṃ hiraṇyagarbhotpattipeśīmaṇḍalam/
``sūryāṇḍagolayormadhye koṭyaḥ syuḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥ/'' iti bhāgavatokteḥ/ īṣadvighaṭitamukule - mukulaśabdaḥ sādṛśyānnimīlanaṃ lakṣayati, kiñcidviśliṣṭapakṣmabandha ityarthaḥ/ anyadā jagadanugrahāya mukulitatvāt/ tathoktamambāstave``dagdhaṃ yadā madanamekamanekadhā te mugdhaḥ kaṭākṣavidhiraṅkurayāṃcakāra/
dhatte tadāprabhṛti devi! lalāṭanetraṃ satyaṃ hriyeva mukulīkṛtamindumauliḥ//
iti/ īṣaditi samagronmīlanasyāparyāptaviṣayatvaṃ brahmāṇḍasya pratīyate/ kālayajvā``sthānātsthānaṃ daśaguṇamekasmāt gaṇyate dvija ṅa/
tato'ṣṭādaśa (me ṛke) bhāge parārdhamabhidhīyate//'' ityuktaparārdhadvayarūpasya brahmāyuṣaḥ parasaṃjñasyāvasānakāla ityarthāt/ sa eva yajvā yajamānaḥ/ suyajorṅvanip (3-2-103)/ juhoti--avadānatvena dadāti/ vartamānanirdeśādanādisiddhe saṃsāre pralayodayayorapi cakravat parivṛtteḥ pratiparāvasānaṃ homo vyajyate/ ``juhāva'' iti tu pāṭhe bhūtānadyatanaparokṣārthamātrapratipādanādasyārthasyāsiddhiḥ/ kālasya hotṛtvoktistasyaiva sargapralayādiṣu prerakatvāt/
``prakṛterguṇasāmyasya nirviśeṣasya mānavi ṅa/
ceṣṭā yataḥ sa bhagavān kāla ityupalakṣitaḥ//'' iti bhāgavatokteḥ/
``tathāvidhānāmabdānāṃ śataṃ tvamapi jīvasi/
tvadāyurmama niśvāsaḥ kālenaiva pracodyate//'' iti śrībhagavatpādācāryavacanācca/ haratṛtīyanayanānalasya jagatsaṃhartṛtvaprasiddherevamuktiḥ/ yathāha murāriḥ``nīlalohitalalāṭalāñchane locane jayati ko'pi pāvakaḥ/
rakṣitasya jagadantahetave yasya saṃjvalanamātmabhūrabhūt//'' iti/ kālasya yajvatvena rūpaṇāllocanasyāgnikuṇḍatvaṃ jagadaṇḍasya havyatvaṃ cārthasiddhamityekadeśavivartirūpakam/ arcirniṣṭaptaḥ-- jvālayā kiñcit taptaḥ/ ``nisastapatāvanāsevane'' (8-3-102) iti mūrdhanyaḥ/ āsevanamāvṛttiḥ/ anāvṛttiśca kādācitkādīṣadunmīlanāditi mantavyam/ anyathā navanītaśakalakomalasya bālaśaśino bhasmībhāvaprasaṅgāt/ sudhāsāraḥ amṛtavṛṣṭiḥ/ ``āsāro vegavān varṣaḥ'' iti vaijayantī/ sātkāro nāma jalabindupātanirvāpyamāṇadahanaśabdānukāraḥ tadvān sātkārī apāṅgadeśo yasya/ tārtīyīkaṃ tṛtīyam/ ``tīyādīkak svārthe vā vaktavyam'' (vā. 4-2-8) itīkak/ purāreḥ asurapuratrayaripoḥ/ anena jagadanugrahatācchīlyaṃ dhvanyate/ avatu/ ``ava rakṣaṇe'' iti dhātuḥ/ madanaploṣaṇaṃ kāmasya dāhakam/ ``pluṣa dāhe'' ityasmāt ``kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam'' (3-3-113) iti kartari lyuṭ/ atra cāyamakhilopaniṣadaṅganāsaṅgītaraṅgamaṇḍapena sāṅkhyayogasāgarapārāvārīṇena kavikulendunā gurumukhaikagamyo'tirahasyo'rthaḥ sūtrito'nusandheyaḥ/ tathāhi-pakṣmaśabdo romavācakaḥ/ ``nisargacitrojjvalasūkṣmapakṣmaṇā'' ityukteḥ/ sūtrāṃśavācakaśca/ ``pakṣma sūtrādyavayave kiñjalke netraromasu'' iti vaijayantī/ atra ca vālāgravat nīvāraśūkavacca tanīyasī, trapusītantuvacca pītavarṇā prabhāsantatiḥ sādṛśyāt pakṣmālītyucyate/ īṣadvighaṭitamukule sadgurūpadeśādabhyāsācca nivṛttaprāyamāyātirodhāne/ īṣadgrahaṇaṃ hotṛhotavyapratītyanuvṛtteḥ, tasyā api māyākāryatvāt/
``śāstreṇa naśyet paramārtharūpaṃ kāryakṣamaṃ naśyati cāparokṣyāt/
prārabdhanāśāt pratibhāsanāśa evaṃ kramānnaśyati cātmamāyā//'' ityācāryavacanāt/ ``bhūyaścānte viśvamāyānivṛttiḥ'' iti śruteśca/ antarnāḍīniyamitamarudvighaṭitādhāradvārakavāṭabandhe ca/ kālayajvā niyatakālānatikrameṇa śrutismṛtivihitaiḥ karmabhirīśvaraṃ pūjayan puruṣaḥ/ kālayajvetyanena niṣiddhakāmyavarjamantaḥkaraṇaśuddhyai vihitakarmānuṣṭhāyī mumukṣuriti dyotyate/ brahmāṇḍaṃ juhoti apunarutthānāya dhyānena vilāpayatītyarthaḥ/ yathāhurācāryāḥ``saṅkalpya havyaṃ sakalaprapañcaṃ prajñāsrucā sarvahutaṃ vimuktyai/
jājvalyamāne svata eva nitye sarvāntare jyotiṣi johavīmi//
iti/ ambāstave ca``brahmāṇḍabudbudakadambakasaṅkulo'yaṃ māyodadhirvividhatatvataraṅgamālaḥ/
āścaryamamba jhaṭiti pralayaṃ prayāti tvaddhyānasantatimahābaḍavāmukhāgnau//
iti/ arciriti sauṣumnasaraṇiviharaṇarasikanijaśikhādrāvitāt brahmarandhrāravindacandrānniṣyanditena paramāmṛtavṛṣṭipūreṇa sātkāriprāntamityarthaḥ/ tārtīyīkam-``anyadeva tadviditādatho aviditādadhi/'' ityupaniṣannītyā māyātatkāryavyatiriktaṃ tadadhyāsādhiṣṭhānatayā tṛtīyam/ yadvā``śaivāgameṣu mukhyaṃ patipaśupāśā iti kramāt tritayam/'' ityuktakrameṇa niyāmyayoḥ paśupāśayorniyantṛtvena taduttīrṇaṃ purāreḥpuraṃ śarīraṃ bhaktānāmajñānanidānakarmamithunanirmitadehabandhanirmūlanasya madanaploṣaṇaṃ saṃsāraviṣatarubījabhūtamanmathonmathanam/
``kāma eṣa krodha eṣa rajoguṇasamudbhavaḥ/
mahāśano mahāpāpmā viddhyenamiha vairiṇam//'' iti bhagavadvacanāt/ locanaṃ ``locṛ darśane'' ityasmāt lyuṭ/ svarūpabhūtaṃ saccidānandarasaṃ mūlādhārasphuritaṃ pratyagjyotiḥ/ nahi draṣṭurdṛṣṭerviparilopo vartata iti śruteḥ/ yathāhurācāryāḥ``mūlādhārāt sphuritataṭidāmāprabhāsūkṣmarūpoṣṭagacchantyāmastakamaṇutarā tejasāṃ mūlabhūtā/
sauṣumnādhvācaraṇanipuṇā sā savitrānubaddhāṣṭadhyātā sadyo'mṛtamatha raveḥ srāvayet sārdhasomāt//'' iti/ atra ca jaṭānāṃ dharmaliṅgatvāddharmavṛddhisravantyūrmīṇāṃ duritaharatvādadharmanirāso locanasya jñānasvarūpatvāttatsādhyo mokṣaścāśāsita iti kramo mantavyaḥ//
itthamāśiṣaṃ prayujyākāṇḍaprathanadoṣajanyaṃ rasavicchedakhedaṃ sahṛdayānāmāśaṅkya pariharati - sūtradhāraḥ - alamativistareṇeti/ atiśabdenaitāvataḥ śabdaprathanasyaucityāparityāgādadoṣatvamito'dhikasya doṣatvaṃ ca dhvanyate/ yathāha dhvanikāraḥ
``anaucityādṛte nānyadrasabhaṅgasya kāraṇam/ prasiddhaucityabandhastu rasasyopaniṣatparā//"
iti/ ``prathane vāvaśabde'' (3-3-33) iāta[iti] ghañaḥ pratiṣedhād vipūrvāt stṛñaḥ śabdaviṣaye ``ṛdorap'' (3-3-57)/ ``alaṃ bhūṣaṇaparyāptivāraṇeṣu'' ityuktervāraṇārthamavyayam/ idaṃ tṛtīyāyuktaṃ prayujyate, ``alaṃ mahīpāla tava śrameṇa'' ityādidarśanāt/ prakṛtyāditṛtīyā ceyam/ atha prabhātasandhyopāsanāvasānasamuditānāṃ bhūmidevānāmucitaṃ sevāsamayamanusandadhānaḥ svābhimatasiddhaye sūryamupatiṣṭhāsurāha - uditabhūyiṣṭha (iti) bahutaramuditaḥ/ udayagirergaganatalamadhirūḍha ityarthaḥ/ aśeṣabhuvanadvīpadīpaḥ aśeṣāṇāṃ bhuvanaviśeṣabhūtabhūlokāvayavānāṃ jambūplakṣaśālmalīkuśakrauñcaśākapuṣkaranāmnāmantarāntarā samudrasīmantitasīmnāṃ pradeśānāṃ prakāśanāddīpa iva dīpaḥ, ``ravicandramasoryāvanmayūkhairavabhāsyate/ sasamudrasaricchailā tāvatī pṛthivī smṛtā//'' iti purāṇavacanāt/ dīparūpeṇa nyūnatvaṃ ca nāśaṅkanīyam, prakāśyadeśamahattvānuguṇyena prakāśakasya dīpasyāpi mahattvopapatteḥ/ upatiṣṭhe pūjayāmi/ upāddevapūjāsaṅgatikaraṇamitrakaraṇapathiṣu'' (vā. 1-3-25) iti tiṣṭhaterātmanepadam//
praṇamyeti/ upasthānaprakāramāha - kalyāṇānāmityādi/ kalyāṇānāmiti vābhimatopakṣepaḥ/ maṅgalahetubhūtānāṃ, kāraṇe kāryopacāraḥ/ mahasāṃ -- tejasām/ bahuvacanena candrādigatānāmapyupasaṃgrahaḥ kriyate/
``yadādityagataṃ tejo jagadbhāsayate'khilam/ yaccandramasi yaccāgnau tattejo viddhi māmakam//" iti/ ``jyotiṣāṃ raviraṃśumān'' iti ca bhagavadvacanāt/ bhājanam - ādhāraḥ/ niyatanapuṃsakatayā bhājanaśabdasya tvamiti sāmānādhikaraṇyam/ viśvamūrte! viśvaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamātmakaṃ jagadvigraho yasya/ caitanyātmanā vyāpta ityarthaḥ/ ``sa yaścāyaṃ puruṣe, yaścāsāvāditye, sa ekaḥ'' iti śruteḥ/ atha - ato hetoḥ/ deva! jagatsargādikrīḍārasika ṅa/ prasīda - madviṣaye kāruṇyakaṭākṣamarpaya/ dhuryāṃ - sajjanasamārādhanabharanirvahaṇasamarthām/ ``dhuro yaṭḍhakañau'' (4-4-47) iti yat/ lakṣmīṃ - vidyātiśayaprayogajanitāṃ khyātilābhapūjātmikāṃ sampadam/ dhehi - poṣaya/ ``ghvasoreddhāvabhyāsalopaśca'' (6-4-119) ityetvamabhyāsalopaśca/ yadyaditi vāṅmanaḥkāyopādānam/ yena kenacidrūpeṇāvasthitaṃ sarvaṃ vīpsayā parāmṛśyate/ tadityekena tacchabdena tathābhūtameva parāmṛśyate/ nyāyadīpāvalyāmudāharaṇavākye ``yadyad dṛśyaṃ tanmithyā yathā śuktirūpyam'' iti vyāptigrahaṇe ubhayathāpi samarthitatvāt/ nyāyabharabandhena cāsmin padye tathā vyākhyātatvāt/ pāpaṃ - niṣiddhācaraṇapariṇatamapūrvam/ pratijahi - pratihataṃ kuru/ ``hanterjaḥ'' (6-4-36)''/ jagannātha! nāthyata iti nāthaḥ, lokānāṃ prārthanīya ṅa, sakalapuruṣārthasavitṛtvāt/ ``nāthṛ yācñāyām'' ityasmād ghañ/ namrasya - namanaśīlasya/ ``namikaṃpismyajasakamihiṃsadīpo raḥ'' (3-2-167) iti raḥ/ bhadraṃ bhadraṃ - uparyupari bhavattattvajñānodayalakṣaṇamaiśvaryam/ ``nityavīpsayoḥ'' (8-1-4) iti dvitvam/ vitara - dehi/ vipūrvastaratirdānārthe vartate/ bhagavan! samagraiśvaryavīryajñānalakṣmīkīrtivairāgyasaṃjñaṣaḍguṇanidhe! anena jñānādidānasāmarthyaṃ dhvanyate/ dhanavata eva dānaśaktirna nirdhanasyeti bhāvaḥ/ bhūyase maṅgalāya/ maṅgalaśabdenopacārāt maṅgalakāryaṃ sukhamucyate/ niśśeṣaduḥkhanivṛttiniratiśayasukhaprāptirūpamapavargaṃ prāptum/ ``kriyārthopapadasya ca karmaṇi sthāninaḥ'' (2-3-14) iti caturthī/ prativākyaṃ sambuddhiḥ/ ``stūyamānā hi devatā vīryeṇa vardhate'' iti nyāyādvīryavardhanāya prasādasaumukhyāya ceti mantavyam/ atra prathamena vīryodbodhanaṃ, dvitīyenaihikaphalaprārthanā, tṛtīyena pāpakṣayāśaṃsā, caturthena tatsādhanabhūtatattvajñānaprārthanā ca vākyaiḥ kṛteti boddhavyam/
``jñānāgniḥ sarvakarmāṇi bhasmasātkurute tathā/'' iti bhagavadvacanāt tadadhigama uttarapūrvārdhayoraśeṣavināśaśravaṇācca/ atra ca nāndyaṅgaṃ devatānamaskāraḥ kṛtaḥ// ``devatādinamaskāramaṅgalārambhapāṭhanam/
nāṭyādau kriyate yattu sā nāndī kathitā budhaiḥ//'' iti vacanāt/ nepathye miśram iti bharatokteḥ nepathye devatāvandanaṃ ca prayuktamiti mantavyam//5//
nepathyābhimukhamityādi/ nepathyaṃ nāma naṭānāṃ saṃvṛtaṃ varṇikāparigrahasthānam/ suvihitāni nāṭyavedoktakrameṇa suṣṭhu prayuktāni/ avataraṇaṃ nāma madhuramaṅgalagītimukharamukhīnāṃ gāyakīnāṃ praveśaḥ taduktaṃ bharatena -- ``tathāvataraṇaṃ caiva gāyakīnāṃ praveśanam/'' iti/ pratyāhārādikeṣu satsvapyanyeṣu pūrvaraṅgāṅgeṣvavataraṇagrahaṇaṃ prādhānyāt/ ``geyaṃ prāṇāḥ prayogasya sarvaṃ vā geyamucyate/
geyasādhyaṃ hi dharmārthakāmamokṣacatuṣṭayam//'' iti bharatokteḥ/ tathā śārṅgadevaḥ/ ``nṛttaṃ vādyānugaṃ proktaṃ vādyaṃ gītānubandhi ca/
ato gītaṃ pradhānatvādatrādāvabhidhīyate//'' iti/ raṅgamaṅgalāni pratyāhārādīnī/ sannipatitaḥ samavetaḥ/ kālapriyaṃ nāma devatāyatanaviśeṣaḥ/ yātrāprasaṅgena divyotsavaprastāvena/ ``puruṣottamasya yātrāyāmupasthānīyāḥ sabhāsada'' iti murāriḥ/ nānādigantavāstavyaḥ - vividhadeśavāsī/ vasestavyat kartari ṇicca'' (vā. 3-1-96)/ abhijanavidyāvṛttairlokottaraścāsau janaśceti mahājanaḥ/ samājaḥ- samūhaḥ/ ``samudorajaḥ paśuṣu'' (3-3-61) ityabvidhānādapaśuviṣaye ghañ/ kimiti - kimartham/ udāsate-kṛtyeṣu nirutsāhatayā vartante/ protsāhanaparametat/ bharatāḥ- naṭāḥ/ apūrvavastuprayogeṇa - adṛṣṭacaretivṛttābhinayena/ vastuśabdavyākhyāne dhanikaḥ - itivṛttabhedā iti/ vinodanīyāḥ - kālakṣepaṃ kārayitavyāḥ/ nirdiṣṭaguṇaprabandhenetyanenaitadguṇaviśiṣṭena prabandhena bhavitavyamiti pariṣanniyogamāsūtrayati/ prabandhaśabdaḥ kāvyanāṭakādisādhāraṇaḥ/ ``viddhi naḥ ṣaṭprabandhān ityādidarśanāt//
praviśya pāripāśrXvika iti/ sūcitārthaśravaṇasākāṃkṣatvena tatpraveśopapattiḥ/ praviśatītyukte punaḥ pātranirdeśo yuktaḥ/ vacanakriyānukteḥ/ praviśyetyukte ``samānakartṛkayoḥ pūrvakāle'' (6-4-21) iti ktvo vidhānāt āhetyasya nāntarīyakatvena siddheḥ punaḥ pātranirdeśaḥ pramādaḥ/ evaṃ sarvatrānusandheyam/ paripārśvavartī sūtradhārasyeti naṭaḥ/ sūtradhārasya naṭena saha sallāpādāmukhaṃ caitat/ ``sūtradhāro naṭīṃ brūte māriṣaṃ vā vidūṣakam/
svakāryaprastutākṣepi citroktyā yattadāmukham//'' ityukteḥ/ bhāva katame te guṇā iti/ praveśāt prayogātiśaya āmukhāṅgametat/ ``eṣo'hamityapekṣāvān sūtradhāraprayogataḥ/
pātrapraveśo yatraiṣa prayogātiśayo mataḥ//'' bhāveti nāṭyoktau/
``bhāvo naṭena sūtrī ca māriṣetyamunāpi ca'' iti vacanānnaṭaḥ sūtradhāraṃ sambodhayati/ katame - kiṃrūpāḥ/ āryamiśrāḥ - sadācāreṣu pūjyāḥ/ miśraśabdaḥ pūjyeṣu prayujyate pādādiśabdavat/ kṛṣṇamiśrādidarśanāt/ bhagavantaḥ- ``utpattiṃ pralayaṃ caiva bhūtānāmāgatiṃ gatim/
vetti vidyāmavidyāṃ ca sa vācyo bhagavāniti//'' uktaguṇaviśiṣṭāḥ/ bhūmidevāḥ brāhmaṇāḥ brāhmaṇagrahaṇena vedādiṣvaṣṭādaśasu vidyāsthāneṣu teṣāmeva mukhyādhikāritvāt nāṭyaprayogasya ca caturvedasāratvāt tadanusaraṇenaiva varṇāntaraiḥ draṣṭavyatvaṃ dhvanyate/ yathoktaṃ bharatena - ``ṛgbhyaḥ pāṭhyamamūd gītaṃ sāmabhyaḥ samapadyata/
yajurbhyo'bhinayā jātā rasāścāsannatharvaṇaḥ//'' iti//
bhūmnetyādi-bhūmnā - bāhulyena/ rasānāṃ - śṛṅgārādīnāmaṅgināmaṅgabhūtānāṃ ca/ kāraṇakāryasahakāriparyāyavibhāvānubhāvavyabhicārirañjitālambanādiviṣayaprītyātmakaratyādirūpā sthāyibhāvā rasāḥ/ rasagrahaṇaṃ bhāvānāmapyupalakṣaṇam/ gahanāḥ - svalpamatibhirduravagāhāḥ sahṛdayahṛdayaikacarvaṇīyāḥ/ prayogāḥ - vyañjakābhinayāḥ, teṣāṃ vyaṅgyaikasvabhāvatvāt/ sauhārdahṛdyāni (viceṣṭitāni) akṛtrimasnehamanoharāṇi nāyakopanāyakādīnāṃ caritāni/ autsukyamabhilāṣavipralambhaḥ, ``autsukyena kṛtatvarā'' ``ityautsukyādaparigaṇayan'' ityādiprayogadarśanāt/ ``syādāyallakamautsukyamutkaṇṭhotkalikā ratiḥ'' iti vaijayantī/ auddhatyamiti pāṭhe manmathamūlamavinītatvamityarthaḥ/ āyojitakāmasūtraṃ sarvatrodāharaṇatvena saṃpāditāni vātsyāyanamunipraṇītāni kāmaśāstrasūtrāṇi yatra tat/ citrā -- saṃvidhānacāturyeṇa vismayajananī kavipratibhotpāditā ca/ kathā - itivṛttaśarīram/ vācīti jātyekavacanaṃ tattatpātroktiṣu, na punaḥ kavisandarbhe, ``yat prauḍhitvam'' ityādinā tasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt/ vidagdhatā - aucityādagrāmyatā/ i (tī)tyanena pariṣanniyogamukhena kaviḥ svasaṃrambhagocarānarthān pratijānīte/ śabdasmṛtinītiśāstrabharatādiyojanānāṃ nāntarīyakatayā siddheḥ/ ete te guṇā iti śeṣaḥ/ etāṃśca guṇān tattatprastāveṣu darśayiṣyāmaḥ//6//
citrā kathetyanenotpādyetivṛttatvaṃ prakaraṇalakṣaṇamanusmārito naṭaḥ pṛcchati -- kasmin prakaraṇa iti/ ete guṇā iti śeṣaḥ/ nanu kimidaṃ prakaraṇaṃ nāma/ ucyate/ yasminnitivṛttaṃ kavipratibhānirmitaṃ loke'pyaucityena saṃvāvadūkaṃ, nāyako vinayādisāmānyaguṇaviśiṣṭo dhīrapraśānto'mātyavipravaṇijāmanyatamaḥ pratyūhaśabalakāryasiddhiśca, nāyikā tu kulastrī gaṇikā vā dve eva/ anyat sarvaṃ nāṭakavat, tat prakaraṇaṃ nāma rūpakabhedaḥ/ prakṛtibhūtaṃ nāṭakalakṣaṇaṃ ca tatra tatropari yojayiṣyāmaḥ/ atra tu nāyako mādhavo nāma brāhmaṇo yuvā anukūlo dhīrapraśāntaḥ sāpāyatrivargasādhanaparaśca/ nāyikā mālatī nāma brāhmaṇī śīlārjavādiguṇavatī mugdhāvasthā ca/ śṛṅgāraraso'ṅgī/ anye punaraṅgabhūtāḥ/ upanāyakaḥ pīṭhamardakaparyāyo nāyakāt kiñcidūnaguṇo makarando nāma pratināyako lubdhastabdhavṛddhatvādiguṇaviśiṣṭo nandano nāmetyādi veditavyam//
vicintyeti - samāhitena manasā tādṛśaṃ prakaraṇaṃ vicāryāhetyarthaḥ/ ``vindhyāttu dakṣiṇo deśo dakṣiṇāpathasaṃjñitaḥ/'' iti vaijayantī/ taittirīyo nāma guruniyogāt yogīśvareṇa yājñavalkyenodgīrṇo mūrtastittiribhūtaistacchiṣyairgṛhītvā jagati pravartito yajurvedaśākhāviśeṣaḥ/ yathāha murāriḥ ``yajūṃṣi taittirīyāṇi mūrtāni vamati sma yaḥ/
sa yogī yājñavalkyastvāṃ vedāntānadhyajīgapat//'' iti/ ``tittirivaratantukhaṇḍikokhācchaṇ'' (4-3-102) iti chaṇ/ tasya śabdato'rthataśca gṛhītatvāttadvantaḥ ata iniḥ taittirīyiṇa iti/ anena svaśākhādhyayanapūrvakatvamadhyayanasya dhvanyate/ bhūriśrutamityādinā śākhāntarādhyayanādervakṣyamāṇatvāt/ pātakisahasrasya paṅktau sthito ya ekastān sarvān punāti, sa paṅktipāvanaḥ, ``āsahasrāt paṅktiṃ punanti'' iti śruteḥ ``agryāḥ sarveṣu vedeṣu sarvapravacaneṣu ca/
śrotriyānvayajāścaiva vijñeyāḥ paṅktipāvanāḥ//'' iti manuvacanācca/ kāśyapāḥ - kāśyapagotrasambhavāḥ/ pañcāgnayaḥ- gārhapatyāhavanīyadakṣiṇāgnisabhyāvasathyākhyāḥ pañcāgnayo yairupāsyante/ athavā ``pañcāgnayo manuṣyeṇa paricaryāḥ prayatnataḥ/
pitā mātāgnirātmā ca guruśca bharatarṣabha//'' iti mahābhāratoktapañcāgniśuśrūṣaṇaparāḥ/ dhṛtavratāḥ- kṛcchracāndrāyaṇāditapaḥpariśīlanasaṃskṛtaśarīrāḥ/ ``vrataṃ viṣṇvṛtuvarṣejyātapomāsāgnibhuktiṣu/'' iti vaijayantī/ ``somapīthī tu somapaḥ'' iti vaijayantī/ pañcāgnaya ityanena gatārthatve'pi somapīthina iti vacanaṃ tācchīlyaṃ dyotayati/ caraṇaguravaḥ - vedaśākhāviśeṣādhyāpanācāryāḥ/ ``na pṛcched gotracaraṇaṃ na svādhyāyaṃ na cāgamam/'' iti vacanāt/ athavā ``ācāro vṛttacāritracaritracaraṇāni ca/'' iti vaijayantī/ laukikānāṃ svayamanuṣṭhānena sadācāropadeṣṭāraḥ/ ``śrutiḥ smṛtiḥ sadācāraḥ svasya ca priyamātmanaḥ/
etaccaturvidhaṃ prāhuḥ sākṣāddharmasya lakṣaṇam//'' iti manuvacanāt/ ``yadyadācarati śreṣṭhastattadevetaro janaḥ/
sa yat pramāṇaṃ kurute lokastadanuvartate''ṃ//
iti bhagavadvacanācca/ ṣaṇmāsamātraparyāptadhānyasaṃgrahī gṛhasthaḥ udumbara audumbaraśca/
``udumbarastu ṣaṇmāsasaṃgrahī tulyakālabhuk/'' ṣṭiti vaijayantī/ tatastena nāmnā prasiddhāḥ/ brahmaviṣayā vītarāgakathā brahmavādaḥ, ``ekamevādvitīyaṃ'' ityādivedāntavākyaśaktitātparyaparyālocanaśīlāḥ/ ``brahmaṇi vadaḥ'' (vā. 3-2-78) iti ṇiniḥ//
te śrotriyā ityādi/ yadyapyekaśākhāmadhītya śrotriya iti smaryate, tathāpyatra brāhmaṇatvamātraparaḥ śrotriyaśabdaḥ/ paṅktipāvanatvādibhiḥ sarvavedādhyayanādiguṇapratipādanāt/ tattvaviniścayāya - īśvarayāthārthyanirṇayaṃ kartuṃ ``tumarthācca bhāvavacanāt'' (2-3-15) iti caturthī/ sadasadekānekanityānityādivikalpadusthaparasparaviruddhavividharāddhāntavihvalīkṛtabuddhisthirīkaraṇāyetyarthaḥ/ bhūri-bahu/ śāśvataṃ-saṃśayaviparyāsanirasanena niṣkampam/ śrutaṃ - śāstraśravaṇaṃ, ādriyante-aśuśrūṣātvarāślāghānirāsena sambhāvayanti/ ``bahubhyaḥ śrotavyaṃ bahudhā śrotavyaṃ'' iti vacanāt/ ``na hyekasmād gurorjñānamutthitaṃ syāt supuṣkalam/''
``brahmaitadadvitīyaṃ vai gīyate bahudharṣibhiḥ'' iti bhāgavatokteḥ/ ``iṣṭaṃ yāgātmakaṃ karma pūrtaṃ khātādikarma ca'' iti vaijayantī/ karma karturīpsitatamaṃ saṃyogavibhāgayorasamavāyikāraṇaṃ vā, tadartham/ arthān - dhanāni/ ``ṣaṇṇāṃ tu karmaṇāmasya trīṇi karmāṇi jīvikā/
yājanādhyāpane caiva viśuddhācca pratigrahaḥ//'' iti smṛtakrameṇārjanarakṣaṇādibhiḥ/ dārān - patnīṃ/ ``dārāḥ puṃsi ca bhūmni ca'' iti pulliṅgatvaṃ nityabahuvacanāntatvaṃ ca/ ``apatyaṃ tokaṃ tayoḥ same'' iti strīpuṃsasādhāraṇo'patyaśabdaḥ, tadartham/ ``striyaḥ śriyo gṛhasyoktāstasmāt pūjyā viśeṣataḥ/'' iti smṛteḥ, vasanābharaṇādibhirācāraparirakṣaṇena ca/ taporthaṃ sakalapumarthatīrthāya dharmānuṣṭhānāya/ ``arthena nityasamāsaḥ sarvaliṅgatā ca vaktavyā'' (pā. 2-1-36) iti caturthīsamāsaḥ napuṃsakatvaṃ ca/ āyuḥ - jīvitadhāraṇakālam/ vedābhyāsādibhirāyurvedopadeśakramānuṣṭhānena ca/ ``anabhyāsena vedānāmācārasya ca varjanāt/
ālasyādannadoṣācca mṛtyurviprān jighāṃsati//'' iti manuvacanāt/ atra śrutamityṛṣīṇāmiṣṭāyeti devānāmapatyāyeti pitaṛṇāmṛṇāpākaraṇapravṛttiḥ pratipādyate/ kiñca taporthamiti dārānityarthāniti tattvaviniścayāyeti dharmakāmārthamokṣākhyapuruṣārthacatuṣṭayāvāpteḥ kṛtakṛtyatā ca dyotyate/ taporthamāyuriti ca sarvasādhāraṇam/ ``āyuḥ kāmayamānena dharmārthasukhasādhanam/
āyurvedopadeśeṣu vidheyaḥ paramādaraḥ//'' ityukteḥ/ ādaraṇakriyāyā madhyamadhyāsīnāyāḥ prākaraṇikasarvavākyārthasambandhāt tulyayogiteyam/ atra ca vākyacatuṣṭayena kramāt khyātyādīnāṃ draviṇalobhasya viṣayalaulyasya dehābhimānasya cārthataḥ paryudāsāt parisaṅkhyālaṅkāraḥ//7//
tat yasmādevaṃ padmanagare brahmavādinaḥ prativasanti tasmāddhetoḥ/ ``āmuṣyāyaṇāmuṣyaputrikāmuṣyakuliketi vaktavyam (vā. 6. 3. 21) ityupasaṃkhyānāt aluk/ prakhyātapitṛjāte'patyapratyayaḥ/
``prakhyātāt piturutpanna āmuṣyāyaṇa iṣyate'' ṣṭiti halāyudhaḥ/ tatra bhavatastasmin padmanagare sambhūtasya/ ``vartamānasāmīpye vartamānavadvā'' (3. 3. 31) iti śatā, na punastatrabhavata iti pūjāvācitvena yojanīyaḥ/ prastutabrāhmaṇasambandhapratipādakaśabdāntarābhāvāt pūjāvācibhaṭṭaśabdaprayogācca/ bhaṭṭācāryabhaṭṭabāṇādivat/ pavitrā pāvanī/ śrīkaṇṭhapadalāñchanaḥ - kanakapaṭṭādiniviṣṭā parameśvarapadanyāsamudrā śikhādidhṛtā lakṣaṇaṃ yasya/ anena śivabhaktyatiśayaḥ sūcitaḥ/ tattvajñānamuṣitadevatābhedānāmapi, ``bhaktyā māmabhijānāti yāvānyaścāsmi tattvataḥ'' iti bhagavadvacanāt/ tattvajñānasya bhaktimantareṇānupapatterbhakteśca pūrvajanmavāsanāvaśāt kvacideva devatāviśeṣe sambhavādevamuktiḥ/ na punarbhedadarśitayā/ ``dvaitino'tathyadarśinaḥ'' iti/ ``sṛṣṭisthityantakaraṇīṃ brahmaviṣṇuśivātmikām/
sa saṃjñāṃ yāti bhagavāneka eva janārdanaḥ''ṃ//
iti bhedanindanādabhedapratipādanācca/ ``śreṣṭhaḥ paramahaṃsānām'' ityādinā svayaṃ paramahaṃsaparivrājakāntevāsitvakathanāt la ``yadvedādhyayanaṃ tathopaniṣadāṃ sāṅkhyasya yogasya ca jñānam'' iti jñānitvokteśca/ padamiti padaśuddhyupalakṣitaṃ vyākaraṇaśāstram, vākyaṃ vākyavicāraparaṃ mīmāṃsādiśāstram, pramāṇaṃ pramāṇādipadārthalakṣaṇaparīkṣaṇavicakṣaṇamakṣapādādiśāstram, tāni jānātīti padavākyapramāṇajñaḥ/ bhavabhūtirnāma prasiddhaḥ/ kaviḥ prājñaḥ kāvyakṛcca/ ``prājñakāvyakṛtau kavī'' iti vaijayantī/ nisargasauhṛdāt akṛtrimaṃ mitrabhāvamavalambya/ ``lyablope pañcamī''/ nisargasauhṛdetyanena tatkṛteḥ svairavaśyamādaraṇīyatvaṃ dyotyate/ svakṛtiṃ svasya karma/ evaṃprāyaguṇabhūyasīṃ - evaṃśabdo bhūmnetyādyuktaguṇaparāmarśakaḥ/ prāyaḥśabdastulyaparyāyaḥ/ etādṛśaguṇabahulām/ evaṃprāyeti tādṛśānāṃ guṇāntarāṇāṃ nītiśāstrayojanādīnāmapi bāhulyaṃ sūcayati/ asmākamiti/ sampradānatvavivakṣābhāvāt sambandhamātre ṣaṣṭhī/ arpitavān dattavān/ yatra kṛtau/ khalu prasiddhau/ iyamiti vakṣyamāṇaparāmarśaḥ/ vācoyuktiḥ vāgupapattiḥ/ ``vāgdikpaśyadbhyo yuktidaṇḍahareṣu'' (vā. 6. 3. 21) iti ṣaṣṭhyā aluk//
ye nāmetyādi/ nāma sambhāvanāyām/ ``nāma prākāśyasambhāvyakrodhopagamakutsane'' iti vaijayantī/ keciditi sambhāvyamānatvādevānirdhāritaviśeṣo nirdeśaḥ/ iheti svavartanāsannadeśaparāmarśaḥ/ na iti/ ``asmado dvayośca'' (1. 2. 59) ityātmani bahuvacanam/ prathayanti vistārayantīti svasamakālavartitvaṃ dyotayati/ avajñāṃ - avamānanāṃ ``rīḍhāvamānanāvajñāvahelanamasūrkṣaṇaṃ'' ityamaraḥ/ ihāvajñāṃ prathayantītyanena ``sannikarṣo hi martyānāmanādaraṇakāraṇam'' ityetadanusmārayati/ yathāha kavivallabhaḥ ``saṃstutādaparijñātastasmādvaideśikaḥ kaviḥ/ tato'pi tāvat svaryāto yāti śraddheyasūktitām''// % ̈UŏTĕ and RĕF Kavivallabha = ??
iti/ kimapīti/ tattāvadarvāci parvaṇi tasthuṣāmasmādṛśāṃ paricchedapadavīṃ na ḍhaukata iti bhāvaḥ/ tānprati - tādṛśānmahāmatīn lakṣīkṛtya/ eṣa yatnaḥ evaṃ guṇaprakaraṇanirmāṇasaṃrambharūpaḥ pratibhāvyāpārapariśramaḥ/ tarhi kaṃ pratītyākāṃkṣāyāmāha - utpasya[tsya]te janiṣyate/ tuśabdo vyāvṛttau/ na khalu sarve sarvatra sarvadā ta iva mahāmatayo bhavantīti niyatirityarthaḥ/ ko'pīti keciditivatsambhāvyamānatvāt sāmānyanirdeśaḥ/ samānadharmā - mandabuddhitvālpaśrutatvādiguṇaḥ sadṛśo yasya/ ``dharmādanic kevalāt'' (5. 4. 124) (ityanic)/ anumānaṃ cedam/ tathā hi ko'pīti dharminirdeśaḥ/ samānadharmotpatsyata iti pratijñā/ kālasya niravadhitve sati pṛthavyā vaipulyāditi hetuḥ/
``anādirbhagavān kālo nānto'sya dvija vidyate'' iti, ``pañcāśatkoṭivistīrṇā seyamurvī mahāmune'' iti ca viṣṇupurāṇavacanāt/ hiśabdena prasiddhiṃ dhvanatā sarvajanasaṃvāvadūkamudāharaṇamanusmāryate/ yathā bhūte kāle vipule dharaṇītale jāteṣu mandātmatayā kecinmatsadharmāṇo'pi jātāḥ śrūyante/ adya ca yathāhaṃ jātastadvadityupanayanigamanavākye apyevamūhye/ tān prati neti niṣedhasāmarthyādya utpatsyate taṃ pratītyarthasiddheḥ kaṃ pratītyākāṃkṣā ca pūritā bhavati/ uttarārdhe ca kāvyaliṅgamalaṅkāraḥ/ śāstrānumānavailakṣaṇyena hetorvākyārthatayā nirdeśāt/ kimapīti samānadharmeti ca stutinindāsādhāraṇyena yojanīyau/ atra ca gurucaraṇaparicaraṇavimukhānāmidānīntanānāṃ pallavagrahaṇadurlalitānāṃ kṣullakānāṃ gambhīramadhurasandarbhagarbhitarasasudhānirjharodgāriṣu sakalaśāstrārthakadambakapratibimbanamaṇimukuravimbeṣu mādṛśāṃ prabandheṣu jātyandhānāmiva ratnapravekaparīkṣaṇeṣu kutastyo'dhikāraḥ ṛ// ``aśaktāstatpadaṃ gantuṃ tato nindāṃ prakurvate'' iti nyāyena asmannindaiva teṣāmasūyājvaradoṣabheṣajaṃ bhavatu/ kā hāniḥ/ anyaḥ punaravanyāṃ yatra kutracidyadākadācidutpanno yaḥ kaścidatiniśitamatiramalavipulavidyāvidyotitaḥ sahṛdayo maṇimiva maulimānayiṣyatyāmukhe māsamānāyāḥ stuternindātvena prarohādvyājastutiralaṅkāraḥ/ keciditi khalānāṃ kauleyakānāmiva bāhulyam/ ko'pīti sujanasya viduṣo mṛgamadasyeva durlabhatā ca dyotyate//8//
tatprakhyāpanāya - tasyāḥ kṛteḥ prakāśanāya/ ``bharatāstu kuśīlavāḥ'' ityamaraḥ/ yathāsvaṃ svasvavyutpattyanatikrameṇa/
``nṛttaṃ gītaṃ ca vādyaṃ ca trayaṃ saṅgītamucyate'' iti halāyudhaḥ/ varṇikā tattadveṣaḥ gāne gāyakāṃ vādyavādane vādakāstattadveṣasaṃgrahe ca nartakā ityarthaḥ/ kavivarṇanaṃ pratīti/ prabandhakartuḥ kavivarṇanaṃ praśaṃsanarūpamaṅgamuddiśyetyarthaḥ/ tena kavinā/ tuśabdenaitadāha -- ``utpatsyate tu mama ko'pi samānadharmā'' ityuktyā sphuritasya madahaṅkārasya guruprasāda eva nidānaṃ nānyat kiñcit, ``ācāryavān puruṣo veda'' iti śruteḥ, sadgurulābhaśca sakalasampadāmuparīti samādhānaṃ kṛtamiti//
guṇaiḥ satāmityādi/ ``sadbhāve sādhubhāve ca sadityetat prayujyate'' iti sādhuvācakasya sacchabdasya saujanyādiguṇadvāreṇaiva pravṛtterguṇavanta eva santa iti sthitam/ ataḥ satāṃ guṇairna punarasmākaṃ guṇyapekṣeti bhāvaḥ/ anena guṇānāmeva paropakāraparatā naisargikīti dyotyate/
``tathā hi sarve tasyāsan parārthaikaphalā guṇāḥ''/
itivat/ ka iti/ niravagraheṇa sarvanāmnā vastutaḥ sannasannapīti dhvanyate/ guṇaḥ vāditvakavitvādiḥ/ prakhyāpitaḥ prakāśitaḥ/ bhavedityanavaklṛptau liṅ/ atra hetumāha - yathārthanāmā abhidheyamanatikrāntaṃ nāma padaṃ yasya/ bhagavām[n] jagadutpattyādisarvavijñānasampannaḥ/ bhagavacchabdena paramahaṃsasannyāsitvamapi sūcayati//
``bhagavadbhiridaṃ gurubhaktiyutaiḥ paṭhitavyamapāṭhyamato'nyajanaiḥ''/
ityādyācāryavacanāt ``śreṣṭhaḥ paramahaṃsānām'' iti kavinaiva mahāvīracarite pratipāditatvācca/ jñānanidhiḥ jñānānyasminnidhīyante ityadhikaraṇe ghoḥ kiḥ/ yathā dhanadevatā niravadhiratnādinidhānānnidhaya iti vyapadiśyante tatheti nāmapadakathanam/ gururiti paramopakāritayā pitrādibhyo mānyatvaṃ dhvanyate/ ``sa gururyaḥ kriyāḥ kṛtvā vedamasmai prayacchati''ṃ/
iti yājñavalkyasmaraṇāt// ``utpādakabrahmapitrorgarīyān brahmadaḥ pitā/
brahmajanma hi viprasya pretya ceha ca śāśvatam''ṃ//
iti manuvacanācca/ atra guruviṣayo bhāvaḥ pratīyate/ udāttamalaṅkāraḥ/ mahāpuruṣacaritasyāṅgatvena varṇanāt//9//
apiceti pūrvoktyā samuccinoti/
yadvedādhyayanamityādi - karmopāsanājñānakāṇḍalakṣaṇasya sarvasyāpi vedasyānuṣṭhānasādhanārthajñānapūrvakaṃ grahaṇam/ vedo nāma parameśvarānniśvasitavadanāyāsenāvirbhūtatvādapauruṣeyasandarbho gabhastimālivat samastapuruṣārthaprakāśako'nādirananta udāttādisvaroccāryaḥ paramapramāṇabhūtaḥ śabdarāśiḥ/ tatheti/ tena prakāreṇa/ svarūpagrahaṇapūrvakamityarthaḥ/ upaniṣadāṃ jīveśvaraikyaviṣayasamyakjñānapratipādanaikaparāṇāṃ vedāntānām/
``yasmācca nirgatā vedā vedāntānyakhilāni ca'' iti/ ``vedaiśca sarvairahameva vedyo vedāntakṛdvedavideva cāham'' itivat/ vedaśabdenaivopasaṃgṛhītatve'pi pṛthagupādānamantaḥkaraṇaśodhanasādhanatayā jñānāṅgabhūtakarmapratipādakāt pūrvabhāgāt paramānandarūpavidehakaivalyasādhanajñānapratipādakasyottarabhāgasyābhyarhitatvaṃ dyotayati/ ``sarvaṃ karmākhilaṃ pārtha jñāne parisamāpyate''ṃ/
iti bhagavadvacanāt ``pratyakpravaṇatāṃ buddheḥ karmāṇyutpādya śuddhitaḥ/
kṛtārthānyastamāyānti prāvṛḍante ghanā iva''ṃ//
iti śrīviśvarūpācāryavacanācca/ jñānaṃ śaktitātparyaparyālocanena prameyanirṇayaḥ/ upaniṣadāṃ jñānamiti/ ``kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti'' (2-3-65) iti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī/ pūrvanirdeśāt svābhimatatvaṃ vedāntajñānasya prakāśayati/ sāṃkhyasyeti/ mūlaprakṛtiravikṛtiḥ sattvarajastamasāṃ sāmyāvasthārūpā cicchaktiśūnyā puruṣasya bhogamokṣārthe svata eva pravartamānā pariṇāmaparispandavyāpārā prasavadharmiṇī sakalapuruṣasādhāraṇabhogyasvarūpā ca/ puruṣastu jñānamātrasvarūpo nirguṇo niṣkriyo niṣpariṇāmo na ca vikṛtiḥ na ca prakṛtiḥ, tasya cājñānavijñānanibandhanau bandhamokṣau/ puruṣāśca bahavaḥ pratidehaṃ bhinnāḥ sarve sarvagatāśca/ mahānahaṃkārastanmātrāṇi ca svakāraṇaṃ prati vikṛtayaḥ svakāryaṃ prati prakṛtayaḥ ityubhayarūpāḥ prakṛtivikṛtayaḥ, ekādaśendriyāṇi pañcabhūtāni ceti ṣoḍaśa vikṛtaya eveti pañcaviṃśatistattvāni/ īśvaro nābhyudgamyate/ puruṣārthasya hetoḥ svayameva kṣīravat pravartamānāyāḥ prakṛteḥ kimantargaḍunā pramāṇaśūnyapravartakāntaraparigraheṇetyādyarthapratipādakaṃ dṛṣṭānumānāgamapramāṇakaṃ kapilamunipraṇītaṃ śāstraṃ sāṅkhyaṃ nāma/ yogasyeti/ yogo nāma hairaṇyagarbhaṃ śāstram/ tatrāpi sāṃkhyavattattvāni pramāṇāni ca/ īśvarastu dharmyādharmyakarmaphalapradātā ṣaḍviṃśako'bhyupagamyate/ vikāreṣu ca prakṛtermahān jāyate mahataḥ ṣaḍviśeṣāḥ ahaṃkāraḥ pañca tanmātrāṇi ca/ tatrāhaṃkārasyāviśeṣasya viśeṣā ekādaśendriyāṇi śabdatanmātratāviśeṣasya viśeṣa ākāśaḥ/ evaṃ sparśatanmātrādīnāmaviśeṣāṇāṃ vāyvādayo viśeṣā ityādi pratipādyate/ sāṃkhyasya yogasya jñānamiti sambadhyate/ cakāro'nuktasamuccayārthaḥ/ pāñcarātrapāśupatayoścetyarthaḥ/ tayorapi śiṣṭaiḥ pramāṇatvābhyupagamāt/ ``sāṃkhyo yogaḥ pāñcarātraṃ vedāḥ pāśupataṃ tathā/
etānyapi pramāṇāni na hantavyāni hetubhiḥ//'' iti mahābhāratokteḥ/ ``trayī sāṃkhyaṃ yogaḥ paśupatimataṃ vaiṣṇavami''ti bhaṭṭācāryokteśca/ eṣāṃ ca pratipādanaprakārabhede'pi pratipādyaparatattvaikyādavaśyajñeyatvam/ anyeṣāṃ tu darśanānāṃ keṣāñcit pūrvapakṣatvena bādhyatvāt keṣāñcidvimardāsahatvena heyatvāccetadagrahaṇamiti veditavyam/ tatkathanena, mameti pūrvaślokādāyāti, ekavaktṛkatvāt/ mama tadastīti vacanena kiṃ phalamiti śeṣaḥ/ tatastatkathanād jñānādvā/ kaścidekaḥ/ apiśabdo'dhyāhartavyaḥ/ guṇa upakāraḥ/ nāṭaka iti/ nāṭakasya prakaraṇaprakṛtitvāt kāraṇena kāryavyapadeśaḥ/ na kaścidapyupakāra ityarthaḥ/ athavā kaścicchabdo'paricchedyamukhena mukhyavācakaḥ, ``yaḥ kaścidvikramo'yaṃ'' ``ko'pyeṣa vīraśiśukākṛtiḥ'' ityādiṣu tathā darśanānmukhya upakāro nāsti, asyopaskārakatvamātram/ upaskāryāyāḥ śaktereva kavitvaṃ prati prādhānyamiti bhāvaḥ/ vyutpattitaḥ śaktereva kavitvaṃ prati prādhānyād avyutpattikṛtasya doṣasya śaktyatiraskriyamāṇatvāt/ aśaktikṛtasya tu vyutpattyā nihnotumaśakyatvāt/ bahujñasyāpi loke śaktivandhyasya tricaturapadaguṃbhanārambhe'pi stambhakampādisambhramaśālinaḥ, samaradharaṇīmavatarata iva kātarasya, vacaḥprasarāniṣpatterniṣpattau vā hāsyāyatanatvāt/ kiñcijjñasyāpi tu śaktimataḥ kimapi racayitumunmukhasya siddhāñjanarañjitadṛśa iva mahānidhīnāṃ svarasata evāhamahamikayāhaṃpūrvikayā ca vividhabhaṅgitaraṅgitānāṃ śabdānāṃ prādurbhāvādanvayavyatirekābhyāṃ kavitvabījarūpasaṃskāraviśeṣātmikā śaktireva pradhānam/ vyutpattistu tadupaskāriketi nirṇayaḥ/ prapañcitaścāyamartho dhvanikāraiḥ/ ataḥ śaktikāryamāha - yat prauḍhitvamityādi//
``ukteḥ prauḍhaḥ parīpākaḥ procyate prauḍhisaṃjñayā''/
iti śrībhojaḥ/ pākaśca lakṣito vāmanena ``yatpadāni tyajantyeva parivṛttisahiṣṇutām/
taṃ śabdanyāsaniṣṇātāḥ śabdapākaṃ pracakṣate''ṃ//
iti/ nālikerasahakāramṛdvīkāpākeṣu nālikerapākaścāyamiṣyate/ kramotkarṣāt dṛḍhamadhuratvācca/
``padārthe vākyavacanaṃ vākyārthe ca padābhidhā/
prauḍhirvyāsasamāsau ca sābhiprāyatvamasya ca//''iti vāmanenārthadvārāpi pauḍhiruktā/ tadubhayamapyatra svīkriyate/
``vikaṭākṣarabandhatvamāryairaudāryamucyate/''iti śrībhojaḥ/
``utkarṣavān guṇaḥ kaścidukteryasmin pratīyate/
tadudārāhvayaṃ tena sanāthā kāvyapaddhatiḥ//''iti daṇḍinaḥ/ tadubhayaṃ gṛhyate/ śabdārthagatatvena dvayoraṅgīkārāt/ arthato gauravamabhidheyasya lāghavapratiyogiko guṇaḥ/ vimardasahatvaṃ vyaṅgyaprādhānyena camatkārakāritvaṃ ca/ lāghave punastārkikagocaraṃ gatasyārthasya caṇḍamārutolluṇṭhitasya tūlapiṇḍasyeva śatadhā khaṇḍanaprasaṅgāt/ arthataḥ iti ṣaṣṭhyarthe tasiḥ/ prau (ḍha ṛḍhi)tvamudāratā ceti/ yaditi dvābhyāṃ vacasāṃ viśeṣyamāṇatvādekasya yadupādānaṃ gauraveṇa arthasyaiva viśeṣyamāṇatvāt pṛthak yacchabdopādānamiti mantavyam/ taditi vākyārthabhūtaṃ vastu parāmṛśyate/ tataḥ tasminnāṭake/ saptamyarthe tasiḥ/ tadeva tadvastveva/ gamakaṃ jñāpakam/ gatyarthānāṃ buddhyarthatvāt/ pāṇḍityaṃ paṇḍitasya karma bhāvo vā śabdārthajñānaṃ bāhuśrutyaṃ ca/
``paṇḍā tu saṃskṛtā buddhistadvān paṇḍita ucyate/''vaidagdhyaṃ vidagdhasya karma bhāvo vā/ vyaṅgyārthasaṃvit vyañjakaśabdaprayogasāmarthyaṃ ca/
``agrāmye saralodāravidagdhacchekadakṣiṇā/''iti vaijayantī/ boddhṛtvavidagdhatvavyapadeśayoḥ śabdārthasādhanajñānamātravyaṅgyajñānakāryatvasya kāvyaprakāśe pratipādanāt/ ``paṇḍito vāpyanātmavān'' iti mahābhārate ca paṇḍitātmavatorbhedapratipādanāt/ ``guṇavacanabrāhmaṇādibhyaḥ karmaṇi ca'' (5-1-124) iti ṣyañ/ cediti/ anena parīkṣakān prati yatnataḥ parīkṣaṇaprārthanā sūcyate/ atra pūrvārdhe kṛtasya kathanasyākṣepādākṣepaḥ/ uttarārdhe yadyarthoktau kalpanādatiśayoktirarthāpattiścālaṅkāraḥ/ asti dakṣiṇāpatha ityādinā pāṇḍityavaidagdhyayorityantena prakaraṇena bharatavihitetikartavyatārūpasambandhābhidheyaprayojanajñāpanārthaṃ kavinā svagotranāmanī pratipādite/
``yānudāharantyāryamiśrāḥ'' ityādinā pariṣadaḥ pūjā/ ``bhūmnā rasānām'' ityādinā paramānandānubhavaḥ paramaprayojanam/ vyutpattyādayastvavāntaraphalāni sūcitāni/ ``prakaraṇanāyakasya mālatīvallabhasya mādhavasya'' iti vakṣyamāṇena mālatīmādhavau nāyakau, tāvadhikṛtya kṛto grantho mālatīmādhavamiti prakaraṇanāma ca sūcitaṃ veditavyam/ ``lubākhyāyikābhyaḥ pratyayasya bahulam'' (vā. 4-3-87) iti lup/ aṇ vā/ yathoktaṃ bharatena ``gotraṃ nāma ca gṛhṇīyāt pūjāvākyaṃ ca pārṣadaḥ/
nāṭakasya ca yannāma garbhanirdiṣṭalakṣaṇam//'' iti/ atha ``divyamartye sa tadrūpo miśramanyatarastayoḥ/
sūcayedvastubījaṃ vā mukhaṃ pātramathāpi vā//''iti vacanāt//10//
bhaṅgyā pātrasūcanamukhena kāvyārthaṃ sthāpayati - naṭaḥ - tā iti/ tacchabdo'nubhataṃ parāmṛśati/ ``tattadveṣastu bhūmikā'' iti vaijayantī/ bhūmikāśabdenātra tadanuguṇaḥ kavivyāpārabhūtaḥ śabdasandarbha ucyate/ ``śṛṇuta manobhiravahitaiḥ kriyāmimāṃ kālidāsasya'' ityatra śṛṇuteti, na tu paśyatetyukteḥ/ tadaiva - yadā svakṛtimarpitavān tadanantaramevetyarthaḥ/ vargyāḥ/ asmadyūthabhavāḥ ``digādibhyo yat'' (4-3-55)/ pāṭhitāḥ adhyāpitāḥ/ ``gatibuddhipratyavasānārthaśabdakarmākarmakāṇāmaṇi kartā sa ṇau'' (1-4-52) iti śabdakarmakatvād dvikarmakatā/ saugatajaratpravrājikāyāḥ, bauddhasiddhāntavartinyā vṛddhāyāḥ sannyāsinyāḥ kāmandakīti saṃjñā/ prathamāṃ sarvapātrādibhūtām/ adhīte paṭhati/ tadantevāsinyāstacchiṣyāyāḥ/ ``śayavāsavāsiṣvakālāt'' (6-3-18) iti sampamyā aluk/ avalokiteti saṃjñā/ adhīya iti sāmarthyāt puruṣavipariṇāmaḥ/ bhūmikāmiti ca tuśabdenākṛṣyate/
anuvādyasya vidheyamukhaprekṣitvamāśaṅkya sūtradhāraḥ pṛcchati -- tataḥ kimiti/ tasmāttava kiṃ vivakṣitamityarthaḥ/
kathaṃ kena prakāreṇetyavasarapraśnaḥ/
tasyottaramāha - kalahaṃsamakarandapraveśāvasara iti/ kalahaṃso mādhavasya ceṭaḥ/ makarandaḥ suhṛt/ kalahaṃsamakarandetyuddeśakrameṇa praveśakramaṃ sūcayati - taditi/ tadvastvityarthaḥ/ suvihitaṃ kartavyatvena suṣṭhu śikṣitamityarthaḥ/
tena hīti/ evaṃ suvihitaprayogatayetyarthaḥ/ atrabhavataḥ pūjanīyān/ sāmājikān samāje bhavān/ ``tatra bhavaḥ'' (4-3-53) iti ṭhañ/ upāsmahe sevāmahe/
bāḍhaṃ dṛḍhaṃ, yuktamityarthaḥ/ bhūmikāparigrahajhāṭityāt kriyādākṣyaṃ prakāśayati - eṣo'smīti/ vidheyasya kāmandakītvasyoddeśye viśrāntyā saṃvṛtta ityetado viśeṣaṇāt pulliṅgatā/
naṭaḥ sasmitamiti/ spardhayā dākṣyaṃ prakāśayati -- ahamapīti/ saṃvṛtta iti sambadhyate pūrvavat/
parivṛtya nepathyaṃ gatvetyarthaḥ/ raktapaṭikānepathyau tatsamayasiddhacīvaraparyāyakaṣāyavastrālaṅkārau/ upalakṣaṇaṃ caitadanyeṣāṃ kamaṇḍalvādīnāṃ yatiliṅgānām/ upaviṣṭau guruśiṣyocitāsanāsīnāvityarthaḥ/ praviśata iti naṭapravāharūpeṇa vartamānatvādvartamānanirdeśaḥ/ ete ca madhyamādhame viṣkambhapātre iti mantavyam/
``ādau viṣkambhakaṃ kuryādaṅkaṃ vā kāryayuktitaḥ/
apekṣitaṃ parityajya nīrasaṃ vastuvistaram//
yadā sandarśayeccheṣaṃ kuryādviṣkambhakaṃ tadā/'' ityukteḥ/
``vṛttavartiṣyamāṇānāṃ kathāṃśānāṃ nidarśakaḥ/
saṃkṣepārthastu viṣkambho madhyapātraprayojitaḥ//
ekānekakṛtaḥ śuddhaḥ saṅkīrṇo nīcamadhyamaiḥ/'' ityukteḥ saṅkīrṇaścāyam/ ata eva saṃskṛtaprākṛtamiśratvam/
``pāṭhyantu saṃskṛtaṃ naṛṇāmanīcānāṃ kṛtātmanām/
liṅginīnāṃ mahādevyā mantrijāveśyayoḥ kvacit//'' ityukterliṅginītvāt pūrvasyāḥ saṃskṛtavyavahāraḥ/ anyasyāstu liṅginītve'pi śiṣyātvāt prākṛtavyavahāraḥ/ prathamaṃ pravrājikāpraveśaśca kāmasūtraprayojanasyārambha iti mantavyam/
``gāndhikamālikarajakastrī pravrājikātha viketrī/
dhātrī prativeśanikā sthirabhāvā dūtya etāḥ syuḥ//'' iti kāmasūtrokteḥ/ bhagavatītyāmantraṇaṃ ca/
``bhagavanto'dhamairvācyā vidvaddevarṣiliṅginaḥ/
ityukteḥ/ vatsa iti ca/
``rathī sūtena cāyuṣmān pūjyaiḥ śiṣyātmajānujāḥ/
vatsa tāteti pūjyo'pi sugṛhītābhidhaśca taiḥ//'' ityukteḥ/ evamanyatrāpyaucityānusāraḥ kartavyaḥ/
ājñāpayatu bhagavatī/ anena tadvacane vakṣyamāṇe bahumānātiśayaṃ sūcayati/
api nāmetyādi/ atra hetuḥ - kāryaṃ - dharmārthānubandhi kāmātmakam/
``kāryaṃ trivargastacchuddhamekānekānubandhi ca/'' iti vacanāt/ tathāhi - caritabrahmacaryasyāsya sarvopakārakṣamaṃ dvitīyamāśramamavalambituṃ prāptakālasya sahadharmacāriṇīlābho yajñapañcakasādhanatvāt sukhahetutvādrājāmātyarūpabandhulābhānubandhitvācca trivargamūlam/
``yadā bhartā ca bhāryā ca parasparavaśānugau/
tadā dhamārthakāmānāṃ trayāṇāmapi saṅgatiḥ//'' iti mahābhāratokteḥ/ atastatkāryabījaṃ sacivasthānīyakāmandakīmukhenopakṣipati/ tadāyattasiddhitvānnetuḥ/
``stokoddiṣṭastu taddhetubījaṃ vistāryanekadhā/'' iti vacanāt/ api nāmeti sambhāvanādyotakamavyayam/ kalyāṇinoḥ kalyāṇaṃ puṇyakarma, tadvatī kalyāṇinī, tadvān kalyāṇī/ ata iniḥ/ tayoḥ kalyāṇinoḥ/ ``pumān striyā'' (1-2-67) ityekaśeṣaḥ/ anena daivasampannatvādavyabhicaritasiddhitvaṃ tayoḥ, atisnehaḥ punarasmān vyākulayatīti dyotyate/ anayoriti santatabuddhisthatvādaparokṣanirdeśaḥ/ bhūrivasudevarātāpatyayoriti/ yathāsaṅkhyena bhūrivasorapatyaṃ mālatī devarātasyāpatyaṃ mādhavaḥ, tayoḥ/ anena samānasambandhaślāghyatvaṃ vyajyate/ abhimato'smākamiṣṭatamaḥ/ pāṇigraho vivāhaḥ/ syāditi saṃpraśne liṅ/
saharṣam abhilaṣitārthasiddhisūcakasunimittajanitaścittaprasādo harṣaḥ/
``prasattirutsavādibhyo harṣo'śrusvedagadgadāḥ/'' ityukteḥ/
vivṛṇvatevetyādi/ vivṛṇvatā idaṃ tvatsamīpa eva vartamānamabhīṣṭārtharūpaṃ maṅgalaṃ dṛśyatāmiti darśayateva, na punaḥ kathayateti/ anenāvyabhicāritvānubhāvaḥ prakāśyate/ ``rāmaṃ purastātsthitamācacakṣe'' itivat/ antarajñena avasaraṃ jānatā/ sandehasamaye sphuraṇāt/ ``atrāntare sarasvatyavataraṇavārtām'' itivat/ ``āto'nupasarge kaḥ'' (3-2-3)/ sphuratā spandamānena/ vāmakena savyena/ svārthe kaḥ/ anukampāyāṃ vā/
``dākṣiṇyaṃ nāma tatprāhuranukūlapravṛttiṣu/
prāṇānapyādadānasya sthātuṃ śaktirna yad bhavet//'' iti lakṣitam/ atra tvānukūlyamātraṃ vakṣyate/ vāmaśabdaḥ pratikūlamapyāha - ``kāmasvabhāvavāma'' ityādiprayogāt/ atra sphuraṇasya vivaraṇatvenotprekṣaṇam la antarajñatvaṃ hetuḥ, ataḥ pūrvārdhe utprekṣālaṅkāraḥ/ uttarārdhe punarvirodhaḥ/ savyena dakṣiṇabhāgatvamavalambyate/ pratikūlenānukūlatvamityubhayathāpi guṇayorvirodhasphuraṇāt/ puruṣakāraphalasādhakaṃ daivānukūlyaṃ cānena vyañjitam/ atra ca kramād ārambhayatnaprāptyāśāniyatāptiphalāgamarūpapañcāvasthānvitaṃ bījabindupatākāprakarīkāryalakṣaṇamarthaprakṛtipañcakaṃ mukhapratimukhagarbhāvamarśanirvahaṇākhyāḥ pañcasandhayo bhavanti/
``mukhaṃ bījasamutpattirnānārtharasasambhavā/'' tatropakṣepādīni mukhasandherdvādaśāṅgāni/
``lakṣyālakṣya ivodbhedastasya pratimukhaṃ bhavet/'' tasya vilāsādīni trayodaśāṅgāni/
``garbhastu dṛṣṭanaṣṭasya bījasyānveṣaṇaṃ muhuḥ/'' tasya cābhūtāharaṇādīni dvādaśāṅgāni/
``krodhenāvamṛśedyatra vyasanādvā vilobhanāt/
garbhanirbhinnabījārthaṃ so'vamarśa iti smṛtaḥ//'' tasya cāpavādādyāni trayodaśāṅgāni/
``bījavanto mukhādyarthā viprakīrṇā yathāyatham/
eekārthyamupanīyante yatra nirvahaṇaṃ hi tat//'' tasya ca sandhyādīni caturdaśāṅgāni/ itthaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭyaṅgāḥ pañca sandhayaḥ pratipāditāḥ/ eṣāṃ ca ṣaṭprayojanāṅgāni vivakṣitārthanibandhanaṃ, gopyagopanaṃ, prakāśyaprakāśanam, abhinavarāgavṛddhiḥ, camatkārakāritvaṃ, kāryasyetivṛttavistara iti/ sandhyaṅgāni ca tatra tatra yojayiṣyāmaḥ/ api nāmetyādirūpakṣepaḥ/ bījanyāsādvivṛṇvatetyādiḥ parinyāsaḥ/ anukūladaivasya svavyāpārasya niṣpattinirṇayāt/
mahanto - mahān khalveṣa bhagavatyāścittāvakṣepaḥ/ avakṣepo vyākulatā āścaryaṃ ca/ yadidānīṃ cīracīvaraparigrahāṃ piṇḍapātamātraprāṇayātrāmapi bhagavatīmīdṛśeṣvāyāseṣvamātyabhūrivasurniyojayati/ tasmiṃścottruṭitasaṃsārāvagraho yuṣmābhirapyātmā nikṣipyate/ cīracīvaraṃ vastrakhaṇḍakṛtaṃ vratināṃ kāṣāyavastram/ cīvaraṃ bhikṣusaṅghāṭī ceti vaijayantī/ parigraho dhanasaṅgraho yasyāḥ/ piṇḍapāta iti bauddhādīnāṃ niyatasyāhārasya saṃjñā/ ``piṇḍapāavelaṃ vajjia'' iti svenaiva vakṣyamāṇatvāt/ ``divākaramitranāmā piṇḍapātī'' iti harṣacaritokteḥ prāṇayātrā śarīrasthitiḥ/ īdṛśeṣu vadhūvarasaṅghaṭanopāyaprayogarūpeṣu/ āyāseṣu vāṅmanaḥkāyakleśajanakeṣu karmasu/ niyojayati bhṛtyādivadājñāpayatīti sauhārdātiśayo dhvanyate/
``pṛthivyāṃ sāgarāntāyāṃ dvāveva puruṣādhamau/
gṛhasthaśca nirārambhaḥ sārambhaścaiva bhikṣukaḥ//'' iti ninditatvāt/ tasminniti niyuktaṃ vastu parāmṛśyate/ avidyākāmakarmaparatantrā sukhaduḥkhādikaluṣā laukikapravṛttiḥ saṃsāraḥ, sa evāvagraho bandhanam/ athavā varṣapratibandhaḥ/ paramānandānubhavarūpavṛṣṭipratighātakatvāt/ sa utttṛṭitaḥ khaṇḍito yena/ yuṣmābhiriti guruṣu bahuvacanam/ ātmā svarūpameva/ athavā manaḥ, tatpūrvakatvāt sarvapravṛttīnām/ nikṣipyate pāratantryeṇārpyate/ na punaryadākadācit praveśyate/ ``bhāvaī ṇiodi'' ityārambhāvasthā/
mā maivam - evaṃ mā vādīrityarthaḥ/ tvarādyotikā vīpsā/ sauhṛdasambhramadyotakaṃ nyūnapadatvam/
yanmāmityādi/ vidheyaviṣaye kartavyasthale/ sa bhavān pūjyaḥ saḥ, tatra bhavānitivat/ niyuṅkta iti/ niyojayatītyuktasya kiṃkarīkaraṇasyānusandhānam/
``vastusiddhaṃ prati prāhurudbhūtāṃ kāraṇaiḥ svakaiḥ/
sukhāvahāṃ ca tadbuddhau snehākhyāmātmavikriyām//'' iti divākaraḥ/ tasya phalaṃ prayojanaṃ hṛdayagatasya snehasya kāryānumeyatvāt/ asau saḥ ayamasāviti prayogāt/ praṇayasya ciraparicayasya/
``praṇayaḥ syāt paricaye yācñāyāṃ sauhṛde'pi ca/'' iti vaijayantī/ sāraḥ sthiroṃ'śaḥ/ ``sṛ sthire'' (3-3-17) iti ghañ/ majjetyarthaḥ/ prāṇaiḥ - śarīrasandhārako vāyuḥ prāṇaḥ, ūrdhvādhogamanādivṛttibhedād bahuvacanam/ lokānusāreṇa pūrvaṃ prāṇairityuktiḥ/ laukikānāṃ tebhyaḥ preṣṭhābhāvāt/ athaveti pakṣavyāvṛttau/ abhimatairiti tapoviśeṣaṇam/ upavāsādibhiḥ prāṇānapi parikleśya teṣāmārjitatvāt prāṇebhyo'pi tapasāṃ svalobhaviṣayatvaṃ prakāśyate/ ghaṭeteti sambhāvanāyāṃ liṅ/ upāyāntaraviraheṇaitaiḥ suhṛdaḥ kāryaṃ nirvartayituṃ śakyaṃ cet tat kṛtaṃ syāt/ na punaḥ kriyamāṇaṃ kariṣyamāṇaṃ vā tannirvartitameva bhavedityavadhāraya/ mā te'tra saṃśayo bhūdityarthaḥ/ anena suhṛtkāryasiddhiṃ pratyautsukyaṃ dhvanyate/ atra pūrvārdhe'tiśayoktiralaṅkāraḥ/ uttarārdhe prāṇebhyastapobhyaśca suhṛtkāryasya gauravakathanādvyatirekālaṅkāradhvaniḥ/ atra ``sauhārdahṛdyānī''tyukteḥ prayogārambhaśca//
kiṃ na vetsi, idamiti śeṣaḥ/ pūrvamapyasmābhiḥ prasaṅgāt kathyamānaṃ tvayā jñātamevetyarthaḥ/ yadaiva yasminneva kāle/ no'smākamiti svasyāṃ bhūrivasudevarātayośca parāmarśaḥ/ vidyā vedayanti dharmādīniti vedādiśāstrāṇi/ ``saṃjñāyāṃ samajaniṣadā''dinā kyap (3-3-99)/ parigrahaḥ svīkaraṇam/ nānādigantetyanena tattadvidyāgurūṇāṃ bhinnadeśavartitvādekatra daurlabhyam/ śraddhayā tadanusaraṇena paribhramaṇaṃ ca dyotyate/ sāhacaryamiti satīrthyatayā dharmato bhrātṛtvamabhaṅgurasnehayantritatvaṃ ca/ tadaivetyevakāreṇa cirakālamanorathatvamasyārthasya prakāśyate/ asmatsaudāminīsamakṣaṃ śiṣyātvenāsmatsambandhinyāḥ saudāminīsaṃjñāyāḥ sannidhau/ ``pratiparasamanubhyo'kṣṇaḥ'' (5-4-123) iti ṭac/ anuvādena nirvahaṇāṅgasya saudāminīpātrasya bhaṅgyā sūcanaṃ kriyate/ iyaṃ vakṣyamāṇā/ pratipipādayiṣayā sādhyārthavacanaṃ pratijñā/ avaśyaṃ niyatam/ āvābhyāṃ tvayā mayā ca/ apatyasaṃbandhaḥ apatyadvārakaḥ saṃśleṣaḥ/ strīpuṃsasādhāraṇenāpatyaśabdena daivavaśāt putravataḥ putrāya duhitṛmān duhitaraṃ dadātviti dyotyate/ itiḥ pratijñāprakāre/ iyaṃ pratijñā kāryasya mukhyaṃ bījam, kāryasya tatkāryatvāt pāṇigrahasya/ so'pi trivarge hetutvāt bījamityavagantavyam/ ``yanmāṃ vidheya'' ityārabhya ``āvābhyāmapatyasambandhaḥ kartavyaḥ'' ityantaḥ parikaraḥ/ bījasya bāhulyakaraṇāt/ taditi hai[he]tau/ satā bhavatā/
``ānvīkṣikyātmavidyā syādvīkṣaṇāt sukhaduḥkhayoḥ/
īkṣamāṇastayā tattvaṃ harṣaśokau vyudasyati//'' iti kāmandakaḥ/ tadadhyayanāya/ kuṇḍinaṃ vidarbharājanagarī ``kuṇḍinaṃ na pravekṣyāmi'' ityādivacanāt/ padmāvatīti bhūrivasornivāsaḥ purī, tām la pratītyāpatati, preṣayatetyukteḥ/
``tau dampatī svāṃ prati rājadhānīṃṣṭasampreṣayāmāsa vaśī vasiṣṭhaḥ/
itivat/ suvihitaṃ śobhanaṃ kṛtam/
suvihitatvamevopapādayati - apatyeti/ priyasyetyavaśyaṃ smārayitavyatvam/ tatsambandhasyābhyarhitatvāditi bhāvaḥ/ smṛtiṃ saṃskārodbodhanam/ loka itarajanaḥ/ ``gatānugatiko lokaḥ'' itivat/ anitarajanasādhāraṇarūpavinayamādhuryādayo guṇā yasya/ samāna eva sāmānyaḥ svārthikastaddhitaḥ/ ``brāhmaṇakṣattriyaviśāṃ sāmānyo dharma ucyate'' itivat/ tanūjastanvā jātaḥ/ ``anyeṣvapi dṛśyate'' (3-2-101) iti ḍaḥ/ prarocanārthaṃ kanyāmātrādīnāṃ prakṛṣṭarucijananārtham/ prakaṭīkṛtaḥ pratyakṣīkṛtaḥ/ pārokṣye rūpādiṣu saṃśayaprasaṅgāt/ tadidānīmityādiyuktiḥ kāryānuguṇārthasampradhāraṇāt//13//
tado/ tataḥ kimiti mālatīmamātyo mādhavāyātmanā na pratipādayati, yena caurikāvivāhe bhagavatīṃ tvarayati/ tataḥ yasmāt svayaṃ pratijñākṛtā abhijanādayaśca parasya vijñātāḥ tasmāt/ ātmanā svayam/ vibhaktipratirūpakamavyayamidam/
``apyājñayā śāsiturātmanā vāṣṭaprāpto'si sambhāvayituṃ vanānmām/'' itivat/ pratipādayati dadāti/ ``viśrāṇanaṃ vitaraṇaṃ sparśanaṃ pratipādanam/'' ityamaraḥ/ corasya bhāvaścaurikā/ ``dvandvamanojñādibhyaśca'' (5-1-133) iti vuñ/ tayānuṣṭhito vivāhaścaurikāvivāhaḥ tasmin/ lokairaparijñāta ityarthaḥ/
atra hetumāha - tāṃ yācata ityādi/ narmasuhṛt krīḍāsu mitram/ vidūṣaka ityarthaḥ/ ata eva jarāvairūpyajaḍatvādidoṣaviśiṣṭatvaṃ sidhyati/ narmasuhṛditi vāllabhyātiśayaṃ dyotayati/ nṛpamukhena natvātmamukheneti, rājamukhena punarapratyākhyeyatvam/ sākṣāt pratiṣedhaḥ na dāsyāmīti mukhataḥ pratyākhyānam/ kopāya vikṛtaye/ narapaterityarthāt/ tuśabdo bhinnakramaḥ/ ayamupāyastu śivaḥ, rājakopādyanarthaparihāreṇa śuddhaḥ/ ayamiti mukhataḥ prārabdhacaurikāvivāharūpaḥ//
accariyam/ āścaryaṃ na khalvamātyo mādhavasya nāmāpi jānātīti nirapekṣatayā lakṣyate/ apirvirodhe/ abhijanādi sarvaṃ jānannapi nāmāpi na jānātīti virodhaḥ/ nirapekṣatayā tatprasaṅgaparihāreṇa/ lakṣyate iti hṛdayasyāpratyakṣatvāt/
pravṛttyanumeyatvaṃ prakāśayati - saṃvaraṇaṃ tat/ mantraguptiḥ sā/ gūḍhākāreṅgitatvamityarthaḥ/
``saṃrakṣenmantrabījaṃ tu tadbījaṃ hi mahīkṣitām/
tasmin bhinne dhruvo bhedo gupte guptiranuttamā//'' iti kāmandakokteḥ/
na kevalaṃ lokato mantrasaṃrakṣaṇaṃ kāryamapi tvato hetorityāha - viśeṣatastviti/ bālatvānmugdhatayeti bhāviguṇadoṣāparijñātṛtvaṃ dhvanyate/ vivṛtabhāvayoḥ prakāśitaparasparābhilāṣarūpābhiprāyayoḥ/ tena bhūrivasunā/ kāryaḥ kartuṃ yogyaḥ/ arhe ṇyat/ svamatinihnavaḥ svabuddhigūhanam/ anyathāmātyabuddhyanusāreṇaivedaṃ vastu vartata iti pravādasambhāvanāt//15//
tathāpi tayoranurāgamapyuddiśya pravādo bhaviṣyatītyāśaṅkyāha - anurāga iti/ parasparapremaviṣayaḥ/ pravādo janavādaḥ/ tuśabdo viśeṣe/ na kevalaṃ doṣaḥ pratyutāsmākaṃ guṇa evetyarthaḥ/ vatsayormālatīmādhavayoḥ/ sārvalaukikaḥ sarvajanaviditaḥ/ tatra vidita ityarthe ``lokasarvalokābhyāṃ ṭhañ'' (5-1-44), ``anuśatikādīnāṃ ca'' (7-3-20) ityubhayapadavṛddhiḥ/ pravādaḥ syāccediti śeṣaḥ/ mādhavena mālatyā itaḥ pūrvamadṛṣṭatvāt/ asmākaṃ śreyaḥ praśasyataram/ hi yasmāt/ evaṃ tu itthaṃbhāve/ punaramātyamatimullaṅghya yauvanamadamohitau tau svātantryeṇa parasparānurāgataḥ pravṛttāviti kiṃvadantyāṃ bhavantyāmityarthaḥ/ pratāyag vañcayituṃ śakyau/ niraparādho'mātya iti tayoḥ pratīteḥ//16//
nītiśāstraniścitamateḥ puruṣasyaivaṃprāyeṣu prayogeṣu phalāvyabhicarimatigāmbhīryādanitarajñeyacaritatvaṃ ca loke nipuṇairnirūpaṇīyamityāha - paśyeti/ buddhyā nipuṇaṃ nirūpayetyarthaḥ/
bahirityādi/ bahiḥ hṛdayavyatirikte pratyakṣagocare sthale/ sarvākārapravaṇaramaṇīyaṃ veṣabhāṣādibhiḥ sarvaiḥ prakārairanuddhatam, akṛtrimatvapratīteḥ śobhanaṃ ca yathā syāttathā/ vyavaharan kāryeṣu nissaṃśayaṃ pravartamānaḥ/
``vi nānārthe'va sandehe hāro haraṇamucyate/
nānāsandehaharaṇādvyavahāra iti smṛtaḥ//'' iti smṛteḥ/ tanutarāṇi atisūkṣmāṇyapi/ parābhyūhasthānāni pareṣāṃ śatrūṇāmayamanyathā vṛtta iti vitarkajanakāni randhrāṇi/ sthagayati chādayati/ jhaṭiti samādhatta ityarthaḥ/ vidvān nītiśāstrārthaprayoganipuṇaḥ/ eka ityasahāyaśūratvaṃ dhvanyate/ atisandhāya vañcayitvā/
``vañcanaṃ tvatisandhānaṃ vyalīkaṃ ca pratāraṇam/'' iti vaijayantī/ kapaṭaiḥ māyāprayogaiḥ/ taṭasthaḥ tīrasthita eva na punarjalamavatīrṇa iti lākṣaṇikaḥ prayogaḥ/ yathā tīragata eva bako matsyamanveti tameva kabalīkṛtya tūṣṇīmāste, tathā svayaṃ dūrasthito'nanupraviṣṭa evetyarthaḥ/ svān ātmano'bhipretān/ arthān prayojanāni/ bahuvacanenaikasyārthasya prārabdhasyānekārthānubandhitvaṃ dyotyate/ ghaṭayati avighnamāpādayati/ sādhyamāne kārye tūṣṇīṃ bhavatu nāma, siddhe punarvikatthanamapi śobhate ityāśaṅkyāha - maunaṃ tūṣṇīṃbhāvam/ phalasiddhāvapi kaimarthakyādeva vikatthanaṃ na karotītyarthaḥ/ ``siṃhavacceṣṭamānasyu kāle karma vipaścitaḥ/
kriyamāṇaṃ svakulyāstu vidyurasyāpare kṛtam//'' iti kāmandakokteḥ/ atra cakārābhyāṃ matidhṛtyorbhāvayoḥ sandhiḥ prakāśyate/ svabhāvoktiḥ sūkṣmaścālaṅkāraḥ//17//
mae vītyādi/ mayāpi yuṣmadvacanāttena tenopanyāsena bhūrivasumandirāsannarājamārgeṇa mādhavaḥ sañcāryate/ tena teneti pratyutpannamatitvāt tadātvotpannatvaṃ dhvanyate/ ``upanyāsastu vāṅmukham'' ityamaraḥ/
dhātreyī upamātuḥ putrī/ strībhyo ḍhak/ dhātreyikāgrahaṇaṃ ca tasyā api dūtīvarge gaṇitatvāt/
bhūyo bhūya ityādi - punaḥ punaḥ/ savidhanagarīrathyayā samīpabhūtarājamārgeṇa/ ``rathyā pratolī viśikhā'' ityamaraḥ/ paryaṭantaṃ sañcaramāṇam/ aṭa gatāvityasmācchatā/ dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭveti bhayo bhūyaḥ paryaṭanaphalam/ bhavanavalabhī svagṛhakūṭāgāram, ``samaṃ vadhūbhirvalabhīryuvānaḥ'' iti māghokteḥ/ ``kūṭāgāraṃ tu valabhiḥ'' iti vaijayantī/ ``vātāyanaṃ gavākṣo'strī'' ityamaraḥ/ tadantarvartinī/ anena tasyā mādhavenādarśanaṃ kathyate, abhiyogamātrasādhyatvaṃ ca/ yathā vātsyāyanaḥ``prāsādād rājamārgāvalokinī''iti/ navaṃ viriñcaśāpadurjātamatītya prādurbhaūtam/ sākṣāditi rūpamādhuryādismaraguṇasarvasvanidhānabhūtatvaṃ dhvanyate/ utprekṣayā niratiśayamuddīpanavibhāvatvaṃ dyotyate/ ratirivetyanena bhāvinīmavyabhicaritāṃ premaphalapravṛttiṃ dyotayati/ gāḍhotkaṇṭhā antaḥ prarūḍhaḥ utkaṇṭhākhyo bhāvo yasyāḥ/
``sarvendriyasukhāsvādo yatrāstīti manaskriyā/
tatprāptīcchāṃ sasaṅkalpāmutkaṇṭhāṃ kavayo viduḥ//'' iti bhāvaprakāśaḥ/ lulitalulitaiḥ karatalamṛditamālatīmālikāvadatimlānaiḥ/ aṅgakairatisaukumāryādanukampanīyaiḥ karacaraṇādibhiḥ/ anukampāyām (5-3-76) iti kanpratyayaḥ/ upalakṣaṇe ceyaṃ tṛtīyā/ tāmyati tamu glānau/ ``ratyāyāsāditṛṭkṣudbhirglānirniṣprāṇateha ca'' iti dhanikaḥ/ tāmyatīti yattat kathitamevetyanvayaḥ/ utprekṣātrālaṅkāraḥ, sākṣāttvasya navatvasya cotprekṣyamāṇatvāt/ ``mae vi'' ityārabhya ``tāmyati'' ityantaṃ karaṇam, prakṛtārambhāt//18//
bāḍhaṃ satyam/ tahā - tathāca tayodvegavinodanaṃ mādhavapraticchandaṃ citraphalake ālikhya lavaṅgikāhaste kṛtaṃ, tayā mandārikāhaste'dya vinihitaṃ tāvat/ udvegavinodanaṃ virahaduḥkhakālakṣepaṇam/
``viyoge cāyoge priyajanasadṛkṣānubhavanaṃ ciraṃ citrālokasvapanasamaye darśanamapi/ tadaṅgaspṛṣṭānāmupagatavatāṃ sparśanamiti pratīkāraḥ kāmavyathitamanasāṃ ko'pi gaditaḥ'' iti guṇapatākokteḥ/ ``pratirūpaṃ pratikṛtiḥ praticchandam'' iti halāyudhaḥ/
vicintyeti - mandārikāhastanikṣepahetuṃ vicāryetyarthaḥ/ mādhavānucaro mādhavasya dāsaḥ/ vihāradāsīṃ bauddhāyatanaceṭīm/ ``bauddhādīnāṃ vihāraḥ syā''dityamaraḥ/ tathā daśakumāracarite ``mahataḥ kṣapaṇakavihāramaṇḍalasye''ti/ kāmayate abhilaṣyati/ anena kalahaṃsena/ tīrthenopāyabhūtena/
``tīrthamantrādyupādhyāyaśāstreṣvambhasi pāvane/
pātropāyāvatāreṣu strīpuṣpe yoniyajñayoḥ''//
iti vaijayantī/ upodghātāya mālatīvṛttāntaprasaṅgāya/ ``upodghāta udāhāra upanyāsaḥ purovacaḥ/ prastāvaḥ punarūdghāto'pi'' iti vaijayantī/ upeyāditi sambhāvanāyāṃ liṅ/ abhiprāyo lavaṅgikāyā ityarthāt/
māhavo'vi - mādhavo'pi kautūhalamutpādya mayā pravṛttamadanamahotsavaṃ makarandodyānaṃ prabhāte'nupreṣitaḥ/ tatra mālatī gamiṣyati/ tato anyonyadarśanaṃ bhavatīti/ makarandodyānaṃ nāmopavanam/ (pravṛttamadanamahotsavaṃ) pratimārūpeṇa sthitasya bhagavato madanasya pravṛttaḥ prārabdho mahotsavo yasminnityarthaḥ/
sādhu, idamiti śeṣaḥ/ matpriyābhiyogena madicchānuvartananirbandhena/ pūrvaśiṣyāṃ pradhānaśiṣyāṃ, pūrvasmin vidyāparigrahakāle vā śiṣyām/ saudāminīm asmatsaudāminīsamakṣamiti pūrvaprastutām/ smārayasi smṛtigocarīkaroṣi/ anena tasyā labdhānujñāyā deśāntaragamanaṃ sūcyate/ samānaśīladarśane tādṛśajanasmaraṇāvaśyaṃbhāvāt/
nirvahaṇopayoginaṃ tasyā vṛttāntamavalokitāmukhena sūcayati kaviḥ - bhāvaï - bhagavati sedānaīṃ saudāminī samāsāditāścaryarūpamantrasiddhiprabhāvā śrīparvate kāpālikaṃ vrataṃ dhārayati/ samāsāditaḥ prāptaḥ āścaryabhūto vismayajanako mahābhairavyādimantrasādhanajanito mahimā yasyāḥ/ āndhradeśe sakalavidyāsiddhikṣetraṃ śrīparvato nāma parvataśreṣṭhaḥ, adyāpi yatra bhagavataḥ parameśvarasya jyotirliṅgamanuvatsaramāvirbhavati/ kāpālikavrataṃ somasiddhāntasiddhaṃ niyamam, ``narāsthimālākṛtacārubhūṣaṇaḥ śmaśānavāsī nṛkapālabhojanaḥ'' ityādi krameṇeritam/
kutaḥ punaḥ/ kasmājjanācchruteti śeṣaḥ/ ``vārtā pravṛttirvṛttāntaḥ'' ityamaraḥ/
atha praśnottaramukhena prakarīpātraṃ sūcayati kaviḥ - atthi/ astyatra nagaryāṃ mahāśmaśānapradeśe karālā nāma cāmuṇḍā/ cāmuṇḍā bhadrakālī/ ``caṇḍamuṇḍā ca cāmuṇḍā carcā mārjārakarṇikā'' iti vaijayantī/
astītyanuvādaḥ/ tatsattāṃ jānāmyevetyarthaḥ/ kiletyaparamārthe/ jīvantīti jīvāḥ prāṇinaḥ, tadupahārastadrūpo baliḥ priyo yasyāḥ/ sāhasikānāṃ yathāpratibhātakāriṇāṃ rajastamaḥprakṛtīnām/ pravādaḥ ayathārtho vyavahāraḥ/ kileti pravāda iti cānena sāttvikapravṛttereva vastuto devatāprīṇanatvam, anyayostu mūḍhajanasaṃkalpakalpitatvānnātiprītijanakatvaṃ ca dhvanyate/
taṃ kkhu - tāṃ khalu śrīparvatādāgatasyeto nātidūrāsannavāsinaḥ sādhakasya muṇḍadhāriṇo'ghoraghaṇṭanāmadheyasyāntevāsinī mahāprabhāvā kapālakuṇḍalā nāmānusandhyamāgacchati/ tata iyaṃ pravṛttiḥ/ ito nagarādatidūro'tyāsannaśca na bhavatīti nātidūrāsannaḥ, tasmindeśe vastuṃ śīlamasyeti/ sādhako mantrasādhanapravṛttaḥ/ ``sādhakasya tu rakṣārthaṃ tasya rūpabhi[mi]daṃ smṛtam'' ityāgamāt/ muṇḍadhāriṇo naraśiraḥkapālabhūṣaṇadhāraṇavratasya/ ``vrate'' (3-2-80) iti ṇiniḥ/ anusandhyaṃ sandhyāyāṃ sandhyāyām/ tatastasyāḥ sakāśāt/
sarvaṃ hi samāsāditāścaryamantrasiddhiprabhāvatvādi/ saudāminyā ityarthāntarasaṃkramitavācyena dhvaninā tasyāḥ sarvaguṇasampatpātratvaṃ prakāśyate/ sambhāvyate saṃgacchata iti tarkyate/
alaṃ dāṇiṃ - alamidānīmetena/ bhagavati so'pi sahacaro mādhavasya bālamitraṃ makarando nandanasya bhaginīṃ madayantikāṃ yadi samudvahati tat khalu mādhavasyādhikaṃ priyaṃ bhavati/ etena saudāminīvṛttāntena/ alamiti pratiṣedhe/ asyāprastutatvādityarthaḥ/ sahacaraḥ satatasamīpavartī/ bālamitraṃ śaiśava eva suhṛt/ mitraśabdo nityanapuṃsakaliṅgaḥ suhṛdvācakaḥ/ samudvahati pariṇayati/ tad vastu/ adhikamiti mālatīlābhāccaritārthasya tata upari suhṛtsamṛddhyā priyātiśayopapatteḥ/
tatra tadghaṭanarūpe kārye/ setyanubhūtatadīyavaidagdhyaparāmarśaḥ/ priyasakhīti niyogādaraḥ pratīyate/
suvihitaṃ bhagavatyā/
mālatīmevetyavadhāraṇena pūrvaprastutaprotsāhanatvaṃ dyotyate/
atyudāraprakṛtiratipraśritasvabhāvā ``audāryaṃ praśrayaḥ sadā'' iti dhanikaḥ/ anenācāpalatvātkṛcchrasādhyatvaṃ dhvanyate/ nipuṇaṃ vaidagdhyādaparijñātaprayogamityarthaḥ/
nisṛṣṭārthadūtīkalpaḥ nisṛṣṭārthāyā dūtyāḥ prayogaprakāro vātsyāyanapratipāditaḥ ``sā tvenāṃ śīlato'nupraviśed'' ityādinā prakaraṇena/ ``buddhvaitasya samīhitamātmadhiyaivārabheta yā kāryaṃ sā hi nisṛṣṭārthoktā'' iti ratirahasyokteḥ/ tantrayitavyaḥ prayoktavyaḥ/
``tantraṃ svarāṣṭravyāpāre tantuvāne paricchade/
śāstrauṣadhāśvamukhyeṣu prayoge'dhvarakarmaṇām//
ekasyaivobhayārthatve'' iti vaijayantī/ atra ca pāradārikoktaprayogayojanaṃ kanyāviṣaye nandanāya mālatī pratipāditeti prakhyāpanāditi mantavyam/ atha vṛttavartiṣyamāṇakathāṃśapradarśanāvasāne ciramanīṣitārthasampattisnehaparavaśatayā daivaṃ prati prārthayate - sarvatheti/ svapravṛttyā daivānukūlyena cetyarthaḥ/
śarajjyotsneti/ vigalitameghāvaraṇatayā bahalavimalatvakhyāpanāya śaradgrahaṇam/ jyotsnā candrātapaḥ/ kāntaṃ kamanīyam/ taṃ mādhavaṃ/ nandayatu samṛddhaṃ karotu/ prārthanāyāṃ loṭ/ sā mālatī/ śarajjyotsnā kumudamivetyakṛtrimaparasparānurāgaprakāśane tātparyānnāsādṛśyadoṣaḥ/ nāyakasyopamānatve (na)kumudasyopādāne (na ṛ)liṅgabhedadoṣaprasaṅgaḥ/ dvayordvitīyāntatvenālakṣitabhedayorevānvayāt/ candra iva mukhamityādiprayogaprasiddheḥ, ``iṣṭaḥ punnapuṃsakayoḥ prāyeṇa'' iti lakṣaṇācca/ sujātaṃ śobhanajanmānaṃ, abhijanādisarvaguṇasāmagryāt/ kalyāṇī maṅgalaguṇavatī, ``upasthiteyaṃ kalyāṇī'' iti prayogāt, ``kalyāṇyādīnāminaṅ'' iti sūtrācca/ kṛtapuṇyaḥ pūrvajanmānuṣṭhitasukṛta ityanumeya ityarthaḥ/ yuvetyanena saphalayauvanatvahetuḥ pratipādyate/ barīyān urutaraḥ/ ``priyasthire''tyādinoruśabdasya barādeśaḥ, īyasun/ anyonyapraguṇaguṇanirmāṇanipuṇaḥ/ praguṇaḥ ṛjaḥ/ ``praguṇaracanayā lakṣaṇaṃ saṃkṣipāmi'' ityuktatvāt, tena ca sādṛśyaṃ lakṣyate/ parasparasadṛśarūpādiguṇasṛṣṭividagdhaḥ/ vidhāturvyāpāro brahmaṇaḥ prayatnaḥ/ phalatu anyonyasadṛśaguṇayoḥ saṃgamāt prayojanavān bhavatu/ anyathā nirarthakatayā sahṛdayopālambhagocaratvāt/ manojñaśca avicchinnapremabandhatayā satputralābhādibhiśca śubhānubandho bhūyāt/ atra pūrvārdhe upamā, uttarārdhe samaṃ cālaṅkāraḥ//19//
ubhe niṣkrānte raṅgāt bahirgate ityarthaḥ/
miśraviṣkambhaḥ saṃskṛtaprākṛtamiśratvāt/
athāṅkamārabhamāṇaḥ kaviḥ kalahaṃsamakarandapraveśāvasara iti pūrvasūcitaṃ nāyakapraveśāṅgaṃ kalahaṃsamakarandapraveśaṃ krameṇādau nibadhnāti - tataḥ praviśatīti/ gṛhītacitropakaraṇaḥ citraṃ mālatīlikhitaṃ mādhavapraticchandam upakaraṇaṃ varṇatūlikādikamālekhyasādhanaṃ ca svahastadhṛtaṃ yena saḥ/
kahiṃ dāṇiṃ - kvedānīṃ tulitamakaradhvajāvaleparūpavibhramākṣiptamālatīhṛdayamāhātmyaṃ nāthaṃ mādhavaṃ prekṣe/ tulitaścalito makaradhvajasyābhirūpasāmānyatvadarpo yena tena rūpeṇa ākāreṇa vilāsaiścāpahṛtaṃ mālatyā mano yena tanmāhātmyaṃ mahānubhāvatvaṃ yasya taṃ, nāthamiti svāmitvādupacāroktiḥ/ pariśrānto'smi/ yāvadatrodyāne muhūrtaṃ viśramya makarandasahacaraṃ nāthamādhavaṃ prekṣiṣye/ yāvacchabdo vākyālaṅkāre/
praviśya udyānamiti prakaraṇādāyāti/
kathitamavalokitayeti - ``paüttamāṇamahūsavaṃ mārandujjāṇaṃ aṇuppesido'' iti pūrvoktamanusandhatte/ pratimārūpeṇa manmathenādhiṣṭhitatvānmanmathodyānaṃ, nāmnā punarmakarandodyānam/ bhavatviti/ mamāpi tadanumatamiti bhāvaḥ/ diṣṭyā bhāgyavaśāditi kṣaṇavirahaduḥkhinastasya jhaṭiti darśanena harṣaḥ prakāśyate/ vayasyaḥ sakhā/ ita eva asminneva deśe/ nirūpya abhivartamānasya daśāṃ manasānusandhāya/
gamanamityādi/ gamanaṃ sañcaraṇam/ alasam apaṭu/ agarvoddhatamityarthaḥ/ śūnyā ahṛdayatvādabaddhalakṣā, dṛṣṭirdarśanam, asauṣṭhavaṃ vilāsaramaṇīyatvarahitamityanena gatiḥ sarvadā dṛṣṭiśca ``vilāse sasmitaṃ vacaḥ'' iti lakṣitavilāsavirahaḥ (ca) sūcyate/ śvasitaṃ śvāsaḥ/ adhikaṃ pūrvāvasthātaḥ pramāṇādhikam/ etat kiṃ nu syāt kinnimittaṃ bhavediti vitarkaḥ/ athaveti pakṣavyāvṛttau matiḥ/ ato'nyat kimiti/ ata iti vakṣyamāṇaparāmarśaḥ/ tatkimityatrāha - bhramatīti/ aviśrāntyā pravartate/ bhuvana iti jātāvekavacanam/ lokeṣvityarthaḥ/ kandarpājñāviṣayarasamagnairbhavitavyamityevarūpaṃ kāmasya śāsanam/ bhramatīti sārvakālikatvaṃ, bhuvane iti sarvapathīnatvaṃ, ājñeti rājājñāvat durlaṅghyatvaṃ ca dyotyate/ vikāri manaḥkṣobhaṇaśīlam/ lalitamadhurāḥ sukumārasundarāḥ/ te ta ityālambanarūpā uddīpanarūpāśca/ vīpsayā kiñcideva kasyacit vikāraheturiti dyotyate/ bhāvāḥ padārthāḥ/ kṣipanti nirasyanti/ ``kṣipu nirasana'' iti dhātuḥ/ iti yaditi vākyārthaparāmarśaḥ, ato'nyat kimityukteḥ/ idaṃ nimittamevaitadityarthaḥ/ gītanṛttakāmopabhogādyātmakamṛdulalitanāyakavyāpārarūpāyāḥ kaiśikīvṛtternarmasphoṭākhyamaṅgamidaṃ jñeyam/ gamanādibhirbhāvaleśairmālatyanurāgonnayanād atrānumānaṃ kāvyaliṅgaṃ cālaṅkāraḥ//20//
niśvasyeti/ arthādadhikaṃ niśvasyeti cintānubhāvaḥ/
tāmityādi - tāmiti madhurasukumāratvādisakalaguṇaviśiṣṭatvānubhavaparāmarśitvāttacchabdasya yacchabdānupādānam/ indusundaramukhīṃ ``mukhamardhaṃ śarīrasya sarvaṃ vā mukhamucyate'' iti prādhānyānmukhasya varṇanaṃ śeṣāṅgasaundaryopalakṣaṇam/ candra iva lāvaṇyādiguṇaviśiṣṭaṃ mukhaṃ yasyā iti dyotakalopinīyamupamā/ vibhāvya nayanadvāreṇānubhūyeti cittāsaṅgarūpā kāmasya dvitīyāvasthā sūcitā/ ``nayanaprītiḥ prathamaṃ cittāsaṅgastato'tha saṅkalpaḥ/
nidrācchedastanutā viṣayanivṛttistrapānāśaḥ//
unmādo mūrcchā mṛtirityetā smaradaśā daśaiva syuḥ/'' iti kāmaśāstroktaḥ/ kathaṃ kathamapi atikṛcchreṇa/ ``kathaṃ kathamapyanaiṣīt'' iti, ``kathaṃ kathamapi sā kṣapā kṣayamagamat'' iti ca bhaṭṭabāṇaprayogāt/ ``daṇḍādhikyabhayāt kathaṃ kathamapi skandhopaneyānmaṇīn'' iti murāriprayogācca/ vyapavartate itomukhaṃ pratinivartate/ natu vyapavṛttamityanenāśakyanivartanatvaṃ dhvanyate/ ma iti lajjādiguṇaviśiṣṭatvādātmanaḥ svapne'pyasambhāvitavikāratvaṃ dyotyate/ tadeva pratiṣedhamukhena darśayati - lajjāmityādi/ prāptasyaiva pratiṣedhopapatteḥ/ akṛtyād bhayaṃ lajjā tām/ vijitya viśeṣeṇābhibhūya/ vinayaḥ śāstrādānvīkṣikyādermanaso harṣaśokavyudāsaḥ, tam/ vinivārya dūrato nirasya/ dhairyaṃ vikārahetāvapyavikriyatvam/ unmathyātiśayena viloḍya/ viveko yuktāyuktavicārasāmarthyaṃ sa mantharo mando yasya tat/ akāṇḍe asthāne/ pūrvasaṃstavābhāvād durlabhatvāñcānucite sthala ityarthaḥ/ lyapo mantharavivekaśabdena sambandhaḥ/ jitendriyatvānmanodhairyasya vinayaṃ prati tasya ca guṇaprakarṣarūpaṃ lajjādikaṃ prati kāraṇatvaṃ jñeyam/ cetaso niraṅkuśatve kiṃ kartavyamiti cintākhyo vyabhicāribhāvaḥ prakāśyate/ akāṇḍa eveti cetaḥ pratyasūyā/ atra ca tāmityālambanavibhāvena niśvāsādibhiḥ anubhāvaiścintādibhirvyabhicāribhiśca saṃyuktairvyakto mālatīṃ prati mādhavasya ratyākhyaḥ sthāyibhāvaḥ śṛṅgārarasātmanā pariṇataḥ pratīyate/ ``tāmindusundaramukhī''mityatra cetaḥkṣobhaṇasamarthasya saundaryātiśayasya pratipādanāt mahilāntarebhyo vyatirekādvyatirekālaṅkāro vyaṅgyaḥ//21//
āścaryaṃ vismayakaram/
yadvismayetyādi/
``upalabdhau viruddhasya pūrvakalpanayā nṛṇām/
ahokhalvetaditi yo bhāvo vismaya eva saḥ''//
iti divākaraḥ/ tadīyarūpaśobhātiśayadarśanajanitena vismayena stimitaṃ niścalam/
``svagocaraṃ na cālyeta yattat stimitamucyate''//
iti bhāvaprakāśaḥ/ astamitānyabhāvam atyantatirobhūtapadārthāntarasmaraṇādivyāpāram, sarvendriyavṛttibhiḥ saha tatraiva līnatvāt/ ānandamandaṃ paramasukhānubhūtyā madhupānamattamivālasam/ astamitānyabhāvatve heturānandamandatvam/ amṛtaplavanāt pīyūṣahradāvagāhāt/ niratiśayasukhādyupalambhato yathā ṣaḍūrminirmūlanena tathā taddarśanānandamandamityutprekṣayā lokottaratvaṃ tatsannidheḥ prakāśyate/ abhūditi bhūtatvena smartavyatvāttasyā daśāyā dainyaṃ dhvanyate/ tasyāḥ sannidhāvityapārokṣyam/ adhunā tadasannidhāvityarthaḥ/ madīyaṃ matsambandhi/ tyadāditvād vṛddhasaṃjñāyāṃ ``vṛddhācchaḥ iti chaḥ/ madīyaṃ tadityahamapi sa evedamapi tadevetyāścaryatāmanusandhatte/ aṅgāracumbitam/ ``aṅgāro'strī praśāntārciḥ'' iti vaijayantī/ aṅgāreṇa spṛṣṭam/ cubi vaktrasparśa iti dhātuḥ/ aṅgāragrahaṇāt jvālāsparśe jhaṭiti bhasmībhāvādvedanāyāḥ kṣaṇikatvena sahyatvamaṅgārasparśasya santatadu[ḥ]khajanakatvaṃ ca dyotyate/ kvathamānaṃ pacyamānam/ āste vartate/ vartamānatvādāvego dhvanyate/ amṛtaplavanāṅgāracumbanayorupamānatvāt pūrvottarāvasthayorvirodhasphuraṇāt sānnidhyāsānnidhyaparihārācca virodhābhāsarūpo virodho'trālaṅkāraḥ/ yadvismayastimitamiti vidhānamidaṃ, sukhadukhayoḥ pratipādanāt//22//
lalāṭantapaḥ atikaṭhoratvāt lalāṭaṃ tāpayatīti ``asūryalalāṭayordṛśitapoḥ'' (3-236) iti khaś/ tapati prakāśate/
kahaṃ - kathaṃ makarandasahacara idameva bālodyānamalaṅkaroti nāthamādhavaḥ/ taddarśayāmi madanavedanāsantapyamānamālatīlocanasukhāvahamātmano'smai praticchandam/ athavā viśramasaukhyaṃ tāvadanubhavatu/ ayamiti śeṣaḥ/
ucchvasitaṃ vikasitam/ kesaraḥ kiñjalkaḥ/ kaṣāyo rañjitaḥ/ ``amunaiva kaṣāyitastanī'' itivat/ śītalo'nugraḥ/ āmodaḥ śobhanagandhaḥ/ ``āmodaḥ so'tinirhārī'' ityamaraḥ/ vāsitaḥ sugandhitaḥ/
``kovidāre camariko raktapuṣpo yugacchadaḥ/
kāñcanāro'pi'' iti vaijayantī/
yātrātaḥ pratinivṛttaṃ pratyāgatam/ kāmadevotsavasya strīpradhānatvānnagarāṅganāpravartitatvoktiḥ/ anyādṛśaṃ pūrvāvasthāto'nyathābhūtam/ avadhārayāmi niścinomītyalasagamanatvādilakṣaṇapauṣkalyādavyabhicaritatarkatvamātmanaḥ sūcayati/ ``api praśne sānunaye'' ityamaraḥ ( ṛ)/ ratiramaṇaḥ kāmaḥ/ bāṇagocaraṃ śarapatanaviṣayam/ avatīrṇaḥ prāpto'si/ vihasyeti/ lajjayā tasyākāragopanaprayatnamālocya smitaṃ kṛtvetyarthaḥ/ tat kimiti/ tasya maunamanuvādaṃ parikalpyāha - tattasmādavatīrṇo'si cedityarthaḥ/ anyathā nāvatīrṇo'si cet tat kimantargatatrapāprakāśanenāvanamreṇa mugdhena sundareṇa mukhapuṇḍarīkeṇa sthito'si/ anena avasthānenaiva karatalāmalakavadāśayo jñāta iti sūcayati/ mukhāvanamanaṃ ca lajjānubhāvaḥ/
atha sāmānyato'jñātasya viṣayābhiṣaṅgasya viśeṣaprakāśanāya taṃ viśvāsayannupapattyā lajjāṃ nirākaroti - antyeṣu jantuṣvityādi/ antyeṣu sarvayonīnāmavasāne bhaveṣu/ atinīcayonijāteṣvityarthaḥ/ jantuṣu prāṇiṣu/ kṛmikīṭādiṣvityarthaḥ/ cakāro'pyarthe virodhe/ tamasāvṛteṣu ajñānena tirohitajñāneṣu/ ``ajñānenāvṛtaṃ jñānaṃ tena muhyanti jantavaḥ/'' iti bhagavadvacanāt/ viśvasyeti niravagraheṇa sarvanāmnā sthiracarātmakaṃ jagat parāmṛśyate/ dhātari śuktiśakala iva rajatasyādhārabhūte/ anenopādānakāraṇatvamuktam/ antyatvavyatirekaścāyam/ parameśvare eeśvaryasya jñānaśaktyādeḥ viśrāntisthalabhūte śive/ ``na tatsamaścābhyadhikaśca dṛśyate'' iti śruteḥ/ anena nimittakāraṇatvamuktam/ ``prakṛtiśca pratijñādṛṣṭāntānuparodhād'' iti smṛteḥ/ tamovṛtatvavyāvṛttiśceyam/ samastulyavṛttiḥ/ parameśvarasyāpi bhaktānugrahagṛhītalīlāvigrahasya pārvatīpariṇayanārdhaśarīravibhajanādiprasiddheḥ/ apiśabdābhyāmatyantaviruddhe koṭidvaye vṛttisāmyasya vicitratvaṃ prakāśyate/ sa iti tathātvena pūrvaṃ śrutaḥ/ ayamiti/ idānīṃ tvayānubhūyamānasāmarthya ityarthaḥ/ prasiddhavibhavaḥ prakhyātaśaktiḥ/ khalviti saṃvādaṃ dyotayati/ cittajanmā manaso jananaṃ yasyetyābhyantaratvena durnivāratvaṃ dhvanyate/ kathañcit kenāpi prakāraṇeti tadarthaḥ/ pravṛttau nivṛttau vā sarvathā prakāśanameva śreya iti bhāvaḥ/ apahnutiḥ chādanam/ mā bhūt na bhavatu/ ``na māṅyoge'' (6-4-74) iti luṅo'ḍāgamapratiṣedhaḥ/ madviṣaya ityarthāt/ atra pūrvārdhe'tivaiṣamyādaghaṭitayogatvād viṣamam/ virodhābhāsatvādvirodho vālaṅkāraḥ/ uttarārdhe tvaprastutapraśaṃsā/ apahnutau ko doṣa iti/ kāryaprasaṅge manmathagatasya mahāprabhāvatvasya kāraṇatvapratipādanenāniṣṭāpātaśaṅkādyotanāt/ cittajanmano vīrāntarebhyo vyāvṛttikathanād vyatireko'laṅkāraśca vyaṅgyaḥ//23//
tatpratipādanasthirīkṛtahṛdaya āha - kinna kathayāmīti/ kimarthaṃ na kathayāmi/ vadāmyevetyarthaḥ/ kathananiṣedhākṣepo lajjayā pūrvamakathanasyādhyavasitatvāt/ śrūyatāmiti vistareṇa kathanopakramaḥ/ avalokitājanitakautuka iti ``māhavo vi kodūhalaṃ uppādia'' ityādyavalokitāvacanaṃ saṅghaṭayati/ āyatanamālayam/ itastataḥ parikramyeti āyatanavistāro draṣṭavyavastubāhulyaṃ ca dyotyate/ parikramaṇaṃ sañcaraṇaṃ pariśramāt bhramaṇakhedāt/ madirāmodo madhugandhaḥ/ parimalo bahukusumagandhasammelanam/ ākṛṣṭaṃ balāt svasamīpaṃ nītam/ sakalakalaṃ kolāhalasahitam/ milat puñjībhavat/ saṅkulaṃ sambhramaḥ tenākulitaṃ kṣobhitam/ mukulaśabdo'vikasadavasthaṃ kusumaṃ lakṣayati/ tataścollasitamadirāmodatvādaparyuṣitarasāsvādalolupatvamalīnāṃ prakāśyate/ aṅkaṇabhuvo devatāyatanājirajātasya bālabakulasya taruṇakesaravṛkṣasya/ mūlādhārabandhasamīpe yadṛcchayānabhisandhipūrvakam/ nirantaravikasitāni nirvivarāṇi vikasitāni cetyanena kusumabāhulyaṃ bālabakulasyetyadhaḥsthitagrāhyatvaṃ ca prakāśyate/ vidagdhaviracanā śilpaviśeṣakalpanādagrāmyaṃ nirmāṇam/ srajaṃ mālām/ sañcāriṇī sañcaraṇaśīlā/ jaṅgamā ityarthaḥ/ patākāntarebhyo vyatirekaḥ/ jagadvijayavaijayantikā tribhuvanavijayenotthāpitā dhvajapatākā/ jayalakṣaṇatvād dhvajasya sañcāriṇī vaijayantikevetyutprekṣā/ tataścātidhīraprakṛterapi kṣobhopapattirdyotyate/ ``patākā vaijayantikā'' ityamaraḥ/ garbhabhavanāt kāmadevāyatanakukṣernirgatyetyutprekṣāhetuḥ/ ujjvalaṃ bhāsuraṃ mahārgharatnamayatvāt/ vidagdhamagrāmyamanulbaṇatvāt/ mugdhaṃ komalaṃ, bālanepathyaṃ bālyāvasthāviśiṣṭānāṃ dhāraṇocitaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ, varṇāśramaucityena tattadavasthaucityena cābharaṇaviśeṣadhāraṇasyābharaṇaśāstrevidhānāt/ vibhāvitakumārībhāvā prakāśitakanyātvā/ ``kumārī kanyakā kanyā'' iti vaijayantī/ cāpalādyanupahataḥ prabhutvaviśeṣo'nubhāvaḥ/ ``anubhāvaviśeṣāttu senāparigatāviva'' ityuktavat/
``bhāvāḥ paropakārārthā lakṣyante yasya sarvathā/
sa cānubhāva ityukto yebhyaḥ spṛhayate janaḥ//'' iti bhāvaprakāśaḥ/ mahānubhāvaprakṛtiḥ svābhāvikamahāprabhāvā/ atyudāraparijanā akṣudraparivārā/ darśanasamaye gotranāmāparijñānāt kāpītyuktiḥ/ tatraiva tasminneva pradeśe/ anantaraṃ ca devasyetyādi bhāvanā/ adbhutarasāveśāt/
setyādi/ rāmaṇīyakaṃ ramaṇīyasya bhāvaḥ/ ramayati nayanaṃ hṛdayaṃ ceti ramaṇīyam/ ``kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam'' (3-3-113) iti kartari kṛtyaḥ/ ``yopadhād gurupottamād vuñ'' (5-1-132) iti tasya bhāve vuñ/ tasya nidhiravināśī rāśiḥ/ yathā kanakādīnāṃ rāśiḥ śaṅkhanidhyādiśabdairucyate/ adhidevatā abhimāninī devatā/ abhimantavyānuguṇayā hyadhidevatayā bhavitavyamiti bhāvaḥ/ yathā śaṅkhanidhyādīnāṃ navaratnadhārāvarṣiṇyo'dhidevatāstatra pratipāditāḥ/
``divyamālyāmbaradharā divyābharaṇalepanāḥ/
divyāṅgā nidhayo dhyeyāḥ pūrayanto dhanairdharām//'' iti/ vā vikalpe/ īśitavyādhidevatayorbhedamāśaṅkya punaranyathā vikalpayati - saundaryasārasamudāyaniketanaṃ vā iti/
``anyūnānatiriktaṃ yadaṅgapratyaṅgasauṣṭhavam/
suśliṣṭasandhibandhaṃ yattatsaundaryamudāhṛtam//'' iti bhāvaprakāśaḥ/ śikhikalāpakamalakuvalayādipadārthanirmathanena navanītamiva kāntisāramādāya tatsamudāyasya kacabharavadananayanādyaucityena niveśanasthānam/ vā ityasya saundaryasārasamudāyatvokteḥ pūrvavikalpādatiśayo jñeyaḥ/ ataśca niratiśayasaundaryāśrayatvahetunānanyasādhāraṇakāraṇajanyatvamanumīyate/ tasyā iti/ yā khalvevaṃvidhā tasyā ityarthaḥ/ sakha iti/ na khalu mayā priyavayasyasya purato'nṛtavādīti dyotyate/ niyatamasandigdhamityutprekṣādyotakam/ indukalāmṛṇālajyotsnādīti mukhasya candrakalā pāṇipādasya mṛṇālikāḥ sarvāṅgīṇasya lāvaṇyasya candrikā/ ādiśabdaḥ prakāravacanaḥ/ nayanādīnāṃ kuvalayādi vastu/ kāraṇamarthādupādānakāraṇam/ madayatīti madanaḥ trailokyamohanaṃ svarūpamāsthitaḥ kāmaḥ/ castvarthe/ vedhāḥ brahmā/ nimittakāraṇamityarthaḥ/ atra pūrvārdhe sandehaḥ/ uttarārdhe tu prasiddhakāraṇavyāvṛttyā lokottīrṇakāraṇavarṇane sambandhe'sambandhātiśayoktiralaṅkāraḥ//24//
atheti/ praṇayinībhiḥ atisnigdhajanairityanullaṅghyavacanatvaṃ dhvanyate/ anucarībhiḥ sakhībhiḥ/ pacādiṣu caraḍiti pāṭhād ṅīp/ abhyarthyamānā ramaṇīyo'yaṃ deśo darśanena sambhāvyatāmityanunāthyamānā/ alaṅkṛtavatī bhūṣitavatī/ tatsannidhānāttasya deśasya saviśeṣaramaṇīyatāpatteḥ/ kasminnapi puruṣaviṣaye/ mahābhāgadheyamaparimitabhāgyaṃ janma yasya tasmin/ tādṛśīnāṃ premāspadatvasya sukṛtaviśeṣakāryatvād bahubhirdivasairabhivardhamānam/ ūhyamānatvādivaśabdaprayogaḥ/ manmathavyathāvikāraṃ madanasantāpakāryamavasthāviśeṣam//
upalakṣitaṃ vikāraprakāramāha - parimṛditetyādi/ karatalasparśādikleśitavisakāṇḍavanmlānaṃ tāntam/ mṛṇālīgrahaṇānmṛdusnigdhamugdhadhavalatvaṃ ca pratīyate/ ``dharmayorekataranirdeśe'nyasaṃvit sāhacaryād'' iti lakṣaṇāt/ aṅgaṃ karacaraṇādikam/ kriyāsu ramaṇīyavastudarśanādiṣu/ pravṛttirudyogaḥ, parijanayācñābhirnatu svataḥ/ bahuvacanena pratikriyaṃ prārthanāyāḥ paunaḥpunyaṃ pratīyate/ tatrāpi kathamapi kṛcchreṇeti, vākyadvaye kramāt glānyālasyākhyau vyabhicāribhāvau prakāśitau/ tanutāviṣayanivṛttyākhye madanāvasthe ca/ kalayati badhnāti/ niṣkalaṅkasya nirastalāñchanasya/ abhinavasya karidantachedasya kāntiriva kāntiryasya/ chedaśabdaḥ sāmīpyād dravyaṃ lakṣayati/ abhinavaśabdo rajodhūsaratvādivirahaṃ darśayati/ niṣkalaṅkasyeti/ yadā niṣkalaṅko bhāvī tadā tasyetyatiśayoktiḥ/ himāṃśorlakṣmīmityatra lakṣmīsadṛśīṃ lakṣmīmiti nidarśanālaṅkāraḥ/ kapolapāṇḍutā ca smaravikāraḥ/ ``pāṇḍukṣāmaṃ vadanam'' iti prayogāt/
``sāvarṇyabhājāṃ pratimāgatānāṃṣṭalakṣyaiḥ smarāpāṇḍutayāṅganānām/
yasyāṃ kapolaiḥ kaladhautadhāmastambheṣu bheje maṇidarpaṇaśrīḥ//'' iti māghokteśca//25//
amṛtavartikā sudhāsāranirmitā nayanauṣadhaśalākā/ ``vartiḥ sunetrī sakalākṣirogān'' iti vāhaṭokteḥ/ niratiśayaṃ atiśete ityatiśayaḥ, nirastaṃ svasmādadhikamānandāntaraṃ yena/ upapādayantyupaharantī/ ayaskāntamaṇiśalākā ayaḥsamākarṣaṇaśaktiyuktaḥ śilāviśeṣo'yaskāntamaṇiḥ śalākā tatkīlakaḥ/ śalākāgrahaṇamupameyasya strītvāt/ lohadhātuṃ, ``dhāturmanaśśilādyadreḥ'' ityabhidhānāt/ dhātūnāṃ bahuvidhatvāllohadhātumiti ayorūpaṃ dhātumityarthaḥ/ antaḥkaraṇaṃ manaḥ/ upasaṃhṛtavatī svasamīpaṃ nītavatī/ atra cakṣuṣoriti nayanaprītirantaḥ karaṇamiti cittāsaṅgaścāvasthe pratipādite/ ``sā mama'' ityādāvupamālaṅkāraḥ/ utprekṣā vā vartikātvaśalākātvayoradhyavasāyaviṣayatvāt/ sarvathā sarvaprakāreṇeti durnivāratvaṃ dhvanyate/ atra ca ``tāmindusundaramukhīm'' ityādibhiḥ ``sā mama darśanāt prabhṛti'' ityādeḥ paunarūktyaṃ nāśaṅkanīyam, pūrvaṃ svānubhavamana (natvānā)didānīṃ svānubhūtakathanācca/
