santāpetyādi - santāpasantatiḥ smaraśaravyathāpravāhaḥ, tadrūpāya mahāvyasanāya mahatīmāpadamanubhavitum/ ``kriyārthopapadasya ca karmaṇi sthāninaḥ'' (2-3-14) iti caturthī/ āsaktaṃ samantād baddham/ anena pratyavayavaṃ saktiḥ prakāśyate/ etaditi/ īdṛśamavivekītyupālambhaḥ/ anapekṣitahetu saulabhyasāmīpyādikaṃ nimittamanapekṣamāṇam/ atha kāraṇamantareṇa kāryotpattyanupapatterbāhyakāraṇānirūpaṇāt kāryotpatteśca darśanādadṛṣṭaṃ kimapi kāraṇamanumimīte - prāya iti/ grāmo bāhulyeneti utprekṣādyotakam/ śubhaṃ cāśubhaṃ ca sukhaṃ ca duḥkhaṃ ca/ vidadhāti karoti/ sarvaṃ jagat vyāpnotīti vā, svaśaktyā nirākarotīti vā sarvaṃkaṣā/ ``sarvakūlābhrakarīreṣu kaṣaḥ'' (3-2-42) iti khac/ bhagavatīti parameśvaraśaktitvād durlaṅghyasāmarthyatvāccopacāraḥ/ bhavitavyatā tasya tasya padārthasya tattaddharmāsaṅkaraṇakāraṇaṃ niyatiśaktiḥ/
``yena yatropabhoktavyaṃ sukhaṃ vā duḥkhameva vā/
sa tatra baddhvā rajjveva balāddaivena nīyate//'' iti mahābhāratokteḥ/
``abhiśauri ratho'tha coditāśvaḥ/
prayayau sārathirūpayā niyatyā/'' iti māghokteśca/ atra pūrvārdhe vibhāvanālaṅkāraḥ/ cetaḥ prati cābhyasūyā vyajyate/ uttarārdhe tvarthāntaranyāsaḥ/ vitarko dainyaṃ ca bhāvau vyajyete//26//
atha makarandastadīyameva vitarkaṃ dṛṣṭāntamukhena sthāpayati - vayasyeti/ snehaśca svayaṃ bhavati, nimitte'rthāt bāhye savyapekṣaḥ sākāṅkṣaśca bhavatītyetadvaco vipratiṣiddhaṃ parasparaviruddham/ tulyabalavirodho vipratiṣedhaḥ/
vyāptigrahaṇapūrvakaṃ dṛṣṭāntaṃ darśayati - paśyeti/
vyatiṣajati nānāvidhamatiśayena badhnāti/ ṣañja saṅge/ padārthāniti/ na kevalaṃ cetaneṣvayaṃ niyamaḥ yāvadacetaneṣvapīti dyotyate/ āntaro'ntarbhavaḥ/ āntaraśabdenāpratyakṣatvaṃ lakṣyate/ ko'pi acintyaprabhāvaḥ/ hetuḥ niyatirityarthaḥ/ bahirupādhīn pratyakṣabhūtān hetūn/
``ekasādhyāvinābhāve mithaḥ sambandhaśūnyayoḥ/
sādhyābhāvāvinābhāvī sa upādhiryadatyayaḥ''//
iti lakṣito'pyupādhiratra kāraṇamātraparyāyaḥ, ``upādhistatrāyaṃ jayati janikartuḥ prakṛtitā'' iti murāryuktavat/ prītayaḥ parasparapremanibandhanāni sukhāni/ bahuvacanena viṣayabāhulyaṃ sūcyate/ hi prasiddhau/ pataṅgasya sūryasya udaye pūrvādrerāvirbhāve/ anena dūragatatvaṃ prakāśyate/ pataṅgasyeti dusparśatvadurnirīkṣatādirarthāntarasaṃkramitavācyena dhvaninā prakāśyate ``rāmo'smi sarvaṃ sahe'' ityatra rāmavat/ puṇḍarīkamiti ca susparśatvadarśanīyatvādiḥ/ dravati ārdrībhavati/ himaraśmāviti śaityasaukumāryādi, candrakānta iti ca kaṭhinavirasatvādiḥ, tataśca parasparopakāravirahiṇoḥ viruddhaguṇayordūradeśasthitayorapi parasparānurāgo'yaṃ dṛśyate/ sa eṣa bhavitavyatāyāḥ prabhāva evetyarthaḥ/ arthāntaranyāso'laṅkāraḥ//27//
tatastataḥ tataḥ paraṃ kathyatāmiti nāṭakanyāyādāyāti vīpsayā śravaṇakautukaṃ dhvanyate/
sabhrūvilāsamityādi/ pūrvadṛṣṭasya vastunaḥ punardarśane tadidamiti pūrvānubhavaparāmarśaḥ pratyabhijñā/ sapratyabhijñaṃ pratyabhijñāsahitam/ tathātvanirṇayābhāvād vitarkadyotaka ivaśabdaḥ/ māmavalokya nirīkṣya/ atha anantaram/ catureṇa vidagdheneti pṛthagjanāparijñeyeṅgitabhaṅgisāmarthyaṃ prakāśyate/ sakhījanena sahacarīsamūhena/ sabhrūvilāsaṃ bhrūcalanasahitam/ so'yamitīva nāma pūrvaṃ prastuto yaḥ sa evāyamitīva/ ivaśabdo'trāpi vitarkadyotakaḥ/ nāma prakāśye sambhāvanāyāṃ vā/ anyonyamevetyevakāreṇānyataḥ saṃvaraṇacāturī dyotyate/ smitasudhāmadhurāḥ sitataradaśanakiraṇavitaraṇena smitamamṛtatvena rūpyate/ smitasudhayā manoharāḥ/ kaṭākṣāḥ muktāḥ preritāḥ/ atra sūkṣmamalaṅkāraḥ//28//
atha mādhavasya tābhirdṛṣṭapūrvatvamajānānomakarandaḥ pṛcchati - kathamityāścarye/ pratyabhijñāpi kathaṃ nāmeti/ nāma sambhāvanāyām/
salīlaṃ savilāsam/ uttālā uddhatā karakamalatālikā tāsāṃ saṃhatya sthitatvāt parasparakarataladhaṭṭanam/ ``tala prahāra'' iti dhātorvuñ/ tayā taralā cañcalā valayāvalī maṇikaṅkaṇapaṅktiryatra tat/ uttrastasyātiśayena bhītasya mattasya kamalamadhupānakṣībasya kalahaṃsasya dhūsaracchadasya haṃsaviśeṣasya vibhramavadvilāsavadabhirāmeṇa caraṇasañcaraṇena pādanyāsena/ raṇaraṇāyamānaṃ raṇaraṇeti śabdānukāraḥ/ avyaktānukaraṇe ḍāc, ``lohitādiḍājbhyaḥ kyaṣ'' (3-1-13), ``vā kyaṣaḥ'' (1-3-90) iti ātmanepadaṃ, śānac/ mañjīraṃ nūpuraṃ tasya mañjunā madhureṇa rasitena śabdena anuviddhena miśritena/ mekhalākalāpasya kāñcīrūpasya bhūṣaṇasya kiṅkiṇīnāṃ kanakamayakṣudraghaṇṭikānāṃ raṇatkāreṇa śabdaviśeṣeṇa mukharaṃ vācālaṃ ca yatheti padatrayaṃ pratinivartanakriyāviśeṣaṇam/ pratinivṛtya pratīpaṃ gatvā/ bhartṛdārike iti/
``rājā bhaṭṭārako devastatsutā bhartṛdārikā'' ityamaraḥ/ rājasamasyāmātyasya duhitṛtvāt tathāmantraṇam/ diṣṭyā vardhāmahe bhāgyena sampūrṇā bhavāmaḥ/ vardhāmahe na tu vardhasa ityuktistasyāstrapāparihārāya, tvadabhyudayaḥ sarvāsāmasmākamabhyudaya iti dyotanāya ca/ ko'pīti niratiśayaguṇatvādaśakyavarṇanatvaṃ dhvanyate/ kasyā apīti/ kasyā api tathāvidhatvam/ vallabhaḥ priyatamaḥ/ ko'pi kasyā api vallabhaḥ ityarthaśaktimūlānuraṇanavyaṅgyena tava dayita iti vacanasyācaturatvāt gūḍhatvapareṇa parihāso dhvanyate/ aṅgulīvilāsena tarjanīnirdeśābhinayalīlayā ākhyātavatyaḥ kathitavatyaḥ/ aṅgulīnirdeśapūrvakaṃ tiṣṭhatītyākhyātavatya ityanvayaḥ/
hanteti harṣe/ mādhavamanīṣitānukūlatvāttadvacanasya/ ``hanta harṣaviṣādayoḥ'' iti vaijayantī/ prāganurāgasya pūrvotpannasya premṇaḥ/ udbhedaḥ prakāśanam/
sarasaramaṇīyānubandhinī strīkathā/ rasasahitamata eva ramaṇīyaṃ cārthamanubadhnāti, strīviṣayā kathā uktiḥ/
atha tasyāḥ svadarśanakāle ``tātkāliko viśeṣastu vilāso'ṅgakriyādiṣu/'' iti lakṣitaṃ vilāsākhyaṃ guṇamāha - atrāntara ityādi/ asminnavasare/ tadākhyānānantaraṃ madavalokana ityarthaḥ/ kimapi anubhavaikagamyam/ vāgvibhavātivṛttavaicitryaṃ vāgindriyaśaktimatikrāntaṃ vaicitryaṃ yasya/ ullasitabibhramam udbhūtaḥ kaṭākṣabhujākṣepādiceṣṭāviśeṣo yasmin/ utpalākṣyā iti vikacakuvalayasadṛśanayanatvamapi tasyāstadānīṃ vyaktamāsīditi dyotyate/ taditi bharatavātsyāyanādiprasiddhiṃ parāmṛśati/ bhūrisāttvikavikāraṃ sattvamantaḥkaraṇaṃ tatkṣobhajātaḥ sāttvikaḥ, bahutaraḥ kampasvedādiḥ sāttviko vikāro yasmin/
``kampaḥ svedo'ātha romāñcaḥ svarasādo'tha vepathuḥ/
vaivarṇyamaśrupralaya ityaṣṭau sāttvikāḥ smṛtāḥ//'' iti bharataḥ/ apāstadhairyaṃ cāpalānupahatacittavṛttirūpam apāstaṃ dūrataḥ kṣiptaṃ yena/ ācāryakaṃ ācāryasya karma/ ``yopadhāt gurūpottamād vuñ'' (5-1-132)/ upadeśa ityarthaḥ/
``nīcānnīcataropasarpaṇamapāmetat kimācāryakam/'' iti murāryuktavat/ vijayi vijayo'bhibhavaparavaśīkaraṇaṃ śīlaṃ yasyeti haṭhātkaraṇasāmarthyaṃ prakāśyate/ mānmathaṃ manmathasambandhi/ anena mugdhānāmapi manmathagurūpadeśāttadātvonmīladvividhavilāsavaidagdhī prakāśyate/
``upadiśati kāminīnāṃ yauvanamada eva lalitāni/'' ityukteḥ/ āvirāsīt prādurbhūtaṃ natūtpalākṣyā kṛtamiti premaprakarṣāt svarasata eva prakāśanaṃ vyajyate/ āviriti prakāśavācakamavyayam/ atra parikaro'laṅkāraḥ, atiśayoktiśca, viśeṣaṇasābhiprāyatvādvilāsaceṣṭitasyācāryakatvenādhyavasitatvācca//29//
atha ratyākhyasthāyibhāvānubhāvāṃstasyā dṛṣṭiviśeṣānāha - tataśceti/ cakāraḥ utpalākṣyā ityanukarṣaṇārthaḥ/
stimitetyādi/ bharatoktānāṃ navarasopayoginīnāṃ caturadhikaśatasya dṛṣṭīnāṃ madhye catuṣṣaṣṭidṛṣṭayaḥ śṛṅgāropayoginyaḥ, tāsu kāścit prakāśyante/ stimitānāṃ niścalānām/
``svagocarānna cālyeta yattat stimitamucyate/'' iti bhāvaprakāśaḥ/ sarve ca dṛṣṭilakṣaṇasaṃvādagranthā bhāvaprakāśataḥ (iti ṛ) jñeyāḥ/ vismayānubhāvaścāyam/ ``yadvismayastimitam'' iti svokteḥ/ vikasitānāṃ mukhādyavayavasaubhāgyāvagāhena praphullānāṃ vikasitādyaviṣayaviśeṣamavagāhate/ harṣānubhāvaścāyam/ ullasadbhrūlatānāṃ abhiprāyasūcakoccalaccillīlatānām/
``yatrollasatyabhiprāyastadullāsīti kathyate/'' iti/ udvartitākhyaṃ caitadvīkṣaṇam/
``udvartitaṃ tadvijñeyaṃ bhruvorūrdhvaṃ prakampanam/'' iti/ adbhutānubhāvaścāyam/ athavā prāpticintānubhāvaḥ/ ``unnamitaikabhrūlatamānanamasyāḥ'' itivat/ masṛṇamukulitānāṃ ``masṛṇaṃ taditi khyātamanurāgakaṣāyitam/'' iti/ masṛṇānāmanurāgavaśādanuddhatānāmityarthaḥ/ mukulitānāmityaucityādardhamukulitatvamucyate/ sukhānubhavādardhanimīlitānām/
``ardhavyākośatārā ca hlādārdhamukulaiḥ puṭaiḥ/
smṛtārdhamukulā dṛṣṭiḥ'' iti/ mohānubhāvaścāyam/
``āśu laṅghitavatīṣṭakarāgre nīvimardhamukulīkṛtadṛṣṭyā/'' iti māghoktavat/ prāntavistārabhājāṃ prānte taddarśanāvasāne vistārabhājām/
``āśliṣṭo yena viṣayastadvistārīti kathyate/'' iti pṛthvagratayā dṛśyaṃ kabalayatāmityarthaḥ/ athavā prānte apāṅge vistāravatāṃ vistīryamāṇānām/ mohapratiyogivibodhānubhāvo'yam/ pratinayananipāte pratīpaṃ madīyanetrayoḥ pravṛttau/ kiñcidākuñcitānāmīṣannivartitānām/ ākuñcitaṃ yathāgataṃ nivṛttiḥ kiñcidgrahaṇaṃ nivṛttau māndyaṃ prakāśayati/ lajjānubhāvaścāyam/
``tayoḥ samāpattiṣu kātarāṇiṣṭakiñcidvyavasthāpitasaṃhṛtāni/
hrīyantraṇāmānaśire manojñānyanyonyalolāni vilocanāni//'' itivat/ ``abhimukhe mayi saṃhṛtamīkṣaṇam'' iti ca śākuntale/ vividhamityanuktānāmapi prakārāntarāṇāmaśakyavarṇanatayā saṅgrahaḥ/ ālokitaviśeṣaṇaṃ cedam/ pātraṃ bhājanam/
``pātrantu bhājane yogye vitte kūladvayāntare/'' iti vaijayantī/ pātraśabdasya nityanapuṃsakatvādahamiti sāmānādhikaraṇyam/ ālokitānāṃ darśanakriyāṇām/ bhāvektaḥ/ ahaṃ pātramabhūvamityanenāho mama dhanyatvam, itaḥ pūrvametāvataḥ sukṛtarāśermayyasambhāvitatvamiti dyotyate/ raktāvilokanasvabhāvavarṇanāt svabhāvoktiratrālaṅkāraḥ/ atra ca ``bhūmnā rasānāṃ gahanāḥ prayogāḥ'' iti pratijñātasya yojanamanusandheyam//30//
atha tathāvidhānāmālokitānāṃ niratiśayaṃ manaḥkṣobhakatvasāmarthyamāha - alasetyādi/ alaseti kiñcidākuñcitānāmityasyānuvādaḥ/
``ālasyaṃ tadabhīṣṭārthād vrīlāderyannivartanam/'' ityuktatvāt/ valitamityādi vividhamiti kriyāviśeṣaṇasya vivaraṇam/
``valitaṃ tannivṛttasya bhūyastryaśrāvalokanam/'' iti/ tryaśraṃ tiryagudañcitam/ mugdhamakṛtrimam/
``svabhāvālokitaṃ mugdhaṃ bhāvagarbhamapi chalāt/'' iti/ snigdhamarūkṣaprabhāpaṭalabahalam/
``snigdhaṃ tadyasya viṣayastatprabhāmilito bhavet/
niṣpandaṃ tadyadanyatra dṛṣṭānna spandate kvacit//'' iti/ niṣpandatvaṃ nāma svayameva svaviṣayādacalanam, stimitatvaṃ punaḥ parapreraṇayāpyacalanamiti vivekaḥ/ mandaḥ sannihite'pi viṣayāntare grahaṇāpaṭuḥ/ ``mūḍhālpāpaṭunirbhāgyamandaḥ'' iti vaijayantī/ alasairvalitairmugdhaiḥ snigdhairniṣpandamandaiśca/ adhikavikasadantarvismayasmeratāraiḥ bhṛśamujjṛmbhamāṇenāntargatena vismayena smerāsmayaśīlā tārā akṣikanīnikā yeṣu/ ``namikampismyajasakamahiṃsadīpo raḥ'' (3-2-167) iti raḥ/
``sphuradbhrūpakṣmatāraṃ yattat smeramiti kathyate'' (iti)/
hṛdayaṃ manaḥ/ aśaraṇaṃ rakṣitṛrahitam, rakṣitaṛṇāṃ vinayādīnāṃ dūrato nirastatvāditi bhāvaḥ/ ``śaraṇaṃ gṛharakṣitroḥ'' ityamaraḥ/ pakṣmalākṣyāḥ praśastapakṣmaviśiṣṭalocanāyāḥ/ matvarthe lac/ athavā lāteḥ ke/
``apāṅge tāravikṣepaḥ kaṭākṣa iti kathyate/'' iti/ apahṛtaṃ svīkṛtaṃ ``priyatamā yatamānamapāharat'' itivat/ apaviddhaṃ pātitam, apaviddhagato bāhuḥ'' itivat/ svaviṣaye nimajjitamityarthaḥ/ pītaṃ kabalīkṛtam, svākāreṇāntarnigīrṇamityarthaḥ/ unmūlitamatyantaṃ svasmin vilāpitam/ hṛdayapuṇḍarīke manāgapyadarśanānniravaśeṣaṃ vināśitaṃ cetyarthaḥ/ apahṛtamityādibhiḥ bādhanasya kramāduttarottarotkarṣaḥ prakāśyate/ tataḥ parasya prakārāntarasyābhāvādunmīlitatve viśrāntiḥ/ me hṛdayamiti madīyatvāttasya durbalatvam/ pakṣmalākṣyāḥ kaṭākṣairiti tadīyatvātteṣāmāśrayabalena balavattvaṃ ceti dyotyate/ aśaraṇaṃ hṛdayaṃ kaṭākṣairityanāthasyaikasya bahubhirbalottarairbādhyamānatve kaḥ pratīkāra iti hṛdayaṃ prati dayā, kaṭākṣān pratyasūyā, svasya hṛdayarakṣaṇākṣamatvāddainyaṃ ca prakāśyate/ atra kaṭākṣairhṛdayavivaśīkaraṇaprakārabhedasyāpahṛtatvādibhiradhyavasitatvādatiśayoktiralaṅkāraḥ/ ekasya kārakasyāpaharaṇādibahukriyāsambandhāddīpakaṃ ca//31//
atha svavṛttamāha - ahantviti/ turviśeṣe, apahnotumaśakye tvasminnavasthāntare duṣkaraṃ mayā kṛtamiti dyotayati/ sarvākārahṛdayaṅgamāyāḥ rūpaśīlādibhiḥ sarvaiḥ prakārairudāratayā hṛdayaṃ cittaṃ praviśantyāḥ/ ``gamessupyupasaṅkhyānam'' iti khac/ sambhāvyamānasneharasena mayyasyāḥ ko'pi premaprakarṣo'stītyūhyamānasneharasena/ sannidhinā purovasthānena/ vidheyīkṛto'pi svavaśīkṛto'pi/ pāriplavatvaṃ capalatvam/ apahnotukāmaḥ chādayitumicchan/ ``tuṃ kāmamanasorapī''ti makāralopaḥ/ yathākathañcit atikṛcchreṇeti vidagdhaviracanāprārambhaparityāgaḥ prakāśyate/ eveti/ aho mama dhairyamiti bhāvaḥ/ tata iti/ vetrapāṇayaḥ pratīhārāḥ, vetraṃ pāṇau yeṣāmiti ``praharaṇārthebhyaḥ pare niṣṭhāsaptamyau bhavataḥ iti vaktavyam'' iti saptamyantasya paranipātaḥ/ varṣavarāḥ ṣaṇḍāḥ tadbahulāḥ puruṣāḥ parivārayantīti parivārāḥ parikarā yasyāstām/ gajavadhūṃ kariṇīmiti maṅgalyatvāduktiḥ/ nagaragāminaṃ puraṃ prati gamanaśīlam/ nagaragamanānukūlamityarthaḥ/
``eṣa panthā vidarbhāṇāmeṣa yāsyati kosalān'' itivat/ induvadanetyanena kariṇīskandhavartinyāstasyā mukhasyodayagirigatacandrabimbasādṛśyasampattirdyotyate/
atha gamanasamaye tasyāḥ pravṛttimāha - yāntyetyādi/ muhurbahuśaḥ/ valitakandharaṃ tiryaggataṃ kaṇṭhanālaṃ yasya tat/ ānanaṃ mukham/ taditi svānubhūtasaundaryatvaṃ dyotyate/ āvṛttavṛntaśatapatranibhaṃ āvṛttaṃ valitaṃ vṛntaṃ prasavabandhanaṃ śatapatraṃ padmam (yathā)/ yadā valitakandharaṃ tadā tadānanaṃ āvṛttavṛntaśatapatranibhaṃ sadṛśamityupamālaṅkāraḥ/ kandharāvṛntayorānanaśatapatrayośca bimbapratibimbabhāvenāvasthānirdeśāt/ valitatvāvṛttatvayostu sambandhibhedād bhinnatvaṃ nārthataḥ, paryāyatvāt/ digdhaḥ upaliptaḥ/ ``diha upalepane'' iti dhātuḥ/ amṛtenānukūlyadyotakatvāt/ viṣeṇa tu svasya durlabhatvāśaṅkyā/ athavā anubhavasamaye sukhāvahatvādvirahasamaye duḥkhāvahatvācca virodho'trālaṅkāraḥ/ gāḍhaṃ dṛḍham/ nikhātaḥ kīlavat sthāpitaḥ/ ivetyutprekṣādyotakam/ tasya hṛdayato'napāyāt/ ``atrāntare kimapi'' ityārabhya ``hṛdaye kaṭākṣaḥ'' ityantena kaiśikī vṛttiranusandheyā/ evamanyatrāpyanusartavyam/
``tadvyāpārātmikā vṛttiścaturdhā tatra kaiśikī/
gītanṛttavilāsādyairmṛduśṛṅgāraceṣṭitaiḥ//'' iti vacanāt/ vīraprastāve sātvatī/ raudrabībhatsaprastāve cārabhaṭīṃ darśayiṣyāmaḥ/
``śṛṅgāre kaiśikī vīre sāttvatyārabhaṭī punaḥ/
rase raudre sabībhatse''//
iti vacanāt/
``bhāratī saṃskṛtaprāyo vāgvyāpāro narāśrayaḥ/
vṛttiḥ sarvatra bhāratī'' iti vacanāt/ bhāratī tu vyāpakatvena sarvatrānusandheyā//32//
atha svāvasthāmāha - tataḥ prabhṛti tasmātkālādārabhya/ ``prabhṛtyādibhirupasaṅkhyānam'' iti prabhṛtiśabdayoge pañcamī/ ``skandhāt prabhṛtyeva sapallavāni'' itivat/
paricchedātīta ityādi - iyānayamiti parimāṇakalpanā paricchedaḥ/ sa ca manovyāpārastamatikrāntaḥ/ ``dvitīyā śritātītapatita'' ityādinā samāsaḥ/ pūrvarūpasya manaso'pyagocaratve kaḥ punaruttararūpāyā vācaḥ prasaṅga ityāha - sakalavacanānāṃ vācakalākṣaṇikavyañjakādibhedabhinnānāṃ sarveṣāṃ śabdānām/ athavā sakalānāṃ bṛhaspatyādīnāṃ vaktaṛṇāṃ sambandhinām/ bahuvacanena bahuvidhasya vacasaḥ, aviṣayaḥ agocaraḥ/ tarhi pūrvānubhavasaṃvādīti cettatrāha - ,punariti . punaśśabdo viśeṣe/ asmin janmani punaḥ/ anubhavapathaṃ smṛtivyatiriktajñānasaraṇim/ janmāntarānubhūteṣvidānīmasmṛtigocaratvādityarthaḥ/ atra pūrvavākyagato'pi yacchabdaḥ uttaravākye tacchabdamākṣipati yattadornityābhisambandhāt/ yathāha kavivallabhaḥ``yadi prayukte tadiva pratyapriyamavāritam/'' iti/ uttaravākyagatasya tu yacchabdasya pūrvavākyagatatacchabdākṣepasāmarthyaṃ prasiddhameva/ ``sa kila vacanānāmaviṣayaḥ'' iti vā pāṭhaḥ/ vivekapradhvaṃsād yuktāyuktavicāro vivekaḥ, tasya pradhvaṃso nāśaḥ/ propasargeṇātyantikatvaṃ prakāśyate/ upacito vardhitaḥ, mahāmohaḥ mahadajñānaṃ tena gahanaḥ nibiḍaḥ/ ko'pītyanubhavaikagamyatvaparāmarśaḥ/ antarvikāro mānaso vṛttiviśeṣaḥ/ jaḍayati indriya (ma)pāṭavayuktaṃ karoti/ ``tatkaroti'' iti ṇic/ tāpaṃ jvalanadāhasadṛśīṃ vedanām/ jaḍaśabdena śaityamapyucyate/ ato jāḍyatāpayoryaugapadye virodhapratītervirodho'laṅkāraḥ/ prastutānyatvarūpātiśayoktiśca//33//
api ca - paricchedavyaktirityādi - ayaṃ ghaṭaḥ paṭo na bhavatīti vyavacchidya jñānaṃ paricchedaḥ tasya vyaktiḥ sphuṭībhāvaḥ/ mṛnmayo na tu hiraṇmaya iti/ purasthe agrataḥ sannihite/ apīti tathātvavirodhaḥ/ abhyaste punaḥ punaḥ śīlite śāstrādau/ atathābhāvaḥ yathā śīlitaṃ tathātvasyābhāvastena virasamanupajātanirṇayasukham/ santāpacchedo dāhaśāntiḥ/ himasarasi tuhinasalilapūrite jalāśaye/ candramasi amṛtamayatvena prasiddhe candramaṇḍale vā/ avagāḍha iti śeṣaḥ/ etatsambhāvanāmātram/ itthaṃ sambhāvayāmītyarthaḥ/ niṣṭhāśūnyaṃ niṣkarṣarahitam/ bhramati itastataḥ sañcarati/ kimapītyanupapadyamānamanorathatvaṃ dhvanyate/ ālikhati samantāduṭṭaṅkayati/ anena tṛtīyadaśāpraveśalakṣaṇānalpasaṅkalpaśilpatvakalpanā manasaḥ prakāśyate/ atra bhāvikamatiśayoktiścālaṅkāraḥ//34//
dṛḍhaṃ khalveṣa kayāpyapahṛtaḥ/ api nāma mālatyeva sā bhavet/ āḥ pīḍāyām/ svāmibhaktatvāttadduḥkhadukhitvaṃ dyotayati/ seti, kayāpīti, yā sāmānyato'vagatā strī sā mālatyeva bhavet/ api nāmeti prārthanāyām/
aho ityāścarye/ tattādṛśadhairyarāśerasya kathamīdṛśo'yamiti bhāvaḥ/ abhiṣaṅgo viṣayāsaktiḥ/ ``abhiṣaṅgajalaṃ vijajñivān'' iti raghuvaṃśe/ tathā kādambaryāṃ - ``viṣayābhiṣaṅgeṣvaniṣṭānubandheṣu'' iti/ niṣedhayāmi nivārayāmi/ kimiti cintā/ suhṛdamityavaśyamamārgānnivāraṇīyatvaṃ dhvanyate/
``ā keśagrahaṇānmitramakāryātsannivartayet'' iti vacanāt/
daśāntarāvagāhanena tasya durnivāratvaṃ niścitya pūrvoktamākṣipati - athaveti/
mā mūmuhadityādi/ mā mohayatu/ ``muha vaicitye'' ityasmāt ṇyantāt luṅi caṅi rūpam/ khalu niścaye/ ananyajanmā kāmaḥ/ matiḥ śāstrajalakṣālananirmalā buddhiḥ/ malīmasavikāraghanā rajastamomūlatayā malinairvikārapāṃsubhirnibiḍā mā bhūt/ itiśabdaḥ samāptau prakaraṇe vā/ ādiśabdaḥ prakāravacanaḥ/ evaṃprakāraṃ vacanamiti śeṣaḥ/ nanu prasiddhau/ iha asmin suhṛdi/ nirarthakaṃ niṣphalameva/ jṛmbhitaguṇaḥ kokottarālambanoddīpanavibhāvajanitaścintādivyabhicāryupacitaḥ kaṭākṣabhujākṣepādibhiranubhāvaiḥ prakaṭībhūta ityarthaḥ/ kāmaḥ ratyākhyasthāyibhāvaḥ/ navayauvanaṃ śarīre samārohat, na punaḥ samārūḍhaṃ tāruṇyam/ cakārābhyāṃ jvalanapavanayoriva tulyayoge parasparopacāyakatvād durnivāratvaṃ dyotyate/ nanviti ``dūrāpetaḥ khalūpadeśakālaḥ'' iti kādambaryādiprasiddhiṃ prakāśayati/ matyākhyo'tra bhāvaḥ prakāśyate/ ākṣepaścālaṅkāraḥ/ viśeṣābhidhitsayā vivakṣitasya niṣedhāt/ viśeṣaśca - smaratāpavaśatayāyamasmadavadhīraṇenāpi pravartata iti vā, trapāvaśādapravṛttau prāṇasandeho'pi syāditi vā vyajyate//35//
prakāśamiti/ tadanumodanameva śreya iti niścityāha - apīti/ apiḥ sānunaye praśne/ tadanvavāyanāmanī tasyāḥ gotramabhidhānaṃ ca/
kareṇukā gajavadhūḥ/ kadambakāt samūhāt/ anyatamā ekā/ bahūnāmekasya nirdhāraṇe ḍatamac/ ``anyārādi''tyādinā pañcamī/ ``vārastrī gaṇikā veśyā'' ityamaraḥ/ apacāyo hastādānam/ ``hastādāne cerasteye'' (3-3-40) iti ghañ/ apacāyakrameṇa pūrvaṃ dūrataḥ tataḥ kiñcidāsannamityanabhisandhipūrvakatvakhyāpanārthaṃ kramagrahaṇam/ nedīyasī antikatamā/ ``antikabāḍhayornedasādhau'' (5-3-63) itīyasuni nedādeśaḥ/ brāhmaṇatvāt prabhutvācca praṇamyetyuktiḥ/ kusumāpīḍavyājena puṣpamālāvarṇanacchalena/ evamuktavatīti tayā prākṛtabhāvayoktamarthavaśāt saṃskṛtabhāṣayā vivṛṇoti/ athavā tayaivaṃ saṃskṛtamāśrityoktam/ mahābhāgetyādi/ ``bhāgo bhāgyāṃśaturyāṃśā'' iti vaijayantī/ suśliṣṭaguṇatayā guṇo grathanasūtraṃ puṣpairnirvivaraṃ sughaṭito guṇo yasmin tadbhāvena/ ramaṇīyo manoharaḥ vaḥ sanniveśaḥ yuṣmatkartṛkaṃ kusumasanniveśanam/ kartari ṣaṣṭhī/ brāhmaṇatvāt prabhutvācca va iti bahuvacanaprayogaḥ/ kutūhalinī etatprāptikautukinī/ grathyamānadaśāyāmasyā mālāyāstayā dṛṣṭatvāt vartata ityuktiḥ/ abhinavo'nyatrādṛṣṭapūrvaḥ/ vicitro vividhabhaṅgitaraṅgitaḥ/ kusumeṣu puṣpeṣu/ vyāpāraḥ grathanaśaktiḥ/ tadviduṣāmeva tadviśeṣadarśane kutūhalamiti bhāvaḥ/ tat tasmāt/ vaidagdhyasya kartṛgatasya mālāgrathanakauśalasya/ kṛtārthatā prayojanasampattiḥ/ ramaṇīyatāyāḥ mālāgatasya sanniveśaviśeṣasaundaryasya/ phalatu upakarotu/ sarasa evāmlāna eva/ sanniveśasya viśeṣyatvāt pulliṅgatā, kusumāpīḍasya vā/ kaṇṭhāvalambanamahārghatāṃ kaṇṭhadeśāśrayeṇa tribhuvanamūlyakreyatām iti/ ayamatra vācyo'rthaḥ/
``dvyarthaiḥ padaiḥ piśunayecca rahasyavastu'' iti kāmasūtrokteḥ vaidagdhyādanyo'pyartho bhaṅgyā prakāśyate/ yathā - suśliṣṭaguṇatayā mādhuryādibhirguṇaiḥ susambaddhatayā/ sanniveśaḥ śarīresaṃsthānam/ ramaṇīyo hṛdayahārī/ kutūhalinī tasya tādṛśasya darśanādutkaṇṭhitā/ abhinavo'ciradṛṣṭatvena bhavatastataḥ prabhṛti jātatvānnūtanaḥ/ athavā anyasya tādṛśasyābhilāṣaduḥkhasyādṛṣṭatvādvā/ vicitro vividhaḥ kṣaṇe kṣaṇe'vasthāntarakaraṇāt/ kusumeṣuvyāpāraḥ kusumāni puṣpāṇīṣavaḥ śarā yasya tasya kusumeṣorvyāpāraḥ śaravarṣaṇarūpā pravṛttiḥ/ vaidagdhyasya ubhayagatasya kalākauśalasya/ ramaṇīyatāyāḥ ubhayāśritasyākārasaundaryādeḥ/ nirmāṇaṃ brahmakartṛkā sṛṣṭiḥ/ sarasa eva lakṣaṇayānavakṣiptakāla eveti tasyāḥ kālāntarākṣamatvaṃ dyotyate/ sarasaḥ sahṛdayo vā mahābhāga iti śeṣaḥ/ evakāro bhinnakramaḥ samāsādayatveveti/ bhartṛdārikāyāḥ svāmiduhituḥ/ kaṇṭhāvalambanena āliṅganena (mahārghatāṃ) bhuvanaślāghanīyatāmiti/ sadṛśasamāgamasya sahṛdayacamatkārakāritvāditi bhāvaḥ/ śabdaśaktimūlo vastudhvanirayam, na punaḥ śleṣālaṅkāraḥ/ ubhayorapyarthayostatra vācyatvāt/ atra tvekasyaiva vācyatvāt parasya vyaṅgyatvācca/
aho vaidagdhyam/ āścaryaṃ nisṛṣṭārthadūtītvamityarthaḥ/
madanuyuktayā mayā pṛṣṭayā[ṣṭyā]/ ``praśno'nuyogaḥ pṛcchā ca'' ityamaraḥ/ prasūtiḥ putrī/ prasādabhūmiranugrahapātram/ mālatīnāmā lavaṅgikānāmeti ca samāsaḥ/ ``ḍābubhābhyāmanyatarasyām'' (4-1-13) iti ḍāp/ prasādabhūmiḥ dhātreyiketi ca snehaviśvāsabhūmitvāt svasyā visrabdhapraśne yogyatāṃ sūcayati/ uttareṇobhayorapi jijñāsitārthonnayanāduttaramatrālaṅkāraḥ/
saharṣamiti svāśāsitasyaiva saṃpatteḥ/ kiṃ nāma mālatīti/ mālatīti kiṃ saṃjñetyarthaḥ/ diṣṭyā vilasitaṃ bhagavatā daivena kusumāyudhena ca/ vilasitamiti bhāve niṣṭhā/ daivena kusumāyudhena ca sadṛśasamāgamanena parasparānurāgeṇa ca svamahimā prakāśita ityarthaḥ/ upari ca tatra tatra kaverdaivamadanayorānukūlyakathanasaṃrambho'nusandheyaḥ/ ``yasmin vidhiśca madanaśca kṛtābhiyogaḥ'', ``vidhiḥ svāsthyaṃ dhattāṃ bhavatu kṛtakṛtyaśca madanaḥ'' ityādyukteḥ/ jitamasmābhiḥ ji jaya ityakarmakasya bhāve niṣṭhāyāṃ rūpaṃ jitamiti/ sarvotkarṣeṇa sthitamityarthaḥ/ asmābhiriti bahuvacanena mādhavapakṣyāṇāṃ saṅgrahaḥ/
aparyāptiḥ aparimeyatvam/ bahumānasya camatkārasya/
``aparyāptaṃ tadasmākaṃ balaṃ bhīṣmābhirakṣitam''/
ityādivat/ anenābhijanādīnāṃ lokottaratvaṃ prakāśayati/ api ceti/ tato'pi paraṃ guṇāntaramāha/ mālatī mālatīti modate bhagavatī kāmandakīti/ vīpsayā tatprasaṅgasya kriyāsamabhihāro dyotyate/
``rāmo rāmo rāma iti prajānāmabhavat kathāḥ'' iti rāmāyaṇoktavat/ itiśabdo modanaprakāre/ modate paramānandamanubhavatīti niratiśayasnehāspadatvaṃ pratīyate/ bhagavatīti tapaḥprabhāvotpannadivyajñānasampannatvadyotanāt tādṛśajanānugrahapatritvasya mahābhāgyamantareṇānupapattiṃ vyañjayati/ bhagavatī kāmandakītyanena tasyāḥ svāyattatvāt prāptyupāyaścopakṣipyate/ tāñceti/ anena ``tāṃ yācate narapateḥ'' iti sūcitamanusandhatte/ cakāro vākyārthasamuccaye/ ``kiṃvadantī janaśrutiḥ'' iti vaijayantī/
anubadhyamānaḥ punaḥ punaryācyamāna ityanena deyasya kṣudratayā dāne lajjāvaśānmāndyaṃ prakāśyate/ asau lavaṅgikā/ punaḥśabdo viśeṣavācī/ abhiniviṣṭayā pakṣapātinyā/ (dṛśā) dṛṣṭyā/ vihastatayā svasya paravaśatayā/ viṣamaviracitaikabhāgāmapīti/ mālatīdarśanānantaraṃ yathākathāñcidavaśeṣasya grathanāt pūrvagrathitād bhāgādvairūpyamanyasya bhāgasya prakāśyate/ ``vihasto vyākulaḥ proktaḥ'' iti halāyudhaḥ/ bahumanyamāneti/ ``vasanti hi premṇi guṇā na vastuni'' iti nyāyādvaiṣamyasyāpi tadavalokanavihastatāhetukatvāt premasūcanena tadāśvāsopayuktatvācca camatkurvāṇeti bhāvaḥ/ yātrābhaṅgāddevotsavāvasānāt/ pracalitasya svasthānagamanodyatasya/ pauranaigamajanasya pure bhavāḥ paurāḥ rājadhānīnivāsinaḥ nigame bhavāḥ naigamāḥ pattanavartino vaṇijaḥ/ ``pūḥ strī purīnagayag vā pattanaṃ puṭabhedanam/
sthānīyaṃ nigamaḥ'' ityamaraḥ// ``nigamo niścaye vede pure pathi vaṇikpathe'' iti vaijayantī// ``dhārāhāropanayanaparā naigamāḥ sānumantaḥ'' iti vikramorvaśīye/ saṅkulena sammardena/ vighaṭitāyāṃ antaritāyām, na punaḥ svayaṃgatāyāmityanena dvayorvivakṣitārthānuktāveva viśleṣaḥ pratīyate/
mālatyā api snehadarśanāditi/ ``atrāntare kimapi'' iti ``stimitavikasitānām'' ityādibhistadbhāvaprakāśanādityarthaḥ/ etad vastu suśliṣṭaṃ suṣṭhu ghaṭiṣyate/ ``āśaṃsāyāṃ bhūtavacca'' (3-3-132) iti bhūtanirdeśaḥ saukaryapratipādanaparaḥ/ kasminnapi mahābhāgadheyajanmanītyasya śaṅkātaṅkaṃ pariharati - yo'pīti/ kapolapāṇḍutā ``kalayati ca himāṃśorniṣkalaṅkasya'' ityuktā/ ādiśabdena ``parimṛditamṛṇālī''tyādi pratipāditaṃ gṛhyate/ prākprabaddhaḥ pūrvānubaddhaḥ/ kāmābhiṣaṅgaḥ kandarpeṇābhibhūtatvaṃ, tasmin saṅgo vā/
``abhiṣaṅgastvabhibhave saṅga ākrośane'pi ca''/
iti vaijayantī/ tvannibandhanaḥ tvāṃ nimittīkṛtya pravṛttaḥ/ vyaktaṃ sphuṭam/ kva kasmin deśe iti deśaviśeṣasyaiva jijñāsā vartate/ darśanaṃ tu bhavataḥ prāṅnivṛttameva/ tatra na sandeha iti bhāvaḥ/ tatropapattimāha - na khalvitikhalu prasiddhau/ damayantyādiṣu vāsavādivarjanena nalādivaraṇasya sārvalaukikatvādityarthaḥ/ tādṛśyo mālatītulyāḥ/ kulapālikā ityarthaḥ/ mahābhāgadheyāḥ lokottarapuṇyā iti/ bhavādṛśe puṇyarāśāveva tāsāṃ bhāvabandho na punarananurūpa iti dyotyate/ anyatrānyasmin puruṣe/ paratra parasmin puruṣe/ cakṣūrāgaḥ sarāganetrapātanam/ praṇayanirīkṣaṇamityarthaḥ/
tasyāpyanubhavagocaramupapattyantaramāha - api ca - anyonyetyādi/ ``anyonyameva catureṇa'' ityuktamanusandhatte/ saṃbhinnāḥ saṃmiśritāḥ/ tvayi prāganurāgacihnaṃ tvayā tasyāssandarśanāt pūrvameva yatra kvacana dṛṣṭe tvayi tasyāḥ premasūcakam/ kasyāpi/ janasyeti viśeṣyamākṣipyate/ kasyā api ko'pītyuktasya parāmarśaḥ/ kasyāpītīndravajrānuguṇyena prayogaḥ/ niveditaṃ vijñāpitam iti bhāve niṣṭhā/ niveditañceti cakāreṇa samuccīyamānamarthāntaramantareṇāviśrānteḥ pṛcchati - kiṃceti/ anyaditi śeṣaḥ/ dhātreyikāyāḥ upamātṛputrikāyā lavaṅgikāyāḥ/ caturaṃ vācyasya vyaṅgyamukhaprekṣitayā vidagdham/ vacaḥ ``mahābhāga! ramaṇīya eṣa vaḥ sanniveśaḥ'' ityādi/ niveditaṃ ca vacaśca cihnamityanvayaḥ/
samīci samaye citrapradarśanena mālatyanurāgaṃ mādhavasaṃśayodghāṭanaṃ kavīśvaraḥ saṃvidhatte/ edaṃ ca etacca/ cakāraḥ pūrvoktena samuccinoti cihnamiti/ ``anyonyasaṃbhinnadṛśām'' ityādiḥ ``edaṃ ca'' ityanta udbhedaḥ/ gūḍhārthodbhedanāt/ atrānumānamalaṅkāraḥ/ prayatnākhyāvasthāviśiṣṭabindunyāsātmakaṃ pratimukhaṃ caitat kalahaṃsamukhenālekhyasya prakāśanāt/
kena/ janeneti śeṣaḥ/
yenāsya hṛdayamapahṛtaṃ tena janena likhitamityarthaḥ/
apiḥ sānunaye praśne/
atha kim/ athaśabdaḥ pakṣāntaradyotakaḥ/ kiṃśabdaḥ kṣepavācī/ bhavanmatādanyaḥ kaḥ, ayaṃ sa evetyarthaḥ/
prasannaprāyaḥ bāhulyena saṃśayakāluṣyarahitaḥ/ tarka ūhaḥ/ ``ūhastarko'numānoktiḥ'' ityamaraḥ/ prāyagrahaṇam iyatāpyasantoṣāttadadhigamaprakārāparijñānācceti mantavyam/
kutaḥ kasmājjanāt/ asya citraphalakasya/ adhigamaḥ prāptiḥ/
mama tāvanmandārikāhastāt, tasyā api lavaṅgikāsakāśāt/ adhigama iti saṃbadhyate/
atha śabdo vyāvṛttau/ likhitamidaṃ bhavatu nāma/ kiṃpunarmādhavālekhyena mālatyāḥ prayojanaṃ, mandārikā kathayatītyarthaḥ/
utkaṇṭhāvinodanamiti/ utkaṇṭhāyāḥ kimapi praśamanaṃ prayojanamāheti saṃbandhaḥ/
upapattyā nirṇītakāryasiddhirmakaranda āha - sarvathā sarvaprakāreṇa/ parasparānurāgeṇa ślāghyasaṃbandhatvādibhirdaivānukūlyāccetyarthaḥ/ samāśvasihi prasannahṛdayo bhava/
sarvathetyuktamupapādayati - yetyādi/ kaumudī candrikā niratiśayāhlādajanakatvāt/ sujanmā śobhanajananayukteti tvādṛśapremapātratā hi strīṇāṃ janmaphalamiti dyotayati/ manorathalabdhabandhuḥ saṃkalpenāyaṃ mama prāṇeśvara ityātmakenopanītaḥ paramasuhṛt/ strīṇāṃ bhartaiva hi paramo bandhuriti bandhugrahaṇam/ tat tasmāt/ saṅgamaṃ ubhayoḥ samāgamam/ prati lakṣīkṛtya/ saṃśayaḥ sandehaḥ/ asmākamiti śeṣaḥ/ nāsti hi nāstyeva/ ``hirhetāvavadhāraṇe'' iti vaijayantī/ yasmin saṅgame viṣaye/ vidhirdaivam/ kṛtābhiyogaḥ kṛtanirbandhaḥ/ ``amandaścābhiyogo'sya'' itivat atra pūrvārdhe rūpakam uttarārdhe'numānaṃ cālaṅkāraḥ/ anyonyaṃ ca vyaṅgyam, paraspararasāvahatvāt/ yā kaumudī nayanayorityākasmikī sahāyāvāptiḥ samādhiḥ//37//
draṣṭavyarūpā, mameti śeṣaḥ/ mama tadrūpadarśane kutūhalamastītyarthaḥ/ tatra hetuḥ bhavato vikāraheturiti/ bhavata ityarthāntarasaṅkramitavācyena dhvaninā tattādṛśadhairyajñānarāśitvamasya dyotyate/ manaḥkṣobhaṇanimittaṃ draṣṭavyarūpetyuktiḥ kanyakānāṃ nirdoṣadarśanatvādvisrambhācceti mantavyam/ atraiva tvatpraticchandasundare citraphalaka evetyanena vaidagdhyānmālatyai mādhavānurāgaṃ prakāśamitumudghaṭṭayati/ abhilikhyatāmityuktiḥ kalahaṃsakenaiva citropakaraṇānāmapyānayanāt/
yadabhirucitaṃ vayasyāya yat suhṛdaḥ priyaṃ tatkariṣyāmīti śeṣaḥ/ ``rucyarthānāṃ prīyamāṇaḥ'' (1-4-33) iti sampradānasaṃjñāyāṃ caturthī/
likhanniti/ śatrā prārambhaṃ sūcayati/ khedaḥ nissahatā/
vāraṃ vāramityādi/ paryāyataḥ/ ``vārastvavasaraḥ kṣaṇaḥ'' iti vaijayantī/ tirayati chādayati/ bāṣpapūro'śrupravāhaḥ/ tatsaṅkalpaḥ manasā samālokya mālatyevaṃrūpeti nirmāṇaṃ tena upahitajaḍima janitā svapravṛttyapratipattiryasya/ ``apratipattirjaḍatā'' iti dhanikaḥ/ stambhaṃ dāruvanniśceṣṭatvam/ sadyaḥ lekhanopakrama eva/ svidyan dharmajalaṃ kṣaran/ ñiṣvidā gātraprakṣaraṇa iti dhātuḥ/ aviratotkampalolāṅgulīkaḥ avicchinnena śarīracalanena calāḥ karaśākhā yasya/ ``nadyṛtaśca'' (5-4-153) iti kap/ lekhāvidhiṣu tadākārānuguṇarekhānirmāṇeṣu/ natarāṃ nātiśayena/ vartate pravartate/ ``na tathā jvālājaṭilo'pi dahano natarāṃ ca kārīṣe'' ityudayanaprayogāt/ ``kimettiṅavyayaghādāmvadravyaprakarṣe'' (5-4-11) ityāmupratyayaḥ/ kiṃ karomi kartavyaṃ na paśyāmi/ sūkṣmekṣikāyā niścalāsvinnahastatvādeśca citralekhanaṃ pratyaṅgatvāt teṣāṃ ca bāṣpādibhirvighātādupāyāntaraṃ na prakāśata iti dainyaṃ dyotyate/ bāṣpādīnāmanubhāvānāṃ prakāśanānniratiśayo ratyākhyo bhāvaḥ pratāyata[pratīyate]/ kāraṇamukhena kāryasya lekhanāsāmarthyasya pratyāyanādaprastutapraśaṃsātrālaṅkāraḥ//38//
vāraṃ vāramityādisāttvikābhinayavad vyavasito'smi upakrāntavānasmīti madhye vicchedasyānaucityaṃ sūcayati/ vyavasita iti kartari niṣṭhā/
upapannaḥ saṃvādī sthāne yogāt/ atrāsyāṃ viṣaye, kathamiti vismaye/ tatra hetuḥ acireṇaiva nirmāyāśusandarbhyeti/ ślokaḥ padyam/ vācayati paṭhati/
jagatītyādi/ jagati na punaḥ kṣitimātre/ trailokya ityarthaḥ/ jayinaḥ vastvantaratiraskāraśīlāḥ, tatra hetuḥ prakṛtimadhurāḥ svabhāvataḥ sundarāḥ/ te ta iti jagato vistāritvātteṣāmapyagaṇyatvaṃ prakāśyate/ bhāvāḥ padārthāḥ/
``bhāvo līlākriyāceṣṭābhūtyabhiprāyajantuṣu/
padārthamātre sattāyāmātmayonisvabhāvayoḥ//'' iti vaijayantī/ navendukalādayaḥ apariṇatamugdhacandralekhādayaḥ/ ādiśabdaḥ prakāravācī/ kamalakuvalayakisalayādayaḥ/ santyeva sattāmanubhavantyeva, na punaratyantamucchinnā ityanenaitatsannidhānādeva teṣāṃ sparśaprāyatvam/ punarasyāstadabhāvataḥ ślāghyatvamiti dyotyate/ anya iti buddhisannihitāyā nāyikāyā itaratvamucyate/ mana iti pratisaṃbandhiviraheṇa nirdeśātsarveṣāmaviśeṣeṇa sambandhīti khyāpyate/ madayanti darśanādibhiḥ paravaśīkurvanti/ mamatviti/ tuśabdo vyāvṛttau/ ``bhinnarucirhi lokaḥ'' iti nyāyena/ mama punarekasya guṇaviśeṣaṃ jānato vā/ iyamiti citragatayā abhinayena nirdiśyamānatvāt nirdeśaḥ/ yātā prāptā/ loke manuṣyaloke/ vilocanacandrikā netrāṇāṃ kaumudīti lokāntaravartināmakṛtārthatā vyajyate/ āloka iti vā padacchedaḥ/ āloke darśanamātra eva nayanāhlādiketyarthaḥ/ jagati loka iti caikatra prayogasyācāturyāt/ nayanaviṣayaṃ cakṣurgocaram/ janmani asminniti śeṣaḥ/ tasyāpyanenaiva sāphalyājjanmatvamiti bhāvaḥ/ sa eka eva/ na punarindukalādidarśanādityevakāreṇa vyāvartyate/ mahotsavaḥ mahān kalyāṇāgamaḥ/ nayanaviṣayaṃ yātā yadityanena sparśādiprāptau punaraindrapadādīnāmapyarvācīnatvamasmatpadāditi vyajyate/ atra ca candrikāśabdasya vitate candratejasi prasiddheḥ kalāśabdasya ``kalā tu ṣoḍaśo bhāga'' ityaṃśamātravācitvād athavā jyotsnātapādiśabdānāṃ ``ekadeśasthitasyāgnerjyotsnā vistāriṇī yathā'' iti, ``pratyāsannanidāghadīdhitimahastandrālucandrātapā'' iti, ``namannṛpatimaṇḍalīmukuṭacandrikādurdinā'' ityādiṣu prabhāmātravācakatvadarśanāccakṣurindriyasya cālokānugrāhyatayā tadbhāvārope kalādinindane ca vyāhatārthatvamiti nāśaṅkyam/ kalācandrikayoratyarthabhedāt kalātvāropaṇe hi vyāhatiḥ/ atrātiśayoktyā hyasambandhe sambandharūpayā nāyikāyāḥ sarvottaratvavarṇanād vyatireko'laṅkāraḥ/ tatprāptāvautsukyaṃ ca bhāvaḥ, tvaddarśanaikotsavo jano'yamananyaśaraṇaḥ karuṇayā kaṭākṣyatāmiti vastu ca dhvanyate//39//
kalahaṃsaka padānusāreṇa labdho'si/ caraṇanyāsapratibimbānyanusṛtya prāpto'si/
salajjaṃ pūrvaṃ tasyaiva dṛṣṭatvāt svairālāpaprastāvaḥ, paścāttayorapi darśanāllajjā/ kathaṃ tāvapi mahānubhāvāvatraiva/ praṇamāmi/
kalahaṃsaka upanaya citraphalakam/
gṛhāṇedam/
kena kiṃ nimittaṃ vātra mālatyālikhitā/
ya eva yannimittaṃ mālatyā/ ālikhita iti liṅgavipariṇāmaḥ/ tenaivetyāyāti/ etadutkaṇṭhāvinodanameva kāraṇīkṛtyetyarthaḥ/
diṣṭyā uddarśitaphalaṃ vijñānaṃ prajāpateḥ anayordvayorapyatiyatnato nirmāṇarūpaṃ brahmaṇaḥ śilpaṃ prayojanavajjātam/ sadṛśasaṅghaṭanādityarthaḥ/ ``vijñānaṃ śilpaśāstrayoḥ'' iti vaijayantī/
atra vastuni asmin vṛttānte/ mālatīviṣaya ityarthāt/ te vallabhaḥ kalahaṃsakaḥ/ yat kathayati ``edaṃ ca ukkaṇṭhāviṇodaṇaṃtti'' ityādi/ tattathā satyameva/ apiḥ praśne/
mahābhāga tathā/
``etattu na jñāyate, kva dṛṣṭapūrvastayā vayasya'' iti sandehanirākaraṇāya pṛcchati - kva punariti/ punaḥśabdo viśeṣe/ etaddarśanamasminnanurāgaśca tasyā upapadyatāṃ nāma/ kasmiṃstu deśe sthitā mādhavaṃ dṛṣṭavatītyetāvatyeva naḥ saṃśaya ityarthaḥ/
lavaṅgikā bhaṇati vātāyanagateti/ bhaṇatīti vartamānasāmīpyānnirdeśaḥ/ prākṛtanyāyādvā/ ``bhaṇaï ṇalo'' ``ābhāsaï suggīvo'' ityādivat bhūte prayogaḥ/ abhāṇīdityarthaḥ/
nanuranumate/ tavāpi tatsaṃvadatyevetyarthaḥ/
``praśnāvadhāraṇaitihyasamīhānumate nanu''/
iti vaijayantī/ amātya bhavaneti ``bhūyo bhūyaḥ savidhe''tyuktaṃ saṃghaṭayati/ sañcarāvahe vikramāvahe/ āvāmiti śeṣaḥ/ rathyayaiva sañcarāvahe iti ``samastṛtīyāyuktāt'' (1-3-58) ityātmanepadam/ tat tasmāt/ upapannaṃ yuktiyuktam/
anumanyatāṃ mahānubhāvo yāvadetadbhagavato devasya madanasya ca sucaritaṃ priyasakhyai lavaṅgikāyai nivedayāmi/ yāvadvākyālaṅkāre/ sucaritaṃ śobhanamanuṣṭhānam/
prāptāvasaraṃ samayocitam/
citrabhāṇḍaṃ citraphalakaṃ tadupakaraṇabhājanaṃ ca/
madhyāhnaḥ divasasya yauvanāvasthā/ gaganamadhyamadhyāsīno bhānurbahiravasthāne tapatīti bhāvaḥ/ ``rātrāhnāhāḥ puṃsi'' (3-4-29) iti pulliṅgatā/ ehi āgaccha/ saṃstyāyaṃ gṛham/ ``sanniveśe gaṇe gehe saṃstyāyaḥ'' iti vaijayantī/
kālavaśādvitarkayati - evaṃ manye itthaṃ tarkayāmi/
dharmāmbhovisaravivartanaiḥ svedaprasare viśeṣeṇa vartanaiḥ svedabinduprasarahetukairanyathābhāvairvā/ idānīṃ madhyāhnakāle vā/ tadityanubhavaparāmarśaḥ/ prātaḥ madanayātrādarśanāgamanasamaye/ vihitavicitrapatralekhāvaidagdhyaṃ nirmitānāṃ nānāvidhānāṃ haṃsamakarasiṃhamañjarīprabhṛtipatralekhānāṃ cāturyam/ jahati tyajanti/ saṃsthānaśaithilyādityarthaḥ/ ``ā hāk tyāge'' ityasmāllaṭi bahuvacane ``adabhyastād'' ityattvam/ vārasundarīgrahaṇaṃ mugdhākṣyāḥ kanyātvāt patralekhābhāvaḥ kapola iti dyotanārtham/ kuṅkumagrahaṇaṃ vasantaveṣaparigrahasaubhāgyaṃ prakāśayati/ mugdhākṣyā iti smaraṇena madanaglapitāyāstasyā madhyāhnasamayonmīlitasubhagadaśāviśeṣaśobhinyā darśanautsukyaṃ prakāśyate/ atra bhāvikaṃ sūkṣmaṃ vālaṅkāraḥ/ evaṃ manya ityanumānañcānusandheyam//40//
atha tathāvidhāyāstasyāḥ śiśiramṛdulena tadātvasparśāmṛtenotsukastadupāyaṃ gaveṣayati - unmīladityādi/ vidalatsaṅkocatayā viśālāt kundakusumakośāt/ kośaśabdo dhanasamṛddhivācako'tra lakṣaṇayā samṛddhivācī/ kuḍmalārthatve mukulaśabdena paunaruktyāt/ praścyotan prakṣaran yo dhano bahalo makarandaḥ puṣparasastatsambandhinaḥ parimalasya mitrabhūtatvenātiśliṣṭatayā/
``karālo danture tuṅge viśāle vikṛte'pi ca'' iti vaijayantī/ ``ścyutir kṣaraṇa'' iti dhātuḥ/ kundagrahaṇaṃ śiśirasaṃbandhino'pi kundasya vasante'nuvṛtteḥ ``niṣiñcan mādhavīṃ vṛddhiṃ kundaśeṣaṃ ca vartayan'' itivat/ ata eva tādṛśasya bhavataḥ sparśanasukhena īṣatpracalavilocanām ardhamukulībhavannayanām/ tāṃ yā mama hṛdayasindhucandrikā/ āliṅgan āśliṣyan/ kulapālikā kathamāliṅgyata ityatrāha - pavaneti/ punātīti pavanaḥ/ sarvapāpaharasya bhagavataḥ piturivāliṅganaṃ na duṣyati bhāvadoṣarāhityāt/
``anyathāliṅgyate kāntā bhāvena duhitānyathā/'' ityukteriti dyotyate/ aṅgamaṅgaṃ pratyekamaṅgāni/ spṛśeti/ tadaṅgasparśanenānītena mamāṅgāni nirvāpayetyarthaḥ/ atra priyatamāsparśalobhasya kāraṇasya kāryamukhena prakāśanādaprastutapraśaṃsālaṅkāraḥ//41//
priyasuhṛdo'vasthādausthyamanusandadhāno makarandastadrakṣaṇopāyaṃ tarkayati/ svagataṃ svahṛdayagatamiti/ mādhavenāśrutaṃ sadasyaiśca śrutaṃ yatheti sarvatraivaṃvidhe viṣaye draṣṭavyam/
``sarvaśrāvyaṃ prakāśaṃ syādaśrāvyaṃ svagataṃ matam'' iti vacanāt/
abhihantītyādi/ [abhihanti] atīva bādhate/ hanteti viṣāde/ hā kaṣṭamityarthaḥ/ kathamityāścarye/ asaṃbhāvitaṃ kathamidamāpatitamiti bhāvaḥ/ mādhavamiti dhairyarāśitvādi dhvanyate/ sukumārakāyaṃ komalaśarīramiti duḥkhāsahatvāt sulabhāpāyatvamāśaṅkyate/ anavagrahaḥ anargalaprasaraḥ/ acireṇa sahasaivetyāśukāritvaśaktiḥ smarasya vyajyate/ vikṛtireva vaikṛtam/ prajñāditvādaṇ svārthikaḥ/ vaikṛtasya vividhavartanena sphuraṇena dāruṇaḥ krūraḥ/ kalabhaṃ dvātriṃśadvarṣatayā saṃpūrṇayauvanavalaṃ kuñjaram/ kaṭhoraḥ asādhyatāmāpannaḥ/ kūṭapākalo gajasya sānnipātiko jvaraḥ/ ``kūṭapākalo gajeṣu'' iti vāhaṭaḥ/ upamānena nāyakasya balavattvaṃ smarasya balīyastvaṃ ca pratīyate/ upamālaṅkāraḥ//42//
atrāsmin kāryaviṣaye/ bhagavatīti sādhanasāmagryaṃ prakāśyate/ naḥ asmākamiti sarvakāryeṣu saivāsmatkulasya śaraṇamiti vyajyate/ śaraṇaṃ rakṣitrī/ ``śaraṇaṃ gṛharakṣitroḥ'' ityamaraḥ//
atha saṅkalpākhyatṛtīyadaśāmūrcchanāmātmano'nusandhatte - paśyāmītyādi/ tatastasmin vastuni/ ito'smin vastunītyaviśeṣeṇa sarveṣu ghaṭapaṭādivastuṣu saiva sphuratītyarthaḥ/ saptamyarthe tasiḥ/ purata ityādibhiḥ sarvadeśasphuraṇamāha– purataḥ purodeśe/ cakāraḥ pūraṇārthaḥ/ samuccayārthatve tu pratipadaṃ vānte vā prayogaucityāt/ paścāt pṛṣṭhadeśe/ antaḥ hṛdayadeśe/ bahirbāhyadeśe/ kiṃ bahunā paritaḥ sarvatā/ paryabhibhyāṃ sarvobhayārthe tasiḥ/ cakāraḥ samuccaye/ evakāro bhinnakramaḥ/ vartamānāmeva tiṣṭhantīmeva/ na punaḥ pratibhāsamānām/ paśyāmi pratyakṣīkaromi/ na punaḥ saṅkalpayāmītyarthaḥ/ udbuddhamugdhakanakābjanibhaṃ vikasitataruṇakanakakamalasadṛśam/ bhaumatāmarasavyatirekeṇa lāvaṇyasaukumāryasaurabhyāmlānaśobhatvādisakalaguṇasāmrājyāddivyakamalagrahaṇam/ vyāsaṅgatiryagapavartitadṛṣṭi parijanapreraṇayā nagaragamanodyatāyāḥ paścāt priyatame manasaḥ samāsaṅgo vyāsaṅgaḥ/
anyatra sotkamanyatra sthitaṃ vyāsaṅgi kathyate'' iti bhāvaprakāśaḥ/ tena tiryagvalitanayanam/ vaktraṃ mukham/ vahantīmityanena ``yāntyā muhurvalitakandharam'' ityuktāṃ tasyāgamanasamayāvasthāṃ sadā hṛdayenānusandhīyamānāṃ prakāśayati/ atraitasyā eva anekagocaratvanibandhādviśeṣo'laṅkāraḥ//43//
prakāśamiti/ makarandena sadasyaiśca śrutaṃ yathā tathetyarthaḥ/ visrambhāt sahṛdayanirviśeṣāya suhṛde svāvasthāṃ nivedayati - vayasyeti/
prasaratītyādi - prasarati pravartate, na punaḥ prasṛta iti, uparyupari pravartamānatvaṃ dhvanyate/ parimāthī paritaḥ sarvamarmaṇāṃ mathanaśīlaḥ/ ko'pītyanirdeśyaḥ/ ayamanubhavaikagamyaḥ dehadāhaḥ śarīrajvaraḥ/ tirayatitiraskaroti/ karaṇānāmindriyāṇāṃ cakṣurādīnām/ grāhakatvaṃ rūpādiviṣayajñānaśaktim/ pramohaḥ prakṛṣṭā vicittatā/ raṇaraṇikavivṛddhim utkaṇṭhātiśayam/ bibhrat dhārayat/ āvartamānaṃ kvathanena vilīyamānam/ āvartanaṃ kvathanena vilāpanam/ ``sandhyānalena bhṛśamambaramūṣikāyāmāvartitairuḍubhireva kṛto'yaminduḥ/'' iti murāryuktavat/ jvalati dīpyate/ antariti bahirjvalane hi jvalanavat kenāpyupāyena nirvāpayituṃ śakyate/ antarjvalat kathaṃ nirvāpaṇīyamiti dainyaṃ dhvanyate/ tanmayatvaṃ nāyikātmakatvam/ anena ``paricchedavyaktirna bhavati'' ityuktasyārthasyānusandhānaṃ kṛtamiti veditavyam/ anyathā prakṛtarasānanusandhāne rasadoṣāpātasambhavāt/ ato na paunaruktyam/ smaramohitasya ca svānubhavakathanapaunaruktyaṃ pratyuta guṇa eveti sarvaṃ samīcīnam/ atrātiśayoktiralaṅkāraḥ//44//
iti niṣkrāntāḥ/ raṅgāt bahirnirgatā ityarthaḥ/ ``ekāhaprayojyasya nāṭakāṃśasyāṅkaḥ'' iti bharate kṛtā saṃjñā/ sa sampūrṇa ityarthaḥ/
mālatīmādhavasyetthaṃ prathamāṅkārthacarcanam/
pūrṇajyotiḥprasādena cakre pūrṇasarasvatī// //iti prathamo'ṅkaḥ//
atha dvitīyo'ṅkaḥ/
atha vṛttavartiṣyamāṇakathāṃśapradarśanena dvitīyāṅkāvatārāya kavīśvaraḥ praveśakamārabhate - tataḥ praviśataśceṭyāviti/ ceṭyau mālatyā dāsyaviti nīcapātratvam/ ``tadvadevānudāttoktyā nīcapātraprayojitaḥ/
praveśo'ṅkadvayasyāntaḥ śeṣārthasyopasūcakaḥ//'' ityukteḥ prathamadvitīyāṅkayormadhye ca prayuktaḥ/ prathamāṅke niṣedhāt/
prathameti - praveśakrameṇa prathamātvaṃ dvitīyātvaṃ ca/ sakhi! saṅgītaśālāparisare avalokitādvitīyā tvaṃ kimapi mantrayantyāsīḥ/
nāṭyagṛhasamīpe tena kila mādhavapriyavayasyena makarandena sakalo madanodyānavṛttānto bhagavatyai niveditaḥ/ mālatīmādhavayoranyonyadarśanotkaṇṭhādikā ca pravṛttiḥ/ tato bhartṛdārikāṃ draṣṭukāmayā tayā pravṛttinimittamavalokitā anupreṣitā/ tataḥ tasmāt svābhilaṣitadvāralābhādityarthaḥ/ tayā bhagavatyā pravṛttinimittaṃ kva vartate mālatī kiṃ vā karotīti pravṛttijñānahetoḥ/ samayopasarpaṇīyatvāt prabhūṇām/ mayāpi tasyai kathitam, yathā lavaṅgikādvitīyā vivikte bhartṛdārikā vartata iti/ tasyai avalokitāyai/ lavaṅgikaiva dvayoḥ pūraṇīti tṛtīyenivṛttiḥ pratipādyate/ vivikte vijane deśe/ ``viviktau pūtavijanau'' iti vaijayantī/
sakhi lavaṅgikā khalu kesarakusumānyavacinomītimadanodyānādeva nāgatā/ kinnu sāmprataṃ samprāptā/ khalu prasiddhau/ tvayāpi tadviditamevetyarthaḥ/ avacinomīti/ na punaravacetum/ itiśabdaprayogastaduktervyājatvaṃ sūcayati/ sāmpratam idānīm/ kinnu samprāptetyanena ``sakhīkadambakādanyatamā vilambya'' ityuktamanusmārayati/
atha kim/ tāṃ khalvāpatantīmeva haste gṛhītvā aparijanā bhartṛdārikā uparyalindaṃ samārūḍhā/ āpatantīṃ āgacchantīmeva/ na punarāgatāmiti tadvārtāśravaṇādaratvarā vyajyate/ aparijanā parivārarahitā/ bhūtveti śeṣaḥ/ uparyalindaṃ prāsādagataṃ prakoṣṭham/
``pradhāṇapradhaṇālindā bahirdvāraprakoṣṭhake/'' ityalindaśabdo lakṣaṇayātra prakoṣṭhamātramāha/
aparijanetyanenānuminoti - nūnaṃ tasya mahānubhāvasya saṅkathayā ātmānaṃ vinodayati/ tasya mādhavasya/ saṅkathayā sakhyā saha sametya vārtayā/
niśvasyeti svāmisnehādaniṣṭamāśaṅkyāvignahṛdayatvaṃ sūcayati/ kuto'syā āśvāsaḥ/ etenādya saviśeṣadarśanenātibhūmiṃ khalu tasyā abhiniveśo gamiṣyati/ āśvāsaḥ hṛdayaduḥkhaśāntiḥ/ saviśeṣadarśanena dūragatavātāyanāntaritakṣaṇikadarśanavyatirekeṇa, madanodyāne samīpataściraprayuktena darśanena/ atibhūmiṃ parāṃ kāṣṭhām/ abhiniveśo hṛdayasyāgrahaḥ/
``nitāntarūkṣābhiniveśamīśam'' itivat/ anyacca astīti śeṣaḥ/ nandanasya kāraṇānmahārājo bhartṛdārikāṃ prārthayamāno'mātyena vijñaptaḥ/
kimiva/ ivaśabdo vākyālaṅkāre/ vijñapta ityanukṛṣyate/
prabhavati nijasya kanyakājanasya mahārāja iti/ prabhavati prabhurbhavati la dānādāviti śeṣaḥ/ nijasyetyanenāsatyaparihārāya mahārājasambandhina iti mukhyavṛttyā pratipādya chalena svaputryā mālatyā rājño'pi dharmataḥ putrītvamāsūtrya rājānaṃ vyāmohayato ``rājakanyānāṃ rājā prabhuḥ, matputryā ahameva prabhuḥ'' iti prārthanāṃ pratyācakṣāṇasya bhūrivasorvacanaṃ yathāśrutameva parikalpya ārjavena nīcapātraṃ ceṭī svayamanuśocati/ ata āmaraṇaṃ khalu mālatyā hṛdayaśalyaṃ mādhavānurāga iti tarkayāmi/ ataḥ vāgdattatvāt/ āmaraṇaṃ/ āṅ maryādāyām/ prāṇatyāgaṃ yāvadityarthaḥ/ hṛdayaśalyaṃ manogataṃ śastramukham/ śalyagrahaṇena dussahatayā prāṇāpāyo'pyacireṇa bhaviṣyatīti snehādāśaṅkyate/
api nāma bhagavatī atra kimapi bhagavatītvaṃ darśayiṣyati/ jñānatapaḥprabhāvasampannatayā nanu kāmandakī sarvairasmābhirbhagavatīti pūjyate/ ataḥ pratibhābalena tapasā ca svasāmarthyaṃ prakāśayati/ api nāmeti sambhāvanāyām/
ayi asaṃbaddhamanorathe! sakhi ehi/ pitari pratikūle bhagavatyā apyakiñcitkaratvād aghaṭita evāyaṃ manoratha ityarthaḥ/ ehi āgaccha, svādhikārānuṣṭhānāyeti bhāvaḥ/
niṣkrānte iti/ amātyavijñāpanasya vṛttasya madanodyānapratinivṛttalavaṅgikādvitīyamālatīdarśanārthaṃ kāmandakyāgamanasya ca varttiṣyamāṇasya cāṃśasya sūcitatvāt praveśakaphalasiddheste nirgate ityarthaḥ/
(praveśakaḥ/)
atha nīrase vastuni sūcite sarasavastuprayogāya dvitīyamaṅkamārabhate tataḥ praviśatītyādi/ upaviṣṭeti/ tathātvenaiva praveśakaḥ/ lavaṅgikā ceti/ lavaṅgikādvitīyetyuktaṃ saṃghaṭayati/
sakhi tatastataḥ anantaraṃ kimityarthaḥ/ vīpsayā śravaṇādaro dhvanyate/ tatastata ityanena pūrvapravṛttatvaṃ saṅkathāyāḥ sūcyate/
tatastena mahānubhāvenopanītā me iyaṃ bakulamālā/
iti - anayā uktibhaṅgyā ``atha tasyāḥ kareṇukārohaṇasamaya evetyārabhya'' ``mahānayaṃ prasāda iti pragṛhītavatī'' ityantasya kathāṃśasya mādhavoktyā prakāśitasya lavaṅgikayā mālatyai pūrvaṃ niveditatvaṃ sūcayaṃstataḥ paraṃ vicchinnasyaiva prakāśanamadhikaroti rasasudhāsaṃvidhānasāvadhānaḥ kavīśvaraḥ, punaḥ kathanasya rasavighātakatvāt/ arpayati dadāti/
nirvarṇya nirūpya/ mālāmiti prakaraṇāt/ sakhi! ekapārśvaviṣamapratibaddheyaṃ viracanā ekasmin bhāge bhāgāntaraprakramaprakāravisadṛśaṃ yathā tathā pratibaddhā gumphitā/ iyaṃ viracanā viracyata iti viracanā mālā kathyate/
atrāramaṇīyatve tvamevāparāddhāsi/
kathamiva - ivaśabdo vākyālaṅkāre/
yena sa dūrvāśyāmalāṅgastathā vihastīkṛtaḥ/ yeneti yasmādarthe'vyayam/ dūrvākāṇḍamiva śyāmalamaṅgaṃ yasyeti saundaryopalakṣaṇam/ tatheti mālāgrathanaprakramanirvāhe'pi yathā na śakto'bhūdityarthaḥ/ vihastīkṛtaḥ paravaśīkṛtaḥ/
tadvacanaṃ mṛṣodyamāśaṅkamānā mālatyāha - sakhi lavaṅgike sarvathā āśvāsanaśīlāsi/ manovasthāpanaṃ svabhāvo yasyāḥ/
sakhi! kātra āśvāsanaśīlatā/ svāpratyakṣe hi vastuni parasya mṛṣāvacanamāśaṅkyate, idaṃ tu na tathetyāha - nanviti saṃvāde/ nanu bhaṇāmi/ sa priyasakhyā mandamārutapracalitapraphullapuṇḍarīkavibhramābhyāṃ prathamārabdhabakulāvalīviracanāpadeśasaṃyamanabalātkāravistīryamāṇābhyāṃ locanābhyāṃ vijṛmbhamāṇavismayastimitadīrghaparyantaparivartanāvilāsollasitabhrūvibhāvitānaṅgaśārṅgavibhramavidagdhamavalokayan pratyakṣīkṛta eva/ prathamārabdheti/ tvaddarśanātpūrvamevopakrāntakesaramālāgrathanavyājena yatsaṃyamanaṃ nirodhanaṃ, tato balātkāreṇa paravaśatayā prasaradbhyāmityarthaḥ/ paryanto'pāṅgadeśaḥ tatra parivartanā tārāsañcaraṇam/ tadvilāsenollasitābhyāmuccalitābhyāṃ bhrūbhyāṃ prakāśitena madanadhanurvibhrameṇa vidagdhaṃ yathā tathāvalokayanniti ``śārṅgaṃ cāpe hare (śca tava ṛ ścāpi'') iti viśeṣavācako'pi śārṅgaśabdo'tra lakṣaṇayā dhanuḥsāmānyamāha/ prasannaṃ vidagdhaṃ caitadvīkṣitam/ ``tatprasannaṃ bhavet sabhrūvilāsaṃ sasmitaṃ ca yat/
vidagdhaṃ tadyadāloke vivaśāḥ sarvajantavaḥ''ṃ//
iti bhāvaprakāśaḥ//
pariṣvajyeti/ tadukteḥ svābhilaṣitasaṃvādāt praharṣavivaśatvādāliṅganaṃ pūrṇapātrīkṛtyetyarthaḥ/
ām ityanuvādārthamavyayam/ pratyakṣīkṛta evetyarthaḥ/ tatra codyaṃ vidyata ityāha - priyasakhi kiṃ tāvat tasya svābhāvikā eva te muhūrtasannidhāyino janasya vipralambhayitāro vilāsāḥ/ athavā yathā priyasakhī saṃbhāvayati/ tāvacchabdo vākyālaṅkāre/ svābhāvikāḥ prakṛtisiddhāḥ/ kṣaṇamātradarśanaviṣayasyetyaparicitatvāt saṃśayaucityaṃ dyotyate/ vipralambhayitāraḥ vañcakāḥ/ asmānuddiśyeti śeṣaḥ/ jaḍānāṃ bhramakāriṇa ityarthaḥ vilāsāḥ śṛṅgāraceṣṭāviśeṣāḥ/
``gatiḥ sagarvā dṛṣṭiśca vilāse sasmitaṃ vacaḥ/'' iti lakṣitāḥ/ priyasakhī yathā saṃbhāvayati tvadviṣayā eveti/ bhavatī yathā tarkayati tathaivetyarthaḥ//
vihasyeti/ svayaṃ suṣṭhu viditatattvāpi tadudantaśravaṇakautukena punaḥ pṛcchatīti jātahāsetyarthaḥ/ sāsūyaṃ - taduktimasahamāneva/ tvamapi svabhāvenaiva tasminnavasare asaṅgītaṃ nartitāsi/ tasminnavasare mādhavadarśanasamaye/ tauryatrikavācako'pi saṅgītaśabdo'tra pāriśeṣyād gītavādyamātravṛttiḥ/ tvamapīti/ sa cettvayaivaṃ śaṅkyate, tarhi tvamapi svabhāvenaiva nartakena gītaṃ vādyaṃ ca vinā nṛttaṃ kāritāsi/ na punastadviṣayeṇa premṇeti prativandiparigraheṇa svānubhūtyā tāṃ pratyāyayati/ nartitāsīti dhairyalajjādyapagamena spaṣṭadṛṣṭavaikṛtatvam ācāryakaṃ vijayītyuktamanusmārayati/
salajjamiti/ tadātvavṛttāntamātmano'nusmṛtya aho sakhībhirjñāto'yamartha iti lajjitetyarthaḥ/ vihasyeti/ taduktyā parājitatvādvilakṣasmitaṃ kṛtvetyarthaḥ/ humityanuvāde/ ``āmantraṇe bhartsane huṃ'' iti vaijayantī/ tatastataḥ/
tataḥ pratinivarttamānajanayātrāsaṃkulenāntarite tasmin mandārikāyā gṛhamupagatāsmi/ tasyāḥ citraphalakaṃ prabhāte haste kṛtamāsīt/ mayeti śeṣaḥ/
kiṃnimittam/
tāṃ khalu mādhavānucaraḥ kalahaṃsako nāma kāmayate tasmai darśayiṣyatīti/
tataḥ priyanivedikā me mandārikā saṃvṛttā/ priyanivedikā diṣṭyā vardhasa iti priyavacanākhyāyikā/
nūnaṃ tenāpi kalahaṃsakena tatpraticchandamātmanaḥ prabhave darśitaṃ bhaviṣyati/ sakhi! kimidānīṃ te priyam/
etat khalu tasya santāpakāriṇo durlabhamanorathāveśadussahāyāsadahyamānacittakṣaṇamātranirvāpakaṃ tava praticchandam/ mama priyamiti saṃbadhyate/
saharṣocchvāsaṃ/ hṛdayaduḥkhabhāralaghūbhāvasūcakaḥ ucchvāsaḥ/ nirvarṇya nirūpya/ aho idānīmapi hṛdayasya me'nāśvāso yenaitadapyāśvāsanavipralambha iti sambhāvyate/ idānīmapi rekhāvinyāsaviśeṣeṇa priyatamakṛtatvanirṇaye'pītyarthaḥ/ anāśvāsaḥ aśraddhā/ etad madrūpalekhanamapi/ āśvāsanārthaṃ sakhī svahastalikhitena vañcanamityutprekṣyate/ athaśabdo vyāvṛttau/ citravyatirekeṇa tena akṣarāṇyapi likhitānyatretyarthaḥ/ akṣaragrahaṇaṃ samudāyanirīkṣaṇāt/ pūrvameva katipayākṣaramātradarśanaharṣākulitatvaṃ dyotayati/ sānandaṃ sukhānubhavasahitam/
ākāśe nāyakamabhimukhīkṛtyāha hṛdayasannihitaṃ vā/ mahābhāga sadṛśaṃ khalu te nirmāṇasya vacanaṃ madhuratayā darśanaṃ punastatkālamanoharaṃ pariṇāmadīrghasantāpadāruṇaṃ ca/ nirmāṇasya dehasṛṣṭeḥ/ madhuratayā hṛdayāhlādakatvena/ sadṛśaṃ anurūpam/ pariṇāme kālāntare santataduḥkhadussahaṃ ca/ dhanyāḥ khalu tāḥ striyaḥ, yāstvāṃ na paśyanti ātmano vā hṛdayasya prabhavanti/ tvāṃ na paśyanti nimittābhāvānnaimittikasya raṇaraṇakaduḥkhasyāprasaṅgāt/ atidhīratayā nīrasatayā vā svahṛdayasya nivāraṇe vā śaknuvanti/
kiṃ sakhi evamapi te nāstyāśvāsaḥ/ evamapi anena prakāreṇāpi/
kathamiti evamityuktaprakārajijñāsā/
yasya kāraṇāt tvamuttruṭitabandhanaṃ kaṅkelīpallavamiva klāntanavamālikākusumanissahāparihīyase/ khaṇḍitavṛntamaśokakisalayamiva śuṣyasi/ mlānanavamālikākusumamiva prakṛtyā durbaletyarthaḥ/ so'pi jñāpito bhagavatā manmathena santāpasya dussahatvamiti/ anena prakāreṇāpi kiṃ nāśvāsaḥ ``akṛtārthe'pi manasije ratimubhayaprārthanā kurute'' iti nyāyādityarthaḥ/
atisnehāt pāpamāśaṅkamānā mālatyāśāste - sakhi! kuśalaṃ tāvattasya mahānubhāvasya bhavatu/ puruṣaratnatvāttasya lokānugrahāyāpi kuśalaṃ cirajīvanamāśāsyameveti bhāvaḥ/ mama punaḥ sudurlabha āśvāsaḥ/ punaḥśabdo vyāvṛttau/
sāsraṃ apratīkāradāruṇatvaṃ svasantāpasyānucintyāvignahṛdayatayā sabāṣpam/ saṃskṛtamāśrityeti/
``kāryataścottamādīnāṃ kāryo bhāṣāvyatikramaḥ/'' iti vacanānniryantraṇanijaduḥkhanivedanāya saṃskṛtabhāṣāmavalambyāhetyarthaḥ/
manoroga ityādi - rujati bhanaktīti rogaḥ/ manaso vyādhirityanenābāhyatvād durucchedatvaṃ vyajyate/ tīvramiti viṣaviśeṣaṇam/ dussahatayā prasiddhaṃ kālakūṭamivetyarthaḥ/ vidhutaḥ pāvaka iveti garīyān jvara iveti saviśeṣaṇopamānaprakramāt/ visarpan uparyupari vijṛmbhamāṇaḥ/ kampasvedādisvakāryakaraṇena śarīraṃ vyāpnuvan vā/ visarpaṇasya vidhīyamānayorjvalanahiṃsanayordvayorapi sādhāraṇyād visarpannityanuvādaḥ/ ``visarpatyavirataṃ'' iti vā pāṭhaḥ/ pramāthī marmavyathanaśīlaḥ/ nirdhūmaṃ nirastadhūmamiti nirvicchedatvaṃ jvalanasyoktam/ anyathā dhūmaprasaṅgāt/ manorogasya nirdhaūmatvaṃ nāma māndyaṃ vihāya nirargalaḥ prasaraḥ/ vidhutaḥ calitendhanaḥ/ tadānīṃ jvālāprasarasyāvasaralābhāt/
``jvalati calitendhano'gniḥ'' iti śākuntalokteḥ/ hinasti antaḥ praviśya tudati/ pratyaṅgaṃ pṛthak pṛthagaṅgāni/ garīyān gurutaraḥ/ sānnipātikādirasādhyo jvara iva/ upamānaiḥ kramānmūrcchādijanakatvaṃ vedanāsantāno mahoṣmaprasaraśca prakāśyate/ ataḥ yata evamatibhūmiṃ gatastasmād/ ito manorogāddhetoḥ/ trātuṃ rakṣitum/ ``bhītrārthānāṃ bhayahetuḥ'' (2-4-25) iti pañcamī/ tātaḥ pitā/ na prabhavati na śaknoti/ ambā mātā/ bhavatī tvaṃ ca/ yuṣmadatiśāyino bandhorabhāvād yuṣmābhirapyayamacikitsyo vyādhirityarthaḥ/ ato mama tu nāstyeva jīvitapratyāśā/ so'pi tāvat kuśalī bhavatviti sambandhaḥ/ upamātrālaṅkāraḥ//1//
atha vṛttavastuparijñānādanāvegā lavaṅgikā bhaṅgyā tadguṇasaṅkīrtanena svayaṃgrahāya protsāhayati ``prathamamiti śīlayogādākhyānādyairviśeṣayedenām'' iti kāmaśāstre dūtīkarmokteḥ/ evametat/ pratyakṣasaukhyadāyinaḥ parokṣaduḥkhadussahā sajjanasamāgamā bhavanti/ sannidhau sukhakarā asannidhau duḥkhakāriṇaśca/ api ca priyasakhi yasya vātāyanāntaritamuhūrtadarśanena samiddhahutavahāyamānapūrṇacandrodayā niṣkaruṇakāmavyāpārasaṃśayitajīvitā te śarīrāvasthā, tasyaiva samprāptasaviśeṣadarśanādadya santapyasa iti kimatra bhaṇitavyam/ samiddhahutavahāyamānaḥ pradīptavahnivadācaran dehadāhāt, pūrṇacandrodayo yasyāḥ atra kiṃ bhaṇitavyam ayamartho na vāggocara ityarthaḥ/ priyasakhi ślāghanīyo durlabhamanorathaphalaṃ jīvalokasya gurvanurāgasarasamahābhāgavallabhasamāgama iti etāvajjānīma iti/ ślāghanīyaḥ pitrādīnāmapyabhinandanīya iti tacchaṅkāṃ nivartayati/ durlabhamanorathaphalaṃ duṣprāpaṃ saṅkalpaprayojanam/ ślāghyatvāderhetumāha - gurvanurāgasarasamahābhāgavallabhasamāgama iti/ svasyāmanurāgaśālinaḥ kalākauśalādibhirvidagdhasya mahākulīnatvādibhirniratiśayamahābhāgyasya svapremāspadatayā vallabhasya janasya samāgamaḥ saṃyoga ityarthaḥ/ tā piasahi ityādirbhedaḥ protsāhanāt/ nanu``gāndharvarākṣasau rājñaḥ'' iti smṛteḥ, brāhmaṇayoḥ kathaṃ gāndharvo vivāhaḥ pratipādyate/ ucyate/ nātra gāndharvo vivāho vidhīyate/ ``mayā ca tubhyaṃ dīyata'' iti, ``preyo mitraṃ bandhutā vā samagrā'' iti, pitṛbuddhyanusāreṇa gurubhūtakāmandakīmukhataḥ prājāpatyasyaivopari vakṣyamāṇatvādatra tu prājāpatyābhimukhyena parasparānukūlyasyaiva vidhīyamānatvāttasya ca sarvavivāheṣu praśastatayā sādhāraṇyāt/ vakṣyate ca itaretarānurāgo hi dārakarmaṇi parārdhyaṃ maṅgalam'' iti/ tato na kaścidvirodhaḥ/
atha sakhīhṛdayaṃ vijñāya atipraśritatayā kulapālikāmaulimālikā mālatī sāhasaṃ pratyācaṣṭe - sakhi dayitamālatījīvite! sāhasopanyāsinyapehi/ dayitamālatījīvita iti kāraṇavicāraṇāsaham/ athavā ``svaṃ vīkṣya manmathonmathitam'' iti vacanād ``yena kenāpyupāyena rakṣaṇīyāḥ suhṛdā suhṛdasavaḥ'' iti nyāyena maddaśāviśeṣadarśanāt pramādaśaṅkinyāste matprāṇā eva priyā na punardharma ityarthaḥ/ mālatīśabdenārthāntarasaṃkramitavācyena sahajasauhṛdārdrahṛdayatvaṃ tasyāḥ prakāśayati/ sāhasopanyāsini sāhasaṃ pitrādilaṅghanena svābhimatānuṣṭhānaṃ, tacchaṃsini/ kartavyatvena tadvidadhāsīti taddhṛdayaprakāśanam/ ato'pehi purato'pasaretyasūyayā vacanam/ athavā ahameva vāraṃ vāraṃ palāyamānavyavasthāpitadhīratvāvaṣṭambhenātmano hṛdayena dūrīkṛtalajjā durvinayalaghvī atrāparādhyāmīti/ athaveti - tava na kaściddoṣo matsnehānuguṇaṃ pravartanāditi tadupālambhaṃ nivartayati/ tarhi kasya doṣa ityatrāha - vāraṃ vāraṃ kṣaṇe kṣaṇe/ palāyamānamapasarad vyavasthāpitaṃ haṭhāt pratinivartitaṃ ca dhairyameva avaṣṭambha āśrayo yasya/ anyathā sphuṭanādiprasaṅgāt/ tena svasyā hṛdayena nirastakāryabhayā/ durvinayalaghvī avinayena avijitendriyatvātmanā prākṛtapramadeva sajjanabahumānabāhyabhūtā/ atra asmin vastuni/ aparādhyāmi sadoṣā bhavāmi/ etanmūlatvādīdṛśānāṃ bhavādṛśavacanānāmavakāśasyetyarthaḥ/
yadi sāhasaṃ na kriyate kathaṃ tarhi jīvitaṃ rakṣyata ityāśaṅkyāha - jvalatu gagana ityādi/ ``samiddhahudavahāantapuṇṇacandodāa ṇikkaruṇakāmavāvārasaṃsaïdajīvidā'' iti tadvacanamanūdya pariharati - jvalatu tapatu iti gūḍhavyaṅgyalākṣaṇikaśabdaprayogena dahanavad dussahatvaṃ śaśinaḥ prakāśyate/ gagana iti pūrvasāgarādāvirbhāvasamaya eva tāpajanakatvaṃ vyajyate/ samīpagatatve hi musalyasya cūrṇīkaraṇatvādi śakyate/ dūrasthitasya tu kā pratikriyetyasūyāpi/ rātrau rātrāvakhaṇḍakala iti pratirajani pūrṇa evāyam, na punaḥ parvaṇyeveti nityadurviṣahatayātiyaśaḥ pratipādyate/ śaśīti pūrvameva kalaṅkinaḥ strīvadhādiṣu kā śaṅketi niṣkaruṇatā vyajyate/ madanaḥ madayati paravaśīkaroti janamiti prasiddhasya taducitameveti bhāvaḥ/ madana ityanena tasya manasijatvasvābhāvyādāntaratvaṃ ca dyotyate/ gagane śaśī jvalatu madano dahatviti bahirantaśca vipadi vitatāyāṃ kā prāṇitavyapratyāśeti vyajyate/ kāmacārakaraṇe loṭau/ tatsaṃrambhaprayojanasya phalgutāṃ tasya ca sveṣṭatayā/ siddhasādhanatvādaniṣṭaprasañjanābhāvaṃ cāha/ pareṇeti vibhaktipratirūpakamavyayam/ mṛtyoḥ maraṇāt paramadhikam/ kiṃ vā vidhāsyataḥ kariṣyataḥ/ etāviti dvivacanasāmarthyādākṣipyate/
``tāmeva śāntamathavā kimataḥ pareṇa/'' iti, ``āryeṇāsmin virama viramātaḥparaṃ na kṣamo'smi/'' iti cāsyaiva kaveḥ prayogāt/ ``pañcamī vibhakte'' (2-3-42) iti pañcamī/ sarvo'pyayamanarthaḥ kiñcit svātantryamavalambya pratikartumīṣatkara eveti cettatrāha - mama tviti/ turviśeṣe/ tava bhavatu nāmaivaṃ buddhirmama punastathā netyarthaḥ/ dayitaḥ iṣṭatamatvena rakṣaṇīya ityarthaḥ/ ślāghyaḥ śrutaśīlādibhiḥ pūjyaḥ/ amalānvayā itaḥ pūrvaṃ malānvayena doṣasambandhena rahitā/ jananī mātā/ dayiteti vipariṇāmaḥ/ tayorguṇavattve'pi vaṃśyeṣu kaścinmalinimā bhaviṣyatītyāha - kulaṃ vaṃśam/ aviśeṣeṇa mātuḥ pituścetyāyāti/ amalinaṃ vṛttadoṣarahitatvena prasiddhamityarthaḥ/
``na kulaṃ vṛttahīnasya pramāṇamiti me matiḥ/'' iti mahābhāratokteḥ/ dayitamiti vipariṇāmaḥ/ ślāghyatvādayo dayitatve hetavaḥ//
``mātuḥ kulaṃ pitṛkulaṃ yatra caiva pradīyate/
kulatrayaṃ saṃśayitaṃ kurute kanyakā'satī//'' iti vyāsopalambhasya nāhaṃ bhūmiriti bhāvaḥ/ tarhi tvanmūlaṃ tasya tannimittaṃ ca tava nissaṃśayaḥ prāṇāpāya iti cettatrāha - natveveti/ ayaṃ jano mādhavaḥ/ hṛdayasannidhānāt prastutatvācca idamaḥ parāmarśaḥ/ ayaṃ janastu na dayita eva/ na tatra saṃśaya ityarthaḥ/ tarhi kathamayaṃ tadviṣayo lokottarānurāga iti cettatrāha - na ca jīvitaṃ dayitaṃ rakṣaṇīyam/ prāṇaparityāgenaiva caritārthatvāttadanurāgāyāpi na kiñcidṛṇaṃ dhārayāmītyabhiprāyaḥ/ ataḥ svātantryaṃ nāvalambyate, jīvitaṃ ca parityajyate ityanena/
``satāṃ kenāpi kāryeṇa lokasyārādhanaṃ vratam/
tatpūritaṃ hi tātena māṃ ca prāṇāṃśca muñcatā//'' ityuktakrameṇa ``kulapālanodyatānāṃ jīvitādapi kulameva rakṣaṇīyam/ anurāgaśca kvacidrūḍhaḥ/ prāṇaparityāge'pi na cālyate'' ityuttamanāyikātvaṃ mālatyāḥ sahṛdayacamatkārakārikaviparameśvareṇa prakāśitaṃ veditavyam/ dhairyaṃ cātra bhāvaḥ prakāśyate/ atra ca jvalatvityādibhiratiśayasya pratipādanāt sāhasakaraṇasya ca kāryasya kāraṇamukhena prakāśanādatiśayoktiraprastutapraśaṃsā cālaṅkāraḥ/ natvevāyaṃ jano na ca jīvitamitīṣṭaniṣedhāt, kiṃ vā mṛtyoḥ pareṇetyaniṣṭavidheyaśca sāhasetaropāyagaveṣaṇe niyogarūpaviśeṣapratipādanaparyavasānenābhāsamānādākṣepālaṅkārabhedadvayamapyaṃśe draṣṭavyam//2//
atredānīṃ ka upāyaḥ/ evaṃvidhe vyasane kaḥ pratīkāropāya ityarthaḥ/
naipathyārdhapraviṣṭā naipathyāt kiñcit praviṣṭeti/ samayāparijñānāt sāśaṅkatvaṃ prakāśyate/ pratīhārī dauvārikī/ eṣā bhagavatī kāmandakī/ upāya iti daivāt sambadhyate/
ubhe mālatīlavaṅgike/ sakautukaṃ śravaṇakutūhalasahitam/ kiṃ bhagavatī! kiṃ karotīti sāmānyataḥ praśnaḥ/
bhagavatītiśabdenāgateti śiṣyāṃ preṣitavatītyevamāhetyādikriyāsāmānyānvayasya sambhāvyamānatvād bhartṛdārikāṃ draṣṭukāmā āgateti vivakṣito'nvayaḥ/ gandhākhyaṃ cedaṃ prastāvanāṅgam/
``gaṇḍaṃ prastutasambandhabhinnārthaṃ sahasoditam/'' iti lakṣitaṃ kavinā vaidagdhyāt saṅghaṭitaṃ veditavyam/ kimiti vilambyate/ tayeti śeṣaḥ/ na khalu bhagavatyāgamane asmākamapi samayaḥ kadācidityarthaḥ/
citraṃ chādayatīti cāpalāparijñānārtham/
susamāhitaṃ khalu jātaṃ ityupāyānveṣaṇasamaye tadāgamanāditi lavaṅgikāmukhena kaviḥ svasaṃvidhānacāturīmanusmārayati/
``pabhavadi ṇiassa kaṇṇāajaṇasse'ti praveśakaprastutamarthaṃ saṅghaṭayati - sādhu sakhe! iti/ ākāśe tadābhimukhyenāha - sakhe iti/ sabrahmacāritvāduktiḥ/ sādhu śobhanam/ vīpsayā camatkārātiśayaḥ prakāśyate/ ubhayalokāviruddhaṃ asyāmuṣya cobhayorlokayorapratikūlaṃ, vācyavyaṅgyābhyāṃ priyasatyayoḥ pratipādanāt/ uttaraṃ prativacanam/ rājavacanasyetyarthāt/ vṛttāntena parasparadarśanādinā/ kimapyadbhutaṃ anirdeśyamāścaryam/ bakulāvalīcitraphalakavyatikarasaṃvidhānakaṃ mādhavagrathitāyā mālāyā mālatīhastagamanaṃ, mālatīvilikhitasya tatpraticchandasya mādhavadṛṣṭigocaratvaṃ, tena ca tasyā lekhanaṃ, tayā ca taddarśanamiti sammiśraṇarūpaṃ kathāsaṅghaṭanam/ pramodaṃ prakṛṣṭaṃ harṣa [ullāsayati] unmīlayati/ itaretarānurāgaḥ parasparapremā dārakarmaṇi vivāhe/ parārdhyaṃ praśastam/ maṅgalam abhyudayasādhanam/ parārdhyaṃ maṅgalamiti dinagaṇamāhendrādīnāṃ maṅgalānāṃ madhye mukhyamidameveti dyotayati/ asminnarthe bhagavata āpastambasyāṃ[sya] vacanaṃ pramāṇayati - gītaḥ uktaḥ/ yasyāṃ manaścakṣuṣornibandhaḥ tasyāmṛddhiḥ iti/ yasyāṃ kanyāyāṃ varasya cakṣuṣastadvāreṇa manasaśca saktiḥ tasyāṃ dhanādisaṃvardhanena sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitamitivat/ tasyāmṛddhiriti hetāvo[vau]pacārikaḥ prayogaḥ/
eṣā mālatī/
nirvarṇya tadākāraṃ nirūpya/
nikāmamityādi - nikāmaṃ bhṛśam/ kṣāmāṅgī kṛśaśarīreti pañcamadaśāpraveśoktiḥ/ sarasakadalīgarbhasubhagā amlānarambhāstambhavat pāṇḍareṇa lāvaṇyena ramaṇīyā/ viśeṣaṇatrayaṃ sādhāraṇo dharmaḥ/ kalāśeṣā kalaiva śeṣaḥ suraparipītyupayuktābhyo anyā yasyāḥ/ mūrttiḥ śarīraṃ kalāmātrasyaiva tadānīṃ mūrttitvāt/ śaśino mūrttiriti ``rāhoḥ śira'' itivadaupacārikaḥ prayogaḥ/ athavā kṣayodayaśīlānāṃ kalānāṃ kūṭasthamadhiṣṭhānaṃ caitanyopādhimūrttirityucyate/ netrotsavakarī utsavaśabdena pramodo lakṣyate, nayanānāṃ pramodahetuḥ/ kṛño hetutācchīlyānulomyeṣu (3-2-2) iti hetau ṭaḥ/ netrotsavakarīti pratipadbhavatvaṃ prakāśyate/ ``viśeṣaḥ kālikovasthā'' ityamaraḥ/ madanadahanoddāhavidhurāṃ agnivatsudussahasya kāmasyātiśayitena tāpena paravaśāmavasthāṃ prāptā/ kalyāṇī praśastaguṇā/ ramayati sukhayati/ netrotsavakaraṇāt svābhimatānukūlyācca/ kampayati snehaparavaśāt pāpaśaṅkayodvejayati ca/ madanadāhavidhuratvāt saukumāryātirekācca/ atra pūrvasminnupamālaṅkāraḥ, uttarasminnardhe virodhaḥ/ harṣāvegayośca bhāvayoḥ sandhiḥ prakāśyate//3//
madanavedanāparihārasya svayaṃ suṣṭhu saṃvidhāsyamānatvādāvegamapāsya punastasyā śobhātiśayaṃ camatkaroti/ paripāṇḍvityādi/ pāṃsulakapolaṃ lalāṭikācandanadhūlidhūsaragaṇḍamaṇḍalam/ durbalakapolamityapi pāṭhaḥ/ kṣāmatayā mṛdutarakapolamityarthaḥ/ manoharataratvaṃ pūrvāvasthāto'pi ramaṇīyataratvam/ ``dvivacanavibhajyopapade tarabīyasunau'' (5-3-57) iti vibhajyopapade tarap/ ``bauddhe'pi pratiyoginyātiśāyinikā'' iti vacanāt buddhisthaḥ pūrvāvasthāpratiyogiko'trātiśāyanikaprayogaḥ/ ramaṇīyajanmani śobhanasvābhāvikarūpe/ paribhraman sarvāṅgīṇasphuran/ lalitaḥ sundaraḥ/ vidhiḥ vidhīyate kriyate iti saṃskāraḥ/ mānmathaḥ manmathakartṛtvena tasyāyamiti vā tata āgata iti vā aṇ pratyayaḥ/ vijayate sarvasmādupari vartate/ hiśabdaḥ prasiddhau/
``kriyā hi vastūpahitā prasīdati'' iti nyāyānmaṇeriva śāṇottejitasya prakṛtiramaṇīyasya ramaṇīyajanakasya kandarpakalpitaśilpaviśeṣo vikalpapathamavataratīti prasiddho'yamarthaṃ ityarthaḥ/ tathā kādambaryām - ``yathā yathā ceyaṃ madanahutabhujā dīpyate tathā tathāgniśaucamaṃśukamiva nitarāṃ nirmalībhavati lāvaṇyam'' iti/ kāntyākhyaścālaṅkāro'tham/ ``manmathāpyāyitacchāyā śobhā kāntiriti smṛtā'' iti vacanāt/ atra arthāntaranyāso'laṅkāraḥ//4//
atha tadīyamākāramālokya ``antaḥ sambhogasaṅkalpastatpathāśāvalokanam'' iti vacanāt sambhogasaṃkalpamutkaṇṭhābhāvamanumimīte - niyataṃ niścitam/
saṅkalpanirmitaḥ cintāviracitaḥ/ priyasamāgamaḥ vallabhasambhogaḥ/ tathāhītyupapādanārambhaḥ/
nīvībandhocchvasanamityādi/ ``nīvī syād grathanaṃ nāryā jaghanasthasya vāsasaḥ'' ityamaraḥ/ nīvībandhasya ucchvasanaṃ śaithilyam ``nīvī yat skhalati sthitāpi sudṛḍhaṃ kāmeṅgitaṃ yoṣitām'' iti ratirahasyokteḥ/ adharaspandanaṃ āṣṭhasphuraṇam/ anena cumbanopakramaḥ pratīyate/ dorniṣādaḥ bhujayornitarāṃ sādaḥ śramanissahatayā/ svedaḥ svinnaśarīratā/ masṛṇanadhurākekarasnigdhamugdhaṃ ``masṛṇaṃ taditi khyātamanurāgakaṣāyitam'' iti/ madhuramacapalam/ ``anulbaṇatvaṃ mādhuryam'' iti dhanikaḥ/ ``ākuñcitapuṭāpāṅgā sānandārdhanimeṣiṇī/
muhurvyāvṛttatārā ca dṛṣṭirākekarā smṛtā//'' iti bhāvaprakāśaḥ/ snigdhamarūkṣam/
``snigdhaṃ tadyasya viṣayastatprabhāmilitaṃ bhavet'' ityuktaṃ vā/ ``svabhāvālokitaṃ mugdham'' ityuktam/ gātrastambhaḥ śarīrasya nirvyāpāratvam/ utprabandhaḥ udbhūtasantānaḥ/ gaṇḍābhoge kapolavistāre/ pulakapaṭalaṃ romāñcasañcayaḥ/ mūrcchanā rasotkarṣānmohaḥ/ cetanā mohavicchede prabuddhatā ca asyā bhavatīti śeṣaḥ/ atra sūkṣmamalaṅkāraḥ//5//
mālatīṃ cālayati pāṇisparśena prerayatītyanyacittatāṃ dyotayati/
bhagavati vande/
guṇavadbhartṛlābhasya phalatvamabhipretyāśīḥ prayujyate-bhūyāditi/ āśiṣi liṅ/
pavitramāsanaṃ/ idamiti śeṣaḥ/
kuśalaṃ bhagavatyāḥ/
niśvasyetyahṛdayapūrvakatvaśaṅkāparihārāya/ ivetyaparamārthe/ svasthavadbahirvyavahriyate la na punarmanasaḥsvāsthyamityarthaḥ/
svagatamiti vastuvṛttaparijñānāttasyāḥ/ prastāvanā khalveṣā kapaṭanāṭakasya vañcanarūpasya nāṭyasya pūrvaraṅgaḥ/ itaḥ prabhṛti tasya prayokṣyamāṇatvāt prakāśamiti vaidagdhyāttadvivakṣitasya dvāraṃ dadāti/ gurubāṣpastambhamantharahṛdayavilagnanirgamamanyādṛśameva bhagavatyā vacanam/ ghanatarāśrunirodhamandahṛdayaskhalitaprasaramapūrvaprakāram/ tat kimidānīmudvegakāraṇaṃ bhaviṣyati/ aniṣṭaśravaṇādermanaso vikāraviśeṣa udvegaḥ/
nanu-saṃvāde/ ayamiti mālatyuddeśābhinayenoktiḥ/ cīraṃ celakhaṇḍaḥ tatkṛtaṃ cīvaraṃ, buddhasanyāsināṃ vastram/ ``kārdamikacelacīrikāniyamitoccacaṇḍātakam'' iti harṣacarite/ tasya viruddhaḥ pratikūlaḥ/ ``yadahareva virajettadahareva pravrajet'' iti śruteḥ, viraktimūlatvānmokṣāśramasya/ tathā mahābhārate``samayo yaḥ sa evāstu paratattvaṃ yathā tathā/
viraktirvidyate yasya mokṣastasyeti me matiḥ//'' iti/ paricayaḥ abhyāsaḥ/ sa ca lakṣaṇayā/
atra tatkāryaṃ snehamāha - kathamiva/ kena prakāreṇodvegakāraṇatvamasyetyarthaḥ/
ayītyavyayaṃ saṃbodhane/ tvamapīti/ amātyabhavanasatatasannihitatvāt tadvṛttāntasākalyavedinī tvamapītyarthaḥ/ idaṃ vastviti śeṣaḥ/
idamihetyādi/ idamityabhinayaḥ purovartinaḥ/ iha loke/ sarvasmin loke, nānyajjayasādhanamityarthaḥ/ jaitraṃ jayasādhanam/ sahajavilāsanibandhanaṃ śarīram akṛtrimāḥ śṛṅgāraceṣṭā eva yasya nimittaṃ tā upādāyaiva nirmitamityarthaḥ/ anucitavarasaṃprayogaśocyaṃ vairūpyavārdhakādibhiratyantamayogyasya varasyabhartuḥ saṃprayogena samāgamena śocyam, rasikānāṃ dayāviṣayaḥ/ ``ṛhalorṇyat'' (3.1.124)/ [viphalaguṇātiśayaṃ] viphalo, rūpaśīlādīnāṃ guṇānāṃ lokottaratvam atiśayaḥ sa, niṣprayojano yasyeti/ sadṛśavarasamāgamaphalatvāttasya/ bhaviṣyati na punarabhūdityadyāpi na kiñcidatikrāmati/ pravṛttau tatparihāraḥ śakya eveti mālatyā āśācchedakhedaṃ pariharati/ iti śabdaḥ prakāre/ anena śaṅkāprakāreṇa paricaya udvegakāraṇamityetat tvamapi kinna jānāsīti saṃbandhaḥ//6//
``dāso'pi tena muktaḥ patirayamāḥ kaṣṭamityādyaiḥ/
patidūṣaṇagaṇavacanairvairāgyaṃ lambhayedenām//'' iti ratirahasyoktasya dūtīkṛtyasyānucitavaretyupakṣiptasya phalaṃ darśayati - vaicintyaṃ nāṭayatīti/ viṣaṇṇacittatāmabhinayatītyarthaḥ/
taduktiṃ pallavayati - astyetannarendravacanānurodhena nandanāya pratipannā mālatīti sakalo jano'mātyaṃ jugupsate/ etad bhagavatyā kathitaṃ vastviti rājñaḥ prārthanāvacanānukūlyena/ nandanāya nandanārtham/ pratipannā abhyupagatā/ athavā pratipāditā dattā, vāgdattatvāt/ antarbhāvito ṇyarthaḥ/ pratipādanasya dānārthatvāt tenetyarthāt/ sakala iti sarvalokaprasiddho'yamarthaḥ/ iyaṃ mālatyekaiva na jānātīti dyotayati/
atha śulkāśanipātenaiva tadvacasā sodvegāyāḥ pitari viraktiṃ prakāśayati - kathamupahārīkṛtāsmi rājñe tātena/ kathamityāścarye/ svapne'pyayamartho mayā notprekṣita ityarthaḥ/ upahāraḥ prābhṛtam/ phalakusumapallavādivadupahārīkṛtāsmīti/ cvinā pūrvamabhūtatvāttadbhāvasyedaṃprathamatvaṃ snehanivṛtteḥ prakāśyate/ rājña iti atyantānaucityaṃ vyajyate/ kvacit kadācit rājājñayā duhitṛdānaṃ na śrutapūrvamityarthaḥ/ tāteneti tathāvidhasnehadravādratvaṃ dhvanatā kathamityāścarya (tva ṛ vattva)mupapādyate/
tadbhāvaṃ jñātvā tameva pitari dveṣamupodbalayati - guṇāpekṣāśūnyamityādi/ rūpayauvanaśīlamādhuryavaidagdhyādiṣu varaguṇeṣvākāṅkṣayā rahitamityupakramakriyāviśeṣaṇam/ idam ayogye duhitṛdānarūpaṃ vastu/ kathamupakrāntaṃ kena prakāreṇārabdham/ cetanasya kasyacidapyayamartho duṣkara iti bhāvaḥ/ athaveti - svacintitamarthamākṣipati/ kutaḥ kasmāddhetoḥ/ apatyasnehaḥ putreṣu putrīṣu vā vātsalyam/ kuṭilanayaniṣṇātamanasāṃ bandhujane'pyatisandhānopadeśādanārjavayukte naye kauṭalyādiśāstre śikṣitacetasām/ ``ninadībhyāṃ snāteḥ kauśale'' (8.3.89) iti ṣatvam/ tathā kādambaryāṃ ``kiṃ vā teṣāmasāmprataṃ yeṣāmatinṛśaṃsaprāyopadeśamiti nirghṛṇaṃ kauṭalyaśāstraṃ pramāṇam'' iti / apatyasnehe sati hyayamasmākaṃ vitarkaḥ śobhate/ sa evātra nāstīti bhāvaḥ/ kuṭilanayaniṣṇātamanasāmityuktam, atra punaḥ ko'yaṃ naya ityāśaṅkyāha - idaṃ tviti/ turviśeṣe/ ajadamparyam idamiti kāryaṃ sāmānyena parāmṛśyate/ kāryameva paraṃ pradhānaṃ yasya sa idaṃparaḥ tasya bhāvaḥ ajadaṃparyam/ yaduta yat khalu/ nṛpaternarmasaciva iti rājadvārā svayaṃ copakartuṃ śakta iti mitrīkaraṇe hetuḥ/ mitraṃ bhavatviti/ yaduta idaṃ tvaidaṃparyaṃ na punaḥ sneha ityarthaḥ//7//
upodbalanaphalamāha - rājārādhanaṃ khalu tātasya guru, na punarmālatīti/ rājārādhanaṃ rājñaḥ priyānuṣṭhānam/ guru mahat/ bahumānapātraṃ vastviti śeṣaḥ/ mālatī punarna guruḥ tṛṇavallaghvityarthaḥ/ ``yasminnudvijate sā doṣe bhūyastameva pallavayet/'' ityukteḥ/
pratināyakadoṣamudghoṣayati - yathā bhagavatyā ājñaptam, tathā taditi śeṣaḥ/ vyatirekamukhena tathātvamevopapādayati - anyathā tasmin vare durdarśane'tikrāntayauvane kimiti na vicāritamamātyena/ anyathā nayaparatvamātramantareṇa snehaviśiṣṭatva ityarthaḥ/ tasminnityanubhavaṃ prasiddhiṃ vā nirguṇatvena tacchabdaḥ parāmṛśati/ vare jāmātari/ amātyasya varatvasaṅkalpāropād vara ityuktiḥ/ durdarśane vairūpyātiśayād duḥkhabhūtaṃ darśanaṃ yasya/ virūpatāpi sahyate yadyupabhogānuguṇaṃ tāruṇyamityatrāha - atikrāntayauvane jaratīti viṣayeṣu viraktiraśaktiśca dyotyate/ tasmin viṣaye/ amātyeneti mantritayā vicāraṇasāmarthyaṃ dhvanyate/ kimiti kimartham/ na vicāritam īdṛśo'sāviti na nirūpitamityarthaḥ/ tasmānna snehasya kāpi kalāpīti bhāvaḥ/
nandane tasyāstaduktimūlāṃ viraktimāha - hā! hatāsmīti/ samupasthitānarthavajrapatanā mandabhāginī/ heti viṣādasūcakamavyayam/ hatāsmināśitāsmi/ daivena tātena iti vā/ arthāt samīpagato'nucitavarasamprayogarūpo'nartho vipat tadeva vajrapatanaṃ yasyāḥ/ mando'lpo bhāgo bhāgyamasyā iti mandabhāginī/ ahamityaprayujyamāne'pyuttamaprayogaḥ/
mālatīhṛdayaṃ vijñāya lavaṅgikā prārthayate - tatprasīda bhagavati paritrāyasvaitasmājjīvanmaraṇāt priyasakhīm/ eṣā tavāpi duhitaiva/ jīvataḥ prāṇaviśiṣṭasyaiva maraṇaṃ prāṇatyāgo jīvanmaraṇam/ jīvanmuktivat/ jīvanaphalasya sukhānubhavasyābhāvāt kuṇapasādṛśyādupacāraḥ/ tavāpīti/ yathā bhūrivasostathā dharmatastatsvasuḥ tavāpi putryeva ityarthaḥ/ ayaṃ ca trātavyatve hetuḥ/
ayi sarale! ṛjubuddhe ṅa/ yathādṛṣṭagrāhiṇītyanena amātyasya bahirasmāsu sagauravaṃ vyavahārameva paśyasi/ na tu tasya svakāryaparatāmasmadatilaṅghanenāpi vartamānāṃ jānāsīti dyotyate/ bhagavatyā iti - na mametyuktiḥ bhagavatīti teṣāṃ vandanamātrasyaiva pātramasmādṛśaḥ, na punarīdṛśeṣu karmasu prabhavantīti vyañjayati/ prāya iti - ``pitā pitāmaho bhrātā'' ityādismṛteḥ, pitāmahādīnāmapi piturasannidhāveva kanyādānādiṣvadhikārāt prāyagrahaṇam/ janayitā pitā/ daivaṃ ceti tasyāḥ svātantryādapratikāryatvaṃ dyotayati/ atha ``prathamamatiśīlayogādākhyānādyairviśeṣayedenām/'' ityuktamupāyaṃ niṣedhamukhena prayuṅkte/ yatkileti/ kiletyaitihye/ kauśiko viśvāmitraḥ, tasya menakāyāṃ sañjātatvāt tadapatyaṃ kauśikī/ apatyārthe'ṇi ṅīṣpratyayaḥ/ duṣṣa[ya]ntaṃ pauravaṃ rājānam/ apsarāḥ[''] urvaśī/ ``striyāṃ bahuṣvapsarasaḥ'' iti liṅgānuśāsane samāmnāto'pyapsaraḥśabda ekavacanāntaprayukto mahākaviprayogāt sādhuḥ/ tathā śākuntale ``sānumatī nāmāpsarāḥ'' iti lakṣaṇāt/ prayogasya prābalyāt/ purūravasaṃ budhasūnumailaṃ rājānam/ cakame kāmitavatī iti premavaśāt svayamupagamaṃ sūcayati/ ākhyānaṃ mahābhāratādi vidantīti ākhyānavida ajatihāsikā ucyante/ vāsavadattā ujjayinīpateḥ pradyotasya putrī/ prattaṃ vāgdattatayā dātumupakrāntam/ ``aca upasargāttaḥ'' (7. 4. 47)/ pitrā prattamātmānaṃ prāyacchaditi pūrvābhyāṃ svātantryātiśayaṃ darśayati/ udayano vatsarājaḥ tasmai/ prāyacchat dattavatī/ ``dāṇa dāna'' ityasya pāghrādinā yacchādeśe laṅ/ ādiśabdena ahalyādīnāṃ vṛttamāsūtryate/ iti yat kila tadapi vastu/ sāhasakalpaṃ mūrkhajanavyāpāraḥ/ īṣadasamā (ptaṃ ṛpte) kalpabgrahaṇaṃ sāhasāntarebhyo vyāvṛttiṃ prakāśayati/ - ucitasthalapātena pitrādyabhyupagamāditi hetoḥ/ anupadeṣṭavyam asmābhiḥ sāhasanivāraṇasyaiva kāryatvāditi bhāvaḥ/ atha tāṃ sarvopāyavirahapradarśanena bhīṣayate - sarvatheti/ gatyantarābhāvāt sarveṇāpi prakāreṇetyarthaḥ/
rājñaḥ priyāyetyādi - kāryād dhanalābhādirūpānnimittāt/ ātmajāmiti svādhīne vastuni tasya kāmacāraṃ ko nivārayiṣyatīti vyajyate/ ``yadviviktatayā sthānaṃ kleśairnaṣṭaiḥ śarīriṇām/
vyavasāyasya buddheśca dīpanī sā tu nirvṛtiḥ//'' iti divākaraḥ/ nirvṛtimān kṛtakṛtyatayā sukhita ityarthaḥ/ bhavatviti ``kāmacārakaraṇe loṭ''/ anena sacivena/ ghaṭatāṃ yujyatām/ vidhauloṭ/ iyamiti sarvaguṇaramaṇīyatvābhinayaḥ/ anenetyanyathātvābhinayaḥ/ dhūmagraheṇa dhūmākāreṇa graheṇa devatāviśeṣeṇa/ dhūmaketuriti prasiddhenetyarthaḥ/ vimalā bālatvādanaṅkuritakuraṅgatayā kalaṅkarahiteti pratipadi sphuritā pratipādyate/ tataścopamālaṅkāraḥ/ athavā prasiddhakalaṅkakalāvyatirekeṇa vimalatvotprekṣayā utprekṣā/ atra cāniṣṭavidhyābhāsena sāhasānuṣṭhānādapyabhimatasādhanopadeśapareṇa janmasāphalyarūpaviśeṣapratipādanādākṣeṣālaṅkāraḥ pratīyate//8//
atha tadukteḥ phalaṃ darśayati - hā tāta! tvamapi nāma mamaivamiti sarvathā jitaṃ bhogatṛṣṇayā/ apirvirodhe/ tādṛśasnehavivaśatayānubhūtastvamapītyarthaḥ/ mameti/ saivāhaṃ mālatītyarthaḥ/ nāma kutsane/ dhigdhigidamityarthaḥ/ evamiti svakāryābhiniveśena nṛśaṃsatvasyānuṣṭhitasyābhinayaḥ/ īdṛśo jāto'sītyarthaḥ/ bhogatṛṣṇayā - viṣayopabhogalipsayā/ jitaṃ sarvaṃ jagadabhibhūya sthitamityarthaḥ/ rājño rājavallabhasya ca prītyā pūrvasmādabhyadhikamaiśvaryameva bhogasādhanaṃ prāpyate, na punardharmo mokṣo veti bhāvaḥ/
atha``nāyakaguṇagaṇabhaṇitiṃ kuryādevaṃ prasaṅgena/'' ityukternāyakaguṇaprastāvāya nisṛṣṭārthatvād vidagdhaśiṣyābhaṅgyā dvāramāpādayati- cirāyitaṃ bhagavatyā/ nanu bhaṇāmi asvasthaśarīro mahābhāgo mādhava iti/ cirāyitaṃ vahukālaṃ vilambitam/ nanu bhaṇāmīti vilambasyānaucityaṃ vyajyate/ asvasthaśarīraḥ aprakṛtisthitadehaḥ/ jvarādyārta ityarthaḥ/ ayaṃ vilambānaucitye hetuḥ/
tadvacanānumodanam idaṃ gamyata iti/ tvarayā sāvaśeṣaṃ vacanaṃ ``praviśa piṇḍīm'' ityādivat/ idamasti tanmayāpi smṛtam, adya gamyata iti śeṣaḥ/ anujānīhi anumanyasva, gamanāyeti śeṣaḥ/
avalokitākṛtapraśnāvakāśā lavaṅgikā hṛdayajñatayā mālatīṃ saṃvādayati-janāntikamiti/
``tripatākākareṇānyānapavāryāntarā kathām/
anyonyāmantraṇaṃ yat syājjanānte tajjanāntikam//'' iti dhanikaḥ/ sakhi! mālati! sāmprataṃ bhagavatyāḥ sakāśāt tasya mahānubhāvasyodgamaṃ jānīmaḥ/ sakāśāt samīpāt, mukhādityarthaḥ/ udgamaṃ janma, rūpādīnāṃ dṛṣṭatvāt/
sakhi asti me kutūhalamiti/ trapayā na tu praṣṭuṃ śaktāsmītyarthaḥ/
bhagavati! ka eṣa mādhavo nāma, yasya bhagavatī snehagurumātmānaṃ dhārayati/ snehabharākrāntaṃ hṛdayaṃ vahati/
ādarātiśayajananāya svābhimatamapyarthaṃ bhaṅgyā niṣedhayati - [aprastāvikīti/] prastūyate'sminniti prastāvaḥ kathanakālaḥ, sa na vidyate'sya ityaprastāvikī/ adhunā tatprasaṅgāya kālo na paryāpta ityarthaḥ/ tatra hetuḥ - mahatī analpaprameyā/ eṣā kathā mādhavaviṣayoktiḥ/
upajātādarātiśayāt prārthayate - tathāpyācaṣṭāṃ, bhagavatī prasādaṃ karotu/ tathāpītyanena saṃkṣipyāpi vaktavyatvamāha/ prasādaṃ anugraham/
śrūyatāmiti vakṣyamāṇasya pīṭhikābandhaḥ/ astīti vartamānatvaṃ tasyāha/ vidarbhādhipateramātya iti brāhmaṇasāmānye'pi droṇādivat niratiśayaiśvaryatvaṃ prakāśyate/ samagrapuruṣaprakāṇḍacūḍāmaṇiḥ sarvapuruṣaśreṣṭhānāṃ śikhāratnamiti lakṣaṇayā pūjyatvātiśayaḥ prakāśyate/
``matallikā macarcikā prakāṇḍamuddhatallajau/
praśastavācakānyamūni/'' ityamaraḥ/ nāma prasiddhau/ [aśeṣabhuvanamahanīyapuṇyamahimānaṃ] aśeṣeṇa bhuvanena mahanīyaḥ pūjyaḥ, puṇyaḥ pāpaharaśca yasya mahimā vṛttādhyayanasampattyā janitaṃ tejaḥ/ ātmanaḥ sāmarthyāt svasya tatsadṛśaguṇaviśiṣṭatvāt/ pitaiva nānyaḥ kaścittādṛśasāmarthyābhāvādityavadhārayati/ ``nāguṇī guṇinaṃ vetti'' iti nyāyāt/
``brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇaṃ veda bhartā veda striyaṃ tathā/'' iti mahābhāratokteḥ, ``vivāhaśca vivādaśca samaireveṣyate budhaiḥ/'' ityuktatvāt samānasambandhatvaṃ ca dyotyate/ te iti lavaṅgikākṛtasyāpi praśnasya phalato mālatīprayuktatvāt tadābhimukhyenoktiḥ/ yo'sāviti yadvaṃśajātaḥ, jāteḥ pramāṇapradatvāt/ yādṛśa iti yad guṇaviśiṣṭaḥ/ labdhasattākaṃ hi vastu guṇairviśeṣyate/ sa iti tādṛśaśceti jānātītyarthaḥ/ yacchabdasyottaravākyopādānāt pūrvavākyagatasya tacchabdasya sāmarthyādākṣepaḥ/
punarapi tadīyaṃ māhābhāgyaṃ tatprarocanāya stauti - apiceti/
vyatikaritadigantāḥ vyatikaraḥ miśratā, sañjātavyatikarā digantā yeṣām/ śvetamānaiḥ dhavalībhavadbhiḥ/ sphaṭikaviśadasattvakāryatvāt kavisamayādvā yaśasaḥ śvaityam/ ``śvita śvaitye'' iti dhāturātmanepadī/ vartamānanirdeśādadyāpi vartamānatvaṃ prakāśyate/ yaśobhiḥ svāpadānajanitābhiḥ khyātibhiḥ/
``kulakramāgatā sā cet kīrtināmnā prakāśate/
svāpadānaprasūtā cedyaśa ityabhidhīyate//'' iti bhāvaprakāśaḥ/ sukṛtavilasitānāṃ puṇyapariṇāmānāṃ jātyāyurbhogarūpāṇām/ sthānaṃ adhikaraṇam/ ūrjvasvalānāṃ utkarṣaśālinām/ ``jyotsnātamisrāśṛṅgiṇorjasvinnūrjasvalagominmalinamalīmasāḥ'' (5-2-114) iti nipātanāt sādhuḥ/ [akalitamahimānaḥ] akalita asaṅkhyātaḥ iyattayā mahimā pratibhābalādisāmarthyaṃ yeṣām/ ``kala saṅkhyāna'' iti dhātuḥ/ pūrvaṃ mahimnaḥ puṇyatvam/ idānīmaparicchedyatvaṃ pratipādyate iti bhedaḥ/ ketanaṃ dhvajaḥ/ kulasya draṣṭṝṇāṃ ca tatprāptermaṅgalāgamanasūcakatvāt/ athavā niketanameva ketanaṃ gṛham/ athavā, ketanaṃ nimantraṇaṃ, ``tathā devalakaścaiva śrāddhe nārhati ketanam/
iti smṛteḥ/ yūyamasmākaṃ pātrabhūtā iti/ maṅgalairvṛtā ityarthaḥ/ maṅgalānām abhyudayānām/ asmin bhuvane manuṣyasañcārayogye bhūloke/ svarlokādiṣu tu sambhāvyate iti bhāvaḥ/ tādṛśāḥ tattulyāḥ/ bahuvacanenaitadāha - yat sa tāvadekaḥ sukṛtairasmākaṃ sambhūtastatsadṛśaśca bhūrivasuḥ kvacit kadācidanyo'pi kaścit prayatnato'nveṣaṇe labhyatāṃ nāma/ ato dvau tādṛśau sambhavataḥ, na punastṛtīyastayoriti dyotyate/ kathaṃ sambhavanti bahūnāmupapattireva nāstītyarthaḥ/ atropamānānupādāne vākyago'yamupamālaṅkāraḥ//9//
pitaiva te jānātītyuktasyārthasya mālatīhṛdayasaṃvādaṃ darśayati - taṃ khalu bhagavatyā gṛhītanāmadheyaṃ sarvadā tātaḥ smarati/ pitṛsakhatvāt śvaśuratvasaṅkalpācca gṛhītanāmadheyamiti svayaṃ nāmānuktiḥ/ sarvadeti prasaṅge, prasaṅge/ ``evaṃ devarātenoktaṃ, evaṃ kṛtaṃ, evaṃ hasitaṃ, evaṃ śvasitam'' iti prasajjatītyarthaḥ/
sakhi samaṃ khalu bhagavatyā gurusakāśād vidyādhigamaḥ kṛta iti tatkālavedino mantrayante/ [vidyādhigamaḥ] vidyānāṃ vedādīnāmadhigamaḥ prāptiḥ kṛtaḥ/ tābhyāmiti śeṣaḥ/ bhagavatyamātyau ca satīrthyatayā niratiśayasauhṛdau iti darśitam/ [tatkālavedinaḥ] taṃ kālaṃ jānānā jaranto janāḥ/ [mantrayante] kathayantītyarthaḥ/
tata ityādi - tataḥ tasmāddevarātāt/ udayagireriva pūrvaparvatādivetyanena tuṅgatvasthiratvamahatvamahībhāradhāraṇakṣamatvādayo guṇāḥ pradarśyante/ eka eva bhrātṛrahita iti pitṛsnehasarvasvabhūmitvaṃ samagraiśvaryasvāmitvaṃ ca dyotayati/ sphuritaguṇadyutisundaraḥ bālya eva prādurbhūtarūpaśīlādiguṇā eva dyutayaḥ prabhāḥ tābhiḥ, yadvā sphuritaguṇayā dyutyā sundaraḥ hṛdayaṅgamaḥ/ kalāvān tadavasthāyāmeva pūrvasaṃskāraprādurbhūtacatuṣṣaṣṭikalākalāpaḥ dvitrābhiḥ kalābhiḥ svabhāgaiḥ viśiṣṭaśca/ mahotsavasya lakṣaṇayotsavakāryasya mahato hṛdayāhlādasya/ nayanavatāṃ na punarviśeṣavidāmeveti cakṣuṣmatāṃ sarveṣāmatra vastunyaikamatyaṃ vyañjayati/ udiyāya uditaḥ/ bhūtatvamātravivakṣayā liṭprayogaḥ, ``mandāraśūnyānalakāṃścakāra''/
itivat/ bālacandraḥ bālaścāsau candraśceti/ bālacandra ityatra sthāne mādhavenduriti prayoktuṃ śakye'pi rasātiśayāpādanārthaṃ nāmānuktiḥ/ atra copamā rūpakamarthaśleṣaḥ śabdaśleṣātiśayoktiśca parasparasāpekṣatvena vartanta iti saṅkarālaṅkāraḥ//10//
api nāma mādhavo bhavedityāśaṃsayā tadukteḥ phalaṃ darśayati/
atha tasya vinayātirekaṃ ślāghyayauvanatvaṃ ca prakāśya vilobhayati - asāvityādi/ prakṛto bālacandraḥ/ vidyāśābhiḥ vidyāsu vedādiṣvaṣṭādaśasu vidyāsthāneṣu jighṛkṣayā/ āśābhiriti bahuvacanaṃ śrotavyabāhulyāt/ śiśuḥ bālo'pīti sahajasattvasampannatvaṃ vyajyate/ bhavanādvinirgatya svagṛhāt niṣkramyeti svagṛhāvasthāne bandhujanopalālanasya vidyārjanavipakṣatvamāśaṃkyeti dhvanyate/
``sukhārthī vā tyajedvidyāṃ vidyārthī vā sukhaṃ tyajet/
sukhārthinaḥ kuto vidyā kuto vidyārthinaḥ sukham//'' iti vyāsokteḥ/ iha padmāvatyām/ āyāta āgata iti prasthāpane pituranatiprayatno vyajyate/ saṃprati asmin kāle/ avikalaśaraccandramadhuraḥ ārūḍhayauvanatayā saṃpūrṇaśaratkālottejitacandra iva madhuraḥ darśanīyaḥ/ madhuratvasya phalaṃ darśayati - yadālokasthāne yasya darśanagocare sthāne/ puraṃ padmāvatī/ unmādataralaiḥ smaraśaraprahārajanitahṛdayavaivaśyacañcalaiḥ/ unmādagrahaṇāt jhaṭityevāṣṭamadaśāpraveśahetutvamālokasya dyotyate/ kuvalayitavātāyanaṃ sañjātā nīlendīvaramālā asyeti/ vātāyanaṃ gavākṣam/ asitabahalaśītalaprabhāpaṭalasañchannatvāt/ ``striyaḥ kāmitakāminyaḥ'' iti nyāyāt tadīyasaubhāgyātiśayaśca prarocanāya prakāśita iti mantavyam/ atropamotprekṣā cālaṅkāraḥ//11//
upārūḍhayauvanatve'pi śaiśava iva vidyāgrahaṇatācchīlyamāha - atra asmin pure/ bālasuhṛdā bālabhāva eva suhṛdā sahapāṃsukrīḍādṛḍhasauhṛdeneti paramavisrambhabhūmitvaṃ prakāśyate/ ānvīkṣikīṃ ātmasvarūpanirūpaṇaparām/ vidyām vedāntaśāstramityarthaḥ/ adhīte abhyasyati/ ānvīkṣikīgrahaṇaṃ dhīrapraśāntasya tatprādhānyajñāpanārtham/ abhijanādiguṇagaṇavarṇanayā pūrṇakautukatvamāpādya tadāhlādanāyānte nāyakasya nāma prakāśayati - sa eṣa mādhavo nāmeti/ sa evaṃ mayā varṇitaḥ/ eṣa idānīṃ avalokitayā prastuta ityarthaḥ/ nāma prasiddhau/ kastaṃ jagati na jānātītyarthaḥ/ ``asti vidarbhādhipateramātyaḥ'' ityādi ``sa eṣa mādhavo nāma'' ityantaṃ vilobhanam/ mālatyā vilobhanāt/
tannāmaśravaṇe sānandaṃ pulakādyanubhavaprādurbhāvāt prakāśitaparamasukhānubhavamityarthaḥ/ sakhi! lavaṅgike! śrutaṃ tvayā/ idamiti śeṣaḥ/ tvayā śrutamiti madanurāgasya sthānapātitvaṃ tavaiva priyamiti vyañjayati/ kathaṃ mahākulaprabhavo'pi sa mahābhāgaḥ/ [mahākulaprabhavaḥ]mahatkulaṃ vaṃśaḥ prabhavaḥ utpattisthānaṃ yasya/ apirguṇāntarairamuṃ guṇaṃ samuccinoti/
