bhagavatīvacanāt pūrvameva tadguṇadarśanādevamanumito mayāyamartha ityāha - sakhi! kuto vā mahodadhiṃ varjayitvā pārijātasya udgamaḥ/ kutaḥ kasmādapādānāt/ mahodadhiṃ amṛtādyutpattisthānatayā samudrāntarebhyo viśiṣṭamudadhim, kṣīrābdhimityarthaḥ/ pārijātasyetyarthāntarasaṅkramitavācyena sakalabhuvanaprasiddhaprabhāvatvaṃ pratīyate/ na khalu kalaśajaladhimantareṇa pārijātaṃ taruratnamitare tarava iva yataḥ kutaścit sambhavatīti jalānāmapyayamanumeya evārtha iti bhāvaḥ/ atra ca kathaṃ mahākulaprabhavo'pi sa mahābhāgaḥ, kuto vā mahodadhiṃ varjayitvā pārijātasyodgama iti vākyadvaye sāmānyadharmasyaikasya śabdabhedenāvasthānād vaidharmyeṇeyaṃ prativastūpamā alaṅkāraḥ/ ``sudaṃ piasahīe'' ityādi prāptiḥ/ mālatyāḥ sukhāgamāt/
aho iti kathāprasaṅgavyākṣepādityarthaḥ/ kālātipātaḥ kālasyātikramaḥ/
kṣipannityādi - kṣipan nirasyan/ ``kṣipa nirasana'' iti dhātuḥ/ nidrāmudrāṃ nidrayā janitaṃ staimityam/ madanakalahacchedasulabhāṃ sambhogāvasānaprāpyām/
``prathamamadanayuddhe yoṣitaḥ svalpabhāvāḥ/'' iti, ``nipīya svedāmbu smarasamarasambhuktavibhavam/'' iti suratasya madanayuddhaśabdenokteḥ/ prathamataḥ āditaḥ/ aśaṅkitameva mahato ghoṣasya śravaṇāt upāttotkampānāṃ bhayavaśena jhaṭiti kampaḥ svīkṛto yaiḥ/ vihagamithunānāṃ pakṣidvandvānām/ saudhānāṃ prāsādānām/ alaghuṣu vipulāyateṣu/ nikuñjeṣu candraśālāgahvareṣu/
``nikuñjakuñjau vā klībe latādipihitodare/'' ityamarasiṃhoktāvādiśabdena bhittyādyantaritapradeśānāmapi grahaṇāt/ ghanatāṃ sāndratām/ sandhyāśaṅkhadhvaniḥ sāyaṃsandhyākālapūritasya maṅgalaśaṅkhasya ghoṣaḥ/ anibhṛtaḥ aparyāptāvakāśatvādamāni[]tyarthaḥ/ cirakālamanuvṛttasaṃskāratayā khe ākāśe vicarati bambhramyate/ atra svabhāvoktiradhikaṃ cālaṅkāraḥ/ sūkṣmataravihagasvabhāvavarṇanādāśrayato gaganādāśritasya dhvanervaipulyakathanācca//12//
sukhaṃ sthīyatāmiti gamanasamaye gurutvādāśiṣaṃ prayuṅkte/
apavāryeti/ cintākrāntatayā tadukteraśravaṇamabhinīya svagatamāhetyarthaḥ/
``kahaṃ'' ityādinā ``pārijādassa uggamo'' ityantena nandane viraktiḥ, pitari vigarhaṇā, nāyake ca bahumānaḥ punarbhāvyata iti dūtīkṛtyasya dattaphalatvaṃ prakāśayati/ api nāma taṃ punarapi paśyeyamityautsukyodbhāvanenāṅkaṃ parisamāpayannabhilāṣaśṛṅgāramaṅginamanusandadhāna uttarāṅkārthasyāvataraṇikāmupakṣipati kavikulapatiriti veditavyam/
ita etena sañjavanenāvatarāmaḥ/ sañjavanaṃ tvidaṃ catuḥśālaṃ'' ityamaraḥ/
athānuṣṭhitaṃ kāmasūtrārthamanukramyānuṣṭheyāṃśakamanusandhatte/ sādhviti - laghūkaraṇakriyāviśeṣaṇam/ taṭasthayaiveti/ avisrambhaparihārāya kamapi pakṣamanāśrayantyaivetyarthaḥ/ mādhavapakṣapātinī iyaṃ bhūrivasunā vā preriteti parijñāne śaṅkanīyatayā tadīyahṛdayāprakāśanāt/ mālatīṃ prati mālatīṃ lakṣīkṛtya/ ``pratiyogeṣu ca dṛśyate'' iti dvitīyā/ nisṛṣṭārthadautyasya nisṛṣṭārthadūtīkalpastantrayitavya ityaṅgīkṛtasya/ bhāraḥ kartavyagauravam/ bhāra ityuktiryathāśāstraṃ pravṛtterdurvahatvaṃ khyāpayitum/ laghūkṛtaḥ subharaḥ kṛtaḥ/ alpāvaśiṣṭatvādanuṣṭheyasyeti bhāvaḥ/
kuta iti codyarūpeṇottaramavatārayitum/ kasmāddhetorlaghūkaraṇamiti cedasmādityāyāti/
tameva hetumāha - vare'nyasminnityādi/ [vare'nyasmin] pratināyakabhūte nandane/ dveṣaḥ aprītiḥ/ pitari bhūrivasau/ vicikitsā akāryakaraṇāt svaviṣaye snigdho na veti saṃśayaḥ/ ``vicikitsā tu sandehaḥ'' iti vaijayantī/
``niyuktastatpramāthāya straiṇena vicikitsate/'' itivat/ janitā utpāditā/ dveṣo janita iti liṅgavipariṇāmaḥ/ purāvṛttodghātaiḥ śākuntalāditihāsaprastāvaiḥ/ ``udghātaḥ praṇavo yāsām'' itivat/ kāryapadavī kartavyasya prakāraḥ śakuntalādivat tvayāpi kriyamāṇe na kaściddoṣa iti sūcitavatītyarthaḥ/ stutaṃ praśaṃsitam/ māhābhāgyaṃ mahābhāgatvam/ lokottarasukṛtaśālitvaṃ tadityāyāti/ abhijanato janmato yad/ guṇataḥ saubhāgyādeḥ yacca/ jātyāyurbhogarūpatvāt sukṛtaphalasya/ prasaṅgād yadṛcchayā/ tatkṛtāt prastāvādeva, na punarasmin nirbandhenetyaśaṅkāhetutvaṃ prakāśyate/ iti hetau/ asmāddhetoriti kuta iti praśnasyottaram/ atheti anantaram/ khalvavadhāraṇe/ vidheyaḥ anuṣṭheyaḥ/ paricayaḥ punaḥpunardarśanenaikāntasaṅghaṭanena sallāpādinā cobhayānurāgasya vāsanaiva paripoṣaṇīyetyarthaḥ/ ``utpādya saumanasyaṃ brūyāt subhage śṛṇuṣva yatkiñcit/
citraṃ kimapi vyatikaramasau yuvā kusumasukumāraḥ//
dṛṣṭibhujaṅgīdaṣṭastava sakhi sandehamāpatitaḥ/
ityukte yadi sahate punaraparedyuḥ sametya saṃghaṭayet//
iti sughaṭitasambhāvāṃ vyasanavivāhotsavaprāye/
udyānapānayātrājalāvatāreṣu hutavahotpāte//
cintitaniratyaye vā veśmani nija eva saṃyujyāt//'' ityuktakramānuṣṭhānamataḥ paraṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ/ svayamabhiyokṣyamāṇastvādāveva paricayaṃ kuryāt/ ``paricayakāraṇāni bāhyābhyantarāṇyucyanta'' ityārabhya, ``ādau paricayaṃ kuryāttataśca paribhāṣaṇam/
paribhāṣaṇasammiśraṃ paścādākāravedanam//'' ityantena vātsyāyanavacanena paricayakāraṇasyoktatvādityaśeṣamatimaṅgalam/
mālatīmādhavasyetthaṃ dvitīyāṅkārthacarcanam/
pūrṇajyotiḥprasādena cakre pūrṇasarasvatī// //iti dvitīyo'ṅkaḥ//
atha tṛtīyo'ṅkaḥ/
atha praveśakamārabhate - praviśya buddharakṣiteti/ ``niyuktaiva tatra sakhī buddharakṣitā'' iti pūrvaṃ sūcitā/ avalokite ityuktibhaṅgyā pātrāntaraṃ praveśayati/ vīpsayāhvānatvarāṃ sūcayati/ api jānāsi kva bhagavatīti/ apiḥ praśne/
buddharakṣite kimasi prasmṛtā ko'pi kālo bhagavatyāḥ piṇḍapātavelāṃ visṛjya mālatīmanuvartamānāyāḥ/ prasmṛtā vismṛtavatīti kartari niṣṭhā/ prasmaratirvismaraṇārthaḥ/ imamarthamiti śeṣaḥ/ [piṇḍapātavelāṃ] piṇḍapāta iti saugatānāṃ bhojanasya saṃjñā, tatkālam/ visṛjya ativāhya/ bhojanānantaramevetyarthaḥ/ anuvartamānāyāḥ sevamānāyāḥ/ ko'pi kālaḥ mahānkālaḥ/ atikrāntaḥ iti śeṣaḥ/
huṃ iti anuvāde'vyayam/ tvaṃ punaḥ kva prasthitāsi/ punaḥ śabdo viśeṣe/ bhagavatīsahacaryāmanujjhitapūrvāmujjhitvā kva gatavatītyarthaḥ/
ahaṃ khalu bhagavatyā mādhavasakāśamanupreṣiteti tadājñāparipālanameva mayā kriyata ityarthaḥ/ saṃdiṣṭaṃ ca tasmai śaṅkarapurasaṃbaddhaṃ kusumākarodyānaṃ gatvā kuñjanikuñjaparyantaraktāśokagahane tiṣṭheti/ gataśca tatra mādhavaḥ/ ``tassa'' iti ``caturthyā ṣaṣṭhī'' iti prākṛte ṣaṣṭhyādeśaḥ/ śaṅkarapuraṃ nāma śivāyatanaviśeṣaḥ/ [kusumākarodyānaṃ] kusumākarasaṃjñitamākrīḍam/ [kuñjanikuñjaparyantaraktaśokagahane] kuñjo latāmaṇḍapaḥ, nikuñjo lakṣaṇayā, tadabhyantaramāha/
``bhaktiprahvāya dātuṃ mukulapuṭakuṭīkoṭarakroḍalīnām/'' itivat/ paryantaḥ parisaraḥ/ tadgate raktāśokasya aruṇakusumasyāśokaviśeṣasya, gahane viṭapaparipāṭīsaṃkaṭe/ tiṣṭheti, sandiṣṭaṃ ca bhagavatyeti śeṣaḥ/ gataśceti svamanīṣitasyaivoktatvādāśu pravṛttiḥ pratipādyate/
avalokite! kiṃnimittamiti sandeśasya gamanasya ca ko heturityarthaḥ/
tannimittamavalokitā prakāśayati - adya kṛṣṇacaturdaśīti ananyā samaṃ mālatī śaṅkarapuraṃ gamiṣyati/ tata evaṃ kila saubhāgyaṃ vardhata iti svahastakusumāpacāyamuddiśya lavaṅgikādvitīyā mālatī tadeva kusumākarodyānamāneṣyate, tato'nyonyadarśanaṃ bhavatīti/ kṛṣṇacaturdaśīti aparapakṣacaturdaśyā bhūtadinatvena parameśvarārādhanasādhanatvamucyate/ tatastadgamanānantaram/ evaṃ kila itthaṃ kṛte/ kiletyaitihye/ āgamapurāṇādiprasiddho'yamartha ityarthaḥ/ ``svayamabhyarcanaṃ bhaktyā'' iti purāṇavacanāt/ saubhāgyaṃ vardhate dayitavāllabhyaṃ tatphalatvātsaundaryasya/ ``priyeṣu saubhāgyaphalā hi cārutā'' ityukteḥ/ ``hṛdbhagasindhvante pūrvapadasya'' (7-3-19) iti ubhayapadavṛddhiḥ/ vardhate na tu bhavatīti rūpaśīlādibhireva niṣpāditasya tasya parameśvaraprasādenoditoditatvaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ/ iti anena hetuneti svapratipādanaprakārakathanam/ svahastakusumāpacāyaṃ prabhutvātiśayena bhṛtyajanabāhulye'pi svahastena puṣpādānasya bhaktiviśeṣasūcakatvādevamuktiḥ/ ``hastādāne cerasteye'' (3-3-40) iti ghañ/ uddiśya lakṣīkṛtya/ tadeveti prāgeva mādhavena yadadhiṣṭhitamityarthaḥ/ āneṣyate prāpayiṣyate/ bhagavatyeti prakaraṇāt/ anyonyadarśanaṃ mālatīmādhavayoḥ parasparadarśanam/ bhavatīti etannimittamityarthaḥ/ tvaṃ punaḥ kva prasthitāsi matprasthānahetustāvāntubhyaṃ niveditaḥ, tvatprasthānaheturapi kathyatāmiti bhāvaḥ/
ahaṃ khalu śaṅkarapurameva prasthitayā priyasakhyā madayantikayā āmantritā/ tato bhagavatyāḥ pādavandanaṃ kṛtvā tatra gacchāmi/ śaṅkarapurameveti tasyā api mālatyā iva kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ īśvaradarśanautsukyaṃ prakāśyate/ [madayantikayā] madayantikā nandanasya bhaginīti pūrvaṃ sūcitā/ āmantritā sahagamanāyāhūtā pādavandanaṃ kṛtveti pūjyapūjāvyatikramasya śreyaḥpratibandhakatvāt/
tvaṃ khalu bhagavatyā yasmin prayojane niyuktā tatra ko vṛttānta iti ``niyuktaiva hi mayā tatra priyasakhī buddharakṣite''ti sūcitam/ makarandārthe madayantikānukūlanamucyate/ ko vṛttāntaḥ kā pravṛttirityarthaḥ/
mayāpi bhagavatyāḥ samādeśena tāsu tāsu visrambhakathāsu īdṛśastādṛśa iti makarandasyopari priyasakhyāḥ madayantikāyāḥ parokṣānurāgastathā dūramāropitaḥ, yathā asyā manorathaḥ api nāma taṃ paśyeyamiWti/ tāsu tāsviti paunaḥpunyaṃ prakāśyate/ visrambhakathāsvityanuvādena tasyāḥ svasyāṃ viśvāsaśca dṛḍhamutpanna iti vyañjayati/ visrambhakathāsu viśvāsādaśaṅkitaṃ prayukteṣu sallāpeṣu/ īdṛśastādṛśa iti svakṛtasya tadvarṇanasya prapañcarūpasya saṅgrahaḥ/ makarandasya upari viṣaya ityarthaḥ, ``suratasukhasyopari dveṣa ivāsīt'' iti kādampa[ba]ryuktavat/ [parokṣānurāgaḥ] parokṣe adarśane'pi śravaṇamātre janito anurāgaḥ premabandhaḥ/ tathā kena prakāreṇa/ dūraṃ [āropitaḥ] parāṃ kāṣṭhāṃ prāpitaḥ/ yathā yena prakāreṇa/ manorathaḥ manasastṛṣṇā/ atrautsukyākhyasya bhāvasyodayaḥ pratīyata iti bhāvodayo'laṅkāraḥ/
sādhu buddharakṣite sādhviti tadvaidagdhyacamatkāre vīpsā/ kṛtamiti harṣavaśādanuktiḥ//
ehi gacchāmaḥ/ ātmani bahuvacanam/ dvayorvā/ //iti praveśakaḥ//
atha ``mālatīmanuvartamānāyāḥ'' iti sūcitāyāḥ yathānirdiṣṭāyāḥ kāmandakyāḥ praveśaṃ nāyikāpraveśapūrvaraṅgamāha - tataḥ praviśatīti/ svānuṣṭhitasya kāmaśāstrārthasyāvyabhicāreṇa svābhimatārthaprāvaṇyaṃ camatkaroti - tatheti/ tathetyanubhavaparāmarśaḥ/ vinayanamrāpi gurupratipattyā prāvaṇyaśīlāpi/ mayeti svasyāḥ śāstrābhiyogaṃ, mālatīti tasyā atyudāraprakṛtitvāt kṛcchrasādhyatvaṃ ca dyotayati/ upāyataḥ pāradārikoktadūtīkṛtyānuṣṭhānena/ katipayāhobhiḥ parimitairdivasaiḥ/ sakhīvisrambhasevyatāṃ sakhīṣu lavaṅgikādiṣu yo visrambhaḥ tena bhajanīyatām/
``yadyatsvacitte sphurati tattat paricitān prati/
niśśeṣaṃ bodhayan bhāvo visrambha iti kīrtitaḥ//'' iti divākaraḥ/ atra virodho nidarśanā cālaṅkāraḥ//1//
atha tasyā ākāreṅgitābhyāṃ svasyāṃ visrambhamevopapādayati - saṃprati hīti/
vrajatītyādi - virahe asannidhau/ vaicittyaṃ viṣaṇṇahṛdayatvam/ naḥ asmākamityātmani bahuvacanam/ prasīdati hṛṣyati/ sannidhau pratyakṣabhāve/ rahasi anyajanarahite deśe/ maddvitīya ityarthaḥ/ ramate prīyate/ svahṛdayaprakāśanāvakāśalābhādityarthaḥ/ dāyaṃ dīyata iti pāritoṣikamucyate/ vasanakusumāṅgarāgakarpūrādikam/ anuvartate aṅgasaṃvāhanādibhiḥ priyaṃ karoti/ gamanasamaye kāryavaśādanyataḥ prayāṇakāle/ kaṇṭhe lagnā kaṇṭhamāśliṣyāmuñcantīti/ niṣidhya niṣidhya ``idānīmevāgataṃ yuṣmābhiḥ, kimarthamadyaiva gamyata'' iti nivārya/ vīpsayā nivāraṇopāyabāhulyaprayogakauśalyaṃ vyajyate/ avaśyaṃ gantavye śapathaiḥ ``mama prāṇaiḥ śāpitāsi tātasyāmbāyāśca'' ityādibhirbahubhiḥ pratyayakaraṇaiḥ/ sapadi pratyāvṛttiṃ avilambena pratyāgamanam/ praṇamya ceti śapathairaparyāptimāśaṅkya pādagrahaṇāñjalibandhanādibhiścetyarthaḥ/ māṃ pratyāvṛttiṃ yācata iti duhyādipāṭhād dvikarmakatā/ atra nāyikāgatasyābhiprāyaviśeṣasya kāryamukhena prakāśanādaprastutapraśaṃsālaṅkāraḥ/ atra ca - ``evaṃ prayujyamāne lakṣayitavyastadīya ākāraḥ/
dṛṣṭvā bravīti sasmitamantikamevopaveśayati//
pṛcchati bhojanaśayane tvākhyātaṃ diśati rahasi vā milati/
niśvasiti jṛmbhate vā svacittamasyai dadāti kiñcidvā//
yāntīmeṣyasi punariti vadati, kathaṃ sādhuvādinī bhavati/
vakti kimapyasamañjasamityuktvā tatkathāṃ bhajate/
ityākāraprakaṭanamālocya prābhṛtaṃ yujyāt//'' iti kāmatantrārthayojanaṃ kṛtamiti veditavyam//2//
anyacca svābhimatārthānukūlyavyañjakaṃ tasyāśceṣṭitamāha - idaṃ ceti/ idaṃ vakṣyamāṇam/ cakāraḥ pūrvoktasamuccaye/ tatreti sadā svahṛdayasannihitatayā prastutaṃ vastu parāmṛśyate, tasmin viṣaye/ sādhīyaḥ bāḍhataram/ pratyāśānibandhanaṃ kālenāpyanukūlā bhaviṣyatīti vāñchānuvṛtternimittam/
``virodhe'pi sphuṭe mahyaṃ kālenaitad bhavediti/
anupekṣākṣamatvaṃ yat puṃsāmāśāṃ vadanti tām//'' iti divākaraḥ/
śākuntalādīniti - śākuntalaṃ śakuntalāmadhikṛtya pravṛttamityaṇ, tadādīn/ itihāsavādān mahābhāratoktīḥ/ anyaparaiḥ arthāntaratātparyayuktaiḥ kālakṣepopayuktakaṇvādipuṇyakathāsaktaiḥ/ vacobhiḥ vacanaiḥ/ prastāvitān bhagavati kathaṃ kaṇvasya śāśvatabrahmacaryasya śakuntalā duhitāsīditi prasaktānuprasaktikayā prāpitān/ svayetyarthasāmarthyādāyāti, anyathā śaṅkāvahatvāt/ śrutveti matsakāśādityarthaḥ/ madutsaṅganiveśitāṅgī madaṅke svairaṃ muktaṃ śarīraṃ yasyāḥ/ anena madanajanito glānyākhyo bhāvaḥ prakāśyate/ cirāya bahukālam/ cintāstimitatvaṃ asyāmavasthāyāṃ mayāpi kiṃ śakuntalādivat pratipattavyamathavā neti dhyānena niścalatvam/ anena mama tu dayitaḥ ślāghyastātaḥ'' ityuktyā vyañjitasya dhairyasya śithilīkāraḥ prakāśyate/ trapāvigalanākhyasaptamadaśāpraveśaśca/ atra ca sūkṣmamalaṅkāraḥ/ iṅgitākārābhyāṃ saṃlakṣitasūkṣmārthaprakāśanāt//3//
tadadya mādhavasamakṣaṃ mādhavasya sannidhau samīpa eva/ tirobhūtena śrūyamāṇatvāt/ uttaraṃ ``atha khalu vidheyaḥ paricayaḥ'' iti pūrvasūcitamanantarakaraṇīyam/ upakramiṣye iti pāṭhaḥ, ārapsye/ ``propābhyāṃ samarthābhyām'' (1-3-42) ityātmanepadavidhānāt/ vatse! ita ita ityanena prāksūcitaṃ śaṅkarapurāya prasthānaṃ prakāśayati/
athāṅgino'bhilāṣavipralambhātmanaḥ śṛṅgārasyānusandhānaṃ rasadoṣaparihārāya kriyate, ``aṅgino'nanusandhānam'' ityādirasadoṣokteḥ/ ``kahaṃ uvahārīkadahmi'' ityādiprakārāntaraparihāreṇa pūrvoktasyaiva vacanaprakārasya kathanaṃ pratināyakadveṣasya pitṛvicikitsāyāḥ nāyakānurāgasya ca tathātvena dṛḍhatvaṃ vyañjayitumiti mantavyam/ viṣāderṣyāharṣādiviśiṣṭasya vaktuḥ kathitapadaṃ na doṣaḥ, pratyuta guṇa eva/
``aviśeṣeṇa pūrvoktaṃ yadi bhūyo'pi gṛhyate/
tadekārthaṃ rasākṣiptacetasāṃ tanna duṣyati//'' iti bhojokteḥ/
eso/ eṣaḥ madhuramadhurasārdrārdramañjarīkabalanakelikalakokilakalahākulitasahakāraśikharoḍḍīnacaṭulacañcarīkanikaravyatikaroddalitadarakarālacampakādhivāsamanoharo marālajaghanapariṇāhodvahanamantharorubharavisaṃsthulollasitacaraṇasañcaraṇopanītasvedaśīkarasudhābindudyotyamānamugdhamukhacandracandanāyamānaśītalasparśastvāṃ pariṣvajate kusumākarodyānamārutaḥ/ tatpraviśāmaḥ/ svādunā makarandena bhṛśasiktāyāḥ kusumakalikāyāḥ khaṇḍanalīlayā madhurāvyaktakūjitaviśiṣṭānāṃ parabhṛtānāmahaṃpūrvikājanitena yuddhena kṣobhitādatisaurabhacūtavṛkṣaviśeṣāgrādutpatitasya cañcalasya bhramarasamūhasya sammardanaviśliṣṭadalatayā īṣadviśālena vikṛtena vā campakakusumena yo'dhivāsaḥ surabhīkaraṇaṃ, tena hṛdayaṅgamaḥ/ marālaṃ samavṛttamityupadeśaḥ/ athavā kiñcitpītaraktavarṇam/ ``marālo'lpaṃ pītaraktaṃ'' iti vaijayantī/ samavṛttasya pītaraktasya vā kaṭipurobhāgasya pariṇāho viśālatā, tadudvahanena mantharayoḥ apaṭvoḥ ūrvorbhāreṇa skhalitoccalitayoḥ pādayorvinyāsaśrameṇa sambhṛtāḥ svedajalakaṇikā eva amṛtaśīkarāḥ, tairalaṅkriyamāṇasya komalasya mukhacandrasya śītalatayā candanadravavadācaran sparśo yasya/ atra lalitākhyo bhāvaḥ prakāśyate/
``sukumāro'ṅgavikṣepo masṛṇo lalitaṃ bhavet/'' iti vacanāt/ mukhasya candratvena rūpaṇāt svedaśīkarāṇāṃ sudhābindutvena rūpaṇopapattiḥ/ pariṣvajatinā āliṅgatīti bandhusamādhiḥ/ atrodāttaṃ svabhāvoktiścālaṅkāraḥ/
tataḥ praviśati mādhava iti - raktāśokagahanāvasthānasya sūcitatvāttathābhāvena praviṣṭa ityarthaḥ/ hanteti harṣe/ parāgatā prāptā/ tadāgamanasya harṣahetutvamevopapādayati - iyaṃ hi mameti/ hiśabdaḥ saṃvāde/
āvirbhavantītyādi/ āvirbhavantī cakṣurgocaraṃ gacchantī/ prathamaṃ agre/ sochvāsamiti santataduḥkhānubhavajanitamohaniruchvāsaṃ manaḥ samprati saṃjīvitaṃ karotītyarthaḥ/ bhagavatyāvirbhāvasya priyāsamāgamanasūcakatvamātreṇa priyādarśanasyaiva samagraprasādahetutvāt sochvāsatvoktiḥ/
``pūrvāparādhabhītasya kāmasyocchvasitaṃ manaḥ/'' iti, ``agaṇiadahamuhadappaṃṇivvūḍhabharaṃ va takkhaṇaṃ ūsasiam/'' iti ca prayogāt/ santāpadagdhasya smaraśarajvaramarditasya/ gharmadurmadataraṇikiraṇaparitaptasya ceti svasya śikhaṇḍiyūnaśca sādhāraṇo dharmaḥ/ śikhaṇḍiyūnaḥ taruṇamayūrasyetyaduḥkhārhatvaṃ dyotyate/ aciraprabhā vidyut/ tatsphuraṇasya samanantarajaladhārāpātapiśunakatvād upamānena santāpasyānanyopāyasādhyatvaṃ, tatprāptau niratiśayasukhaprāptirakṛtrimapremabandhanatvaṃ ca prakāśyate/ upamātrālaṅkāraḥ//4//
diṣṭyā daivānukūlyāt/ apiḥ parāgatetyanukarṣaṇārthaḥ/
atha priyādarśanāt pūrvottarakṣaṇayorativilakṣaṇamavasthāviśeṣamanusandadhāna āha - āścaryamutpaladṛśa ityādi/ vadanāmalendusānnidhyataḥ mukhameva niṣkalaṅkaścandraḥ, tasya sannidhireva sānnidhyaṃ pratyakṣatvam/ cāturvarṇyādivat svārthe taddhitapratyayaḥ/ ``pañcamyāstasil'' (5-3-7)/ muhuḥ kṣaṇāt/ ``muhuḥ kṣaṇe'nukṣaṇe ca'' iti vaijayantī/ jaḍimānaṃ santāpavirahācchaityam/ ``apratipattirjaḍate''tyarthaḥ tatra na ghaṭate/ santāpadagdhasyeti pūrvaprastutasantāpasyaiva śamanapratipādanaucityāt, anantaraṃ dravatvokteśca/ jātyena viśuddhasvajātibhavena kalaṅkādirahitenetyarthaḥ/ tasyaiva jhaṭiti svakāryotpādanāt/ candramaṇinā candrakāntākhyaratnena/ sphaṭikaviśeṣatvena candrakāntasya/ ratnaśāstre tasyāpi ratneṣvanyatamatvokteḥ/ mahīdharasya kailāsādeḥ parvatasya/ mahīdharopamānena atisthiraprakṛterapi dṛśyamānavastusvabhāvamahimnaiva jaḍatvadravatvopapattiḥ prakāśyate/ sandhāryate samyagūhyate/ dravamayaḥ ārdratāsvarūpaḥ/ kimasyāḥ priyaṃ karavāṇīti buddhijanakānukūlyaviśeṣarūpo vikāraḥ kṣobhaḥ/
``yadyadasya priyaṃ vetti tasya tasyāśukārikām/
yogyatāmārdratāṃ prāhurmanaḥkāluṣyanāśinīm//'' iti divākaraḥ/ athavā rasaparavaśatāmātram, ``yanna santi dravaccittaṃ premāśrupulakodgamāḥ/'' itivat/ mama manasā ityanenāpīyaṃ paramānandāvasthānubhūyata iti diṣṭyā vardhāmaha ityarthaḥ/ candramaṇipakṣe tu jaḍimā divātanoṣmasampattiśamanāt sahajaśaityāvirbhāvaḥ/ dravatvaṃ salilabinduniṣyandaḥ/ upamayā sānnidhye jāḍyadravatvānubhūtiḥ, asānnidhye yathāpūrvaṃ santāpānuvṛttiśca dyotyate/ atrāvegaharṣayośca bhāvayoḥ praśamodayau jñeyau/ saṅkaro'trālaṅkāraḥ, rūpakopamāśleṣāṇāmanyonyānugrāhyānugrāhakabhāvenāvasthiteḥ//5//
sampratīti - pūrvāvasthāto'pi/ ramaṇīyatarā saundaryaśālinī/ ṣoḍaśavarṇaṃ suvarṇamiva hiraṇyaretasā kandarpeṇa nirbharamupatāpyamānatvāditi bhāvaḥ/
``na tu grīṣmasyaivaṃ subhagamaparāddhaṃ yuvatiṣu/'' iti śākuntalokteḥ/
jvalayatītyādi/ darśanāhlādena kṣaṇamupaśamāt aṅgārāvasthaṃ madanānalaṃ vighnitadṛḍhopagūhatarṣeṇa viprakarṣeṇa punaḥ sandhukṣayatītyarthaḥ/ madayati dhairyadhṛtamapi manaḥ paravaśīkaroti/ athavā taddaśāviśeṣasya svābhilaṣitānulomyāt sagarvaṃ karotītyarthaḥ/ kṛtārthayati draṣṭavyaviṣayamādhuryātibhūmerdṛṣṭatvāddarśanamātrasādhanatvācca cakṣuḥ pūrṇamanorathaṃ karotītyarthaḥ/ parimṛditāyāḥ karatalasparśādikheditāyāḥ campakāvalyāḥ campakakusumamālāyā iva vilāsaḥ śobhā yeṣāṃ taiḥ/ campakāvaligrahaṇaṃ tatsāvarṇyāllāvaṇyasya mārdavātiśayācceti mantavyam/
``kuvalayadalakāntiḥ kāpi cāmpeyagaurī/'' iti madanatantre prāśastyokteśca/ tatra hetuḥ- lulitālasaiḥ smaraglānatayā kriyāsvapaṭubhiḥ [aṅgaiḥ] karacaraṇādibhiḥ/ atra dīpakamalaṅkāraḥ/ mālatīrūpasyaikasya kārakasya jvalayatītyādibahukriyābhiḥ sambandhāt//6//
sahi/ sakhi asmin kuñjanikuñje kusumānyapacinuvaḥ/
prathametyādi/ [prathamapriyāvacanasaṃśravasphuratpulakena] prathamena tatpūrveṇa, svasya priyāvacanasaṃśravaṇena dayitābhāṣaṇākarṇanena, sphurantaḥ prarohantaḥ pulakā romodbhedā yasya tena/ ghanarājermeghamālāyāḥ/ nūtanena prāvṛḍārambhe tatprathamena/ payaḥsamukṣaṇena jaladhārāvasekena/ kṣaṇabaddhakuḍmalakadambaḍambaraḥ kṣaṇāt baddhakuḍmalasya sarvāṅgīṇaprarūḍhakorakasyanīpavṛkṣasya, ḍambaraḥ saṃrambhaḥ, lakṣaṇayā tasya vibhrama ityarthaḥ/
``āḍambarastu saṃrambhe paṭahe gajagarjite/'' iti vaijayantī/ atropamā yathāsaṃkhyaṃ nidarśanā cālaṅkāraḥ/ priyādīnāṃ ghanarājyādibhiḥ upamitatvāt, kramasambandhād, ḍambarasadṛśo ḍambara ityupamāparikalpanācca//7//
sakhi! evaṃ kurvaḥ/ puṣpāpacāyamiti pāṭhaḥ/
mālatyānayanasvahastapuṣpāpacayādirūpaṃ svamanorathānurūpaṃ kāmandakyā nayaprayogaṃ camatkaroti mādhavaḥ - aparimeyāścaryaṃ aparicchedyādbhutaprayogam/ ācāryakam upāyopadeśavaidagdhyam/
ito'pyaparāṇyapacinuvaḥ/ ita ita iti pradeśāntarābhinayaḥ/ apiśabdenāśaktāvapyādarātiśayaḥ prakāśyate/
saukumāryātiśayajanitaṃ puṣpāpacāyakhedaṃ jñātvā sānunayamāha - pariṣvajyeti/ devatārādhanādādarātiśayacamatkāreṇāliṅganasatkāramanuṣṭhāyetyarthaḥ/ virama nivartasva/ asmādvyāpārāditi śeṣaḥ/ ``vyāṅparibhyo ramaḥ'' (1-3-83) iti parasmaipadam/ nissahā soḍhumaśaktā/ ``smaraparibhavanissahātidīrghaiḥ'' iti murāryukteḥ/
nissahātvamevopapādayantī tulyaviśeṣaṇena patākāsthānakena pratyāsannaṃ priyatamasandarśanaṃ sūcayati skhalayati vacanamityādinā/ ``prastutāgantubhāvasya vastuno'nyoktisūcanam/
patākāsthānakaṃ tulyasaṃvidhānaviśeṣaṇam//'' iti dhanikokteḥ/ vacanaṃ skhalayati vacaḥprasaraṃ pratihataṃ karoti/ aṅgamaṅgaṃ pratyekaṃ hastapādādikam/ sraṃsayati srastaṃ svavyāpārākṣamaṃ karoti/ saṃśrayatīti tu pāṭhe parasparasaṃśritaṃ karotīti ṇijartho jñeyaḥ/ mukhacandrodbhāsinaḥ mukharūpe candre udbhāsanaśīlān/ tasyāmṛtabinduniṣyandaucityāt svedabindūnāṃ mukhasambandhoktiḥ/ prathamaṃ lalāṭatalagaṇḍamaṇḍaleṣu teṣāmāvirbhāvāt/ mukulayati kuḍmalaṃ karoti/ sādṛśyalakṣaṇayā sammīlanatītyarthaḥ/ sarvathā sarveṇa prakāreṇa/ subhru iti bhrūlatayorapi tadānīṃ srastatayā saviśeṣaramaṇīyatvaṃ sūcayati/ khedaḥ śramaḥ/ vilasati utkaṭatayā pratīyate/ tulyaṃ sadṛśaṃ yatheti kriyāviśeṣaṇam/ vallabhālokanena priyatamasya darśanena/ karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhyāṃ kṛdantena samāsaḥ, na punaḥ kartari ṣaṣṭhyāḥ/ tathā vyākhyāte nāyikayā tu adṛśyamānena nāyakena dṛśyamānāyāstasyā vacanaskhalanādīnāmanupapatteḥ/ ``tulyārthairatulopamābhyāṃ tṛtīyā'nyatarasyāṃ'' (2-3-72) iti tṛtīyā/ atrārthaśleṣo'laṅkāraḥ, arthadvāreṇaupamyapratīteḥ/ khedajanitānāṃ vacanaskhalanādīnāṃ vastuto bhede'pi vallabhālokanajanitaistairabhedo atiśayoktyādhyavasīyate/ kaiśikīvṛttyaṅgabhūtaṃ vacohāsyanarma cedamanusandheyam/
``vaidagdhyakrīḍitaṃ narma priyopacchandanātmakam/'' ityukteḥ/ mukhāṅgaṃ narma cedaṃ parihāsavacaḥprayogāt//8//
lajjāṃ nāṭayatīti/
``durācārādibhirvrīḍādhārṣṭyābhāvastamunnayet/
sācīkṛtāṅgāvaraṇavaivarṇyādhomukhādibhiḥ//'' iti vacanāt sācīkṛtāṅgatvādikaṃ abhinayatītyarthaḥ/
śobhanaṃ bhagavatyā ājñaptam/ suṣṭu sasvinnaiveyamityarthaḥ/
hṛdayaṅgamaḥ manoharaḥ/ parihāsaḥ krīḍābhāvinaḥ svasandarśanasya bhaṅgyā prakāśanāditi bhāvaḥ/
taditi - yasmāt khedastvayi prakāśate tasmāt/ āsyatāṃ upaviśyatām/ kiñciditi ``prasṛtasadbhāvāyāṃ ca kāryaśeṣamitthaṃ vadet'' iti kāmasūtrokteḥ/ ``vrajati virahe vaicityam'' ityādibhiḥ prakaṭīkṛtasadbhāvāṃ nāyikāṃ prati kāryaśeṣakathanopakramaḥ/ kiñciditi sāmānyakathanam/ hṛdayajñatayedamiyaṃ vivakṣatīti sā visaṃvadati na veti parīkṣārthamiti mantavyam/
saṃvādaṃ darśayati - upaviśantīti/ ``devatārādhanamidānīṃ kartavyam/ ambā vilambaṃ na sahate'' ityādipratyākhyānaprakāraparihāreṇa tatsammatiṃ dyotayati/ sarvāḥ kāmandakī mālatī lavaṅgikā cetyarthaḥ/
cibukaṃ mukhādadhobhāgam/ unnamayya trapāvanatiṃ pratihantuṃ kareṇottambhyopalālyetyarthaḥ/ śṛṇvityādi kāmasūtrameva smārayati/ tadavisaṃvādaṃ niścitya kāryakathanaprakāraḥ - subhage! iti/ diṣṭyā vardhase/ svānurūpavaraprārthanīyatvāditi protsāhanam/ vicitramāścaryam/ asambhāvyamidaṃ vastu daivenāpatitamityarthaḥ/
protsāhanaphalaṃ darśayati - avahitāsmi śrotumekāgratayā sthitāsmītyādarātiśayaḥ prakāśyate/
prasaṅgataḥ ``assatthasarīro māhavo tti'' avalokitāvacanaprastāvāt ``bhāvadi ko eso māhavo tti'' lavaṅgikāpraśnenetyanusmārayati/ kathita eveti abhijanato guṇataśca nivedita eva/ na tu tatsattādikamadya kathanīyamityarthaḥ/ aśrutasyaiva bubhutsitatayā vyākhyeyatvāt/ māmakīyasya matsambandhinaḥ/ (dvitīyatvaṃ tāvad ṛ) bandhanaṃ nigalo viṣayāntaraparibhramaṇanivāraṇena dṛḍhaṃ dhāritatvāt/ dvitīyaṃ tvatto'nyadityarthaḥ/ dvitīyaśabdaprayoge'pi tvamivetyuktiḥ kiñcidapyanyūnatvaṃ prakāśayitum/ kumārastāvadastītyanvayaḥ/
smarāmaḥ na tvidānīṃ smṛtamiti tasya sadānusandhīyamānatvaṃ dyotayati/ avahidahmīti mālatyā avadhānadāne sumarāmo iti lavaṅgikāyāḥ prativacanaṃ tasyā vrīḍāmudritatvāt tadrūpeṇāvasthitā sakhī prativaktīti sūtrayati/
khalu prasiddhau/ mayā kathito bhavatībhyāṃ viditaścetyarthaḥ/ durmanāyamānaḥ duḥkhitahṛdayo bhavan/ ``kartuḥ kyaṅ salopaśca'' (3-1-11) iti kyaṅ/ paravāniva paravaśa iva/ śarīropatāpena śārīreṇa jvareṇa hetunā/ atra ca durmanāyamāna iti mānasasya, śarīropatāpena iti śarīrasya duḥkhasya ca sadbhāva uktaḥ/
tadanvayavyatirekābhyāmupapādayati - yadindāvityādi [indau] candre/ dṛṣṭa iti śeṣaḥ/
``agneḥ śītena toyasya tṛṣā bhaktasya ca kṣudhā/
kriyate sukhakartṛtvaṃ tadvilomasya cetaraiḥ//'' iti nyāyāt/ deśakāladaśāviśeṣavaśād anaikāntikaṃ candrasya sukhāvahatvamāśaṅkyāha - veti pūrvoktāvyāvṛttau/ praṇayini jane prakṛṣṭapremāspade makarandādāvityaikāntikaṃ ānandahetutvaṃ dyotayati/ na bhajate na prāpnoti/ bhajate na punarabhajiṣṭeti pūrvāvasthāto vyatirekaṃ darśayati/ yat yasmāt/ tat tasmāt/ vyanakti prakāśayati/ antastāpaṃ mānasaṃ duḥkham/ atidhīraḥ atyantaṃ gambhīraḥ/
``vedanāṃ yastu śaknoti niyantuṃ bahulā api/
udyuktaścet svabuddhyaiva naro'sau dhairyavān mataḥ//'' iti divākaraḥ/ apirvirodhe/ nihnotuṃ śakyatve nihnuta eva/ tadaśaktyābhivyanaktīti daśāyā atibhūmigatatvaṃ dyotayati/ viṣamaṃ kṣaṇe kṣaṇe mohādikāryabhedajananān bahuvidhaḥ/ priyaṅguśyāmāṅgaprakṛtiḥ phalinīlatāvat snigdhaśyāmalā aṅgaprakṛtiḥ śarīrasvabhāvo yasya saḥ/ apiratrāpi virodhe/ tasminnāpāṇḍutvavirodhāt/ cakāro bhinnakramaḥ/ vapuśca vahati ityanvayaḥ/ [āpāṇḍumadhuraṃ]āpāṇḍu īṣatsitavarṇībhūtam/ madhuraṃ anulbaṇaṃ auddhatyavirahāt/ kṣāmakṣāmaṃ atikṛśībhūtam/ vahatīti vartamānanirdeśādatrāpi vyatirekaḥ/ kramoktyā manastāpahetukatvamitarasya prakāśyate/
``manaḥśarīrayostāpaḥ parasparamabhivrajet/
ādhārādheyabhāvena taptājyaghaṭayoriva//'' iti vaidyakokterjvarādihetukatvamapi manastāpasya kiṃ na syādityāśaṅkāṃ nivārayitum/ bhavatu nāma manastāpahetukatvamaparasya/ sa punaḥ pitrādidarśanotkaṇṭhāmūlaḥ kiṃ na syādityāśaṅkāṃ nivārayati - ramaṇīyaśca bhavatīti/ kāraṇāntarajanyatve antastāpasya vicchāyatvādikamavaśyaṃ bhavatyeva/ asau tu nirmalalāvaṇyaḥ kṣaṇe kṣaṇe bhavatītyataḥ pāriśeṣyānmanmathonmādahetukatvamevetyupapattyā sthāpayati/
``cintājāgaraṇapratāntanayanastejoguṇādātmanaḥṣṭasaṃskārollikhito mahāmaṇiriva kṣīṇo'pi nālakṣyate/'' iti śākuntalādiprasiddheḥ/ śokātmanaḥ kāraṇasya pitrādivirahajātasya punaḥ ``aśrupāto mukhe śoṣaḥ svarabhedo vivarṇatā/'' ityādibhiranubhāvai ramaṇīyatvadarśanāt/ atrātiśayoktiranumānaṃ tulyayogitā cālaṅkāraḥ//9//
etadapi tasminnavasare bhagavatīṃ tvarayantyāvalokitayā udīritamāsīt/ etad mādhavasyāsvāsthyarūpaṃ vastu/ tasminnavasare prasaṅgataḥ kathanārambhakāle/ tvarayantyā śīghragamanāya prerayantyā/ udīritaṃ kathitam/ ``cirāidaṃ bhāvadīe/ assatthasarīro māhavo tti'' ityuktimanusandhatte/
atha sāmānyato'vagataṃ manmathonmādaṃ kāraṇaviśeṣe niyacchati - yāvaditi/ yāvacchabdo'vadhāraṇe/
``yāvattāvacca sākalye'vadhau māne'vadhāraṇe/'' iti vaijayantī/ manmathonmādaḥ kāmajanitaṃ manasaḥ unmārgagamanam/ ``unmāthaḥ'' iti vā pāṭhaḥ/ udbhūtaḥ kṣobhaḥ ityarthaḥ/ mālatyevāsya manmathonmādaheturityaśṛṇavaṃ śrutavatyevetyavadhāraṇena bahūnāṃ vaktaṛṇāmekavākyatvaṃ dyotyate/
``gatānugatiko loko na lokaḥ pāramārthikaḥ/'' iti nyāyāt/ vaktaṛṇāmanāptatve lalanāntarahetukatvasyāpi sambhāvanādavadhāraṇe vaiyarthyamityāśaṅkyāha - mamāpīti/ na kevalaṃ vaktṛjanapratyayādeva niścayaḥ/ kiṃ tarhi ṛ mamāpi/ apiḥ samuccaye/ sa eva yasteṣāṃ vaktaṛṇāṃ nirṇayaḥ sa eva nirṇayo mamāpītyarthaḥ/
kuta iyamavadhāraṇetyatra pratijñāpūrvakaṃ hetumupanyasyati - anubhavamityādi/ anubhavaśabdenātrānubhūtitvāvāntarajātiḥ sākṣāttvāparaparyāyam aparokṣatvaṃ vivakṣyate/ vadanenduḥ induriva vadanam/ ``upamitaṃ vyāghrādibhiḥ sāmānyāprayoge'' (2-1-56) ityupamāsamāsaḥ/ paya ivetyupamānuguṇyāt/ niyataṃ niścitamiti kriyāviśeṣaṇam/ eṣa iti purovartino mālatīvadanendoranubhavadyotakena abhinayenāśakyavarṇanatvanirdeśaḥ/ anubhavaṃ niyatamupāgamat prāpta iti pratijñā/ asya mādhavasya/ mahātmanaḥ mahān īdṛśaistādṛśairviṣayairakṣobhyaḥ ātmā mano yasya/ kṣubhitaṃ udvelavikāram/ utkalikātaralam utkaṇṭhayā nijadhairyaṃ tyājitaṃ mahadbhistaraṅgaiścañcalaṃ ca/
``.... .... .... utkaṇṭhotkalike same/'' ``ūrmiḥ kallola ullolalaharyutkaliketi ca//'' iti vaijayantī/ stimitasya nivātatayā pūrvaṃ niścalasya/ atra saṅkaro'laṅkāraḥ/ mahātmano'sya manaḥ stimitasya mahodadheḥ paya iveti bimbabhāvena nirdeśād, dṛṣṭāntasya vadanendurityupamayānugṛhītatvād, utkalikātaralamiti śliṣṭaṃ sādhāraṇaṃ viśeṣaṇam/ anumānaṃ cālaṅkāraḥ, sādhyasādhanabhāvapratipādanāt/ yathāhīndudarśanādeva sindhurājo vikurute, na punastārakādidarśanāt/ evamasāvapi tvanmukhadarśanādeva kṣubhitahṛdayo'bhūt, na punaranyasyāḥ yasyāḥ kasyāścit tatkṣobhaṇasāmarthyamiti niratiśayamuddīpanavibhāvatvaṃ nāyikāmukhendoḥ, lokātikrāntadhīratvaṃ ca nāyakasyātra prakāśyate//10//
aho ityāścarye/ īdṛśī vaidagdhī nānyasyāḥ kasyāściditi bhāvaḥ/ ``upanyāsastu vāṅmukham'' ityamaraḥ/ upanyāsasya vivakṣitāyā nāyakasamāgamānukūlyaprārthanārūpāyā vāco dvārasya viśuddhiḥ asiddhatvādidoṣaparihārāddhetoḥ uttarānirākāryatvam/ mahatvāropaṇe ``avāptavyānavāptāni yasya sarvāṇi dehinaḥ/
paropakāravyasanī sa mahānabhidhīyate//'' iti lakṣitasya mahattvasya mālatīhṛdayāvarjakasya asmāsu sampādane pravṛttirityanena svasmin svābhāvikānapi guṇāṃstayāropyanta iti sambhāvayata/ uttamanāyakatvādavikatthanatvamanahaṅkāratvaṃ ca prakāśyate/
athaveti aho iti pūrvotpannāmāścaryabuddhiṃ nivartayati/ śāstreṣviti - ekaprayojanapratibaddhānekārthapratipādako granthaḥ śāstram/ bahuvacanena bāhuvidhyaṃ prakāśyate/ bharatavātsyāyananītiśāstrādiṣvityarthaḥ/ niṣṭhā niratiśayā sthitiḥ/ niṣkarṣa ityarthaḥ/ sahajo bodhaḥ prāgbhavīyapuṇyasaṃskārajanito vivekaḥ, śāstravāsanā yasyopaskurute/ nissādhvasatvaṃ prāgalbhyam/ abhyastaguṇā ``mādhuryamakṣaravyaktirhetuvādaḥ pragalbhatā/
prakṛtasparśitā ceti pañcārthaṃ bruvato guṇāḥ//'' ityuktā guṇāḥ śikṣitā yasyāḥ sā/ vāṇī vāk/ praśastavaktrasaṃsargajanyatvādvaktṛtvaviśeṣasya/
``satyaṃ rūpaṃ śrutaṃ vidyā kulaṃ śīlaṃ balaṃ dhanam/
śauryaṃ vicitrabhāṣyaṃ ca daśa saṃsargayonayaḥ//'' iti vyāsokteḥ/ kālānurodhaḥ avasarasyocitasyānusaraṇam pratibhānavatvam/
``prajñā navanavonmeṣaśālinī pratibhā matā/'' iti lakṣitā pratibhaiva pratibhānam/ bhāve lyuṭ/ tadvattvaṃ nityayoge matup/ caita iti pāṭhaḥ/ atra kathite guṇaṣaṭke dvayordvayorupakāryopakārakatvena mithunatvaṃ cakāraistribhiḥ prakāśyate/ tathā hi, sahajabodhasya śāstraniṣṭhāvirahe bālamūkādivijñānasadṛśatvāt, prāgalbhyasyāpi vāṇīguṇavaidhurye jaraṭhakaraṭaraṭitasyeva vairāgyajanakatvāt, pratibhānasyāpi kālānurodhamantareṇa śaraduparacitaśālibījavāpavarjanāvamānahetutvādanupakārakatvaṃ prasiddhameva/ ato dahanapavanayoriva dvayordvayoḥ sambhūya kāryakaraṇāccakāratrayaprayoga iti mantavyam/ ete parigaṇitā guṇāḥ ātmadharmaviśeṣāḥ/ kāmadughāḥ prayoktaṛṇāmiṣṭānarthān duhantīti/ ``duhaḥ kabghaśca'' (3-2-60) iti kabghaśca/ kriyāsu kartavyapravṛttiṣu/ kriyāsviti sāmānyokte na kevalaṃ priyasamāgamarūpe prastutavastunyayaṃ niyamaḥ, kintu yatra yatra kārye pravartyate tatra tatra sādhāraṇa evāyaṃ sādhyasādhanopāya iti dyotayati/ ata etadguṇasāmagrīviśiṣṭāyāḥ bhagavatyāḥ kimasmābhirvarṇyata iti bhāvaḥ/ atra dūtīgatasya vaidagdhyasya kāraṇamukhena prakāśanāt aprastutapraśaṃsālaṅkāraḥ//11//
asya manaḥ kṣubhitamityuktam/ tat kathaṃ jñāyata ityatrāha - yata iti/ yataḥ yasmāt/ tena mādhavena/ jīvitāt prāṇasandhāraṇāt/ udvijamānena bibhyatā, vedanānubhavāśaktatayetyarthaḥ/ ``bhītrārthānāṃ bhayahetuḥ'' (1-4-25) iti pañcamī/ duṣkaramiti sāmarthyād virahibhiḥ, kartumaśakyamapītyarthaḥ/ kiñcit kimapi/ na na kriyate sarvaṃ kriyata evetyarthaḥ/ ``dvau nañau prakṛtamarthaṃ sūcayataḥ'' ityukternañordvayorvidhāyakatvāt/ na na kriyata iti yatastataḥ kāryato manaḥkṣobho'numita iti śeṣaḥ/
kiṃ tat kāryamityāha - tathāhīti/ dhatta ityādi - dhatte na tu preṣayatītyeva ciramavasthāpayatītyarthaḥ/ cakṣuriti indriyatvābhiprāyeṇaikavacanam/ mukulini kuḍmalabahule na punaḥ kusumitamātre/ anenoparyupari vikasatpuṣpatayoddīpanavibhāvatvātiśayaḥ khyāpyate/ raṇatkokile śabdāyamānaparabhṛte/ atrāpi vartamānanirdeśādaṅkurāsvādakaṣāyakaṇṭhānāṃ kalakaṇṭhānāmakuṇṭhakūjitasantāno vyajyate/ viśeṣaṇābhyāṃ vasantasamayasannidhānasampannasaundaryatvaṃ prakāśyate/ bālacūte iti taruṇatayā snigdhamugdhabahalapallavollasitasya sahakārasyānyadāpi duḥsahatvaṃ kiṃ punastadānīmiti dyotyate/ bālacūte aupaśleṣike'dhikaraṇe ityarthaḥ/ mārge ayamanena pathā gamiṣyatītyutprekṣya tasmin pathi/ na punastasyāgamanasamaya evetyanena pūrvameva tanmārganirodhe saṃrambho ``māmahatvā padāt padamapi na calitumenamanumanya[''] iti sūcyate/ gātraṃ śarīram/ kṣipati durvahaṃ bhāramiva nirdayaṃ nirasyati/ bakulāmodagarbhasya kesarakusumaparimalamāgalamāpīyāgatasya na punaḥ kiñcitspṛṣṭveti garbhaśabdena dyotyate/ viśeṣaṇena mandamandaparispandinaścandanagirinandanasya vasantabandhorgandhavāhanasyeti vyajyate/ dāvapremṇā - ``davadāvau vanāraṇyavahnī'' iti vaijayantī/ dāve vanavahnau yat prema snehaḥ mumūrṣāṇāṃ tatsadṛśasya bandhorabhāvāt, tena premṇā teṣu bandhenetyarthaḥ/ sarasabisinīpatramātrāntarāyaḥ śiśiropacāratayā suhṛdbhirupari nihitāni karpūracandanadravārdrāṇi navāhṛtāni padminīpatrāṇyevāntarāyo vighnaḥ sadyo mṛtyunivārakāṇi yasyetyarthaḥ/ tāmyanmūrttiḥ jvarāturatayāvasīdaccharīra iti śrayaṇāya gacchataḥ skhalanapatanādi sūcyate/ śrayati upasarpati/ bahuśaḥ bahuvāramiti/ anena makarandādīnāṃ balātkāreṇa nivartanaṃ, punargamanaṃ, punarnivartanaṃ ca dyotyate/ mṛtyave mṛtyuśabdena maraṇaṃ lakṣyate/ prāṇatyāgāyetyarthaḥ/ candrapādān candraraśmīn/ mṛtyave iti vākyatraye'pi sambadhyate/ atrātiśayoktiralaṅkāraḥ/ dhatte cakṣurityādi puṣpaṃ, vākyaviśeṣaprayogāt//12//
atiduṣkaraṃ karotīti svānubhūtisaṃvādaṃ darśayati/
tat tasmāt/ evamityuktaprakāraparāmarśaḥ/ prakṛtyā sukumāraḥ svabhāvato mṛduḥ/ kumāra ityabhinavayauvanatvoktiḥ/ kadācidekavāram/ apyartho'nusandheyaḥ/ anyatrānyasmin viṣaye nimittabhūte/ aparikliṣṭapūrvaḥ pūrvamananubhūtaduḥkhaḥ/ pūrvānubhūtatve hi duḥkhasya vāsanāvaśāt sahyatvamiti bhāvaḥ/ tapasvī dayāviṣayaḥ/ evaṃ yata ityanvayaḥ/ itthaṃbhūto yasmādityarthaḥ/ tat tasmāditi yacchabdasya pratiyogī tacchabdaḥ/ adhunā asmin kāle/ anena mādhavena/ maraṇamapīti sādhanasāmagryāt sādhyasampattyavaśyaṃbhāvāt suhṛdādyasannidhau candrikāvagāhādisāhasānuṣṭhāne maraṇamapi anubhavituṃ prāptum/ śakyaṃ sukaram/ yatastenetyādi tadevaṃ prakṛtyetyādi ca sākṣāt kāmasūtrameva vaidagdhyāt kavīśvareṇa sthāne yojitaṃ veditavyam/
janāntikamiti - kāmandakyā śravaṇasyaiva parihārānmādhavena tirohitena yathāvat śrūyamāṇatvamajānatī mālatyāha - sakhi ātmanaḥ kāraṇānmartyalokālaṅkārabhūtasya kimapyāśaṅkamānā bhītāpi na jānāmi kiṃ pratipatsye iti/ ātmanaḥ kāraṇāt mama hetoḥ/ martyalokālaṅkā[ra]bhūtasya puruṣaratnatayā manuṣyalokasya bhūmaṇḍalasyaiva bhūṣaṇabhūtaḥ śobhātiśayajananād yastasya/ kimapītyamaṅgalatayānuktiḥ śarīrāpāyamityarthaḥ/ bhītāpi kampitahṛdayāpi/ kiṃ pratipatsya iti dhairyamavalambya sāhasenāpi taṃ rakṣāmi vā pitṛsnehādadhīrā tena saha naśyāmi veti dvayoḥ pakṣayoḥ kimaṅgīkaromi iti na jānāmītyarthaḥ/ anayā coktyā dūtīkarmaṇaḥ phalaṃ tadviṣayāmanukampāṃ darśayati/
tadevāha tadvacanaṃ śrutvā mādhavaḥ - diṣṭyā daivānukūlyena kāruṇyaviṣayatvena aṅgīkṛto'smīti/ diṣṭyeti dūtīprayatnasāphalyamālocya harṣo vyajyate/
ataḥparaṃ ``atha khalu vidheyaḥ paricaya'' iti vidheyatvena cintitasya ``mādhavasamakṣamuttaramupakramiṣye'' ityupakrāntasya parasparānurāgaprakaṭanādirūpasyobhayabhāganiṣṭhasya dūtīkarmaṇaḥ kāmandakīmukhena ekamaṃśaṃ mālatīhṛdayarasāyanaṃ pratipādya lavaṅgikāmukhena dvitīyamaṃśaṃ mādhavaśravaṇapīyūṣaṃ prakāśayitumupakramate kavīśvaraḥ - bhāvadītyādi/ bhagavatī evaṃvādinītya[ā]khyāyate/ evamiti ``śṛṇu vicitraṃ'' ityādi taduktaprakāraparāmarśaḥ, ittham/ bhagavatītyanena hetunā pūrvaṃ mādhavahṛdayāparijñānāt bhagavatīṃ prati lajjayā ca asmābhirayamartho na prakāśitaḥ/ idānīṃ bhagavatyaiva tadavasthāyā niveditatvāt asmābhirapi visrabdhaṃ kathyate ityarthaḥ/ asmākamapi bhartṛdārikā bhavanāsannarathyāmukhamuhūrtamaṇḍanasya tasyaiva bahuśo'nubhūtadarśanā bhūtvā ravikaraspṛṣṭamugdhakamalinīkandasundarāvayavaśobhāvibhāvitānaṅgavedanāvegaramaṇīyāpi parijanaṃ dunoti/ asmākamapīti/ yuṣmābhistāvadyuṣmadīyasya kumārasya daśānubhūtā niveditā ca/ asmākaṃ svāmiduhiturapi tathaiva kiñcidapyanyūnāsmābhiranubhūtā nivedyata ityapinā sūtryate/ tasyaiveti-yaḥ khalvasyā hetoritthaṃbhūtaḥ tasyaivetyevakāreṇa diṣṭyā vardhase svābhimatasampatterityarthaḥ/ bhavanāsannetyādinā ``bhūyo bhūyaḥ savidhanagarīrathyayā'' (1.18, pṛ. 45) ityādi saṃghaṭayati/ tasya anubhūtadarśaneti gamakatvāt samāsaḥ/
``vaimānikānāṃ marutāmapaśyadākṛṣṭalīlānnaralokapālān/'' itivat sūryāṃśuspṛṣṭatayā kiñcit mlānaṃ! āladdhiṃ spṛṣṭam/
``ghaṇarohavimukkhadiṇārakarāladdhim/'' iti setūktavat/ [mugdhaṃ] apariṇataṃ kamalinīkandaṃ mṛṇālamiva sundarā ye'vayavāḥ karacaraṇādyaṅgāni, teṣāṃ śobhayā kāntyā prakāśitā, anaṅgavedanā kāmasantāpastasya vega ujjṛmbhaṇaṃ, tajjanita āvego hṛdayakṣobho vā, tena ramaṇīyāpi/ madanasantāpasya rāmaṇīyakajanakatvaṃ pūrvaṃ pratipāditam/ parijanaṃ sakhyādikaṃ samīpavartinaṃ janam/ [dunoti] paritāpayati, apāyaśaṅkayeti bhāvaḥ/
nābhinandati kalākrīḍāḥ kalādibhirdyūtādibhirvihārān nādriyate/ bahuvacanena sarvāsvaviśeṣeṇa viraktiḥ pratipādyate/ tarhi kathaṃ kālaḥ kṣipyata ityāha - kevalaṃ mlāyatkamalāyamānahastapallavaparyastagaṇḍamaṇḍalā divasān gamayati/ tāmyatpadma ivācaran, nissaha ityarthaḥ, yo hastapallavastasmin paryastaṃ paravaśatayā nikṣiptaṃ, gaṇḍamaṇḍalaṃ yasyāḥ sā/ tathā bhūtveti tatkālaviśeṣaṇam/ cintānubhāvaścāyam/ gamayati kathaṃcid yāpayati/ na punaḥ nirvinodatayā dīrghībhūtāste svayaṃ gacchantītyarthaḥ/
api ceti priyatamacintāvyākṣiptacittatayā divasān gamayitumicchantyā madhye madhye mahānanartho vyākṣepamapi na sahata ityāha - vikasitāravindamakarandaniṣyandasundareṇa dalitakundamākandamadhubindusandohavāhinā bhavanodyānaparyantamārutenottāmyati/ mākandaḥ cūtaḥ/ sandohaḥ samūhaḥ/ gṛhopavanasamīpavāyuneti durnivāratvaṃ dyotyate/ ``viasiāravindamārandaṇīsandasundareṇa'' ityādibhiḥ aratikathanād vidhūtam/ dvādaśaitāni mukhāṅgāni bījārambhadyotakāni yojitāni/ eteṣāmuddeśanirdeśavaiṣamyaṃ kriyākramasyāvivakṣitatvāt/
anyacca yattasmin divase nijamahotsavābhyudayapratipannarūpasya bhagavato madanasyeva kāmakānanālaṅkāriṇastasyāsyāśca vividhavibhramānurāgānubandhamahārghīkṛtayauvanārambhamanyonyadṛṣṭivinipātavañcanāvasarasantaptacittodbhriyamāṇakautūhalollasitasādhvasaṃ stambhamantharāvayavapratilagnasvedapulakotkampānanditasakhījanaṃ parasparāvalokanasukhaṃ samāsāditam/ tasminnityanubhavaḥ prasiddhirvā parāmṛśyate/ nijamahotsavaḥ nijaśabdena madanaḥ parāmṛśyate/ yaḥ svasambandhiyātrotsavaḥ tasyābhyudayāya śobhanatvāya anaṅgatvamapraśastamapahāya svīkṛtadehasya kāmasyevetyutprekṣā/ tatra hetuḥ - kāmakānanālaṅkāriṇo madanodyānaṃ bhūṣayata iti/ ``tassa sea'' iti pāṭhaḥ/ tasya mādhavasya asyā mālatyāśca yat parasparāvalokena sukhaṃ samāsāditaṃ itaretarasya darśanena yat sukhaṃ prāptaṃ tataḥ prabhṛtītyanvayaḥ/ kīdṛśaṃ sukhamityāha-vividhavilāsenānurāgabandhena parasparapremāsaṅgena mahārghīkṛtaḥ mahatā trailokyādinā mūlyena na kretuṃ yogyaḥ, athavā samastajanapūjyaḥ kṛtaḥ, yauvanārambhaḥ ubhayostāruṇyāvatāro yasmin/ ``aghag pūjāpratikriyāvi''ti vaijayantī/ anyonyadṛṣṭivinipātavañcanāvasaraḥ parasparasya dṛṣṭīnāṃ samāpatteḥ parihārasamayaḥ lajjayā jhaṭiti vyāvartanakālaḥ, tanmātradarśanābhāvāt saha tayā santapte manasi pūryamāṇena darśanakautukena ullasita udbhūtaḥ sādhvaso hṛdayotkampastajjanitayā stabdhatayā niśceṣṭatayā manthareṣu mandeṣu avayaveṣvaṅgeṣu pratilagnaiḥ pratyekaṃ prasṛtaiḥ, svedapulakotkampaiḥ utkampaḥ utkaṭaśarīravepathuḥ/ ānanditaḥ aho sadṛśayoḥ parasparānurāgeṇa kṛtārthāsmīti pramoditaḥ sakhīsamūho yasmin, tattādṛśamityarthaḥ/
tataḥprabhṛti saviśeṣadussahamadanavijṛmbhaṇoddāmadāruṇaṃ daśāpariṇāmamanubhavantī muhūrtaṃ samprāptapūrṇacandrodayeva bālakamalinī praśuṣyati/
``pavvāai sarasaṇahavāṃ idahaṇum/'' itivat/ tataḥprabhṛti tatsukhānubhavakālādārābhya/ saviśeṣadussahena vātāyanadarśanadaśāto'tiśayayuktatvāt asahyena madanasya vijṛmbhaṇena svakāryasarvasvaprakāśanena, uddāmadāruṇaṃ viśṛṅkhalatayā krūraṃ, prāṇānapi jighatsantamityarthaḥ/ daśāpariṇāmaṃ avasthāyāḥ paripākaṃ, parāṃ kāṣṭhāmityarthaḥ/ anubhavantīti svayamevopabhuṅkte asaṃvibhajanīyatvāt/ asmābhiḥ punaḥ sākṣitvamevāvalambyate/ hā kaṣṭamiti karuṇaraso dhvanyate/ samprāptapūrṇacandrodayeva bālakamalinītyupamayā yathā pūrṇacandrodayaḥ sakalajanāhlādako'pi kamalinī kadarthayati tathā mādhavasya darśanamenāmiti dyotyate/ bāleti sulabhaśoṣatvaṃ prakāśyate/ muhūrtaṃ praśuṣyatītyuktiḥ muhūrtāntare daśāntarasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt/
tathā ca muhūrttamātraṃ hṛdayavinihitanirmīyamāṇavallabhasamāgamā nirbharasalilāsārasicyamāneva medinī śītalāyata iti jānāmi/ tathāceti tadvadanyacca śrūyatāmiti śeṣaḥ/ athavā yathā śuṣyatīti tathā śītalāyata iti viruddhayordvayoravasthayorjhaṭiti vyatikaraṃ darśayati/ hṛdayavinihitatvena saṅkalpopasthāpitatvenānuṣṭhīyamānaḥ priyatamasambhogo yasyāḥ/ nirbhareṇa pūrṇena, salilāsāreṇa jalasya śīghravarṣeṇa, sicyamānā medinīvetyupamayā nidāghadairghyaśoṣaśocyāṃ yathā kṣaṇikenāsāreṇa śiśirībhavati tatheyamapi virahataptā saṅkalpasamāgameneti dyotayati/ iti jānāmīti ceṣṭāviśeṣairanuminomītyarthaḥ/ tadeva liṅgamupapādayati - yena prasphuraddaśanacchadoccaladdantamuktāpaṅktikāntisaviśeṣaśobhitanirantarollasitapulakapakṣmalakapolaghūrṇamānasantatānandabāṣpadhāram, īṣadviṣamaniṣpandamandatārottānamasṛṇamāṃsalamukulāyamānanetranīlol[t]palam, aviralodbhinnasvedajalabindusundaralalāṭanavacandralekhāmanoharaṃ mugdhamukhapuṇḍarīkamudvahantī vidagdhasahacarīcittasaṃjñayitakumārībhāvā bhavati/ daśanacchado'dharaḥ tasya prasphuraṇaṃ cumbanasaṃkalpāt, tasmāduccalantyo dantā eva muktā ratnāni, teṣāṃ paṅktyoḥ śreṇyoḥ, kāntyā prabhayā/ pulakapakṣmale romāñcasāndre kapole ghūrṇamānā prasarantī, santatā avicchinnā ānandabāṣpadhārā yasmin/
``vāhatthevo vāṣpadhārā vāhantheva vaha āsiata maüho'' iti setuprayogāt/ īṣadviṣamā kiñcit tiraścīnā, niṣpandā svaviṣayānniścalā, mandā ``paryāyeṇa calattāraṃ mandaṃ'' ityuktakrameṇa calantī viṣayagrahaṇāpaṭvī vā, tārā kanīnikā yasya tad uttānaṃ ūrdhvībhūtam masṛṇam anurāgakaṣāyitam, māṃsalaṃ bahalaprabhāpaṭalaṃ, mukulāyamānaṃ nimīlacca netrakuvalayaṃ yatra tat/ etairviśeṣaṇairlajjāvismayautsukyānurāgasnehopacitā ratāvasānikī harṣāvasthā prakāśyate/ aviralodbhinnaiḥ nirantaraprādurbhūtaiḥ, svedajalabindubhirabhirāmayā lalāṭarūpayā navacandralekhayā manoharamiti ratiśramoktiḥ/ mukhasya puṇḍarīkatvena rūpaṇaṃ smarāpāṇḍutayeti mantavyam/ ``puṇḍarīkaṃ sitāmbhojaṃ'' ityabhidhānāt/ vidagdhānāṃ dayitasamāgamasukhānubhavavikāravedinīnāṃ sahacarīṇāmiti santatasavidhasannidhānādakhaṇḍitacāritratvaṃ suṣṭhu jānatīnāmapīti dyotayati/ cittairmanobhiḥ saṃśayitaḥ khaṇḍitatvena śaṅkitaḥ, kumārībhāvaḥ kanyātvaṃ yasyāḥ/
kiñceti divasavṛttāntastāvat kathitaḥ, rātrivṛttānto'pi śrūyatāmityarthaḥ/ uddāmaśaśimayūkhanikurumbacumbitapravṛttaniṣyandacandramaṇihāradhāriṇī pracurakarpūrasaviśeṣaśiśiracandanarasacchaṭāsāraśīkaranikaradanturitabālakadalīdalaśayanā saṃvāhanādivyāpāratvaramāṇasahacarīsārthaviracitopanītakamalinīdalajalārdrā unnidraiva rajanīrgamayati/ meghādyāvaraṇavirahāduddāmānāmucchruṅkhalānāṃ candrakiraṇānāṃ, nikurumbena samūhena, cumbitaṃ saṃspṛṣṭam, ata eva pravṛttaniṣyandaṃ prārabdhajalabindukṣaraṇamityanena candradarśanāsahatvādasyāḥ sakhībhireva candrātape'vasthāpya pravṛttaniṣyandatve tasya samānayanaṃ dyotyate/ candramaṇihāraṃ candrakāntaratnagulikāvaliṃ, dhārayituṃ śīlaṃ yasyāḥ/ pracureṇa nirbhareṇa karpūreṇamilitatvāt saviśeṣaṃ svabhāvaśaityādadhikaṃ śītalasya candanarasasya candanapaṅkasya chaṭā samūhastasyāsāro'vasecanaṃ tajjanitaiḥ śīkaraiḥ bindubhirdanturitamunnatadantaṃ kṛtam, viṣamitamityarthaḥ/ bālairakaṭhoraiḥ kadalīpatraiḥ, kṛtaṃ śayanaṃ talpakalpanamityarthaḥ/ saṃvāhanaṃ hastapādādimardanam/ ādiśabdena mṛṇālavalayādyupahāraḥ/ tatprakāreṣu vyāpāreṣu karmasu tvaramāṇena kena kṛtenāsyāḥ aratyupaśamo nidrāgamaśca bhavediti sādaraṃ prayatamānena sakhīsamūhena viracitā tathātvena nirmitā, upanītā samīpe prayuktā ca, kamalinīdalātmikā jalārdrā yasyāḥ, himajalāvasiktamambarakhaṇḍaṃ bījanārthaṃ jalārdrā/
``sacandanāṃbhaḥkaṇakomalaistathā vapurjalārdrā pavanairna nirvavau/'' iti māghe/ unnidrā nidrāmudgamya vartamānā/ eveti kṣaṇamapyalabdhanidrātvaṃ pratīyate/
``hiāviṇihittaṇimmāantavaêlahasamāametti'' saṅkalpasamāgamasya pratipāditatvādidānīṃ svapnasamāgamaṃ varṇayati - kathamapītyādi/ kathamapyupalabdhanidrā avakṣaritapādapallavodvamatpiṇḍālaktakarasā dharadharāyamāṇapīvarorumūlapārśvavisaṃvāditanīvībandhanā utkṣubhyaddhṛdayāntarottaraṅganiḥśvāsaviṣamocchvasatpulakapakṣmalapayodharoparinihitavepamānabhujalatāveṣṭabandhanaṃ jhaṭiti pratibudhyate/ kathamapīti kālasvabhāvāt sakhīprayatnāccetyarthaḥ/ apakṣaritāt svinnāt pādapallavādudvamannārdrīkṛtatayā sravat, piṇḍālaktakaraso lākṣārasaviśeṣo yasyāḥ/ vamirakarmako'pi prayujyate/ tathā kādambaryāṃ - ``udvamadamalagaṅgāpravāhamiva jahnum'' iti, kirātārjunīye ca - ``udvamannabhirarāja samantāt'' iti/ dharādharāyāmāṇeti smarajanitasya sphuraṇasyāvyaktasyānukāraḥ/ ḍācivīpsāśānacau/ dharādharāyamāṇasya pīvarasya pīnasyorumūlasya jaghanamaṇḍalasya pārśve ekadeśe, na punaḥ svasthānabhūte nābhideśe ityarthaḥ, visaṃvāditaṃ śithilatvād ayathāpūrvaṃ nīvībandhanaṃ vāsasa āgrathanaṃ yasyāḥ/ utkṣubhyatā harṣataralena sambhogavegakṣubhitena vā hṛdayena, uttaraṅgairuparyupari pravṛttairucchvāsairviṣamamuccāvacaṃ yathā tathocchvasataḥ utkampamānasya, pulakaiḥ pakṣmalasya sāndrasya payodharasyoparinihitaṃ vepamānayoḥ prathamasāhasabhayāt priyapariṣvaṅgasukhavikārādvā kampamānayorbhujalatayorveṣṭena valayīkaraṇena bandhanaṃ yathā tatheti kriyāviśeṣaṇena parasparāliṅganasukhe vartamāna evāsamāptatṛṣṇāyāḥ prabodhaḥ pratīyate/
``kva nīlakaṇṭha vrajasītyalakṣyavāgasatyakaṇṭhārpitabāhubandhanā/'' ityuktavat/ jhaṭiti pratibudhyata iti aratibalāt kṣaṇena nidrābhaṅgaḥ prakāśyate/ tathāvidhasya pratibodhasya dāruṇaduḥkhahetutvamāha - paḍivohetyādi/ pratibodhavelāvisarjitāpāṅgadṛṣṭivijñātaśūnyaśayanīyasañjātamohamīlallocanā sasambhramasakhīpravṛttipratipannamūrcchāvicchedasamayasaṅgalitadīrghaniḥśvāsasañjātajīvitāśā kiṃkartavyamūḍhaṃ prathamaprārthitaṃ nijajīvitāvasānaṃ durvāradaivadurvilasitopālambhamātravyāpāraṃ sakhījanaṃ karoti/ pratibodhakāle visarjitayā preṣitayā, priyadarśanāyetyarthāt, apāṅgadṛṣṭyā kaṭākṣadarśanena vijñātāt śūnyaśayanīyāt sañjātena, ``saviśeṣaṇe vidhiniṣedhau viśeṣaṇamupasaṃkrāmataḥ'' iti nyāyācchayanīyasya priyatamaśūnyatvaṃ jñātvetyarthaḥ/ mohena mūrcchayā, sendriyasya manaso duḥkhābhighātāt pralīnatayetyarthaḥ/ mīlallocanā mukulībhavannetrā/ ata eva sasambhramāṇāṃ sakhīsnehavyākulānāṃ sakhīnāṃ pravṛttyā himajalāvasekabījanasaṃvāhanādinā prayatnena, pratipannaḥ prāpto yo mūrcchāyā, vicchedaḥ praśamaḥ tatkāle saṅgalitena pravṛttena dīrghaniḥśvāsena sañjanitā utpāditā jīvite svasyāḥ prāṇasandhāraṇe āāśā śraddhā yayā/ sakhīnāmityarthāt/ niśceṣṭatayā pūrvamutpannasya mṛtatvabhramasya jīvanacihnena śvāsanirgameṇa[na] nirastatvāt/ [kiṃkartavyamūḍhaṃ] kiṃ kartavyamasmābhiriti apratipattivivaśam/ prathamaṃ mālatīprāṇāvasādāt pūrvaṃ nijaprāṇaviyogaḥ prārthito'bhilaṣito yena/ dussahaduḥkhadarśanaparihārāyetyarthaḥ/ tatra hetuḥ - durvārasya pratikartumaśakyasya daivadurvilasitasya vidhikartṛkasya duṣṭaceṣṭitasya, upālambho vigarhaṇaṃ, tanmātraṃ tadeva vyāpāraḥ prayatno yasyeti aparihāryatayā avaśyaṃbhāvinyarthe sākṣimātramapi mā bhūdasmākamiti bhāvaḥ/
atha vibhīṣikābhaṅgyā jhaṭiti sāhasakaraṇāya mālatīṃ protsāhayati - paśya bhagavati! eṣu tāvallāvaṇyabhūyiṣṭhanirmāṇaparipelaveṣvaṅgeṣu dāruṇaṃ vijṛmbhitasya kiyacciraṃ kuśalāvasānatā manmathasya/ paśyeti nirūpaya, bhagavatyā evāyaṃ bhāra iti dyotayati/ eṣvityabhinayena anukampanīyatāmāha/ tatra hetuḥ - lāvaṇyabhūyiṣṭhanirmāṇaparipelaveṣviti/ lāvaṇyabahutareṇa sargeṇa sarvato mradiṣṭheṣu bhūtāntarāṇi leśataḥ saṃmelyābahulaṃ teja evopādāya nirmitatvāt/ pārthivasya kāṭhinyasya vāyavyasya balasya cālpatvamiti bhāvaḥ/
``bhūyiṣṭhaṃ teja evādbhirbahulābhirmṛdūkṛtam/
cakṣurānandajananaṃ lāvaṇyamiti kathyate//'' iti divākaraḥ/ dāruṇaṃ kra[krū]rataraṃ yathā tathā/ vijṛmbhitasya svakāryasāmagrīprakāśanenodbhūtasyeti paripelavatvadāruṇatvayoḥ parasparavirodhāt sulabhāpāyatvaṃ dhvanyate/ kiyacciraṃ kiṃ parimāṇaṃ ciraṃ dīrghakālamatītyeti śeṣaḥ/ athavā ciraśabdasyāvyayatvāt kiyatā cireṇetyarthaḥ/ cirācirayoḥ pratiyogyapekṣatvāt kiyadgrahaṇam/ kuśalāvasānatā parasparasamāgamena kuśalaṃ maṅgalamavasānaṃ pariṇāmo yasya tasya bhāvaḥ/ atha ṛtuviśeṣarātriguṇairuddīpitatvācca madanasya durnivāravīryatvamāha - kathaṃ ca imāni ramaṇakelikalahakopoparāgapallavitakeralīkapolakomalodvelavimalacandracandrikoddāmadalitatimirāvaraṇāni vibhāvarīmukhāni/ imāni ime iti ca vasantasya vartamānatvāt praśritatvābhinayaḥ/ ramaṇaiḥ priyatamaiḥ saha yaḥ kelikalahaḥ krīḍākṛto gotraskhalanādimūlaḥ samaraḥ, tena yaḥ kopoparāgaḥ krodhāvalepaḥ, tataḥ pallavitaḥ sañjātapallava ityaruṇatvaṃ lakṣyate/ keralavaravarṇinīnāṃ suvarṇavarṇānāṃ kopoparāgamaṇḍitaiḥ smarāpāṇḍubhirgaṇḍamaṇḍalairakhaṇḍasāmyalābhādudayarāgarūṣitāyāścandrikāyāḥ keralīgrahaṇaṃ[m]/ vakṣyate ca ``gāḍhotkaṇṭhakaṭhorakeralavadhūgaṇḍāvapāṇḍucchadaiḥ'' ( la ṛ. 19.)
iti/ keralīkapolavat komalā sukumārasubhagā, udvelā maryādāmullaṅghaya vartamānā, sarvapathīnetyarthaḥ/ vimalasya himavyapāyāt prasannasya candrasya candrikayā uddāmadalitaḥ viśṛṅkhalaṃ nāśitaṃ, timirarūpamāvaraṇaṃ tirodhānaṃ yeṣāṃ tāni/ vibhāvarīmukhāni rātrīṇāmārambhāḥ/ kathaṃ nānarthakāriṇo bhavanti priyasakhyā iti uttaravākyagatena vipariṇataliṅgenānvayaḥ/ atra nāyakasya sakhyā jhaṭityapanītāvakuṇṭhananīlāṃśukāyā nāyikāyāḥ samādhiranusandheyaḥ/
ime collasitadugdharāśipūradhavalojjvalajjyotsnāprakṣālitanabhoṅkaṇaparimilitapāṭalabakulanirgacchadbahalaparimalotpīḍasakalasaṅkalanamāṃsalāyamānamasṛṇamalayamārutoddhūsaritadaśadiśāmukhā rajanīpariṇāmā nānarthakāriṇo bhavanti priyasakhyāḥ/ ullasitasya candrodayakṣubhitasya, dugdharāśeḥ kṣīrasāgarasya, pūraḥ pravāhaḥ, tadvaddhavalayojjvalayā ca jyotsnayā prakṣālite snapite/ nijasya nīlimno'tyantaparityāgena dhavalavarṇasvīkārāt snapita iveti dyotakaśūnyotprekṣā/ tasminnabhoṅkaṇe gaganājira iti gaganasyājirasyāśrayasya saṃkocaḥ kathyate/ parimilitasya sampiṇḍitasyetyāśritasya vaipulyaṃ prakāśyate/ grīṣmamantareṇa vasante'pi pāṭalapuṣpasambhavāt pāṭalagrahaṇam/ athavā madhuraparipūrṇatvāt pāṭalavarṇebhyo bakulebhyaḥ kesaratarukusumebhyo nirgacchato, bahalasya sāndrasya parimalotpīḍasya saurabhyasamūhasya, sakalena sampūrṇena saṅkalanena saṃśleṣeṇa māṃsalāyamānena pīvaraśarīreṇeva bhavatā, masṛṇena mandena, malayamārutena uddhūsaritāni kusumarajasā bhṛśaṃ dhūmalitāni vāsitāni vā, daśānāṃ diśāṃ mukhāni yeṣu/ anarthakāriṇaḥ prāṇaharaṇarūpavyasanahetavo, na kathaṃ bhavanti/ rajanīpariṇāmāḥ rātrīṇāṃ tṛtīyayāmarūpāḥ paripākāḥ/ mukhapariṇāmagrahaṇaṃ prathamayāme pravardhamānāyā arateḥ sakhīyatnāt kālaśaityācca kiñcinnidropalambhane dvitīyayāme'sahyatvāt paścāt jhaṭiti prabuddhāyāstṛtīyayāme punarudvelatvaṃ ca prakāśayati/ kathaṃ nānarthakāriṇo bhavantītyukteḥ tatropāyaḥ sapadi vicintyatāmiti prārthanāṃ sūcayati/
atha kāmandakī śrutatadvṛttāntā bhaṅgyā tadanurāgabandhaṃ sthirīkaroti yadītyādi/ yadīti pūrvamaparijñātatvamabhinīyoktiḥ/ tadviṣayaḥ mādhavamālambya pravṛttaḥ/ anurāgabandhaḥ anurāgātmako bandhaḥ bandhanaṃ, anurāgasya vā bandhaḥ dṛḍhībhāvaḥ/ ``sukhaduḥkhātmakaṃ bhogyaṃ sukhatvenābhimanyate/
yena rāgaḥ sa ityukto rañjanādviṣayātmanoḥ//''ṃ ``rāgo'nuvṛtto'vicchinnamanurāga udāhṛtaḥ/'' iti bhāvaprakāśaḥ/ sphuṭaṃ niścitam/ phalaṃ prayojanam/ guṇajñatāyāḥ kularūpaśīlamādhuryakalākauśalādiguṇaviśiṣṭapuruṣaviśeṣajñānasya/ etattadviṣayānurāgabandharūpam/ hi prasiddhau, sarvalokasammato'yamartha ityarthaḥ/ anyathā guṇaviśiṣṭaṃ ca jānāti anyasmiṃścānurajyata iti/ kena saṅgatamityunmattapakṣe vicakṣaṇairnikṣipyata iti bhāvaḥ/ iti anena hetunā/ nanditaṃ prahṛṣṭam/ apītyuktyā pitṛdeśīyāyā svasyā abhinandanena pitrādīnāmapyanabhinandanīyatvāt na tadviṣayāśaṅkā kartavyeti vyañjayati, guṇapakṣapātasya sarvajanaślākhya[gya]tvāt/ vidāryate vibhidyate/ dāruṇayetyatra hetuḥ, kālāntarākṣamatvād apāyaśaṅkājananenetyarthaḥ/ me hṛdayamiti nirvyājasnehanigalitatvaṃ prakāśyate/ atra pūrvārdhe'tiśayoktiruttarārdhe bhāvasandhiścālaṅkāraḥ/ yadyarthoktau kalpanāddharṣāvegayorbhāvayoḥ spardhībhāvena avasthānapratipādanācca//13//
sthāne yogye'vasare/ svajijñāsitasya tadabhiprāyasya sarvātmanā jñātatvāditi bhāvaḥ/ hiravadhāraṇe/ sthāne evetyarthaḥ/ ullāsaḥ harṣaḥ/ ullāsasyaivoktiḥ harṣasyaiva sātvikatvādāvegasya nāṭitatvācceti mantavyam/ hṛllāsa iti tu pāṭhe hṛllāso nāma hṛdrogaviśeṣaḥ/
``sapraseko hṛdayotkleśo hṛllāsaḥ/'' iti vaidyake lakṣitatvāt/ atra tu lakṣaṇayā hṛdayaduḥkhamucyate hṛdayaṃ vidāryata ityukteḥ/ atha tadavasthāśravaṇādāvijamāno'pāyaśaṅkī kathayati - aho iti acintitatvādvismayaḥ/ svāvasthayā evānubhavagocarasya pūrvamatidāruṇatvasambhāvanādidānīṃ tato'pi tadavasthāyā dāruṇatvamanusandhāyācintito'yamarthaḥ kathaṃ daivenopanipātita ityāścaryabuddhiṃ dyotayati/ pramādaḥ avadhāya pariharttavyo'narthaḥ/
pramādatvamevopapādayati - prakṛtilalitamityādi/ prakṛtyā svabhāvato, na punarveṣaviracanayā lalitaṃ sundaram/ etaditi purovartino'nubhavābhinayaḥ/ saukumāryaikasāraṃ mārdavamekameva sāro balaṃ sthirāṃśo vā yasya/ veṇūnāmiva tvak candanānāmiva gandhaḥ, yataste tvaksārā gandhasārā iti ca kathyante/ ayamiti puṃkhitaśarasya svasamīpe santatasannihitasya tasyānubhūyamānatvābhinayaḥ/ satyamityanubhavasiddhatvādasandigdhatvam/ cārucandrāvataṃsaḥ cāruḥ prasannaścandra evāvataṃsaḥ kundastabakādimayaḥ karṇapūro yasya/ ayamiti vartamānatvādvasantasya parāmarśaḥ/ apibhyāṃ dāruṇatvaṃ samuccīyate/ ayaṃ pañcabāṇo'pi dāruṇaḥ, ayaṃ kālo'pi dāruṇaḥ iti svahṛdayasaṃvādāt prakṛtilalitametadvapuḥ saukumāryaikasāram la etau ca dāruṇau la ataḥ sukumāradāruṇayoḥ śleṣasyātivaiṣamyāt, kathaṃ kaḥ prakāro bhaviṣyatīti śeṣaḥ/ atra cintākhyo bhāvo vyajyate/ viṣamaṃ cālaṅkāraḥ//14//
anyacca jñātaṃ bhavatu bhagavatyā/ uktādanyacca kiñcidvastu bhagavatyā jñātaṃ bhavatu/ ``matibuddhipūjārthebhyaśca'' (3-2-188) iti niṣṭhāyāṃ ``ktasya ca vartamāne'' (2. 3. 67.) iti kartari ṣaṣṭhī/ etanmādhavapraticchandasanāthaṃ citraphalakam/ etadityukteḥ sadā svahastadhṛtatvaṃ tasya prakāśyate/ stanāṃśukamapanīyeti trapācchāditāyāḥ bakulamālayāḥ prakāśanāya tirohitasya mādhavasya stanamukulapradarśanena nayanāhlādasāmrājyaṃ ca sampādayitumiti bhāvaḥ/ eṣāpi tasyaiva svahastaviraciteti kaṇṭhāvalambitā bakulamālā sañjīvanaṃ priyasakhyāḥ/ sañjīvanaṃ prāṇasandhāraṇasādhanam/
stanāṃśukāpanayanasya phalamāha - saspṛhamiti/ aho iyaṃ dhanyā nāmasmākamīdṛśaḥ sukṛtapariṇāma iti tasya janmani svayaṃ sāpekṣamityarthaḥ/
jitamityādi/ iha bhuvane na punarasmin pradeśe/ jitaṃ sarvamabhibhūya sthitamiti bhāve niṣṭhā/ asyāḥ mālatyāḥ/ sakhīti, na punarvatseti sakhītvasya putrītvādapi/ visrambhabhūmitvādavasare smārayitavyastvayāyaṃ jana iti prārthanā dyotyate/ vallabhā iṣṭatamā/ ata eva jātāsi saphalajanmāsi yadityarthaḥ/ anyathā ``asi''padaprayogāt ``jātā''śabdasyāpuṣṭārthatvaprasaṅgāt/ vallabhātvamevopapādayati - pariṇataṃ kiñcijjaraṭham, bisakāṇḍaṃ mṛṇāladaṇḍaḥ, tadvat pāṇḍvogagravarṇayormugdhayornavaprarūḍhatvādaprauḍhayoḥ stanayoḥ/ pariṇatabisagrahaṇaṃ campakadalavarṇayoḥ stanayoḥ prasaktasya smarapāṇḍimno'sphuṭatvāt kapilaśobhitvaṃ prakāśayitum ``bimbaṃ kaṭhorabisakāṇḍakaḍāragaurairviṣṇoḥ padaṃ prathamamagrakarairvyanakti/'' ityuktatvāt/ pariṇāho vistārastasya vilāsaḥ śobhā tadarthā vaijayantī tribhuvanavijayenotthāpitadhvajapatākā, bhūtveti śeṣaḥ/ atrācetane vastuni cetanavadabhimukhīkṛtya sambhāṣaṇānupapatteḥ vācyasyāsambhave'pi prakṛte tātparyeṇāropapratītervaidharmyeṇāyamaprastutapraśaṃsālaṅkāraḥ/ asmābhistu na jitamiti vaidharmyeṇa prastutapratīteranumānaṃ ca/ sādhyasādhananirdeśādvaijayantītyatra rūpakaṃ ca/ ``tadāsyatāṃ kiñcidākhyeya''mityārabhya ``vilāsavaijayantī''tyantena uttarottarakathanāt pragamaḥ/
athaivaṃ dūtīmukhena prakaṭitaparasparānurāgayornāyakayoranyonyasya darśanāya patākānāyakasya makarandasya madayantikādarśanāya copāyabhūtaṃ śārdūlāvaskandarūpaṃ vyasanamupakṣipati/ guṇānuraktāyā eva prāṇasaṃśaye nāyakena paritrātāyāḥ kṛtajñatayāpi tasminnanurāgadārḍhyasyāvaśyaṃbhāvāt madayantikāmakarandayoranurāgadārḍhyāya śārdūlavṛttānto'dhunā kathyate/ mālatīmādhavayostu kāpālikavṛttānto vakṣyate/ evaṃ kṛtaparasparaparigrahayośca dūtīpratyayāt samāgamaḥ/ sa tu ``devatābhigamane yātrāyāmudyānagamane krīḍāyāṃ jalāvataraṇe vivāhe yajñe vyasanotsaveṣvagnyutpāte coravibhrame janapadasya cakrāropaṇe prekṣāvyāpāre teṣu teṣu kāryeṣviti bābhravīyā'' iti vātsyāyanavacanāt/
kalakalaḥ kolāhalaḥ/ avijñāyamānabhedo bahūnāṃ mahīyān dhvanirityarthaḥ/ ākarṇayanti samantāt tadābhimukhyena karṇān kurvanti, avadhānena śṛṇvantītyarthaḥ/ ``prātipadikād dhātvarthe'' (ga.) iti ṇic//15//
are are ityādi/ are are śaṅkarapuravāsino janapadāḥ/ eṣa khalu yauvanārambhabharitadurviṣahāmarṣaroṣavyatikarabalātkāravighaṭitottruṭitalohapañjarapratibhaṅgasaṅgalito līlāvilāsodvelladvallabhatuṅgalāṅgūlavikaṭavaijayantikaviṣamaḍāmaraśarīrasanniveśo maṭhādavakramya tatkṣaṇasatṛṣṇakabalatiānekadehidehāvayavamadhyasthitaṃ niṣṭhurāsthikhaṇḍanaṭaṅkārakaṭakaṭāyamānakarapatrakaṭhinadaṃṣṭrākarālamukhakandaraḥ prakaṭavijṛmbhaṇoddāmadāruṇacapeṭabalātkārapramathitānekaturaṅgajāṅgalāvagārabharitagalaguhāgarbhagambhīragalgadollasitaralliṅgallaraṇaśabdasandarbhapūritanabhobhāgo bhīṣitanaṣṭavidrāvitāśeṣajananivahaḥ kaṭhoranakharakarparavajranirdayakṛṣṭakaṭakatvaritajantugātrāparoparyuttaradraktakardamitagatipatho duṣṭaśārdūlaḥ kṛtāntalīlāyitaṃ karoti/ tat parirakṣata yathāśaktyātmanāṃ jīvitamiti/ are are iti ābhimukhyakaraṇadyotakamavyayam/ vīpsayā sambhramo dyotyate/ janapadāḥ janāḥ/ ``deśe jane janapada'' iti vaijayantī/ bālya eva pūrvaṃ pañjare niruddhatvādidānīṃ yauvanasyārambheṇa pūrṇo durviṣaho manasyamānamarṣo bandhanayantraṇākṣamā, tena yo roṣo roddhṛjanasyopari jighāṃsayā krodhaḥ, tatsambandhena balātkāro haṭhapravṛttiḥ/ svato balinaḥ krodhe sati dviguṇabalatvamiti bhāvaḥ/
``prāyaḥ svaṃ mahimānaṃ kopāt pratipadyate hi janaḥ/'' iti śākuntalokteḥ/ tena vighaṭitasya viśleṣitasandhibandhasyāta evottruṭitasya svayaṃ khaṇḍitāvayavasya lohapañjarasyāyomayabandhanayantrasya, pratibhaṅgena pratyaṅgasammardanena saṅgalitaḥ nirbādhaṃ niṣkrāntaḥ/ līlāvilāsena krīḍāprayuktena sañcaraṇenodvellat ūrdhvaṃ calat vallabhamiṣṭatamaṃ tuṅgaṃ svata unnataṃ lāṅgūlaṃ bāladhireva vikaṭā vistṛtā vaijayantikā dhvajapaṭī/ dūrata eva taralonnatatvena dṛśyamānatvāt tayā viṣamaḥ nimnonnataḥ ḍāmaraḥ bhīṣaṇaśca śarīrasanniveśo dehasaṃsthānaṃ yasya/ maṭhāddevālayasamīpagatacchātrādinivāsasthānāt pañjarāvasthānasthalāt/ ``maṭhaḥcchā[maṭhaśchā]trādinilayaḥ'' ityamaraḥ/ avakramya utplutya, tatkṣaṇa evāpakramasamanantarameva satṛṣṇaṃ cirakālaprārthitatvāt sāgrahaṃ yathā tathā kabalitānāṃ bhakṣitānāṃ anekeṣāṃ dehināṃ dehāvayavā mūrdhādyaṅgāni, tanmadhyasthitānāṃ niṣṭhurāṇāṃ kaṭhinānāmasthnāṃ kapālādīnāṃ khaṇḍane carvaṇe yaṣṭaṅkāraḥ kaṭhinadravyakhaṇḍanaśabdānukāraḥ/
``dordaṇḍāñcitacandraśekharadhanurdaṇḍāvabhaṃgodyataṣṭaṅkāradhvanirāryabālacaritaprastāvanāḍiṇḍimaḥ/'' iti mahāvīracaritokteḥ/ tena kaṭakaṭāyamānābhiḥ parasparābhighaṭṭanāt kaṭakaṭetiśabdān kurvāṇābhiḥ/
``nipīḍya pāṇinā pāṇiṃ dantān kaṭakaṭāpya ca/'' iti rāmāyaṇokteḥ/ karapatraṃ krakacastadvat karkaśābhiḥ daṃṣṭrābhiḥ mahadbhiḥ daśanaiḥ karālā vikṛtā mukharūpā kandarā giridarī yasya/ prakaṭena spaṣṭena vijṛmbhaṇena vitatīkaraṇena uddāmadāruṇena atyarthaṃ krūreṇa, anyadā kośanikṣiptanakharasya pāṇipādasya saṅkocāt, capeṭasya hastatalatāḍanasya balātkāreṇa/
``pāṇau capeṭapratalaprahastā vistṛtāṅgulau'' ityamaraḥ/ pramathitānāmanekeṣāṃ turaṅgāṇāmaśvānāṃ jāṅgalasya māṃsasya avagāreṇa bhakṣaṇena/ avapūrvād giraterghañi rūpam/ ``ādavāpayoḥ'' (prā. pra. 4. 110) ityokāraḥ/ bharite pūrite/ galaguhāgarbhe kaṇṭhabilakuhare gambhīreṇa garīyasā gadgadena ullasitena ralligallūraṇaśabdasandarbheṇa vyāghrādīnāṃ harṣotkarṣahetukaṃ garjitaṃ ralligallūraṇam/ deśīśabdaścāyam/ sandarbhaḥ grathanaṃ uparyupari pravṛttirityarthaḥ/ pūrito nabhobhāgo yena/ bhīṣitāḥ trāsitā ata eva naṣṭā adarśanaṃ gamitā latākuñjādiṣu tirohitā ityarthaḥ/ vidrāvitā diganteṣu vidhāvitāśca jananivahā yena/ kaṭhorairnakharakarpararūpairnakhakapālātmakairvajrairnirdayakṛṣṭānāṃ pṛṣṭhato'nusṛtyetyarthāt/ ``ṇahakaḍambe''ti vā pāṭhaḥ/ nakhasamūhenetyarthaḥ/ ``uraphpha iti vajrasya deśīsaṃjñā/ kaṭakatvaritānāṃ puraṃ praveṣṭuṃ dhāvatāṃ jantūnāṃ, gātrāparopari gātrasya śarīrasyāparaḥ pṛṣṭhabhāgaḥ ākarṣaṇenādhomukhāpātitvāt tasyopari ūrdhvabhāge, uttaratā utplavamānena raktena rudhireṇa kardamitaḥ paṅkilo gatipatho yasyeti/ gatipatha ityanena yato yato gamyate sa sa panthāstatheti vyajyate/ śārdūlaśabdenaiva gatārthatve'pi duṣṭaśabdasya prayogo bhītajanavacanatvādaduṣṭaḥ/ kṛtāntasya yamasya līlaiva līlāyitaṃ, tatkaroti/ sarvajantusaṃhārasaṃrambhādityarthaḥ/
atra ca kabalitāneketi pramathitānekaturaṅgeti bhīṣitanaṣṭavidrāviteti nirdayakṛṣṭakaṭakatvaritajantugātreti ca paunaruktyaṃ nāśaṅkanīyam/ tatra tatra phalaikye'pi vidhvaṃsanaprakārabhedapratipādanasya camatkārakāritvādatra raudraraso dhvanyate/ ārabhaṭī ca vṛttiranusandheyā/ evamanyatrāpīdṛśe sthale/ ``.... .... .... ārabhaṭī punaḥṣṭarase raudre sabībhatse'' iti vacanāt/ [tat] tasmāt parirakṣata/ yathāśakti svaṃ svaṃ sāmarthyamanatikramya/ garbhagṛhapraveśavṛkṣārohaṇadūradhāvanādibhirityarthaḥ/ ātmanāṃ sveṣāṃ jīvitaṃ prāṇānityavaśyarakṣaṇīyatvamāha/
sambhrāntā keśasraṃsanottarīyaskhalanādibhirmanaḥkṣobhaṃ prakāśayantītyarthaḥ/ paritrāyadhvaṃ paritrāyadhvaṃ rakṣata rakṣateti vīpsayā tvarāṃ dyotayati/ aviśeṣeṇoktiḥ yaḥ kaścit samarthastaṃ prati prārthanāṃ vyañjayati/ kuta ityāha - eṣā naḥ priyasakhī amātyanandanasya bhaginī madayantikā etena duṣṭaśārdūlena hatavidrāvitaparijanā abhidrāvyate/ eṣeti sāmīpyāt surakṣatvaṃ, naḥ priyasakhīti bahvīnāṃ strīṇāmanugrahaḥ/ amātyanandanasya svaseti mahate pratyupakārāya paryāpteti dhvanyate/ keciddhatā kecidvidrāvitāścānucarā yasyāḥ sā/ hatavidrāvitaparijaneti rakṣakāntarābhāvādāpadi vartamānāyā rakṣaṇaṃ prati samīcīno'yamavasara iti khyāpyate/ abhidrāvyate svoddeśenānugamyate/
aho pramādaḥ acintito'narthaḥ/
utthāya raktāśokagahanānniṣkramya prakāśībhūyetyarthaḥ/ vīratvāddayālutvācca rahasyabhedamapi kṛtavāniti dyotayati/ kvāsau kvāsau kasmin deśe madayantikā/ vīpsayā rakṣaṇatvarāṃ sūcayati/
saharṣaṃ priyatamasya ciramanorathabhatāddarśanāt sapramodam/ sasādhvasamatarkitopanatatvāt strīsvabhāvācca/ sāttvikavikārācca sotkampam/ ammahe ityāścaryadyotakamavyayam/ eṣo'pyatraiveti svasallāpaśravaṇaśaṅkayā lajjāṃ dyotayati/ vayamivāyamapyasminneva kiṃ sthita ityarthaḥ/
śaṅkarapurodyānakuñjatirohitasya mālatīvacanaśravaṇāt jhaṭityanyonyadarśanācca samādhānaṃ bījasya prakāśanāt/ hanteti harṣe/ atarkitopanatena acintitaprāptena maddarśanena/ ullasitayā prahṛṣṭayā anayā mālatyā/ ṣṭakabalita ivetyādi/ sphāritena praharṣavistāritena ata eva sitabhāgaprabhābāhalyānnimagnakanīnikānīlimatvaṃ cakṣuṣaḥ prakāśyate/ kṛtsnaḥ kabalita iva sākalyena nigīrṇa ivetyanena tasyā darśanāgrahaḥ, prabhāpaṭalāvacchāditatvaṃ cātmanaḥ pratīyate/ snigdhākhyaṃ caitad vīkṣitam/
``snigdhaṃ tadyasya viṣayastatprabhāmilito bhavet/'' iti vacanāt/ ``asnapayādiva dhavalitadaśadiśā dṛśa'' iti harṣacaritoktavat/ tataścotprekṣate/ prasabhaṃ jhaṭityevācintitamityarthaḥ/ sāndreṇa nīrandhreṇa amṛtameghena amṛtavarṣaṇaśīlo megho amṛtameghaḥ, tena/ śākapārthivāditvāt samāsaḥ/ ``kāraṇaguṇaprakrameṇa kāryuguṇārambhaḥ'' iti nyāyāt tasya dhavalavaṇagcityāt tadgrahaṇam/
śubhrairabhrairadabhrairupariparicitairmuktapīyūṣavarṣaiḥ'' iti teṣāmāgamaprasiddheḥ/ siktaḥ abhivṛṣṭaḥ/ arthādamṛteneti sidhyati/ aviralaṃ sarvāṅgīṇam/ pauṇḍarīkeṇa dāmnā dhavalakamalasaṃbandhinyā mālayā/ naddhaḥ baddha iva/ dugdhasrotasā kṣīrābdhipravāheṇa nirbhareṇa udvelena snapitaḥ kṣālita iveti/ atra sakalasantāpaharatvaṃ bahalaprabhāvatvaṃ svacchamadhuraprasaraṇaṃ ca darśanasyotprekṣātrayeṇa kramādvyajyate/ yasmādevaṃ tasmātpuṇyavānasmi/ anyathaivaṃvidhasya priyādarśanasya prāptyasambhavāditi bhāvaḥ/ asya ślokasya pūrvottarārdhayoḥ pāṭhavyatyāsaḥ prāmādikaḥ/ ``yadahamatarkite''tyādi vākyaśeṣasyāsambandhādutprekṣānimittakathanapurassaramevotprekṣaṇasyaucityāt/ anyathā tasyākasmikatvaprasaṅgānmadhyavartino hetoḥ purato'nukarṣaṇasyāsāmañjasyāt/ snapita iva ceti cakārasya sarvavākyārthasamuccāyinaścaramavākya eva kavinā tathā pāṭhacihnatvena prayuktatvād vākyāntare tvaprayogācca//16//
``hanta puṇyavāni''tyādeḥ svagatameva mananāt prakāśameva ``kvāsau'' iti pūrvoktasya buddharakṣitottaramāha- mahābhāga udyānabāhyarathyāmukhe kusumākarodyānād bahirvartinyā rathyāyāḥ prārambhasthale/
ahaheti raudrasya rasasyānusandhābhinayaḥ na tu bībhatsasya, prācaṇḍyamiti paryāyeṇa raudrasyaiva pratipādanāt/
saṃsakteti-saṃsaktaiḥ prathamaṃ caraṇalagnairathākarṣaṇe truṭitaiḥ khaṇḍitaiḥ, vivartitaiḥ itastato vikṣiptaiśca āntrajālaiḥ purītallatāsamūhaiḥ, vyākīrṇāḥ saṅkulitāḥ sphuranto'lpāvaśiṣṭaprāṇatayā luṭhantaḥ, apavṛttā adhobhūtavakṣasoruṇḍāḥ śirorahitāḥ kāyāsteṣāṃ khaṇḍāḥ śirāadiśakalā yasmin/ ``ruṇḍo'śirāḥ kabandho'strī'' iti vaijayantī/ kīlālasya rudhirasya vyatikareṇa sambandhena gulphadaghnaḥ gulphapramāṇaḥ kardamo yasmin/ ``pramāṇe dvayasajdaghnañmātracaḥ'' (5-2-37)/ ``kīlālo rudhire toye'' iti vaijayantī/ gulphaḥ pādajaṅghāsthisandhyasthi/ prācaṇḍyaṃ prakṛṣṭaṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ bhāvam/ nakhāyudhasya nakhāḥ karajā eva praharaṇāni yasyetyayutasiddhakaraṇatayā nirargalasāhasarasikatvaṃ tasya svayaṃ vīratayā camatkaroti/ mārgaḥ na tu rathyetyanena yato dhāvati tatastatastathāvidhatvaṃ saraṇerdyotyate/ atra raudraraso vyaṅgyaḥ/ bhāvikamalaṅkāraḥ//17//
atha puro'valokya sānuśayamāha - vayamityādi/ vayamityātmani bahuvacanam/ athavā svapārśvavartinām upasaṅgrahaṇārtham/ bateti khede/ rakṣaṇākṣamatvādātmano dainyaṃ vyañjayati/ tatra hetumāha - vidūrataḥ viprakṛṣṭataḥ dūradeśe vartāmahe iti śeṣaḥ/ sāmarthye satyapi dūrato'nupakārakatvamiti bhāvaḥ/ kramagatā kramaḥ kramaṇaṃ padavikṣepaḥ taṃ gatā prāptā ekotplavanaprāpyetyarthaḥ/ paśoḥ paśavo vai dvipādaścatuṣpādaśca'' iti vacanācca catuṣpāttvādvyāghraḥ paśurityucyate, tasya/ kanyaketi strītvāt maugdhyācca tasyā atibhīrutvaṃ dayāviṣayatvaṃ cāha/ paśoḥ kanyaketyanenātyantanīrasaḥ sakalajanādaraṇīyāṃ prati kiṃ kiṃ kariṣyatīti karuṇaraso vyajyate/
sarvāḥ mālatyādayaḥ/ hā madayantike/ heti viṣādavyañjakamavyayam/ dhikkaṣṭamityarthaḥ/ madayantike iti nāmagrāhaṃ krandanaṃ prakāśyate/ ``hā tāteti krandita''mitivat/ viṣādo'tra bhāvaḥ pratīyate/
saharṣākūtaṃ harṣeṇākūtena ca sahitam/ tadrakṣaṇopāyalābhena harṣaḥ, tatpremāspadasya makarandasyaiva daivenopanītatvādabhiprāyaḥ/
kathamityacintito'yamarthaḥ kena prakāreṇa saṃvihita ityāścaryaṃ dyotayati/ tadavapātitāt tena vyāghreṇa māritāt/ lokato janāt/ adhigatāyudhaḥ prāptakhaḍga ityanāyāsena sādhanamapi sampannamiti vyajyate/ kuto'pi kasmādapi deśāt kāraṇādvā/ kuto'pītyuktirdeśakāraṇayoḥ pūrvamanirūpaṇāt/
``kenāpi kāmena tapaścapāra'' itivat/ etyāgatya/ sahasaiva yāvanna kramate tāvadeva/ madhye sthita ityāścarya hetuḥ/
sādhu mahābhāga sādhviti samayopanipātāt paramopakāriṇo makarandasya camatkāraḥ/ atra harṣo dhvanyate/
dṛḍhaṃ gāḍam/ āhataścapeṭena vakṣasi tāḍitaḥ/ vyasuḥ vigataprāṇaḥ/ asau paśuḥ/ amunā makarandena/ dṛḍhaṃ paśunāhata iti sauhārdāt jīviṣyati na veti cintāṃ dyotyate/ vyasuḥ kṛta iti harṣaḥ/ cakārābhyāṃ tulyakālatvamāhananavyasūkaraṇayoḥ khyāpyate/ vīrarasaścobhayoḥ prakāśyate/ atra ślokasya khaṇḍaśaḥ pāṭho madhye madhye vaktrantaravākyānupraveśaśca abhineyārthatvāt prabandhasya, rasabhāvavaividhyanibandhanatvāccābhinayasyeti mantavyam/ atra madayantikānurāgarakṣaṇayoḥ kāryayoḥ kāraṇabhūtamakarandavṛttāntenāprastutena sūcanādaprastutapraśaṃsā cālaṅkāraḥ//18//
atyāhitaṃ mahatyāpat/ asmākamāpatitamiti śeṣaḥ/ śaṅkātra vyajyate/
sākūtamiti jīvitasaṃśayāśaṅkayā viśiṣṭamityarthaḥ/ vyālanakharaprahāraḥ duṣṭamṛganakhaprahārasthānam/ tato'tikṣaritarudhirasaṅghātaḥ/ kṣititalaviṣaktā adho'graṃ nihitā khaḍgalataivāvaṣṭambhaḥ ādhāraḥ tena niścalo bhuvi apatata[t]/ sambhrāntayā viṣādavyākulayā madayantikayā dhāritaḥ/ tāmyati mohana glāyati/
gāḍhaprahāratayā klāmyati mahābhāgaḥ/
pramugdhaḥ mūcrXchitaḥ/ eveti śaṅkitameva vastu kimāpatitamiti viṣādo vyajyate/ pratikārāntaramapaśyannāha - paritrāyasva māmiti/ tasya svāvyatirekāt paritrāṇaṃ svaparitrāṇameveti bhāvaḥ/
tamāśvāsayati - atikātaro'si/ suhṛnmaraṇaśaṅkayā tasya mohamātre atyarthaṃ kiṃ bhīrurbhavasi/ kā tvāmevaṃ bhūstasyedānīmeva pratyāpatsyamānatvāditi dyotyate/ tatra hetuḥ - nanuścodye/ mama tu darśane nirṇayo bhaviṣyati/ na punardūrastha ityarthaḥ/ tadāha - ehi āgaccha/ paśyāmastāvat/ tamiti śeṣaḥ/ darśanānantarameva sarvātmanā jīvayiṣyāmīti bhaṅgyā svasāmarthyaṃ samānasnehatvaṃ ca vyanakti/ atra paritrāyasva māmiti, na punarenamiti, upari ca ``pramugdhau makarandamādhavau'' ``ityādibhiḥ sauhārdahṛdyāni viceṣṭitāni'' iti pratijñātasya pratipādanaṃ kavikulacakravartinā nirvartitaṃ veditavyamityaśeṣamatimaṅgalam/
mālatīmādhavasyetthaṃ tṛtīyāṅkārthacarcanam/
pūrṇajyotiḥprasādena cakre pūrṇasarasvatī// //tṛtīyo'ṅkaḥ//
atha caturtho'ṅkaḥ/
atha pūrvāṅkapraviṣṭaireva kāmandakyādipātraiḥ sūcitasya madayantikāvalambitasya makarandasya tatsnehamohitasya ca mādhavasya kāmandakyādīnāṃ ca praveśaṃ pratipādayan praveśaviṣkambhādivarjamavibhāgena caturthamaṅkamavatārayati/ ``aṅkāvatārastvaṅkānte pāto'ṅkasya vibhāgataḥ/'' iti dhanikokteḥ/ tataḥ praviśata iti/ madayantikāmālatībhyāmavalambitāviti yathāsaṃkhyaṃ madayantikayā makarando mālatyā ca mādhavo'vadhāritāvityarthaḥ/ pramugdhau śārdaūlaprahāreṇa mūrchitaḥ ekaḥ, suhṛtsnehena cānyaḥ/ sambhrāntāstayorvyasanena vyākulāḥ/ kāmandakīlavaṅgikābuddharakṣitā iti dvandvaḥ/ cakāraḥ praviśantītyanukarṣaṇārthaḥ/
prasīda bhagavatī paritrāyasva paritrāyasva madayantikānimittaṃ saṃśayitajīvitaṃ vipannānukampinaṃ mahābhāgaṃ[paritrāyasva] anugrahaṃ kuru/ madayantikānimittaṃ matprāṇatrāṇahetoḥ/ madayantikānimittaṃ na punarmannimittamityuktiḥ arthāntarasaṃkramitavācyena madayantikāśabdena svasyā adhanyatvāttādṛśasya puruṣaratnasyāpyāpat sambhāvyata iti tasyājīvane svajīvanamapi niṣprayojanamiti śaṅkā nirvedaśca prakāśyate/ anena ca vyasanasamāgamarūpaśāstrārthānuṣṭhānayojanena kṛtajñatayāpyanurāgadārḍhyaṃ saṃjātamiti dyotyate/ saṃśayitajīvitamiti na vraṇitatvamātram api tu prāṇā eva madarthe jihāsitā iti duṣkaraparamopakārakaraṇaṃ vyajyate/ vipannānukampinaṃ vipannān vipadaṃ prāptānanukampituṃ dayituṃ śīlamasyeti prāktanaṃ paricayamupakāraṃ vā kamapyanapekṣya tasya vṛttiḥ prakāśyate/ tatra hetuḥ - mahābhāgamiti/ puṇyaśālināmiyameva śailī/ jīmūtavāhanādiṣu tathā darśanāditi bhāvaḥ/
itarāḥ lavaṅgikā buddharakṣitā mālatī ca/ hā dhik hā dhik/ heti viṣādadyotakamavyayam/ dhigiti nindādyotakam/ acintitaṃ kaṣṭamidaṃ kathamāpatitamityarthaḥ/ kimidānīṃ atra prekṣitavyaṃmasmābhiḥ/ atra vyasane/ asmābhirbhāgyahīnābhiḥ/ idānīmasmin kṣaṇe/ prekṣitavyaṃ kiṃ kiṃ vastu drakṣyate/ mohāvasthā tāvad anubhūtā, kimanayormaraṇe'pi sākṣitvamanubhaviṣyata ityarthaḥ/ śaṅkā cātra vyaṅgyā/
kamaṇḍalūdakena kuṇḍikājalenetyanena mantrapūtatvādanekatīrthopahṛtatvācca tasya mahāprabhāvatvaṃ dyotyate/ nanuścodye/ vṛthā viṣādaṃ mā kṛḍhvam, kimanena prayojanamityarthaḥ/ he bhavatyaḥ/ paṭāñcalairuttarīyavastradaśābhiriti teṣāṃ sānnidhyena saukaryāttadgrahaṇam/
mālatyādayaḥ ādiśabdena madayantikālavaṅgikābuddharakṣitā gṛhyante/ tathā yathādiṣṭam/ tathā kurvanti vījayantītyarthaḥ/
samāśvasya cetanāṃ labdhvā/ avalokya pūrvaṃ mohamīlite nayane unmīlya nirīkṣyetyarthaḥ/ atikātara snehenātimṛduhṛdaya/ kimetat adyāpyapratibodharūpametadvastu kimayuktamityarthaḥ/ kiṃśabdaḥ kṣepe/ nanu saṃvāde/ svasthaḥ svabhāvesthitaḥ/ eveti vraṇavedanāyā vāsanāpi na vidyata iti bhagavatīprabhāvacamatkāraḥ/
ahmahe iti harṣāścaryadyotakamavyayam/ pratibuddhaṃ tāvat makarandapūrṇacandreṇa/ nayanahṛdayāhlādajanakatvāt pūrṇacandreṇeva makarandena pratibuddham/ bhāve niṣṭhā/ pratibodhaḥ prāpta ityarthaḥ/ tāvacchabdaḥ prāthamye/ ayaṃ tāvat prabuddhaḥ/ no śaṅkitavyasanopanipātaḥ/ etanmohamūlatvāt mādhavamohasya, nimittābhāvāt naimittikasyāpyabhāvaḥ iti bhāvaḥ/
lalāṭa iti - hṛdayābhighāte jhaṭiti śirovedanāsaṃbhavāt tadapanodāya śiro niṣpīḍyetyarthaḥ/ diṣṭyā vardhase/ nanu bhaṇāmi pratipannacetano mahābhāga iti/ [pratipannacetanaḥ] pratipannā prāptā cetanā jñaptiryena/ ``prekṣopalabdhiścitsaṃvitpratipatjñapticetanāḥ'' ityamaraḥ/ mahābhāgo[ga] makaranda/ iti nanu vadāmi tathāpi na śṛṇoṣītyarthaḥ/
taddhastasparśavacanāmṛtayoḥ phalamāha - āśvasyeti/ sāhasika avicāritakārinniti/ madvyasane asau na jīviṣyati, tataścāsmadīyo janaḥ sarvo'pi vinaṅkṣyatīti nanu tvayā vicāraṇīyamiti dyotayati/
āliṅgatīti/ mṛtsyeva punarāgamānmohāvasthayā kṣaṇamadṛṣṭatvācca santaptasya śarīrasya nirvāpaṇāya dṛḍhataramāśliṣyatītyarthaḥ/
ubhau mādhavamakarandau/ śirasyāghrāya ``api varṣaśatāyustvaṃ bāla eva mato'si me'' iti nyāyāt putrasnehaparavaśatayā śiśuvat mūrdhni cumbitvetyarthaḥ/ jīvadvatsāsmi jīvantau prāṇavantau vatsau putrau yasyāḥ sāsmi/
priyaṃ naḥ saṃvṛttam/
sarve kāmandakyādayaḥ saṃbhūya/ harṣaṃ nāṭayanti romāñcānandabāṣpādīn harṣānubhāvānabhinayantītyarthaḥ/
janāntikam anyairaśrutam/ sakhi madayantike! eṣa eva saḥ, madvacanād yaste niratiśayaparokṣānurāgabhūmiḥ/ anena ``tāsu tāsu vīsaṃbhakahāsu'' ityādyuktimanusmārayati/ sa eṣaḥ/ evakāreṇa yaḥ prāṇadānamapi kṛtavāniti dyotayati/ skandakandarpādisadṛśāvityāditvannirdiṣṭalakṣaṇaviśiṣṭatayā hṛdayena sadānusandhīyamānayordarśanamātreṇopamānapramāṇāt pratyabhijñā/
mama tvadvacanātpūrvameva jñātetyāha - sakhi! jñātameva mayā yathā eṣa mādhavaḥ, ayamapi sa jana iti/ lajjayā svapremaviṣayasya nāmānuktiḥ/ iti yathā tathā jñātamevetyanvayaḥ/
svasya prāmāṇyaṃ tanmukhena sthāpayituṃ saparihāsaṃ pṛcchati - api satyavādinī aham ṛ apiḥ praśne/ etadrūpaśauryādivarṇanamukharatvaṃ mama kiṃ mṛṣodyannavetyarthaḥ/
vyatirekabhaṅkyā tasyā āptatvābhyupagamaṃ prakāśayati - nahyanyādṛśeṣu yuṣmādṛśyaḥ pakṣapātinyo bhavanti/ yuṣmādṛśyaḥ yuṣmattulyā iti liṅginītvāt nispṛhatayā guṇaikapakṣapātinītvaṃ prakāśyate/
``vītaspṛhāṇāmapi muktibhājāṃ bhavanti bhāveṣu hi pakṣapātaḥ/'' ityukteḥ/ anyādṛśeṣu evaṃguṇaviśiṣṭādasmādanyayathābhūteṣu guṇaśūnyeṣvityarthaḥ/ pakṣapātaḥ svatvabuddhyā tadadhīnatvaṃ, tacchīlāḥ pakṣapātinyaḥ/ sakhi! mālatyā apyasmin ramaṇīyaḥ khalvanurāgapravādaḥ/ asminniti purovartino guṇasāmagryābhinayaḥ/ anurāgapravādaḥ anurāgo mahāniti lokavārtā/ guṇaviṣayo doṣaviṣayo'pi lokapravādo bhavati/ ayaṃ tu guṇaviṣaya eva abhinavayauvanādiviśiṣṭe puruṣaratne diṣṭyā mālatyā anurāgabandha ityevaṃrūpatvād ityarthaḥ/ apiśabdena na kevalaṃ mama makaranda iti samuccīyate/ mālatyā apyasminnanurāgapravāda ityanena ``anurāgapravādastu vatsayoḥ sārvalaukika'' iti svābhilaṣitarājanandanapratāraṇopāyasya kāmandakīcintitasya nandanabhaginyāpi jñātatvāt sampannatvaṃ prakāśyate/
iti evamuktvā/ makarandameveti svapremāspadatvāt tameva/ sasnehaṃ paśyati darśanenaivāntargataṃ snehaṃ prakāśayatītyarthaḥ/
kāmandakīmukhena svasaṃvihitaṃ śāstrārthaṃ camatkurvannanusmārayati kaviḥ - ramaṇīyorjitaṃ ramaṇīyamanyonyānurāgajanakatvācchobhanam, ūrjitam utsāhasāreṇa vīreṇa paribṛṃhitarasatvādujjvalaṃ ca/ netarajanavat kṣodiṣṭhakusumopahārādyupārjitatvād grāmyamityarthaḥ/ ``ūrjāvutsāhakārtikau'' iti vaijayantī/ ``utsāhavardhano vīraḥ'' iti bharate, ``yadyadvibhūtimatsattvaṃ śrīmadūrjitameva vā/'' iti bhagavadvacanācca/ daivādacintitamevetyarthaḥ/ kathaṃ punariti - punaḥśabdo vyāvṛttau/ idamanyadavaśyaṃ śrotavyamityarthaḥ/ asminnavasara iti mṛtyumukhapraveśakāle/ bhagavatā daiveneti acintyamahimatvādīśvarasya kinnāma durghaṭamiti dyotyate/ iha asmin deśe/ tvam/ sannidhāpitaḥ sannihitaḥ kṛtaḥ/
antarnagare nagarasyāntaḥ, madhye ityarthaḥ/ antargṛha itivat/ evetyatrāgamanasyācintitatvaṃ prakāśayati/ kāñciditi tasya cittakhedaparihārāya viśeṣānākhyānaṃ lokataḥ śanaiḥ śroṣyatīti/ adhikamiti abhilāṣamūlasya tasya pūrvamevānuvṛtteridānīṃ cittodvegasyādhikyamāśaṅkamāna ityarthaḥ/ itomukhamāgamanasya hetumāha - avalokitāniveditakusumākarodyānavṛttāntaḥ avalokitayā jñāpitaḥ kusumākarodyāne yo vṛttāntaḥ ``ajja kasaṇacaüddasi tti'' ityādisūcito mālatīmādhavagamanarūpo yasya saḥ/ tvaritataramiti sapadi savidhagatatve samāśvāsanasya śakyatvādatiśīghramityarthaḥ/ parāpatan āgacchan/ evakāreṇa yādṛcchikatvād daivasaṅghaṭitatvaṃ dyotyate/ śārdūlāvaskandagocaraṃ vyāghrāvapātasya viṣayabhūtāmiti mahāvyasanamagnatvaṃ, abhijātakanyakāmiti rūpaveṣavinayādibhirmahati kule jātā kumārī cetyanumitāmiti dayanīyatvaṃ anabhisandhipūrvakatvaṃ ca tatpūrvadṛṣṭatvāt svaprayatnasya vyañjayati/ gocaraṃ kanyakāmiti niyataliṅgatvāt sāmānādhikaraṇyam/ abhyavapannavān anugṛhītavān/
vimṛśataḥ kāñciditi chāditā kāsau vārteti nirūpayata ityarthaḥ/
tāṃ vārtāṃ vaidagdhyāt kāmandakīmukhena prakāśayati kaviḥ/ svagatam/ vṛttena niṣpannena, ``vṛttassa nau saṅgatayorvanānte'' itivat/ bhavitavyamiti makarandasya vacanādanumīyamānatvaṃ vyañjayati/ pūrvamevāmātyena sahaivaṃ kartavyamiti svayaṃkṛtasaṅketatvāt tayorvimarśanaṃ jñātvā vaimanasyaparihārāyāha - prakāśam/ diṣṭivṛddhyā daivasampadā/ vardhito'si ānandito'si ``diṣṭhiā baḍhḍhasi ṇaṃ bhaṇāṇi'' ityādinā/ so'yamiti makarandasya cetanopalambhena yo'smākaṃ harṣahetuḥ so'yaṃ kālaḥ/ prītidāyasya pāritoṣikadānasya/ yadā diṣṭyā vardhate tadānīmeva tasyaucityāditi bhāvaḥ/
tathāvidhena bhagavatīvacasā nirastāśaṅka āha - yadvyāletyādi/ yadvyālavraṇitasuhṛtpramohamugdhaṃ duṣṭamṛgeṇa vraṇitasya janitakṣatasya suhṛdaḥ pramohena mūrcchayā mugdhaṃ mohitam/ saujanyāt śobhanahṛdayo janaḥ sujanaḥ, tasyaiva paraduḥkheṣu duḥkhitatvamiti bhāvaḥ/ tasya bhāvaḥ saujanyaṃ, tasmāddhetoriti hetvantarābhāvaṃ sūcayan madayantikādibhyaḥ trapayā parasparānurāgamūlatvaṃ chādayati/ vihitavatī kṛtavatī/ ``vipūrvo dhāñ karotyarthe'' iti vacanāt vipūrvasya dhāño niṣṭhā/ gatavyathaṃ śamitahṛdayaduḥkhaṃ, vihitavatī/ yat yasmāt tat tasmāt/ kāmamityavadhāraṇe, ``kāmaṃ karṇāntaviśrānte viśāle tasya locane''/
itivat/ pūrṇapātravṛttyā pāritoṣikaprakāreṇa/
``utsaveṣu suhṛdbhiryad balādākṛṣya gṛhyate/
vastramālyādi tatpūrṇapātraṃ pūrṇānakaṃ ca tat//'' iti vaijayantī/ svīkartuṃ svamananyādhīnaṃ kartum/ hṛdayaṃ manaḥ/ jīvitaṃ prāṇāṃśca/ yato mohena gataṃ hṛdayaṃ prasthitaṃ jīvitaṃ cānayaiva prakṛtau sthāpitaṃ, atastaddvayaṃ pūrṇapātraṃ svīkartuṃ prabhavatyeveti bahirupacāraśabdatvena pratipādyāntarmama hṛdayeśvarī jīviteśvarī ceyameva, tato'dhikaṃ kimanyad dīyatāmiti vyañjayati/ yadvyālavraṇiteti sāmadānokteḥ saṅgrahaḥ//1//
tadubhayaṃ jānānā vidagdhā tanmukhabhūtā sakhī tadanuguṇamevottaramāha - pratīṣṭaḥ khalu naḥ priyasakhyā ayaṃ prasādaḥ/ pratīṣṭaḥ svīkṛtaḥ/ khalviti nirṇaye/ na iti tatra sannihitānāṃ madayantikādīnāṃ grahaṇam, asmākam/ priyasakhyā, ayaṃ hṛdayajīvitapradānarūpaḥ, prasādaḥ anugrahaḥ/ anugrahe khalvevamupacāraḥ prayujyate iti vācyo'rthaḥ/ vyaṅgyastu pratīṣṭaḥ, na tu pratīṣyata iti ciranivṛttatvaṃ sūcayati/ naḥ priyasakhyeti satatapārśvavartinībhirasmābhirayamartho viditacara eva/ ayaṃ prasādaḥ hṛdayajīvitayostvadīyayoriyamīśvarī ityevaṃrūpa iti/
tathoktaṃ viditvā camatkaroti - jānāti mahābhāgadheyo jano ramaṇīyaṃ mantrayitum/ [mahābhāgadheyaḥ] mahad bhāgadheyaṃ sukṛtaṃ yasya, rūpādibhistasyānumitatvāt sa tathāvidho, loke jano ramaṇīyaṃ mugdhavidagdhasādhāraṇatayā vācyavyaṅgyabhaṅgyāliṅgitatvena sundaram/ [mantrayituṃ] bhaṇitumityarthaḥ/
pūrvavimarśanamevānuvartamānaṃ mālatyāḥ strīsvabhāvakātaratayā pitṛvicikitsayā ca śaṅkitahṛdayāyāḥ prakāśayati - svagatam/ kiṃ nāma makarandenodvegakāraṇaṃ śrutaṃ bhavet/ udvegakāraṇam mādhavasyetyarthāt/ bhavediti saṃbhāvanāyāṃ liṅ/
tadvimarśaṃ bhaṅgyāchinatti kaviḥ - praviśya puruṣa iti/ sāmānyoktirviśeṣe tātparyābhāvāt, tadvārtāmātra eva tātparyāt/ madhyamapātramiti ca pratīyate, prabhuputryāṃ brāhmaṇyāṃ ca dūtyenādhamasyāgantumayuktatvād uttamasya ca preṣyatvānupapatteḥ/ ataśca saṃskṛtavyavahāraḥ/ jyāyān agrajo, bhrātā/ parameśvareṇa rājñā/ paraṃ viśvāsam adhikaṃ visrambham/ asmābhiḥ kṛtaṃ tasyānumatameveti niścayāt/ āviṣkurvatā loke prakāśayatā/ svayameva bhūrivasorasannidhāvityarthaḥ/ pratipāditā dattā/ ``viśrāṇanaṃ vitaraṇaṃ sparśanaṃ pratipādanam''ṃ/
ityamaraḥ/ sambhāvayāmaḥ mahotsavakāraṇena pūjayāmaḥ/ prasādaṃ rājña iti/ arthāt kāñciditi chāditāṃ prakāśayati/
iyaṃ sā yā mayāntarnagare śruteti sūcitā, sā/ iyamanena puruṣeṇa prakāśitetyarthaḥ/
vaivarṇyaṃ bhinnamukhavarṇatām/ ``praviśya puruṣaḥ'' ityādi ``vaivarṇyaṃ nāṭayataḥ'' ityantaṃ nirodhanaṃ, puruṣavacasā samāgamāśānirodhanāt/
sakhi! tvaṃ khalvekanagarādhivāsena pāṃsukrīḍanāt prabhṛti priyasakhī bhaginī ca/ sāṃprataṃ punarasmākaṃ gṛhasya maṇḍanaṃ jātāsi/ [ekanagarādhivāsena] samānadeśavāsād visrambhasnehabhūmitayā, priyasakhī bhaginī ca/ mamāsīditi śeṣaḥ/ khalu prasiddhau/ pāṃsukrīḍanāt prabhṛti sikatābhirvedikādikaṃ kṛtvā yat krīḍanaṃ vihāraḥ, tata ārabhyeti śaiśavopalakṣaṇam/ ``ekadeśanivāso vā snehasya hetavaḥ'' iti, ``sahapāṃsukrīḍāparicayapeśalaḥ sakhījanaḥ'' iti harṣacaritokteḥ/ sāmpramadya punarviśeṣo'pyastītyarthaḥ/ jyeṣṭhabhāryātvena santatasannidhānādasmadgṛhasya bhūṣaṇamapi jātāsītyarthaḥ/
bhrāturiti/ makarandasya priyatvādasyā mādhavo dharmato bhrātaiveti tattvakathanam, nandanasyeti pratibhāsācchalaprayogaḥ/
maugdhyāt tadajānānā prativakti-yuṣmākamāśiṣaḥ prasādena/ [yuṣmākaṃ] gurutvād bahuvacanam/ [āśiṣaḥ] yuṣmābhirasmāsu yā svastigīḥ prayuktā tasyāḥ, prasādena anugraheṇa/ vardhāmaha iti vipariṇāmena yojanā/ sakhi lavaṅgike! bharitā no manorathāḥ yuṣmākaṃ lābhena/ bharitāḥ pūrṇāḥ/ manorathāḥ yadā nandanasya mālatīvivāhārthaṃ prayatna ārabdhaḥ tadāprabhṛti kadā mālatī lavaṅgikādibhiḥ sahāsmākaṃ gṛhamalaṅkariṣyatītyādaraḥ saṅkalpāḥ kṛtāḥ/
