pūrvavacchalenāha-sakhi asmākamiti mantrayitavyam/ asmākaṃ manorathāḥ yuṣmākaṃ nandanādīnāṃ lābhāt pūrṇā iti vaktavyamiti bāhyo'rthaḥ/ mādhavāya mālatīpradānaniścayādasmākaṃ manorathāḥ pūrṇāḥ, na tu yuṣmākamityāntaraḥ/
sakhi buddharakṣite! ehi mahotsavaṃ sambhāvayāmaḥ/
``ramaṇīyorjitaṃ daivādadya darśanam'' ityuktasya darśanasya phalaṃ bhaṅgyā prakāśayati - bhagavati yathā hṛdayabharitodvahavismayānandasundarāghūrṇitadhīraparyantamanoharāḥ paryasyante madayantikāmakarandayordalitendīvaramāṃsalacchavayo dṛṣṭisambhedāstathā manye manorathanirvṛttasamāgamāvetāviti/ [hṛdayabharitodvahavismayānandasundarāghūrṇitadhīraparyantamanoharāḥ] manasi pūrṇaḥ, tatrāmān[] bahiḥ kāryarūpeṇa sphuradvismaya ānandaśca, tābhyāṃ sundarairāvūrṇitairlolairdhīraiḥ stimitaiśca paryantaiḥ kaṭākṣairmanoharāḥ/ paryasyante parasparaṃ vikṣipyante/ yathā ( ṛ) ``madāṃtiāmārandāṇaṃ'' iti ``dvivacanasya bahuvacanam'' iti prākṛtanyāyād dvivacanasya bahuvacanādeśaḥ/ ``nīlotpalaṃ tu kandoṭṭam'' iti vaijayantī/ [dalitendīvaramāṃsalacchavayaḥ] vikasitendīvaravat snigdhanīlabahulaprabhāḥ/ dṛṣṭisaṃbhedāḥ dṛṣṭīnāṃ sammiśraṇāni/ [manorathanirvṛttasamāgamau] saṅkalpanirmitasambhogau, etāvitimanye/
nanviti sammatau, tathaivetyarthaḥ/ mānasaṃ manasā nirmitam, mohanaṃ suratam/ ``surataṃ mohanaṃ proktam'' iti halāyudhaḥ/
tathātvamupapādayāta[yati] - tathāhīti/
īṣattiryagityādi - [tiryagvalanaviṣamam] ``vala tiryaggatau'' iti dhātostiryaggativācakamapi/ valanamatra calanamātraparam/ tiryagvalanena tiraścīnena valanena kiñcidvakram/ kūṇitaprāntaṃ purastṛtīyāṃśasammīlanaviśiṣṭāpāṅgam/
``purastribhāgasaṅkoce premṇā tat kūṇitaṃ bhavet/'' iti vacanāt/ [premodbhedastimitalulitam] premodbhedena snehasyautkaṇṭhyena stimitaṃ parasparasminniścalaṃ, lulitaṃ trapayā kiñcid glānam/
``parikliṣṭapuṭaṃ mlāyattāraṃ vilulitaṃ bhavet/'' ityukteḥ/ kiñcidākuñcitabhru īṣat kuṭilitacillikam/ antarmodānubhavamasṛṇam antargatasukhānubhūtyā viṣayāntaragrahaṇāśaktam/ srastaniṣkampapakṣmagalitamata eva nimeṣarahitaṃ ca pakṣma netrapālī romāvalī yatra/ ākekarākṣam ``ākuñcitapuṭāpāṅgā saṅgatārdhanimeṣiṇī/
muhurvyāvṛttatārā ca dṛṣṭirākekarā smṛtā//'' iti vacanāt tathāvidhamakṣi yasmin/ ``bahuvrīhau sakthyakṣṇoḥ svāṅgāt ṣac'' (5. 4. 113) atra viśeṣaṇairlajjāśaṅkāvismayaglānicintāśramadhairyamohānāṃ bhāvānāṃ harṣajanitā śabalatā sukhaparyavasāyinī dyotyate/ kilikiñcitākhyaśca bhāvaḥ/
``smitaruditahasitabhayaroṣaharṣaduḥkhaśramābhilāṣāṇām/
yat saṅkaraṇaṃ harṣādasakṛt kilikiñcitaṃ jñeyam//'' iti divākaraḥ/ aciraṃ muhurmuhuścalanenāsthiraṃ, athavā aciraṃ vyāghrāvapātasamaya eva darśanānnātidīrghakālabhavatve'pi snehasyātibhūmigamanaṃ vyajyate dṛṣṭaṃ darśanam/ bhāve niṣṭā[ṣṭhā]/ vyaktaṃ śaṃsati sphaṣṭaṃ kathayati/ mohanamanubhavata iti vyaktaṃ śaṃsatīti dṛṣṭasyācetanasya śaṃsanānupapatteḥ liṅgatayā sphuṭamanumāpayatītyarthasiddheḥ gūḍhavyaṅgyalākṣaṇikaśabdaprayogaḥ/ atra sūkṣmamalaṅkāraḥ, saṃlakṣitasūkṣmārthaprakāśanāt//2//
ita ita iti prabhutvānmārgakathanaṃ gamanatvaraṇaṃ ca/
sakhi buddharakṣite! api punardṛśyata eṣa jīvitadāyī puṇḍarīkalocanaḥ/ apiḥ praśne/ jīvitapradāyītyupakārasmaraṇam/ api punardṛśyata ityautsukyaṃ ca upari tatsaṅgamānurūpaṃ rasamanusandadhānena kavimukundena sandarśitaṃ bodhitavyam/ puṇḍarīkalocana iti darśanīyatvopalakṣaṇam/
yadi daivamanukūlayiṣyati anukūlavadācariṣyatīti daivānukūlyamantareṇa kathamīdṛśāṃ darśanaṃ bhaviṣyatītyautsukyameva draḍhayati/
atha tadudantaśravaṇe vivarṇo nirāśo mādhavaḥ svajīvitatyāgamabhisandhāyāha - apavārya svagatam/
cirādityādi/ cirād bahoḥ kālāt/ etāvantaṃ kālam kathamapi manorathaistasya rakṣitatvāt, ``tvaṃ vatsaleti kathamapyavalambitātmāṣṭasatyaṃ jano'yamiyato divasānanaiṣīt/'' ( la ṛ. 14)
iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt/ āśātantuḥ ``virodhe'pi sphuṭe mahyaṃ kālenaitad bhavediti/
anupekṣākṣamatvaṃ yat puṃsāmāśāṃ vadanti tām//'' iti lakṣitāśaiva tantuḥ sūtram, parasparabandhahetutvāt/ truṭatu chidyatām/ ``vā bhrāśabhlāśabhramukramuklamutrasitruṭilaṣaḥ'' (3-1-70) iti vikalpena śyano vidhānācchap/ bisinītantubhiduraḥ prāgeva mṛṇālasūtravat jhaṭiti khaṇḍanaśīlaḥ, antarāntarāpāyaśaṅkayetyarthaḥ/ ``vidibhidicchideḥ kurac'' (3-2-162)/ karmakartari cātra prayogaḥ/ mahān pūrvasmādatiśayitaḥ/ ādhivyādhiḥ niravadhiridānīmadya śarīrapātaṃ yāvadanuvṛtta iti kalpitaḥ, pūrvaṃ samāgamāvasānatvena sāvadhiriti cintitatvāt/ prasaratu pravartatām/ pratiṣṭhāṃ dṛḍhāvasthitim/ avyājaṃ sākṣādeva pūrvamutkaṇṭhāvyājena labdhāspadatvāt tadapāye nimittābhāvāt svayamiyaṃ na bhaviṣyatīti suhṛdbhiścintitatvād, idānīmunmādatvena sākṣāt svayaṃ sāmrājyamanubhavatvityarthaḥ/ pāriplavadhurā capalānāṃ bhāraḥ pāriplavaḥ cañcalaḥ/
``pāriplavāḥ srotasi nimnagāyāḥ'' ityādidarśanāt/ dhūrbhāraḥ/ ``ṛkpūrabdhūḥpathāmānakṣe'' (5-4-74) iti samāsānto'cpratyayaḥ/ loṭtrayaṃ kāmacārakaraṇe/ vidhirdaivam, svāsthyamavyākulatvam, dhattāṃ dhārayatu/ kṛtakṛtyaḥ sādhitasādhyaḥ, ubhayorapi mahatā prayāsenaitāvata eva kāryasya sisādhayiṣitatvāt tasya ca siddhatvāditi bhāvaḥ/ asulabhasamāgamayorāvayostatra tatra darśanaṃ vidhinā yadṛcchayā sampāditaṃ, madanena tu parasparānurāgaḥ samuttejitaḥ/ dvayasyāpi virasāvasānatvaṃ dvābhyāmeva kṛtamidānīmityarthaḥ/ etau loṭau vidhiparau/ aniṣṭavidhyābhāsarūpa ākṣepo'trālaṅkāraḥ/ prāṇatyāgamantareṇa virahaduḥkhasya duḥsahatvarūpaviśeṣavivakṣayāniṣṭavidhānāt//3//
vidhiḥ svāsthyaṃ dhattām, madanaśca kṛtakṛtyo bhavatvityuktyā tayoḥ svaviṣaye anucitapravṛttiḥ prakāśitā/ tadavicāritābhidhānamityupapattyā pūrvoktamākṣipati - ,athaveti . athaveti pakṣavyāvṛttau/
samānapremāṇamityādi - tulyānurāgamiti nirūpyetyarthaḥ/ etāvadeva nirūpitam, na tu saulabhyādītyātmanaḥ prekṣāvattvaṃ pratikṣipati/ janamityekanagarādhivāsasahapāṃsukrīḍanādiparicayarūpasnehahetvabhāvāt taṭasthaṃ strījātimātramiti dyotyate/ tadā tvadṛṣṭe'pi ghaṭata eva prārthanā/ yadi sulabhatvabuddhiḥ sāpi nāstītyāha - asulabhaṃ akṛcchreṇa labhyaṃ na bhavatīti pūrvameva nirṇītamityarthaḥ/ ``āsaktametadanavekṣitahetu cetaḥ'' iti pūrvamevālocitatvāt/ ``ānīya jhaṭiti ghaṭayati vidhirabhimatamabhimukhībhūtaḥ/'' iti nyāyādasulabhamapi vidhyānukūlye kadācit sulabhaṃ bhavatītyāśaṅkyāha- vāmārambhepratikūlapravṛttau/ mametyarthāntarasaṃkramitavācyena dhvaninā vivekaśūnyasya pratilomadaivasyeti ca dyotyate/ eṣeti prārthitasya janasya svapurata evānyahastagamanam manoduḥkhānubhūtiḥ sahṛdayahāsyatvam ityevaṃrūpeṇa vartamānetyarthaḥ/ pariṇatiḥ phalaṃ samucitā samyagupapannaiva/
``keṣāṃ na syuḥ paribhavaphalā niṣphalārambhayatnāḥ/'' iti vacanādityarthaḥ/ ato vidhimadanayorupālambho mohārambha evetyarthaḥ/ tat kimidānīṃ vicchinnāśāpāśena vilambyate/ tūṣṇīmeva gatvā ``sahatāṃ hatajīvitaṃ mama prabalāmātmakṛtena vedanām/'' ityuktakrameṇa svaireva duśceṣṭitairupapāditaṃ duḥkhamanubhūyatāmityāśaṅkya gatyantarābhāvāt tathaiva kriyate/ tadāpi madavasthādausthyato'pyasyā avasthā māṃ vivaśayatītyāha - tathāpīti/ mama nairāśye prāpte'pītyarthaḥ/ asminniti bartamānatvāt/ dānaśravaṇasamaye svayameva mālatī pratipāditeti puruṣavacanākarṇanakāle/ pravigalatprabhaṃ prakarṣeṇa bhraśyacchāyaṃ/ śatrā galanasyoparyupari vartamānatvaṃ prakāśyate/ tata eva prātaścandradyuti dinamukhavartinaḥ sūryakiraṇavisaraṇadhūsaritatejasaścandrasya dyutiriva dyutirdīptiryasyeti uktibhaṅgyā dyutihīnamiti kathyate/ vadanaṃ mukham/ antarmanasi/ māṃ dahati/ ato nairāśyamapi dṛḍhamavalambituṃ na śakyate/ yatastvaddhastaṃ vāsau gamiṣyati kṛtāntahastaṃ vā na punaranyasya haste patiṣyatīti etadvadanaṃ spaṣṭamācaṣṭa ityarthaḥ/ atra pūrvārdhe matyākhyo vyabhicārī vyajyate/ uttarārdhe dainyākhyaḥ/ upamā cālaṅkāraḥ//4//
janāntikaṃ lavaṅgikayā śrutamityarthaḥ/ evamiti vaivaśyādyabhinayaḥ/ durmanāyamānaḥ duḥkhitamanā bhavan, kyaṅ/ pīḍayati duḥkhitāṃ karoti/ vatso mādhavaḥ/ vatsā ceti cakāraḥ pīḍayatītyanukarṣaṇārthaḥ/ tatrāpi saukumāryātiśayāt mālatīṃ pratyāha - duṣkaraṃ kartumaśakyaṃ yathā tathā/ prāṇiti jīvati/ atikṛcchreṇedānīṃ jīvatītyarthaḥ/ tatra hetuḥ-nirāśā nirastā āśā yasyāḥ/ etāvantaṃ kālamāśayaiva dhāritajīvitatvāditi bhāvaḥ/ āśvāsanaṃ bhaṅgyā kartumāha pṛcchāmīti/ āyuṣmantaṃ mādhavam/ tatpraśnottareṇaiva mālatyā apyāśvāsanasiddhestaṃ prati praśnaḥ/ apiḥ praśne/ amaṃsta matiṃ kṛtavān, manyaterluṅi rūpam/ anudāttettvādātmanepadam/ iṭpratiṣedhaśca ``ekāca upadeśe'nudāttāt'' (7-2-10) ityanena/ ``tadādigrahaṇaṃ syādinumartham'' iti sijantasyāṅgasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ ``aniditām'' iti anunāsikalopābhāvaḥ/ tathetyāyāti/ bhūrivasureveti pitṛtvāddāne'dhikṛtatvamāha/ asmabhyamiti caturthyā sampradānatvena satkṛtya dāsyatīti dyotyate/ iti yathā tathā bhavānapyamaṃstetyarthaḥ/
tatpraśnasya sopālambhatvaṃ jñātvāha - salajjamiti/ nahi amaṃsiṣīti vipariṇāmena arthādāyāti/ vīpsayā tathātvasya svapne'pyaśaṅkitatvaṃ prakāśayati/
tatsaṃvādenaiva taṃ samāśvāsayati - na tarhīti/ tarhi tasmād yato bhūrivasuhṛdayasaṃvādamantareṇa parasparānurāgādasmatprayatnena ca yuvāṃ sāhasikyenaiva pravṛttāvata ityarthaḥ/ prāgavasthāyāḥ dānaśravaṇāt pūrvaṃ yā avasthā manasaḥ prāptyāśāviśiṣṭatvena sukhāvasthānaṃ ataḥ paramapi tasyā avasthāyāḥ/ na parihīyase na nyūno bhavasi/ parihīyata iti pāṭhe etatkāryamityarthaḥ/ adyāpi na kiñcidatikrāntam, saivāvasthā vartata ityarthaḥ/ ``cirādāśātantustruṭatu'' iti vicchinnasyācchedakāraṇam/ ``na tarhi prāgavasthāyāḥ parihīyase'', ``kathaṃ ca vatsa/ māmanavadhānāṃ manyase'' ityādi binduḥ/
trapāmudritasya tasya āśayaṃ makarandaḥ prakāśayati - dattapūrvā anyasmai pūrvaṃ dattā, ityāśaṅkyate rājñodakapūrvaṃ dattatvād, bhūrivasunāpi ``prabhavati nijasya kanyakājanasya mahārājaḥ'' iti vācānumoditatvāt/ ataścāśāccheda ityabhiprāyaḥ/
``sakṛdaṃśo nipatati sakṛt kanyā pradīyate/
sakṛdāha dadānīti trīṇyetāni sakṛt sakṛt//'' iti, ``na datvā kasyacit kanyāṃ punardadyādvicakṣaṇaḥ/
datvā punaḥ prayacchan hi prāpnoti puruṣo'nṛtam//'' iti, ``nānyotpannā prajāstīha na cānyasya parigrahe/
na dvitīyaśca sādhvīnāṃ kvacid bhartopadiśyate//'' iti, ``patiṃ hitvāpakṛṣṭaṃ svamutkṛṣṭaṃ yā'vasevate/
nindyaiva loke bhavati parapūrveti cocyate//'' iti manuvacanād dharmalopaśaṅketyarthaḥ/
atha ``anadhikāriṇā kṛtamakṛtam'' iti nyāyādrājño dānasya nairarthakyaṃ bhūrivasoścānanumodanaṃ vyākhyānenopapādya tadāśaṅkāyā niravakāśatvamāha - jānāmi mayātrāparijñātasya kasyacidabhāvāditi bhāvaḥ/ tāṃ yā bhavatāmāśaṅkāmaṅkuritavatī tāmityarthaḥ/ vārtāṃ ``antarnagara eva'' iti tvayā sūcitāṃ lokoktim/ khalviti nissandehatvam/ kathaṃ nissandehatvaṃ jñāyata ityatrāha - turvyāvṛttau/ yathāśrutagrāhī lokaḥ, katipaye punaḥ tattvaṃ jānantītyarthaḥ/ idaṃ vastu tāvat prathamam/ suprasiddhaṃ sarvalokaviditam/ nandanāya nandanasyārthe/ tādarthye caturthī/
astyetad, vastviti śeṣaḥ/
adya ceti/ adya parameśvareṇetyuktasyānuvādaḥ/ svayamiti pitranapekṣatvam/ saṃpratyeveti yuṣmābhirapi ucchrutamityarthaḥ/ puruṣeṇa madayantikāhvāyakena/ tadapi śrutam, kimato'smākaṃ prāptamityatrāha-tat tasmāt/ bhūrivasorvāganṛṇātmikaivetyanvayaḥ/ vatseti bālatvād bhavatāṃ boddhavyatvamasminnartha iti vyañjayati/ vākpratiṣṭhāni vāci vākye pratiṣṭhā nirṇayo yeṣām/ dehināmityaviśeṣeṇa mlecchādīnāmapi, tathā kiṃ punarvaidikānāmiti dyotayati/ vyavahāratantrāṇi pravṛttinivṛttilakṣaṇavyavahāraprayogāḥ/ ``na so'sti pratyayo loke yaḥ śabdānugamādṛte/
anuviddhamiva jñānaṃ sarvaṃ śabdena bhāsate//'' ityāptavacanāt/
``padamabhyadhikābhāvāt smārakānna viśiṣyate/'' iti vacanāt smārakatvameva śabdānāmiti cet, tatrāha - vācī śabde puṇyāpuṇyahetavaḥ sukhaduḥkhaprāptiphalayoḥ sukṛtaduṣkṛtayoḥ kāraṇabhūtāḥ/ vyavasthā niyamāḥ/ sarvathā sarvaprakāreṇa śrutismṛtibhyāṃ sadācārāccetyarthaḥ/ vācyāyatante tadadhīnatayā vartante, ``dhanurvedasaṃskārastāvadasmāsvāyatate/'' iti murāryuktavat/ ``ekaḥ śabdaḥ samyagjñātaḥ suṣṭhu prayuktaḥ svarge loke kāmadhug bhavati'' iti vākyāt, ``nāsti satyāt paro dharmo nānṛtāt pātakaṃ param/
sthitiśca lokadharmaśca tasmāt satyaṃ viśiṣyate//
vācyārthā niyatāḥ sarve vāṅmūlā vāgvinissṛtāḥ/
tāṃ tu yaḥ stenayedvācaṃ sa sarvasteyakṛnnaraḥ//'' iti manuvacanāt, daśarathaprahlādādīnāṃ putrebhyaḥ prāṇebhyaśca satyasyāṅgīkāreṇa svargaprāptiśravaṇād, yudhiṣṭhisya chalenāpyasatyaṃ prayuktavato nirayadarśanākarṇanāccetyarthaḥ/ sā ceti yā evaṃvidhānubhāvā sā/ bhūrivasoriti viditaveditavyatvamadhītāśeṣaśāstratvaṃ ca vyañjayantī kadācidapi sanmārgādaskhalanamāha/ anṛṇātmikaiva kadācidapyananumodanād dānasya nandanaṃ prati anṛṇaṃ ṛṇasaṃbandharahitaṃ ātmā tattvaṃ yasyāḥ/ ātmagrahaṇena bahiranyathā pratibhātu nāma kṣulladhiyām, tathāpi kuśāgradhiyāṃ nirūpaṇe anṛṇaivetyavadhārayati/ tathātvameva vyācaṣṭe - khalu prasiddhau/ ``prabhavati nijasya kanyakājanasya'' iti bhūrivasuvacane nijaśabdaḥ sākṣāt nṛpatisaṃbandhameva vakti/ atastatprasūtiryaḥ kanyājanastameva spṛśati, na punarmālatīṃ kaṭākṣeṇāpi vīkṣituṃ kṣamata iti bhūrivasuvāgdānaśaṅkā nivartitā/ atha rājñā dattatvāśaṅkāṃ nivārayati - pramāṇaṃ nirṇayahetuḥ/ ityevaṃvidhaḥ, itissamāptau ityuktaṃ yad, evaṃprakāraḥ, [dharmācāryasamayaḥ] dharmācāryāṇaṃ smartṛṇāṃ manvādīnāṃ samayaḥ saṅketaḥ siddhānto vā/ ``samayastu kriyākāre saṅkete carite satām/
siddhānte śapathe kāle'' iti vaijayantī/ ``yasmai dadyāt pitā tvenāṃ bhrātā vānumataḥ pituḥ/
taṃ śuśrūṣeta jīvantaṃ saṃsthitaṃ ca na laṅghayet//'' iti, ``tāṃ tu kanyāṃ pitā mātāā bhrātā mātula eva vā/
pitṛvyaśceti pañcaite dātuṃ prabhavatāṃ gatāḥ//'' iti devīvacanācca pitureva dāne sākṣādadhikṛtatvokteḥ, ``kāle'dātā pitā yāpyo yāpyaścānupayan patiḥ/
mṛte bharttari yāpyastu putro māturarakṣitā//'' iti pitureva kālāpradāne nindāsmaraṇāt, ``balāddattaṃ balādbhuktaṃ balādyaccāpi lekhitam/
sarvān balakṛtānarthānakṛtānmanurabravīt//'' iti balakṛtasyākṛtatvasmaraṇācca manvādīnāmiyamanumatirna bhavatītyarthaḥ/ tasmādavasthitametat anṛṇātmikaivetyavadhāraṇena yaduktaṃ tadanuvādamevetyarthaḥ/ ``sā ca bhūrivasorvāganṛṇātmikaiva'' ityādikāmandakīvacanāt lakṣyasyaiva mālatīvivāhotsavārambhādalakṣyasyeva mantripratijñārūpasya bījasya pratipādanāt pratimukhamidam/ evamadṛṣṭaśaṅkayā nairāśyaṃ na karttavyamityāśvāsya dṛṣṭe prabalasahāyasampattyāpi bhavadabhīṣṭasiddherna vyabhicāraḥ śaṅkanīya ityāha - cakāraḥ upapattyantarasamuccayārthaḥ/ anavadhānāmasminnarthe pramādyantīm/ māmiti tvanmayajīvitatvaṃ bhūrivasuhṛdayanirviśeṣatvamupāyaprayogakauśalamityādyaparimitaṃ guṇajātaṃ svasyā dhvanyate/ kathaṃ manyasa iti kena prakāreṇa taveyaṃ buddhirutpannetyupālambhaḥ/
vihasya aho bhavato maugdhyaṃ yanmayyapi dhuraṃdharāyāṃ evaṃ cintyata iti smitaṃ kṛtvetyarthaḥ/
mā vāmityādi - vāṃ yuvayoḥ, sapatneṣu śatruṣu, api nāma sambhāvye/ tat pāpaṃ mā bhūt tādṛśaṃ pāpaphalamaniṣṭaṃ mā bhavatu/ asyāṃ mālatyāṃ, tvayi vā yadviśaṅkyaṃ etacchārīraṃ mānasaṃ vā duḥkhamanayorāpatiṣyatīti yacchaṃkāspadaṃ tatpāpaṃ vāṃ sapatneṣvapi mā bhūdityetaduktaṃ bhavati/ loke hi svabandhūnāṃ ye śatravasteṣāmaniṣṭamāśaṃsante janāḥ/ mama tu matistathā na vartate/ yato yuvayoḥ śatravaḥ iti virodharūpo'pi ko'pi sambandho yuvābhyāṃ saha sapatnānāṃ vidyate, atastatsambandhavaśāt teṣāmapyaniṣṭaṃ mā bhūditi bhavati dhīḥ/ kiṃ punaryuvayormābhūdityatrāpinā dyotyate/ lokoktyanusāraścāyam, taditīdānīṃ śaṅkitasyāniṣṭasya parihartavyatvādityarthaḥ/ saṅgamanāya saṃśleṣaṇārtham, sarvathā pitṛbuddhyanusāreṇa vā tadvyatirekeṇa vā sarvaprakāreṇa yatsaṅgamanaṃ tadartham/ ``tumarthācca bhāvavacanāt'' (2-3-15) iti caturthī/ prāṇavyayena prāṇānāṃ parityāgena/ apiśabdena kiṃ punarasminnarthe buddhivyāpāramātrasādhya iti saukaryapratipādanāt manasaḥ sthirīkaraṇaṃ kriyate/ vidheyaḥ kartavyaḥ/ atrātiśayoktiralaṅkāraḥ//5//
atha taduktimanūdya puruṣakārastāvadavikalo yuṣmākaṃ, daivagatiḥ kathamiti na jñāyate ityāha - suṣṭhu samyak/ yujyamānaṃ upapadyamānam, ādiśyate upadiśyate, yuṣmābhiriti tathādeśe hetuḥ ``śāstreṣu niṣṭhā'' ( ṛ ṛ ṛ. ja ja.) ityādiguṇaviśiṣṭābhirityarthaḥ/``prāṇavyayenāpi mayā vidheyaḥ'' ityādi tasya ca prayatnasya bāhyopādhivaidhuryamāha - dayā vetyādi/ ``anukampā tu sā jñeyā duḥkhitān prati dehinaḥ/
upakāraparatvaṃ yā kurute cittavikriyā//'' iti lakṣitānukampāparyāyo dayāśabdaḥ, ``manaso yaddravārdratvaṃ viṣayeṣu mamatvataḥ/
bhayaśaṅkāvasānātmā sa eva sneha ucyate//'' iti lakṣitaḥ sneho vā/ nija iti mamatvena sneho vā, śiśujana iti svahitasādhanāparijñānād duḥkhitatvācca dayā vā/ saṃsārādvirataṃ saṃsāradharmebhyo rāgādibhyo nivṛttamapi/ ``jugupsāvirāmapramādārthānāmupasaṅkhyānam'' (vā. 2-3-28) iti pañcamī/ dravayati adhīraṃ karoti/ ataścittadravaṇāt/ pravrajyāsulabhasamayācāravimukhaḥ sanyāse sulabhāḥ suprāpāḥ samayācārāstattatsiddhāntānuguṇāḥ ācārāḥ anuṣṭhānāni caityavandanaśāstraśravaṇayogābhyāsādayaḥ, teṣu vimukhaḥ tebhyo vyāvṛttaḥ/ etadarthameva kālakṣepāt teṣāmavasarālābhādityarthaḥ/ prasaktaḥ prārabdhaḥ/ punaḥ pakṣavyāvṛttau/ aparaṃ paramatiśayitaṃ asmānna vidyata iti aparaṃ, anuttamamityādivat/ athavā aparamanyavilakṣaṇamityarthaḥ, sarvasmādutkṛṣṭam/ daivaṃ punaḥ prabhavati svatantratayā prabhutvaṃ vahati/ kartumakartumanyathā kartuṃ vā pragalbhate/ ``anukūle taṭasthe vā daive na tu virodhini/
pauruṣaṃ sādhayedarthaṃ daivaṃ tu svavaśaṃ sadā//'' iti vacanāt/ atastadviṣayāśaṅkaivāsmākaṃ vartate nānyetyarthaḥ/ atra śaṅkākhyo bhāvaḥ prakāśyate/ aprastutapraśaṃsālaṅkāraḥ, daivavailomyād bhagavatyā apyasādhyo'yamarthaḥ prasaṅgasyātikramāditi kāryasya kāraṇamukhena prakāśanāt//6//
bhagavati! bhaṭṭinī vijñāpayati mālatīṃ gṛhītvā tvaritamihāgaccheti/
``devī kṛtābhiṣekāyāmitarāsu tu bhaṭṭinī/'' iti nāṭyavyavahārādrājatulyasya bhāryā mālatīmātā bhaṭṭinītyucyate/ vijñāpayatīti guruviṣaye vinayoktiḥ/
sarvāḥ kāmandakī mālatī lavaṅgikā ca/
sakaruṇānurāgaṃ śokasthāyibhāvo rasaḥ karuṇaḥ, anurāgaḥ rāgasyānuvṛttiḥ, tābhyāṃ sahitaṃ yatheti/ śokānubhāvairaśrupātādibhiḥ anurāgānubhāvaiḥ stimitavikasitatvādibhiḥ śabalamanyonyamavalokayata ityarthaḥ/
kaṣṭaṃ idamiti śeṣaḥ, mahadvyasanam/ ``syāt kaṣṭaṃ kṛcchramābhīlam'' ityamaraḥ/ etāvatī etatparimāṇā/ etadā tātkālikamavalokanaṃ parāmṛśyate/ mādhavasya mālatyā samamiti ca dhvaninā aho dhanyau mālatīmādhavau, yayoranurūpaḥ, praṇaya iti loke prasiddhaṃ, tat prema īdṛśīṃ daśāṃ gatamiti dyotyate/ lokayātrā laukiko vyavahāraḥ/ apunardarśanāya viyujyamānayoḥ parādhīnayordvayoḥ loke parasparānukūlyadyotakaṃ tadātvadarśanamātramevopacāro vartate tadevedamityarthaḥ/ aho ityavyavasthitimacintitāmālocyāścaryabuddhidyotakam/ nuḥ praśne/ ``praśne vikalpe nu svicca'' iti vaijayantī/ khalvityavadhāraṇe/ bho ityākāśe lokamabhimukhīkaroti/ he lokāḥ! idamāścaryameva/ kimarthaṃ ṛ bhāvena mayā tu na jñātamityarthaḥ/
tat kimityāha - suhṛdivetyādi/ śobhanahṛdayo makarandādiriva/ ivaśabdena naisargikaṃ durhṛttvam/ suhṛttvaṃ tu nāṭitamiti vyajyate/ prakaṭayya prakāśyeti/ āmukhe taṭita iva sphuraṇamātramanirvāhā (d) dyotyate/ sukhapradāṃ nirvṛtiṃ dadātīti/ ``pre dājñaḥ'' (3-2-6) iti kaḥ/ prathamamādau/ ekarasāṃ ekaprakārāmiti lakṣaṇāprayogaḥ/ uparyupari tatphalānubhavāt/ eko mukhyo raso rāgo yasyāmiti vā/ ``mukhyānyakevaleṣveka'' iti, ``raso rāge viṣe vīrye'' iti ca vaijayantī/ anukūlatāṃ abhimatasampādanābhimukhatām/ punaḥ paścāt akāṇḍavivartanadāruṇaḥ asthāna eva viruddhena vartanena krūraḥ/ pariśinaṣṭi pariśeṣaṃ karoti/ ``neti neti vyudastebhyo'nyo'vasthāsnurarthaḥ pariśeṣaḥ/ manaso rujaṃ hṛdayasya rogaṃ, duḥkhamityarthaḥ/ suhṛdivānukūlatāṃ prakaṭayya paścāddāruṇaḥ śatrutvena rujaṃ pariśinaṣṭītyanena buddhipūrvameva pratāraṇe pravṛttirdyotyate/ yathā mātsyako baliśagarbheṇa piśitakhaṇḍenāṇḍajaśiśumādau vilobhya paścāt prāṇāneva tyājayati tathāyamapīti/ lyapā laṭā ca ``snātvā bhuṅkte'' itivat pūrvakālakriyāyā uttarakālakriyāṅgatvāttatra viśrāntiḥ prakāśyate/ atra vidhiṃ pratyasūyā dhvanyate/ virodho'laṅkāraḥ//7//
apavārya svagatam/ mahābhāga locanānanda etāvad dṛṣṭo'si/ ,locanānanda ṅa
mama locanayorānanda āhlādarūpa, anyatra candrādāvapyanirvāpaṇāt/ etāvad etadeva darśanasya parimāṇamavasānaṃ yathā tathā/ dṛṣṭo'sītyanenātaḥ paraṃ jīvanta eva tvāṃ drakṣyanti, na punarahamidānīṃ tyakṣyamāṇajīviteti dyotyate/ anyathā etadanto nassamāgamaḥ iti vaktavyam, darśanasya pūrvavad vātāyanādigatatvenāpi sambhavāt/
tadāśayajñā sakhī tasyāḥ pitṛdveṣavardhanāya āha - hā dhik! hā dhik/ śarīrasaṃśayameva naḥ priyasakhī āropitā amātyena/ śarīrasaṃśayaṃ śarīraṃ kañcitkālaṃ sthāsyati vā na veti sandeham/ āropitā prāpitā/ naḥ priyasakhī ityanena sarvā eva vayamāropitā iti dhvanyate/
pūrvoktasyāśayaṃ vivṛṇoti/ pariṇatamidānīṃ me jīvitatṛṣṇāyāḥ phalam/ [jīvitatṛṣṇāyāḥ] etāvato divasānāśāvaśena yā jīvite tṛṣṇā kāṅkṣā mama jātā tasyāḥ/ phalamaniṣṭasthale dānaprasaṅgarūpaṃ prathojanam/ [pariṇataṃ] pakvam/ etadarthaṃ hi mayā jīvitaṃ dhāritam/ yadi pūrvameva mayā jīvitamamokṣyata tadā jugupsitametanna niravartiṣyateti jīvitaṃ pratyasūyā vyajyate/ ata idānīmapi jīvitatyāga eva śreyānityabhiprāyaḥ/ nirvyūḍhaṃ ca niṣkaruṇatayā kāpālikatvaṃ tātasya/ [kāpālikatvaṃ] vividhajīvopahāranirdayāḥ pāṣaṇḍaviśeṣāḥ kāpālikāḥ tadbhāvaḥ kāpālikatvam/ tātasya kāpālikatvaṃ nirvyūḍhaṃ yathopakramamupasaṃhṛtam/ kutaḥ ṛ niṣkaruṇatayā iyaṃ mama duhitā varākī yāvajjīvaṃ duḥkhamanubhokṣyata ityanālocya svakāryakaraṇāttātaḥ sākṣātkāpālika eva jāta ityarthaḥ/ pariniṣṭhito daivasya dāruṇasamārambhasadṛśaḥ pariṇāmaḥ/ pariniṣṭhitaḥ sampūrṇaḥ pariṇāmaḥ prayojanam/ tat kamupālabhe mandabhāgyā, kaṃ vā aśaraṇā śaraṇaṃ pratipadye/ taditi pitari daive caivaṃbhūtayorityarthaḥ/ [kaṃ upālabhe] kimevamanucitaṃ tvayā kriyata iti kamadhikṣipāmi/ upālambhayogye pitari krauryadarśanāt/ kaṃ vā[aśaraṇā] arakṣitṛkā ahaṃ, [śaraṇaṃ pratipadye] rakṣakatvenāśraye/ āśrayaṇīyasya daivasyātyantavailomyādityarthaḥ/ atra ``nirvyaūḍhaṃ'' ityādibhiruttarāṅke prastoṣyamāṇasya kāpālikavṛttāntasya sūcanaṃ kṛtamiti mantavyam/
sakhi! ita itaḥ/
``pariśinaṣṭi vidhirmanasorujaṃ'' iti kimiti śaṅkyate ṛ ``jānāmi tāṃ khalu vārtām'' ityārabhya ``prāṇavyayenāpi mayā vidheyaḥ'' ityantasya bhagavatīvacanasya pratyeyatvādityāśaṃkyāpāyaśaṅkayā pratikṣipati - āśvāsanamātraṃ manaḥparyavasthāpanamātram/ mātraśabdo'vadhāraṇe/ tena tāvadeva, na paramārthatastadityarthaḥ/ tatra hetuḥ sahajasnehārdrahṛdayā akṛtrimavātsalyadravībhūtamanā iti/ mādhavasyeti bhrātṛputratvasvasaṃvardhitatvaśikṣitatvādihetubhirgāḍhasnehāspadatvaṃ pratīyate/ anyathā vailakṣyādaniṣṭaṃ kimapyācariṣyatīti tatparihārāyeti bhāvaḥ/ tadvacanasyāpi svayamevāśvāsanamātramiti pratikṣiptatvānniravalambanatvamālocyāha - sodvegaṃ udvegaḥ duḥkhātiśayajanito manaḥkṣobhaḥ tatsahitam/ hanteti viṣāde/ saṃśayitajanmasāphalyaḥ janmanyekaḥ sa eva mahotsava iti mālatīprāptereva janmaphalatvena svayamadhyavasitatvāt tadrūpajanmasaphalatvaṃ saṃśayitaṃ sandigdhaṃ yasya/ saṃśayitetyanena kāmisvabhāvādāśāyāḥ kiñcidacchedaḥ prakāśyate/ pravartaḥ praṇaṣṭaḥ/ niṣphalajanmanaḥ praṇaṣṭakalpatvāditi bhāvaḥ/ ``saṃvarttaḥ pralayaḥ kalpaḥ'' ityamaraḥ/ tat kiṃ karttavyamiti cintāprārambhaḥ/ vicintyeti cintāsamāptiḥ/ cintayā nirṇītamarthamāha - na khalviti/ khaluravadhāraṇe/ mahāmāṃsavikrayāt mahāmāṃsamiti naramāṃsasya bhairavatantrasiddhā saṃjñā/ tathā prabodhacandrodaye``mastiṣkāktavasābhighāritamahāmāṃsāhutirjuhvatām/'' ityādi/ tasya vikrayo nāma/ ``kalpoktakrameṇa dīkṣitasya vaśyākarṣaṇādiṣvanyatamaphalāpekṣiṇaḥ puruṣasya kṛṣṇacaturdaśīrajanyāṃ mahāśmaśānaṃ gatvā svaśastrakṛttena nirddoṣeṇa naramāṃsena bhūtavetālādibhyo niṣkrayatayā dattena svābhimatasvīkaraṇam/ tataśca jhaṭiti phalasiddhiḥ'' ityāgamāt, sāhasikānāṃ tathānubhavaśravaṇācca tatra saṃjātapratyaya āha - mahāmāṃsāvikrayāt/ anyadupāyāntaraṃ viśiṣṭamupāyaṃ sukhasādhanahetum/ priyāsamāgamarūpasya svakāryasyetyarthāt/ ``na khalu mahāmāṃsavikrayādanyad'' ityādi niyatāptyavasthā/ prakāśamiti mahāmāṃsavikrayaṃ karttavyatvena nirṇīya svamākūtamapahnuvāno madayantikāmakarandayorākāreṅgitābhyāṃ dṛṣṭamanurāgaṃ praśnavyājena prakāśayati makarandaṃ vañcayitvaikākinaḥ svasya niśi śmaśānapraveśāya tamanyato vyākṣeptum/ api madayantikāyā utkaṇṭhate tāṃ sarāgaṃ smarati kim/ ``adhīgarthadayeśāṃ karmaṇi'' (2-3-52) iti ṣaṣṭhī//
``utkaṇṭhamāno bharato gurūṇām/'' iti bhartṛkāvyaprayogāt/
vyākṣiptatvamāha - atha kiṃ tathaiva/ utkaṇṭhe eva/
tatra hetumāha - tanme ityādi/ taditi vākyārthaparāmarśaḥ/ me manaḥ kṣipatīti madapekṣameva hṛdayaṃ prerayati capalaṃ karotītyarthaḥ/ sarasaprahāraṃ navatayā kṣaradrudhiro vyāghranakharaprahāradeśo yasya/ agaṇitaskhaladuttarīyā skhalat stanataṭād vigalad uparivāso na gaṇitaṃ nā nirūpitaṃ yayeti snehasaṃbhramānubhāvaḥ/ trastaikahāyanakuraṅgaviloladṛṣṭiḥ yataḥ kutaścid bhītasya ekavarṣajātasya sāraṅgasyeva vilolā cañcalā dṛṣṭiryasyāḥ/ upamānena snigdhāsitavipulāyatatvaṃ dṛṣṭeḥ prakāśyate/
``dharmayorekataranirdeśe anyasaṃvit sāhacaryāt/'' iti vāmanokteḥ/ ``haśca brīhikālayoḥ'' (3-1-148) iti lyuṭ/
``ekahāyanasāraṅgagatī raghukulottamau'' iti bhartṛkāvye prayogāt/ etena pūrvaṃ vyāghradarśanāt paścādasyā apāyacintayā ca bhayānubhāvaḥ prakāśyate/ amṛtasaṃvalitairiva amṛtapaṅke nimajjitairiveti tatsparśamātreṇa vraṇavedanāyāḥ śāntatvaṃ dyotyate/ sā āśliṣṭavatī yat āliṅgavatī yat tanme manaḥ kṣipatītyanvayaḥ//8//
upapattyā samāśvāsayati - buddharakṣitāpriyasakhīti/ buddharakṣiteti svavisraṃbhabhūmitvaṃ tasyāḥ, priyasakhīti tasyāṃ madayantikāyā visrambhaśca pratīyate/ ato na durlabhā/ upapattyantaramapyastītyāha - api ceti/
pramathya kravyādamiti - pramathya hatvā/ kravyādamiti nirdayatvoktiḥ/ maraṇasamaye prāṇatyāgakāle ityupakārasya garīyastvam/ pariṣvaṅgaṃ āliṅganam/ taveti sarvotkṛṣṭatvaṃ prakāśyate/ anyatra aparasmin puruṣe/ kathamiva ramatāṃ kena prakāreṇa sā krīḍatu/ buddharakṣitāpriyasakhīti pūrvavākyāt sambadhyate/ yato buddharakṣitāpriyasakhītyeva saulabhyahetuḥ, tato'pi tvayā dattajīviteti, tato'pyadhikaṃ tavāmṛtāyamānaṃ sparśaṃ labdhavatīti hetutrayamanumāpakam/ saulabhyasya na kevalamanumānaṃ pratyakṣamapi pramāṇeṣu jyeṣṭhaṃ pramāṇamityāha/ tathā yathānumānaṃ tathā/ nayanayorvyāpāraḥ nirīkṣaṇaprakāraḥ/ vyaktasnehaḥ spaṣṭasnehaḥ/ stimitaramaṇīyaḥ stimitatayā tvayi niścalanibaddhatayā śobhanaḥ, alasavalitatvādibhaṅgitaraṅgitaḥ/ ciraṃ na kṣaṇamātram/ abhūditi asmābhirnissaṃśayaṃ dṛṣṭamityāha/ atra suhṛdviṣayo bhāvaḥ prakāśyate/ anumānamalaṅkāraḥ//9//
pārāsindhusambhedaḥ pārāsaṃjñāyāḥ sindhusaṃjñāyāśca mahānadyoḥ saṅgamaḥ/ avagāhyeti tava vyāghraprahārakheditatvādāśvāsanāya āvayoḥ sūryopasthānāya cetyarthaḥ/ nagarīmevetyanyato gamanāśaṅkāṃ pariharati/
parikrāmataḥ tadabhimukhaṃ gamanamabhinayataḥ/
ayamasau asāvityatra tacchabdārthamāha, idamā sāhacaryād yaḥ pūrvaṃ prastutaḥ so'yamityarthaḥ/ mahānadyoḥ pāvanatvād yāvatsamudraṃ pravṛtteśca mahatyornadyoḥ pārāsindhvoḥ/ vyatikaraḥ saṅṛgamaḥ/
madhyandinasantāpaśāntaye jalakrīḍārāgiṇībhistaruṇībhirasāvupabhujyate ityāha - ya eṣaḥ jalanibiḍitetyādi/ jalena nibiḍitaiḥ gāḍhaṃ gātre sandaṣṭaiḥ, vastrairarthataḥ svacchairvyaktāni spaṣṭadṛṣṭāni nimnāni gambhīrāṇi nābhirandhrādīni, unnatāni uttuṅgāni nitambādīni sthānāni yāsām/ parigatataṭabhūmiḥ sarvataḥ prāptatīrapradeśaḥ/ snātamātrotthitābhiḥ snātamātre kṛtamajjanatva eva jalādutthitābhirityaniṣpīḍitavastratayā jalanibiḍitavastratvopapatteḥ/ snānaphalaṃ santāpaśamanamāha - rucirāścaturaśilpinirmitatvena niravadyā ye kanakakumbhāḥ suvarṇakalaśāsta iva śrīmadābhogāḥ śobhanavistārāstuṅgā unnatāśca ye stanāḥ teṣu vinihitāni hastasvastikāni svastikākāreṇa vyatyastabaddhā hastā yābhiḥ/ ārdraśarīratayā śiśiratarataraṅgamārutasparśaśaityātiśayavāraṇārthaṃ hastavihitasvastikabaddhābhirityarthaḥ/ vadhūbhiḥ strībhiḥ/ ``yoṣā sīmantinī vadhūḥ'' ityamaraḥ/ ya eṣa parigatataṭabhūmirayamasau mahānadyoḥ vyatikara ityanvayaḥ/ atra svabhāvoktiralaṅkāraḥ/ ityaśeṣamatimaṅgalam//10//
mālatīmādhavasyetthaṃ caturthāṅkārthacarcanam/
pūrṇajyotiḥprasādena cakre pūrṇasarasvatī// //iti caturtho'ṅkaḥ//
atha pañcamo'ṅkaḥ/
atha vṛttavartiṣyamāṇakathāṃśapradarśanenottarāṅkamavatārayituṃ viṣkambhamārabhate/ ākāśayānena ākāśagamanābhinayena, bhīṣaṇojjvalaveṣā [bhīṣaṇaḥ] bhayaṅkaraḥ śūlakapālādiviśiṣṭatayā, ujjvalaḥ dīptaḥ kapilajaṭājūṭakanakakiṅkiṇyādisaṅkalanād, veṣa ākalpakalpanā yasyāḥ/ kapālakuṇḍaleti prathamāṅke ``taṃ kkhu siripavvadādo āadassa'' ityādi ``aṇusaṃjhaṃ samāacchadi'' ityantena sūcitā prakarīpātraṃ aghoraghaṇṭaśiṣyā kāpālikī ityarthaḥ/
svābhyupagatasomasiddhāntānurodhena svānubhavagocaraṃ parameśvaramātmanā parāmṛśati - ṣaḍadhiketyādi/ [ṣaḍadhikadaśanāḍīcakramadhyasthitātmā] ṣaṭsaṅkhyottaradaśasaṅkhyāviśiṣṭānāṃ nāḍīcakrāṇāṃ madhye sthitaḥ karṇikāsu sadā sannihitaḥ ātmā sphurattārūpaṃ tattvaṃ yasya/ atra nāḍīśabdena dehamadhyavartinī suṣumnākhyā brahmanāḍī vivakṣyate/ ``tasyāḥ parvaviśeṣāścakrāṇyādhārāḥ/'' iti ca āgameṣu kathyante/ tāni cakrāṇi ṣoḍaśetyāgameṣu paṭhitāni/ tadyathā - mahābindupīṭhasthānamatītasthānamāgatasthānaṃ śāntātītaṃ sūryacakraṃ vyomāmbhojaṃ pretabhūmirardhacandramārambhaṃ setubandhamājñā viśuddhiranāhataṃ maṇipūrakaṃ svādhiṣṭhānaṃ mūlādhāra iti/ teṣvādyaṃ vyomarūpāvasthātmakaniṣkalākāśaḥ, dvitīyaṃ vyāpinyavasthā, tṛtīyamunmanāvasthā, caturthaṃ samāvasthā, pañcamaṃ visargākhyaparāśaktisthānaṃ, ṣaṣṭhaṃ visargāvasthitaśāntākhyaṃ brahmarandhraṃ, saptamaṃ brahmarandhrāvasthitakarṇikāsthānagataśaktyākhyasadāśivasthānaṃ, aṣṭamaṃ sahasrārapadmasya ṣoḍaśakalātmakakesarasthānaṃ, navamaṃ nādātmakasahasradalasthānaṃ, daśamaṃ bindvātmakalalāṭamadhyavyoma, ekādaśaṃ bhruvormadhyaṃ, dvādaśamīśvarasthānaṃ kaṇṭhasthānaṃ, trayodaśaṃ rudrālayaṃ hṛdayasthānaṃ, caturdaśaṃ viṣṇusthānaṃ nābhirandhraṃ, pañcadaśaṃ brahmaṇaḥ sthānaṃ liṅgamūlaṃ, ṣoḍaśaṃ kuṇḍalinī dehamadhyamiti vibhāgaḥ/ eteṣāmādhārapadmānāṃ madhyasthitātmetyarthaḥ/ athavā- ``iḍā piṅgalā suṣumnā ca gāndhārī hastijihnikā/
suyaśālambusā pūṣā kuhūścaiva ca śaṅkhinī//
vimalā ghoṣiṇī pṛthvī tataścāpyāyanī matā/
tejovatī vāyavī ca nāḍyaḥ ṣoḍaśa kīrtitāḥ//'' iti yogaśāstroktānāṃ nāḍīnāṃ samūhasya madhyacakre hṛdayakamala ityarthaḥ/ hṛdi vinihitarūpaḥ hṛdaye viśeṣeṇa nihitaṃ, na tu nidhīyamānamityanena sākṣātkṛtatvaṃ dhvanyate, viniṣpannasamādhitvaṃ cocyate/ siddhidaḥ muktipradaḥ/ athavā aṇimādyaṣṭasiddhipradaḥ/ yadvā pātālagulikāñjanakhaḍgamudrākhyā adhikāramantrayogātmajñānākhyā vā pañcasiddhiṃ dadātīti/ tadvidāṃ tat ṣaḍadhikadaśanāḍīcakramadhyasthitātmatvaṃ gurumukhena jñātavatāṃ labdhavatāṃ vā, viderjñānārthāllābhārthādvā kvibantavyutpattyā/ avicālitamanobhiḥ ``ālasyaṃ vyādhayastīvrāḥ pramādo'sthānasaṃśayaḥ/
anavasthitacittatvamaśraddhā bhrāntidarśanam//
duḥkhāni daurmanasyaṃ ca viṣayeṣu ca lolatā/
daśaite yuñjatāṃ puṃsāmantarāyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ//'' iti, ``upasargāḥ pravartante divyāḥ ṣaṭ siddhisūcakāḥ/
pratibhā śravaṇaṃ vārttā darśanāsvādavedanāḥ//'' iti ca yogaśāstroktairantarāyairupasargaiścāvighnitaikāgryaṃ mano yeṣām/ sādhakaiḥ mantrayogasādhanapravṛttaiḥ, na tu siddhairiti yuktaṃ prakāśyate/ mṛgyamāṇaḥ anviṣyamāṇaḥ/ tattvajijñāsubhirdīrghakālanairantaryasatkārairanusandhīyamāna ityarthaḥ/ śaktibhiḥ pariṇaddhaḥ sargasthitisaṃhārādiviśeṣairmūlaśaktivyāpārabhedairyatra yatra militā marīcayaḥ tatra tatra vibhureva jṛmbhata iti abhiyuktoktaistaraṇiriva kiraṇajālairjagadvyāptaḥ/ ``pariṇāho viśālatā'' ityamaraḥ/
``tattvaṃ vastuta ekaṃ śivasaṃjñaṃ citraśaktiśatakhacitam/
śaktivyāpṛtibhedāttasyaite kalpitā bhedāḥ//'' iti bhojokteḥ/ athavā``vāmā jyeṣṭhā śivā raudrī cittonmādakarī sukhā/
kālī kalebarā bhūtadamanī ceśaśaktayaḥ//'' iti śrutyāgamasiddhābhirnavabhiḥ śaktibhiḥ samantād baddhaḥ sevitaḥ/ śaktināthaḥ ``cidacidanugrahahetostasya sisṛkṣorya ādya unmeṣaḥ/
tacchaktitattvamabhihitamavibhāgāpannamasyaiva//'' iti lakṣitāyāḥ svāvyatiriktāyāḥ sarvakartryāḥ pṛthivyādisadāśivāntānāṃ catustriṃśattattvānāmudayavilayasthānabhūtāyāḥ pañcastriṃśyāḥ śakteḥ svāmī ṣaḍtriṃśakaḥ śiva iti/
``akulaṃ śiva ityuktaṃ kulaṃ śaktiḥ prakīrtitam/
kaulaṃ tejovikāraḥ syāditi tritayanirṇayaḥ//'' iti śrīrudratantrokteḥ, śivaḥ śaktistatkāryajātaṃ ceti samastatattvānāṃ śivāgame tridhā saṅgṛhītatvāt sa tādṛśaḥ/ jayati sarvotkarṣeṇa vartata iti tadvimarśasukhasya samagrānyasukhātiśayitatvamanusandhatte/ atra nāḍīcakrādīnāṃ śāstramātraprayuktānāṃ prayogādapratītatve'pi tadvidaḥ svayaṃparāmarśatvādadoṣaḥ/ atra parameśvaraviṣayo bhāvo vyajyate/ bhāvikamalaṅkāraḥ//1//
tāṭasthyena parameśvarasya mahimānaṃ parāmṛśyedānīmātmanastadviṣayamanubhavaṃ tatphalamaṇimādisiddhiṃ ca prakāśayati - iyamidānīmahaṃ yā khalvevambhūtamīśvaraṃ guruprasādājjānāmi iyamīdṛśī ahamityarthaḥ/ idānīmityabhyāgateti ślokagatena sambandhaḥ/
nityanyastetyādi/ nityanyaste sadā tattat sthāneṣu sthāpite, nityagrahaṇāttadaikāgryaṃ prakāśyate, ṣaḍaṅgacakre hṛdayādyaṅgaṣaṭkacakre, nihitaṃ tannyāsasya sānnidhyahetutvāt/
``sarvajñatā tṛptiranādibodhaḥṣṭasvatantratā nityamaluptaśaktiḥ/
anantaśaktiśca vibhorvidhijñāṣṭaṣaḍāhuraṅgāni maheśvarasya//'' ityuktānāṃ svajātiyuktānāṃ ṣaṇṇāmaṅgānāṃ hṛdayaśiraḥśikhākavacanetrāstrasthānanyastānāṃ samudāye sphuritamityarthaḥ/ athavā ṣaṭsu aṅgacakreṣu śārīreṣvādhārapadmeṣu mūlādhārasvādhiṣṭhānamaṇipūrakānāhataviśuddhyājñāsaṃjñeṣu nityanyasteṣu kramāccatuṣṣaḍdaśadvādaśaṣoḍaśadvidaleṣu vādisāntairbādilāntairḍādiphāntaiḥ kādiṭhāntairādivisargāntairhakṣābhyāṃ ca nityaṃ kṛtanyāseṣu sannihitamityarthaḥ/ pa (ñcā ṛdmā) nāmupadeśagamyatvāddhṛdayakamalasphuraṇasya tu sarvalokānubhavagocaratayā hṛtpadmamadhye uditaṃ viśeṣataḥ prakāśamānamityarthaḥ/ nahi kaścit mama śirasi haste pāde vā jñānamiti manyate, sarvo'pi mama hṛdyevaṃ pratibhātīti hṛdayadarpaṇapratibimbitatvena caitanyaṃ pratipādyate/ ātmānaṃ aṅguṣṭhamātraṃ jyotirmayaṃ jīvātmānam/ layavaśācchivarūpiṇaṃ suṣumnārandhrodgatayā nīvāraśūkavat tanīyasyā svabhāsā dvādaśāntasthaparamaśivenaikyabhāvanayā līnadrutatvāt kaṭakamiva kanakapiṇḍena, tadrūpaṃ śivarūpiṇaṃ śivatvamāpannam/ paśyantī na tu cintayantīti sākṣātkāraṃ dyotayati/ idaṃ ca sākāranirākārayornirākāraṃ dhyānam/ yathāha gurudevaḥ- ``sākāraṃ dhyānamuddiṣṭaṃ nirākāramathocyate/
hṛtpadme vā bhruvormadhye bindau vā dvādaśāntake//
laiṅgikaṃ paramaṃ jyotirdhyāyedaṅguṣṭhāmātrakam/
tasmānnīvāraśūkābhaṃ jyotirūrdhvaṃ suṣumnayā//
nirgataṃ dvādaśāntasthaśivenāpyekatāṃ gatam/
viśvamāvṛtya tad vyāptaṃ dhyāyenniścalamānasaḥ//
dhyānānāmuttamastvetadyogaścāyaṃ paro mataḥ/
evaṃ satatayuktātmā yogī nirdhūtabandhanaḥ//
aṇimādiguṇaiśvaryaṃ prāpya nirvāṇamṛcchati//'' iti/ layo nāmānthānupraveśāt svarūpabhedānupalambhaḥ/ ``līye parabrahmaṇi'', ``līnaṃ pare brahmaṇi yasya cetaḥ'' iti, ``sthitametat/ yasya yato notpattistasya tasmin vṛttiḥ pralayo, na svarūpalayaḥ'' ityādyācāryaprayogāt/ nāḍīnā iḍādīnāmityāśrayāśrayiṇorabhedopacāro bahuvacanaṃ ca/ nāḍīdvayadvārabhūtayonāsāpuṭayorapyabhivyajyamānānāṃ mahābhūtānāmityarthaḥ/ udayaḥ prādurbhāvaḥ/ ``puṭayorubhayośca daṇḍasaṃsthāṣṭapṛthivī toyamadhaḥ kṛśānurūrdhvam/
pavanastiryaṅ naso'tha madhyeṣṭagaganaṃ bhūtagatistanūdbhaveyam//'' ityācāryopadiṣṭenābhivyaktiprakāreṇa tattadbhūtodayaḥ, tattatsvīkaraṇasya saukaryamityarthaḥ/ jagataḥ prāṇināṃ, prāṇibhyo vā/ pañcāmṛtākarṣaṇāt pañcavidhasya amṛtasya svīkaraṇāt, śabdasparśarasarūpagandhānāṃ sāro yaḥ sañjīvanatvādamṛtākhyastasyāmṛtākarṣaṇyākhyayā vidyayā samākṛṣyāsādanenāpyāyitatvāt/ athavā kaulikatantraparibhāṣitasya``viṭ ca mūtramasṛṅ majjā śuklaṃ pañcāmṛtaṃ smṛtam/'' ityamṛtapañcakasya, tasyāpi śarīrāvasthātmakatvādamṛtatvoktiḥ/ asminnarthe tattadvāhinīnāṃ nāḍīnām utpattikrameṇetyarthaḥ/
``amṛtākarṣiṇī caiva śabdākarṣaṇarūpiṇī/'' ityādyāgamapratipāditatvād amṛtākarṣiṇyādividyānām/ aprāptotpatanaśramā gaganaśikharoḍḍayanakhedamanupagatavatī/ vighaṭayantī sammilitāvegapavanena tūlajālavad dikṣu vikṣipantī/ agrenabhaḥ nabhaso'gre, ākāśasyoparibhāge/
``sarve yogavibhāgena samāsāḥ syuralakṣitāḥ/'' iti aluk/ ambhomucaḥ meghān/ athavā agre purobhāge, nabhombhomucaḥ gaganatatānmeghānityarthaḥ/ idānīmahamabhyāgatā ``siripavvadādo aṇusaṃjhaṃ āacchaï'' iti pūrvaprastāvādidānīmeva śrīparvatānnirgatā/ idānīmevābhyāgatetyāścaryatvaṃ vegasyāha/ abhilaṣitadeśasya jhaṭiti prāptyā harṣo vyajyate/ atiśayoktiḥ svabhāvoktiścālaṅkāraḥ//2//
atha gamanavegamupakāratvena camatkaroti - udvṛttetyādi/ udvṛttā utpatanavegena sthānāduccalitā, skhalitā punarnivṛttā ca yā kapālakaṇṭhamālā śiraḥkarparamayī kaṇṭhabhūṣaṇārthā mālā, tasyāḥ saṅghaṭṭanenāsphālanena kvaṇitāḥ śabditāḥ karālāḥ vikṛtāḥ, nānāprakāratvāt, kiṅkiṇyaḥ kṣudraghaṇṭikāstāḥ api arthāt kaṇṭhamālātvena sthitā yatra/ paryāptaṃ sampūrṇam/ ramaṇīyaḍāmaratvaṃ ujjvalatvaṃ bhayaṅkaratvaṃ ca/
``prasṛmarasamaroḍḍāmaraujā biḍaujāḥ/'' iti murāryuktam/ mayi sandhatte saṃśleṣayati/ [gaganatalaprayāṇavegaḥ] gaganatale yat prayāṇaṃ tasya vegaḥ rayaḥ//3//
tatsandhānamevopapādayati-viṣvagvṛttirityādi/ sarvato vṛttiryasyeti tatkālaviśeṣaṇam/ pracalati prakarṣeṇa kampate/ nibiḍagranthibandhaḥ dṛḍhagrathano bandhaḥ bandhasādhanaṃ paṭṭāṃśukādi yasya/ bhāraḥ samūhaḥ/
``nibiḍaṃ nibirīsañca dṛḍhaṃ sāndraṃ nirantaram/'' iti vaijayantī/ ``nerbiḍacbirīsacau'' (5-2-32) iti biḍacpratyayaḥ/ saṃskārakvāṇadīrghaṃ vīcītaraṅganyāyena prathamaśabdotpāditaiḥ śabdasantānairanuraṇanāparaparyāyaiścirakālāvasthāyi yathā tathetyarthaḥ/ paṭu svata eva spaṣṭaṃ yathā tathā/ raṭati śabdāyate/ kṛtāvṛtti punaḥpunarjihvāghaṭṭanena kṛtā āvṛttiḥ paunaḥpunyaṃ yathā tatheti trayaṃ raṭanakriyāviśeṣaṇam/ khaṭvāṅgaghaṇṭā khaṭvāṅgaṃ nāma khaṭvāpādasadṛśa āyudhaviśeṣaḥ, ``mahokṣaḥ khaṭvāṅgaṃ paraśurajinaṃ bhasma phaṇinaḥ/'' ityādyācāryavacanāt, tasya śirasi baddhā ghaṇṭā/ ūrdhvam upari, dhūnoti kampayati/ dhuñ dhūñiti ca kampanāthag dhātū/ dhūñi idaṃ rūpam/ vivṛtaśavaśiraḥśreṇikuñjeṣu vyāttamukhānāṃ kapālānāṃ śreṇirmālā, tasyā randhreṣu praveśād guñjan śabdāyamānaḥ/ ``guñji avyakte śabde'' iti dhātuḥ/ uttālam uddhatam, svaskandhavartitvācca/ kiṅkiṇīnāṃ bhūṣaṇabaddhakṣudraghaṇṭikānām/ ``kiṅkiṇyaḥ kṣudraghaṇṭikāḥ'' ityamaraḥ/ anavarataraṇatkārahetuḥ anavaratasya aviśrāntasya raṇatkārasya hetuḥ/ patākāṃ dhvajāṃśukam, khaṭvāṅgasyeti prakaraṇāt/ adholambanasvabhāvādūrdhvaṃ dhūnoti/ khaṭvāṅge svaprānte ca yathā samaṃ vartate tathā calayatītyarthaḥ, ``yaṣṭyagre ca samaṃ sthito dhvajapaṭaḥ prānte ca vegānilāt/'' ityuktavat/ atra kāvyaliṅgamalaṅkāraḥ, ramaṇīyaḍāmaratvasandhānasya hetorvākyārthatayopādānāt svabhāvoktiśca//4//
vilokya adha ityarthāt/ purāṇena cirakālātikrānteneti kaṭutaragandhatvamāha/ nimbatailena picumandasnehena/
``ariṣṭaḥ sarvatobhadrahiṅguniryāsamālakāḥ/
picumandaśca nimbaḥ'' ityamaraḥ/ abhyaktasya siktasya, paribharjyamānasya paritaḥ pacyamānasya rasonasya laśunasya raso dravaḥ, tasya gandho yeṣām/
``laśune gṛñjanāriṣṭamahākandarasonakāḥ/'' ityamaraḥ/ ``nimbe tiktakaḥ'' iti durgandhaprakaraṇe vaijayantī/ ato nimbatailasya tiktagandhatayā, tatsadṛśagandhasya rasonasya tadavasekena bharjyamānasya tiktakaṭugandhavirasatvāttattulyagandhatvaṃ citādhūmānāmapi dahyamānaśavaśatalomakeśādigandhagarbhatayetyavagantavyam/ citā śavadāhārthaḥ kāṣṭhasañcayaḥ/ ``citā cityā citiḥ striyāṃ'' iti vaijayantī/ tatsambandhibhirdhūmaiḥ viyati prasaradbhirliṅgatvenādhastādvartitayā vibhāvitasya prakāśitasya, mahataḥ mahānagarasambandhādvistīrṇasyetyanena janabāhulyājjāyamānānāmiva mriyamāṇānāmapyasaṃkhyatvācchavabāhulyaṃ prakāśyate/ vakṣyati ca ``bhūyasībhyaścitābhyaḥ'' ( la. 17) iti/ śmaśānavāṭasya pitṛvanapradeśasya, nedīyaḥ antikatamam, karālāyatanaṃ karālāsaṃjñitāyāścāmuṇḍāyā ālayaḥ/ ``atthi ettha ṇārīe'' ityādi pūrvaprastutaṃ saṃghaṭayati/ paryavasitamantrasādhanasya samāptamantrasya, mahābhairavavidyādeḥ/ sādhanaṃ kalpoktaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ yasya samavasitetyanenāmaṅgalaṃ ca bhāvi sūcyate/ etāvatyeva tasya mantrasādhanaṃ sampūrṇamataḥ paraṃ pareṣyatvāditi sūcanāt/ ājñayā niyogāt/ adya saviśeṣamiti puraścaraṇārambhadivasādārabhya taddinaparyantaṃ sāmānyapūjāyā nivṛttatvāt ``aṇusaṃjhaṃ āacchaï'' ityanenārthasya prāgeva sūcitatvāt/ pūjāsambhāraḥ arcanārthasya madhumāṃsāderdravyasya sāmagrī, sannidhāpanīyaḥ sannihitaḥ kartavyaḥ/ yatra tadidamityanvayaḥ/ saviśeṣamiti sūcitaṃ viśeṣaṃ bhaṅgyā prakāśayati - kathitaṃ hīti uktaṃ yasmāt/ me guruṇeti tasya svasyāṃ visrambhaḥ, svasyāśca taduktyā santoṣaḥ prakāśyate/ prāṅ mantrasādhanārambhadivase/ upayācitaṃ dāsyāmīti pratiśrutam/
``tvayā purastādupayācito yaḥ/'' iti raghuvaṃśokteḥ/ strīratnamiti upayācanaprakāraṃ sūcayati, ubhayakulaśuddhatvādrūpalakṣaṇādisampannatvācca strījāteḥ śreṣṭhāṃ kanyāṃ mantrasādhanāvasāne pūrṇāhutitvenopahariṣyāmīti pratiśrutamityarthaḥ/ ratnaśabdaḥ svajātiśreṣṭhamāha/ aśvaratnaṃ gajaratnaṃ maṇiratnamityādiprayogadarśanāt/ upahartavyamityāvaśyake kṛtyapratyayaḥ/ atraiveti karālādhiṣṭhitāyāṃ padmāvatyāmevetyāsa (kte ṛtte)rākarṣaṇasaukaryaṃ dyotayati/ viditaṃ ``asmin gṛhe vartate'' iti pūrvamevānviṣya jñātamityarthaḥ/ āste vartate iti asmāt kathitam/ ataḥ saviśeṣamiti tadākarṣaṇamapi kartavyamityarthaḥ/
``na khalu mahāmāṃsavikrayādanyamupāyāntaram'' ityupakṣiptāya mahāmāṃsavikrayāya makarandaṃ vañcayitvā ātmanaiva śmaśānaṃ praviśato nāyakasya praveśanaṃ sūcayati - taditi/ yanmamāpi kautukaṃ janayati tasmānnirūpaṇīya evāyamityarthaḥ/ atigambhīramadhurākṛtiḥ atyantamaparicchedyā manoharānulbaṇā vā ākṛtiḥ śarīrasaṃsthānaṃ yasya/ anenaitannimitteyamasya pravṛttirityākāreṅgitābhyāmaśakyajñānatvaṃ prakāśyate/
``yasya prakārādākāre krodhaharṣabhayādayaḥ/
santo'pi nopalakṣyante gāmbhīryaṃ tat pracakṣate//'' iti divākaraḥ/ uttambhitakuṭilakuntalaḥ ūrdhvabaddhā vakrā alakā yasya/ anena nirbhayatvena vetālādibhirapi pakṣe samarāya sannaddhatvaṃ dyotyate/ kṛpāṇapāṇiḥ haste arthāddakṣiṇe khaḍgo yasya/ ``praharaṇārthebhyaḥ pare niṣṭhāsaptamyau'' (vā. 2-2-37) bhavata iti vaktavyamiti samāsaḥ/ anena priyāvirahamahāpatpratīkāradhiyā mahāmāṃsavikrayodyuktasya śastradhāraṇaṃ droṇādīnāmiva na doṣa iti sūcayati kaviḥ/ āpadi brāhmaṇasya kṣatriyadharmasya śastradhāraṇādīnāmaniṣiddhatvāt/
``ajīvaṃstu yathoktena brāhmaṇaḥ svena karmaṇā/
jīvet kṣatriyadharmeṇa sa hyasya pratyagantaraḥ//'' iti manuvacanāt/
kuvalayadaletyādi/ nīlotpalapatravat snigdhaśyāmalaḥ/ prakṛtyā paridhūsaraṃ sarvato'snigdhavarṇam asaṃskārāt/ lalitavikaṭanyāsaḥ prakṛtyā sagarvatvād ramaṇīyaḥ tvarayā vikaṭaḥ pūrvasmād virūpaḥ, ``vikaṭaṃ tu virūpaṃ syād'' iti vaijayantī, nyāso arthāt padayoḥ nikṣepo yasya/ śrīmān ekākyapi bahujanaparivṛta iva tejoviśeṣānumitalakṣmīka ityarthaḥ/ mṛgāṅkanibhānanaḥ candravat prasannamukhaḥ/ mṛgāṅketyanena viṣādamalinimāpi kiñcidvidyata iti dyotyate/ ubhābhyāṃ bhāvinaṃ vijayamāsūtrayati/ anyathā ``udyatānāṃ hi yuddhārthaṃ yeṣāṃ bhavati lakṣaṇam/
niṣprabhaṃ vadanaṃ teṣāṃ bhavatyāyuḥparikṣaye//'' iti rāmāyaṇokteḥ/ ko'yamiti sambadhyate/ harati tiraskaroti/ vinayaṃ śāstraniścayajanitaṃ manaḥparipākam/ haratītyanena tasya vastuto vidyamānatvamāha, avidyamānasya haraṇānupapatteḥ/ tatra hetuḥ - prakāśitasāhasaḥ sāhasamavivekitvaṃ prakāśitaṃ yena/ pravigaladasṛkpaṅkaḥ tatkṣaṇacchedāt māṃsasya prakarṣeṇa kṣaradrudhirakardamo yasmin/ lalannarajāṅgalaḥ vilasannaramāṃsaḥ/ ``lala vilāsa'' iti dhātuḥ/
``payasā mudgayūṣeṇa jāṅgalānāṃ rasena vā/'' iti vāhaṭokteḥ/ atra naragrahaṇenoparyapi nṛmāṃsapaṇanāyeti nṛgrahaṇāt svamāṃsavikrayabuddhirna kāryā, mahāmāṃsavikraya iti prakārabhedena puruṣopahārasyaiva kathanāt puruṣāṅgopakalpitamiti vakṣyamāṇatvācca/ anyathā ``lalannijajāṅgalaḥ'' iti bhrāmyan svamāṃsapaṇanāyeti ca vaktavyam/ jāṅgalagrahaṇena kṛpāṇakhaṇḍitāt puruṣadehādupahārayogyatvena kalpakathitaṃ māṃsaṃ vapādivad gṛhītamiti darśayati/ ayameva cāsya puruṣopahārād bhedaḥ/ atra raudraraso vyajyate/ bhāvikamalaṅkāraḥ, tadbhāvasya sphuṭapratīteḥ/ aprastutapraśaṃsā ca, kāryamukhena kāraṇasyodvegasya pratipādanāt//5//
nirūpya nipuṇaṃ vicārya/ lakṣaṇaiḥ pratyabhijñāyetyarthaḥ/ kāmandakīsuhṛdaḥ devarātasya putraḥ/ anena tasyāḥ snehabhūmitvaṃ dyotyate/ asyāśca tatsambandhaparijñānakathanaṃ vakṣyamāṇasya saudāminīmukhena mālatīrakṣaṇasya ghaṭanārtham/ mahāmāṃsasya paṇitā vikretā/ ``vyavahṛpaṇoḥ samarthayoḥ'' (2-3-57) iti vikrayārthasya paṇeḥ prayoge karmaṇī ṣaṣṭhī/ paṇitaiṣa sa mādhavaḥ ityanvayaḥ/ tat kimanena tasmāt pūrvadṛṣṭatvāt kimidānīmasminnapūrvavat kautukaṃ kriyata ityarthaḥ/ yathāsamīhitam upakrāntamanatikramya kāryaṃ nirvartayāmi/ athavā yathā yathāvaditi pṛthakpadam/ samīhitaṃ iṣṭārtham ityarthaḥ/ vigalitaprāyaḥ bāhulya[lye]nāpakrānta[ḥ]/ kiñciccheṣa ityarthaḥ/
tadupapādanaṃ tathāhīti/
vyomna ityādi - vyomnaḥ ākāśasya/ tāpiñchagucchāvalibhiḥ kākatuṇḍikāstabakānāṃ śreṇibhiḥ/ ``tāpiñchaḥ kākatuṇḍikā'' iti halāyudhaḥ/ ``guccho gulucchastabakaḥ'' iti vaijayantī/ athavā tamālaḥ/ ``kālaskandhastamālaḥ syāttāpiñcho'pi'' ityamaraḥ/ tamovallarībhiḥ tata itaḥ sābhibhūyodgamāt timiramañjarībhirityuktiḥ/ ``vallarī mañjarī striyām'' ityamaraḥ/ athavā ``dīrghajaṭāvallarī'' iti, ``gajabhagne patanāya vallarī/'' ityādiprayogaiḥ pratatāyatatvāttamolatābhirityarthaḥ/ vriyante cchādyante/ paryantāḥ samīpadeśāḥ, diṅmukhānītyarthaḥ/ uparyevam/ adhastāttu prāntavṛtyā prāntānāṃ jaladhivelāpradeśānāṃ vṛtirvaraṇaṃ chādanaṃ tayā tamonimittayā hetubhūtayā/ athavā vṛttiḥ kramaḥ, prāntakrameṇetyarthaḥ/ payasi jale/ nūtane nave/ kardamakaluṣatayā nīlapāṭale varṣavāripūra ityarthaḥ/
``paryāvilānīva navodakāni/'' ityuktavat/ anena sandhyānubandhaśabalatvaṃ tamasaḥ prakāśyate/ ``sandhyānubandhatāmre pariṇatatālaphalatviṣi medinī nimīlayati navapayasi tamasi'' iti harṣacaritokteḥ/ vasumatī bhūmiḥ/ majjati avagāḍhā bhavati/ vartamānanirdeśāt kramo majjanasya prakāśyate/ madhye punaḥ vātyāyāḥ saṃvegena mahatā javena viṣvagvitatāyāḥ sarvato vistāritāyā valayitāyāstenaiva vartulīkṛtāyāḥ sphītāyāḥ sāndrāyāḥ dhūmyāyāḥ dhūmasaṃhateḥ prakāśaḥ śobheva śobhā yasya/ ``vātyā vātastu maṇḍalī'', ``dhūmyā vātyā vanyā'' iti, ``tattadvṛnde sarvam'' iti ca vaijayantī/ gaganamaṇḍalasya tamasā saṅkucitavarttulākṛtitvena pratītervalayitopamānagrahaṇam/ prārambhe svāvirbhāvamātre/ apirvirodhe/ triyāmā rātriḥ/ taruṇayati taruṇaṃ yuvānaṃ karoti/ ``tat karoti'' iti ṇic/ nijaṃ svataḥ siddhaṃ nīlimānaṃ śyāmavarṇatvam/ ``pṛthvādibhya imanijvā'' (5-1-122) iti imanic/ vaneṣviti patrapallavādibahalatayā divāpyapraviṣṭasūryakiraṇatvāt tadānīṃ palvalottīrṇavarāhayūthatvādibhiśca viśeṣataḥ śyāmāyamānatvaṃ prakāśyate/ atra tamovallarībhirhetunotprekṣyate-vyomnaḥ paryantāstāpiñchagucchāvalībhiḥ prālambabhūtābhirvriyanta iveti, prāntavṛtyā vasumatī nūtane payasi majjatīveti ca/ tata eva hetostriyāmā vaneṣu nijaṃ nīlimānaṃ prārambhe'pi taruṇayatīti/ śaiśave sampūrṇasvarūpābhivyaktyabhāvādyauvana eva tadupapatteḥ śaiśave'pi yuvānaṃ karotīveti dyotakaśūnyotprekṣā/ buddhipūrvasya taruṇatvasyāsambhavād atiśayoktirvā, asaṃbandhe sambandhakathanāt/ vākyatraye krameṇa prālambāvalambanairivāmbaravimānasya saviśeṣaramaṇīyatvam, upāntyāntyakrameṇa sarvasyā bhūmeravyaktībhavanam, sthūlāntarebhyo'pi vanāntarasya nibiḍanīlimatvaṃ ca prakāśyate/ aprastutapraśaṃsā cātra vyajyate//6//
uparyadho'ntarāle ca jagataḥ timirakabalitatvādasmadabhimatasādhanasamucitasamayasampattyā tadarthaṃ niryantraṇamidānīṃ pravartāmahe ityasyārthasya kāraṇamukhena prakāśanād vṛttasya mādhavaśmaśānāvataraṇasya vartiṣyamāṇasya mālatyupahārasya ca darśitatvād viṣkambhaṃ samāpayati - niṣkrānteti/ //viṣkambhakaḥ//
atha sūcitasya nāyakasya praveśamukhena sarasavastuprayogāyāṅkamārabhate - tataḥ praviśatīti/ yathānirdiṣṭaḥ kapālakuṇḍalayā yena prakāreṇoktastatprakāraviśiṣṭaḥ/ dakṣiṇapāṇikalitakṛpāṇakaḥ savyakarakamalalalannarapalalo latāvalayanibiḍanibaddhakuṭilakuntalakakṣyābaddhasudṛḍhacaṇḍātakastribhuvanalobhanīyena raudramadhureṇākāreṇa lalitavikaṭaṃ parikrāmannityarthaḥ/ ``na khalu mahāmāṃsavikrayādanyadupāyāntaraṃ paśyāmi'' iti pūrvāṅkāvasānopakṣiptātmanirapekṣapravṛttiprotsāhakasyābhilāṣavipralambhātmanaḥ śṛṅgārasyāṅginaḥ kavisahṛdayakulaśikhāmaṇiranusandhānaṃ karoti - sāśaṃsamiti/ āśaṃsā prārthanā tayā sahitaṃ ityabhilāṣasvarūpaṃ dyotayati/
``saṅkalpecchāsamudbhūtavyavasāyapurassaraḥ/
yastatsamāgamopāyaḥ so'bhilāṣaḥ prakīrtitaḥ//'' iti lakṣitatvāt/
premārdrā ityādi/ premṇā ārdrāḥ/
``parasparāśrayatvena nirūḍhaṃ bhāvabandhanam/
yadekāpāyato na syāt tat premeti nigadyate//
manaso yad dravārdratvaṃ viṣayeṣu mamatvataḥ/
bhayaśaṅkāvasānātmā sa eva sneha ucyate//'' iti ca, ``ārdratā śiśiratvaṃ yat sarvāvasthāsu mānasam/'' iti ca bhāvaprakāśaḥ/
``snehastu pracayādvastuprayukto vivaśaṃ naram/
satataṃ tatsamīpe tu kṣipan prematayoditaḥ//'' iti, ``yadyadasya priyaṃ veti tasya tasyāśukāritām/
yogyatāmārdratāṃ prāhṛrmanaḥkāluṣyanāśinīm//'' iti divākaraḥ/ snehotkarṣarūpeṇa premṇā śiśirāḥ sarvātmanānukūlāścetyarthaḥ/
``rathāṅganāmnoriva bhāvabandhanaṃṣṭababhūva yat prema parasparāśrayam/'' iti raghuvaṃśoktavat/ premṇaḥ prathamakathanaṃ tasyaiva ratyadhiṣṭhānatvāt/
``iśabdavācyo madano māti yatra prakarṣataḥ/
tat prema tadadhiṣṭhānaṃ rate yūnoḥ parasparam//'' iti vacanāt/ ``sati hi kuḍye citrakarma'' iti nyāyādadhiṣṭhāne hi satyadhiṣṭheyasya pratiṣṭhānaṃ bhavati/ praṇayaspṛśaḥ praṇayaṃ spṛśantīti/
``upacārairmitho yūnoryad bāhyābhyantarābhidhaiḥ/
prema nītaṃ prakarṣaṃ cet sa eṣa praṇayaḥ smṛtaḥ//'' (iti//)
bāhyāḥ āliṅganacumbanādayaḥ, ābhyantarāḥ rativiśeṣāḥ/ paricayādudgāḍharāgodayāḥ nirvighnāccirakālābhyāsādatidṛḍharāgasya udaya udbhavo yāsām/
``sa eva ced guṇadravyadeśakālādibhirhṛdi/
rajyate dīpyate citte sa rāga iti kathyate//'' (iti//)
sa eveti sneha ucyate/
``kālenāvaraṇātyayāt pariṇate yat snehasāre sthitam/'' iti uttararāmacaritoktavat/ tāstā iti tacchabdavīpsayā īrṣyāmānapraṇayamānādiśabalatvādaśakyavarṇanatvamanubhavaikagocaratvaṃ ca prakāśyate/
``ratiraṅkuritā premṇā mānāt pallavitā bhavet/
sakorakā praṇayataḥ snehāt kusumitā bhavet//
rāgāt phalavatī ceyamanurāgeṇa bhujyate//'' iti vacanāt/ mugdhadṛśa ityakṛtrimālokanasubhagatvaṃ dṛśoḥ prakāśyate, nisargamadhurāḥ svabhāvato hṛdyāḥ ceṣṭāḥ vāgaṅgasattvanirvṛttāḥ pravṛttiviśeṣāḥ/ nisargamadhurā ityanuvādaḥ/ nisargamadhurāśceṣṭāḥ premārdratvādiviśiṣṭā mayi bhaveyuriti prārthanā/ prārthane liṅ/ mayi madviṣaye, antaḥkaraṇasya yugapad jñānānutpattiliṅgonneyatā dehābhyantaravartitvād jñānasādhanatvācca/ antaḥkaraṇaṃ manaḥ tasya/ bāhyakaraṇavyāpārarodhī sthūladehāpekṣayā cakṣurādīnāmapyāntaratve'pi manopekṣayā bahirvartanād bāhyāni, jñānakarmasādhanatvācca karaṇānīti tāni bāhyakaraṇānyucyante/
``indriyāṇi parāṇyāhurindriyebhyaḥ paraṃ manaḥ/'' iti bhagavadvacanāt, ``sāmpratakālaṃ bāhyaṃ trikālamābhyantaraṃ karaṇam/'' iti ca sāṅkhyokteḥ/ teṣāṃ vyāpārāḥ draṣṭavyādigrahaṇaṃ vaktavyādivyāptiśca, tān roddhuṃ nivārayituṃ śīlaṃ yasya/ anena manasaḥ sarvendriyasārathitvāt tallaye sarvendriyalaya iti prakāśyate/ kṣaṇāditi ceṣṭānāmāśukāritvasāmarthyamāha/ āśaṃsāparikalpitāsu manorathaiḥ somaśarmapitṛvat paritaḥ kalpitāsu anubhūyamānatvena cintitāsvityarthaḥ/ apiśabdāt kimuta sākṣāt prāptāsviti vyajyate/ ānandasāndraḥ sukhena bahala ityanena tīvraduḥkhajanitānmohādvyāvṛttiḥ/
``tīvrābhiṣaṅgaprabhaveṇa vṛttiṃṣṭamohena saṃstambhayatendriyāṇām/'' ityukteḥ/ layaḥ svavyāpāroparamāt svarūpaśūnyasyeva viśrāntiḥ/ atrautsukyaṃ bhāvo vyajyate/ atiśayoktiścālaṅkāraḥ, apikṣaṇaśabdābhyāmatiśayasya prakāśitatvāt//7//
punaḥ prakārāntareṇa prārthanāmāha - api ceti/
avimuktetyādi - avimuktā kadācidapyanujjhitā/ tatra hetuḥ madgrathitā mayā gumphitā iti na punardravyagauravāt/ ata āha - kesarāvalī na punamagktikāvalīti/ tayā satatamanavaratam/ adhivāsaḥ surabhīkaraṇaṃ yasya sa cāsau prakṛtyā subhagaśca arpitaḥ cumbanaparirambhādiṣu niryantraṇaṃ dattaḥ stano yasmai/ karṇajāhaviniveśitānanaḥ karṇamūle svasya karṇapārśve viniveśitaṃ viśeṣeṇa nikṣiptaṃ mukhaṃ yasya/ anena svasya tatkapolacumbanasaṃrambho vyajyate/ ``tasya pākamūle pīlvādikarṇādibhyaḥ kuṇabjāhacau'' (5. 2. 24) iti jāhac/ priyayeti kartṛpadaṃ viniveśanakriyayā sākṣāt sambadhyate, arpaṇakriyayā tvarthāt/ apiśabdaścārthe viśeṣaṇadvayaṃ samuccinoti/ evamevamapi bhavanniti tatkālaviśeṣaṇaṃ caitat/ tadaṅgaparivṛttiṃ tasyāḥ aṅgānāṃ mujalatayorūrvośca madīyairaṅgairvinimayaṃ tadaṅgasthāne madaṅgānāṃ madaṅgasthāne ca tadaṅgānāmavasthitiḥ/ samprayogakāle prayojyaṃ tilataṇḍulakākhyamupagūhanaviśeṣamityarthaḥ/ ``śayanagatāvūruvyatyāsaṃ bhujavyatyāsaṃ ca kṛtvā sasaṅgharṣamiva yad ghanaṃ svajete tattilataṇḍulam'' iti vātsyāyanaḥ/ ekavacanena sakṛt pravṛttimātraṃ prakāśyate/ āpnuyāṃ labheya iti prārthane liṅ/ atrāpi vakṣyamāṇe ``tat paśyeyam'' ityatrāpyautsukyameva viṣayabhedādvyajyate/ atrāprastutapraśaṃsālaṅkāraḥ, kāryamukhena parasparānurāgasya prakāśanāt/ atra ``premārdrāḥ'' ityādinā cirakālamavicchinnarasamuditoditaṃ priyāsamāgamasukhamāśaṃsitam/ ``avimukte''tyādi tu tadalābhe'pi jātucidyathābhilaṣitamupagūhanamanubhūya tadanantarameva maraṇamapi varamiti dyotitam//8//
idānīṃ tadubhayamapyākṣipya tato'rvāci parvaṇyāśaṃsāmavasthāpayati - athaveti pūrvoktavyāvṛttau/ dūre tāvat manorathānāmapyabhūmāveva tādṛśasukṛtarāśerabhāvāditi bhāvaḥ/
``yāvattāvacca sākalye'vadhau māne'vadhāraṇe/'' iti vaijayantī/ etad anantarāśaṃsitaṃ dvayam/ idaṃ vakṣyamāṇameva/ tāvat prathamam/
prārthanāprakāramāha-sambhūyaivetyādi/ sambhūya samavetāni bhūtvā/ ``bhū prāptau'' iti dhātoḥ sampūrvāllyapi rūpam/ ``sambhūya kāntaiḥ pibanti'' iti vakṣyati ca/ eva-na tatra saṃśaya ityarthaḥ/ iveti vā pāṭhaḥ/ sukhaṃ ``yadarthaṃ sarvaṃ yacca nānyārthaṃ tatsukham'' iti lakṣitam/ sukhānīti yataḥ kutaścit jātāni yāni yāvanti ceti bahuvacanena vyajyate/ paraṃ bhūmānaṃ niratiśayaṃ vikāsam/ saṅkocasya duḥkharūpatvāt/ anena ``yo vai bhūmā tatsukham'' iti śrutyantavākyamapyanusmārayati kaviḥ/ yatra yasminmukhe/ ālokapathāvatāriṇi darśanasya mārgaṃ gāhamāne, na tu samīpataḥ sphuṭaṃ dṛśyamāna iti/ anena lakṣyālakṣya iva dūrato dṛśyamāna iti dyotyate/ āloketyāghrāṇāsvādādipathāvatāritvamanenaiva vyākhyātamityapi sphurati/ ratiṃ ramaṇaṃ krīḍām/ cetasītyeva/ prasnauti pravarṣati, ``śreyaḥ parisnauti tanoti kīrtim/'' itivat/ prastautīti vā, prārabhate/ netrotsavaḥ cakṣuṣorutsavaḥ/ samīpataḥ sphuṭamavalokanaṃ dūradarśananirvṛtasya manaso darpajanitāṃ naṭanādirūpāṃ krīḍāṃ karotītyarthaḥ/ ``ramu krīḍāyām'' iti dhātvarthāśrayaṇāt, na punaratra sthāyībhāvo ratirucyate/
``vyabhicārirasasthāyibhāvānāṃ śabdavācyatā/'' iti rasadoṣatvenācāryairuktatvāt/ tattve hetubhūtaṃ lokottaraṃ saundaryamāha bālendukaloccayād bālānāmapariṇatatvena mugdhalāvaṇyānāṃ candrakalānāmuccayādekatra saṅgrahādapādānāt/ apacitaiḥ svīkṛtaiḥ/ apacitaśabdastvavivakṣitavācyena dhvaninā latābhyaḥ parigṛhītaiḥ puṣpairivetyarthaṃ vyañjayati, ``suvarṇapuṣpāṃ pṛthivīṃ cinvanti puruṣāstrayaḥ/'' itivat/ sāraiḥ kāntinavanītairupādānaiḥ/ utpāditaṃ sṛṣṭamiva, na punaḥ karpūradravairiva viliptam/ anaṅgamaṅgalagṛhaṃ madanasyābhyudayasādhanaṃ bhavanam/ devatāgārādike maṅgalasthāne svasamṛddhyarthamādareṇa janaḥ satataṃ yathā sannidhatte tathāsminnaṅga ityarthaḥ/ anena tadāśrayavaśādanaṅgasya durvāravīryatvaṃ prakāśyate/ bhūyo'pi punarapīti pūrvadarśanena tṛṣṇāyā aśāntiḥ pratipādyate/ paśyeyamiti prārthane liṅ/ tasyā iti yā tathāvidhānurāgavivaśatayānubhūtā tasyā ityarthaḥ/ atra pūrvārdhe eveti pāṭhe atiśayoktiḥ, iveti pāṭhe tūtprekṣālaṅkāraḥ/ uttarārdhe punarutprekṣārūpake/ sambhūyetyādirudāhṛtiḥ utkarṣābhidhānāt/ ataḥ prārthanātrayaṃ mahāmāṃsavikrayaniṣkrayatvena devatāḥ prati yuktamiti ca veditavyam//9//
atha paśyeyamiti kṛtāṃ darśanāśaṃsāmākṣipanniva bhaṅgyā cetasastadekāśrayatvamāha - athaveti/ yat satyaṃ satyameva/ sandarśanaṃ samyak cakṣuṣā viṣayīkaraṇam/ neti tadabhāvaḥ kathyate, ``vṛṣatā klībatā jñānamajñānaṃ jīvitaṃ na vā/'' iti vāhaṭoktavat/ iti anayoḥ prakārayoḥ svalpo viśeṣaḥ laghīyān bhedaḥ/ svalpagrahaṇaṃ manaso'navasthāne darśanābhāvasya duḥkhāvahatvaṃ dhvanati/ tadevopapādayati - mama hi sampratīti/ hirhetau/ sātiśayaprāktanopalambhasambhāvitātmanaḥ buddhirupalabdhirjñānaṃ pratyaya iti paryāyāḥ/ sātiśayena vyāvṛttena prāktanena pūrvaṃ jātenopalambhenārthāt priyatamāviṣayeṇa jñānena sambhāvitātmanaḥ samyagutpāditasvarūpasya/ saṃskārasya svotpādakasajātīyotpādakastadvijātīyo guṇaḥ saṃskāraḥ tasya, arthād bhāvanārūpasya/ anavarataprabodhāt pratyūhābhāvena sadā vikāsāt/ pratāyamānaḥ vistīryamāṇaḥ/ tadvisadṛśaiḥ tacchabdena santānaḥ parāmṛśyate tasya svabhāvānyatvena viruddhaiḥ/ pratyayāntarairahamidamādibhirjñānaviśeṣairghaṭajñānasantāna iva ghaṭapaṭādipratyayaiḥ/ atiraskṛtapravāhaḥ anantaritaprasaraḥ/ pūrvottarapravāhayormadhye teṣāmananupraviṣṭatvāt/ priyatamāsmṛtipratyayotpattisantānaḥ prāṇasamāviṣayasya smṛtirūpasya jñānasya bhāvanāsaṃskārajanyajñānatvāt smṛteḥ utpattisantānaḥ udayasyāvicchedaḥ sā sā setyevaṃrūpaḥ/ tanmayaṃ priyatamāsvarūpam/ iveti vastutastasya tathātvābhāvāt/ vṛttisārūpyataḥ vṛttyā buddhivṛttirūpeṇa jñānena samānarūpatayā ekākāratayetyarthaḥ/ caitanyaṃ ātmasvarūpabhūtaṃ jñānam/ ayamarthaḥ - buddhivṛttyātmakasya priyāsmṛtipratyayasantānasya caitanyaikākāratayodayamānasyādhyānaparyāyasya ātmacaitanyaikyamāpadya vilayānnirbhedasvarūpaśūnyamivānandānubhavamātramavasthānaṃ samādhisaṃjñitaṃ sampadyata iti/ tathā cāhurabhiyuktāḥ``viruddhairaviruddhairvā bhāvairvicchidyate na yaḥ/
ātmabhāvaṃ nayatyanyān sa sthāyī lavaṇākaraḥ//'' iti/ atra ca yogavedāntaśāstrasarvapathīnena kavinā tadartho vicchittyā prakāśyate iti mantavyam/ tathā hi - niratiśayetyādinā yamādipañcāṅgīniṣpannatvamucyate, saṃskārasya iti dhāraṇā, pratāyamāna iti dhāraṇāntaṣaḍaṅgīsambhṛtatvam, tadvisadṛśairityādinā dhyānaṃ ``vijātīyapratyayānantaritasajātīyapratyayapravāhakaraṇaṃ nididhyāsanam'' iti, yogaśāstre lakṣitatvāt, ``tadrūpapratyayaikāntasantatiścānyaniḥspṛhā/
tad dhyānaṃ prathamairaṅgaiṣṣaḍbhirniṣpādyate nṛpa ṅa//'' iti śrīviṣṇupurāṇavacanācca/ tanmayamiva karotītyādinā samādhiḥ/
``tasyaiva kalpanāhīnaṃ svarūpagrahaṇaṃ hi yat/
manasā dhyānaniṣpādyaḥ samādhiḥ so'bhidhīyate//'' iti, ``ātmabhāvaṃ nayatyenaṃ tadbrahmadhyāyinaṃ mune/
vikāryamātmanaḥ śaktyā lohamākarṣako yathā//'' iti ca śrīviṣṇupurāṇokteḥ/
``sarvavyāpini cinmātre śive svaikyena bhāvanā/
avicchedena satataṃ samādhiḥ paramo mataḥ//'' iti gurudevaḥ/ vṛttisārūpyata iti idamanidaṃrūpādahaṃkārānmuñjādiṣīkāmivānidamaṃśaṃ caitanyarūpaṃ niṣkṛṣya śrutyā cācāryaprasādādahaṃ brahmāsmīti jñānena vidyākhyena buddhivṛttirūpeṇābhyastenaikākāratayā samastabhedabādhanād brahmātmatvānubhūtiḥ prabodhākhyā jāyate ityadvaitasiddhāntaṃ pratipādayannātmanastadabhirucimāsūtrayati/ atra viśeṣaṇasāmyādaprastutasya gamyatvena samāsoktiralaṅkāraḥ/ priyatamārūpaprastutavastvavacchedakatvenāprastutasya paramātmanaḥ pratīteḥ/
sāpi laukike vastuni śāstrīyavastuvyavahārasamāroparūpatanmayīkaraṇamevopapādayati - tathā hi - līnevetyādi/ līneva yataḥ kutaścid bhiyā hiyā vāpavarakasthānīye cetasyanupraviśya saṃśliṣṭevetyarthaḥ/ ``sitāravindapracayeṣu līnāḥ''ṃ, ``divākarādrakṣati yo guhāsu līnam''ṃ, ``tiraścakāra bhramarābhilīnayoḥ'' ityādiṣu līnaśabdasya saṃyogasambandhamātravācakatvāvagamāt/ athavā vyāpakasya bāhyasya vastunaḥ kathamaṇumātre'ntaḥ praveśa ityāśaṅkyāha - pratibimbiteva mukurāyamāṇe tasmiṃśchāyātmanānupraviṣṭeveti/ pratibimbapraveśasyāvāstavatve'pi, ``chāyāmivādarśatalaṃ praviṣṭām/'', ``mukhamindurujjvalakapolamataḥ pratimācchalena sudṛśāmaviśat/'', ``bolantiapecchantapaḍimāsakantadhavalaghaṇasaṅgho/'' ityādiṣu tatpraveśaprasiddherevamuktiḥ/ bimbamukurayoranyatarāpāye pratibimbāpāyamāśaṅkyāha - likhiteva phalakāyite tasmin varṇaistūlikayā nirmiteveti/ salilādiviruddhopanipātāttadvināśamāśaṅkyāha - utkīrṇarūpeva stambhakalpe tasminniśitaṭaṅkatakṣaṇenākāriteveti, ``yaḥ kṣatradehaṃ paritakṣya ṭaṅkaistapomayairbrāhmaṇamuccakāra/'' iti murāryuktavat/
``stambheṣu yoṣitpratiyātanānāmutkrāntavarṇakramadhūsarāṇām/'' ityuktanyāyena kālavaśāttatrā'pi vaivarṇyādikamāśaṅkyāha - pratyupteva kanakarucasadṛśe tasmin māṇikyādivat sākṣādeva kṣepaṇena sthāpiteva/
``anargharatnapratyuptakāñcīyutanitambinīm/'' ``tasyollasatkāñcanakuṇḍalāgrapratyuptagārutmataratnabhāsā/'', ``pratyuptaḥ padmarāgeṇa prabhāmaṇḍalabandhinā/'' ityādiprayogeṣu prativāpasya ratnanikṣepaviṣayatvena darśanāt/ tatrāpi kṣepaṇavaśādasamagradarśanatvamāśaṃkyāha - vajralepaghaṭiteva pīṭhadeśīye tasmin devatāpratimādivad vajralepākhyenauṣadhena dṛḍhaṃ śleṣiteveti/
``lākṣāsarjarasaḥ śaṅkhaḥ sikatā triphalārasaḥ/
kunduruṣkaṃ ca saṃpiṣṭaṃ vajralepo'yamīritaḥ//'' iti siddhāntasārokteḥ/ tatrāpi kālavaśād bandhaśaithilyena calanamāśaṅkyāha - antarnikhāteva kṣititalatulite tasmin nidhānādivadavadāryābhyantare nihiteveti/ antaḥśabdo līnevetyādibhiḥ pratyekamabhisambandhanīyaḥ/ anayā pūrvapūrvākāṃkṣānivāritayotprekṣāśṛṅkhalayā antaḥpraviṣṭaiva niravagamaiva nirnāśaivāmlānalāvaṇyaiva samagradarśanaiva kṣaṇamapyacalitaiva priyā cetasi lagnetyatiśayito'rthaḥ sahṛdayahṛdayahārī samarpyate/
parasparanirapekṣatayā vyākhyāne kaścamatkāraḥ/ utprekṣābāhulyaṃ ca nirarthakamāpadyeta/ anyatamayaiva lagnatāmātrapratītisiddheḥ/ kriyotprekṣā ceyam, laganakriyāyā layanādikriyātvena sambhāvanāt/ utkīrṇarūpetyatra samāsasya sambandhisandhāyitvāt sambandhasya siddhadharmatvena guṇatve'pi utkiraṇakriyāyā atra prādhānyena vivakṣitatvāt kriyotprekṣaiveti mantavyam/ athātra heturutprekṣyate/ sā yā sātiśayaprāktanopalambhaviṣayībhūtā/ naḥ prāṇebhyo'pi tāmabhilāṣukāṇāmasmākamityarthaḥ/ kīlitā kīlaḥ aṇiḥ kavāṭatulye tasmin kanakapaṭṭikāvat sañjātakīlaṃ kṛteva/ ``tat karoti'' iti ṇic/ ``dhruvaḥ kīlo'pyaṇirnnaṣaṇṇi[]'' iti vaijayantī/ viśikhaiḥ śaraiḥ cetobhuvaḥ cittajanmanaḥ, saṅkalpayonitvāt kāmasya/ pañcabhiriti prasiddhāyā api saṃkhyāyā grahaṇaṃ pañcāṅgyāmāhatairaṇibhūtaiḥ kīlanaṃ prakāśayati/ teṣāmavicchinnapātāttathotprekṣaṇam/ cintāsantatitantujālanibiḍasyūteva cintāyā anudhyānasya pravāhaścintāsantatiḥ saiva tantujālaṃ sūtrasamūhaḥ sūkṣmāyatatvāt tena nibiḍaṃ suśliṣṭaṃ yathā tathā syūtā nunnā sūcīmukhaniveśitena tantujālena paṭe paṭāntaravaccintāsantatyā syūteva/ ``sūtrāṇi taritantavaḥ'' iti vaijayantī/ syūteti bandhanārthasya sīvyateḥ niṣṭhāntasya rūpam/ ivaśabdo'tra sarvatrotprekṣādyotakaḥ/ cakārāḥ pādapūraṇārthāḥ/ ``tu hi ca smaha vai pādapūraṇe'' iti vacanāt/ asadarthapadādvaraṃ hi nirarthakatvaṃ doṣaḥ/ yata eva lagnā, atastanmayamiva karoti/ tataśca sandarśanatadabhāvayoḥ svalpo viśeṣa iti pūrvapūrvasyottarottaro hetutvenopāttaḥ/ tataśca sandarśanaprāyeṇa saṅkalpasamāgamena, kiñcidāvegaśāntiḥ prakāśyate/ utprekṣālaṅkāraḥ//10//
aho saṃpratīti aho ityāścaryadyotakam/ kālaviśeṣād balopalambhaṃ tāmasānāṃ bhūtaviśeṣāṇāṃ prakāśayati/ tadevāha - sampratīti/ kṛṣṇacartudaśīpradoṣasya vartamānatvādityarthaḥ/ ``ajja kasaṇacaüddasi tti'' ityuktatvāt, ``kasaṇacaüddasie mahāmasāṇe'' iti vakṣyamāṇatvācca/ tāmasānāṃ ca niśā balakarī/ kiṃ punarbhūtadinasya kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāḥ sambandhinī/
``tato hi balino rātrāvasurā devatā divā/'' iti śrīviṣṇupurāṇavacanāt/ pravardhamānabalenāvāryamāṇaḥ pravartamānaḥ sañcaritumārabhamāṇaḥ kauṇapānāṃ śavāśanānāṃ rakṣaḥpiśācānāmityarthaḥ/ nikaraḥ samūho yasmin/ raudratā bhīṣaṇatvam/ asmin śmaśāne/
paryantetyādi/ paryantapratirodhi samīpadeśāvārakaṃ meduradhanastyānaṃ salilabharitatayā sāndrasnigdhaśyāmalo megha iva saṃhatam/ ``sāndrasnigdhaṃ tu meduram'' ityamaraḥ/ [styānaṃ] ``styai ṣṭyai saṃghātaśabdayoḥ'' ityasmānniṣṭhā/ citājyotiṣāṃ śavadahanakāṣṭhasañcayalagnānāmagnīnām/ aujjvalyaṃ prabhonmeṣam/ [parabhāgaḥ] guṇotkarṣaḥ ``parabhāgo guṇotkarṣaḥ'' iti vaijayantī/ tena, prakaṭayati sphuṭaṃ karoti/ asitakapilavarṇayorviruddhatayā parasparonmeṣakaraṇāt/ ``samprāde[mproda]śca kaṭac'' (5-2-29)/ ābhogabhīmaṃ vistīrṇatayā bhayāvaham/ tamaḥ timiraṃ kartṛbhūtam/ tamaḥśabdopādānāttāmasajanāhlādakatvaṃ dyotyate/ ata āha - saṃsaktākulakelayaḥ saṃsaktāḥ prasaktāḥ ākulāḥ sambhramaviśiṣṭāḥ eko'nyamabhidhāvati, anyo'paramākarṣati, aparaḥ parasmin patatītyevamādiprakārasaṃkulā ityarthaḥ la kalayaḥ krīḍāḥ yaiḥ/ kilikilākolāhalaiḥ kilikileti nīcajanmanāṃ harṣaśabdānukāraḥ, ``tataḥ kilikilāyante'' iti śrīrāmāyaṇe vānaraviṣayatvenokteḥ tadrūpaiḥ [kolāhalaiḥ] kalakalaiḥ [sammadāt] ``pramadasammadau harṣe'' (3-3-68) iti nipātanāt sammado harṣaḥ, tato hetoḥ/ uttālā niryantraṇāḥ/ kaṭapūtanāprabhṛtayaḥ jaraṭhakaṭaprāvṛtāḥ piśācīviśeṣāḥ kaṭapūtanāḥ/ athavā piśācajātiviśeṣāḥ/
``kaṭadhūmasya saurabhyamavaghrāya vrajaukasaḥ/'' iti śrībhāgavate/ kaṭaśabdenaiva piśācyā abhidhānāt/ ``vāntāgnyulkāmukhaḥ preto vipro bhavati vicyutaḥ/
amedhyakuṇapāśī tu kṣattriyaḥ kaṭapūtanaḥ''ṃ//
iti manuvacanācca/ ṭābantaprayogaśca piśācastrīvācakaḥ/ pūtanacakramiti puṃvācakasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt/ ata eva jātyantarasaṃgrahaṇāya prabhṛtigrahaṇam/ ``ḍākinyo yātudhānyaśca kūśmāṇḍā ye'rbhakagrahāḥ/
bhūtapretapiśācāśca yakṣarakṣovināyakāḥ''ṃ//
ityādayaḥ purāṇapaṭhitāḥ/ sāṃrāviṇamabhivyāptaṃ saṃrāvam/ ``abhividhau bhāva inuṇ'' (3-3-44), ``aṇinuṇaḥ'' (5-4-18)/ sāṃrāviṇasya prakārāntareṇāpi bhāvāttadvyavacchedārthaṃ kilikilākolāhalagrahaṇam/ anyathā sāṃrāviṇaśabdena gatārthatvāt/ atra raudraraso vyajyate/ pūrvārdhe pratibalajaladhiparivṛtatve'pi prasannamukharāgāṇāṃ vīrāṇāṃ samādhiḥ/ vicitramalaṅkāraḥ/ aparārdhe svabhāvoktiḥ//11//
atha tadabhimukhīkāreṇa kalpoktamāghoṣaṇaṃ karoti/ bho bho! he bhavantaḥ śmaśānaniketanāḥ pitṛvanamāvāso yeṣām/
svaśastrapūtetyādi/ svahastadhṛtena śastreṇa khaḍgena khaṇḍitatvāt pūtena śuddhena/ ``gobrāhmaṇārthe śastrapūtāntarātmā hataḥ saṃgrāme kṣattriyaḥ svargameti/'' iti ``tava prayāto yamyatvaṃ śastrapūto bravīmi te''/
ityādimahābhāratādivacaneṣu śastrapātasya pāpaharatvāvagamāt pūtatvoktiḥ/ tadarthameva ca kṛpāṇapāṇiriti śastradhāraṇoktiḥ/ tataḥ pūrvaṃ paścācca śastradhāraṇasya prasaṅgābhāvāt/ aśastrapūteti tu pāṭhe pūtatvaniṣedhādapūtatvavidherviruddhatvaṃ sphuṭameva/ nirvyājena ṣaṇḍarogādidagdhavraṇitatvādidoṣarahitasya puruṣasyāṅgena manuṣyasya medhyāvayavenopakalpitaṃ yuṣmadarthe saṃskṛtam/ vikrīyate asmadabhilaṣitena mūlyena vinimīyate/ gṛhyatāṃ svīkriyatām/ vīpsayā sādaratvaṃ dhvanyate//12//
āghoṣaṇā uccairghuṣṭaṃ tadanantarameva samuccaratā samantādudgacchatā tumulena saṅkulenāta evāvyaktenāsphuṭākṣareṇa kalakalenākulaḥ saṃkṣobhitaḥ/ pracalitaḥ svasthānādudghāṭita iva/ tatra hetuḥ āvirbhavadbhūtasaṅkaṭaḥ pratyakṣībhavadbhūtasaṅkaṭaḥ pramathairnibiḍa iti tanmūlena bhūkampena/ athavā``āsumbhantajalaṭṭhiakaïvalavalantāloaṃ/
dīsaï bhamantavihaḍhaṃ thāṇapphiḍiaḍiḍhilaṃ paḍantaṃ va ṇahaṃ//''
( ṛ la. 54.)
iti setūktanyāyena bhūtasambhramalakṣyālakṣyasvarūpatayā kalakalaiśca pracalita ivetyutprekṣā/ āścaryamityadṛṣṭapūrvadarśanād vismayaṃ prakāśayati/
karṇābhyarṇetyādi - karṇayoḥ śravaṇapālyorabhyarṇābhyāmāsannābhyām/
``samīpanikaṭābhyarṇābhyagrābhyāśāntimā bhuvaḥ/
ete śabdāḥ samīpādyā dharme klī tadvati triṣu//'' iti vaijayantī/ ``abheścāvidūrye'' (7-2-25) ityabheriḍabhāvaḥ/ vidīrṇābhyāṃ ata eva viśeṣato bhinnābhyām/ ``daṛvidāraṇe'' ityasmānniṣṭhā/ sṛkvabhyām/ ``prāntāvoṣṭhasya sṛkvaṇī'' ityamaraḥ/ vikaṭena virūpeṇa, vyādānena āsyavivaraṇena/ ``vikaṭaṃ ca virūpaṃ syāt'' iti vaijayantī/ dīptāgnibhiḥ prajvalitadahanaiḥ, tajjātisvābhāvyādata eva colkāmukhasaṃjñā/ daṃṣṭrākoṭiviśaṅkaṭaiḥ mahādantānāmagreṣu viśālaiḥ viśaṅkaṭadaṃṣṭrairityarthaḥ/ visaṅkaṭairiti vā pāṭhaḥ/ viśeṣato nibiḍairityarthaḥ/
``madhyadantā rājadantā daṃṣṭrā tatpārśvayordvayoḥ/'' iti vaijayantī/ tata ita ityāmiṣagaveṣaṇākulatvaṃ dyotyate/ dhāvadbhiriti mukhaviśeṣaṇatvenoktiḥ śarīrāṇāṃ kvacidavasthāne'pi kandharāṇāṃ tu dairghyātteṣāṃ digantabhrāntiṃ prakāśayitum/ anyathā thāvatāmiti vaktavyam/ ākīryate santanyate/ vidyutpuñjanikāśakeśanayanabhrūśmaśrujālaiḥ [vidyutpuñjanikāśāni] taṭitsamūhavat kapilavarṇāni, keśānāṃ śirasyabālānāṃ [nayanānām] netrāṇāṃ [bhrūṇām] taduparilomapālīnāṃ śmaśrūṇāṃ cibukaromṇāṃ ca jālāni yeṣām/
``nikāśādyāstu sāmyārthāḥ same syuḥ śabdataḥ parāḥ/'' iti vaijayantī/ lakṣyāṇi dīrghākāratvād alakṣyāṇi viśuṣkatayā sūkṣmatvācca vapūṃṣi śarīrāṇi yeṣām/ lakṣyālakṣyetyatra pāṭhakramādarthakramasya balīyastvādarthakramo'nusandheyaḥ/ alakṣyālakṣyeti vā padacchedaḥ/ alakṣvāṇyālakṣyāṇi cetyarthaḥ/ ulkāmukhānām u (nmu ṛlmu)kalakṣaṇā jvālā yeṣāṃ mukhe te ulkāmukhā iti piśācaviśeṣāḥ la ``jvalanmukholkāvicitāmiṣābhiḥ saṃvāhyate rājapathaḥ śivābhiḥ/'' iti yathā kroṣṭuviśeṣāḥ/ atra raudraraso vyajyate/ prakaraṇe'smin bhāvikamalaṅkāraḥ, svabhāvoktirvā//13//
atha vicitalabdhanarapiśitānāṃ teṣāṃ ceṣṭāviśeṣān śarīrasaṃsthānaṃ cāha, mukhānāṃ varṇitatvāt - api ca/
etatpūtanacakramityādi/ pūtanaśabdena puṃpiśācāḥ kathyante, teṣāṃ cakraṃ samūham/ pautanacakramiti vā pāṭhaḥ la pūtanāsambandhi cakram/ akramakṛtagrāsārdhamuktaiḥ āgrahādakramakṛtena grāsena sarabhasaprayuktena carvaṇena, ardhamuktaiḥ ardhena samabhāgena tyaktaiḥ/ vṛkān vanaśunaḥ/ ``kokastvīhāmṛgo vṛkaḥ'' ityamaraḥ/ utpuṣṇat atiśayenāpyāyayat/ paritaḥ samantāt/ nṛmāṃsavighasaiḥ naramāṃsaśeṣaiḥ/
``amṛtaṃ vighaso yajñaśeṣabhojanaśeṣayoḥ/'' ityamaraḥ/ ādardaraṃ krandataḥ piśitapūritamukhavivaratayā kiñcit paruṣaṃ bhaṣataḥ, parasparakalahādityarthaḥ/ dardaraghargharagadgadādayaḥ śabdavikāravācakāḥ/ ``yuddhadhvāne krandanayodhane'' iti vaijayantī/ kharjūradrumadaghnajaṅghaṃ kharjūro nāma tālatarupramāṇastṛṇadrumaviśeṣaḥ/
``..'tha madhukṣīro mahārasaḥ/
paruṣaḥ pāṇḍukharjūrau......'' iti vaijayantī la ``kharjūraṃ ketakī tālī kharjūrī ca tṛṇadrumāḥ/'' ityamaraḥ/ tatpramāṇe jaṅghe, jānugulphayorantarālapradeśo, yasya/ ``pramāṇe dvayasajdaghnañmātracaḥ'' (5-2-37) ityatra, yadyapi ``prathamaśca dvitīyaśca ūrdhvamāne matau mama/'' iti maharṣivacanāddaghnacpratyayenordhvamānaṃ prakāśyate tathāpi upamānaviśeṣagrahaṇenādhodhaḥ sthavīyastvamuparyupari tanīyastvaṃ ca dharmasāhacaryājjaṅghayoḥpratyāyyate/ ata eva śeṣāṅgānāṃ dairghyavairūpye vyākhyāte/ tatra varṇaviśeṣaṃ dhātutrayavirahaṃ cāha - asitatvaṅnaddhaviṣvaktatasnāyugranthighanāsthipañjarajaratkaṅkālaṃ asitayā kṛṣṇavarṇayā tvacā carmaṇā naddhaṃ baddham, ācchāditamiti yāvat, viṣvaktatābhiḥ sarvato vyāptābhiḥ snāyubhiḥ sandhibandhinībhiḥ nāḍībhiḥ yo granthigrathanaṃ, tena ghanaṃ saṃhatam, aśithilasaṃsthānamityarthaḥ, asthipañjaraṃ dārukṛtaśakuniḥ kulāyavaduccāvacatvena sthitānyasthīni kīkasāni yasmin tacca, jaracca cirakālajīvi athavā jaracchabdena jarākāryamavasādanaṃ lakṣyate, avasīdacca kaṅkālaṃ kāyāsthi yasya, anyathā palitatvādiviśiṣṭasya jaraṇasya devayonitvāt teṣvanupapatteḥ/
``nakhārustu snasā snāvaḥ snāyvanā[] sandhibandhanam/'' iti, ``kaṅkālo'strī tanorasthi karaṅko'pyasthipañjaram/'' iti vaijayantī/
``snāyunyāsanibandhakīkasatanurnṛtyantamālokya mām/'' iti bālarāmāyaṇe'pyuktam/ atra bībhatsasya raudrādbhutayorvā vyaktiḥ//14//
samantādvilokyeti - bahutvāt bahuprakāratvācca kvacit sthitānāmekaprakāraḥ anyatra sthitānāmanyaḥ prakāra iti prakāśayitum/ vihasyeti adbhutavyañjakatvāduktiḥ/ aho āścaryabhūtaḥ, prakāraḥ svabhāvaviśeṣaḥ/
tatapṛthvityādi/ tatayā bhakṣalobhaprasāritayā pṛthvyā svato vipulāyatayā rasanayā jihvayā ugraṃ bhīmam/ ``rasajñā rasanā jihvā'' iti vaijayantī/ āsyagarttaṃ āsyaṃ mukhaṃ tasya gartaṃ, lakṣaṇayā vivaram/ ``gartāvaṭau bhuvi śvabhre'' ityamaraḥ/ vidārya vyādāya/ viśuṣkadīrghadehā iti pūrvoktānuvādaḥ/ galadajagaraghorakoṭarāṇāṃ galadbhiḥ avaśaṃ nissaradbhirajagarairmahoragaviśeṣairghorāḥ koṭarāḥ kandararandhrāṇi yeṣām/ ``vāhaso'jagaraḥ śayuḥ'', ``niṣkuṭaḥ koṭaro na strī'' iti ca vaijayantī/ iha ca śmaśāne/ dagdhapurāṇarohaṇānāṃ davadagdhānāmata eva kṛṣṇavarṇānāṃ cirakālajātatvāddīrghāṇāṃ candanānāṃ asitatvaṅnaddhānāṃ viśuṣkadīrghāṇāṃ copameyatvāddagdhatvapurāṇatvoktiḥ/ dagdhatvād galanaucityam/
``candano'strī malayajo bhadraśrī rohaṇadrumaḥ/'' iti vaijayantī/ śaityahetorbhujaṅgamasaṅgamaucityāccandanagrahaṇam, ``paṭīratarukoṭaramadhyamadhyāsīnā bhujagayuvatayaḥ/'' iti murāriprayogāt, ``vyālīva malayadrumam'' iti raghuvaṃśokteśca/ nyagrodhānāṃ vā, ``rohaṇasamidhāmayutaṃ juhuyānmantrī tatassa śṛṅgānām/
sarvāpadāṃ vimuktyai sarvasamṛddhyai grahādiśāntyai ca//'' iti prapañcasārokteḥ/ atrādbhuto vā raudro vā raso vyaṅgyaḥ/ dṛṣṭānto'laṅkāraḥ piśācasya gartarasanānāṃ rohaṇakoṭarājagarāṇāṃ ca bimbapratibimbabhāvena nirdeśāt/ nidarśanā ca, tiṃ[] dadhatītyatra dyutisadṛśīṃ dyutimityupamāparikalpanāt//15//
atibībhatsam atyantaghṛṇāvaham/ karmeti śeṣaḥ/
utkṛtyotkṛtyeti - chittvā chittvā/ ``kṛtī chedane'' iti dhātuḥ/ kṛttiṃ tvacam/ nṛmāṃsavighasairiti nṛśarīramya prastutatvāt nṛśarīrasyetyāyāti/ tacca kṛttyādibhiḥ sarvaiḥ sambadhyate/
``tvak strī chadistanuḥ kṛttiḥ sañchādanyapyasṛgdharā/'' iti vaijayantī/ prathamamādau/ jagdhvetyatrāpi sambadhyate/ atha tadanantaraṃ pṛthūcchrāyabhūyāṃsi vipuleṣu unnateṣu ca sthaleṣu bahutarāṇi/
``viśālamuru vistīrṇaṃ vipulaṃ pṛthulaṃ pṛthu/'' iti vaijayantī/
``nagādyāroha utsedha ucchrāyaścocchrayaśca saḥ/'' ityamaraḥ/ aṃsasphikpṛṣṭhapiṇḍādyavayavasulabhāni aṃsaṃ bāhuśikharaṃ, sphig ūrumūlaṃ bāhyapiṇḍaṃ pṛṣṭham aparabhāgaḥ, piṇḍaṃ jaṅghāmadhyapradeśaḥ, ādiśabdena stanajaghanādigrahaṇam, etatprakāreṣvaṅgeṣu suprāpāṇi/ ``skandho bhujaśiroṃ'so'strī'', ``ūkhau puṃsi kaṭiprothau pūlakau ca sphijau striyau/
paścimāṅgaṃ tanoḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ piṇḍikā syāt picaṇḍikā//'' iti ca vaijayantī/ [ugrapūtīni] dussahaḥ pūyavad gandho yeṣām/ ``visro yakṛti pūye tu pūtiḥ'' iti vaijayantī/ jagdhvā bhakṣayitvā/ jakṣa bhakṣahasanayoḥ'' ityasya ktvāntasya rūpam/ āttasnāyvāntranetraḥ svīkṛtāni snāyūni sandhibandhanasirāviśeṣāḥ, āntrāṇi purītadākhyāni netrāṇi cakṣurmāṃsāni ca yena/ āṅpūrvasya dadāteraca upasargāttaḥ/ prakaṭitadaśanaḥ prakāśitadantapaṅktiḥ, harṣahāsavivṛtamukhatvāt, pretaraṅkaḥ piśācaḥ/ karaṅkāt śarīrāsthipañjarādapādānād āttasnāyvāntranetraḥ/ tvaṅmāṃsānāmupakṣayeṇāsthanāmeva śiṣṭatvāt karaṅkagrahaṇam/
kaṅkālo'strī tanorasthi karaṅko'pyasthipañjaram/'' iti vaijayantī/ aṅkasthāt ādarātiśayenotsaṅge sthāpitāt/ asthisaṃsthasthapuṭagatam asthisthitāni sthapuṭāni viṣamonnatasthalāni/ ``sthapuṭaṃ viṣamonnatam'' iti vaijayantī/ apītyanyatra sarvatra bhakṣitatvāt/ kravyaṃ māṃsam/ avyagram atvaritam, tasya prayatnahāryatvāt/ ``vihasto vyākulovyagraḥ'' iti/ atti bhakṣayati/ ``ada bhakṣaṇe'' ityasmāllaṭi rūpam/ atra bībhatsaraso dhvanyate//16//
atha prakārāntareṇa bībhatsatvamāha - api ca/ niṣṭhāpetyādi - niṣṭhāpasvidyadasthnaḥ niṣṭhāpena kiñcidagninā tāpitatvāt svidyanti pacyamānāni asthīni yeṣām/ anena mṛdumāṃsabhūyiṣṭhatvamāha/ ``athāsthi kīkasam'' iti vaijayantī/ ``ñiṣvidā gātraprakṣaraṇe'' ityukto'pi svidyatiratra pāke vartate, anekārthatvād dhātūnām/
``vītatvagasthikūśmāṇḍatulāṃ svinnāṃ punaḥ pacet/
suṣṭhudhautaḥ srutaḥ svi (nnastya ṛnno'tya)ktoṣmā caudano laghuḥ//'' iti vaidyakavacanāt/ kvathanapariṇamanmedasaḥ kvathanena pākena pariṇamat sneharūpeṇa nirgacchat medo yeṣām/
``.... .... medastu palatejaḥ palodbhavam/
visramasthikaraṃ snehavaram ... ... ...'' iti vaijayantī/ pretakāyān mṛtānāṃ śarīrāṇi, śavāniti yāvat/ ākṛṣya parato nītvā/ āsaktadhūmān samantād baddhadhūmān, ūṣmaṇo'śāntatvāt/ apītyāgrahāt kālakṣepākṣamatvaṃ prakāśyate/ kuṇapabhujaḥ śavāśanā ityanena tvarāyā aucityaṃ pratīyate/ bhūyasībhyaḥ bahutarābhya iti citānāṃ bāhulyāt/ medasvināmapi śavānāṃ bahūnāṃ lābhāddharṣo vyajyate/ utpakvasraṃsimāṃsaṃ uttamena pākenāsthibhirīṣadapyasaktaṃ galanmāṃsaṃ yasya/ pracalat svasthānāt bhraśyat/ tatra hetuḥ - ubhayataḥ sandhinirmuktaṃ dvayorbhāgayoruparyadhaśca jānugulphasandhibhyāṃ viśliṣṭamityarthaḥ/ ārādantike iti spaṣṭadṛṣṭasarvaceṣṭatvamāha/ niścūṣya ākuñcitādharapuṭadvayavāyunāntarākṛṣya/ jaṅghānalakaṃ jaṅghānāmasthi/ jātāvekavacanam/ nalakānītyarthaḥ/ majjadhārāṇāṃ bahutvokteḥ/ ``śākhāni nalakam'' iti vaijayantī/ udayinī vilīnatayā cūṣaṇamātra eva nirgacchantīḥ/ majjadhārāḥ tadantargatasnehasrotāṃsi/
``majjā strī kauśikaṃ sūkṣmamasthitejo'sthisambhavam/
asthisneho vīryakaraḥ ... ... ...//'' iti vaijayantī/ atrāpi bībhatsa eva rasaḥ pratīyate/ ārabhaṭī vṛttiḥ, ``... ... ... ārabhaṭī punaḥṣṭarase raudre sabībhatse... ... .../'' iti/
``māyendrajālasaṃgrāmakrodhodbhrāntyādiceṣṭitaiḥ/'' iti vacanāt svabhāvoktiḥ sphuṭaiva//17//
vihasyeti/ svayaṃ śṛṅgāritatvātteṣāṃ bībhatsarasamapi śṛṅgāratvenābhimanyamānaścamatkaroti prādoṣikaḥ pradoṣe rajanīmukhe bhavaḥ/ ``tatra bhavaḥ'' (4-3-53) iti ṭhak/ pramodo harṣaḥ/ piśācānāṃ piśācyaḥ piśācāśca piśācāḥ, ``pumānstriyā'' (1-2-67) ityekaśeṣaḥ, teṣām/
āntraiḥ kalpitetyādi/ kalpitamaṅgalapratisarāḥ kalpito nirmito'bhyudayārthaḥ pratisaraḥ kautukahastasūtraṃ yāsām/ ``hastasūtraṃ pratisaraḥ'' iti vaijayantī/ strīhastaraktotpalavyaktottaṃsabhṛtaḥ mṛtānāṃ strīṇāṃ hastā evāruṇasukumāratvādraktotpalānyaruṇakamalāni, ``atha raktasaroruhe/ raktotpalaṃ kokanadaṃ'' ityamaraḥ, tadrūpaṃ vyaktamujjvalamuttaṃsaṃ śekharaṃ bibhratīti tāstathā/ pinahya prālambatvena kaṇṭhe baddhvā/ apipūrvānnahyaterallope lyapi ca rūpam/
``vaṣṭi bhāgurirallopamavāpyorupasargayoḥ/'' ``dhāñkṛñostaninahyośca bahulatvena śaunakiḥ/'' ityallopaḥ/ sahaseti mlānatvaparihārāya/ hṛtpuṇḍarīkasrajaḥ mana indriyādhārabhūtānāṃ padmākārāṇāṃ hṛnmāṃsapiṇḍānāṃ mālāḥ rudhirakardamameva sāndrāruṇatvāt kuṅkumaṃ juṣanti sevanta iti śoṇitapaṅkakuṅkumajuṣaḥ/ sambhūya sametya/ kāntaiḥ priyatamaiḥ/ asthisnehasurāḥ majjadhārārūpā madirāḥ/ kapālacaṣakaiḥ śirosthimayaiścaṣakaiḥ, teṣāṃ tulyākāratayā pānasādhanatvopapatteḥ/
``sarakaṃ caṣakaṃ cāstrī galvarko'pyanukarṣaṇam/'' iti vaijayantī/ prītāḥ sapītyā sahṛṣṭāḥ/ atrāntrādipadānāṃ jugupsādyotakānāmapi maṅgalapratisarādipradairantarānītairaślīlatvaṃ parihṛtam/ ``śṛṅgāriṇo hi jagadapi śṛṅgāramayaṃ paśyantīti guṇatvena viśrānteḥ'' iti bhojaḥ/ atra śṛṅgāraḥ pratīyate/ rūpakaṃ cālaṅkāraḥ//18//
punariti pūrvapaṭhitatvāt/ āghoṣaṇāyāśca yāvatprayojanalābhaṃ vidheyatvānna punaruktidoṣaḥ/ katha[thaṃ] nāmetyāścarye/ atipraśāntavibhīṣaṇavibhīṣikāprakāraiḥ viśeṣeṇa bhīṣaṇā bhīrūṇāṃ bhayāvahāḥ, vibhīṣikāprakārāḥ buddhipūrvāḥ bhṛkuṭibaddhabhūbhaṅgamukhakuharavyādānādayastrāsanaviśeṣāḥ atyantameva praśāntāḥ uparatā yeṣām/ anenaitaddarśanenāghoṣaṇāśravaṇena ca pratyuta teṣāmeva bhītatvaṃ prakāśyate/ tataśca bālyādviṣayābhiṣaṅgaśṛṅkhalitatvācca akāryapravṛttasyāpi sattvaprakṛtervṛttādhyayanasampannasya brāhmaṇasya puratastāmasānāṃ bhūtānāṃ sthātuṃ na śaktirvidyata iti vyajyate/ ``yo hyagniḥ sa dvijo viprairmantradarśibhirucyate/''ṃ, ``lokānanyān sṛjeyurye lokapālāṃśca kopitāḥ/
devān kuryuradevāṃśca kaḥ kṣiṇvaṃstān samṛdhnuyāt//''ṃ, ``śmaśāneṣvapi tejasvī pāvako naiva duṣyati//''ṃ, ``evaṃ yadyapyaniṣṭeṣu vartate sarvakarmasu/
sarvathā brāhmaṇaḥ pūjyaḥ paramaṃ daivataṃ hi saḥ//'' iti manuvacanāt/ jhaṭiti śīghram, apakrāntaṃ palāyitaṃ iti bhāve niṣṭhā/ atra bhayānakaraso vyajyate/ atha dhīrapraśāntatayā tadbhīteḥ svamahimamūlatvamasambhāvayannāha - nissattvatā nirastamanobalatvam/ sanirvedaṃ nirvedasahitam/
``dāridryavyādhiduḥkheṣṭaviyogaparivṛttibhiḥ/
īrṣyātattvāvabodhābhyāṃ nirvedo nāma jāyate//'' ityuktatvāt/ atra bahudeśaparibhramaṇakhedādīpsitārthāniṣpatteśca manasaḥ pravṛttiṣu kuṇṭhatā nirvedaḥ/ vicitaḥ anviṣṭaḥ, asmadabhilaṣitapūrakaḥ kaścidatra kiṃ vartate ityasminnanveṣaṇaṃ kṛtamityarthaḥ/ adhikaraṇe karmaṇi cānviṣyatyādeḥ prayogo dṛśyate/
``.......ṣamiccaṣālacamasavyāptā gṛhā yajvanām/
pratyekaṃ ca nirūpitāḥ pratipadaṃ catvāra evāśramāḥ//'' iti prabodhacandrodaye, ``saiṣā sthalī yatra vicinvatā tvām''/
iti raghuvaṃśe ca prayogāt/ prakāreṇa na cepsitaṃ siddhamiti dainyaṃ dyotyate/ sarvataḥ sarvasmin bhāge ityādarātiśayaḥ sūcyate/
tadevopapādayati - tathāhi khalviyaṃ purata eva/ purato'grabhāga eva na parata ityarthaḥ/
guñjatkuñjetyādi/ guñjatāṃ śabdāyamānānāṃ, kuñjakuṭīrāṇāṃ latāmaṇḍapanīḍānām/ ``kuṭīrastu kuṭī pallī'' iti vaijayantī/ kauśikānāṃ ulūkānām/ ``kauśiko guggulūlūkaśakreṣu'' iti vaijayantī/ ghaṭā lakṣaṇayā samūhaḥ tasyāḥ, ghūtkāraiḥ ghūtkāra iti śabdānukāraḥ taiḥ, saṃvargitānāṃ sammelitānām/ ``samaranihataśeṣavānarasubhaṭasaṃvargaṇavalitasugrīvaḥ'', ``unmīlatkamanīyanāyakaguṇagrāmopasaṃvargaṇaḥ/'' iti ca murāriprayogāt/ krandatāṃ pheravāṇāṃ gomāyūnām/ ``pherupheraṇḍapheravāḥ/ mṛgadhūrto bhūrimāyo gomāyuḥ'' iti vaijayantī/ caṇḍābhirbhayānakābhiḥ ḍātkṛtibhiḥ ḍātkāraḥ śabdānukāraḥ, bhṛtaiḥ pūrṇaisteṣāṃ bahutvāt, prāgbhārabhīmaiḥ atiśayena bhayadaiḥ/ pūrvameva śmaśānasāmīpyāt timirabahulatayā ca bhayāvahatvāt kauśikapheravakulakolāhale kiṃ punariti prāgbhāragrahaṇam/ ``prāgbhāro'tiśaye tu'' ityamaraḥ/ taṭaistīraiḥ/ bahuvacanaṃ pradeśabāhulyaparam/ itthambhūtalakṣaṇe tṛtīyā/ antaḥkīrṇairabhyantare vṛkasṛgālakaṅkādibhirākṛṣya vikṣiptaiḥ karaṅkaiḥ śarīrāsthibhiḥ karkarasya kaṭhinasya/ ``kaṭhoraḥ kaṭhinaḥ krūraḥ karkaraḥ karkaśo dṛḍhaḥ/'' iti halāyudhaḥ/ tarata upari plavamānasya, saṃrodhikūlaṅkaṣasya svecchāgamananirodhakaṃ taṭaṃ kaṣituṃ bādhituṃ śīlamasyeti/ ``sarvakūlābhrakarīreṣu kaṣaḥ (3-2-42) iti khaś/ srotasaḥ pravāhasya nirgamenāvicchinnena prasaraṇena ghoraḥ śravaṇaparuṣaḥ, gharghara iti śabdānukāraḥ asnigdha ityarthaḥ/ ``ghargharāvyaktaghoṣān'' iti bhaṭṭamayūroktavat/ sa ravaḥ śabdo yasyāḥ/ pāreśmaśānaṃ śmaśānasya pāre/ ``pārāvāre parārvācī tīre'' ityukte'pi pāraśabdo'tra lakṣaṇayā paryantabhāgamāha/ ``pāre madhye ṣaṣṭhyā vā'' (2-1-18) ityaluk/ ``nāvyayībhāvādato'mtvapañcamyā'' (2-4-83) ityamādeśaḥ/ sarit nadī/ iyaṃ sarit purata eva khalviti sambandhaḥ/ khalussaṃvāde, dṛśyata ityarthaḥ/ atra raudraraso vyaṅgyaḥ/ svabhāvoktiralaṅkāraḥ//19//
atha ``yajñavyasanotsaveṣu'' iti kāmasūtroktatvādanurāgadārḍhyāya vyasane samāgamaṃ yojayitumupakramate - naipathye/ hā tāteti/ hā tāta! niṣkaruṇa! eṣa idānīṃ te narendracittārādhanopakaraṇaṃ jano vipadyate/ heti viṣādadyotakamavyayam/ niṣkaruṇa nirastadayeti svakāryaparatayā ``kuto'patyasnehaḥ'' ityuktasyānusandhānam/ idānīmiti diṣṭyā vardhase svābhilaṣitasiddhijhāṭityeneti dyotyate/ yato niṣkaruṇena tvayā chalena māṃ mārayitumevānucite sthale dānaṃ prastutam/ tanme maraṇamidānīmeva daivādupapāditam/ atastava manorathāḥ pūrṇā iti pitari vicikitsāyā mūlatvaṃ prakāśyate/ niṣkaruṇatvamevāha - narendrasya rājñaḥ cittārādhane manaḥprīṇane upakaraṇaṃ phalakusumapallavādivat sādhanam, na punaḥ snehabhājanamiti/ eṣa janaḥ ayaṃ parijanasādhāraṇo janturna punaḥ putrīti/ vipadyate mriyate, athavā idānīṃ vipadyate iti tvanmanorathā daivena khaṇḍitā iti dyotayati/ tatra hetuḥ - narendretyādi/ yato mayopakaraṇena rājānamārādhya tataḥ pūrvasmādadhikaṃ bhogaṃ samāsādya yāvatkalpaṃ jīvituṃ tvayā saṅkalpaḥ kṛtastadupakaraṇabhūtā cāhamidānīṃ vipadye iti vare'nyasmin dveṣasya dārḍhyaṃ prakāśyate/ anayā ca vācoyuktyā mṛtyumukhe vartamānāyā api yathāpūrva eva nāyikāyā nāyake'nurāga iti prakāśayannaṅgino vipralambhātmanaḥ śṛṅgārarasasyānusandhānaṃ karoti rasasudhānirjharollāsakailāso mahākaviḥ/ hā tātetyādiḥ dravaḥ gurutiraskārāt/
sākūtaṃ ko'yaṃ kuto vā nāda iti bubhutsāyuktam/
