kiñcit pratyabhijānānaḥ sāvegamāha - nādastāvadityādi/ nādaḥ svaraḥ/ tāvat prathamamiti sādṛśyabhrānterapi sambhāvanāṃ dyotayati/ vikalakurarīkranditasnigdhatāraḥ vikalāyāḥ kuto'pi duḥkhād vivaśāyāḥ, kuraryāḥ kranditamiva snigdho'paruṣastāra uccaistaraśca/ ``khaṇḍane maunavikalāḥ'' iti vaijayantī, ``ayaṃ ca kasmādvikalaḥ kathāntare'' ( ca ja ja. 1) iti vakṣyati ca/
``kṛśamatha vikalaṃ vā vyādhitaṃ vādhanaṃ vā/'' iti kāmatantrokteḥ/ kuraraḥ krauñcaviśeṣaḥ/ ``utkrośakurarau samau'' ityamaraḥ/ ``uccaistaro dhvanistāraḥ'' iti vaijayantī/ cittākarṣī viṣayāntarebhyaḥ sadyo hṛdayamākraṣṭuṃ śīlamasya/ paricitaḥ pūrvamabhyastaḥ/ ivaśabdaḥ prakārāt, nirvikārāvasthāyāṃ śrutasya svarasya vikṛtimaye chāyāmātrasphuraṇaṃ prakāśayati/ śrotrasaṃvādaṃ śravaṇendriyasya tathātvena sammatim/ ``sakalahṛdayasaṃvādabhājā sādhāraṇyena'' iti, ``api dvandvaṃ diṣṭyā tadiha subhage saṃvadati vām/'' ityādivat/ bhinnamapāyaśaṅkayā vidīrṇam, ata eva hṛdayaṃ manaḥ antarbhramati vicārasaraṇiṃ vigāhitumasamarthaṃ mūḍhamevāntarbaṃbhramyate/ vihvalati vivaśaṃ bhavati/ ``hvala hmala calane'' iti dhātuḥ/ aṅgamaṅgaṃ pratyekaṃ hastapādaṃ svasvavyāpārākṣamaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ/ gātrastambhaḥ śarīrasya niśceṣṭatā, skhalayati pratihanti gatiṃ gamanam/ skhalayatīti haṭhād gamanodyogasyāpyaśakyatvamāha/ kaḥ prakāraḥ pūrvāvasthātaḥ ko'yaṃ viśeṣa āpatita iti snehasvabhāvādevābuddhipūrvasātvikavikārāṇāmāvirbhāvamanusandhatte/ kimetat asmin deśe īdṛśanādaśravaṇarūpamidaṃ kiṃ vastu vartate/ athavā nādaśravaṇātmakametat kiṃ mayā cintitaṃ tadvā na vetyarthaḥ/ kaḥ prakāraḥ etasya vastunaḥ kathamasmin deśe'syāṃ rātrau sambhavaprakāra ityarthaḥ/ atra niṣphalaśmaśānavāṭaparyaṭanasambhṛtena virodhinā nirvedena prasuptasya śṛṅgārasya karuṇarasamantarniveśya prabodhanaṃ kṛtamiti mantavyam/
``rasāntareṇāntarito nairantarye tu yo rasaḥ/'' iti vacanād āvegākhyasya bhāvasya codayaḥ pratipādyate/ sūkṣmamanumānaṃ vālaṅkāraḥ//20//
śabdānusāreṇa deśamanumimīte - karālāyatanādityādi/ karālāyāścāmuṇḍāyā ālayād uccaran udgacchan, karuṇadhvaniḥ karuṇaḥ śokāvaho nādaḥ, vibhāvyate jñāyate/ cakāraḥ svaśaṅkitānuguṇatvaṃ sthānasyāpyāsūtrayati/ tadevāha - nanu prasiddho'yamartha ityarthaḥ/ sthānamucitaṃ sthalam/ aniṣṭānāṃ lokaduḥkhakarāṇāṃ karmaṇām/ tat karālāyatanaṃ[m] īdṛśāmasmadāśaṅkitapriyatamopahāratulyānām/ īdṛśāmityuktiraśakyavacanatvāt/ anena ca ``yā kila vividhajīvopahārapriye''tyādi pūrvoktaṃ saṅghaṭayati/ anumānamalaṅkāraḥ/ ``nādastāvadi''ti ``karālāyatanāccāyami''ti ca vitarkavadvākyād rūpam//21//
bhavatviti - cintitameva bhavatu vā mā bhūt, tathāpi darśanenaiva saṃśayacchedaḥ santāpacchedaśceti sūcayati/
atha prakarīvṛttāntaṃ prastauti - tataḥ praviśata iti/ ``prakarīti pradeśabhāk'' iti lakṣaṇāt/ devatārcanavyagrāviti ``saviśeṣamadya mayā pūjāsambhāraḥ sannidhāpayitavyaḥ'' ityuktasyopayogaḥ/ kṛtavadhyacihnā kṛtaṃ kāpālikābhyāṃ nirmitaṃ vadhyānāṃ upajihīṣitānāṃ cihnaṃ lakṣaṇam/ ``nyastālaktakaraktamālyavasanā'' ( la. 23) iti vakṣyamāṇaprakāraṃ yasyām/ rājasapūjātvāt, ``rajo rāgātmakaṃ viddhi'' iti, ``yakṣarakṣāṃsi rājasāḥ'' iti ca bhagavadvacanācca/ nāgānande ca garuḍāyopahṛtasya śaṅkhacūḍasya raktavastrādidhāraṇokteḥ/
hā tādeti/ naipathyoktermālatīvacanatvaṃ prakāśayituṃ pitṛvairāgyāderdārḍhyaṃ ca pratipādayituṃ punarvacanaṃ rasaparipoṣakatvād guṇa eva/ hā amba! hṛdaye hatāsi, daivadurvilasitena īśvarasya durbilasitena acintitena pratikūlaceṣṭitena śuṣkāśanineva hṛdaye'bhihatāsi/ hā mālatīmayajīvite! mama kalyāṇasādhanaikasakalavyāpāre bhagavati! cirasya jñāpitāsi duḥkhaṃ snehena/ [mālatīmayajīvite] mālatīrūpaṃ prāṇanaṃ yasyā iti svāpāye tasyā api jīvitāpāyaṃ dyotayati/ tatkathaṃ jñātamityāha - mama [kalyāṇasādhanaikasakalavyāpāre] kalyāṇasya maṅgalasya ``stanyanyāsāt prabhṛti sumukhī dantapāñcālikādikrīḍāyogaṃ tadanu vinayaṃ prāpitā vardhitā ca/'' ( X. 5)
ityādi vakṣyamāṇakramasya sādhanaṃ sampādanamekaṃ pradhānaṃ yeṣāṃ te, sakalāḥ samastāśca vyāpārāḥ pravṛttayo yasyāḥ/ cirasya bahoḥ kālāditaḥ pūrvaṃ sukhasyaivānubhūtatvāt, snehena mayi vātsalyena, duḥkhaṃ jñāpitāsi īdṛśaṃ duḥkhamityanubhāvitāsi/ priyasakhi lavaṅgike! svapnāvasaramātradarśanā te ahaṃ saṃvṛttā/ [svapnāvasaramātradarśanā] svapnasamaye eva darśanaṃ yasyāḥ, mṛtānāmanyathā darśanānupapatteḥ/
hanteti viṣāde/ sampratīti kāmandakyādisaṅkīrtanasya nirṇayahetoḥ śrutatvādityarthaḥ/ api nāmeti sambhāvanāyām/ tāvatī vidheranukūlā kṛtiḥ sambhavedityarthaḥ/ jīvantīmavyāpāditāmeva sambhāvayāmi satkaromi/ mahati vyasane śaraṇībhāva eva sambhāvanamiti bhāvaḥ/ ``samprati nirasta eve''tyādiḥ sambhramaḥ, śaṅkātrāsābhyām/
kapālakuṇḍalāghoraghaṇṭau svopahārasaṅgrahaṇārthaṃ devatāṃ stutibhiruddhoṣayata ityāha - devīti/
sāvaṣṭabhmetyādi - sāvaṣṭambhena sāvalambena savalātkāreṇetyarthaḥ/ nisumbhena caraṇākramaṇena hetunā sambhramato vyākulatayā, namatā pātālakuhare patatā bhūgolena bhūmipiṇḍena yat niṣpīḍanaṃ bhārākrāntatvaṃ tena nyañcatkarparasya nirbhujyamānapṛṣṭhakapālasya sakalabhuvanādhārasyādikamaṭhasya stambhasyeva kampena calanena vicaṭataḥ sphuṭato brahmāṇḍasya khaṇḍānāṃ śakalānāṃ sthitiryasmin/ athavā vicaṭati brahmāṇḍe khaṇḍasthiti asamagracaraṇāvasthānam, samagrasthiterasahatayetyarthaḥ/ avaṣṭambhetyatra ``avāccālambanāvidūryayoḥ'' (8-3-68) iti ṣatvam/ nisumbha ākramaṇaṃ ``prāgaprāptanisumbhaśāmbhavadhanurdvedhāvidhāvirbhavat/'' iti mahāvīracaritokteḥ/ kūrmagrahaṇamakhaṇḍadharaṇimaṇḍalādhārasya kuṇḍalīpaterapyādhāratvāt/
``pṛthvi! sthirībhava bhujaṅgama! dhārayaināṃṣṭatvaṃ kūrmarāja! tadidaṃ dvitayaṃ dadhīthāḥ/'' iti bālarāmāyaṇe'pyuktam/ ``caṭa sphuṭa viśaraṇe'' iti dhātuḥ/ pātālapratimalle pratimallaḥ pratipakṣaḥ adhobhuvanavivarasya lakṣaṇayā tulye, vikaṭagambhīratvāt, gallavivare kapolarandhre prakṣiptāḥ sapta samudrāḥ yasmin/ ``gallo gaṇḍaḥ kapolaśca'' iti halāyudhaḥ/ nanditanīlakaṇṭhapariṣat nanditaḥ santoṣitaḥ svacikīrṣitasyānāyāsena karaṇāt, nīlakaṇṭhaḥ arthāt kālarudraḥ, pariṣat tadīyabhūtagaṇasaṃsacca yena/ tatra hetuḥ/ vyaktarddhi prakaṭasaṃharaṇasāmarthyam/ vaḥ yuṣmākamiti gurutvād bahuvacanam/ krīḍitaṃ vihāraḥ prapañcasaṃharaṇarūpam/ bhāve niṣṭhā/ anena ``kālaḥ kālyā saha bahukalaḥ krīḍati prāṇiśāraiḥ/'' ityuktanītyā kālarudraśakterbhadrakālyāstribhuvanasaṃharaṇamayatnasādhyatvāllīlāmātrameveti dhvanyate/ atra raudro vyajyate/ atiśayoktirbhāvikaṃ cālaṅkāraḥ//22//
atha saṃharaṇānantaramānandatāṇḍavaṃ caṇḍikāyā daṇḍakena stuvantau svābhilaṣitamāśaṃsataḥ - api ca pracalitetyādi/ pracalitakarikṛttiḥ bhramarikāvegena prakampitā prāvaraṇabhūtā vāraṇatvag yasmin/ paryante paritaḥ cañcatāṃ aṅgahāreṇa calatāṃ nakhānāmāghātenāghaṭṭanena bhinnādindoḥ candramaṇḍalāt kalaśādiva salilena niṣyandamānena, iti candrapādādupari devīmukhasya vartanaṃ ca dyotyate, amṛtaścyotena pīyūṣadraveṇa jīvantyā labdhaprāṇayā, amṛtasya mṛtasañjīvanasvābhāvyāt, bhūṣaṇakapālāvalyā nimittena devyā muktāt, kāyasaṃśleṣaṇarahitānāṃ teṣāṃ rāhuvad bhrūkṣepādiceṣṭitairhāsyarasavihāratvāt, athavā kapālāvalyaiva muktāt pravartitād devīnṛttotsavadarśanapramodeneti yāvat, caṇḍād bhīmādaṭṭahāsād atiśayitāddhāsāt/ ``aṭṭāvatiśayakṣaumau'' iti vaijayantī/ trasadbhyo bibhyadbhyo bhūribhyo bahubhyo bhūtebhyaḥ prāṇibhyo'thavā pārṣadebhyaḥ pravṛttā prasṛtā stutiḥ stotraṃ yasya/ śvasatāṃ bhūriśrameṇa phūtkurvatāmasitabhujaṅgānāṃ kṛṣṇasarpāṇāṃ bhogāḥ śarīrāṇyevāṅgadāni dormūlabhūṣaṇāni - ``keyūramaṅgadaṃ bhūṣā dormūle'' iti vaijayantī - teṣāṃ granthirbandhanaṃ tasya niṣpīḍanena bādhāvahenāsphālanena parasparāghaṭṭanena, dordaṇḍānāmityarthāt/ ``ajarāvatāsphālanaviślathaṃ yaḥ'', ``anyonyāsphālabhinnadvipa'' ityādiprayogāt/ utphāleti pāṭhe niṣpīḍanena ya utphālaḥ kṣobhastenetyarthaḥ, ``satyasaṅgapriyatā ca vīrarabhasotphālaśca māṃ karṣataḥ/'' itivat/ phulladbhyaḥ krodhena vikasadbhyaḥ - ``phulla vikāse'' iti dhātuḥ - phaṇāpīṭhebhyaḥ vikaṭāyatatvāt phalakasadṛśebhyaḥ phaṇātaṭebhyo niryato nirgacchato viṣajyotiṣo viṣāgnerujjṛmbhaṇādujjvalanād uḍḍāmareṇa bhīṣaṇena vyastenābhinayārthaṃ vikṣiptena vistāriṇā svata eva vipulena doḥṣaṇḍena bhujasamūhena paryāsitāḥ sarvataḥ pātitāḥ kṣmādharāḥ parvatā yasmin/ doḥṣaṇḍoktiḥ, ``adṛśyatānujā viṣṇossāyudhāṣṭamahābhujā/'' iti, athavā ``ṣoḍaśaśūlavyagrabhujā triṇayanāhinaddhāṅgī/'' ityādi purāṇāgamaprasiddhabhujabāhulyavivakṣayeti mantavyam/
``durgeti bhadrakālīti vijayetyambiketi ca/'' ityekasyā eva devatāyā nāmabhedapratipādanāt/
[jvaladanaletyādi] - jvaladanalavat [piśaṅgānāṃ] piṅgalānāṃ tuṅgantīnāṃ calantīnāṃ -- ``tugi tvagi calane'' iti dhātuḥ - jaṭānāṃ jhāṭena samūhena, ``sandhyānṛttapravṛttatripuraharajaṭājhāṭavācāṭavīcī/'' ityādiprayogāt/ bhīmamuttamāṅgaṃ śiro yasyām/ tayā bhramyā bhramaṇena maṇḍalanṛttena, ``nirvyūḍabhramivibhramāya jagatāmīśāya pitre namaḥ/'' iti murāryukteḥ/ prastutā ārabdhā alātacakrakriyā alātam ulmukaṃ jvalitaikakoṭikāṣṭhamityarthaḥ, tasya cakravat kriyā ceṣṭā, avicchinnaṃ bhramaṇamityarthaḥ, adho nīlavarṇatvād upari kapilavarṇatayā bhramivegācca/ tayā syūtaḥ sambaddhaḥ/ diśāmagninā kabalīkṛtatvaṃ aparimitātikapilaprabhāpaṭalavyāptatvāt/ uttuṅgasya khaṭvāṅgākhyasyāyudhaviśeṣasya śṛṅge'gre yā dhvajapatākā tasyā uddhūtyā kampanena vikṣiptā svasthānādanyato vikīrṇāstārakāṇāṃ gaṇā nakṣatrāṇāṃ samūhā yasmin/ pramuditānāṃ saṃhṛtajanarudhirapiśitāsvādahṛṣṭānāṃ kaṭapūtanānām, uttālānāṃ dṛptānāṃ vetālānāṃ ca/ ``piśācaḥ kāpiśeyaḥ syāt'' iti vaijayantī/ piśācaviśeṣāḥ kaṭapūtanāḥ/ ``pretāḥ paretā vetālāḥ'' iti vaijayantī/ pretaviśeṣā vetālā iti bhedaḥ ``bhūtapretapiśācajambhakabhaye smṛtvā mahābhairavīm/'' ityādyabhiyuktokteḥ/ rāveṇa śabdena nirghātaghoreṇa siṃhanādena sphuṭadbhyāṃ daladbhyām (iti lakṣaṇayā kaḥ krīḍaśīlerthitābhyāṃ ṛ) karṇābhyāṃ sambhrāntāyā bhayākulitāyā gauryāḥ parvatarājaputryā ghanāśleṣeṇa svayaṃkṛtena dṛḍhāliṅganena dṛṣyanmanasaṃ tryambakaṃ parameśvaramānandayituṃ śīlaṃ yasyeti/ mahadupakṛtamamunā tāṇḍaveneti bahumānabhājanatvāt, ``trasattuṣārādrisutāsasambhramasvayaṃgrahāśleṣasukhena niṣkrayam/'' iti māghoktavat/ tāṇḍavamuddhataṃ nṛttam/ devi! dyotanaśīle! vaḥ ariṣṭyai riṣeti kṣayasamṛddhyathag dvau dhātū, yu iti yathā pṛthagbhāvamiśraṇāvag/ tayoḥ ktini rūpaṃ riṣṭiḥ/ ariṣṭyai riṣṭeḥ kṣayasya pratiṣedhāya, riṣṭyai samṛddhyai/
``ariṣṭā vāyase nimbe gorase nirupadrave/
klī vaivarṇye mṛtyucihne madye tāmre śubhe'śubhe//'' iti, ``riṣṭaṃ nāśe śubhe'śubhe'' iti vaijayantī/ bhūyādityāśiṣi liṅ/ ayaṃ vivakṣito'rthastābhyāmanyathābhūta ityapi dyotayati kaviḥ ariṣṭyai samṛddhyabhāvāya riṣṭyai kṣayāya ceti/ tatra hetuḥ - na iti sacchāstracodanāmantareṇa phalakāmanayā śiṣṭajanagarhitāṃ hiṃsāprāyāṃ vṛttimīśvarārādhanabhrameṇa kurvāṇānāmasmākamityarthaḥ/ ariṣṭyai ca riṣṭyai ca no bhūyādityāśaṃsayā sākṣāt phalābhisandhiḥ prakāśitaḥ/ mālatyā jighāṃsayā samākarṣaṇena brahmahatyāstrīvadhavisrambhaghātakanyāviśasananiraparādhabādhanādimahāpātakādhyavasānācca śāstravidhyullaṅghanaṃ sūcitam/ ata eva devatākoṣād viruddhaphalopanipātaḥ kavinopari pradarśitaḥ/ svarasamāsānvayādyaparādhānmantrādīnāṃ viruddhaphalatve prasiddheḥ, ``yathendraśatruḥ svarato'parādhāt/'' iti, ``sa vavre bhagavan kṛtyā pitṛhanturvadhāya me/'' iti prārthitavataḥ kāśirājaputrasya parameśvarakopāt svavināśāyaiva kṛtyāsamutpattivacanācca/
``yaśśāstravidhimutsṛjya vartate kāmakārataḥ/
na sa siddhimavāpnoti na sukhaṃ na parāṃ gatim//'' iti bhagavadvacanāt/ atra raudrau vyajyate/ atiśayoktirudāttaṃ cālaṅkāraḥ//23//
abhinayataḥ harṣeṇa nṛtyataḥ/
atha taddarśanajanitodvega āha - dhik pramādaḥ kaṣṭamidaṃ mahadanavadhānajanitaṃ jhaṭiti samādhānayogyaṃ ca vyasanam/
tathātvamevāha - nyastālaktaketyādi/ nyastālaktakā tilakatvena nihitalākṣārasā, raktāni lohitavarṇāni mālyāni mālāyāṃ sādhūni puṣpāṇi, ``tatra sādhuḥ'' (4-4-98) iti yat, vasane vastre ca yasyāḥ/ pāṣaṇḍacaṇḍālayoriti/ ``pāṣaṇḍā bāhyaliṅginaḥ'' iti vaijayantī/ ``kalau jagatpatiṃ viṣṇuṃ sarvasraṣṭāramīśvaram/
nārcayiṣyanti maitreya pāṣaṇḍopahatā janāḥ//
kiṃ devaiḥ kiṃ dvijairvedaiḥ kiṃ śaucenāmbujanmanā/
evaṃ kalau vadiṣyanti pāṣaṇḍopahatā janāḥ//'' iti śrīviṣṇupurāṇe, ``niśāmukheṣu khadyotāstamasā bhānti na grahāḥ/
yathā pāpena pāṣaṇḍā na hi vedāḥ kalau yuge//'' iti śrībhāgavate ca vedabāhyānāmīśvarabhaktirahitānāṃ dussamayināṃ śvakharasṛgālasadharmaṇāṃ duṣkarmaṇāṃ pāṣaṇḍatvāvagateḥ/ tathāgatanagnāṭakakāpālikādayaḥ pāṣaṇḍaśabdenocyante/ pāṣaṇḍī pāṣaṇḍaśca pāṣaṇḍau, ``pumān striyā'' (1-2-67) ityekaśeṣavidhānāt/ anena cāntevāsinyā gurorekaśeṣavacanena gamyāgamyaniyamābhāvo dyotyate/ caṇḍālī caṇḍālaśca caṇḍālau/ tadupamitayāḥ[yoḥ] athavā pāṣaṇḍarūpayorjanaṃ[]gamayoriti anenaitadāha``sarvadharmān parityajya māmekaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja/'' iti, ``hitvā svadharmaṃ caraṇāmbujaṃ harerbhajannapakvo'tha patettato yadi/
yatra kva vābhadramabhūdamuṣya kiṃṣṭako vārtha āpto'bhajatāṃ svadharmataḥ//'' ityādibhiḥ pratipāditāṃ parameśvarabhaktiṃ, ``yasya nāhaṅkṛto bhāvo buddhiryasya na lipyate/
hatvāpi sa imāhllokān na hanti na nibadhyate//'' iti, ``jñānāgniḥ sarvakarmāṇi bhasmasāt kurute tathā/'' iti, ``api cedasi pāpebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ pāpakṛttamaḥ/
sarvaṃ jñānaplavenaiva vrajitaṃ santariṣyasi//'' iti, ``sarvabhūtasthitaṃ yo māṃ bhajatyekatvamāsthitaḥ/
sarvathā vartamāno'pi sa yogī mayi vartate//'' iti, tadadhigame ``uttarapūrvāghayoraśleṣavināśau tadvyapadeśād'' ityādibhiḥ smṛtibhistanmūlamūtābhiḥ śrutibhiśca prakāśitaṃ tattvajñānaṃ taddvayamanavaṣṭabhya yatheṣṭaṃ ceṣṭamānānāṃ puruṣadoṣaduṣṭāgamābhyāsavikṣubhitānāṃ vedaviruddharāddhāntavibhrāntānāmaśāstravihitaghoradharmacaryāṇāmanāryāṇāṃ niravadhikavipadi nirayatamasi niravalambanaṃ patatāṃ darśanasparśanādiṣvapi duritopapatterdūrato varjanīyatvaṃ śiṣṭairiti/ ``yā vedabāhyāḥ smṛtayo yāśca kāśca kudṛṣṭayaḥ/
sarvāstā niṣphalāḥ pretya tamoniṣṭhā hi tāḥ smṛtāḥ//'' iti manuvacanāt/ bhaktasya tu svadharmataḥ skhalane'pi, ``mokṣayiṣyāmi mā śucaḥ/'' iti, ``yogakṣemaṃ vahāmyaham/'' iti, ``teṣāmahaṃ samuddhartā mṛtyusaṃsārasāgarāt/'' iti, ``kaunteya! pratijānīhi na me bhaktaḥ praṇaśyati/'' ityevamādivacanaiḥ karuṇābhūtena bhagavataiva jananyeva śiśoḥ paripālyamānatvāt la jñāninaḥ punarniṣiddhācaraṇasya ``anabhyāsādaprasaṅgāccādveṣṭṛtvādayo guṇāḥ/
ayatnato bhavantyasya na tu sādhanarūpiṇaḥ//'' iti adveṣṭṛtvādīnāmevābhyastatvāt, alepakapakṣasya ca``śunāṃ tattvadṛśāṃ caiva ko bhedo'śucibhakṣaṇe/'' iti nirastatvāt, karmānuṣṭhānasya ca``ahaṃpratyayabījaṃ yadahaṃpratyayavatsthitam/
nāhaṃpratyayavahnyuṣṭaṃ kathaṃ karma prarohati//'' ityahamadhyāsanibandhanakartṛtvādyāropamūlatvāt tasya ca brahmajñānāgninā dagdhatvena, anadhikāratayā vidhyagocaratvena ``daṇḍākhilādhikāraśced brahmajñānāgninā muniḥ/
vartamānaśrutermūrdhni naiva syādvedakiṅkaraḥ//'' iti śrutikaiṅkaryāsambhavena parāstatvāt la bhaktajñāninoḥ karmānanuṣṭhānamātradarśanena patitatvāśaṅkā moha eva/ bhaktijñānayoranyataravirahe tu vihitaniṣiddhakarmaṇorakaraṇakaraṇābhyāṃ pāṣaṇḍatvamata eva caṇḍālatvamiti sādhayati paramapramāṇabhūto bhavabhūtiḥ/ tatra hetuḥ - pāpārambhavatoḥ pāpānāṃ, ``brahmahatyā surāpānaṃ steyaṃ gurvaṅganāgamaḥ/
mahānti pātakānyāhuḥ saṃyogaścaiva taiḥ saha//'' iti manusmṛtānāṃ mahāpātakānāṃ govadhādīnāṃ upapātakānāṃ ca, ārambho'nuṣṭhānaṃ, tena nityayuktayoḥ/ nityayoge matup/ mṛgī hariṇī/ mṛgīgrahaṇena mugdhasvabhāvatvāt spṛhaṇīyasabhayadṛṣṭipātācca dayanīyatvātiśayo dyotyate/ ekavacanena yūthabhraṣṭatvaṃ vyajyate/ vṛkayoḥ vṛkī ca vṛkaśca vṛkau, tayoḥ/ upamānena pāpārambhavatvamevopapādayati, nahi vṛkādayaḥ śvāpadāḥ kadācidapi sāttvikā bhavantīti/ bhīruḥ bhayaśīlā/ ``bhiyaḥ kruklukanau'' (3-2-174) iti krukpratyayaḥ/ kriyāvacanattvādūṅ na bhavati/ gatetyekavacanenaikākinītvam/ gocaraṃ svacchandaparābhavaviṣayam/ seti garbheśvaratvasaukumāryaduḥkhānabhijñatvādikaṃ dyotayati/ athavāsmābhiryadviṣaye bhūyodarśanamātramāśaṃsitaṃ seti/ iyamiti asmin pradeśe purovartitvamasyāḥ svapne'pyasambhāvitamiti darśayati/ seti dyotitasya garbheśvaratvāderhetumāha - vasoḥ uparicarasya rājarṣeḥ/ vasusaṃjñayā prasiddhasyeti samagraśaktitrayatvaṃ prakāśyate/ sutetyekāpatyādekatvamāha/ mṛtyoḥ yamasya, mukhe iti anantarameva jighāṃsitatvāt mṛtyormukhaṃ praviṣṭaiva na nigīrṇetyetāvānasmākamāśvāsa ityarthaḥ/ hā dhik - heti viṣādadyotakamavyayam, dhigiti jugupsāvyañjakam/ kaṣṭamaniṣṭamatiduḥkhamatiduḥsahamapriyamasmākamiti śeṣaḥ/ aniṣṭaṃ dhigiti ``dhiguparyādiṣu triṣu'' ityādinā dvitīyā/ astakaruṇaḥ nirastadayaḥ/ ka iti vikalpe/ ``praśne kṣepe vikalpe kiṃ'' iti vaijayantī/ ayamidānīṃ dṛśyamānaḥ prakramaḥ ārambhaḥ kaḥ āvayorutsādanārtho vā, asmadvaṃśayoḥ sasuhṛdvargayorunmūlanārtho vā, saṃsārasyaiva nissārīkaraṇārtho vetyarthaḥ/ atrāvego vyajyate, vidhiṃ pratyasūyā vitarkaśca/ upamālaṅkāraḥ/ nyastālaktaketyādirapavādaḥ, vidhidoṣaprakhyāpanāt//24//
atha vadhyānāmantargato bhāvaḥ taireva viśasanāt prāk prakāśayitavyaḥ taccittaparijñānāyeti kalpoktakramānuṣṭhānāyāha kāpālikītaṃ bhadre ityādi/ bhadre kalyāṇini iti nāmāparijñānāt saṃbuddhiḥ/ smara cintaya/ smṛtvā vadeti yāvat/ dayitaḥ anurāgaviṣayaḥ/ atra asmin loke/ abhūt na tu bhavatīti bhūtatvaprakāśanena tadanurāgasya nairarthakyaṃ prakāśayati/ tatra hetuḥ - adya tvarayati śīghraṃ prerayati, svapuragamanāyeti śeṣaḥ/ dāruṇaḥ, ``na bāleṣu snehaṃ vahati na jaratsvādaralavaṃṣṭana dākṣiṇyacchāyāṃ yuvatiṣu na cārteṣu karuṇām/'' iti varṇitakauryaḥ kṛtāntaḥ yamaḥ/ ato'dya naṣṭāyāstavānurāgo niṣphala ityarthaḥ//
heti/ hā kaṣṭaṃ tādṛśo manorathaḥ īdṛśo jāta ityarthaḥ/ dayita mādhava! paralokagato'pi smartavyo yuṣmābhirayaṃ janaḥ/ na khalu sa uparataḥ yasya vallabhaḥ smarati/ [paralokagataḥ] yamapuraṃ prāptaḥ/ apiśabdena yadyapi tavānena janena na phalaṃ tathāpīti dyotyate/ smartavyaścintanīya iti prārthane kṛtyapratyayaḥ/ yuṣmābhiriti bhartuḥ pūjyatvād bahuvacanam/ tatra hetuḥ - ayaṃ janaḥ yastvadanurāgeṇa tādṛśīṃ daśāmanubhāvita ityarthaḥ/ smaraṇe phalamāha - uparataḥ mṛtaḥ/ vallabhaḥ priyatamaḥ/ yasya smarati yaṃ manasā cintayati/ ``adhīgarthadayeśāṃ karmaṇi'' (2-3-52) iti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī/ vallabhaḥ smaratītyubhayānurāgasya vidyamānatvānmanasi sānnidhyācca mṛto'pi na mṛtaḥ/ api tvatraiva vartate/ vallabhe'smarati sati sa jīvannapi mṛta eveti vyatireko'pi sāmarthyāt sidhyati/
hanteti harṣe, kalpoktasya hṛdayaparijñānasya kṛtatvāttadāha/ mādhavānurakteti/ tapasvinī śocyā/ ``sā kkhu tavassiṇī devīe ujjaïṇiṃ ṇīdetti ppavādaṃ kadua'' iti ratnāvalyāṃ prayogāt/
śastramudyamya kaṇṭhacchedanāya khaḍgamasyā upari utkṣipyetyarthaḥ/
cāmuṇḍe iti/ mantrasādhanādau mantrasādhanārambhe, uddiṣṭāṃ pratijñātāṃ upanihitāmidānīṃ samīpataḥ sannidhāpitām, bhajasva pratīccha, pūjāṃ kanyāratnopahārarūpām arcanām//25//
sahaseti śastrapātanasyevāvaśiṣṭatvāttadanantare ityarthaḥ/ prakoṣṭhena vikṣipya dūrato nipātya/
``pragaṇḍaḥ kūrparādūrdhvaṃ prakoṣṭhaḥ kūrparādadhaḥ''/
iti vaijayantī/ balātiśayāt prakoṣṭhagrahaṇam/ ``niṣṭhuraiḥ prakoṣṭhapṛṣṭhaprahāraistrīnapi ṭiṭṭibhaprabhṛtīnapātayat'' iti harṣacaritokteḥ/ āḥ iti kope/ ``āstu syāt kopapīḍayoḥ'' iti vaijayantī/ durātman! duṣṭabuddhe ṅa, pratihato'si vidhnitamanoratho'si/ kāpālikāpaśada kāpālikaścāsāvadhamaśceti/
sahasāvalokyeti - jalamadhyamajjanāvasare'vahitasyevācintitopanatatvāt sāśvāsatvaṃ prakāśyate/ paritrāyatāṃ paritrāyatāṃ mahābhāgaḥ/ bhayānakadyotikā vīpsā/
mahābhāge iti mahān bhāgo bhāgyaṃ yasyāstasyāstava nāticiraṃ duḥkhānubhava iti dyotanāyāmantraṇam/ na bhetavyaṃ na bhītiḥ kartavyā/ vīpsayā tasyāḥ sthairyamāpādayati/
idānīṃ pratyuta tvadapakāriṇa eva bhayāvakāśa iti tāmupapattyā samāśvāsayati - maraṇasamaya ityādi/ āsannaprāṇatyāge kāle, tyaktāśaṅkena pralāpena muktalajjena paridevitena, nirargalaṃ apratibandhaṃ, sarvo'pi jano jānātviti nijaṃ praśrayaṃ parityajyetyarthaḥ, prakaṭitaḥ prakāśito nijo'kṛtrimaḥ sneho yasmin/ na tu laukikavanmātṛprabhṛtiṣviti dyotayati/ sa iti yastvadviṣayeṇānurāgeṇedṛśīṃ daśāṃ nītaḥ, kāmandakyāste niveditaṃ ityarthaḥ/ ayamiti bhayanimīlite dṛśāvunmīlya dṛśyatāmityarthaḥ/ sakheti striyā bharturatiśayitasya bandhorabhāvāt/ ``maharṣermahiṣīsakha'' iti prayogāt, ``preyo mitra''miti śiṣyamāṇatvācca/ pura eva te tavāgrata evānantarito vartate/ maraṇasamaya ityādibhistasyāste tena mayā prāṇebhyo'pi trātavyatvānmayi ca gṛhītabhare durātmano'sya kā śaktistava gandhamapyāghrātumiti tasyā harṣamāpādayati/ sutanu śobhanāṅgītyasyāstvattanorapāye kathaṃ mayā jīvitavyamiti vyañjayati/ visṛja viśeṣeṇa muñca, niravaśeṣaṃ muñcetyarthaḥ/ utkampaṃ bhayānubhāvaṃ hṛdayakṣobhaḥ/ samprati mayi sannihite ityarthaḥ/ asāviti pratyakṣadṛṣṭāparādhatvādvadhyatvamāha/ iheti ito deśāt jīvan padamapi na caliṣyatīti/ pāpmanaḥ tvadvadhodyamarūpasya pāpasya, phalaṃ prayojanam, anubhavati, vartamānasāmīpye laṭ, na kṣaṇāntaravilamba ityarthaḥ/ ugramiti lokadvaye'pyanubhāvyatvāt krūram/ pāpa iti niṣiddhakarmatācchīlyāt pūrvameva vadhyaḥ, kiṃ punaridānīmiti vyañjayati/ pratīpavipākinaḥ sveṣṭasya pratikūlaṃ vipaktuṃ śīlaṃ yasya/ ``atyutkaṭaiḥ pāpapuṇyairihaiva phalamaśnute/'' iti vacanāt/ athavā pratīpo vipāko yasya/
``pratīpaḥ pratikūlaṃ syādanukūlaṃ viparyayaḥ/'' iti vaijayantī/ tvadvadhena svasamṛddhiḥ nanvamunā pūrvaṃ saṅkalpitā, samprati tvamuṣyaiva vadhena tvatsamṛddhirbhaviṣyatītyarthaḥ/ atra parasparānurāgasandhukṣitaḥ śṛṅgāro vyajyate/ dhṛtiranukampā ca ripudveṣaśca bhāvāḥ/ viṣamālaṅkāraḥ, arthālābhasyānarthaprāpteśca kathanāt//26//
āḥ! durātmannityādinā tarjanodvejanābhyāṃ dyutiḥ/ antarāyo vighnaḥ [saṃvṛttaḥ] sañjātaḥ/ antarāyagrahaṇaṃ kuyogināṃ ``ālasyaṃ vyādhaya'' ityādyantarāyaprādurbhāvaṃ sūcayati/
asyā snehabhūmiḥ premṇo viṣayabhūta iti ``hā daïa māhave''ti prakaṭitatvāt/ kāmandakīsuhṛtputra iti pūrvaṃ viṣkambhakoktaṃ saṅghaṭayati/
sāsraṃ sabāṣpamityatītāvasthānusmaraṇena sakaruṇatvaṃ dyotayati/ kimetat etadbhavatyāḥ pāṣaṇḍahastagamanarūpaṃ vastu kiṃ kathamāyātamiti praśnaḥ/
cirādāśvasya bahunā kālenātmānaṃ paryavasthāpyeti vāgvṛttiyogyatāpādanamāha/ mahābhāga ahamapi na jānāmi/ etāvat punarjānāmi - uparyalinde prasuptā iha pratibuddhāsmītyākarṣaṇavidyayākṛṣṭatvādantarālavṛttāntāparijñānamāha/ iheti karālāyatane/ yūyaṃ punaḥ katham ṛ punaḥ śabdaḥ pakṣavyāvṛttau/ madvṛttāntastāvadāstām/ bhavadvṛttāntaścitrīyate/ etaṃ vṛttāntamajñātvaiva kena prakāreṇāsmin deśe'sminnavasare acintitameva sannihitā ityarthaḥ/
salajjamiti svakṛtasya sāhasasya svenaiva vaktumanucitatvāt savailakṣyamityarthaḥ/
svasannidhānopapattimāha - tvatpādetyādi/ tvatpādapaṅkajayoḥ parigraheṇa aṅgīkaraṇena/ kartari ṣaṣṭhyā samāsaḥ la karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhyāḥ parigrahe tu pādapaṅkajayoḥ prabhutvaṃ vyāhanyeta/ pādapaṅkajagrahaṇaṃ tvatparigrahetyukterapi caraṇakamalaparigrahokteragrāmyatvena rasāvahatvāt/ puṇyajanmā śobhanaṃ janma jananaṃ yasya/ bhūyāsamityāśiṣi liṅ/ abhiniveśakadarthyamānaḥ abhiniveśo nirbandhaḥ ``nitāntarūkṣābhiniveśamīśam'', ``abhūtābhiniveśo rāgaḥ'' ityādi darśanāt/ tena kadarthyamānaḥ kleśyamānaḥ/ anena durlabhatvabuddheḥ sthairyaṃ prakāśyate/ bhrāmyan itastataḥ sañcaran/ ``vā bhrāśa...'' (3-1-70) ityādinā śyan vikalpāt, bhrameḥ śyani śatari rūpam/ nṛmāṃsapaṇanāya nṛmāṃsavikrayārtham/ paretabhūmau śmaśāne/ bhīrviti smaryamāṇā tavaikākinyā bhayāvasthā māṃ dahatīti dyotayati/ ruditānīti lakṣaṇayā sāśrumokṣāṇi vilapitānītyarthaḥ/ atrautsukyaṃ bhāvaḥ/ karuṇaśca raso vyajyate/ samādhiralaṅkāraḥ, tasyāḥ prāptyarthaṃ ekasminnupāye'nuṣṭhīyamāne kāraṇāntarasyāpi daivopanītasya nibandhāt/ ``mahābhāa ahaṃ pi ṇa jāṇāmī''tyārabhya ``ruditāni tavāgato'smī'' tyanto mārgaḥ, tattvārthakīrtanāt//27//
vyasane samāgamasya yojitasya sāphalyamāha - apavārya svagatam/ kathaṃ mama kāraṇādevaite ātmanirapekṣāḥ paribhramanti/ mametyarthāntarasaṅkramitavācyena dhvaninā kaṭhinahṛdayatvanirdākṣiṇyaguṇaviśeṣānabhijñatvādīni sāhasakaraṇonneyāni vyajyante/ ete iti viparyayaḥ pratīyate/ tatra hetuḥ - ātmanirapekṣā iti/ bhūtavetālavyālādisaṅkulatayā sulabhāpāye pitṛvane paribhramasya svaśarīropekṣādyotakatvāt/
acintitena daivasaṅghaṭanena vismayamāna āha - aho nu khalu bhoḥ! ākāśe lokamabhimukhīkṛtyoktiḥ/ bhoḥ he bhavanniti/ aho nu khalu āścaryamevaitadityanubhavaṃ parāmṛśati/ etaditi vartamānaṃ vastu, kākatālīyaṃ nāma kākatālīyamiti prasiddham/ ``samāsācca tadviṣayād'' (5-3-105) iti chaḥ/ kākatālīyamiti kālapakvatayā vṛntāt cyute tālaśikhāvartini tālaphale sahasā sametya kaścit kākaḥ padaṃ karoti, tatphalamapi tadānīṃ patati la avivekinastadālokya kākena pātitaṃ tālaphalamiti kathayanti/ daivopapāditaṃ yaugapadyamantareṇa punaḥ kākena tatpātitamiti/ athavā kāryāntareṇa tālamūlaṃ gataḥ kākastatphalamapi tadānīmeva patitamiti kākatālīyamiti nyāyo nirdiśyate/ tathā śrūyamāṇaṃ tadetadvastu mahāmāṃsavikrayāya śmaśāne bhramato mālatīparitrāṇopapattiriti/ yaditi prakaraṇāt/
atha tādātvikaṃ manaso'vasthāviśeṣamanusandadhāna āha - rāhorityādi/ rāhoḥ saXhikeyasyeti prasiddhaṃ bhrukuṭīkarālatvādiraudratvaṃ dhvanyate/ candrakalāmiti lāvaṇyamārdavādi/ ānanacarīṃ mukhe vartamānāmityubhayatra sambadhyate/ dasyunāpi kabalīkartuṃ nirūpitatvāt, ``śyenāvapātacakitā navavartikevaṣṭakiṃ ceṣṭase nanu cirāt kabalīkṛtāsi/'' ( la ṛ ṛ ṛ. 8)
iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt/ samāsādya anabhisandhipūrvakaṃ bhāgyavaśādeva samāgatya/ me iti etadarthaṃ prāṇānapyupekṣya pravartamānasya mametyarthaḥ/ dasyoḥ, ``śatrurdasyuramitro'riḥ'' iti vaijayantī, paramāpakāritvācchatroḥ/ asyeti purovartitvam/ kṛpāṇapātaviṣayāt khaḍgapatanagocarāt/ ācchindataḥ haṭhādākarṣataḥ/
``dhvāntādācchidya devadviṣa iva balinaḥ'' iti bhaṭṭamayūroktavat/ preyasīṃ priyatamām/ ``priyasthira-'' (6-4-157) ityādisūtreṇa priyaśabdasya prādeśe īyasuni ca rūpam/ ātaṅkād bhayāt, apāyaśaṅkayā la yadyahamasminnantare nāyāsyaṃ tataḥ kimabhaviṣyadityāśaṅkayetyarthaḥ/ ``ulkāśaninṛpavyāghrādibhiryaścittaviplavaḥ/
ātaṅkaḥ sa bhavet so'pi prāyaḥ karuṇatāmiyāt//'' iti bhāvaprakāśaḥ/ ``ātaṅko bhayamāśaṅkā'' ityamaraḥ/ vikalaṃ vivaśam/ ``ūrustambhaśca hṛtkampaḥ svedo dṛkcalatārakā/
śuṣkoṣṭhatāsyaśoṣaśca gadgadatvaṃ vivarṇatā//
viṣayasyāparichittiruktānuktānabhijñatā/
etairbhayānakaḥ svābhāviko mānasa ucyate//'' ityuktānubhāvayuktamityarthaḥ/ drutaṃ navanītadravabhāvamāpannaṃ, karuṇayā ekākinyā, aduḥkhārhāyā striyā evaṃvidhaṃ vyasanamaho samāpatitamiti/ tathā śrīrāmāyaṇe ``strī praṇaṣṭeti kāruṇyamāśritetyānṛśaṃsyatā/'' iti/ ``anukampā tu sā jñeyā duḥkhitān prati dehinaḥ/
upakāraparatvaṃ yā kurute cittavikriyā//'' iti divākaraḥ, ``karuḥ kleśa iti proktaḥ kleśaṃ na sahate yataḥ/
yasya dhīḥ karuṇā sā syāt pratyaye karuṇo bhavet//'' iti bhāvaḥ/ ``yasya cittaṃ dravībhūtaṃ kṛpayā sarvajantuṣu/
tasya jñānaṃ ca mokṣaśca kiṃ jaṭābhasmacīvaraiḥ//'' iti ca mahābhārate/ karuṇayā drutamiti- ``bāhyārthānanusandhānaṃ niśvāsocchvāsadīrghatā/
upekṣā keśavāso'ṅgasaṃskārādiṣu dīnatā//
ākāśavīkṣaṇaṃ ceti mānasaḥ karuṇaḥ smṛtaḥ//'' ityuktaguṇaviśiṣṭamityarthaḥ/ vikṣobhitaṃ vikṛtam, vismayād adbhutarasāveśāt/
``vismayaścittavaicitryaṃ sa tridhā triguṇātmakaḥ/
iti lakṣitādadbhutasthāyibhāvāddhetorityarthaḥ/ vikṣobhitamiti - ``dhyānaṃ nayanavistāraḥ prasādo vadane dṛśi/
ānandāśru saromāñcamanimeṣavilokanam//
aniścalatvaṃ manaso yat tat syānmānaso'dbhutaḥ//'' iti nirdiṣṭavikārayuktamityarthaḥ/ krodhena parāpakārajanitena vikāraviśeṣeṇa, ``tejaḥ syānmanasaḥ krodhaḥ'' iti lakṣitena/
``krodhastridhā bhavet krodhakoparoṣavibhāgataḥ/'' iti śatruviṣayasya krodhasaṃjñokteḥ krodhagrahaṇam/ jvalitaṃ śuṣkendhanamivāgninā vyāptam/ ``bhrakuṭīṃ kuṭilāṃ dhatte jihvayā leḍhi sṛkvaṇī/
muhurmuhurdaśatyoṣṭhaṃ dantān kaṭakaṭāpayan//
śastrāṇyudvīkṣate rūkṣaṃ dṛptaścodvīkṣate bhujau/
na tiṣṭhati na caivāste vidhatte kaṇṭhagarjitam//
evaṃ hi vartate prāyo jātakrodhastu śatruṣu/'' iti krodhakāryonmukhamityarthaḥ/ mudā harṣeṇa/
``mut prītiḥ pramado harṣaḥ pramodāmodasammadāḥ/'' ityamaraḥ/ ``harṣo manaḥprasādaḥ syādīpsitārthopasaṅgamāt/
acintyeṣṭārthasampatterjāyate sarvadā nṛṇām//'' iti lakṣitena harṣeṇa, vikasitaṃ kamalamiva bālātapena nirastasaṅkocam/ ``romāñcāliṅganasvedairlalitaiḥ karatāḍanaiḥ/
netravaktraprasādaiśca bhāṣitairmadhurairapi//
tyāgadānaprabandhaiḥ syuranubhāvāstu harṣajāḥ//'' ityuktaharṣakāryasamagramityarthaḥ/ atra rāhoścandrakalāmiva dasyorānanacarīmityātaṅkasya, preyasīmiti karuṇāyāḥ, daivāt samāsādyeti vismayasya, asyetyadyāpi jīvan puro vartata iti krodhasya, kṛpāṇapātaviṣayādācchindata iti mudaśca heturupanyasta iti mantavyam/ sāmañjasyenānvīyamānānāmapi padānāmākāṅkṣāsannidhiyogyatāvaśādevārthapratyāyanaucityāt/ anyathā ``rāmaṃ daśarathaṃ viddhi'' ityādāvapyasambandhārthatvaṃ prasajet/ tatra rāmajanakātmajāṭavīnāmuddeśyatvena daśarathasumitrāyodhyātvavedanasya krameṇa vidheyatvāt/ granthasandarbhe ca vākyadvayasyāsāmañjasyādarthānusaraṇenānvayo yuktaḥ/ evaṃ sarvatrāvagantavyam/ kathaṃ kena prakāreṇa/ vartatām āstām/ ekasya vastunaḥ ekenaiva prakāreṇa vartanopapatteścetasastu vikalatvādibhiḥ prakāraiḥ śabalatvenāvirbhavadbhiranukalaṃ sahasradhā kadarthyamānatvāt kenacidapi prakāreṇāvasthātuṃ na śakyata ityarthaḥ/ atra ``na doṣaḥ svapadenoktāvapi sañcāriṇaḥ kvacit/'' iti vacanāt svānubhavasiddhānāṃ bhāvānāṃ tathā parāmarśamantareṇa durbhaṇatvāt svaśabdābhidhāne'pi na doṣaḥ/ ``autsukyena kṛtatvare''tyādivat ārtham/ yathāsaṃkhyamatrālaṅkāraḥ, samudāyasambandhasya śrautatve'pyarthānugamānusaraṇenāvayavānāṃ hetuhetumadbhāvataḥ kramasambandhapratīteḥ la upamā ca/ bhāvaśabalatvaṃ tu spaṣṭameva/ sāmānyābhinayavāṃścātra prayogaḥ, āṅgikavācikasātvikāhāryāṇāṃ caturṇāmabhinayānāṃ vidyamānatvāt//28//
are iti sopālambhamāmantraṇam/ vīpsayā vacanatvarā vyajyate/ brāhmaṇaḍimbha! brāhmaṇaśiśo! ityanena brāhmaṇasya svato bhujavīryarāhityaṃ, śiśutve kiṃ punariti dyotayati/ bahuśo brahmahatyāyāḥ prayatnato'nviṣya kṛtatvādidānīṃ svayameva tadāgamād diṣṭyā vardhāmaha iti ca vyañjayati/
vyāghrāghrātetyādi/ vyāghreṇa śārdūlena āghrātāyām, āghrātetyuktiḥ ``ghrāṇaiḥ paśyanti paśavaḥ'' iti vacanāt sāgrahamāghrātenānusṛtya jighatsayā gṛhītāyāmiti dhvanati/ mṛgyāṃ hariṇyām, kṛpayā kāruṇyenākulasya mohitacetaso mṛgasya hariṇasya nyāyena krameṇa/ nyāyaścākiñcitkurvāṇasya tayā saha svayamapi vināśodyamaḥ/ tathāvidho'yam/ tavāpi priyāviṣayeṇa kāruṇyena madabhiyoga ityarthaḥ/ hiṃsāruceḥ prāṇivadhe ruciratirāgo yasya/ pāpa devīpūjāvighnakṛttvena duṣkṛtakārin/ prāṇyupahāraketanajuṣaḥ sahasrakṛtvaḥ pūjārthaṃ kṛtena śarīriṇāmupahāreṇa niṣkṛpajanavijayacihnaṃ dhvajaṃ prāptavataḥ/ athavā prāṇyupahārakarmaṇi ketanaṃ nimantraṇaṃ dīkṣāmityarthaḥ/ ``śrāddhe nārhanti ketanaṃ'' iti smṛtiprayogāt/ prāpto'si na tu mayā yatnataḥ prāpito'sīti niyaticoditatvamāha/ me iti kāyaprāṇamanomantratantrabalairviśiṣṭatvoktiḥ/ gocaraṃ hastaprāpyaṃ deśam/ so'haṃ yaḥ tvayaivaṃ svayameva kopitaḥ so'hamityarthaḥ/ prāk asyāḥ kanyāyāḥ pūrvamiti paścāttadupahārasyāpi vidhitsitatvāt/ bhavataiveti āstāṃ rakṣyabhūtā, rakṣitammanyatayā samāgatena tvayaivetyarthaḥ/ brāhmaṇīto brāhmaṇasya mukhyatayā pradhānahaviṣā tvayaiveti vārthaḥ/ bhūtajananīṃ bhūtānāṃ astipratyayaviṣayāṇāṃ carācarāṇāṃ sṛṣṭiḥ, mūlaprakṛtitvāt/ ``bhūtānāṃ prāṇinaḥ śreṣṭhāḥ'' iti vacanāt/ ṛdhnomi prīṇayāmi/ khaḍgāhatyā khaḍgaprahāreṇa, vyastaskandhasya pṛthakkṛtakaṇṭhamūlasya/ ``skandho bhujaśiraoṃ'so'strī'' iti vaijayantī/ ata eva kabandhasya śirorahitasyādhaḥkāyasya, ``kabandho'strī kriyāyuktamapamūrdhakalebaram/'' ityamaraḥ, randhraṃ kaṇṭhanālavivaraṃ, tasya rudhiraprāgbhāraṃ śoṇitabharaṃ niṣyandituṃ śīlaṃ yasya/ prāgbhāragrahaṇaṃ yuvatvācchrīmatvācca pratyagrasamagradhātutvaṃ prakāśayati/ atra raudraraso vyajyate/ nidarśanā dṛṣṭānto vā alaṅkāraḥ//29//
atha guṇaviśeṣanirapekṣaṃ tasya dāruṇatvamanucintya sāmarṣamāha - asāramityādi/ sāra upādeyaoṃ'śaḥ, tadrahitamasāram, asyā eva sāratvāt, saṃsāraṃ jananamaraṇāditaraṅgasaṅkulaṃ tāpatrayabāḍavābhighātaduḥsthitaṃ lokavyavahārasāgaram/ parimuṣitaratnaṃ stenāpahṛtasarvottaravastu, asyā eva ratnatvāt, tribhuvanaṃ svargabhūtalapātālākhyaṃ lokatrayaṃ, tadavāntarabhedaviṣayatvāt saptacaturdaśasaṃkhyānām/ nirālokaṃ ālokaḥ prakāśaḥ tacchūnyatayā dhvāntākrāntam, asyā eva prakāśatvāt/ maraṇaśaraṇaṃ prāṇatyāga eva rakṣitā śokaduḥkhato yasya, bāndhavajanaṃ bandhavaḥ pitrādaya eva bāndhavāḥ, svārthe taddhitapratyayaḥ, teṣāṃ samūham/ adarpam ``prītinirvṛtinighnānāmarāgaviṣaye'pi yaḥ/
pravṛttiṃ kurute bhāvaḥ pusāṃ darpaḥ sa ucyate/'' iti lakṣitadarparahitaṃ, kandarpaṃ kāmam, asyā eva darpahetutvāt/ jananayananirmāṇaṃ janānāṃ lokānāṃ cakṣurindriyasya brahmakartṛkāṃ sṛṣṭim, aphalaṃ niṣprayojanam, asyā darśanasyaiva phalatvāt/ jagat sarvameva lokam, jīrṇāraṇyaṃ cirantanatayā phalakusumapallavādiśūnyaṃ dāvadagdhaṃ vanam, asyā abhāve jagato'sevyatvāt/ vidhātuṃ kartum, vyavasitaḥ niścayaṃ kṛtavān/ kartari niṣṭhā/ ``kiñcidācarituṃ kāryaṃ vyavasāyaḥ samutthitaḥ/
ākāryasiddherajalo yasya so'pi tadāhvayaḥ//'' iti divākaraḥ/ kathaṃ vyavasito'si ṛ kena prakāreṇādhyavasitavānasītikaraṇaṃ tāvad dūre kartumadhyavasāyo'pi cetanasya duṣkara iti dyotyate/ atrānayā duḥkharūpasya saṃsārasya sukhapratīterjani (ta ṛtṛ)tvaṃ, tribhuvanasya bhūṣitatvaṃ, candrikādibhyo'pi lokasya prakṛṣṭalāvaṇyenoddīpakatvaṃ, bāndhavajanasya guṇagaṇairnigalitatvaṃ, kandarpasya apade'pi jayāśaṃsāyā vihitatvaṃ, jananayanānāmākārasaundaryānanditatvaṃ, puṣpalatayevodyānasya jagato vilāsijanopabhogyatvāpādanaṃ ca kramādvyajyate/ saṃsārādīnāmuddeśyānāmasāratvādīnāṃ vidheyānāṃ ca prāyaḥ paryāyatve'pi punaryaduktiḥ priyānurāgaripuroṣavivaśacetaso vakturna kevalaṃ na doṣaḥ api tu guṇa eveti mantavyam/ ``doṣo'pi guṇaḥ kvacit kvacinnobhau'' iti kāvyaprakāśokteḥ, ``aviśeṣeṇa pūrvoktaṃ yadi bhūyo'pi kīrtyate/
tadekārthaṃ rasākṣiptacetasāṃ tanna duṣyati//'' iti śrībhojavacanācca/ atra ca prakaraṇāllokottīrṇasya kanyāratnasya yat pramāpaṇaṃ tvayopakrāntaṃ tadetat saṃsārādīnāmasāratākaraṇāditi vastusambandhāsambhavenopamā parikalpitā/ mālānidarśanālaṅkāraḥ/ athavā mālatīmāraṇopakramasya saṃsārāsāratākaraṇādibhiradhyavasitatvādatiśayoktiḥ/ tasya madhye maraṇaśaraṇaṃ bāndhavajanamiti sahacarabhinno'pyarthaḥ praviṣṭaḥ/ tasyopamātvābhāvāt so'pi doṣaḥ pūrvaparihāreṇaiva dattotaraḥ/ atra karuṇaraso dhvanyate/ ripuṃ pratyasūyā ca/ ``are brāhmaṇaḍimbhe''tyādinā ``durātman pāṣaṇḍacaṇḍāle''tyādinā ca anyonyasaṃrabdhavacasā toṭakam//30//
punastadaparādhānucintanānmūrchatkrodha āha - praṇayisakhītyādi/ praṇayinīnāmiti svaśarīrebhyo'pyasmin snehavivaśatayā dayālutvaṃ dyotyate, sakhīnāmiti snehavisrambhabhūmitvam, tāsāṃ salīle parihāsarase priyajanānukaraṇasahite krīḍārāge/
``manomadhuravāgaṅgaceṣṭitaiḥ prītiyojitaiḥ/
priyānukaraṇaṃ līlā sā syāt strīpuṃsayorapi//'' ityuktā līlā/ ``dravakeliparīhāsāḥ'' ityamaraḥ/ adhigataiḥ prāptaiḥ/ lalitaśirīṣapuṣpahananaiḥ amlānatayā mṛdulaiḥ śirīṣapuṣpairye prahārāḥ taiḥ/ athavā lalitairatodajanakairiti hananaviśeṣaṇam/ tāmyati davaspṛṣṭaṃ navakisalayamiva mlānaṃ bhavati/ tatra vapuṣi tasmin śarīre viṣaye/ upakṣipataḥ samīpe prerayataḥ/ athavā prastuvānasya vadhāya śastramupakṣipata iti atyantavaiṣamyādavivekitvamāha/ akāṇḍayamadaṇḍaḥ acintitatvādakāla evāśanivad jhaṭiti pravṛtta ityarthaḥ, yamasya kālasya daṇḍa iveti/
``atha pracchannapāpānāṃ śāstā vaivasvato yamaḥ/'' iti vacanāt yamadaṇḍagrahaṇam/ prāṇaharaṇe ca bhujasya paryāptatvaṃ dyotyate atra viṣamaṃ kāvyaliṅgamupamā cālaṅkāraḥ/ praṇayisakhītyādi saṃpheṭaḥ, roṣabhāṣaṇāt//31//
solluṇṭhamāha - prahara prahareti/ mayi prahartuṃ tava kā śaktirityarthaḥ/ tadevāha - ayaṃ na bhavasi/ ayamīdṛśo jalaḥ, tvamityāyāti madhyamaprayogāt/ na bhavasi jhaṭiti vinaṅkṣyasīti vartamānasāmīpye laṭ/
snehādapāyaśaṅkinyāha - pasīdeti/ prasīda sāhasika nātha/ dāruṇaḥ khalveṣa hatāśaḥ/ paritrāyasva māṃ nivṛtyāsmādanarthasaṃśayāt/ prasīda anugrahaṃ kuru/ tatra hetuḥ - dāruṇaḥ krūraḥ, khalu prasiddhau, hatāśaḥ hatā adharmaviṣayatayā duṣṭā āśā abhiprāyo yasya/ athavā dūṣitā svaduśceṣṭitairdiśo yena/ prasādaprakāramāha - asmādvigraharūpāt, anarthasaṃśayāt vyasanasandehāt, ekāntavijayasyānyatarasmin anadhyavaseyatvādityarthaḥ, nivṛtya viramya, māṃ rakṣeti tvadapāye madapāyasyāpi nāntarīyakatvāt tvadrakṣaṇameva madrakṣaṇamityarthaḥ/ ``ṇivvattīadu'' iti pāṭhe nivartyatāṃ bhavateti śeṣaḥ/ ``jugupsāvirāmapramādārthānāmupasaṃkhyānam'' ( la. 2. 3. 28) iti virāmārthatvāt pañcamī/
apramattaḥ avahitaḥ/ vyāpādaya māraya/
mālatīkapālakuṇḍale pratīti yathāsaṃkhyamanvayaḥ, mādhavo mālatīṃ lakṣīkṛtyāghoraghaṇṭaḥ kapālakuṇḍalāmityarthaḥ/ uktyaikyaṃ nāṭakanyāyādrasābhinayanibandhanam/
dhairyaṃ nidhehītyādi - nidhehi sthāpaya, tasya calitatvāt/ hata iti bhūtatvena nirdeśo nātra saṃśaya iti dyotayitum/ eṣa iti mādhavoktau kāpālikaḥ taduktau mādhavaḥ parāmṛśyate/ pāpaḥ mahāpātakapuñjakañcukitatvāt pūjāghātakatvācca/ kimiti praśne/ veti vikalpe/ kadācidapi vā kenacidvā kimanvabhāvi pratyakṣamakārītyarthaḥ/ sāraṅgasaṅgaravidhau hariṇena saha yuddhakaraṇe/ ibhakumbhakūṭakuṭṭākapāṇikuliśasya gajaśiraḥpiṇḍarūpaśailaśikharatakṣaṇaśīlāni hastasthitāni vajrāṇi yasya/ ``kumbhau tu piṇḍau śirasaḥ'' iti, ``kūṭo'strī śikharaṃ śṛṅgaṃ'' ityamaraḥ/ kumbhayoḥ kūṭatvena rūpaṇād ibhasya śailatvarūpaṇasiddhiḥ/ ``jalpabhikṣakuṭṭaluṇṭavṛṅaṣṣākan'' (3-2-155) iti ṣākanpratyayaḥ/ pāṇikuliśabdena hastasthitā nakhā atiśayoktyādhyavasīyante/ kūṭatvokteḥ kuliśatvoktyaucityaṃ vajrasya śikhariśikharadāraṇaśaktiprasiddheḥ/ hareḥ siṃhasya, indrasyeti ca sphurati/ pramādaḥ lakṣaṇayānavadhānakāryavyasanamiti yāvat/ atra vīraraso dhvanyate/ vaidharmyataḥ prativastūpamā, ekadeśavivartirūpakam, atiśayoktiścālaṅkāraḥ//32//
mālatyanveṣiṇaḥ mālatīmanveṣṭuṃ śīlaṃ yeṣām, tadanveṣaṇārthamitastataḥ paribhramaṇaśīlā ityarthaḥ/ āśvāsayantī sunimittādikathanena vītaśokaṃ kurvāṇā/ apratihatagatiḥ sarvapathīnajñānasāmarthyā/ ``gatyarthā buddhyarthāḥ'' iti vacanād gatiśabdo jñānamāha/ ``ṇau gamirabodhane'' (2-4-46) iti gamerbodhanārthatvamapyastīti jñāpakācca/ paryavaṣṭabhyatāṃ paritaḥ sarvataḥ ākramyatām/ etadityukteḥ samīpagatatvaṃ vakturjñeyam, karālāyatanam/
paryavaṣṭambhe hetumāha - nāghoraghaṇṭādityādi/ anyatra anyasmin puruṣe/ dāruṇādbhutaṃ krūraṃ mugdhastrīvadharūpatvāt, āścaryam uparyalindavartinyāḥ sakhījanamadhyādardharātre samākarṣaṇāt/ karālopahārāt karālāyai balitvena dānāt, anyat phalaṃ prayojanam/ vibhāvyate nirūpyate/ iti samādiśatīti sambandhaḥ/ ``anyārād--'' (2-3-297) ityādinā anyaśabdayoge pañcamī/ atrānumānamalaṅkāraḥ/ anumānākhyaṃ garbhāṅgaṃ cedaṃ, liṅgato'myūhanāt//33//
kāpālikaṃ kāpālikī sabhayamāha - paryavaṣṭabdhāḥ smaḥ uparuddhā bhavāmaḥ, amātyasainikairityarthāt/
kāpālikaḥ sadhīramāha - samprati bahujanoparodhe, viśeṣato'tiśayena, pauruṣasya parākramasya, avasaraḥ samayaḥ/ pūrvamekenaikasya jaye tādṛśasya yaśaso'nutthānād bahūnāṃ tvekena parājaye sarvaślāghyatvāt prayatnataḥ parākramaṇīyamityarthaḥ/ ``gaganatalaprayāṇavega'' ityuktau gaganagamanaśaktayorapyanayoradharmapāśabaddhatvād gatibhaṅgo jāta ityavaseyam/
svajanavacanaṃ bahiḥ śrutvā sotkaṇṭhā mālatyāha - hā tāta! hā bhagavati! bhūrivasuriti kāmandakīti ca dvayoḥ smāritatvāt tayorduḥkhamanusandhāya tannāmagrāhaṃ roditītyarthaḥ/
bāndhavasamājasusthitāṃ bandhusamūhe nirbhayatvena sthitām/ bhavatvityādirvidravaḥ, kāpālikavadhakathanāt/
anyataḥ pūrvasthānād bandhujanābhimukhaṃ sthānāntare pravartayan/
atha priyāparibhavasmaraṇānuśayāt pūjāvighātāccoddīpitakrodhāvāhatuḥ- kaṭhorāsthītyādi/ kaṭhinānāmasthigranthīnāṃ sandhibandhāsthināṃ vyatikarāt samparkād ghaṇatkāreṇa kṛṣṇapāṣāṇakuṭṭākaṭaṅkasaṅghaṭṭaśabdasadṛśena śabdaviśeṣeṇa mukharo vācāṭaḥ/ kharāṇāṃ karkaśānāṃ snāyūnāṃ sandhibandhasirāṇāṃ chedena kṣaṇaṃ svalpakālaṃ vihitaḥ kṛtaḥ patanavegasya vyuparamaḥ śamanaṃ yasya/ dāruṇadārudāraṇapravṛttasyeva paraśoḥ pariṇatalatāpāśabandhanena kiṃcidvilambāt/ nirātaṅkaḥ āśaṅkārahita iti pratibandhābhāvo lakṣaṇayocyate/ paṅkeṣu kardameṣviveti madhye kaṭhinadravyābhāvāt/ piśitapiṇḍeṣu aṃsasphigādipradeśamāṃsaghaneṣu/ asiḥ khaḍgaḥ/ gātraṃ gātraṃ pratyekamaṅgāni/ sapadīti krodhasya kālāntarākṣamatvaṃ prakāśayati/ lavaśaḥ tilavat kaṇaṃ kaṇaṃ kṛtvā/ vikiratu dikṣu vikṣipatu/ vidhau loṭ/ atra raudro vyajyate/ svabhāvoktiralaṅkāraḥ/ kaṭhorāsthītyādirvyavasāyaḥ, svaśaktyukteḥ/ sampheṭākhyamārabhaṭyaṅgaṃ cedam/ ``sampheṭaḥ sa samāghātaḥ kruddhaḥ saṃrabdhayordvayoḥ/'' iti vacanāt//34//
niṣkrāntāḥ sarve iti - ``dūrādhvānaṃ vadhaṃ yuddhaṃ rājyadeśādiviplavam/
saṃrodhaṃ bhojanaṃ snānaṃ surataṃ cānulepanam//
ambaragrahaṇādīni pratyakṣāṇi na nirdiśet//'' iti vacanād yuddhaṃ kāpālikavadhaṃ copari viṣkambhakeṇa sūcayiṣyan pātraniṣkrāmaṇenāṅkaṃ parisamāpayatītyaśeṣamatimaṅgalam//
mālatīmādhavasyetthaṃ pañcamāṅkārthacarcanam/
pūrṇajyotiḥprasādena cakre pūrṇasarasvatī// //iti pañcamo'ṅkaḥ//
atha ṣaṣṭho'ṅkaḥ//
atha viṣkambhakamārabhate - praviśyeti/ [āḥ] ``āstu syāt kopapīḍayoḥ'' iti vaijayantī/ mālatīnimittaṃ mālatīhetoriti vinipātanakriyāviśeṣaṇam/ mālatīnimittamityuktiḥ nimittabhūtāyāṃ tasyāṃ vairānubandhaṃ dyotayati/ vinipātitāsmadguro pramāpitaḥ, asmākamityātmani bahuvacanaṃ tannigrahaśaktiṃ sūcayati, gururyena ityanuvādena samarabhuvi tasya mādhavena hatatvaṃ jñāpyate/ mādhavahataka! mādhavasaṃjñanaṣṭaśīla! ityākāśe'bhimukhīkṛtyoktiḥ/ tasminnavasare iti vinipātitetyuktestadvinipātanakāla ityarthāt, nirdayaṃ nighnatī niṣṭhuraṃ praharantī, apīti svasyāvadhyatvaṃ prakāśayati strītyavajñātā strītvenopekṣitā/
``avadhyā brāhmaṇā gāvaḥ striyo bālātha jñātayaḥ''/
iti smṛteḥ/ anayā nīce ghṛṇayā nāyakasya śobhākhyaḥ sāttvikaguṇaḥ prakāśitaḥ/
``hīne ghṛṇādhike spardhā śobhāyāṃ śauryadakṣatā/'' iti vacanāt/ sakrodhamiti - tadapakārānusandhānāt krodhavikāramabhinīyetyarthaḥ/ taditi tasmādyato'haṃ jīvāmītyarthaḥ/ avaśyamavyabhicaritaṃ kapālakuṇḍalākopasya kapālakuṇḍaleti na tu madityanena prasiddhaprabhāvatvaṃ dyotayati/ vilasitaṃ vipākam/
uktamarthaṃ nidarśanenopapādayati - śāntiḥ kuta ityādi/ śāntirmanaso nirvṛtiḥ kutaḥ kasmāddhetoḥ, sadā śaṅkāspadatvenodvignatvāt, bhujaṅgaśatroḥ nāgamithunāt pumāṃsaṃ hatavataḥ/ yasmin viṣaye, amuktānuśayā aparityaktadīrghadveṣā/
``paścāttāpe tvanuśayo dīrghadveṣānubandhayoḥ/'' iti vaijayantī/ sadā nityam evakāro bhinnakramaḥ, jāgartyeva na nidrātyeva, ``jāgṛ nidrākṣaye'' iti dhātuḥ, avahitaiva chidrānveṣiṇī vartata iti yāvat/ daṃśāya daṃśanārtham/ niśātadaṃṣṭrākoṭiḥ tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭrāgrā, viṣodgāraguruḥ garalodvamanena gurvī apratihatasāmarthyā, bhujaṅgī hatasya nāgasya virahavidhurā sahacarī nāgī/ atra vaidharmyeṇa dṛṣṭānto'laṅkāraḥ, kāpālikasya taddhanturmādhavasya tatpraticikīrṣośca svasyāḥ ``tadavaśya''miti vākyoktānāṃ bimbabhūtānāṃ padmokteḥ bhujaṅgena tacchatruṇā bhujaṅgyā ca pratibimbitasya sphuṭatvāt/ ``anubhaviṣyasī''tyuktasya kuta iti vaidharmyeṇa samarthanācca vaidharmyadṛṣṭāntatvam/ athavā pūrvavākyamanapekṣya paryālocane aprastutapraśaṃsā, prastutasyārthasya aprastutamukhena gamyamānatvāt, atiśayoktirvā prakṛtasyārthasya samena nigīryādhyavasānāt/ avaśyamanubhaviṣyasītyādi virodhanam, saṃrabdhokteḥ//1//
atha ``nandanāya rājñā pratipāditā'' iti pūrvaprastutasya mālatīvivāhotsavasyānusandhānaṃ karoti kaviḥ nāyakakāryahetoḥ - naipathye/ he rājāna ityādi/ ityādiśatīti vakṣyamāṇena sambandhaḥ/ ādeśaprakāraḥ - he rājāna iti/ rājagrahaṇaṃ cakravartinā padmāvatīśvareṇa pravartitatvād utsavasya pratāpānurāgāvanatāḥ sāmantā eva bhṛtyakṛtyaṃ vahantīti dyotanārtham/ caramavayasāṃ caramamantimaṃ vayo jīvanakālo yeṣām, navatiṃ varṣāṇyatītānāṃ daśamīsthānāmiti yāvat/ vṛddhatvoktyā dharmajñatvaṃ lakṣyate/ anyathā paśvādivad vṛddhatvavyavahārasyaivāyogyatvāt/ ``na sā sabhā yatra na santi vṛddhāḥṣṭana te vṛddhā ye na vadanti dharmam/'' iti vacanāt, teṣāṃ vaidikalaukikācāraniṣṇātānām/ ājñayā niyogena/ kartavyeṣu anuṣṭheyeṣu karmasu, toraṇastambhottambhanavitānabandhanamaṇḍapamaṇḍanādiṣu, sañcaradhvaṃ pravartadhvam/ ājñayā sañcaradhvamiti ``samastṛtīyāyuktāt'' (1-3-54) ityātmanepadam/ śravaṇasubhagaṃ arthānusandhānaṃ vināpyākarṇane maṅgalasādhanaṃ puṇyāhasvastivācanādikaṃ sahasranāmādikaṃ cetyarthaḥ, bhūmidevāḥ brāhmaṇāḥ, teṣāmeva yājane'dhikārāt, paṭhantu adhīyantām/ citraṃ gītavādyanartanādivividhaprakāraviśiṣṭam, nānāvacananivahaiḥ bahuprakārā hariharapitāmahaskandakandarparudrāṇīndrāṇyādidevatāviśeṣastutiparā vacanasamūhā yeṣāṃ taiḥ, naṭanartakatālaravacaracāraṇādibhirityarthaḥ, [ceṣṭyatāṃ] pravartyatām, maṅgalebhyaḥ abhyudayārthamāyurārogyaiśvaryasaubhāgyaputrasampadādiphalasādhanatvabhedād bahuvacanam/ pratyāsannaḥ tricaturanāḍikāntaritaḥ, tvarayatitarāṃ atiśayena protsāhayati, asmān īdṛśeṣu vyāpāreṣviti śeṣaḥ, janyayātrāpraveśaḥ janyānāṃ jāmātṛbandhūnāṃ yātrā, utsavārthamāgamanaṃ kanyāvaraṇārthaṃ vā/
``jñātibhṛtyā navoḍhāyā janyā snigdhā varasya vā/'' iti, ``śāntiyātrā varanimantraṇe'' iti ca vaijayantī/ śāntiśabdāprayogaḥ prasiddhyā/ athavā janyaśabdopalakṣitā varayātrā janyayātrā, ``daundubhī varayātrāyāṃ'' iti vaijayantī/ svakṛtasaṃvaraṇārthaṃ caiva taditi mantavyam/ tasyāḥ praveśaḥ/ praviśatyasminniti tadyogo muhūrtaḥ praveśaḥ/ tvarayatitarāmiti tatsamarthācaraṇāduktiḥ/ atrārthāntaranyāso'laṅkāraḥ, kartavyasañcaraṇādeḥ kāryasya praveśatvaraṇena kāraṇena samarthanāt/ aprastutapraśaṃsā vā, sañcaraṇādinā kāryeṇa kāraṇasya mālatīvivāhotsavasya sūcanāt//2//
yāvat yasmin kālāvadhau, cakāro vākyārbhasamuccaye, saṃbandhinaḥ kanyādvāreṇa sambandhamabhilaṣanto bandhavaḥ, ``pulastyaḥ pulahapraṣṭhāśca sambandhinaḥ'' iti murāryuktavat, na parāpatanti nāgacchanti, tāvat tasmin kālāvadhau ca/ nagaradevateti deśādhipatyāt kuladevatātvāccāvaśyābhigamanīyatvamāha/ avighnamaṅgalāya niṣpratyūhāya kalyāṇāya, anyathā``pratibadhnāti hi śreyaḥ pūjyapūjāvyatikramaḥ/
iti nyāyādvighnopapatteḥ/ anyacceti ādiśatikriyānukarṣaṇārthaḥ/ gṛhītasaviśeṣamaṇḍana iti vibhūtiprapañcena pūrvameva bhūṣitatvādidānīmutsavārthaṃ sātiśayaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ svīkṛtaṃ yena, pratīkṣatāṃ nirgacchantīṃ pratipālayatu/ ānuyātrikaḥ anugamanaṃ sevanaṃ prayojanaṃ yena, parijana ityarthaḥ/ ``he rājāna'' ityādi prarocanā, bhāvino'rthasya siddhatvena pradarśanāt/
bhavatvityardhāṅgīkāre, vṛthā samanuṣṭhīyatāṃ, mayā punarmūlamevocchetsyata iti bhāvaḥ/ itaḥ asmāt/ parikarmasthāneṣu jananiveśanaṃ, tattatkarmasu tattajjanavyāpāraṇamityādirupasaṃskāraḥ parikarma, tatra satvarāṇāṃ sambhrāntānāṃ pratīhārāṇāṃ vetrapāṇīnām/ ``dvāsthedvārau pratīhārau'' iti vaijayantī/ śatena saṅkulāt saṅkaṭāt/ mādhavāpakāraṃ prati mādhavasya vipriyaṃ lakṣīkṛtya/ abhiniviṣṭā nirbandhavatī, chidrānveṣiṇīti yāvat/
atītasya kāpālikavadhasya, āgāminaḥ kapālakuṇḍalānimittasya vyasanasya mālatīnirgamasya ca sūcitatvād viṣkambhamupasaṃharati - niṣkrāntā/ //iti viṣkambhakaḥ//
atha sarasavastvabhinayāyāṅkamārabhate - tataḥ praviśati kalahaṃsa iti/
kalahaṃsaḥ - āṇattohnītyādi/ ājñapto'smi nagaradevatāgarbhagṛhavartinā samakarandena nāthena/ samakarandeneti makarandasāhitye tātparyamāha/ nāthena svāminā mādhavenetyarthaḥ/ jānīhi tāvaditomukhaṃ pravṛttā mālatī na veti/ itomukhaṃ etaddeśoddeśavalitavadanamiti kriyāviśeṣaṇam/ pravṛttā prasthitā/ athavā neti apāyaśaṅkitvaṃ dyotayati, ``śreyāṃsi bahuvighnāni'' iti nyāyāt/ anayā coktibhaṅgyā sābhiprāyakāmandakīsaṅketapūrvameva nagaradevatāgarbhagṛhavartitvamanayoḥ, tanniyogācca mālatyāstadupagamanamiti prakāśyate/ ``avighnamaṅgalāya gantavyami''ti ca vacanaṃ saṅghaṭayati/ tadyāvadānandayiṣyāmi priyavacanenetyarthaḥ/ yāvacchabdo vākyālaṅkāre avadhāraṇe vā/
atha garbhagṛhavartitvena sūcitatvāt nāyakopanāyakayoḥ praveśamāha - tataḥ praviśata iti/
phalāphalayoranyataraniścayājjīvanamaraṇayoranyataraṃ niṣkṛṣya hṛṣṭo dhṛṣṭa āha- mālatyā ityādi/ prathamāvalokanadinād ādyadarśanopalakṣitamadanodyānagamanadivasamādiṃ kṛtvā, vistāriṇaḥ svayameva rūpamādhuryadarśanamātreṇa vardhiṣṇoḥ/ vistāribhirityapapāṭhaḥ, bhūya ityādīnāṃ vaiyarthyāpātāt/ bhūyaḥ paścāt, snehaviceṣṭitaiḥ premakāryaiḥ pravṛttiviśeṣaiḥ, citralekhanabakulamālādhāraṇadānaśravaṇavaivarṇyamaraṇasamayamuktāśaṅkapralāpaprabhṛtibhirityarthaḥ, mṛgadṛśā mālatyā, parāṃ koṭiṃ nītasya agrabhūmimāropitasya, ``ānandasya parāṃ koṭimanvabhavan'' iti kādambaryuktavat/ adya asmin kāle iti pūrvavaditaḥ parasya, śvaḥ paraśvo veti pratīkṣaṇīyasya kālāntarasyānupapatteḥ/ antaḥ avasānam/ khaluravadhāraṇe/ sarvathā sarvaprakāreṇa, siddhāvasiddhau cetyarthaḥ/ asyetyanubhūyamānatvābhinayaḥ, madanāyāsasya kāmena janitasya duḥkhasya, sarvasya antarbahirdeśakāladaśādibhiruddīpyamānasyetyarthaḥ, kalyāṇaṃ priyatamāprāptirūpaṃ maṅgalam/ bhagavatīnītiḥ kāmandakyā naya upāyaprayogaḥ, viparyetu viparyayamanyathābhāvaṃ vā gacchatu, tatprāptivighnopanipātāt/ atra harṣadhṛtyākhyau bhāvau prakāśyete/ vikalpo'laṅkāraḥ, tulyabalayoḥ siddhyasiddhyoḥ spardhībhāvenopanibandhāt//3//
atha tadalābhe prāṇatyāgodyamaparaṃ tadīyamākūtamavabuddhyopapattyā pakṣāntaraśaṅkāmapanudati - bhagavatyā iti prasiddhaprabhāvatvāt saṅkalpasiddhiṃ dyotayati, samedhāśāstiḥ - ``dhīrdhāraṇāvatī medhā'' iti vaijayantī/ medhāśabdena tatkāryabhūto nītiprayoga ucyate, tatsahitā āśāstiḥ, ``svastyasmai bhūyādi''ti snehapūrvā āśīḥ, kathamityākṣepe, kena prakāreṇa, viparyeṣyatīti viparītā bhaviṣyati/ ``śāpādapi śarādapi'' iti nyāyena pratyekaṃ samarthayordvayoranayormilatitve dahanapavanayoriva phalavisaṃvāditā kadācit na bhaviṣyatītyarthaḥ/ ``mālatyāḥ prathame''tyādi ``kathaṃ samedhāśāstirviparyeṣyatī''tyantaḥ ākṣepaḥ, bhagavatīnītirūpasya garbhabījasya samutkṣepāt/
ṇāhetyādi/ nātha diṣṭyā vardhase/ pravṛttā khalvitomukhaṃ mālatī/
apiḥ praśne, satyaṃ kimityātmanastādṛśaṃ bhāgadheyamasambhāvayannāha/
aśraddadhānaḥ aviśvasan/ ``tathetipratyayaḥ śraddhā'' iti halāyudhaḥ/ na kevalaṃ pravṛttā prasthitetyetāvadeva na, kintu pratyāsannā samīpībhūtā vartate/
sāmīpyamevopapādayati - tathā hi/ asmākamityādi/ ekapade ekacaraṇavinyāsakāle eva na dvitīyapadacalanāvakāśa ityanenaikasmin kṣaṇe ityuktaṃ bhavati/ ``ayamekapade'nayā viyogaḥ'' iti prayogāt/
``padaṃ sthāne śare trāṇe pādāṅke pādacihnayoḥ/
śabdeṃ'śuvastuvākyeṣu vyavasāyāpadeśayoḥ//'' iti vaijayantī/ marutā vāyunā vikīrṇasya vistāritasya iti prāvṛṣeṇyatvaṃ dhvanyate, jīmūtajālasya meghasamūhasya rasitaṃ stanitaṃ tasyānukṛtiḥ sādṛśyaṃ yasmin/ gambhīrāṇāṃ agādhodarāṇāṃ maṅgalamṛdaṅgānāṃ śabdaśravaṇātkalyāṇahetubhūtānāṃ murajavādyānāṃ sahasrājjanma utpattiryasya/ ``mṛdaṅgā murajā'' ityamaraḥ/ maṅgalamṛdaṅgeti śākapārthivāditvāt samāsaḥ/ śabdāntarāṇāmanyeṣāṃ svavyatiriktānāṃ śabdānāṃ dhvanīnāṃ grahaṇe śravaṇe yā śaktiḥ śrotrendriyapāṭavaṃ tāṃ apākaroti nirasyati/ atrodāttamatiśayoktiścālaṅkāraḥ//4//
ehi āgaccha/ jālamārgeṇa garbhagṛhagavākṣarandhreṇa/ ``jālaṃ gavākṣa ānāyaḥ'' iti vaijayantī/
tathā uktaprakāreṇa, kurvanti anutiṣṭhanti/ paśyantītyarthaḥ/
ṇāhetyādi - nātha! paśya paśya/ ime tāvadutpatitarājahaṃsavibhramābhirāmacāmarasamīraṇapreraṇodvellatkadalikāvalītaraṅgitottānagaganāṅkaṇasaronirantaroddaṇḍapuṇḍarīkavibhramaṃ vahanti maṅgalātapatranivahāḥ/ [utpatitānāṃ] uḍḍayamānānāṃ rājahaṃsānāmiva vibhramo vikṣepo yastena [abhirāmāṇāṃ] manoharāṇāṃ sitacamarabālavyajanānāṃ [samīraṇasya] vāyoḥ preraṇena calantīnāṃ kadalikānāṃ gajadhvajapaṭānām, ``abhyullasatkadalikāvanarājiruccaiḥ'' iti māghoktavat/ ``kadalī kariṇāṃ ketuḥ'' iti vaijayantī [āvalibhiḥ] paṅktibhiḥtaraṅgitasya sañjātakallolasya ata evottānasya gatagāmbhīryasya, tābhiḥ paricchinnordhvabhāgatvāt/
``nimnaṃ gabhīraṃ gambhīramuttānaṃ tadviparyaye/'' ityamaraḥ/ athavā ``uttānaśaya'' ityādivadadhobhāgasya nibiḍatvādupari vitatasvarūpasyetyarthaḥ/ gaganāṅkaṇarūpasya sarasaḥ padmākarasya nirantarāṇāṃ parasparamilitānāmuddaṇḍānāmudgatanālānāṃ puṇḍarīkāṇāṃ sitāmbhojānāṃ vibhramaṃ vilāsaṃ vahanti, maṅgalārthāḥ ātapatranivahāḥ chatrasamūhāḥ/ maṅgalātapatretyukteḥ śvetacchatratvaṃ labhyate/ svacchandavipule gaganasarasi lolatayā cāmarāṇi rājahaṃsatāṃ, kadalikāstaraṅgatāṃ, maṅgalātapatrāṇi puṇḍarīkatāṃ ca dhārayantītyarthaḥ/ udāttaṃ rūpakañcātrālaṅkāraḥ/
dīsantīti - dṛśyante ca savilāsakabalitatāṃbūlāpūritakapolamaṇḍalābhogapratiskhalitamadhuramaṅgalodgītakolāhalaiḥ vividharatnālaṅkārakiraṇāvalīviḍambitamahendracāpakhaṇḍavicchuritanabhasthalaiḥ vārasundarīkadambakairadhyāsitāḥ kanatkanakakiṅkiṇīraṇitajhaṇajhaṇājhaṅkāriṇyaḥ kariṇyaḥ/ savilāsakabaliteti tāmbūlacarvaṇaprakāro'pi cāturyānmukhaśobhāmāvahatīti dyotayati/ tāmbūlenāpūritatvād gaṇḍamaṇḍalakuharavistāre pratiskhalitāḥ pratiruddhanirgamāḥ, madhurāḥ snigdharaktakaṇṭhatayā prayogavaidagdhyācca hṛdayagrāhiṇaḥ, maṅgalārthāstatkarmocitadevatāstutirūpatvādudgītakolāhalā uccaistarā gānakalakalā yeṣām/ vividhānāmaruṇasitanīlapītaśyāmavarṇānāṃ, māṇikyādimahāratnamayānāmābharaṇānāṃ kiraṇāvalībhirmayūkhasamūhairnīlavarṇeṣu, kariṇīśarīreṣu patitābhirhetubhūtābhirityarthaḥ, viḍambitamanukṛtam, mahendracāpasya indradhanuṣaḥ, tasya nānāvarṇatvāt, khaṇḍaiḥ śakalairvicchuritaṃ miśritaṃ nabhaḥsthalaṃ yaiḥ/ vārasundarīkadambakairmukhyagaṇikāsamūhaiḥ/ ``...veśyāḥ rūpājīvātha sājanaiḥ/ satkṛtā vāramukhyā syāt'' ityamaraḥ/ adhyāsitā adhiṣṭhitāḥ/ kanantīnāṃ dīpyamānānām/ ``kana dīptikāntigatiṣu'' iti dhātuḥ/ kanakakiṅkiṇīnāṃ raṇitarūpo jhaṇajhaṇājhaṅkāro yāsām/ jhaṇajhaṇeti śabdānukāraḥ, jhaṅkāra iti samudāyadhvaniḥ/ kariṇyaḥ gajavadhvaśca dṛśyanta iti/
spṛhaṇīyāḥ ``īdṛśīnāṃ vibhūtīnāṃ kāraṇabhūtaṃ kiṃ nāma tat tapaḥ yadi tadviditamabhaviṣyat, sarve vayamacariṣyāma'' iti vāñchākāriṇya ityarthaḥ/ kartari kṛtyapratyayaḥ/ khaluravadhāraṇe/ vibhūtayaḥ sampadaḥ, bahuvacanena bahumukhatvaṃ sūcyate/
tat samarthayati - tathā hi/ preṅkhadbhūrītyādi/ preṅkhatāṃ calatāṃ [mayūrāṇāṃ mecakāḥ], netrāṇīti yāvat/ ``mayūro barhiṇo barhī'' iti, ``samaucandrakamecakau'' ityamaraḥ/ tannibhaistatsadṛśaiḥ/ ``[tulyaṃ savarṇaṃ] śabdebhyaḥ pare syuḥ ,pratimā prabhā .
[ābhā prakhyopamābhikhyā prakāraḥ] sannibhaṃ nibham//''ṃ, ``nikāśādyāśca sāmyārthāḥ'' iti vaijayantī/ unmeṣicāṣacchadacchāyāsaṃvalitaiḥ unmeṣeṇa sphuraṇaṃ lakṣyate, sphuratāṃ cāṣapakṣipakṣāṇāṃ chāyayā śobhayā sammiśritaiḥ/ ivaśabdo bhinnakramaḥ, saṃvalitairiva/ vivartibhiḥ vividhavarṇatayā pravartamānaiḥ/ ``cāṣo rājavihaṅgamaḥ/ maṇikaṇṭhaścitravāja'' iti, ``chadaḥ pakṣo garudvājaḥ'' iti, ``chāyānātapaśobhayoḥ'' iti ca vaijayantī/ unmukhamaṇijyotirvitānaiḥ unmukhānāmūrdhvaṃ prasaratāṃ maṇijyotiṣāṃ chatracāmaravāraṇavāranārījanādibhūṣaṇanihitanavaratnaprabhāṇāṃ vistāraiḥ, prānteṣu samīpeṣu paryāvṛtāḥ, ūrdhvabhāgasyāpi diktvāt tiryagūrdhvamapi sarvataḥ saṃcchāditāḥ diśa utprekṣyante/ vyaktākhaṇḍalakārmukā iva spaṣṭadṛṣṭendracāpā iva tiryak/ uccitracīnāṃśukaprastārasthagitā iva udbhūtanānāvarṇalekhyaviśiṣṭānāṃ cīnāṃśukānāṃ cīnadeśanirmitapaṭṭavastrāṇāṃ devāṅgādīnāṃ prastāraiḥ prapañcaiḥ prāvṛtā ivordhvaṃ bhavantīti/ ``prestro'yajñe'' (3-3-32) iti ghañ/ ``puṣpaprastāraśāyinā'' iti bhartṛkāvyokteḥ/ atrodāttaṃ utprekṣā cālaṅkāraḥ//5//
sasaṃbhrametyādi/ sasaṃbhramānekapratihāramaṇḍalāvarjitojjvalakanakakaladhautapaṅkapatracitravetralatāparikṣiptarekhāracitamaṇḍalo dūrata eva saṃsthitaḥ parijanaḥ/ pratihāramaṇḍalena dvārapālasamūhenāvarjitābhiravanāmitābhirujjvalābhiḥ sphurantībhiḥ la tatra hetuḥ - kanakakaladhautapaṅkapatracitrābhiḥ parabhāgahetoḥ suvarṇarajatadravakṛtayā patralekhayā nānāvarṇābhirvetralatābhiḥ, parikṣiptāyāṃ bhuvi vartulākāreṇa nihitāyā asyā rekhāyā bahireva sthātavyamiti rājājñābhūtayā rekhayā racitamaṇḍalaḥ kṛtavartulākārasaṃsthānaḥ/
eṣā ca bahalasindūranikarasandhyārāgoparaktamukhaghūrṇamānanakṣatramālābharaṇadhāriṇīṃ kareṇurajanīmalaṅkurvāṇā ita eva kautūhalotphullamukhasamastalokadṛśyamānamanoharāpāṇḍaraparikṣāmadehaśobhāvibhāvitānaṅgavedanā prathamacandrarekhāvibhramaṃ vahantī kiñcidantaraṃ prasṛtā mālatī/ sindūro dhātuviśeṣaḥ, tasya raktavarṇatvāt sandhyārāgatvāropaḥ, tenoparakte rūṣite mukhe vadane, bahalasindūranikarasadṛśasandhyārāgoparañjite ārambhe ca/ ghūrṇamānaṃ calantaṃ nakṣatramālārūpamābharaṇalaṅkāraṃ dhārayituṃ śīlaṃ yasyāḥ/
``proktā nakṣatramālā yā saptaviṃśatimauktikā/'' iti halāyudhaḥ, tārakāvalī ca śleṣeṇocyate/ kareṇurajanīṃ hastinīrūpāṃ rātrim, abhyudayahetutvāt kareṇuvannīlabṛhadrūpāṃ rātriṃ ca/ prārabdhavivāhānāṃ kanyānāṃ darśane sarvalokasya sakautukatvaprasiddheḥ, navoditatvācca/ manoharasyāpāṇḍarasya parikṣāmasya ca dehasya śobhayā vibhāvitā prakāśitā [anaṅgavedanā] kāmajanitā pīḍā yasyāḥ, dehaśobhayā jyotsnāṅkureṇa sūcitā bhāvinī lokasya kāmapīḍā yayā ca/ ata eva ca prathamacandralekhāvibhramaṃ vahantī pūrvapakṣapratipaduditāyāścandrakalāyā vilāsaṃ dadhāneti sandhyānurañjitaprārambhāṃ tārakānikaraśobhinīṃ yāminīmiva sindūrāruṇāvadanāṃ nakṣatramālākhyamuktābharaṇadhāriṇīṃ kariṇīmadhirūḍhā kautūhalotphulletyādisādhāraṇaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭā mālatī pratipaccandralekhevetyarthaḥ/ kiñcidantaraṃ prasṛtā svalpamasmākaṃ svasyāścāntarālapradeśaṃ prāptā/ athavā kiñcidantaramiti samāsaḥ/ svalpāntarālaṃ yathā tathā/ prasṛteti kriyāviśeṣaṇam/ atra saṅkaro'laṅkāraḥ/
iyamityādi/ avayavaiḥ aṅgaiḥ śākhābhiśca/ alaṅkṛtamaṇḍanā alaṅkṛtāni bhūṣitāni bhūṣaṇāni yayā, teṣāṃ tadavayavasaṅgamena sātiśayaśobhotpatteḥ, ``ābharaṇasyābharaṇam'' ityuktavat/ alaṅkṛtamaṇḍanetyanena teṣāmanādaranyastatvaṃ tathāpi teṣāṃ smṛhaṇīyatvaṃ ca darśayan vicchittyākhyaṃ śārīraṃ bhāvamāha/ ``svalpo'pyanādaranyāso mālyādīnāṃ svamaṇḍane/
yaḥ parāṃ janayecchobhāṃ sā vicchittirudāhṛtā//'' iti vacanāt/ kalitakusumā sambaddhapuṣpā, bālā apariṇatā, antaḥ pariśoṣiṇī samayasekādyabhāvādabhyantarasaṃsaktaśoṣā/ smarajvarapāṇḍukṛśairaṅgairalaṅkṛtamaṇḍanā tadānīmantaḥpariśoṣiṇī/ ata eva pāṇḍukṣāmairviṭapaiḥ kalitakusumā bālā lateva vartamāneti śleṣānugṛhīto dṛṣṭānto'trālaṅkāraḥ/ antaḥpariśoṣiṇī bāleti ca dharmādhikyaṃ nāśaṅkanīyam, tathātvaviśiṣṭāyā eva latāyā aupamyopapatteḥ/ [varārohā]``varārohā mattakāśinyuttamā varavarṇinī/'' ityamaraḥ/ ramyāṃ darśanīyām/ [vivāhamahotsavaśriyaṃ]``vaivāhiko vidhiḥ strīṇāmaupanāyanikaḥ smṛtaḥ/'' iti manuvacanād dvijatvahetubhūtasaṃskārarūpeṇa pāṇigrahaṇākhyena mahatā kalyāṇena yā śrīḥ śobhā tām/ udayinīmiti tācchīliko ṇiniḥ/ svayameva bhaviṣyatsamṛddhisūcakatvenāvirbhavantīmityarthaḥ/ manorujaṃ manaso rogam/ uttarārdhe samuccayo'laṅkāraḥ, vahativyanaktyoḥ kriyayoyaggapadyena pratipādanāt/ atra pūrvaṃ kalahaṃsoktau ``paṇḍaraparikkhāma'' ityuktasyaivārthasya punarmakarandena ``pāṇḍukṣāmaiḥ'' ityādibhiḥ pratipādanāt punaruktirnāśaṅkyā, ubhābhyāmapi nāyakāśvāsanāya ekasyaivārthasya sthirīkaraṇāt/ pratyuta guṇa eveti grāhyam//6//
niṣāditā avarohaṇārthamupaveśitā/ kathamiti svabhāgadheyasya phalonmukhatvaṃ nirūpya vismayaḥ prakāśyate/
avatīrya gajavadhvāḥ avaruhya/
saharṣamiti svaprayatnaphalasiddherāsattimanusandhāya sānandamityarthaḥ/ apavārya svagatam/
samuciteṣṭadevatāsaṅkīrtanenābhimatamāśāste - vidhātā bhadraṃ na ityādi/ vidhātā sakalajagatsraṣṭā bhagavān prajāpatiḥ, bhadramavighnamaṅgalam, naḥ asmākam, vitaratu dadātu/
``viśrāṇanaṃ vitaraṇaṃ sparśanaṃ pratipādanam/'' ityamaraḥ/ vidhātṛgrahaṇaṃ mahānubhāvānāṃ dārasaṅgrahaṇasya guṇavatsantānalābhaprayojanatvāt sṛṣṭikarturīśvarasya tatsādhanaucityaṃ dyotayati/
``athābhyarcya vidhātāraṃ prayatau putrakāṅkṣayā/'' iti raghuvaṃśoktavat, ``prajāyai gṛhamedhināṃ'' ``dārānapatyāya'' ityādiprayogācca/ manojñāya vidhaye śobhanāya karmaṇe, tulyaśīlavayorūpayostulyābhijanalakṣaṇayośca suhṛtputryāḥ praśastasambandhārthamityarthaḥ/ vidheyāsuḥ kriyāsuḥ, devāḥ hariharādayaḥ, paramaramaṇīyāmatyantaspṛhaṇīyām, pariṇatiṃ phalaniṣpattiṃ, uparitanīṃ dhanādisampadam/ kṛtārthā niṣpāditaprayojanā, priyasuhṛdi iṣṭamitre bhūrivasau devarāte ca viṣaye, yatnaiḥ pravṛttibhiḥ, abhimatairabhīṣṭaviṣayagāmitvādabhīṣṭaiḥ/ kṛtsnaḥ avalokitābuddharakṣitādiprayuktaśca, ayaṃ prastutaḥ [prayatnaḥ], phalatu idānīmavighnaṃ siddhyatu/ śivatātiḥ upari ca śivaṅkaraḥ śubhānubandho bhavatvityarthaḥ/ ``śivaśamariṣṭebhyaḥ kare'' (4-4-143) iti tātipratyayaḥ/ ``śivatātiḥ śivaṅkaraḥ'' iti halāyudhaḥ/ atrāśiṣi liṅloṭau/ āśīrnāmālaṅkāraḥ/ ``vidhātā bhadraṃ na'' ityādi vicalanam, kāmandakyā svaprayatnasūcanāt//7//
atha nāyikāyā nāyakānurāgapratināyakavairāgyayordārḍhyamanusandhatte - keṇeti/ kena punarupāyena maraṇanirvāṇaṃ sāmpratamanubhaviṣyāmi/ maraṇanirvāṇasya antaraṃ sambhāvayiṣyāmīti vā pāṭhaḥ/ [maraṇanirvāṇaṃ] maraṇarūpaṃ sukhaṃ, anubhūyamānasya duḥkhasya tadānīmucchedāt/
``yadviviktatayā sthānaṃ kleśairnaṣṭaiḥ śarīriṇaḥ/
vyavasāyasya buddheśca dīpanī sā tu nirvṛtiḥ//'' iti lakṣitatvāt/ tasya antaramavakāśam/ sambhāvayiṣyāmi prāpayiṣyāmīti yāvat/ maraṇamapi mama mandabhāgyāyāḥ abhimatamiti durlabhaṃ bhavati/ maraṇamapīti jīvanāt prāṇatyāgasya sarvairadhyavasāyamātreṇa sādhyatvaṃ dhvanyate/ mandabhāgyāyā alpapuṇyāyāḥ, abhimatamiṣṭaṃ, iti anena hetunā, durlabhaṃ labdhumaśakyaṃ bhavati/ atrāmaṅgalabhūtasya maraṇasya vacanaṃ svābhilaṣitanairāśyanirviṇṇāyā uktitvānna doṣaḥ/ mandabhāgyāyā iti ātmanindā ca dhvanyate/ ``kenopāyene''tyādirudvegaḥ/
pitrādivairāgyād iṅgitākārābhyāṃ tadabhiprāyaṃ viditvāha - atiklāmitā khalu priyasakhī etenānukūlavipralambhena/ atyarthaṃ kheditaiva etena vartamānena anukūlavipralambhena anukūlena svābhimatānuguṇena tathā vipralambhena vañcanena, paramārthaṃ pracchādyānyathā kathanāt/ athavānukūlānāmevāsmākaṃ pratāraṇena/
paṭalakahastā ābharaṇapeṭakaṃ haste yasyāḥ/
``paṭalaṃ dṛgrukcchadiṣoḥ klī na nā piṭake gaṇe/'' iti vaijayantī/ pratīhārī dauvārikī/
bhagavati amātyo bhaṇati - ``etena narendrānupreṣitena vivāhanaipathyena devatāpurataḥ saviśeṣamalaṅkartavyā mālatī''ti/ narendrānupreṣitena padmāvatīśvaraprahiteneti tasya svayaṃ dattavato mālatīviṣaye prasādātiśayaṃ sūcayati/ devatāpurataḥ nagaradevatāsannidhāviti māṅgalikatvaṃ vadan garbhagṛha evānyairaparijñātamiti vyañjayati/ saviśeṣaṃ pūrvasmādadhikaṃ, rājaśāsanasyādaraṇīyatvāditi vācyo'rthaḥ la viśeṣo vyatirekaḥ, puṃsaḥ strītvācchādanāditi vyaṅgyaḥ/ alaṅkartavyā bhūṣayitavyā la alaṃ paryāptiḥ, nissaṃśayamityarthaḥ, kartavyā sraṣṭavyeti vyaṅgyaḥ/
tadudghaṭitajñāha - yuktamupapannaṃ āha kathayati, amātya iti prakaraṇāt/ māṅgalikaṃ maṅgalaprayojanam, hi prasiddhau, etat sthānaṃ devatāyatanarūpaṃ sthalam, aśaṅkāspadatvāditi bhāvaḥ/ ita ityabhinayenāsmatpurata ityarthaḥ/
vivāhanaipathyaṃ vibhajya darśayati - etat tāvat paṭṭāṃśukayugalam/ ime sarvāṅgīṇābharaṇasaṃyogāḥ/ ime mauktikā hārāḥ/ etaccandanam/ ayaṃ ca sitakusumāpīḍa iti/ vastramukhyatvādalaṅkārasya pūrvaṃ taduktiḥ - paṭṭāṃśukayugalaṃ kṣaumavastradvayaṃ, antarīyottarīyarūpamityarthaḥ/ paṭṭāṃśukagrahaṇaṃ maṅgalyatvāt/
``kṣaumaṃ kenacidindupāṇḍu taruṇā maṅgalyamāviṣkṛtam/'' iti śākuntalokteḥ/ [sarvāṅgīṇābharaṇasaṃyogāḥ] sarvāṅgīṇānāṃ sarvāṅgavyāpināṃ, pādāṅgulīyādicūḍāmaṇiparyantānāmityarthaḥ, ābharaṇānāṃ saṃyogāḥ samūhāḥ/ ``tatsarvādeḥ pathyaṅgakarmapatrapātraṃ vyāpnoti'' (5-2-7) iti khaḥ/ mauktikahārāṇāṃ śobhātiśayajanakatvānmaṅgalyatvānmahārghatvācca prādhānyena pṛthaguktiḥ/ āpīḍaḥ śekharaḥ/ sitakusumagrahaṇaṃ praśastatvāt, ``yatkiñcit pāṇḍuraṃ puṣpaṃ yatkiñcidanulepanam/'' iti vacanāt/
amātyena svayaṃ ca saṅketitamarthaṃ svagatena bhaṅgyā prakāśayati - ramaṇīyaṃ hīti, etaiḥ prasādhitatvāt/ vatsamiti tasya saukumāryasaundaryādibhirmālatīvyapadeśayogyatāmāha/ jana iti yathādṛṣṭagrāhitvamitarajanasyāha/ evamiti itthaṃ kriyate'smābhirityarthaḥ/
taha/ tathā/
vaidagdhyādabhyantaravartinā nāyakena saha svairasallāpādikaṃ pravartayituṃ sakhīsametāmeva nāyikāmantaḥ praveśayati - abhyantaraṃ devatāgarbhagṛham/
jñātatatvāpi sakhī tacchaṅkāparihārāya pṛcchati - kathaṃ bhagavatī ṛ katham, kariṣyatīti śeṣaḥ/
upapannamapadeśamāha - vivikte vijane, manasa eaikāgryāya, śāstrataḥ ratnaśāstrāt, ``varṇavayo'vasthādyānuguṇyena nirdoṣāṇāṃ guṇināṃ vajrādiratnānāṃ dhāraṇe samṛddhiranyathā vyasanam'' iti buddhabhaṭādibhiḥ pratipāditatvāttacchāstrata eva guṇadoṣanirṇayādityarthaḥ, parīkṣiṣye nirṇeṣya iti/
kāmandakīvaidagdhyaprayogasya phalaṃ darśayati - diṣṭyā lavaṅgikāmātraparijanāsmi saṃvṛttā/ svābhimatāvakāśalābhaharṣāddiṣṭyetyuktiḥ/ [lavaṅgikāmātraparijanā] lavaṅgikaiva parijanaḥ parivāro yasyā iti tṛtīyavirahaḥ/
idaṃ devatāmandiradvāram/ praviśatu priyasakhī iti guptadeśābhinayaḥ/
stambhāpavāritau stambhena chāditau/
sakhi! eṣo'ṅgarāgaḥ/ imāḥ kusumamālāḥ/ aṅgarāga ālepanam/
tataḥ kimiti tairvastubhiḥ kiṃ kartavyamityasūyoktiḥ/
sakhi! asmin pāṇigrahaṇamaṅgalārambhe kalyāṇasampattinimittaṃ devatāḥ pūjayeti ambayānupreṣitāsi/ vivāharūpaśobhanakarmopakrame samṛddhisampādanahetorityarthaḥ/ devatā iti bahuvacanena pūjyadevatābāhulyamabhilaṣitavaśāt sūcayati/ anupreṣitāsi prasthāpitāsi/ tat kiṃ vismṛtamiti bhāvaḥ/
sāvegamāha - kasmādidānīṃ dāruṇasamārambhadaivadurvilasitapariṇāmaduḥkhanirbharaniṣṭhāpitamānasā punaḥ punarmarmacchedadussahaṃ mandabhāgyā paritāpye/ krūropakramasyātyantaṃ prātikalyāddaivasya durvilāso duśceṣṭitaṃ, tasya pariṇāmena paripākena, itaḥ paraṃ tasya kartavyābhāvāt, duḥkhanirbharaṃ santāpapūrṇaṃ, niṣṭhāpitaṃ nāśitaṃ, śūnyīkṛtamiti yāvat, mānasaṃ yasyāḥ/ punaḥ punariti tātena kadācidambayā kadācit sakhyā kadāciditi tatkṛtāparādhasmaraṇam/ [marmacchedadussahaṃ] marmāṇi prāṇavāyusannidhānasthānāni, tacchedena dussaham/ kasmātparitāpye evaṃ paritāpaparamparākaraṇe kiṃ phalaṃ yuṣmākamityasūyā vyajyate, āvegaśca/
tadākūtavedinī vidagdhasakhī mādhavasamakṣaṃ tadupanyāsasyāvataraṇikāṃ karoti - ayi kimapi vaktukāmā ṛ ayi sānunaye praśne/ kimapi [vaktukāmā] vivakṣurivālakṣyase/ tat tava vivakṣitaṃ viśeṣato niraśaṅkaṃ brūhītyarthaḥ/
labdhāvakāśā viśeṣābhidhitsayā vivakṣitamākṣipati - kimidānīṃ durlabhābhiniveśimanorathavisaṃvadadbhāgadheyo jano mantrayate/ idānīmiti atikrāntakālatvaṃ sūcayati/ durlabhe vastuni abhiniveśino nirbandhino manorathasya manobhilāṣasya visaṃvadad virudhyamānaṃ bhāgyaṃ yasya, anyatrābhilāṣo'nyatra daivakalpanetyarthaḥ/ kiṃ mantrayate vaktumavakāśa eva nāstītyarthaḥ/ kimidānīmityādi kramaḥ, sañcintyamānamālatībhāvāptikathanāt/
sakhā tamāhlādayati - śrutamiti/
tāvatā tadbhāvasyāspaṣṭatvādasantuṣṭa āha - śrutaṃ niśamitameva, idaṃ vaca iti śeṣaḥ/ turvyāvṛttau/ hṛdayasya tu asantoṣaḥ, alambhāvo na bhavatītyarthaḥ/ ``śrutam/ asantoṣastu hṛdayasye''ti svābhimatakāryasaṃgrahaṇādādānam/
pariṣvajyeti - svābhimatānukūlyārthamupasāntvanaprakāraḥ/ tatparamārthabhagini! priyasakhi lavaṅgike! eṣedānīṃ te priyasakhī anāthā maraṇe vartamānā āgarbhanirgamanirantaraprarūḍhavisrambhasadṛśaṃ pariṣvajyābhyarthayate/ taditi yata evamatikrāntavāgavasarā tasmāt, tvadanyeṣvabhyarthanā na phalāyetyarthaḥ/ paramārthabhagini! anupacaritasvasaḥ ṅa, tvanmātrā eva mamāpi poṣitatvāt/ priyasakhīti prāṇebhyo'pi snehabhūmiḥ tvaṃ mametyarthaḥ/ eṣeti dṛṣṭe'pi madavasthā jñāyata iti bhāvaḥ/ idānīṃ paścime kāla ityarthaḥ/ priyasakhīti na kevalaṃ tvaṃ mama, tavāpyahaṃ priyasakhī eveti parasparapremabandhamāha/ anāthā nāthaiḥ pitrādibhirupekṣitatvād, [maraṇe vartamānā] gatyantarābhāvāt maraṇameva śaraṇamavalambamānā/ [āgarbhataḥ] garbhato māturudarato nirgamo garbhanirgamaḥ, tata ārabhya, abhividhāvāṅ/ nirantaraprarūḍho nirvighnagāḍho yo visrambhastasya sadṛśaṃ yathā tathā/ abhyarthayate yācate, na punarabhyarthaye ityuktiḥ yā tathāvidhā sā tvāmabhyarthayata ityabhyarthanābhaṅgasya svapne'pyakaraṇīyatvaṃ dyotayati/ haṭhāt tāṃ saṃvādayantī abhyarthanāviṣayaṃ prakāśayati - yadi te ahamanuvartanīyā tato māṃ hṛdayena dhārayantī samagrasaubhāgyalakṣmīparigrahaikamaṅgalaṃ mādhavaśrīmukhāravindamānandamasṛṇaṃ pralokaya/ anuvartanīyā ānukūlyena santoṣaṇīyā/ te iti kṛtyapratyayayoge kartari ṣaṣṭhī/ tvadanuvṛttirapekṣitaiva, tathāpi tvadvirahakātaryaṃ māṃ nānukūlayatītyāha - māṃ hṛdayena dhārayantīti, hṛdayasannihitatve kā virahaśaṅketyarthaḥ/ samagrāyāḥ sampūrṇāyāḥ saubhāgyalakṣmyāḥ sarvajanaprārthanīyatvaśriyaḥ parigrahārthamekamadvitīyaṃ [maṅgalaṃ] kalyāṇaṃ, mādhavaśrīmukhāravindaṃ mādhavasya śrīmukharūpamambujam/ śrīśabda upacāravācakaḥ/ ānandamasṛṇaṃ sukhānubhavena mandaṃ yathā, madanusmāraṇāyetyarthaḥ/ roditīti tatsmaraṇena navīkṛtaśokatvāduktiḥ/
taduktivyakteḥ santuṣṭahṛdaya āha - mlānasyetyādi/ nairāśyadāvasaṃsparśāt klāntasya, jīvakusumasya ātmacaitanyātmanaḥ puṣpasya, vikāsanāni ullāsakārīṇi/ santarpaṇāni āpyāyanāni, kṛśasya śarīrasya jhaṭiti poṣakatvāt, kṛśaśarīrāpyāyakasyauṣadhasya santarpaṇasaṃjñayā vaidyake vyavahārāt/ sakalendriyamohanāni sarveṣāṃ śrotrādīnāṃ bāhyendriyāṇāṃ vivaśīkaraṇāni/ ānandanāni tādātvikaparamasukhajanakāni/ hṛdayaikarasāyanāni āyatyāmapi manasaḥ pradhānarasāyanāni/ jarāmaraṇādihara auṣadhaviśeṣo rasāyanam/ nikhilaśaṅkātaṅkasaṅkartanena hṛdayasthairyakāriṇītyarthaḥ/ mayāpīti nikhilāśāpāśavicchedaniścitanijajīvitāpāyena, ``tat paśyeyamanaṅgamaṅgalagṛhaṃ bhūyo'pi tasyā mukham'' ityetāvanmātramāśaṃsamānena mayāpītyarthaḥ/ adhigatāni prāptāni na tu śrutānīti nidhivat saṃgṛhītatvaṃ sūcayati/ vacomṛtāni vacanarūpāṇyamṛtāni/ tadvacasāmeva mādhuryānmṛtasañjīvanatvaṃ, svānukūlyadyotakatvena kiṃ punaḥ kathyatāmityamṛtatvāropaḥ/ atra harṣākhyo bhāvaḥ prakāśyate/ niravayavamālārūpakamalaṅkāraḥ//8//
yathā tasya jīvitapradāyino'vasīdantīṃ māṃ śrutvā santapyamānasya tathāvidhaṃ śarīraratnaṃ na parihīyate, lokāntaragatāmapi māmuddiśya sa janaḥ saṃsmaraṇasaṅkathāmātraparigraheṇāpi kālāntareṇa na lokayātrāṃ śithilayati tathā kuru/ jīvitapradāyina iti vyasanasamāgamasya kāmasūtroktasya prayogasāphalyamāha/ kāpālikakabalitaprāṇapratyāharaṇaparamopakāriṇa iti kṛtajñatayāpyanurāgadārḍhyaṃ prakāśayati/ avasīdantīmidānīṃ maraṇasyāvakāśalābhāt kālena vinaśyantīmityarthaḥ/ tathāvidhaṃ tādṛśī vidhā prakāro yasyetyanubhavaparāmarśaḥ/ śarīraratnaṃ svayaṃ santāpakārśye'pi navanavalāvaṇyavatvaṃ dyotayati/ na parihīyate kṣīṇaṃ na bhavati, tathā kurvityanvayaḥ, samāśvāsanenetyarthaḥ/ lokāntaragatāmapīita/ adyaiva bhāgyavaśādavakāśaṃ labdhvā tyaktajīvitā paralokaṃ yadyahaṃ gatā tathāpi māmityarthaḥ/ apiśabdo yathāśabdānukarṣaṇārthaḥ/ uddiśya lakṣīkṛtya/ sa janaḥ priyatamaḥ/ saṃsmaraṇasaṅkathāmātraparigraheṇa saṃsmaraṇapravṛttasya saṅkathāmātrasya tayaivaṃ kṛtaṃ tayaivaṃ hasitaṃ nirīkṣitaṃ kathitamityādisallāpasyaiva parigraheṇāṅgīkāreṇa/ apīti taditarasambandhasya daivena vighaṭitatvaṃ vyajyate/ kālāntareṇa kālaviśleṣeṇeti ``snehaḥ pravāsāśrayād'' ityuktanyāyāt kālavicchedena snehavicchedasya saṃbhāvyatvamiti bhāvaḥ/ lokayātrāṃ laukikīṃ sthitim, ``parasparānurāgiṇordvayoranyatarāpāye'nyataraḥ smarati'' iti nyāyamityarthaḥ/ na śithilayati na mandīkaroti/ tathā kuru tatpārśve pratikṣaṇaṃ gatvā madanusmāraṇenetyarthaḥ/ evameva te priyasakhī sanāthā mālatī sakāmā kṛtā bhavati/ evamuktaprakāreṇa kṛte/ eveti asya visaṃvāde śatrutvācaraṇaṃ vyajyate/ priyasakhīti tvatpremabhūmitvamanenaiva spaṣṭībhaviṣyatīti dyotyate/ sanāthetyanāthātvaṃ mama nirākṛtaṃ bhavati, tvayā sanāthatvāt/ sakāmā kṛtā bhavati tvayi prārthanasya matkṛtasya sāphalyamapi tvayā kṛtaṃ bhavatīti ``aṇāhā'', ``abbhatthedi'' ityuktaṃ dvayamapi parihṛtaṃ bhaviṣyatītyuktaṃ veditavyam/
hanteti viṣāde, atikaruṇamatyantaśokāvahaṃ, prastutaṃ prakrāntaṃ, anayeti śeṣaḥ/
atha tadapāyaśaṅkayā tadanurāgavacanaśravaṇena ca viṣādapramodamadhyavartyāhanairāśyetyādi/ nairāśyakātaradhiyaḥ matsamāgamanirāśatayā bhīruhṛdayāyāḥ, [hariṇekṣaṇāyāḥ] nikāmakaruṇa[ṇaṃ] jīvitatyāgodyogāt, manoharaṃ dṛḍhānurāgasūcakatvād, vātsalyamohaparidevitaṃ vātsalyaṃ lakṣaṇayā snehastatkṛto mohaḥ kartavyāparijñānaṃ tena janitaṃ paridevitaṃ vilāpam, śrutvā, cintāviṣādavipadaṃ ca kiṃ bhaviṣyatīti cintayā yo viṣādaḥ manaso duḥkhaparavaśatvaṃ tena janitāṃ vipadam, śarīrasādādikāmāpadam, mahotsavaṃ ca aho dhanyo'smi matprāṇasamāyā api mayyevamanurāgāditi paramamutsavaṃ, lakṣaṇayā tatkāryaṃ sukham/ atra viṣādahaṣag bhāvau spardhībhāvena vyajyete/ bhāvasandhiralaṅkāraḥ//9//
athāmaṅgalāśāṅkinī sakhī vakti - sakhi! pratihatamidānīṃ te amaṅgalaṃ maraṇavacanam/ pratihatamīśvarasmaraṇādibhirnirastam, bhavatviti śeṣaḥ, ``śāntaṃ pāpam'', ``pratihatamamaṅgalam'' ityādiprayogāt/ nāto'paraṃ te vacanaṃ śroṣyāmi/ sāsūyamāha - ataḥ uktādaparaṃ duḥśravatvāt nākarṇayiṣyāmītyarthaḥ/
tadvacanasyāsnehapūrvatvādupacāraśabdatvamāropya saroṣamāha - sakhi! priyaṃ khalu yuṣmākaṃ mālatījīvitam, na punarmālatī/ khalurjijñāsāyām/
``niṣedhavākyālaṅkārajijñāsānunaye khalu/'' ityamaraḥ/ yuṣmākamiti bahuvacanena tātādisaṅgrahaḥ/ yuṣmākaṃ mālatījīvitaṃ priyam, na punarmālatī priyeti vacanenaitadvivakṣitvāha - yena kenāpyupāyena śvāsamātraśeṣā śalyaprotaśakuntikeva duḥkhasantaptā jīvanmaraṇamanubhavatviyamiti mālatījīvitaṃ priyamityasyārthaḥ/ na punarmālatītyarthāntarasaṅkramitavācyena sukhasaṃvardhitatvamaduḥkhārhatvamupalālanīyatvamanuvartanīyatvamityādiviśiṣṭatayā mālatī na gaṇyata iti/
tadvivakṣitamajānatī kila pṛcchati - kimiti bhaṇitaṃ bhavatīti/
svavivakṣitaṃ vivṛṇoti - yena pratyāśānibandhanairvacanasaṃvidhānairjīvayitvā imaṃ mahābībhatsamārambhamanubhāvitāsmīti/ pratyāśānibandhanaiḥ tātamevaṃ vaśīkariṣyāmaḥ, ambāṃ [prati] evamupāyāntaraṃ vā kariṣyāmaḥ, adyaivaṃ kriyate, śva evaṃ, paraśva evamityāśāpāśahetubhirityarthaḥ/ vacanasaṃvidhānaiḥ vāṅmātrarūpairna punaḥ kriyayānuṣṭhīyamānairupāyaprayogairiti bhāvaḥ/ jīvayitveti anyathā pratyāśāvicchedena prāgeva prāṇaparityāgo'kariṣyata cedayamartho nāpatiṣyadityarthaḥ/ imamidānīṃ vartamānaṃ, mahābībhatsaṃ kamapi guṇamanapekṣya kāryaparatayaiva pravartitatvāt sarvajanajugupsāspadam, ārambhaṃ kāryamayogyapratipādanarūpam, anubhāvitā prāpitāsmīti ṇicā balātkāraṃ dyotayati/ yeneti yacchabdaparyāyo vibhaktipratirūpakamavyayam/ yata evamanubhāvitāsmyato mālatījīvitaṃ priyaṃ, na punarmālatītyuktamiti sambandhaḥ/ evaṃ daivopanipātite'narthe kiṃ kriyatāmidānīṃ tūṣṇīmeva sahyatāmityāśaṅkyāha - sāmprataṃ punarmanoratha etāvāneva yattasya jīvitapradāyinaḥ parakīyatvenāparāddhamātmānaṃ parityajya nirvṛtā bhaviṣyāmīti/ punaḥśabdo vyāvṛttau, sarvathā yuṣmadabhisandhistu nānuvartata ityarthaḥ/ manorathaḥ saṅkalpaḥ, etāvān etatparimāṇaḥ/ eveti ``ka īpsitārthasthiraniścayaṃ manaḥṣṭapayaśca nimnābhimukhaṃ pratīpayet/'' iti nyāyena brahmaṇāpyanivāryatvaṃ vyañjayati/ jīvitapradāyina iti upakārasmaraṇadārḍhyaṃ prakāśayantī, taddattajīvitaṃ tadarthameva tyajyata iti ko'trāsmākaṃ prayāsa iti sūcayati/ parakīyatvena - ``pitā rakṣati kaumāre bhartā rakṣati yauvane/
putrastu sthavirībhāve na strī svātantryamarhati//'' iti smaraṇāt pitrāyattatayā/ aparāddhaṃ parahastasparśarūpaṃ paramāniṣṭakāriṇam/
anaparāddhamiti vā pāṭhaḥ/ aparādhasyābuddhipūrvatvāt paśuvadasvatantratayā baddhā nīyamānasyānutapyamānasya nāparādhaḥ kaścit/ buddhipūrvatve hi brahmahatyādīnāmapi prāyaścittābhāvaḥ, anutaptasya prāyaścittavidhānāt, ``akāmataḥ kṛte pāpe prāyaścittaṃ vidurbudhāḥ/'' iti manuvacanāt, ``prāyaścittamakurvāṇāḥ pāpeṣu niratā narāḥ/
apaścāttāpinaḥ kaṣṭānnarakān yānti dāruṇān//'' iti yājñavalkyavacanāccetyarthaḥ/ ātmānaṃ deham/
``ātmā dehe dhṛtau jīve svabhāve paramātmani/'' iti vaijayantī/ ātmānaṃ parityajyeti ``deśaṃ kālaṃ vayaḥ śaktiṃ pāpaṃ cāvekṣya yatnataḥ/
prāyaścittaṃ prakalpyaṃ syādyatra coktā na niṣkṛtiḥ//'' iti yājñavalkyasmaraṇāt svayamālocya pāpānuguṇaṃ prāyaścittaṃ kalpayati/ bhartṛtvena svayaṃ saṅkalpite vaṃśādibhiranurūpe praṇayaśālini prāṇadāyini ca pāratantryaprayuktasyāparādhapātakasya prāṇaparityāgamantareṇa prāyaścittāntarasyāśakyatvamaparyāptatvaṃ cetyarthaḥ/ nirvṛtā nirayabhayanivāraṇāt sukhitā/
``pāpakṛnnarakaṃ yāti prāyaścittaparāṅmukhaḥ/'' iti smaraṇāt prāyaścittasya cānuṣṭhitatvāditi bhāvaḥ/ bhaviṣyāmīti aya[yaṃ]lokastāvannirarthako bhavatu nāma, asau tu loko maivaṃ bhūditi bhāvaḥ/ iti yadvastu etāvāneva manoratha ityanvayaḥ/ anayā coktyā ``na tvevāyaṃ jano na ca jīvitam'' ityuktasya sthairyamanusaṃhitaṃ veditavyam/ etasmin pāralaukikatvena sūcite, prayojane paramasukharūpe phale viṣaye, priyasakhī me iti adya yāvat matpriyahitānveṣiṇyāstavedānīṃ prātikūlyamanucitameveti dyotayati, paripanthinī viruddhā na bhavatītyaparipanthinī, bhavatviti prārthane loṭ/
pādayoḥ patatīti svāminyāḥ pratyuta ceṭīkarmācaraṇenānatilaṅghyatvaṃ tadabhyarthanasya, nirbandhagocaratvāditi vyañjayati/
tacceṣṭitaṃ camatkaroti - saiṣeti pāṭhaḥ/ ``sīmasīme striyāmubhe'' ityamaraḥ/ sā yā lokaprasiddhā, eṣā idānīmanubhūyamānā ceṭīviṣaye svāminyāḥ pādapatanarūpā, sīmā paramāvadhiḥ/ sa eṣa iti pāṭhe vidhirityadhyāhartavyaṃ syāt/ snehasya tvadviṣayasyānurāgasya/
avasarajñasakhīmukhena nāyakasamāgamaṃ saṃvidhatte kaviḥ - hastasaṃjñayeti nāyikāyā aparijñānārthamāhvānaṃ saṅketarūpeṇa hastābhinayena, āhvayati āgatyātra sthāne sthīyatāmityabhiprāyeṇākārayatītyarthaḥ/ mādhavaṃ hastasaṃjñayā āhvayatītyadhibalam, mālatyā atisandhānāt/
tadiṅgitaṃ vivṛṇoti - upasṛtya samīpaṃ gatvā, lavaṅgikāsthāne yatra pūrvaṃ lavaṅgikā sthitā tatra sthale, tiṣṭha/
harṣotkampamabhinayannāha - paravān paratantraḥ asvavaśaśarīra ityarthaḥ/ sādhvasena hṛdayotkampena/
tathātvamevopapādayati - iyameva vartamānasādhvasaviśiṣṭatvādirūpā, nedīyasāṃ antikatamānām/ dūrasthatve punarautsukyena kadā bhaviṣyatīti prārthyate, hastagatatve punaracintitānāmabhilaṣitānāṃ harṣaparavaśatayā manasaḥ stambhakampādisambhāra itīyameva, prakṛtiḥ svabhāvaḥ, agnerivauṣṇyam, ato na vitarkagocara ityarthaḥ, abhyudayānāṃ samṛddhīnām/
svairaṃ śanaiḥ, padaśabdāśravaṇāya/
pādapatitaivāha - sakhi anukūlatayā prasādaṃ kuru/ anukūlatayā madabhiprāyānuvartanena/ prasādamanugraham/
atha lavaṅgikāsthāne sthito vaidagdhyāttadbhāṣāmanukurvāṇa āha tacchaṅkāpanodanārthaṃ - sarale ityādi/ sarale akuṭile iti saṃbuddhiḥ, ``bāle lajjā nirastā nahi nahi sarale! colakaḥ kiṃ trapākṛt/'' itivat/ anena aho taveyamṛjutā, yā pitrādīṃstṛṇāya matvā svābhilaṣitaṃ na sādhayatīti vyajyate/ athavā agrāmye iti/
``agrāmyasaralodāravidagdhacchekadakṣiṇāḥ/'' iti vaijayantī/ sāhasarāgaṃ ātmatyāgarūpe'vicāritakāritve saktim, ātmaghātasyāpi mahāpātakamadhye gaṇanāt/
``surāpyaścātmaghātinyo nāśaucodakabhājanāḥ/'' iti yājñavalkyasmaraṇāt, ``mahāpātakināṃ caiva tathā caivātmaghātinām/
udakaṃ piṇḍadānaṃ ca na kuryāddharmameva ca//'' iti saṃvartanasmṛteśca/ parihara tyaja/ [rambhoru] rambhā kadalī, tatkāṇḍavṛttānupūrvamasṛṇaśītalagaurabhājāvūrū yasyāḥ/ sāhasaparihārahetumāha - muñca saṃrambhaṃ pitrādivairāgyajanitanirbandham/ ``āveśa eva viṣaye pratighātini roṣavān/
anubandhī ca bhūyo'pi saṃrambhatvaṃ prapadyate//'' iti divākaraḥ/ virasaṃ vigatasukham/ tava virahāyāsaṃ tvadviśleṣaduḥkham/ cittaṃ me soḍhumasahaṃ aśaktam/ ``śakadhṛṣajñāglāghaṭarabhalabhakramasahārhāstyartheṣu tumun'' (3-4-65)/ anayoktyā tvannidhane mayāpi na jīvyate/ ata ubhayostrāṇāya sāhasarāgaṃ mā kārṣīriti dyotayati/ atra matirāvegaśca bhāvau vyajyete/ bhāṣāśleṣo'laṅkāraḥ, madhyamapātrabhūmikāsthottamapātraprayojyasaṃskṛtaprākṛtasādhāraṇajātitvāt/
``tadbhavaṃ tatsamaṃ deśītyanekaḥ prākṛtakramaḥ/'' iti daṇḍyādibhirlakṣitaṃ tatsamam idam//10//
lavaṅgikāyā ananumatiṃ vijñāya punarvicchityā tāṃ prārthayate - sakhi lavaṅgike! alaṅghanīyaste mālatīpraṇāmaḥ/ sakhi lavaṅgike iti tvāmahamarthaye iti bhedaprayogaḥ/ alaṅghanīyaḥ pratīpāccaraṇenānādartuṃ na yogyaḥ/ mālatīti sahajasauhārdadravārdratvāditi dyotayati/ praṇāma iti nīcakarmatvam/ te iti kartari ṣaṣṭhī/
tadanumativyājena svābhimataṃ vyanakti - kiṃ vā bhaṇāmītyādi/ evaṃvādinyāṃ tvayi mayā kiṃ vaktavyamanumatimantareṇetyarthaḥ/ vicchedadāruṇāyāsakāriṇīti etāvat punarbhaṇyate - vicchede virahe dāruṇaṃ dussahaṃ āyāsaṃ duḥkhaṃ kartuṃ śīlaṃ yasyāḥ, sā tvamiti bandhujanopatāpamagaṇayantī svasukhaṃ cikīrṣasītyaho te nirghṛṇatvamiti bhāvaḥ/ kāmaṃ kuru svābhimataṃ kuru/ parirambhaṇaṃ āśleṣaṃ tāvat me dehi/ etāvatāpi māṃ sukhayeti sakhīvacanatvena vācyaḥ, nāyakavacanatvena tu vyaṅgyaḥ/ tvadvirahavedanā kathaṃ mayā varṇyate/ ato mamābhilaṣitaṃ kuru/ tat kimiti cet parirambhaṇaṃ dehi/ tāvataiva caritārthatvamiti bhāvaḥ/ atrautsukyaṃ vyajyate/ bhāṣāśleṣa evālaṅkāraḥ//11//
tadanumatiṃ parikalpyāha - saharṣaṃ svābhimatasaukaryāt/ kathamanumatāsmi/ maraṇaṃ pratītyarthāt/ iyaṃ ahaṃ āliṅgāmi tvatpriyaṃ karomītyarthaḥ/ sakhījanasannidhau priyatamāliṅganadoṣaṃ mugdhāyā adarśanakṛtamiti bhaṅgyā pariharati kaviḥ - darśanaṃ punarbāṣpotpīḍena priyasakhyā apaścimaṃ na labhyate/ bāṣpotpīḍena aśrusamūhena, anumatiharṣajena vā strīsvābhāvyāt bandhujanānusmaraṇajanitena vā, apaścimaṃ yasmādantimaṃ nāsti, tasyaivāvasānasamayabhāvitayā antyatvādityarthaḥ, na labhyate na prāpyate, dṛṣṭiprasaranirodhādityarthaḥ/
adarśane'pi sparśāntarāt priyatamasparśanasya saviśeṣasukhapradatvaṃ svabhāvato'nusandhāyāha - yathā uttararāmacarite bhāgīrathīvarāntarhitāyāḥ sītādevyāḥ sparśe rāmaḥ ``iyamiyaṃ gṛhyase'' iti, raghuvaṃśe ca, ``vispaṣṭamasrāndhatayā na dṛṣṭauṣṭajñātau sutasparśasukhopalambhāt/'' iti/
sakhi! kaṭhorakamalagarbhapakṣmalo'nyādṛśa eva te'dya nirvāpayati māṃ śarīrasparśaḥ/ kaṭhorasya pūrvedyurvikasitatvena pariṇatasya kamalasya garbho'bhyantaramiva pakṣmalaḥ sāndraḥ/ sukumāraprakṛtitvāt puṃstvavyāyāmādibhiśca mṛdukaṭhinakāyatvāt kamalasya kaṭhorasyopamānatvam/ anyādṛśaḥ pūrvasmāt prakārāntaraviśiṣṭa eva/ eveti nātra kaścid bhrama iti yāvat/ adyeti antimadaśāprayuktatve kimīdṛśo bhavatīti maugdhyāt pratītirdyotyate/ nirvāpayati nirvṛtasukhitāṃ karoti/ sakhi! kiñca maulivinihitāñjalirmama vacanena vijñāpaya taṃ janam/ kiñca anyacca, mama vaktavyamiti śeṣaḥ/ ``taha karehi'' iti nāyakaṃ prati sandeśasya prastutasyānusaraṇena tatsamuccinoti, anyasya vākyajātasya prasaktānuprasaktikayā madhye prasaṅgāt/ [maulivinihitāñjaliḥ] śirasi nikṣipto yutahastadvayarūpo'ñjaliḥ yayā, tanmānanārtham/
``cūḍā kirīṭaṃ keśāśca saṃhatā maulayastrayaḥ/'' iti, ``tau yutāvañjaliḥ pumān'' iti cāmaraḥ/ yatheti yena prakāreṇa vijñāpyate tathā, kathyate iti sāmarthyādāyāti/ vijñāpanaprakāramāha - na mayā mandabhāgyayā vilasacchatapatralakṣmīvilāsahāriṇo mukhacandramaṇḍalasya svacchandadarśanena sambhāvitaściraṃ locanamahotsavaḥ/
