``sahasrapatraṃ kamalaṃ śatapatraṃ kuśeśayam/'' ityamaraḥ/ vilāso vistāraḥ/ mukhasya candratvāropāt padmaśrīharaṇaucityam/ svacchandadarśanena vātāyanāntaritatvamantareṇa svecchayā kṛtena darśanena/ sambhāvitaḥ satkṛtaḥ/ locanamahotsavaścakṣuṣorānandaḥ/ tarhi kathaṃ jīvitamiti cet tatrāha - mudhāmanorathairevaṃ virahavijṛmbhamāṇadurvārodvegavyatikarodvartamānabandhanaṃ dhāritaṃ hṛdayam/ mudhāmanorathairniṣphalatvānmithyābhūtaiḥ saṅkalpaiḥ/ udvartamānabandhanaṃ śithilībhavatsvasthānasthiti/ vāraṃ vāraṃ saviśeṣadussahāyāsasantāpitasakhījanā gamitāśca śarīrasantāpāḥ/ kathamapyativāhitā malayamārutacandrātapaprabhṛtayo'narthaparamparāḥ/ ativāhitāḥ gamitāḥ/ prabhṛtiśabdāt parabhṛtavirutabakulaparimalādayo gṛhyante/ anarthaparamparāḥ uparyupari avicchinnāgamā vipattayaḥ/ duḥkhāvahatvād vākyatraye'pi mudhāmanorathairiti sambadhyate/ sāmprataṃ punarnirāśāsmi saṃvṛtteti/ sāmpratamiti parasmai pradānodyamāt nirāśā tvatprāptyāśārahitetyato jīvitanirapekṣāsmītyarthaḥ/ itirvijñāpanaprakārasamāptau/
tava priyasakhi! sarvadā smartavyāsmi/ taveti kartari ṣaṣṭhī/ smartavyāsmītyanuvādaḥ parisaṅkhyayā prakāśyate, natu vidhiḥ, anaucityāt/ matto'nyattava smartavyaṃ na kadācidastītyarthaḥ/ nityamanukte'pi smaraṇīyaiva/ ato na viśeṣatastvamasminnarthe'bhyarthanīyeti bhāvaḥ/ ``ātmā vā are draṣṭavyaḥ'' ityatra draṣṭavya itivat la ``niyamaḥ parisaṅkhyā vā vidhyarthe'pi bhavedyataḥ/
anātmādarśanenaiva parātmānamupāsmahe//'' ityācāryavacanāt/ eṣā ca mādhavaśrīsvahastanirmāṇamanoharā vakulamālā mālatīnirviśeṣaṃ priyasakhyā draṣṭavyā/ sarvadā hṛdayena ca dhāraṇīyā/ draṣṭavyā dhāraṇīyeti ca vidhiḥ, pūrvasiddhatvabhāvāt la ``vidhiratyantamaprāpte niyamaḥ pākṣike sati/
tatra cānyatra ca prāpte parisaṅkhyeti kīrtyate//'' ityācāryokteḥ/ unmucya ūrdhvamutkṣipya, kaṇṭhe vinyasyantīti tadā sthānaniveśanāya sūkṣmekṣikāyā avaśyambhāvamāha/ sahasāpasṛtya śīghraṃ parato gatveti nāyako'yamiti jñātvā lajjayāpasṛtyetyarthaḥ/ sādhvasotkampaṃ manaḥkṣobhajanitaṃ śarīravepathum, āliṅgyeti prakṛtam/
acintitopanataṃ priyāpariṣvaṅgasukhamevānusandadhāna āha - ekīkṛta ityādi/ ekīkṛtaḥ sammiśritaḥ/ tvaci sparśanendriye, niṣiktaḥ abhivṛṣṭaḥ, ``sukhairniṣiñcantamivāmṛtaṃ tvaci'' itivat/ avapīḍya yantraniṣpīḍanena svarasaṃ saṃgṛhyetyarthaḥ, athavā gāḍāliṅganena vakṣaḥ sammṛdya/ nirbhugrapīnakucakuḍmalayā vakṣaḥpīḍanena vāmanīkṛte sthavīyasī navodbhinnatvāt kamalakośasadṛśatvādvāstanamukule yayā, ``gāḍhāliṅganavāmanīkṛtakucaprodbhinnaromodgamā'' ityuktavat/ nirupasṛṣṭād ``bhuja kauṭilye'' ityasmāt niṣṭhāyāṃ nirbhugna iti rūpam/ anayā purovartinyeti svabhāgadheyapariṇatirdyotyate/ hāraḥ muktāvalī/ ``tāmrasāraṃ tu candanam'', ``pītacandanamarkeṣṭaṃ gośīrṣaṃ haricandanam/'' iti vaijayantī/ candrakāntaniṣyanda iti candrakāntasya śilāviśeṣatvāt tasya candrasandarśanajanite jaladrava eva śaityānniṣyandagrahaṇam/ anyeṣāṃ tu svataḥ śaityāt tasyāparigrahaṇamiti jñātavyam/ ``śaivalo jalaśūkaḥ syād'' iti vaijayantī/ mṛṇālaṃ bisam/ himaṃ tuhinajalam/ ādiśabdaḥ prakāravacanaḥ, ityevaṃprakāraḥ vargaḥ samudāyaḥ/ ādiśabdācchaśikarakarakopalakadalīkisalayakamalakuvalayādigrahaṇam/ ``bahuṣvaniyamaḥ'' iti vacanād alpāctarābhyarhitatvānādareṇa pūrvanipātaḥ/ atrotprekṣātiśayoktiścālaṅkāraḥ//12//
vailakṣyādāha - aho lavaṅgikayā mālatīvipralambhaḥ prayuktaḥ/ aho iti tasya svapne'pyaśaṅkitatvaṃ dyotyate/
mālatyā vañcanaṃ svāvasthānivedanavyājena tadvailakṣyaṃ pariharati - svacittavedanāmātravedini! svahṛdayaduḥkhameva jñātuṃ śīlaṃ yasyāḥ/ paravyathānabhijñe! parasya pratiyogino, mametyarthāt, vyathāṃ santāpamanabhijānāne iti/ iyam īdṛśī tvaṃ upālabhyase sotprāśaṃ paruṣamucyase/ ``utprāśaḥ syādupālambhaḥ'' iti vaijayantī/ svasantāpamātravedane sati paravyathānabhijñatvoktireva prayuktopālambhaḥ/
tatra hetumāha - uddāmetyādi/ uddāmadehaparidāhāḥ viśṛṅkhalasarvaśarīradahanakriyāḥ mahājvarāḥ mahāntaḥ santāpā yeṣu/ saṅkalpasaṅgamaiścintāviracitaiḥ sambhogaiḥ [vinoditā] praśamitā vedanā duḥkhānubhavā yeṣu/ tvatsnehasaṃvidā tvaṃ mayi snigdheti parijñānena avalambitaṃ balānniruddhaṃ prayāṇonmukhaṃ jīvitaṃ yeṣu, ``akṛtārthe'pi manasije ratimubhayaprārthanā kurute/'' iti nyāyāt/ mayāpīti/ yathā tvayetyarthaḥ/ dināni kiṃ vā nātivāhitānīti praśnamukhenoktiḥ/ sarvalokavidito'yamarthaḥ, tvayāpi kāmandakyādimukhena śruta eva/ ataḥ svaduḥkhavedanādupālambhamarhasyevetyarthaḥ/ atra nāyikāṃ pratyasūyā vyajyate/ aprastutapraśaṃsālaṅkāraḥ, kāryamukhena kāraṇasya lokottarasya svānurāgasya prakāśanāt/ paryāyoktaṃ vā, paryāyeṇa gamyasyānurāgasyābhidhānāt//13//
tadvacanamupodbalayati - sakhi! upālambhanīyamupālabdhāsi/ upālambhanīyamadhikṣepayogyamartham, pratīti śeṣaḥ/
kalahaṃsamukhena saṃvidhānacāturīṃ sahṛdayān pratyanusmārayati kaviḥ - aho sarasaramaṇīyatā saṃvidhānasya/ sarasatayā pradīptaśṛṅgārarasatayā camatkārakāritvaṃ saṅghaṭanasya vidhikartṛkasya kavikartṛkasyeti sphurati/
atha nāyakoktamarthaṃ svasaṃvādena draḍhayaṃstadānukūlyaṃ prārthayate - mahābhāge! iti strīṣu tvameva bhāgyaśālinī, yasyāmasya puruṣaratnasyedṛśasneha iti dyotayati/
tvaṃ vatsaletyādi/ vatsalā svaviṣaye snigdhā/ iti anena hetunā/ anena ``tvatsnehasaṃvit'' ( la ṛ. 13) ityāderanuvādaḥ/ tatrāpi kathamapi atikṛcchreṇa, avalambitātmā dhāritadehaḥ/ ``ātmā jīve dhṛtau dehe'' iti vaijayantī/ ``kathamapī''tyādiḥ ``saṅkalpasaṅgama'' ( la ṛ. 13) ityāderanuvādaḥ/ satyamavyabhicaritamityasminnarthe tulāpratyayādikamapi mayā kartuṃ śakyamityarthaḥ/ ayaṃ jana iti hastasparśena kārśyavaivarṇyādikapradarśanam/ iyataḥ idaṃparimāṇāniti dairghyābhinayaḥ/ anaiṣīt nītavān iti/ na tu nayati neṣyati ceti tvamiva nairāśyādayamapyataḥ paraṃ na jīviṣyatīti dyotayan bhedaṃ prayuṅkte/ ata eva ābaddhakaṅkaṇakarapraṇayaprasādam, ``hastasūtre'pi kaṅkaṇam'' iti vaijayantī, ābaddhakaṅkaṇayoḥ karayorubhayoḥ sambandhinoḥ sauhṛdarūpaṃ paricayarūpaṃ vā prasādaṃ ca tvadanugrahaṃ āsādya/ ``karapraṇaye''tyanena samānasambandhatvāt sarvajanaślāghyatvaṃ dyotayati, ``pāṇigrahaṇasaṃskāraḥ savarṇāsūpadiśyate/'' iti smaraṇāt/ nandatu samṛdhnotu, so'yaṃ jana ityarthāt/ cirāya bahoḥ kālāt, phalantu, ``phalantu kalpataravaḥ'' itivat phalitā bhavantu, kāmāḥ kadā nu khalveṣa kṛtakṛtyo bhaviṣyatīti manorathāḥ/ aviśeṣanirdeśāt sarveṣāmasmākamiti siddhyati/ atra suhṛdviṣayo bhāvaḥ prakāśyate/ atiśayoktiralaṅkāraḥ/ ``tvaṃ vatsale''tyādi paryupāstiḥ, makarandamukhena nāyikānunayāt//14//
balādapi pāṇigrahaṇe kriyamāṇe na kaściddoṣaḥ/ ataḥ svayamevābhyupagamyatāmiti bhaṅgyā sakhī pratipādayati - mahābhāga! hṛdaye'pi apratihatasvayaṅgrāhasāhaso'yaṃ janaḥ/ kimidānīṃ kaṅkaṇābharaṇe kare vicāryate/ hṛdaye'pīti tasya āntaratvāt surakṣaṇīyatvācca virodhaḥ prakāśyate/ apratihataṃ aniṣiddhaṃ svayaṅgrāhasāhasaṃ etadananumatyāpi nāyakasya svecchayā grahaṇarūpaṃ sāhasaṃ yena/ ayaṃ jana iti mālatī/ kaṅkaṇābharaṇa iti ``ābaddhakaṅkaṇe''ti taduktyanuvādaḥ/ kara iti bāhyatvena svayaṅgrāhānumateḥ saukaryam/ kiṃ vicāryate kiṃśabdaḥ kṣepe, na khalu tatra saṃśayo'syā ityarthaḥ/
tadabhiprāyavedinī mālatyāha - svagatam/ hā dhik! hā dhik! kulastrīviruddhameṣā kimapyupanyasyati/ kimapītyanucitatvādacintyamityarthaḥ/
sandehanivāraṇena kāryasampādanārthamucite samaye kāmandakīṃ praveśayati - praviśyeti/ sādhvasāṃ pratipattimākārato lakṣayitvāha - putri! kātare! kimetat/ putrīti nanu tava pitari mātari ca mayi sannihitāyāṃ na sāhasametaditi pitrādyananumatiśaṅkāṃ nirasyati/ kātare iti iṣṭe'pi vastuni maugdhyāt strīsvabhāvācca bhīrutvaṃ bhavatyevetyarthaḥ/ tathāpi etāvat kātaryaṃ mā bhūdityāha - kimetat atiśayena dṛśyamānaṃ kātaryamityarthaḥ/
kampamānā sāhasabhayena sotkampā śiśuriva jananīṃ śaraṇabuddhyā āliṅgatītyarthaḥ/
cibukamadharasyādhaḥpradeśam/ unnamayya trapayā namitamukhatvāt/ anunayaprakāraścāyam/
parasparānurāgaprakāśanena virahaduḥkhānusmāraṇena ca tāṃ paryavasthāpayati- puraścakṣūrāga ityādi/ puraḥ ādau/ cakṣūrāgaḥ cakṣuṣo ramaṇīyatvābhimānena prītiḥ/ tadanu tasyānantaram/ ananyaparatā anyadviṣayāntaraṃ paraṃ pradhānaṃ na bhavatītyananyaparaṃ, tasya bhāvaḥ/ manaso'nanyaparateti cittasaṅgena saṅkalpanidrācchedaviṣayanivṛttitrapānāśonmādamūrcchā upalakṣyante, manaḥsaṅgamūlatvāt/ tanujyāniḥ śarīrakārśyam, ``ātmodayaḥ parajyāniḥ'' iti māghoktavat/ ``jyā vayohānau'' iti dhātuḥ/ tanujyāneḥ pṛthagvacanaṃ pratyakṣatvād avasthāntarāṇāṃ kāryonneyatvāt/ maraṇasyāprasaṅgādakīrtanam/ tvayi tvadviṣaye/ yatra yasmin viṣaye/ yuvā bhogayogyaḥ, saḥ abhijanādisarvaguṇasamagratayā mayā kathitastvayā śrutaśca yaḥ, ayamiti diṣṭyā sannihitaḥ, preyān priyatamaḥ iti tvayā prepsitatvenānviṣṭa ityarthaḥ/ ihāsmin yūni viṣaye/ suvadane śobhanamukhīti sotprāśaṃ vacanaṃ, tava hṛdayānukūlyaṃ prasannena mukhenaivāpasarpaṇe kathyate, kimarthamasmān vyākulayasītyarthaḥ/ jaḍatāṃ kiṃkartavyamityapratipattim, ``apratipattirjaḍatā'' iti vacanāt, ,muñca . vaidagdhyaṃ yuvayorākārasaundaryanirmāṇaguṇasāmagryasaṅghaṭanarūpaṃ naipuṇam, vilasatu sajjanasakāśe prakāśatām/ sakāmaḥ samānānurāgajanakaḥ madanaḥ kāmo'pi saṅgamanena siddhasaṅkalpo'stu/ ``so'yaṃ'', ``iha'' iti cokteḥ sannihitopekṣaṇe paścāttāpo'pi bhavatīṃ bādhiṣyata iti vyañjayati/ aprastutapraśaṃsātiśayoktiścālaṅkāraḥ//15//
sakhī sākūtamāha - bhagavati! kṛṣṇacaturdaśīrajanīmahāśmaśānasañcārapṛthagbhūtaviṣamavyavasāyo niṣṭhāpitacaṇḍapāṣaṇḍoddaṇḍabhujadaṇḍasāhasaḥ sāhasikaḥ khalveṣaḥ/ ataḥ khalu me priyasakhī utkampitā/ kṛṣṇapakṣacaturdaśīrātrau, mahāśmaśāne iti bhūtavetālasṛgālādikarālatvaṃ dyotayati/ mahāmāṃsavikrayārthena sañcāreṇa pṛthagbhūtam anyebhyo vyatirekeṇa spaṣṭaḥ/
``ṇivbaḍiasuhāloaṃ ṇivvattiakajjaṇivbaḍattacchāaṃ/'' ityādisetuprayogāt/ viṣamaḥ svajātyavasthājñānasaukumāryāderviruddho vyavasāya ārambhadārḍhyaṃ yasya/ anenānurāgasya garīyastvaṃ sūcitam/ ``sadoṣeṣu punaḥ kāryeṣvālocya guṇavattaram/
adhyavasyati yaḥ kartuṃ vyavasāyī sa kathyate//'' iti, ``ālocanaṃ tu kāryeṣu manvāno dīrghasūtratām/
adhyavasyati yaḥ śīghramasau sāhasikaḥ smṛtaḥ//'' iti ca divākaraḥ/ niṣṭhāpitaḥ samāpitaḥ, caṇḍaḥ krūra iti sukumāraitatkaṇṭhakāṇḍaghaṭitamaṇḍalāgratvaṃ vyañjayati, pāṣaṇḍo yena, ata eva uddaṇḍaṃ lokottaraṃ bhujadaṇḍayoḥ sāhasaṃ śauryaṃ yasya iti prāṇaparitrāṇarūpasyopakārasya garīyastvaṃ dyotayati/ utkampitā etaddarśanena bhītā, vepitetyarthaḥ, utkampanasya harṣabhayasādhāraṇatvāt/ vyājoktiralaṅkāraḥ, anyathodbhinnasya kampasya bhayavyājena gūhanāt/ mīlitaṃ vā/
taduktimavasaraprāptatvāccamatkaroti - svagatam/ sādhu praśastam, idaṃ vastviti śeṣaḥ/ vīpsayādaraṃ dyotayati/ sthāne yogye'vasare/ anurāgopakārayoriti taduktikramāduktiḥ/ garīyasoratimahatoḥ/ upanyāsaḥ svavivakṣitadvāratayoktiḥ/
atha taduktyā paryavasthāpitahṛdayatvaṃ nāyikāyā āha - hā tāta! hā ambeti/ heti viṣāde/ asminnavasare yuvābhyāṃ na sannidhiḥ kṛta ityarthaḥ/ athavā yuṣmadatilaṅghanena mayedamadhyavasitamiti/
ākāratastasyāḥ paryavasthitatvamupalakṣyāha - vatsa mādhaveti/ matsannidhānād devarātādisannidhistava nāpekṣya iti dyotayati/
ājñāpayeti tadvacanaśravaṇe sādaratvamāha/
athānadhikāriṇā kṛtasya pūrvadānasya akṛtatvādidānīṃ dānādhikṛtairevāsmābhiḥ śrutismṛtyuditena mārgeṇa dīyata ityāha - iyamityādi/ sāmantāḥ samantād bhavā rājanaḥ, padmāvatīśvarasya cakravartitvādasya ca tadātmabhūtatvāt/ brāhmaṇyācca, namatāṃ teṣāṃ mastake śirasi ye uttaṃsāḥ śekharamālikāḥ tatparāgaiḥ tadrajobhiḥ/ ``vataṃsottaṃsaśekharāḥ'' iti vaijayantī/ ``parāgaḥ sumanorajaḥ'' ityamaraḥ/ rañjitā rūṣitāḥ pādāṅgulayo yasya/ ekāpatyaratnaṃ ekam apatyāntarābhāvāditi premasarvasvabhūmitvaṃ dyotayati/ ``apatyaṃ tokaṃ tayoḥ same'' ityamaraḥ/ apatyaśreṣṭhamiti sarvaguṇasamuditatvāt svaguṇato'pyupalālanīyatvaṃ vyañjayati/ sadṛśasaṃyogarasikena tulyaguṇayoḥ saṅghaṭane tātparyaśālinā, vedhasā daiveneti pratyūhabahulatve'pi saṅkalpitasiddhirdaivānukūlyamantareṇa kuto bhavatīti prakāśayati/ manmatheneni parārdhyamaṅgalabhūtasya dārakarmaṇītaretarānurāgasya bhāvād bhāvinīmṛddhiṃ sūcayati/ mameti bhūrivasutvena devarātatvena ca sthitāyāḥ ``yatra dātā grahītā ca svayaṃ kuśikanandanaḥ/'' itivad dānagrahaṇayorananyāpekṣatvaṃ dyotayati/ cakāreṇa pitrā cetyanuktasamuccayāt tadbuddhyanusāreṇaiva svayā kriyamāṇatvamanṛtaparihārāya vyañjayati/ tubhyaṃ na tu taveti sampradānatvaṃ samagraguṇatayā samānasambandhatvena ca prakaṭayati/ dīyate udakapūrvaṃ svatvanivṛttyā tvadadhīnā kriyata ityarthaḥ, agnisākṣikasya vivāhavidherupari vakṣyamāṇatvāt/ ``iyamaśeṣasāmante''tyādiḥ prasaṅgaḥ, gurukīrtanāt/
harṣalajjābhyāṃ tūṣṇīṃ tiṣṭhan nāyakaḥ prativacanaṃ suhṛnmukhenāha - phalitaṃ saprayojanena jātam, bhāve niṣṭhā/ na iti kuladvayānubandhināṃ saṅgrahaḥ/ tarhi tasmāt, bhagavatyāḥ pādaśuśrūṣaṇāt, tayoridānīṃ prasādenānugraheṇa/ ``phalitaṃ hi nastarhī''tyādiḥ śaktiḥ, virodhaśamanāt/
harṣakāle tvasambhāvitaṃ duḥkhamupalakṣyāha - taditi/ yasmāt ciraprayuktasya bhagavatyāḥ prayatnasya phalitatvenedānīṃ harṣasyāvasaraḥ, tasmādityarthaḥ/ kimiti kasmāddhetoḥ/ bāṣpāyitaṃ aśrujalodvamanaviśiṣṭaṃ/ ``bāṣpoṣmabhyāmudvamane'' (3-1-16) iti kyapi niṣṭhā/
cīvarāñcalena kāṣāyavastrāntena/ ``vastrāntastvañcalaḥ'' iti vaijayantī/ bāṣpahetumāha - vatsa! kimapīti sūcanamādarajananārthaḥ/ kalyāṇinaṃ mahābhāgyād bhaviṣyatsamṛddhiśālinamiti svata eva tu buddheravikṛtatvaṃ svasyāḥ snehavaśādvacanodyamaṃ ca sūcayati/ vaktukāmāsmi na tu vadāmīti tadabhyupagamanānantaraṃ vivakṣāṃ vyanakti/
tadāśaṅkāṃ nivartayati - nanuravadhāraṇe, ājñāpayatveva bhagavatī/ duṣkaramapi tatkriyata iti bhāvaḥ/
nirastāśaṅkā vivakṣitamāha - pariṇatītyādi/ pariṇatiramaṇīyāḥ kālapāke, ciraparicaya ityarthaḥ, manoharāḥ, prītayaḥ snehāḥ, bahuvacanena bahumukhatvaṃ vyajyate/ tvadvidhānām ``ciraparicayadveṣī loko navaṃ navamicchati'' ityuktāllokāduttīrṇānāṃ tvatsadṛśānāṃ mahāpuruṣāṇām, ``na saṃvāsājjīryate maitrī teṣām.......'' iti mahābhāratokteḥ, ``ikṣoragrāt kramaśaḥ parvaṇi parvaṇi yathā rasaviśeṣaḥ/
tadvatsajjanamaitrī viparītānāṃ tu viparītā//'' iti vacanāt/ tvadvidhānāmiti abhaṅgurasaṅgatve heturuktaḥ/ hetvantaramapi tena samuccinoti - ahamapīti/ tava mānyā pūjyā, taiśca taiścetyagaṇyatvam, hetubhiḥ pitṛdharmataḥ svasṛtvaṃ poṣaṇaṃ rakṣaṇaṃ vidyopadeśaḥ pravrajyā svābhilaṣiteṣu snehataḥ pravṛttirityādibhiraparimitaiḥ kāraṇairityarthaḥ/ tat tasmāditi mayi jīvantyāṃ prītibhaṅgasya yasmāt svapne'pyanāśaṅkyatvamityarthaḥ, iha asyāṃ, suvadanāyāmityupalakṣuṇaṃ sarvāṅgalakṣaṇasampannāyā asyāḥ kadācidapyanāśaṅkyavyasanatvaṃ tathāpi snehato vaktavyamiti vadāmīti pratīyate/ ``putrastu vatsa tāta'' iti vacanāt tātetyāmantraṇam/ mattaḥ mat, ``pañcamyāstasil'' (5-3-7), parastāt parasminnuparitane kāle, kālārthe'stātiḥ, maccharīravimokṣādūrdhvamityarthaḥ, paricayakaruṇāyāḥ prema tāvaddaivato bhavatu vā mā vā, ciraṃ paricayajanitādasmadāśritāyā duḥkhaṃ mā bhūditi dākṣiṇyaparyāyāt kāruṇyāt, sarvathā sarvaprakāreṇa ubhayorābhijātyādikamanurāgamasmāṃścāvekṣya dṛṣṭarūpeṇa dharmapatnītvamāśritātvaṃ strītvaṃ cādṛṣṭarūpeṇetyarthaḥ/ ``sādhvī bhāryā sutaḥ śiśuḥ'' iti manuvacanāt, ``ānṛśaṃsyaṃ paro dharmastvatta eva mayā śrutaḥ/'' iti rāmāyaṇokteḥ, ``striyaḥ śriyo gṛhasyoktāstasmādrakṣyā viśeṣataḥ/'' iti mahābhāratokteḥ/ mā viraṃsīḥ nivṛtto mā bhūḥ/ ``jugupsāvirāmapramādārthānāmupasaṃkhyānaṃ'' (vā. 2-3-28) iti pañcamī/ ``vyāṅparibhyo ramaḥ'' (1-3-83) iti parasmaipadam/ atrāprastutapraśaṃsālaṅkāraḥ, kāryamukhena kāraṇasya vātsalyasya prakāśanāt/ evamādiṣu sthaleṣu, ``sauhārdahṛdyāni viceṣṭitāni'' ityuktasyānusandhānaṃ kāryam//16//
vātsalyaṃ camatkaroti - vātsalyāt snehāt, atikrāmati atibhūmiṃ gacchati, prasaṅgaḥ vacanaprastāvaḥ/ etadviṣaye mayyevaṃ vaktavyatvābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ/
upapattyā tadājñāparipālanasyāvyabhicāramāha - ślāghyānvayetyādi/ [ślāghyānvayā] pūjyavaṃśabhavā, nayanotsavakāriṇī niratiśayalāvaṇyayogāt, nirvyūḍhasauhṛdabharā vātāyanadarśane prastuto yāvatprāṇaparityāgādhyavasāyaniścalatvena phalaparyantatāṃ nītaḥ sauhṛdabharaḥ snehātiśayo yayā, guṇojjvalā guṇaiḥ sahajaiḥ śīlamādhuryādibhiḥ sāṃskārikaiḥ vinayādibhiśca pradīptā/ itiḥ sarvatra prakāravācī/ evaṃprakāraṃ vastviti śeṣaḥ/ ekaikaṃ pratyekameva na dvitīyāpekṣeti/ ``garbheśvaratvamabhinavayauvanatvamapratirūpatvamamānuṣaśaktitvaṃ ceti mahatī khalviyamanarthaparamparā/ sarvāvinayānāmekaikamapyeteṣāmāyatanam/ kimuta samavāya'' iti kādambaryuktavat/ vaśīkaraṇaṃ etadadhīnatākaramauṣadhaṃ mantrapadaṃ vā/ karaṇasādhano'tra lyuṭpratyayo na bhāvasādhanaḥ/ garīyaḥ apunarnivṛttikāritvānmahattaram/ ekaikamevetyukteḥ kimuta samavāya iti dyotyate/ yuṣmākamiti guruṣu bahuvacanam/ evamiti ``mattaḥ parastād'' iti vacanahetubhūtavātsalyaviṣayatvābhinayaḥ/ itiḥ prakāre/ athaśabdo vyāvṛttau, asmin prakāre, kiṃ punarbravīmi avāṅmanasagocaro'syā bhāgyasampadityarthaḥ/ atra kāvyaliṅgamatiśayoktiścālaṅkāraḥ//17//
atha sarvopakārakṣamasya ``viśeṣeṇa gṛhasthasya śeṣāstraya ivāśramāḥ/'' ityādismṛtibhirāśramatrayāt praśastasya gṛhasthāśramasya dampatyoḥ parasparamānukūlye eva samagradharmasādhakatvāt sahadharmacaraṇopadeśāya dvayorābhimukhyaṃ karoti vatsa mādhaveti/
ājñāpayetyādaraḥ/
vatse mālatīti/
ājñāpayatu bhagavatītyavadhānaṃ dyotayati/
upadiśati - preyaḥ priyatamaṃ, mitraṃ vayasyaḥ, bandhutā mātāpitṛsambandhānāṃ bhrātṛmātulādīnāṃ samūhaḥ, ``grāmajanabandhusahāyebhyastal'' (4-2-43) iti samūhārthe talpratyayavidhānāt/ samagrā samastā/ vāśabdaḥ samuccaye/ ``vā vikalpopamānayoḥ/ samuccaye ca'' iti vaijayantī/ kāmāḥ kāmyanta iti śabdādiviṣayāḥ, sampadaḥ tatsādhanabhūtā dhanadhānyādisamṛddhayaḥ, jīvitaṃ sarvasya mūlabhūtaṃ prāṇadhāraṇam, ``śarīramādyaṃ khalu dharmasādhanam/'' ityukteḥ/ vāśabdo'trāpi samuccaye/ bāhyāntarabhedena rāśidvayatvādeko rāśirekena aparo'nyena vāśabdābhyāṃ samuccīyate/ bhartā dhāraṇapoṣaṇādhikṛtatvena dhātrā kalpitaḥ, ``vṛddhau ca mātāpitarau sādhvī bhāryā sutaḥ śiśuḥ/
apyakāryaśataṃ kṛtvā bhartavyā manurabravīt//'' iti vacanāt/ dharmadārāḥ dharmata ūḍhā bhāryā, savarṇā pitrā dattā agnisākṣikaṃ śrautena smārtena ca vidhinā pariṇītetyarthaḥ, tasyā dharmasahāyatvād anyāsa[] kāmārthatvāt/ ``bhartuḥ śarīraśuśrūṣāṃ dharmakāryaṃ ca naityakam/
svā svaiva kuryāt sarveṣāṃ nāsvajātiḥ kathaṃcana//'' iti manuvacanāt/ puṃsi bhūmni ca dāraśabdo bhāryāparyāyo vartate, ``ete vayam, amī dārāḥ'' ityādiprayogāt/ iti itthaṃbhūtaṃ vastu/ itiśabdo bhinnakramaḥ/ iti jñātamastviti sambandhaḥ/ anyonyaṃ parasparam/ vatsayoriti viditaveditavyatve'pi bālatvāt jñānadārḍhyāya punaḥ punaḥ praboddhavyatvaṃ dyotayati/ jñātamastviti rājājñāvat śrutismṛtivacanaṃ gṛhyatām/ na punaratra saṃśayaḥ kārya iti vidhiḥ/ strīṇāṃ puṃsāṃ ca bhartā dharmadārāścānyonyaṃ mitrādikaḥ kāmādikaśca varga iti jñātamastviti sambandhaḥ/ preyo mitraṃ paramavisraṃbhabhūmitvāt, bandhutā nityaṃ priyahitānveṣaṇāt sukhaduḥkhayorabhedenānubhavācca, kāmāḥ sukhahetutvāt, sampadaḥ bhogyasāmagrīsampādanāt, jīvitaṃ parasparavirahe tasyāpi duḥkhāvahatvena jihāsitatvācceti grāhyam/
``mitaṃ dadāti hi pitā mitaṃ bhrātā mitaṃ sutaḥ/
amitasya tu dātāraṃ bhartāraṃ kā na pūjayet//'' iti, ``nāsti strīṇāṃ pṛthagyajño na vrataṃ nāpyupoṣaṇam/
patiṃ śuśrūṣate yattu tena svarge mahīyate//'' ityādibhirubhayalokopakārāt strīṇāṃ bhartā mitrādiḥ, ``dharmārthakāmakāryeṣu bhāryā puṃsaḥ sahāyinī/'' iti, ``videśagamane cāsya saiva viśvāsakāriṇī/'' iti, ``apatyaṃ dharmakāryāṇi śuśrūṣā ratiruttamā/
dārādhīnastathā svargaḥ pitaṛṇāmātmanaśca hi//'' ityādibhiḥ smṛtivacanaiḥ puṃsāṃ dharmadārā mitrādiḥ kathyate iti jñeyam/ ``jñātamastvi'' tyanenopaniṣadātmajñānavyatiriktānāṃ jñānānāṃ pravṛttinivṛttyupayogitvādetat jñātvā parasparāvyabhicāreṇa sahadharmacaryā kāryetyupadeśo dyotyate, ``anyonyasyāvyabhicāro bhavedāmaraṇāntikaḥ/
eṣa dharmaḥ samāsena jñeyaḥ strīpuṃsayorvaraḥ//'' iti manuvacanāt/ anayā ca vācoyuktyā prājāpatyo'yaṃ vivāho na tu gāndharva iti sūcitam, ``sahobhau carataṃ dharmamiti vācānubhāṣya tu/
kanyāpradānamabhyarcya prājāpatyo vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ//'' iti manuvacanāt, ``icchayānyonyasaṃyogaḥ kanyāyāśca varasya ca/
gāndharvaḥ sa vidhirjñevo maithunyaṃ kāmasambhavam//'' ityukteḥ, svecchāsaṃyogasya cātrākathanāt, parasparānurāgasya ca sarvavivāhopakārakatvāt, tāvatā ca gāndharvavivāhatvābhāvāt/ atrollekho'laṅkāraḥ, ekasya nimittavaśādanekadhā grahaṇāt/ anyonyaṃ ca mitramityādijñānasya parasparasādhāraṇyena kathanāt//18//
atha nāyakayostrapāmudritatvāt sakhā sakhī ca tadvacanamanuvadataḥ - athakimiti/
yathā yūyamājñāpayatha tathaitacchāstrārthānatikramādityarthaḥ/
atha svābhilaṣitasya mālatīpradānasya nirvṛttatvāt prakṛtasya nandanavivāhasya chalena nirvāhāya madayantikāsaṃgrahaṇāya ca anāśaṅkanīyamagrāmyaṃ caikamupāyamupadiśati - [vatsa makarandeti/] aneneti narendrānupreṣitanirdeśaḥ, mālatīnaipathyena mālatyarthenālaṅkārajātena, apavāraya chādaya/ mālatīnaipathyenetyukteḥ sāmarthyānmālatībhāveneti siddhyati/ svapariṇayāya ātmano madayantikāvivāhāya/ ātmānaṃ svam/ apavāritaṃ vartayasveti pāṭhe chāditaṃ prasthāpayetyarthaḥ/
paṭalakaṃ ābharaṇapeṭakam/
sauhārdādapāyaśaṅkayāha - sulabhaṃ upāyabalāt suprāpamapi, bahvanarthasaṅkaṭaṃ bahubhirvyasanairviṣamaṃ, durantamiti yāvat, rājño'mātyayośca kṣobhahetutvāt/ hiravadhāraṇe/ ``hi hetāvavadhāraṇe'' iti vaijayantī/ etadvastu nandanātisandhānaṃ madayantikāharaṇaṃ ca/ vayasyasyeti snehakātaryaṃ dyotyate/ sulabhamapī''tyādiprāptyāśā/
upāyāpāyaśaṅkābhyāṃ sucintitakṣematayā tamavasthāpayati - [kastvamiti/] asyāmīdṛśyāṃ, cintāyāṃ kāryavicāre, tvaṃ kaḥ/ kiṃśabdaḥ kṣepe, na ko'pi/ tava kaḥ sambandhaḥ kāryācintāyām/ asmāsvadhikāro, yuṣmākaṃ tu phalabhoktṛtvamevetyarthaḥ/
tadabhiprāyamanusarati - [evamiti/] bhagavatyeveti iha pūrvaṃ yathā, tathātaḥ paramapi bhagavatyevāsminnarthe pramāṇam/ asmaccintā tu cāpalameveti bhāvaḥ/ atra ``kastva''mityādinā dṛṣṭasya rājaroṣapreṣitabalavyasanena ``matsaravailakṣyamaṣīmalinamukhau bhūrivasunandanā''viti vakṣyamāṇena naṣṭasya punaḥ narendraprasādādinā dṛṣṭasya bījasyānveṣaṇarūpo garbhasandhirārabhyata ityanusandheyam/
mālatīsannidhāvevoktervihasyetyuktiḥ/ mālatyasmīti yadi kaścid bhettuṃ pragalbhate tarhi jānīma ityarthaḥ/
sakautukaṃ veṣasya suśliṣṭatvena ramaṇīyatvāt, sasmitaṃ puṃsaḥ strītvāvalambane hāsyarasavyañjakatvāt/
pariṣvajyeti svakāryārthaṃ tasyāḥ kāryakaraṇe'pi pravṛttiṃ suśliṣṭaveṣatāṃ cānusandhāya harṣādāliṅgyetyarthaḥ/ īdṛśaṃ mālatīveṣabhūṣitaṃ, muhūrtamapīti parato vañcanasya prakaṭībhāvāt, kāmayiṣyate kāmukatvenābhimaṃsyate/ ``yadi''ti mālatīveṣabhūṣitasya ``dhanyo nandana'' iti stuteridamabhūtāharaṇaṃ, chadmaprayogāt/
ito'smāt pradeśānnirgatya, asmadvihārikāyāḥ asmanmaṭhasya, paścāt, paścimabhāga iti viviktatayā janairaparijñātatvāya, udyānavāṭe udyānapradeśe gamyatām/ kiṃ tatra gamyata ityāha - suvihitaṃ suṣṭhu sampāditaṃ, vaivāhikaṃ vivāhaḥ prayojanamasya tat, ``prayojanam'' (5-1-109) iti ṭha (k ṛ ñ), dravyajātaṃ ājyakuśasamicchamīpallavalājādipadārthasamūhaḥ/ suvihitamityanena purohitavacanādupapāditatvaṃ tatsannidhiśca dyotyate/ bhūyaśceti punaśca kathyate ityarthaḥ/
sambhogasādhanadravyasampattyā udyānavāṭasyoddīpanatvamāha - gāḍhotkaṇṭhetyādi/ gāḍhā ciravirahādantaḥprarūḍhā priyasamāgamotkaṇṭhā yāsāṃ kaṭhorāḥ prauḍhāḥ, ``bālā tvā ṣoḍaśābdāt tadupari taruṇī triṃśatā yāvadūrdhvaṃṣṭaprauḍhā syāt pañcapañcāśadavadhi parato vṛddhatāmeti nārī//'' iti ratirahasyokteḥ, gāḍhotkaṇṭhāśca kaṭhorāśca yāḥ keralavadhvaḥ tāsāṃ gaṇḍavadavapāṇḍucchadairīṣaddhavaladalaiḥ/ īṣatpāṇḍutvādaprasannalāvaṇyācca viśeṣaṇadvayopādānaṃ, prakṛtyā kanakavarṇatvāt keralīgrahaṇaṃ, viṭapavartināṃ dalānāmupameyatvād, avatārya saṃskṛtānāṃ dhāvalyalāvaṇyātiśayaprasiddheḥ, ``śakayuvatikapolāpāṇḍu tāmbūlavallīdalamaruṇanakhāgraiḥ pāṭitaṃ vā vadhūbhyaḥ/'' ityādiprayogāt/ tāmbūlīpaṭalaiḥ nāgavallīsamūhaiḥ pinaddhaphalitavyānamrapūgadrumāḥ āśliṣṭāḥ sañjātaphalāḥ, ata eva tadbhareṇa vyānamanaśīlāḥ kramukavṛkṣā yeṣu/ takkolī nāma sugandhaphalī latāviśeṣaḥ, tatphalasya jagdhyā bhakṣaṇena mugdhāḥ komalāḥ vikirāṇāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ vyāhārāḥ śabdā yeṣu/
``.........ṭakkolaṃ kolakaṃ param/
api kośaphalaṃ phālaṃ.........//'' iti, ``śalako vikirastuṇḍī nīḍajo vātagāmyapi/'' iti vaijayantī/ vikiraśabdena saṃvardhitā līlāpakṣiṇaḥ śukādaya ucyante/ tadbhuvaḥ udyānabhūmerbhāgāḥ pradeśāḥ/ preṅkhitamātuluṅgavṛtayaḥ mandamārutacalitā mātuluṅgalatā eva vṛtiḥ prāntāvaraṇaṃ yeṣu/ ``phalapūro bījapūro rucako mātuluṅgakaḥ/''ṃ, ``............ prācīnaṃ prāntato vṛtiḥ/'' ityamaraḥ/ preyaḥ priyatamaṃ vastviti vaidagdhyāt sambhogasāmrājyaṃ sūcayati/ vidhāsyanti kariṣyanti/ vāṃ yuvayoḥ, ṣaṣṭhīdvivacanasthasya yuṣmacchabdasya vāmādeśaḥ/ atra naṣṭarāgapratyānayanamukhavāsopayuktadravyasampattiruddīpanānāṃ śukaśārikādiśakunikulakolāhalānāṃ sadbhāvaśca pratipādyate/ ``mātuluṅgatvacastāmbūlamukhavāsanāni ca syuḥ/ tasya bahiḥ krīḍāśakunipañjarāṇi'' iti ratibhavanavinyāse vātsyāyanokteḥ/ udāttamalaṅkāraḥ, samṛddhimadvastuvarṇanāt//19//
ataḥ pradeśasya manoharatvāt, sthalāntaragamanasyānapekṣitatvamucyate - madayantikāmakarandāgamanaṃ madayantikāyā makarandasya cāgamanaṃ, yāvat yatparimāṇena kālena bhavet tāvatkālāvadhi/ anena ``svapariṇayāye''tyuktamarthaṃ niścāyayati/
harṣāt svabhāgadheyaṃ camatkaroti - kalyāṇavatāṃ puṇyavatāṃ, kalyāṇasampat maṅgalasamṛddhiḥ, upariṣṭād ūrdhvam/ vīpsāpyarthādanusandheyā, uparyuparītyarthaḥ, ``sampat sampadamanubadhnāti'' iti vivakṣitatvāt/
evamapi no bhaviṣyati ṛ[evaṃ] ayamapi makarandavivāharūpaḥ prakāraḥ/ apirmādhavavivāhaṃ samuccinoti/ naḥ asmākaṃ, bhaviṣyatīti kākuprayogāt kiṃ bhaviṣyatīti praśne paryavasyati/
praśnasyottaramāha - kathaṃ kena prakāreṇa, atra asminnarthe/ phalasiddheḥ pramāṇato nirṇītatvāt sandehasya na kācidupapattirityarthaḥ/
mālatīṃ hlādayati - śrutaṃ priyasakhyā/ etadvacanamiti śeṣaḥ/
itaḥ anena mārgeṇeti vivāhasthānamārgābhinayaḥ/ athavā asmāt pradeśāditi/ pratiṣṭhāmahe gacchāmaḥ/ ``samavapravibhyaḥ sthaḥ'' (1-3-22) ityātmanepadam/
sakhīvirahāsahatvādāha - sakhi! tvayāpi gantavyamiti kākvā praśno vyajyate/ apiśabdāditarayorgamanaṃ bhavatu nāma, tvadgamanaṃ tvayuktamiti dyotyate/
vihasyeti/ ``tvayāpi gantavya'' mityanena svavirahāsahatvaṃ tayā sūcitamabhipretya sotprāśamāha - sāmprataṃ khalu vayamatrotkaṇṭhāmahe/ sāmpratamiti ciraprārthitapriyasamāgamanirvṛtāyāṃ tvayīdānīṃ, atrāviraharūpe vastuni, utkaṇṭhāmahe abhilāṣukā bhavāmaḥ/ vartamānasāmīpye laṭ/ tvaddarśane vayamevotkā bhaviṣyāmaḥ, sadā sambhogarasikatayā draṣṭumevānavakāśāditi bhāvaḥ/
``adyāntaḥ khalu sarvathāsya madanāyāsasya sarvasya me'' ( la ṛ. 3.)
iti svābhimatānukūlaṃ cirānubhūtasya madanasantāpasya pratyāsannaṃ praśamamanusandadhānaḥ sānandamāha - ayamahaṃ yastathāvidhamadanavedanābaḍavānalajvālāparibharjitaḥ ayamahamityarthaḥ, idānīmasmin kṣaṇe/
āmūlakaṇṭakitetyādi/ āmūlaṃ aṃsadeśaṃ yāvat [kaṇṭakito] pulakito nāla iva bāhuryasya/ skandhamaṇibandhayorantarālapradeśo [bāhuḥ], ``bāhā bāhubhujau na ṣaṇ'' iti vaijayantī/ ārdrāḥ svinnā dalānīvāṅgulyo yasya/ upamāsamāsāśrayaṇena karapakṣayojanā/ anena sāttvikavikāra uktaḥ/ kāntaṃ āruṇyamārdavādiyogāt sundaram/ āmūlaṃ yāvatkandaṃ kaṇṭakito vāhusadṛśo nālo yasya, ārdrāṇi sarassalilena madhunā vā siktāni, aṅgulīsadṛśāni dalāni yasyeti madhyamapadalopisamāsāntarāśrayaṇena paṅkajapakṣayojanā/ kāntamiti sādhāraṇaṃ viśeṣaṇam/ karaṃ pāṇitalam/
``maṇibandho maṇiṃ pāṇimūle pāṇau karaḥ śayaḥ/'' iti vaijayantī/ anaṅganidāghataptaḥ nidāgho grīṣma iva kāmastena santāpita iti nāyakapakṣe, anaṅgasadṛśena nidāghena tapta iti dviradapakṣe/ kareṇa svapāṇinā, puṣkareṇa ca/ ākalayāmi gṛhṇāmi/ ``kala bandhane'' iti dhātuḥ/ āraktapaṅkajaṃ aruṇakamalam/ dviradaḥ gajaḥ/ nalinyāḥ padmastambasya sarasyā vā/ ``... ... ... .. ... nalinī punaḥ/
bisinī padminītyādyāḥ padmastambe sarasyapi/'' iti vaijayantī/ padmastambasyopamānatve śaityasaukumāryādi, sarasyāstu svacchasarasagambhīratvādi nāyikāyāḥ pratīyate/ dviradagrahaṇenāgrahātiśayaṃ dyotayati, ākalanamātre tātparyāt/ bādhakopamānagrahaṇe doṣo nāśaṅkanīyaḥ, sarvathā sāmyābhyupagame sarvodāharaṇabhaṅgaprasaṅgāt/ atra dṛṣṭānto'laṅkāraḥ, nāyakasya nāyikāyāḥ, karasya ca dviradasya, nalinyā raktapaṅkajasya ca bimbapratibimbabhāvena nirdeśāt/ viśeṣaṇānāṃ tu samāsadvayavaśād bimbapratibimbabhāvaḥ pradarśita eva/ karamākalayāmītyukteḥ ``pāṇigrahaṇasaṃskāraḥ savarṇāsūpadiśyate/'' iti smṛtasya pāṇigrahaṇamaṅgalasya vidhivat kariṣyamāṇatvasūcanādavikalaśāstrārthānuṣṭhānamubhayalokopakārakaṃ kavikulamukundaḥ kandalayatītyaśeṣamatimaṅgalam//20//
mālatīmādhavasyetthaṃ ṣaṣṭhāṅkasyārthacarcanam/
pūrṇajyotiḥprasādena cakre pūrṇasarasvatī// //iti ṣaṣṭho'ṅkaḥ//
//atha saptamoṅkaḥ//
atha patākānāyakavṛttāntasya pṛthak pratipādanāya praveśakamārabhate- tataḥ praviśatīti/ ``niyuktaiva hi mayā tatra sakhī buddharakṣitā'' iti madayantikāsamāgamane niyuktatvād buddharakṣitāpraveśaḥ/
susilaṭṭhietyādi/ suśliṣṭamālatīnepathyalakṣmīvipralabdhanandanakaragraho bhūrivasumandire bhagavatīsaṃvidhānaiḥ kṣemeṇa gopāyito makarandaḥ/ suśliṣṭayā suṣṭhu ghaṭitayeti bhedāparijñāne hetuḥ/ mālatīnaipathyalakṣmyā mālatīveṣaparigrahaśobhayā vipralabdhaḥ pratāritaḥ [nandanakaragrahaḥ] nandanasya vivāho yena/ bhagavatyāḥ saṃvidhānaiḥ bāhyajanotsāraṇasvasakhījanaparivṛtatvāvakuṇṭhanāpavārakasthāpanādibhiḥ upāyaiḥ, kṣemeṇa rakṣayā gopāyitaḥ chāditaḥ/ adyāsmābhirnandanāvāsamupagataḥ/ asmābhiriti lavaṅgikādīnāṃ saṅgrahaḥ, sahetyarthaḥ/ tato bhagavatī nandanamāpṛcchya nijāvasathaṃ gatā/ tataḥ jāmātṛgṛhagamanānantaraṃ tasmāt gṛhādvā, āpṛcchya anujñāpya, [nijāvasathaṃ] svavihāraṃ, gatā/
ayaṃ ca navavadhūvarapraveśaviracitākālakaumudīmahotsavamātraparyākulāśeṣaparijanaḥ pradoṣo'nukūlayiṣyatyadya no vyavasitam/ cakāro vākyārthasamuccaye/ navena vadhūvarayoḥ ūḍhakanyājāmātroḥ praveśena viracite akālakaumudīmahotsave śaradṛtuprathamamāsasyāśvayujasya pūrvapakṣe indrayāgarūpasya kaumudīmahotsavasya kartavyatvād, akālagrahaṇaṃ pramodamātreṇa, kālāntare pravartitatvāt/ jyotsnopalakṣite pūrvapakṣe pravṛttatvāt kaumudīmaha iti saṃjñā la ``sakhījanodvīkṣaṇakaumudīmaham'' iti raghuvaṃśokteḥ, ``bandhutānayanakaumudīmahaḥ'' iti vakṣyati ca la ``āśvayujyāmaṣṭamīcandrake kaumudyāmutsave'pi'' iti vātsyāyanavacanāt/ mātraśabdo'vadhāraṇe/ tasminneva paryākulāḥ saṃbhrāntāḥ parijanā yasmin ityanena rakṣiṇāmapyanavadhānaṃ dyotayati/ ``pradoṣo rajanīmukham'' ityamaraḥ/ anukūlayiṣyati anukūlaṃ saphalaṃ kariṣyati/ na iti bhagavatyupadeśena svasyā lavaṅgikāyāścodyamaṃ sūcayati/ vyavasitaṃ adhyavasitaṃ, madayantikāharaṇarūpaṃ kāryam/ svavyavasitānukūlye hetvantaramapi samuccinoti - sāmprataṃ ca tvaramāṇakāmaḥ kāmayituṃ sapādapatanamabhyarthya punarbalātkāreṇābhidravanmakarandena niṣṭhuramabhihato jāmātā/ sāmprataṃ tvaramāṇakāma iti śanaiḥ śanaiḥ visrambhaṇe kṛte kartavyasyābhiyogasyākālapravṛtteranaucityaṃ dyotayati, ``saṅgatayostrirātramadhaḥśayyā brahmacaryam'' iti kāmasūtroktaviruddhānuṣṭhānāt/ punarityabhyarthanaphalasyālābhādityarthāt, kāmayituṃ rantumabhidravan abhigacchan, niṣṭhuraṃ dehābhighātavedanā yathā gaṇarātramanuvartate tathā nirdayaṃ abhihataḥ gardameneva kṛtavyāyāmakaṭhinābhyāṃ caraṇābhyāṃ tāḍitaḥ/ sa ca vailakṣyaroṣanirbharo vañcitaḥ - kṣubhita iti vā - ḍhulukkhido iti vañcanārthe deśīpadam - praruditaprasphuradvadano ``na me sāmpratamanayā kaumārabandhakyā prayojanam'' iti saśapathaṃ pratijñāṃ kṛtvā vāsabhavanānnirgataḥ/
``vilakṣaṃ ceṣṭate cittaṃ yattadvailakṣyamucyate/'' iti vacanāt svābhiprāyabhaṅgajanitābhyāṃ vailakṣyaroṣābhyāṃ [nirbharaḥ] pūrṇaḥ, ata eva kṣubhitaḥ la praruditaṃ sāśru prasphurat paruṣavacanāya sphuradadharaṃ mukhaṃ yasya/ kaumārabandhakyā kaumāre kanyātve bandhakyā kulaṭayā cāritrahīnayeti mādhavānurāgapravādaṃ manasi kṛtvoktiḥ/ saśapathaṃ sapratyayaṃ ``iyaṃ mayā kadācit spṛśyate cediṣṭadevatāgurvājñālaṅghako mahāpātakī ca bhaviṣyāmī''tyādiśāpasahitamityarthaḥ/ tadvṛttāntasya svābhimatānukūlyaṃ daivopapāditamanusandhatte - tadetena prasaṅgena madayantikāmānīya makarandena saṃyojayiṣyāmi/ etena prastāvena mālatībhartsanasāntvanādyavakāśalābhād bharttṛbhaginyā madayantikāyā ānayanaucityādaśaṅkāspadatvamiti bhāvaḥ/
nandanagṛhāgamanasya tatkopanirgamanasya ca vṛttasya madayantikānayanasya ca vartiṣyamāṇasya sūcitatvāt praveśakamupasaṃharati - niṣkrānteti/ //iti praveśakaḥ//
athāṅkamārabhate patākāvṛttāntakathanāya, ``sānubandhaṃ patākā syād'' iti vacanāt - tataḥ praviśatīti/ śayyāgataḥ śayanatalavartīti navavadhūtvābhinayāyoktiḥ/
buddharakṣitāsaṃkrāntā buddharakṣitāmanupraviṣṭā/ bhagavatīnītiḥ kāmandakyā upāyaprayogaḥ ityanena putrikādivaduktaprakārānuṣṭhānamevāsyāḥ, prayojakavyāpārastu tadīya eveti dyotayati/ vijeṣyate pratyūhān nirasya phaladāyinī bhaviṣyati/ ``viparābhyāṃ jeḥ'' (1-3-19) ityātmanepadam/
kathaṃ sandeho mahābhāgasya ṛ kiṃ bahuneti/ sandehābhāvopapattiṃ vaktukāmā kāryapratyāsattimanumāya vivakṣitamākṣipati - yathaiṣa mañjīraśabdaḥ, śrūyate iti śeṣaḥ, tathā jāne tena vyapadeśenānītā buddharakṣitayā madayantiketi/ teneti pūrvasaṅketitatvāt prakṛtaparāmarśaḥ/ vyapadeśena ``mālatyā parikopitastavabhrātā saśapathaṃ pratijñāya nirgataḥ, atastāṃ nirbhartsanasāntvanābhyāṃ tvaṃ bhrātṛvaśavartinīṃ kurvi''ti vacanavyājena/ anena ``tā edeṇa pasaṅgeṇa madāntiaṃ āṇīa mārandeṇa sañjoaissaṃ'' iti buddharakṣitāvacanaṃ saṃghaṭayati/ taduttarīyāpavāritaḥ suptalakṣeṇa tiṣṭha/ uparivastreṇāvakuṇṭhitaḥ, suptaṃ suptiḥ, bhāve niṣṭhā, tadvyājena/
``lakṣaṃ napuṃ śaravye nā strī vyāje niyute na nā/'' iti vaijayantī/
svādarśanāya tadvisraṃbhavacanapravartanāya ca buddharakṣitayā nandanavṛttāntasya kathitatvaṃ la taduktibhaṅgyā prakāśayati - satyameva parikopito me bhrātā mālatyā/ atha kim/
aho atyāhitaṃ mahadvyasanam/ dampatyorekasyānurāgapāravaśye'nyasyāvairāgyeṇa niratiśayaduḥkhahetutvamiti bhāvaḥ/ tadehi/ vāmaśīlāṃ mālatīṃ nirbhartsya gacchāmaḥ/ tadyato'yamanartho'smābhiḥ suhṛdbhāvena parihartavyaḥ tasmāt kāraṇāt, ehi tvayāpi sāhāyyaṃ kartavyamiti prārthanā/ vāmaśīlāṃ pratikūlasvabhāvāṃ, bharturityarthāt la anena svabhrāturnirdoṣatvaṃ dhvanati/ nirbhartsyaparuṣavacanena vinīyetyarthaḥ/ paścāt svabhavanaṃ gacchāmaḥ/ anena vyapadeśaprayogasya phalonmukhatvaṃ dyotayati/
idaṃ vāsabhavanaṃ śayanagṛham/
uttarīyāvakuṇṭhananiṣpandatvābhyāmanumāyāha - sakhi lavaṅgike! jñāyate prasuptā te priyasakhīti/ te priyasakhīti tvayāpi kimasyā duśceṣṭitamanumodyata iti sūcayati/
sakhi! maināṃ pratibodhaya/ tatra hetuḥ- eṣā ciraṃ durmanāyamānā idānīṃ īṣanmanye prasupteti/ durmanāyamānā manoduḥkhamanubhavantīti nandanāparādhasūcanam/ idānīmīṣatprasupteti manye iti sambandhaḥ/ ataḥ śanairita eva śayanārdhānte upaviśa/ ataḥ apratibodhanāya, ita ityaṅgulīnirdeśaḥ, śayyaikadeśe, ``mahialaddhantā'' ityādiprayogāt/
tathā kṛtvā uṣaviśya/ durmanāyate vā iyaṃ vāmaśīlā/ vā vikalpe/ svayaṃ bhartuḥ pratikūlamācarati durmanāyate ca kimityupālambhaḥ/
tasyā upālambhodyamaṃ jñātvā niravakāśatvāya svayamupālambhate- kathaṃ nāma navavadhūvisrambhaṇopāyajñaṃ laṭahaṃ vidagdhamadhurābhāṣaṇaṃ aroṣaṇaṃ akātaraṃ bhrātaraṃ te bhartāraṃ samāsādya durmanāyiṣyate me priyasakhī/ navavadhūvisrambhaṇopāyāḥ ``tasmāt sāmnaivopacaret, yuktyā ca/ yuktitaḥ prasaramupalabheta/ tenaivaināmanupraviśet/'' ityādikāmasūtroktāḥ tān jānānaṃ, laṭahaṃ sundaraṃ, vidagdhamadhurābhāṣaṇaṃ agrāmyaṃ sarasaṃ ca vacanaṃ yasya, anena ``tatra siddhāmālapayettadvākyaśravaṇārtham/ kiñcidalpākṣarābhidheyamajānanniva pṛcchet/'' ityādyālāpayojanavaidagdhyaṃ kāmasūtroktaṃ sūcayati la aroṣaṇaṃ atilajjayā tasyā vāmaśīlatve krodhaśīlo na bhavatīti, ``atilajjānvitetyevaṃ yastu kanyāmupekṣate/
anabhiprāyavedīti paśuvat paribhūyate//'' iti vacanāt la akātaraṃ sādhvasarahitaṃ, tadabhiprāyaṃ jñātvā kiñcid balātkāro'pi kartavya iti dyotayati, ``nātyantamānukūlyena na cāpi prātilomyataḥ/
siddhiṃ gacchati kanyāsu tasmānmadhyena sādhayet//'' iti vātsyāyanavacanāt/ atra viparītalakṣaṇayā anupāyajñatvaṃ asundaratvaṃ grāmyaparuṣavacanatvaṃ roṣaṇatvaṃ kātaratvaṃ ca prakāśyate/ bhrātaraṃ te iti sarvo'pi svajanaṃ guṇavantaṃ manyate, na tu tadīyaṃ doṣaṃ paśyati ``priye śubhāni sarvāṇi dveṣye pāpāni bhārata/'' ityuktanyāyāditi sūcayati/ bhartāramiti yāvajjīvabhāvitvaṃ hṛdayaśalyasya prakāśyate/ kathaṃ durmanāyiṣyate kena prakāreṇodvijiṣyate iti viparītalakṣaṇā/ atyantatiraskṛtavācyena dhvaninā sadā viṣādasyaivāvakāśo na kadācidapi sukhaleśa iti vyajyate/
taduktyabhiprāyaṃ jñātvāha- paśya buddharakṣite! vipratīpamupālabhyāmahe/ paśyeti nirūpyatāṃ gambhīrākṣepa ityarthaḥ/ vipratīpaṃ pratikūlam/
atha vikalpya bhaṅgyā lavaṅgikopālambhasyopapannatvaṃ sthāpayati-vipratīpaṃ na vā vipratīpamiti/ ubhayathāpi vidagdhairyojayituṃ śakyate/ tattvatastu ekaiva koṭiḥ pariśiṣyata ityarthaḥ/ ``doṣānapi guṇīkartuṃ doṣīkartuṃ guṇānapi/
śakto vāgmī na tattathyaṃ doṣā doṣā guṇā guṇāḥ''ṃ//
ityukteḥ/
tajjijñāsayā pṛcchati - kathamiva kena prakāreṇaikasyobhayathā yojanamityarthaḥ/
tatprakāraṃ darśayati - yattāvaccaraṇānato bhartā na bahumānitaḥ la tāvadādāvityavicāradaśāyāmiti dyotyate, bahumānaḥ satkāraḥ tatpraṇayānuvartane na lambhitaḥ, yaditi etat khalu tvayā tadupālambhanimittamityāśaṅkyate ityarthaḥ la atra parihāro'stītyāha - atra lajjādoṣeṇaiṣa jano nopālambhanīyaḥ/ atra asminnarthe lajjādoṣeṇa asaṃskṛtamugdhatvādihetukena lajjārūpeṇa doṣeṇa, athavā lajjāyā aparādhena, ``skhalitaṃ mama jānīyuriti cintāsamudbhavā/
mānasī vikriyā lajjā sarvavṛttivirodhinī//'' iti divākaraḥ, eṣa jana iti mālatyabhinayaḥ, nopālambhanīyaḥ upālambhaṃ nārhatīti ``vipratīpamupālabhyāmaha'' ityuktasya prativacanam/ yadapi navavadhūviruddhasarabhasopakramaskhalanavailakṣyaviccharditamahānubhāvatvasya bhrātuste vāggataṃ kimapyapariṣṭhānakaṃ tena vicāryate ke vayamiti/ navavadhūḥ navapariṇītā kanyā tadviruddhasya tatpratikūlasya, kāmaśāstre tasya niṣiddhatvāt, sarabhasopakramasya rabhasasahitasya ratārambhasya la ``sarvātyayānapekṣī tu tvarāvān laṅghitakramaḥ/
aśakyaḥ soḍhumanyaiśca vyāpāro rabhasaḥ smṛtaḥ//'' iti divākaraḥ, skhalanaṃ pratihatiḥ, śāstrārthātikramasya viruddhaphalatvāditi bhāvaḥ, taddhetukena vailakṣyeṇa lajjātiśayena viccharditamudvāntaṃ, nirastamiti yāvat, mahānubhāvatvaṃ vaṃśaiśvaryaśrutavayaḥpariṇāmādijanitaṃ māhātmyaṃ yena, ``kṣamāsārā hi sādhavaḥ'' iti vacanāt/ te bhrāturiti tadaparādhasya asmāsu sarvāsu sambandhitvāllajjājanakatvamiti dyotayati/ vāggatamiti kāyikaṃ tāḍanādikaṃ tu samucitameva, śikṣārūpatvāt tatkṣaṇa eva vedanāśamanācca, vācikaṃ tu marmāvittvānna kadācicchāmyatīti, ``vāksāyakā vadanānniṣpatanti yairāhataḥ śocayati rātryahāni/
parasya nāmarmasu te patanti tān paṇḍito nāvasṛjet pareṣu//'' iti vyāsavacanāditi vyañjayati/ kimapītyatiparuṣatayā durvacatvamāha/ apariṣṭhānakaṃ-appaḍiṭṭhāṇāṃ iti vā pāṭhaḥ, apratiṣṭhānakaṃ - yogyasthalamullaṅghya pravṛttiṃ, akramavacanamityarthaḥ/ tena hetunā vicāryate nirūpyate la ``keṇa jāṇīadi'' iti vā pāṭhaḥ, kena jñāyate/ vayamiti nandanagṛhyāṇāṃ grahaṇam/ ke iti ``eso jaṇo ṇa uvālambhaṇijjo'' iti mālatyā anupālabhyakoṭau niveśitatvādavaya tu kasyāṃ kakṣyāyāṃ nikṣeptavyāḥ upālabhyakoṭau vā upālambhakakoṭau veti na jñāyate ityarthaḥ/ ``navavadhūviruddhe''ti, ``viccharditamahānubhāvatve''ti, ``apratiṣṭhānakami''ti sphuṭaṃ doṣodghoṣaṇāyāḥ kṛtiḥ mayā tu na jñāyate, tvameva matiśālinī nirṇaye'sya pramāṇamiti sūcayantī bhaṅgyā vayamevopālabhyā iti sthāpayatīti mantavyam/ ke iti pulliṅgāntena kiṃśabdenoktirmandanasya prādhānyena parāmarśavīkṣaṇād, anyathā kā vayamiti vaktavyatvāt/
navavadhūviruddhetyuktameva nandananindanāya kāmasūtrasaṃvādanena sthāpayati- kiñceti/ anyacca mayā kathyate/ madūhamātramidamiti tvayā na mantavyam/ śāstrārtha eva mayā pradarśyate ityarthaḥ/ tadeva śāstramudāharati - kusumasadharmāṇa ityādi/ puṣpasadṛśasvabhāvāḥ, yathā kusumāni sadayamādāya śirasi dhāritāni paramaṃ sukhaṃ śobhātiśayaṃ ca janayanti, na tu karatalakalanaṃ vidṛḍhataraṃ kṣamante, tathā yoṣito'pyupalālanīyāḥ, na tu kadarthanīyāḥ ityarthaḥ, ``naisargikī surabhiṇaḥ kusumasya siddhā mūrdhni sthitirna musalairavatāḍanāni/'' ityukteḥ/ hi prasiddhau/ yoṣita iti strīmātrasyāyaṃ dharmaḥ, kiṃ punaḥ kanyānāmityarthaḥ, kanyāvisrambhaṇaprakaraṇapaṭhitatvāt/ sukumāropakramāḥ mṛdūpāyānuṣṭheyasamprayogāḥ, bhavantīti śeṣaḥ/ tā yoṣitaḥ, turviśeṣe, anadhigataviśvāsaiḥ aprāptavisrambhaiḥ prasabhaṃ balātkāreṇa upakramyamāṇāḥ bhoktumārabhyamāṇāḥ, sadyastatkṣaṇa eva saṃprayogavidveṣiṇyaḥ puruṣasaṃsargavirāgaśīlāḥ/ tato'pi vairasyamāha - puruṣadveṣiṇyo veti/ samprayogamantareṇāpi puruṣamātrameva darśanasparśanādiṣvapi dveṣṭuṃ śīlaṃ yāsāṃ tāḥ, vā/ itissūtrasamāptau/ evvaṃ kileti/ evamiti prakāre, īdṛśānāṃ vacanānāṃ bahutvāt/ evaṃ kila kāmasūtrakārāḥ āmanantīti/ kileti prasiddhau/ tvayāpyadhītatvādvidita evāyamartha iti bhāvaḥ/ kāmasūtrakārāḥ nandīśvaraśvetaketubābhravyavātsyāyanādayaḥ, āmananti adhīyate/ itiḥ śrutivat tadanusāriṇyā strīvargasmṛteravyabhicaritaphalatvamavicāraṇīyatvamanyathākaraṇe viruddhaphalatvaṃ ca vyañjayati/ ``kusume''tyādeḥ ``puruṣadveṣiṇyo ve''tyantasya sūtrasya pāṭhānukaraṇād ``anukaraṇe tu sarveṣāṃ'' ityukteḥ sādhutvāt saṃskṛtatvaṃ, ``evaṃ kila'' ityādeḥ svoktitvāt prākṛtatvaṃ ceti mantavyam, na tu saṃskṛtāśrayaṇena, tasya svavacanaviṣayatvāt/
sāsramiti satyatvabhāvanāvaidagdhyamāha/ gṛhe gṛhe puruṣāḥ striya udvahanti/ na ca ko'pi lajjāprasādhanamanaparāddhamugdhasvabhāvaṃ kulakumārījanaṃ prabhavāmīti vāganalena prajvālayati/ udvahanti vivahanti/ ko'pītyuttamo madhyamo'dhamo vetyarthaḥ/ lajjaiva prasādhanamalaṅkāro yasya, ``sphuṭamabhibhūṣayati striyastrapaiva'' ityukteḥ/ anaparāddhaḥ kadācidapyaparādharahitaḥ, tatra hetuḥ mugdhaḥ hariṇyāderivākṛtrimaḥ svabhāvo yasya/ kaḥ khalvanunmattaḥ śiśuṣu ca paśuṣu ca kanyājaneṣu ca maugdhyādaniṣṭamāceṣṭamāneṣvapi nikṛṣṭaroṣāviṣṭatvamācarediti bhāvaḥ/ kulakumārījanaṃ praśaste vaṃśe jātaṃ kulasya paripālakaṃ ca kanyājanam/ anena trivargasya tadāyattatvāt paṇyanārīvadānukūlye parigrahaḥ, prātikūlye parityāgaśca kiṃ śakyate vā ayaṃ upapanno veti dyotyate/ prabhavāmi prabhuḥ svāmyahamasmīti/ itirhetau, anena hetunā na punastadgatenāparādhaleśena śeṣeṇāśeṣabhūtasya vastunaḥ parilālane parilolane ko vā nivārayitā, tathāpi dvitīyā koṭiranuciteti bhāvaḥ/ vāganalena vacanarūpeṇāgninā, niratiśayavedanājanakatvāt punaḥsandhānābhāvatvāccāgnitvarūpaṇam, ``vācā duruktaṃ bībhatsaṃ na saṃrohati vākkṣatam/'' iti mahābhāratokteḥ/ prajvālayati pradīptaṃ karoti/ prajvālayati na punardahatītyuktiḥ puṭapākavat sarvadā manaḥkvāthajananād abhasmīkaraṇācca/ ete khalu te hṛdayaśalyanikṣepāḥ āmaraṇaṃ saṃsmaryamāṇadussahāḥ paragṛhanivāsavairāgyakāriṇo mahāparibhavāḥ/ khaluḥ prasiddhau/ ete lokairdṛśyamānāḥ āmaraṇaṃ yāvajjīvaṃ hṛdayaśalyanikṣepāḥ manasi śalyasya śaraphalasya nikhananarūpāḥ, antarvyathākāritvāt/ saṃsmaryamāṇatve dussahāḥ anubhavasamayādapi smaraṇe smaraṇe marmacchidaḥ/ paraśabdena svapitṛgehādanya ucyate/ anyadīyabhavananivāse vairāgyānnirvedaṃ kartuṃ śīlaṃ yeṣām/ mahāparibhavāḥ tāḍanādibhyo'pyadhikāstiraskārāḥ/ yeṣāṃ kṛte strījanmalābhaṃ jugupsante bāndhavāḥ/ yeṣāṃ kṛte hetoḥ, paribhavānāṃ bhāvināmāśaṅkayetyarthaḥ, strījanmalābhaṃ svavaṃśe strīṇāṃ prasūtiṃ jugupsante garhante, bāndhavāḥ pitrādayaḥ/ ``dhik khalvalaghuśīlānāmucchritānāṃ yaśasvinām/
narāṇāṃ śuddhasattvānāṃ kule kanyānirūpaṇam//'' iti mahābhāratokteḥ/
``etasminnimittaṃ jātamātrābhyaḥ kanyābhyaḥ prayacchanti salilamaśrubindubhirbāndhavāḥ'' ityādivacanaiḥ sāsratvādibhiḥ paramārthato duḥkhitatvaṃ niścityāha - sakhi buddharakṣite! atiparitāpitā priyasakhī lavaṅgikā/ api mahān ko'pyaparādhaḥ kṛto me bhrātrā/ apiḥ praśne/ mahāniti kṣudre'parādhe sāsratvāderanupapatteḥ/
aparādhamevopanyasyati - atha kim/ ``na me anayā kaumārabandhakyā prayojanami''ti saśapathaṃ pratijñāṃ kṛtvā vāsabhavanānnirgataḥ iti praveśakoktameva saṅghaṭayati/
kaṇag pidhāya śravaṇapuṭau hastābhyāmācchādya, ``guroryatra parīvādo nindā vāpi pravartate/
kaṇag tatra pidhātavyau gantavyaṃ vā tato'nyataḥ//'' ityādismaraṇāt sādhunindāśravaṇasya prāyaścittaṃ vidhāyetyarthaḥ/ aho atikramaḥ/ aho pramādaḥ/ atikramaḥ kramātilaṅghanaṃ, kulakanyāviṣaye tathā vaktumayuktatvāt/ tatra hetuḥ - pramādaḥ anavadhānam/ aho ityāścarye/ mahānubhāvasya tasya kathamīdṛśo buddhikṣobhaḥ sañjāta ityarthaḥ/ tadaparādhena lajjitā āha - sakhi lavaṅgike/ asamarthāsmi te mukhaṃ draṣṭum/ asamarthā aśaktā, hriyeti śeṣaḥ/ bhrāturanaparādhatvaṃ bhaṅgyā samarthayitumupakramate - tathāpi prabhavāmīti kimapi mantrayiṣyāmi/ tathāpītyaparādhaḥ kṛtastena bhavatu nāmetyarthaḥ/ prabhavāmi priyasakhītvād yuṣmānnigṛhya vaktumahamadhikṛtāsmītyarthaḥ/ kimapīti yathāpratibhātaṃ kiñciditi tat soḍhavyamiti prārthanā/
atha tadanumodamāneva svābhilaṣitāvataraṇāya visrambhasallāpasyāvakāśaṃ vaidagdhyād dadāti - svādhīnaste ayaṃ janaḥ/ svādhīnaḥ tava vaśe vartate, ayaṃ janaḥ mālatī ahaṃ ca/ anena tvadvacasi na kadācidasmākamīrṣyeti dyotayati/
atha suhṛdbhāvenopālabdhumupakramate - tiṣṭhatu tāvanmama bhrāturduśśīlatā, apariṣṭhānakaṃ ca/ duśśīlatā duṣṭasvabhāvatā, apariṣṭhānakaṃ capalatvaṃ ca, tiṣṭhatu nedānīṃ tadvaktavyam, tathātvasya prasiddhatvādityarthaḥ/ yuṣmābhirapi īdṛśo'pi sāmprataṃ yathācittamanuvartanīyaḥ, yena bhartā eṣa iti/ apiśabdo yuṣmākamapi sāparādhatvamastyeva, na kevalaṃ tasyeti samuccinoti/ īdṛśaḥ duśśīlatvādiviśiṣṭaḥ, apirvirodhe, tasyānyairasevyatve'pītyarthaḥ sāmprataṃ pāṇigrahaṇe nirvṛtte, yathācittaṃ cittamanatikramya, icchāsadṛśamityarthaḥ, anuvartanīyaḥ paricaraṇīyaḥ/ nirguṇo'pyanuvartanīya iti kimiyaṃ rājājñetyatrāha - yena bharteti/ yeneti vibhaktipratirūpakamavyayaṃ, idaṃ yasmāttasmādityarthaḥ/ anena śrutismṛtyo rājājñāvadavicāraṇīyatvaṃ vyajyate, ``aśīlaḥ kāmavṛtto vā guṇairvā parivarjitaḥ/
sādhvyā striyopacaryaḥ syāt satataṃ devavat patiḥ//'' iti manuvacanāt/ tadaparādhasya na kevalaṃ duśśīlaṃ mūlamanyadapyastītyāha - na ca yūyamasyānabhijātākṣarādhikṣepopālambhasya yanmūlaṃ tajjānītha/ anabhijātānāmakulīnānāmakṣarairvacanairadhikṣepaḥ paruṣoktiḥ tena upālambho nindā, tasya yanmūlaṃ nimittam/
taduktyabhiprāyaṃ lavaṅgikā jānānā api ajānānevāha - vayaṃ kathamātmagataṃ jānīmaḥ/ ātmagataṃ manasi sthitaṃ kathaṃ jānīmaḥ ``vacanaliṅgā hi vakturabhiprāyāḥ'' iti nyāyāt tvayā kathite jñāyate tvadākūtaṃ, tat kathyatāmityarthaḥ/ ``asantāṃ'' iti pāṭhe asat mithyābhūtamityarthaḥ, tasya mūlābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ/ ``ṇa vāāgāṃ'' iti pāṭhe vāggatamapi kathaṃ na jānīma iti tadvivakṣitārthakhaṇḍanāya sābhiprāyaṃ vacanaṃ, tvadbhrātudagśśīlyamantareṇa na kiñcinmūlaṃ tacca tadvācaiva vyaktamityarthaḥ/
upālambhamūlaṃ vivṛṇoti - yadidānīṃ tasmin mahānubhāve mādhave kimapi kila mālatyā vāṅmātramāsīt tasmin sarvalokasyātibhūmiṃ gataḥ pravādaḥ, tat khalvetad vijṛmbhate/ tasminniti śārdūlavimardasamayadṛṣṭatvāt mādhavānubhavābhinayaḥ/ athavā tasminniti śaṅkarapurapraveśābhinayaḥ/ mādhave viṣaye kimapītyanurāgaviṣayatvasaṃvaraṇam, anyasmai dattāyā aparasminnanurāgakathanasyānaucityāt/ kiletyaitihye, mayāpi śrutaṃ kathyate, na mayi roṣṭavyamiti bhāvaḥ/ vāṅmātraṃ sakhyādīnāṃ mitho vacanameva, vivāhakāryasyānyatra nirvṛttatvāt la athavā ``diṭṭhiā vaṭṭhasi paḍivaṇṇaceaṇo mahābhāā'', ``tatkāmaṃ prabhavati pūrṇapātravṛttyāṣṭasvīkartuṃ mama hṛdayaṃ ca jīvitaṃ ca/'' ( la ṛ. ṛ.), ``paḍicchido kkhu eso pasādo'' ityādirūpaṃ vāṅmātraṃ la āsīt, tasmin viṣaye sarvalokasya ābālavṛddhasya sarvasya janasya atibhūmiṃ parāṃ kāṣṭhāṃ, sarvadā sarvatrodghuṣyamāṇatvāt, pravādaḥ apavādaḥ/ idānīmatibhūmiṃ gataḥ pravāda iti yadityanvayaḥ/ anena ``anurāgapravādastu vatsayoḥ sārvalaukikaḥ'' ityādi pūrvoktamupāyojayati/ tat tathā bhūtaṃ vastu, khaluravadhāraṇe, etat nandanaparuṣavacanaṃ bhūtvā vijṛmbhate pariṇamati, tanmanasi kṛtvā kaumārabandhakīti cāritradūṣaṇaṃ durbhāṣaṇaṃ tena prayuktamityarthaḥ/
tat priyasakhi! yathāsyā bharturapakṣābhiniveśo niravaśeṣaṃ hṛdayāduddhriyate tathā kuruta/ anyathā mahādoṣa iti jñātaṃ bhavatu/ bhartṛhṛdayādasyā mālatyā apakṣābhiniveśaḥ viruddhapakṣānurāgaḥ nirbandhaḥ, tadāśaṅketyarthāt, niravaśeṣaṃ sākalyena uddhriyate apohyate yathā tathā kuruta tathā tadāvarjanaṃ sarvātmanā kartavyam/ kuruteti bahuvacanena maugdhyānmālatyā aparijñāne'piyuṣmābhiḥ tadātmabhūtābhiḥ sā śikṣaṇīyā rakṣaṇīyā ceti dyotayati/ vipakṣe bādhakamāha - anyathā tathā yuṣmābhirakriyamāṇe, mahādoṣaḥ mahad vyasanaṃ, dampatyoḥ parasparavirodhe gṛhasyaiva nāśaprasaṅgāt, kadācid duṣṭāyāḥ striyo'parityāgo'dhivedanaṃ vāpi sambhāvyata iti bhaṅgyā sūcayati - ``vidhivat pratigṛhyāpi tyajet patnīṃ vigarhitām/
vyādhitāṃ vipraduṣṭāṃ vā chadmanā copapāditām//'' iti, ``madyapāsatyavṛttā ca pratikūlā ca yā bhavet/
vyādhitā cādhivettavyā hiṃsrārthaghnī ca sarvadā//'' iti, ``sadyastvapriyavādinī'' iti ca manuvacanāt/ jñātaṃ bhavatviti upadeśatvena idaṃ gṛhyatāmityarthāntarasaṅkramitavācyena dhvaninā vyajyate/
tyāgādeḥ sambhāvitasya hetuṃ samarthayati - niṣkampadāruṇāḥ khalu striyaḥ, paritāpayanti hṛdayaṃ manuṣyāṇāmīdṛśād durabhiṣaṅgāditi/ niṣkampāḥ īpsitārthasthiraniścayāḥ dāruṇāḥ anurāgaparavaśe'pi jane niṣkāruṇyāḥ, khalu prasiddhau, ``na ca dīrye kaṭhināḥ khalu striyaḥ'', ``kiṃ krūraṃ strīhṛdayam'' ityādinā sahṛdayaiḥ samarthito'yamartha ityarthaḥ/ īdṛśāt mālatīpravṛttisadṛśād durabhiṣaṅgād duṣṭāllokadvayaviruddhād, bhartāramantareṇa yatra kutracit pravṛttādanurāgāt/ itirhetau/ manuṣyāṇāmityanavasthitaprematvaṃ vyajyate/
``pramadāsvanavasthitaṃ nṛṇāṃ na khalu prema calaṃ suhṛjjane/'' ityukteḥ, ``manuṣyajāteścittānityatvāt'' iti vātsyāyanavacanācca/ yataḥ paritaptāḥ tyāgādiṣvapi pravartante, ato'nyathā mahādoṣa iti jñātaṃ bhavatvityanvayaḥ/ ``ākeśagrahaṇānmitramakāryāt sannivartayet/
avācyaḥ kasyacid bhavati kṛtayatno yathābalam//'' iti vacanād ātmano nirdoṣatvāyāha - mā bhaṇaha/ mā bhaṇata madayantikayā na kathitamiti/ madayantikayeti sahapāṃsukrīḍāsamupajātasauhārdavisrambhatvaṃ dhvanyate/ ayamartho jānānayāpi madayantikayā hanta! nāsmabhya kathitaḥ iti paścānmā vadata, pūrvameva mayopadiṣṭatvādityarthaḥ/
praṇayakupitāha - [ayi] asambaddhalokapravādamohite! apehi/ na tvayā saha mantrayiṣyāmi/ asambaddhena asatyaviṣayatvādaghaṭitena lokasyetarajanasya pravādena mohite vyākulitahṛdaye, apehi purato'pasara/ tvayā saha sallāpaṃ na kariṣyāmi, unmattaiḥ saha sambhāṣaṇasyānaucityāditi bhāvaḥ/
atha tāṃ prasādayantī svokteḥ paramārthatvasamarthanena ``asambaddhalokapravādamohite'' iti taduktiṃ pratikṣipati - sakhi! prasīda mā kupya/ athavā na yūyaṃ prathamaṃ bhaṇitāḥ/ athaveti pūrvoktavyāvṛttau, yūyaṃ mālatyādayaḥ, prathamaṃ bhaṇitāḥ lokapravādapatitatvena mayoktāḥ athavā bhaviṣyadvyasanaṃ mayā pūrvameva jñāpitā na bhavatheti śeṣaḥ/ tatra yuṣmākaṃ vimaterityarthaḥ/ tiṣṭhata kiñcit kṣaṇamātraṃ tūṣṇīmādhvam/ tato maduktamarthaṃ saṃvādayāmīti bhāvaḥ/ saṃvādanāyopakramate - kiñca vayaṃ satyameva mādhavamayajīvitāṃ mālatīṃ jānīmaḥ/ vayamiti buddharakṣitāgrahaṇam/ satyameva na lokapravādamātreṇetyarthaḥ/ mādhavamayajīvitāṃ mādhavātmakaprāṇām/ tadaprāptau maraṇāderapi sambhāvyatvamanena dyotayati/ na jānīma iti pāṭhe kākvā kinna jānīma iti vyajyate/
yuṣmābhiḥ kathaṃ jñāyata ityāśaṅkya ābālagopālaṃ jñāto'yamartha ityāha- kena vā kaṭhoraketakīgarbhavibhramāvayavadaurbalyapṛthagbhūtasundaratvaṃ mādhavasvahastanirmitabakulāvalīviracitakaṇṭhāvalambamātrasañjīvanaṃ mālatyā mādhavasya ca prabhātacandramaṇḍalāpāṇḍaraparikṣāmaramaṇīyadarśanaṃ na vibhāvitaṃ śarīram/ kaṭhorasya pariṇatasya ketakīgarbhasya ketakīkusumābhyantarapatrasya vibhramo vilāsa iva vibhramo yeṣām āpāṇḍarasukumāralāvaṇyatvād, avayavānāṃ daurbalyena glānyā pṛthagbhūtaṃ svābhāvikādvyatiriktaṃ saundaryaṃ yasya la kaṇṭhāvalambaḥ kaṇṭhabhūṣaṇaṃ tanmātraṃ sañjīvanaṃ prāṇadhāraṇauṣadhaṃ yasya/ mālatyāḥ śarīraṃ, mādhavasya ceti śarīraṃ samuccinoti/ vibhāvitaṃ nirūpitam/ kiñca tasmin divase kusumākarodyānaparyantarathyāmukhasamāgame savibhramollasitakautūhalayoḥ savilāsamasṛṇasañcaraṇacārutārakāvirājamānavibhramā anaṅgasaṅgītācāryasarvādaropadeśanirmitanijavaidagdhyamugdhamanoharā mayāpi nanu nirūpitā anayordṛṣṭisaṃbhedāḥ/ tasminnityanubhavaparāmarśaḥ, śārdūlavimardasaṃbhramajanite samāgame savibhramamullasitamudbhūtaṃ kautūhalaṃ parasparadarśanābhilāṣo yayoḥ/ vibhramaḥ tvarājanito bhūṣaṇādivinyāsavyatyāsaḥ/
``vibhramastvarayākāle bhūṣāsthānaviparyayaḥ/'' iti dhanikaḥ/
savilāsamasṛṇena salīlatayā anulbaṇena sañcaraṇena cāruḥ śobhanā tārakā kanīnikā tayā virājamānāḥ vibhramāḥ karacaraṇādīnāṃ ceṣṭāviśeṣāḥ yeṣu, nayanavilāsamūlatvāccheṣāṅgavibhramacārutvasya, ``sarve bhāvāścakṣuṣi vyajyante'' iti nyāyāt/ anaṅgarūpasya saṅgītācāryasya nartakasya sarvādaropadeśena sarveṇa samagreṇa ādaropadeśena sacchiṣyalābhajanitapakṣapātakṛtena śikṣādānena nirmitanijavaidagdhyā svato mugdhā ata eva manoharāḥ/ mayāpīti nānyavacasā matpratyayaḥ, mayāpi sākṣānnirūpitā dṛṣṭāḥ/ nanviti saṃvāde, yuvābhyāṃ sahetyarthaḥ/ neti vā pāṭhaḥ/ tadānīṃ ``kiṃ ce''tyatra kimā sambandhaḥ, kiṃ na nirūpitā ityarthaḥ/ cakāro hetvantarasamuccaye/ anayoḥ mālatīmādhavayordṛṣṭisaṃbhedāḥ dṛṣṭīnāṃ parasparavyatikarāḥ/ hetvantaramāha - kiṃ ca mama bhrātre dānavṛttāntaṃ śrutvā tatkṣaṇottaraṅgodvegavyatikaramlāyaddehaśobhamudvartamānamūlabandhanamiva na lakṣitaṃ hṛdayam/ mama bhrātre nandanāya ``parameśvareṇa svayameva mālatī pratipāditā'' iti puruṣamukhāt śrutvā tatkṣaṇa evottaraṅgasya uparyupari prasarataḥ udvegasya kṣobhasya vyatikareṇa sambandhena dahanasparśeneva kusumasya mlāyantī dehasya śobhā kāntiryasmin yena vā, manastāpasya śarīratāpanāntarīyakatvāt, ``manaḥ śarīrayostāpaḥ parasparamabhivrajet/''iti pūjyavāhaṭokteḥ la ata evodvartamānamūlabandhanaṃ manaso'pīndriyatvāt cakṣurādivadadhiṣṭhānasthiratvād hṛdayagranthiśabdavācyāt nijādhārādvighaṭitasandhibandhamivetyarthaḥ/ hṛdayaṃ antaḥkaraṇam/ kinna lakṣitaṃ dṛṣṭameva liṅgonneyatvānmanovṛttervaivarṇyarūpasya liṅgasya ca jhaṭiti sphuraṇādityarthaḥ/ kiñca me aparamapi smṛtam/ kiñca anyacca, vadāmīti śeṣaḥ, aparaṃ anyadapi vastu, smṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ vismṛtamidānīṃ pratibhātamityarthaḥ/ me smṛtamiti ``matibuddhipūjārthebhyaśca'' (3-2-18) iti matyarthatvād vartamāne ktaḥ, ``ktasya ca vartamāne'' (2-3-67) iti ṣaṣṭhī/
tadvivakṣitajñā praśnadvāreṇa tat prastāvayati svacikīrṣitānuguṇyāt - sakhi! kimidānīmaparam ṛ smṛtamityanuktiḥ tvarāṃ dyotayati/
smṛtamarthaṃ prakāśayati - yattasya mama jīvitapradāyino mahānubhāvasya cetanālambhapriyanivedikāyai mālatyai bhagavatyā vidagdhavacanopanyāsena coditena hṛdayaṃ ca jīvitaṃ ca mādhavena pāritoṣikatvena svayaṅgrāhe niyuktam/ tasyeti svarūpamādhuryaśauryadākṣiṇyādiviśiṣṭatayānubhavo vyajyate/ mama jīvitapradāyina iti prāṇadānātparasyopakārasyābhāvāt/ ``ekataḥ kratavaḥ sarve samāptavaradakṣiṇāḥ/
ekato bhayabhītasya prāṇinaḥ prāṇarakṣaṇam//'' iti vyāsastutasya prāṇadānasya karaṇāt paramopakāritvaṃ tasya, svasyāśca kṛtajñatayā tatpriyānveṣaṇaṃ taddarśanādiṣu autsukyaṃ ca dyotayati/ vyasanasamāgamasya kāmasūtroktasya ca sāphalyamanena prakāśayati kaviḥ/ mahānubhāvasya tādṛgvyālavyāpādanasamartho niratiśayaḥ prabhāvo yasyeti tatparākrame adbhutabuddhiḥ prakāśyate/ cetanetyādinā ``diṭṭhiā vaṭṭhasi paḍivaṇṇaceaṇo mahābhāā'' ityuktamanusmārayati/ bhagavatyā kāmandakyā vidagdhavacanopanyāsena agrāmyeṇa ``vatsa mādhava! diṣṭyā vardhito'si/ mālatyāḥ so'yamavasaraḥ prītidāyasya'' ityevaṃrūpeṇa vacanaprastāvena hetunā/ ``prāṇasamā tvayā sambhāvanīyā'' iti vacanasya bahujanasamakṣaṃ grāmyatvād, vicchittyā vyañjanasya ca camatkārakāritvādityarthaḥ/ coditena preritena, mādhavena svayaṅgrāhe svayameva balādgrahaṇe, niyuktam ``yadvyālavraṇitasuhṛtpramohamugdhami''tyādinā samarpitam/ atha lavaṅgike! tvayaiva bhaṇitaṃ ``pratīṣṭaḥ khalu me priyasakhyā ayaṃ prasādaḥ'' iti/ tvayaiveti yā tvamidānīṃ ``asambaddhalokapravādamohite'' iti māmadhikṣipasi, kupyasi, analpabāṣpajalajhalajhalīvicchilīkṛtakapolatalā mithyedamiti rodiṣi ca, sā tvameva tadānīmevamanuṣṭhitavatī la aho tava kaitavamiti vyañjayati/
atha makarandaviṣaye tasyāḥ prarūḍhaṃ premabandhamanusandhāya prastutavastuvismaraṇāyārthāntareṇa vyākṣipati - katamaḥ punaḥ sa mahānubhāvaḥ ṛ vismṛtaṃ mayā/ punaḥśabdo vyāvṛttau/ āstāṃ tāvadidaṃ vastvityarthaḥ/ saḥ yastvayā ``tassa mama jīvidappadāiṇo'' iti sūcitaḥ sa katamaḥ tatra bahavaḥ sthitāḥ la teṣāṃ madhye kaḥ sakhi! smara smara, tamityāyāti, upari yacchabdād la yena tasmin divase vikaṭaduṣṭaśārdūlāvapātagocaraṃ gatā aśaraṇā muhūrtasannihitena pīvarabhujastambhasambhāvitā niṣkāraṇabāndhavena sakalabhuvanaikasāranijadehopahārasāhasaṃ kṛtvā parirakṣitāsmi/ smara smareti vīpsayā tatrādaro dhvanyate/ tasmin divase kṛṣṇacaturdaśīdine/ vikaṭasya vistīrṇasya duṣṭaśārdūlāvapātasya tadutplavanasya gocaraṃ viṣayaḥ/ aśaraṇā hatavidrāvitaparijanatvād rakṣitṛrahitetyapratīkāratvaṃ dyotayati/ kṣaṇasannihiteneti pūrvasaṃstavābhāvaḥ khyāpyate/
``kaha vi tulaggaghaḍiāhi āgamasuddhaṃ''iti setau/ sa ca niṣkāraṇabāndhavahetuḥ/ pīvarābhyāṃ pīnābhyāṃ bhujastambhābhyāṃ vṛttotuṅgakaṭhināyatatvāt sthūṇākārābhyāṃ bāhubhyām, sambhāvitā madhye praviśya sadayamāśliṣya pṛṣṭhataḥ pratiṣṭhāpyānugṛhītā/ niṣkāraṇabāndhavena kāraṇaṃ pūrvopakārādikamantareṇa bandhutvamāśritavatā, ``kāryaṃ vinā bhavati yaḥ śaraṇaṃ sa bandhuḥ/''iti lakṣitatvāt/ sakalabhuvanaikasārasya sarveṣāṃ lokānāmekībhūtasya praśastāṃśasya, sarvaguṇasamudāyāśrayatvāt, nijasya dehasyeti paramapremāspadatvamāha, upahārasāhasaṃ vyāghrāyārpaṇarūpamavicāritakāritvamanuṣṭhāyetyarthaḥ/ prathamaṃ madarthaṃ śvāpadāya dehaḥ samarpitaḥ, prahāraścānubhūtaḥ, paścād daivato'yamujjīvitaḥ, sa ca hata iti tasya svasyāṃ kāruṇyavighnatāṃ dyotavati/ parirakṣitāsmīti/ ahaṃ tāvad rakṣitā la mayā tu mandabhāgyayā tadviṣaye na kiñcit priyamāceṣṭitamiti dainyaṃ vyajyate/ vidhṛtāśca vikaṭamāṃsalottānapariṇāhivakṣaḥsthalojjvalitajaraṭhajarjaritamuktālatāpīḍahāriṇā karuṇādhanena mama kṛte nimajjatsakalanakhanikāyavajrapañjaraprahārāḥ/ viḍhattā vidhṛtāḥ, ``kalaṅgasaṅghāḍī viḍhattā'' iti murāriḥ/ vikaṭaṃ kaṭhinaviṣamam/ ``vikaṭaṃ tu virūpaṃ syāt'' iti vaijayantī/
``vikaṭo'kṣarabandhaśca kṛtsnamekatra durlabham/''iti harṣacaritoktavat/ māṃsalaṃ pīnaṃ uttānamunnataṃ pariṇāhi viśālaṃ ca yadvakṣaḥsthalaṃ tasminnujjvalat sphurat jaraṭhaḥ ucitakālapākāvasthiraḥ prahārabalāt śakalībhūtaḥ muktālatāpīḍaḥ mauktikāvalīrūpā mālā, tāṃ dhartuṃ śīlaṃ yasya tena vā hāriṇā sundareṇa, [karuṇādhanena] karuṇā bhūtānukampaiva dhanaṃ sarvasvaṃ yasya/ karuṇādhanenetyanena pratyupakāranairapekṣyaṃ dhvanyate/ mama kṛte matkāryanimittam, ``kṛte kāniṣṭhineyasya jyaiṣṭhineyaṃ vivāsitam/''iti bhartṛkāvyaprayogāt/ āhativegād vakṣaḥsthale nimajjato'ntaḥpraviśataḥ sakalasya nakhanikāyarūpasya vajrapañjarasya niśitasya kaṭhinatayā kuliśasamūhasya prahārā āhananavraṇāḥ khuppanta nimajjat, ``paṅkakhuppantavaga ( ṛ) ailakkaïseṇṇaṃ'' iti setūkteḥ/ māritaśca sa duṣṭaśvāpadamahārākṣasaḥ/ śvāpadasya mahārākṣasatvāropaṇaṃ nirdayatvātiśayapratipādanārtham/ yena parirakṣitāsmi, vajrapañjaraprahārā vidhṛtāḥ, māritaśca śvāpadarākṣasaśtaṃ smareti sambandhaḥ/
smaraṇābhinayenāha - huṃ makarandaḥ ṛ ``āmantraṇe bhartsane huṃ'' iti vaijayantī/
punaḥśravaṇaśraddhayā pūrvoktāśravaṇamabhinayantī āha - sakhi! kiṃ bhaṇasi tadbhāvajñā punarāha - nanu bhaṇāmi makaranda iti/ nanviti tvayā kiṃ na śrutamityarthaḥ/
atha svābhimatamārgamavatīrṇāyāstasyā hṛdayaṃ prakāśayitumākāraviśeṣaṃ svayā dṛṣṭaṃ vivṛṇoti - sasmitamiti bhāvajñānaṃ sūcayati/ śarīramasyāḥ spṛśantīti priyatamanāmaśravaṇāt sapadi pulakitatvaṃ pratīyate/ saṃskṛtāśrayaṇaṃ niryantraṇopālambhakāryāya/
vayaṃ tathetyādi/ vayamiti mālatyādīnāṃ saṅgrahaḥ, tathā tatprakāraviśiṣṭāḥ, nāmeti prākāśye kutsane vā, tathā prasiddhāḥ kutsitā iti vārthaḥ la yathā yatprakāraviśiṣṭatayā, āttha tvaṃ bravīṣi/ bruvo laṭi āhādeśe, āhaḥ the ca, madhyamaikavacanasya rūpamidam/ pāṇigrahaṇamantareṇa puruṣāntarapraṇayavivaśatayā laṅghitamaryādāḥ kutsitā evetyarthaḥ/ kiṃ vadāmi tvayā pramāṇataḥ pratipādite'rthe'nyathābhāvaḥ kiṃ vaktuṃ śakyata ityarthaḥ/ athavā vakṣyamāṇasyārthasya pīṭhikābandhaḥ, ``sarvaḥ paradoṣanirīkṣaṇe pragalbhate/ svadoṣaṃ tu na vijānāti/ asminnarthe kiṃ vadāmī''ti/ athavā kimiti praśne/ ``mayopalakṣitamarthaṃ vadāmi kiṃ ṛ mayi manyuṃ mā kṛthāḥ'' ityarthaḥ/ turviśeṣe/ akasmāt kāraṇamantareṇa/
``tamālaśyāmalajñāne nirbādhe jāgrati sphuṭe/
dravyāntaraṃ tamaḥ kasmādakasmādupalabhyate//''iti citsukhācāryaprayogād, ``ākasmikatvaprasaṅgaḥ'' ityādiprayogācca/ vikalaḥ paravaśaḥ/ kathāntare mālatyupālambhanārthaṃ pravartitāyāḥ kathāyāḥ sallāpasya madhye, ityanenānuṣaṅgike tatprasaṅge taveyamavasthā mukhyeti kiṃ brūma iti dyotayati/ kadambagolākṛtiṃ nīpatarukuḍmalākāraṃ, bahalapulakatvāt, pulakānāṃ kadambamukulasāmyaprasiddheḥ/ golaśabdena piṇḍamātravācināpi kadambasannidhinā kuḍmalaṃ lakṣyate/ kathamityāścarye/ viśuddhamugdhaḥ anucitasthale rāgāpravṛtteḥ viśuddho nirdoṣaḥ mugdhaḥ śāṭhyamaśikṣitaḥ/ anena vayaṃ tvaviśuddhāḥ śaṭhāśceti vyatirekaṃ vyañjayati/ kulakanyakājanaḥ kulaparipālanaikavrataḥ kanyāvargaḥ/ svavargavyatiriktatvakhyāpanāya janagrahaṇam/ ayaṃ tu jano'nyaḥ, vayamanye ityarthaḥ/ atra tvamapi kasmiścidanurāgeṇa kadarthyamānā mithyaiva mālatīmupālipsase, ``yatrobhayoḥ samo doṣaḥ parihāro'pi vā samaḥ/
naikaḥ paryanuyoktavyastādṛgarthavicāraṇe//'' iti nyāyāditi viparītalakṣaṇayā vyajyate/ atra moṭṭāyitākhyo bhāvaviśeṣaḥ prakāśyate/
``moṭṭāyitaṃ tu tadbhāvabhāvaneṣṭakathādiṣu/''iti dhanikaḥ/ sūkṣmamalaṅkāraḥ, saṃlakṣitasūkṣmārthaprakāśanāt la aprastutapraśaṃsā ca, kāryamukhena kāraṇasya makarandānurāgasya pratīteḥ la nidarśanā ca, ākṛtisadṛśīmākṛtimityupamāparikalpanāt//1//
atha lajjayā svābhiprāyaṃ chādayati - sakhi! kasmānmāmupahasasi kuto hetormāmanyathā sambhāvyopālambhase/ na khalu cintito'rthaḥ pulakasvedakampādihetuḥ yenāhamupahāsya ityarthaḥ/ tarhi ko'nya ityatrāha - nanu bhaṇāmi udvejayati tādṛśasyātmanirapekṣavyavasāyinaḥ kṛtāntakabalīkriyamāṇajīvitabalātkārapratyānayanagurūpakāriṇo janasya saṅkathā nāmagrahaṇamapīti/ udvejayati bhāyayati/ ``āvijī bhayacalanayoḥ'' iti dhātuḥ/ bhayagrahaṇāt tatkāryatvenāpi pulakādīnāmupapattiḥ samarthyate/ tādṛśasyeti tṛṇīkṛtaśārdūlavikramatvamāha - ātmanirapekṣavyavasāyinaḥ svaśarīrāpāyaśaṅkārahitaniścayasya/ kṛtāntena yamena la kṛtāntatayā vyāghro'dhyavasīyate, saṃhartṛtvāt/ athavā taddvāreṇāpi yamasyaiva saṃhartṛtvāt sa evocyate/ kabalikriyamāṇasya grasyamāṇasya, na tu kabalīkariṣyamāṇasyetyavasarasannidhāyitvaṃ dyotyate/ jīvitasya balātkārataḥ pratyānayanena/ ``anyajanmakṛtaṃ karma daivaṃ pauruṣamaihikam/
vibhakte karmaṇi tredhā śreṣṭhamadhyādhamatvataḥ//''
``daivaṃ puruṣakāreṇa durbalaṃ hyupahanyate/
tathā daivena balinā pauruṣaṃ karma durbalam//'' iti saṅgrahokteḥ, ``bali puruṣakāro hi daivamapyativartate/''iti vacanāt niścitamapi maraṇaṃ puruṣakārasāmarthyena nivartitamityarthaḥ/ gurūpakāriṇaḥ paramānugrahaśīlasya, janasyeti tāṭasthyenoktiḥ, svapraṇayasaṃvaraṇārthā saṅkathā vṛttāntakathanaṃ, nāmagrahaṇaṃ nāmākṣarakīrtanam/ nāmagrahaṇamapīti paścāduktiḥ saṅkathā tāvadāstāṃ, nāmākṣarameva śrutamudvejayatīti dyotayitum/ atra vyājoktiralaṅkāraḥ, udbhinnavastunigūhanāt/
ātmanirapekṣavyavasāyatvādikameva saṃvādayati - tathā tvayāpi gāḍhanakharaprahāravedanālaṃbhavismāritaśarīrasaṅgaḥ saṅkalitamohamīlannetranīlotpalayugalobhūmivilasitāsiyaṣṭiniṣṭambhadhīradhāritaśarīrasāraḥ pratyakṣīkṛta eva madayantikānimittamātraviccharditamahāmahārghajīvaloko mahābhāgaḥ/ tathā maduktena prakāreṇa gāḍhānāmurasi magnānāṃ nakharāṇāṃ prahāreṇāghātena yā vedanā tīvrā rujā tasyālambhena prāptyā vismāritaḥ pramoṣitaḥ śarīrasaṅgo ahambhāvo yasya saṅkalitena vedanājanitena mohena mūrcchayā nimīlannayanakuvalayadvayaṃ yasya/ bhūmivilasitāyāḥ kṣititalanimagnāgrāyāḥ asiyaṣṭeḥ khaḍgapaṭṭikāyā niṣṭambhenāvalambena dhīraṃ niścalaṃ dhāritaḥ śarīrasāro dehabalaṃ dehaśreṣṭho vā yasya/ madayantikānimittamiti kṛtajñatāṃ svasyā laghīyastvaṃ ca dyotayati/ viccharditamahāmahārghajīvalākeḥ viccharditaḥ parityaktaḥ atiśayena mahārghaḥviśiṣṭajātyāyurbhogalakṣaṇapuṇyaphalānubhavasādhanatvād bahumūlyaḥ/ mahārghaśabdasya tathaiva rūḍhatvāt mahāśabdena samāsaḥ/ athavā mahānmaha utsavaḥ arghaḥ pūjā ca yasminnityarghaḥ/ ``maha uddhava utsavaḥ'' ityamaraḥ, ``aghag pūjāpratikriyau'' iti vaijayantī/ jīvalokaḥ jīvānāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ lokaḥ, bhāratavarṣamityarthaḥ, tasya svargato'bhyarhitatvāt/ ``gāyanti devāḥ kila gītakāni dhanyāstu ye bhāratabhūmibhāge/
svargāpavargāspadamārgabhūte bhavanti bhūyaḥ puruṣāḥ suratvāt//'' ityādivacanaiḥ, tatrāpi lokottarajñānaiśvaryarūpasaubhāgyādiguṇagaṇavareṇyasya brāhmaṇasyāgaṇyajanmāntarasañcitapuṇyaviśeṣajanyatvāt tadeva matprāṇatṛṇaparitrāṇāya tena tṛṇāyāpi na matamiti upakāragauravaṃ dyotayati/ ``brāhmaṇo jāyamāno hi pṛthivyāmadhijāyate/
īśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ dharmakośasya guptaye//'' ityādimanuvacanāt/
svedādīn ādiśabdena stambhakatvādayaḥ sāttvikā gṛhyante/ nāṭayatīti bhayahetutvena vyapadiṣṭatvānniśśaṅkamabhinayatītyarthaḥ/
atha tadabhiprāyāvagamanāya suhṛdbhāvena tāmupāyataḥ prerayati - asvasthaśarīre priyasakhi! udbhinnā smaḥ sahavāsinyā mālatyāḥ/ asvasthaṃ kṛśatvapāṇḍutvādiyogādidānīṃ svabhāve nāvasthitaṃ śarīraṃ yasyā ityāmantraṇena śarīrāvasthayaiva sarvaṃ prakāśyate, kimiti vṛthā saṃvaraṇavyasanamanubhūyata iti dyotayati/ udbhinnā smaḥ prakāśitarahasyā bhavāmaḥ/ ``ayaṃ tvakasmā''ditvādivācoyuktibhirityarthaḥ/ sahavāsinyā saha vastuṃ śīlaṃ yasyāḥ/ mālatyāḥ sahavāsinyetyanena mālatyāmeva manmathonmāthaprakārasya śikṣitatvādanyatrāpi talliṅgaistadūhanasāmarthyaṃ prakāśyate/
``udbhinnā smaḥ'' ityukterlabdhaprasarā svasāntvanasyābhedaṃ prayuṅkte - sakhi madayantike! vayamapi jñātavyaṃ jānīmaḥ/ vayamapīti yathā buddharakṣitā tathā vayamapi premavisrambhabhūmitvāt tava vṛttāntamavaśyaṃ jñeyaṃ viśeṣato jānīmaḥ, sāmānyato jñātatvāt/ tat prasīda/ virama vyapadeśāt/ tat tasmād, yato vayaṃ jijñāsavaḥ, kathanenānugrahaṃ kuru/ vyapadeśāt bhayādivyājokteḥ virama nivartasva/ ehi āgaccheti lokoktyanusāraḥ, pratikūlamārgādito'nukūle vartmani samāgaccheti yāvat/ visrambhagarbhitakathāḥ saviśeṣasukhaṃ tiṣṭhāmaḥ/ visrambhagarbhitayā antargataviśvāsayā kathayā sallāpena saviśeṣasukhaṃ tvaddarśanādeva sukhasya vidyamānatvāt tato'dhikasukhaṃ yathā tathā, tiṣṭhāmaḥ vartāmahe/ ``mitrasyāvañcanaṃ rasaḥ'' ityukteriti bhāvaḥ/
taduktimupodbalayati - sakhi! śobhanaṃ lavaṅgikayā bhaṇitam/
mugdhatayā tadabhiprāyapatitā āha - vidheyāsmi sāmprataṃ priyasakhyoḥ/ vidheyā vaśavartinī, ``puravijayī karuṇāvidheyacetāḥ'' itivat/
atha tanmukhāravindaniṣyanditena praṇayavacanamakarandena makarandendīvaramānandayituṃ dvāramāracayati - yadyevaṃ tatkathaya kathaṃ nu te kālo gacchatīti/ yadyevamiti asmākaṃ vidheyāsi cedityarthaḥ/ tat tasmāt, kathaya vañcanaṃ mā kṛthā iti bhāvaḥ/ nuḥ praśnadyotakamavyayam/ ``praśne vikalpe nuḥ svicca'' iti vaijayantī/ kathaṃ kena prakāreṇa te rātrindivamatikrāmatīti pṛchyase, utkaṇṭhāduḥkhāvakuṇṭhitacittatbāditi yāvat/
atha bhaṅgyā kālakṣepaprakāramāha - niśamaya priyasakhi! śṛṇvityarthaḥ/ mama hi buddharakṣitāpakṣapātapratyayena prathamameva tasmin jane aviralotkaṇṭhāmanorathaṃ hṛdayamāsīt/ buddharakṣitāyāḥ pakṣapātena snehena yaḥ pratyayaḥ tadguṇeṣu viśvāsaḥ tena, prathamameva darśanāt prāgeva aviralayā nirantarayā utkaṇṭhayā prāptyāśayā manorathaḥ saṅkalpasantāno yasminnityanena ``asandṛṣṭākārayorasaṃskṛtayorapi dūtīpratyayāt'' iti vātsyāyananītyuktaṃ nidarśitamiti veditavyam/ tato vidhiniyogadurvṛttadarśanā ca durvāradāruṇāyāsasaṅgaduḥkhasantāpadahyamānacittavighaṭamānajīvitāśaṃsāvijṛmbhitāpūrvasarvāṅgasaṅkalitamadanahutavahoddāmadāhadussahāyāsadurmanāyamānaparijanā pratyāśāmokṣamātrasulabhamṛtyunirvāṇapratikūlabuddharakṣitāvacanavardhitāvaśavyatikaravisaṃsthulā imaṃ jīvalokaparivartamanubhavāmi/ vidherniyogena īśvarasyājñayā sampāditaṃ arthāt tasya darśanaṃ yasyāḥ, śārdūlāvaskandasamaye yadṛcchayopanatatvāt/ durvāradāruṇāyāsena niṣpratīkārakrūraśarīrābhighātena saṅgaduḥkhasantāpena snehaduḥkhajvareṇa dahyamānahṛdayatayā viśliṣyantī prāṇadhāraṇaprārthanā yasyāḥ/ saṅgaduḥkhetyālambanavibhāvasampaduktā/ vijṛmbhitena pūrvasmādadhikaṃ prasṛteneti stambhakampādyanubhāvaglānyādivyabhicārapoṣa uktaḥ/ apūrveṇa ananubhūtapūrveṇetyanabhyāsādasahyavegatvaṃ prakāśyate/ sarvāṅgasaṅkalitena sakalaśarīravyāptena madanahutavahoddāmadāhena dussaho ya āyāsaḥ kusumaśayanatalaviveṣṭanotthānaparyaṭananiṣadanādikaṃ kṣaṇe kṣaṇe śarīrakleśaḥ tena durmanāyamānaḥ viṣīdat parijano yasyāḥ/ pratyāśā kālena prāpsyata iti buddhiḥ, tanmokṣamātre tasyāḥ khaṇḍana eva sulabhasya akṛcchreṇa prāpyasya, pratyāśayaiva prāṇānāṃ dhāryamāṇatvāt, mṛtyunirvāṇasya maraṇasukhasya pratikūlena virodhinā buddharakṣitāyā vacanena, evaṃ kṛte evaṃ bhaviṣyati, adya bhaviṣyati, śvo vā bhaviṣyatīti pratyāśājanakenetyarthād, vardhitasyāveśasya tadviṣayanirbandhasya vyatikareṇa miśraṇena la ``ataḥ parataraṃ nānyanmamāstīti tvarānvitā/
ekāgrā mānasī vṛttirāveśa iti kīrtitaḥ//'' iti divākaraḥ la visaṃsthulā cañcalā anyatarakoṭiparigrahāsamarthā ityarthaḥ/ imaṃ idānīmapyanubhūyamānaṃ jīvalokaparivartaṃ martyalokasya pūrvāvasthāto'nyathābhāvam/ ``yāni sma ramaṇīyāni tayā saha bhavanti me/
tānyevāramaṇīyāni jāyante me tayā vinā//'' iti rāmāyaṇoktaprakāramanubhavāmītyarthaḥ/
saṅkalpasvapnayośca manorathonmādamohitā paśyāmi taṃ janam/ saṅkalpe dhyāne svapnāvasthāyāṃ ca, manorathonmādamohitā tamevamāliṅgāmi, evaṃ cumbāmi, tena saha evaṃ praṇayakupitā vartiṣya ityādirūpā cintaiva unmādo bhrāntiḥ aparamārthatayā tena vicittīkṛteti paśyāmītyatra hetuḥ/ sākṣātkārabuddhimeva dyotayituṃ paśyāmītyuktiḥ/ darśanaprakāramevopapādayati - tathā priyasakhi! muhūrtamudūḍhavismayaviśṛṅkhalodvelladvistīryamāṇaraktanetrapuṇḍarīkatvavibhāvitodvegaḍāmaraprarūḍhamaireyadarpaṃ nidhyāyāmi/ tatheti tathābhāvaḥ śrūyatāmityarthaḥ/ muhūrtaṃ kañcitkālaṃ udūḍho vismayo yena, anena stimitatvamuktam, viśṛṅkhalodvellat niravagrahacapalaṃ vistīryamāṇaṃ vikasad raktaṃ aruṇaṃ netrapuṇḍarīkaṃ yasya, tadbhāvastathāvidhanetrapuṇḍarīkatvam/ anena bahubhāvabhaṅgitaraṅgitatvaṃ vyajyate/ ata āha - tena vibhāvitaḥ prakāśita udvegaḥ udbhūto madavegaḥ, tena ḍāmaraḥ bhayaṅkaraḥ, prarūḍhaḥ samagraḥ, svakāryakaraṇād draḍhībhūtaḥ, maireyadarpaḥ madhupānajanito vikāraviśeṣo yasya, ``prītinirvṛtinighnānāmarāgaviṣaye'pi yaḥ/
pravṛttiṃ kurute bhāvaḥ puṃsāṃ darpaḥ sa ucyate//'' iti divākaraḥ/ maireyadarpagrahaṇaṃ svapne maireyapānadarśanasya bhaviṣyanmaṅgalasūcakatvāt/ ``pauṣkare svarṇapātre vā ghṛtapāyasabhojanam/
dadhikṣīrāśanaṃ pānaṃ maireyasyāmṛtasya vā//'' iti śubhasvapnādhikāre gurudevaḥ/ rāgiṇyā guṇadoṣavicāramūḍhayā svasambhogānuguṇyena saṅkalpāt, saṅkalpe'pi maireyagrahaṇopapattirna tu tasya dvijaśreṣṭhasya tācchīlyāt, ``surā vai malamannānāṃ pāpmā ca malamucyate/
tasmād brāhmaṇarājanyau vaiśyaśca na pibet surām//'' iti dvijāderniṣedhāt/ nidhyāyāmi paśyāmi/ ``nidhyānamavalokanam'' iti vaijayantī/
kiṃ ca kabalitāravindakesarakaṣāyakaṇṭhakalahaṃsaghoṣaghargharaskhalitagambhīrabhāratībharitakarṇavivaraṃ ``priye madayantike'' iti vyāharati/ āsvāditaiḥ kamalakiñjalkaiḥ kaṣāyakaṇṭhasya tu vararasaprasāditakaṇṭhanālasya, aravindakesarāṇāṃ kaṣāyarasatvāt/ tathā kaṣāyadravyaskandhe padmāpadmakapadmapuṣpanāgakesare''tyādinā saṅgrahe gaṇitatvāt, ``tatrādyā mārutaṃ ghnanti trayastiktādayaḥ kapham/''iti tiktakaṭukaṣāyāṇāṃ vaidyake kaphaharatvavacanāt, ``cūtāṅkurāsvādakaṣāyakaṇṭhaḥ'' iti kumārasambhave prayogācca/ kalahaṃsasya haṃsaviśeṣasya ghoṣavad ghargharā aspaṣṭā skhalitā madhye madhye niruddhanirgamā/ ghargharātvaṃ skhalitatvaṃ ca maireyavikārāt/ gambhīranirhradinī mahāpuruṣasambandhitvāt, ``trigambhīraḥ ṣaḍunnataḥ'' iti sāmudrikavacanāt, bhāratī vāk tayā bharitaṃ pūritaṃ karṇavivaraṃ śravaṇarandhraṃ yathā bhavati tathā, vyāharati kathayati/ atha vyāharan kopodvṛttottarīyāñcalāvalambanaparābhavasamuttaraṅganiśvāsadhamadhamāyamānahṛdayā samuttrāsayati/ kopena kaumāradūṣaṇopakramajanitenāgamanavilambahetukena vā udvṛttāṃ parāvṛttāṃ, tadānīmuttarīyāñcalāvalambarūpeṇa paribhaveṇa, kulakumārījanasya stanāṃśukākarṣaṇānaucityāt, samuttaraṅgairuparyupari pravarttamānaiḥ niśvāsaiḥ, dhamadhameti vepamānaprakārānukaraṇaṃ dhamadhamāyamānaṃ hṛdayaṃ yasyāḥ/ samuttrāsayati yadi mama pratikūlaṃ vartase tato nakhavilekhadantakṣatādibhirdūṣayitvā sakhībhyo darśayiṣyāmīti bhīṣayatītyarthaḥ/ ``apratipadyamānāṃ ca bhīṣayet/ ahaṃ tava dantapadamadhare kariṣyāmi, stanapṛṣṭhe vā nakhapadam/'' ityādivātsyāyanavacanāt/
sahasā visṛṣṭasukhāpasṛtāṃ tatkṣaṇakaṭhorakomalārdrībhavadbāhubandhanāpavāritapayodharodgamāṃ vighaṭamānamekhalāvalayasandānyamānavyāpṛtorupratiṣiddhavipratīpagamanāṃ pratikūlavinihitasarvākāraprayatnanirvarttitamuhūrtakopoparāgaduḥkhaparuṣīkṛtahṛdayāṃ snigdhapunaruktapakṣmalalocanavibhāvitāśeṣacittasārāṃ upahasya dviguṇabāhudaṇḍāveṣṭaniśceṣṭanivartitāṃ priyasakhi! prarūḍhaśārdūlakararuhavajravikaṭapatrāvalīprasādhanottānavakṣaḥsthalaniṣṭhuraniveśanissahāṃ kṛtvā sāvegavidhutamastakāviddhakabarīvinihitakaraparigrahābhibhūtonnamitaniścalamukhāvayavasvacchandavilāsitavidagdhavadanakamalo vāmakapolamūlaciranihitavisphuratpuñjitādharasamudgamanoharasparśanirbharapulakitaśarīraśobhāṃ ullasitasādhvasānandaviṣamasambhramavalanamohamantharadghūrṇamānacetanāṃ, kimapi kimapi durvinītasāhasānurūpavyavasāyo māmabhyarthayate nāmeti/ sahaseti atyantoparodho mā bhūditi, [visṛṣṭāṃ] visarjitāṃ, vimuktottarīyāmiti yāvat, sukhena śīghraṃ parato'pasṛtāṃ dhāvitāṃ, tatkṣaṇe tadīyasparśasamaye kaṭhorayoḥ kaṇṭakitatvena karkaśayoḥ komalayoḥ mṛdutayā avasannayoḥ ārdrībhavatoḥ svinnayoḥ - ``taṇṇāā'' ārdra, ``mahutaṇṇāpasarantaṇavakusumarāa'' itivat - bāhvorbandhanena svastikabandhena apavāritaḥ chādito haṭhāśleṣabhayena payodharodgamaḥ stanamukulaṃ yayā/ vighaṭamānena vigalatā mekhalāvalayena vṛttākāreṇa kāñcīpāśena sandānyamānābhyāṃ badhyamānābhyāṃ vyāpṛtābhyāṃ gamanāya pravartamānābhyāṃ, athavā bhāvacihnena sphuritābhyāṃ ūrubhyāṃ pratiṣiddhaṃ nivāritaṃ vipratīpagamanaṃ parāṅmukhagamanaṃ yasyāḥ/ pratikūlavinihitaṃ tadabhilaṣitaviruddhatayā kṛtaṃ, na tu pratikūlatayā sthitamiti tathātvasya balānnāṭitatvaṃ dhvanyate, sarvaprakāraprayatnanirvartitena prayatnaviracitabhrūkuṭībhīṣaṇatvādiprakāśitena muhūrtakopoparāgeṇa kṣaṇamātrakoparañcitatvena duḥkhaparuṣīkṛtaṃ kṛcchrādvikṛtaṃ kṛtaṃ hṛdayaṃ yayā/ snigdhābhyāṃ snehaguṇaviśiṣṭābhyāṃ punaruktapakṣmalābhyāṃ pūrvasāndrābhyāṃ tadālokanakutūhalād dviguṇapakṣmalābhyāṃ locanābhyāṃ vibhāvitaḥ tasmai prakāśitaḥ aśeṣaḥ samagraḥ cittasāro manaso'nurāgarūpaḥ sāro yasyāḥ la athavā cittasya sāro balamiti viparītalakṣaṇayā etāvadasyā hṛdayasya balaṃ na kiñciditi karṇejapābhyāṃ locanābhyāṃ kathitamityarthaḥ la athavā bahirnāṭita eva kopo na hṛdayapūrvakaḥ, tasmāt svairamabhiyujyatāmiti prerita ivetyarthaḥ/ kuṭṭamitākhyo bhāvo'tra sūcitaḥ/
``rasānandāt kuṭṭamite kupyet keśādharagrahe/''iti dhanikaḥ/ upahasya madbhāvaparijñānādvihasyetyarthaḥ/ prarūḍhā kiṇībhūtā [śārdūlakararuhavajrāṇāṃ] śārdūlanakhakuliśānāṃ vikaṭā viśālā yā patrāvalī vraṇarekhāvinyāsaviśeṣaḥ saiva prasādhanaṃ vibhūṣaṇaṃ yasya, tasmin uttāne vistārite vakṣaḥsthale niṣṭhuraniveśanena nirdayanivasanena, nissahāṃ niṣpandāṃ kṛtvā, sāvegaṃ sakrodhaṃ vidhutena mastakena śirasā viddhāyāṃ galitabandhatayā patitāyāṃ kabaryāṃ keśapāśe vinihitasya karasya parigraheṇa dṛḍhasaṅgraheṇa abhibhūtasya unnamitasya mukhasya - ``āaggia'' abhibhūta, ``āaggaïtuhmajaso'' iti setūktaprayogāt - avayaveṣu ekadeśeṣu, lalāṭanayanakapoloṣṭhāntarmukheṣvityarthaḥ, svacchandavilāsitaṃ svecchayā vyāpāritaṃ, nivārakābhāvāt/ vidagdhaṃ nimitakasphuritakaghaṭṭitakeṣu kanyācumbaneṣu śikṣitamityarthaḥ, [vadanakamalo] mukhapadmaṃ yasya/ ``balātkāreṇa niyuktā mukhe mukhamādhatte na viceṣṭate tannimitakam'' ityādi kāmasūtrakramasyātra yojanaṃ veditavyam/ vāmakapolamūle ciranihitasya visphurataḥ puñjitasya kuḍmalitasya adharasamudgasya āṣṭhasampuṭasya manohareṇa sparśena [pulakitā] romāñcitā śarīraśobhā yasyāḥ la ``ucchūnakaṃ pravālamaṇiśca kapole karṇapūravaccumbanaṃ daśanacchedyamiti savyakapolamaṇḍanāni'' iti vacanāt la vāmakapolagrahaṇaṃ strīṇāṃ vāmabhāgasya kāmakalādhiṣṭhānatvācca/ ``dantoṣṭhasaṃyogābhyāsaniṣpādanāt pravālamaṇeḥ siddhiḥ, tadeva pīḍanāducchūnakaṃ'' iti vacanāttadarthaṃ visphuratpuñjitādharetyādyuktiḥ/ ullasitena udbhūtena sādhvasena kanyātvajanitena kampena ānandena priyasamāgamahetukena paramasukhena ca viṣamo bahuvidhaḥ sambhramo vyākulatvaṃ tena yo mohaḥ kartavyāparijñānaṃ tena mantharaṃ mandaṃ [ghūrṇamānā] bhramantī cetanā buddhiryasyāḥ/ kimapīti anucitatvādavyapadeśatvaṃ vīpsayā bahuvidhatvaṃ ca dyotyate la svamanorathānurūpānāliṅganacumbanaviśeṣān sambhogaviśeṣāṃścetyarthaḥ/ tatra hetumāha - durvinītasāhasānurūpavyavasāya iti/ durvinītānāmavivekināṃ yat sāhasamavicāritānuṣṭhānaṃ tadanurūpaḥ tatsadṛśo vyavasāyo niścayo yasyeti madānukūlyamantareṇāpi svayameva svābhilaṣite'sau pravartata iti dyotayati/ abhyarthayate nāmeti abhyarthanasya viḍambanatvānnāmaśabdena krodhopagamaḥ kutsanaṃ vā vyajyate iti/
priyasakhīsamakṣaṃ sarvamanubhūya jhaṭiti śūnyāraṇyasannibhaṃ punarapi mandabhāginī vibhāvayāmi jīvalokamiti/ [itiḥ] prakāre, ekaḥ prakāraḥ kathitaḥ, anye'pi prakārabhedāḥ kṣaṇe kṣaṇe anubhūyanta ityarthaḥ/ priyasakhīsamakṣaṃ buddharakṣitādīnāṃ sannidhāviti svapnasaṅkalpayoraniyatakālabhāvitvamāha, sarvaṃ vṛttāntam, [anubhūya] sākṣātkṛtya, jhaṭiti, tanmadhye prabodhavyākṣepayoḥ sambhavādatṛptatvaṃ prakāśyate, śūnyāraṇyasannibhaṃ nirjanavanasādṛśyādudvegakaraṃ, punarapīti pūrvaṃ prabuddhāvasthāyā duḥkhahetutvāt saivāvasthā punarapyanubhūyata iti pratīyate, mandabhāginīti svabhāgyaṃ pratyasūyā, vibhāvayāmi paśyāmi, jīvalokaṃ martyalokamiti dainyaṃ ca vyajyate/
atha tāṃ tasminnarthe sthirayituṃ grāmyamapyagrāmyaparihāsatvena pṛcchati - sakhi madayantike! sphuṭamācakṣva - api tasminnavasare savibhramamīṣaddhāsavikasadbuddharakṣitāvilocananirūpitaṃ parijanato'pi gopanīyaṃ te āsanamasūrakaṃ śayanīyapracchadapaṭo vā bhavati kiṃ na veti/ apiḥ praśne, tasminnavasare svapnasaṅkalpasamāgamasamaye, savibhramaṃ savilāsamiti parijanāparijñānāya vyājaprayogaḥ, īṣaddhāsena mandahāsena vikasadbhyāṃ buddharakṣitāvilocanābhyāṃ nirūpitaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ, parijanādapi rakṣaṇīyaṃ, rahasyabhedabhayād, āsanamasūrakaṃ āsikārdhaṃ masūrabījavad vṛttottuṅgamasṛṇaṃ paṭṭopadhānam - ``nātidūre bhūmau vṛttāstaraṇamasūrakaṃ ākarṣaphalakaṃ dyūtaphalakaṃ ca'' iti vātsyāyanavacanāt, ``masūrakopadhānāni'' iti harṣacaritokteśca - śayanīyapracchadapaṭaḥ śayanatūlītalāstaraṇavastraṃ, veti vikalpane, āsanaśayanayoraniyamāt/ api bhavati kiṃ vā na bhavatītyācakṣvetyanvayaḥ/
sāsūyamāha - ayi aśliṣṭaparihāsaśīle! apehi anucitanarmaśīle! parato'pasareti/
tasyā vailakṣyamapanayati - sakhi madayantike! mālatīpriyasakhī iyameva īdṛśāni jānāti/ mālatyā madanavedanāsākṣiṇītvādiyaṃ lavaṅgikā/ evakāreṇa na tu vayamiti vyatireko dhvanyate/ īdṛśāni vastūni grāmyāṇītyarthaḥ/
mālatīśravaṇabhayādāha - mā khalvevaṃ mālatīmupahasa/ evamityavinayadyotanena tadupahāso mama na priya iti bhāvaḥ/
suhṛdbhāvena tāṃ lavaṅgikāsākṣikaṃ svābhimate vastunyavatārayitumupāyaṃ prayuṅkte - sakhi madayantike! prakṣyāmīdānīṃ kimapi yadi na me viśvāsabhaṅgaṃ karoṣi/ viśvāsasya visrambhasya bhaṅgaṃ vighātaṃ paramārthākathanād yadi na karoṣi/
visrambhaṃ vyatirekamukhena draḍhayati - kiṃ puro'pi praṇayabhaṅgena kṛtāparādho'yaṃ janaḥ yenaivaṃ mantrayasi/ puraḥ pūrvamapi, praṇayabhaṅgena yāñcāyā vighātena kṛtāparādhaḥ kiṃ evamiti yadi karoṣīti yadyarthagarbhaṃ mantrayasi kathayasi yasmād, ato'yaṃ janaḥ kṛtāparādhaḥ kimiti sambandhaḥ/ visrambhe upapattimāha - priyasakhi! tvaṃ lavaṅgikā ca sāmprataṃ me hṛdayam/ sāmpratamidānīmiti mālatīsambandhenāsmadgṛhamanupraviṣṭā yadā tadaiva tvamiva lavaṅgikāpi me hṛdayavadviśvāsyeti tātparyam/ adagdhadahananyāyena buddharakṣitāyāstu pūrvameva viśvāsyatāyāḥ sampratipatterlavaṅgikāyā viśvāsyatvasyaiva vidheyatvād, yāvadaprāptaṃ tāvata eva pratipādyatvāt/
punardraḍhīkārapurassaraṃ svābhimataṃ bhaṅgyā sūcayantī tasyā hṛdayaṃ prakāśayati - yadyevaṃ tatkathaya/ yadi te kathamapi makarandaḥ punarapi darśanapathamavatarati, tataḥ kiṃ tvayā kartavyam/ kathamapi asmatprayatnādityarthaḥ/ kartavyaṃ kariṣyata ityarthaḥ/
kartavyamāha - ekaikāvayavaniṣaṅganiścale ciraṃ locane nirvāpayiṣyāmi/ mukhādyaṅgeṣu tasya pratyekaṃ niṣaṅgeṇa nitarāṃ bandhena niścale viṣayāntaramanavagāhamāne nirvāpayiṣyāmi candrādidāhakadravyadarśanataptatvādamṛtasarasīva nimajya śītalīkariṣyāmītyarthaḥ/
atha parvakrameṇa tasya svayaṅgrāhamudghaṭṭayantī tatrānukūlayati anudvegāya - atha sa manmathabalātkāritaḥ kandarpajananīṃ tvāṃ rukmiṇīmiva puruṣottamaḥ svayaṅgrāheṇa sahadharmacāriṇīṃ karoti, kā tataḥ pratipattiḥ/ atheti pakṣavyāvṛttau/ taddarśane tava pravṛttirāstāṃ tāvat/ sa punaḥ [manmathabalātkāritaḥ] kāmena haṭhāt preritaḥ/ tatra hetuḥ - kandarpajananīṃ kāmasya hetubhūtāmiti tava darśane kasya sacetasaḥ smaraśarajvarajvalanajvālā jhaṭiti na prasaratīti cāṭubhistāṃ vaśayati la kandarpasya pradyumnasya jananīṃ mātaramiti ca/ rukmiṇīdevīṃ vidarbharājasya bhīṣmakasya putrīṃ puruṣottamo bhagavān vāsudevaḥ, upamānenābhijanādiguṇasāmagryādanyonyānurūpyādaśeṣabhuvanaślāghanīyasambandhatvaṃ dyotayati, svayaṅgrāheṇa pitrādyanumatimantareṇa svayameva pāṇigrahaṇasāhasena, bhagavatāpi rukmiṇyā gāndharvānugṛhītarākṣasavivāhenoḍhatvāt, sahadharmacāriṇīṃ dharmapatnīṃ karotīti kākvā yadyartho labhyate, tataḥ anantaraṃ pratipattiḥ pravṛttiḥ kā, tavetyarthāt/
tāvataḥ sukṛtasyātmanyasambhāvyatvamālocyāha - niśvasyeti bhāgyābhāvaśaṅkājanitāvegasūcakaṃ dīrghocchvāsaṃ muktvetyarthaḥ/ kasmāttvayā etāvadāśāsitāsmi/ kasmāt kena hetunā/ etāvat svayaṅgrāha iti yat, etatparimāṇaṃ sukṛtamiti śeṣaḥ/ āśāsitā sambhāvitā/
tayā nigadenaivālapayitatumāha - sakhi kathayeti/
kiṃ vācā kariṣyate/ bhāvastāvat parijñātaḥ/ evaṃ bhaṅgyantareṇetyāha - sakhi! kathitameva hṛdayāvegasūcakairdīrghaniḥśvāsairiti/ āvego naitāvanmama bhāgyamiti, atastadanuvāde kiṃ vicāryata ityarthaḥ/
