tasyāḥ saṃśayaṃ nigadena nirasyati - sakhi! kā ahamasya tenaivātmānaṃ paṇīkṛtya mṛtyukabalanāt kṛṣṭasya tasyaiva svabhūtasya [kerakasya] - kerakaśabdaḥ prākṛte samasto'samasto'pi tadīyamāha, ``parakeraehiṃ tassa keraeā'' ityādiprayogadarśanāt - ātmanaḥ śarīrakasya/ kā kiṃśabdaḥ sambandhamāha, kīdṛśasambandhaviśiṣṭetyarthaḥ/ asyetyabhinayena kṣullakatvamāha/ svasvāmibhāvassambandho'smin vidyata ityāśaṅkya pariharati - tenaivetyevakāraḥ sambandhaprasaṅgaṃ vyāvartayati/ ātmānaṃ svaśarīraṃ paṇīkṛtya mūlyaṃ kṛtveti tasya gauravamāha/ mṛtyukabalanāt mṛtyorvyāghrarūpasya yamasya bhakṣaṇāt kṛṣṭasya balādapahṛtasya tasyaiva svabhūtasyeti na khalu loke ratnādibhirutkṛṣṭairdravyaiḥ kenacit krītaṃ ghaṭapaṭādi vikretussvaṃ kadācid bhavatīti bhāvaḥ/ ātmanaḥ mama śarīrakasya kutsitasthā[syā]lpasyānukampanīyasya vā dehasya/
sthairyāya taduktiṃ camatkaroti - sadṛśaṃ mahānubhāvatāyāḥ/ abhijanādiguṇaviśiṣṭatāyāḥ anurūpam, idaṃ vacanamiti śeṣaḥ, guṇapakṣapātaḥ kṛtajñatā ca yena dyotyate tadvacanamityarthaḥ/
avasare smārayituṃ taduktaṃ sākṣisannidhau draḍhayati, paścāllajjayā visaṃvādasya sambhāvyatvāt - sakhi! smara etat idānīṃ tvayoktam/
atha vivakṣitasaṃvidhānāya kathāvicchede tasyāḥprasthānaṃ sūcayati kaviḥ - kathaṃ dvitīyanāḍikāvicchedapaṭupaṭahastāḍyate/ rātrerdvitīyasyā nāḍikāyā virāmasūcakaḥ paṭuḥ spaṣṭaśabdaḥ paṭaha ānakastāḍyate, tadvādakenetyarthāt, rājamandireṣu nāḍikāvicchedajñānāya tathācaraṇāt/ tadidānīṃ nandanaṃ nirbhartsya sapādapatanaṃ vābhyarthya mālatyā uparyanukūlayiṣyāmi/ tat pradoṣasya prauḍhatvāt nirbhartsya tvayā tadabhiprāyamajānatā kadarthitā mama priyasakhī mālatīti tarjayitvā, athavā trapāparavaśatayā tayā kṛtamaparādhaṃ madarthe kṣamasveti praṇāmapurassaramanunīya mālatyā upari mālatīviṣaye anukūlayiṣyāmi anukūlaṃ kariṣyāmi/
mukhamutpāṭya avakuṇṭhanāṃśukāpanayanena prakāśyetyarthaḥ/ udghāṭyetyapi pāṭhe sa evārthaḥ/ haste gṛhṇāti karatale salīlaṃ gṛhṇāti, madayantikāmityarthāt/
mālatībuddhyā eva pṛcchati - sakhi mālati! kiṃ prabuddhāsi vigatanidrāsi/
vilokya sphuṭaṃ nirīkṣya, saharṣaṃ priyatamadarśanāt, sasādhvasaṃ acintitopanatatvāt maugdhyācca/ ahno ityāścarye/ anyadeva kimapyetad vartate/ anyat prastutānmālatīvṛttāntādaparaṃ, kimapi anirūpitam/ etadanubhūyamānaṃ vastu/
tasyāḥ sādhvasamapanayati - rambhorvityādi/ rambhoru rambhā kadalīkāṇḍaḥ tatsadṛśavūrū yasyāḥ, bhayaṃ strīsvabhāvasulabhaṃ sahasādarśanopanataṃ sādhvasaṃ saṃhara parityaja/ vipakṣe bādhakamāha - vikāramucchvāsajanitaṃ kṣobhaṃ, utkampinaḥ antarbhayādutkampanaśīlasya stanabharasya pīnottuṅgatayā durvahasya stanasya/ madhyabhāgaḥ avalagnadeśaḥ tanīyastvāditi bhāvaḥ/ tathāpyaparicitasya darśane bhayamupapannamityāśaṅkyāha - itthamanantaroktena prakāreṇa ``buddharakṣitāpakṣapātapratyayena'' ityārabhya ``jīvalokaparivartamanubhavāmi'' ityantena prakāreṇa tvayaiva na punaḥ sakhīmukhena kathitaḥ praṇayo'nurāgātiśayaḥ tadrūpaḥ prasādo'nugraho yasmin/ saṅkalpanirvṛtiṣu saṅkalpaśabdena svapno'pyupalakṣyate, tasyāpyantaḥkaraṇadharmatvāt, saṅkalpasvapnasamāgamasukheṣu, ``saṅkappasiviṇaesu a pekkhāmi taṃ jaṇaṃ'' ityādinā ``vibhāvemi jīvaloaṃ'' ityantena prapañcitāsu, saṃskṛtaḥ paricito dāsa eṣaḥ ato na bhayasyājakāśa ityarthaḥ/ atra pūrvārdhe atiśayoktiralaṅkāraḥ, uttarārdhe vibhāvanā, viśeṣoktirvā la sambandhe asambandhābhidhānāt, asaṃskṛtatvarūpaṃ kāraṇamantareṇa kāryasya bhayasyopanibandhanāt, saṃskṛtatvātsvakāraṇasambhave'pi bhayābhāvarūpakāryānudayanibandhādvā//2//
atha hṛdayanirviśeṣā buddharakṣitā pūrvopakārasmāraṇena tāmupasāntvayati - mukhamunnamayyeti sāntvanārambhaḥ/
preyānityādi - manorathasahasravṛtaḥ bahubhirmanorathaiḥ prārthitaḥ, sa iti niratiśayapremāspadatvaṃ dhvanyate, saḥ preyāneṣa puro vartate/ rakṣipuruṣabhayamapīdānīṃ te nāstītyāha - suptapramattajanaṃ suptāḥ kecit pramattāḥ utsavasaṃvidhānavyākulatayā antaḥpurarakṣaṇe'navahitāḥ kecijjanāḥ pratihārādayo yasmin, etadityabhinayena tathātvaṃ darśayati, amātyaveśma nandanamandiram/ kālo'pyanukūla ityāha - prauḍhaṃ tamaḥ pariṇataṃ, sāndramiti yāvat/ anena candrodayāt prāgavasthā kathyate, anantaraṃ candrodayasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt, ``timiranikaramudyannaindavaḥ prākprakāśaḥ'' ( la ṛ ṛ ṛ. 1)
iti kṛtajñatayā tatkṛtaparamopakārasmaraṇena, sāpi tvayā paripālanīyeti bhāvaḥ/ evakāro bhinnakramaḥ/ bhadraṃ kalyāṇaṃ, asmākaṃ sarveṣāmityarthāt, kurveva asaṃśayaṃ kuru/ gamanasamaye nūpuradhvanirjanān bodhayiṣyatītyāśaṅkyāha - utkṣiptamūkamaṇinūpuraṃ jaṅghāmūlotsāritamaṇinūpuraṃ yathā tathā, yāmaḥ gacchāmaḥ ehi tadarthamanukūlā bhavetyarthaḥ/ atra parikaro'laṅkāraḥ//3//
``yāma'' iti gantavyasthalasūcanāt tadviśeṣaṃ pṛcchati - buddharakṣite! kvedānīmasmābhirgantavyam ṛ asmābhiriti makarandādīnāṃ saṅgrahaḥ/
pratihastipradarśanena protsāhayitumāha - yatraiva mālatīti/ tatra gantavyamiti sambandhaḥ/
vihārikodyāna ityapi vaktuṃ śakyatvāttaduktyānumāyāha - kiṃ nirvṛttasāhasā mālatī/ nirvṛttasāhasā pitrādyatilaṅghanena kṛtamādhavābhigamanetyarthaḥ/
atha kiṃ tathaivetyarthaḥ/ anyacceti ``preyānmanorathasahasravṛtaḥ'' ( la ṛ ṛ 3.) ityādibhissaṃgṛhītairhetubhiḥ samuccayatve ``asmābhirgantavya''mityādeḥ prasaṅgato madhye'vatārād aparamapi bhadrakaraṇe kāraṇamastītyarthaḥ/ tvamabhāṇīḥ ``kā ahaṃ imassa teṇa jevva attāṇaṃ paṇīkadua'' ityādikasya sasākṣikasya pratyayakalpasya vacanasyākaraṇe tavāsatyadoṣaśca lokadvayavirodhī bhaviṣyatīti bhedaprayogaḥ/
aśrūṇi pātayatīti bāṣpapātasya prasādacihnatvāt kathanam/
``savyājaṃ hasitaṃ mayā dhṛtiharo bāṣpastu muktastayā/'' ityādiprayogād bandhujanānusmaraṇajanitaṃ cāśru mantavyam/ pātayatītyāvegapraśamaḥ/
tadabhiprāyavedinī sakhyāha - dattaṃ khalvātmānaṃ pratipadyasva priyasakhyā/ khaluravadhāraṇe/ dattaṃ udakapūrvatvāddānasya aśrubhireva jalairdattamityarthaḥ/ ātmānaṃ svāṃ priyasakhyeti bāndhavanirapekṣaṃ svayaiva dattamityanena svābhāviko anurāgo guṇaviśeṣapakṣapātaḥ kṛtajñatetyādibhirnimittaiḥ prāṇebhyo'pi tvayā śaśvadiyamupalālanīyeti dyotayati/ pratipadyasva prāpnuhi, bahumanyasveti vā/ ``pratipattistu gaurave prāptau'' iti keśavasvāmī/
tadvacanaṃ sabahumānamaṅgīkaroti - adyetyādi/ ūrjitamatiśayitaṃ yathā tathā iti kriyāviśeṣaṇam, mayā vijitameva sarvasmādutkarṣeṇa sthitameva, anyat kimucyata iti śeṣaḥ/ phalavataḥ abhijanādibhiranurūpāyāḥ preyasyā lābhāt saprayojanasya yauvanasya tāruṇyasyotsavaḥ kalyāṇaṃ, svābhimatasambhogasampattyā/ vijayotsavayorhetumāha - prasādasumukhena anugrahavaśācchobhanamukhena devena mahādbhutaprabhāvena ityanena tasya kimaśakyaṃ nāmeti camatkāraḥ/ bāndhavadhurā pitrādīnāṃ dānādhikṛtānāṃ dhūrbhāro yasya/ samāsāntavidheranityatvāt ``ṛkpūrabdhūḥ'' [5-4-74] ityādinā apratyayābhāvaḥ/ makaradhvajena kāmena yasya mama samarpitā datteti yattasmāttena mayā vijitaṃ īdṛśasya bhāgadheyasyānyasminnasambhāvyatvāt, ``priyasakhyā dattamātmāna''mityukteḥ/ kāmamūlatvagarbhīkārāt makaradhvajenetyuktiḥ/ iyamiti rūpaśīlāmādhuryādiviśiṣṭatābhinayena tasyā jayayauvanātsavopapattiḥ prakāśyate/ parasparānurāgasya rūpādiguṇānāṃ ca sāmānādhikaraṇyamatidurlabham/ mayā bhāgyavaśāllabdhaṃ, ata etadupalālane kaḥ sandehāvakāśa iti sakhīśaṅkāṃ nirākaroti/ atiśayoktiralaṅkāraḥ//4//
tad yasmādetallābhāvadhirevaṃ nandanagṛhāvāsaḥ, eṣā ca labdhā, tasmād, aneneti samīpagatatvaṃ pakṣadvāreṇa vāsagṛhapārśvadvāreṇa, mahādvāranirgame kaiścit parijñāyeta, atastatparihārāyeti bhāvaḥ/
``dvāḥ strī dvāraṃ pakṣakastu pakṣadvāram/'' iti vaijayantī/ sādhayāmaḥ svābhimataṃ pūrayāmaḥ, gacchāma ityasya agrāmyeṇa prakāreṇoktiḥ/
nibhṛtam niśśabdam/
niśīthinīsañcāraramaṇīyatā rātrisañcaraṇe manoharatā, niśīthanissambādharamaṇīyatetyapi pāṭhaḥ/ ``madhyarātraniśīthau dvau'' ityamaraḥ/ rātrergāḍhatayā janasammardarāhityena kāmijanahṛdayaṅgamatvamityarthaḥ/ rājamārgasya nagaramadhyamahānīthyāḥ/ anena rājamārgaprāptirapi sūcyate/
ramaṇīyatvamupapādayati - saṃprati hi/ prāsādānāmityādi - prāsādānāṃ rājaveśmasaudhānām, ``prāsādo devabhūbhujām'' ityamaraḥ, upari ūrdhvabhāge valabhījālavātāyaneṣu kūṭāgārasamūhasya gavākṣeṣu/ ``kūṭāgārantu valabhī'' iti vaijayantī/ teṣāṃ sambhogasādhanatvāt tatsaṅgrahaṇam/ ``sama vadhūbhirvalabhīryuvānaḥ'' ityādimāghokteḥ/ prāptāmodaḥ labdhaharṣaḥ, sopaskārakaparimalasampattyā/ tathātvameva samarthayati - pariṇatasurā purāṇamadirā tasyā gandhasaṃskāro gandhavāsanā garbhe udare yasya, mālyāmodī mālāyāṃ sādhūnāṃ puṣpāṇāmatinirhārī gandho yasyāsti muhurbahuśaḥ upahitasphārakarpūravāsaḥ sphārasya samṛddhasya mukhavāsapaṭavāsādyarthasya karpūrasya vāsaḥ saurabhyavāsanā, sa upahitaḥ āhito yasmin, vāto vāyuḥ abhimatavadhūsannidhānaṃ abhīṣṭānāṃ strīṇāṃ tatrāvasthānaṃ vyanakti prakāśayatīti tatsamarthācaraṇātprayogaḥ/ agūḍhavyaṅgyo lakṣaṇāmūlo'yaṃ dhvaniḥ/ ato ramaṇīye kāle priyatamāprāptyā diṣṭyā vardhāmaha iti harṣo vyajyate/ atrodāttamalaṅkāraḥ, samṛddhimadvastuvarṇanāt la anumānaṃ ca, vātaliṅgena vadhūsannidhānasyānumīyamānatvāt/ atra keṣāñcidāḍhyānāṃ samīpe mṛṣṭaṃ bhuktavatastaddattamālyāṅgarāgabhūṣitasya hṛṣṭasya bahirnirgatya teṣāṃ tyāgabhogādikaṃ varṇayataḥ sujanasya, athavā teṣāmavinayaṃ piśunayato durjanasya samādhiranusandheyaḥ ityaśeṣamatimaṅgalam//5//
mālatīmādhavasyetthaṃ saptamāṅkārthacarcanam/
pūrṇajyotiḥprasādena cakre pūrṇasarasvatī/ //saptamo'ṅkaḥ//
aṣṭamo'ṅkaḥ atha praveśakamārabhate - tataḥ praviśatyavalokiteti/ vanditā mayā bhagavatī nandanāvāsapratinivṛttā/ tadyāvanmālatīmādhavasakāśaṃ gacchāmi/ vanditā abhivāditeti guruvandanasya pratidinaṃ vratatvenānuṣṭheyatvāduktiḥ/ nandanasya āvāsād gṛhāt pratinivṛtteti ``ṇandaṇaṃ āpucchia ṇiāvasahaṃ gāa'' ityuktaṃ saṅghaṭayati/ yāvaditi vākyālaṅkāre, avadhāraṇe vā/ mālatīmādhavayoḥ vihārodyānavartinorityarthāt, sakāśaṃ samīpameva gacchāmītyarthaḥ/ atra madayantikāpaharaṇarātreḥ pūrvasya divasasya vṛttāntaḥ kavinā kathyate krameṇa tadrātrikālasaṅghaṭanāyeti mantavyam/ etau khalu mālatīmādhavau nirvartitagrīṣmadivasāvasānamajjanau dīrghikātaṭaśilātalamalaṅkurutaḥ/ tadupasarpāmi/ nirvartitamanuṣṭhitaṃ grīṣmadivasasyāvasāne sāyaṅkāle majjanaṃ śiraḥsnānaṃ yābhyām/ pūrvaprastutasya vasantasyāpagamād grīṣmoktiḥ/ dīrghikāyāḥ krīḍāvāpyāḥ tīragataṃ sphaṭīkamaṇikuṭṭimaṃ śaityahetorvibhūṣayataḥ, tadadhivāsācchilātalasya śobhātiśayasampatteḥ/ ``udyānasalilakrīḍā chāyākisalayāstarāḥ/
dhārāgṛhaṃ maṇigṛhaṃ mṛṇālamaṇikuṭṭime/
ityādayaḥ syuḥ saṃsṛṣṭā grīṣme rāgapradīpanāḥ//'' iti vacanāt, ``subhagasalilāvagāhāḥ, pariṇāmaramaṇīyāḥ'' ityādibhiśca/ grīṣmartoḥ sāyaṃ snānasya śilātalasya ca grahaṇamuddīpanatvātiśayāt ``saritaḥ pulinaṃ velā kāntārārāmabhūdharāḥ/
divā vihāradeśāḥ syuḥ'' iti vacanād dīrghikātaṭasya grahaṇam// //praveśakaḥ//
upaviṣṭāviti ``silātalaṃ alaṅkarentī''tyuktaṃ ghaṭayati/ avalokitā ceti tasyā apyupasṛptatvam/
sānandamityanukūlakālasampatteḥ/ varttata iti vartamānasāmīpyāllaṭ/ vartiṣyata ityarthaḥ/ manmathaprauḍhisuhṛdo madanasya prabhāvasampādane mitrabhūtasya/ niśīthasyeti ``niśīthastvardharātrakaḥ'' ityukto'pi niśīthaśabdo'tra rātrimātramāha, ardharātrasyaiva yauvanatvāt/ yauvanaśrīḥ madhyayāmasya lakṣmīḥ, tadānīṃ gaganaśikharagatātapasamayahimakarakaranikaraparilasitabhuvanatayā dinammanyatvāllokottarasambhogasāhāyyaṃ rātreriti bhāvaḥ/
bhaviṣyantīṃ śriyamevānumityā sādhayati - dalayatītyādi/ pariśuṣyatprauḍhatālīvipāṇḍuḥ pariśuṣyantī na tu pariśuṣkā iti īṣatpāṇḍutvāyoktiḥ, prauḍhā pariṇatā tālī rājatālīpatrikeva vipāṇḍurvirūpadhāvalyā, udayarāgamilitatvāt/ timiranikaraṃ tamaḥsamūhaṃ dalayati śakalīkaroti/ udyannudgacchan/ na punaradalayaditi na punarudita iti vipāṇḍutve hetuḥ/ eendavaḥ indusambandhi, ``tasyedaṃ'' (4-3-120) ityaṇpratyayaḥ, prāk pūrvadigbhāge prakāśaḥ ālokamātraṃ, na punaḥ kiraṇakalāpaḥ, tasyāpyuktatvāt la ``anantaraṃ cāsannacandrodayajanmanā viralaviralenālokena vasantavanarājiriva kusumarajasā dhūsaratāṃ vāsavī digayāsīd'' iti kādambaryuktavat la unmukhaḥ ūrdhvagamanodyataḥ abhinavaḥ tatkālavikāsānnavatvena sphuṭadhavalaḥ sāndro nirantaraḥ mākarandaḥ makarandena puṣparasena raktaḥ/ ``tena raktaṃ rāgād'' (4-2-1) ityaṇ, na punaḥ ``tasyeda''miti, ``makarandaḥ puṣparasaḥ parāgaḥ sumanorajaḥ/''ityabhidhānād dvayoḥ pṛthagdravyatvāt/ ``apasara madhukara! dūraṃṣṭaṣṭaparimalabahale'pi ketakīkusume/
iha nahi madhukaṇalābhoṣṭaṣṭabhavati paraṃ dhūlidhūsaraṃ vadanam//'' ityādiṣu ketakīkusumasya madhvabhāvaḥ pratipādyate, kathamatra mākarandetyuktiḥ ṛ ucyate - kusumatvāviśeṣādasyāpi madhusadbhāvo'styeva/ na tu kundamākandādivat tasya prabhūtatvaṃ, parāgasyevādhikyāt/ ``apasara madhukare''tyatrāpi na madhvabhāvaḥ pratipādyate, tallābhasyaiva niṣidhyamānatvāt/ tatra hetuḥ dhūlīpālīdhūsaritavadanatvam/ ato na kaścid virodhaḥ/ parāgasya puṣparajasaḥ svato dhāvalyasya rāgānuviddhatvapratipādanāyātra mākarandatvoktiḥ, anyathodayarāgarūṣitasyaindavaprakāśasyopamānatvānupapatteḥ/ ataḥ śobhanasasyāṅkuradarśanādiva sasyasamṛddhirbhāvinī yauvanaśrīranumīyata ityarthaḥ/ atropamālaṅkāraḥ//1//
svagatam/ tat yasmādetadānukūlyamantareṇa mahāvyasanatayeyaṃ pariṇaṃsyate tasmād, vāmaśīlāṃ navoḍhatvānmugdhatvācca premaparavaśatve'pi trapayā pratikūlamācarantīmityarthaḥ, upāvartaye svavaśe karomi, ``prayojyasyopāvartanaṃ'' iti kāmasūtraprasiddheḥ/ bhavatu tathā sā vartatām, evaṃ tathāpyevaṃ kriyamāṇe phalasiddhirbhaviṣyatīti svamatinirṇayaḥ/ evamiti vakṣyamāṇaprakāraḥ/ tāvaditi prāthamye, tasyāpyanyathātve kriyāntaraṃ prayokṣyāmaha iti bhāvaḥ/ prakāśam/ pratyagrasāyantanasnānasaviśeṣaśītalāṃ ayātayāmena dināvasānamajjanena pūrvasmādadhikaṃ śiśiraśarīrāṃ, pūrvameva candracandanādibhyo'pi madaṅganirvāpaṇāya paryāptaśaityatvāt/ nidāghasantāpaśāntaye grīṣmadivasoṣmakhedaśamanārthaṃ kiñcit kimapi vakṣyamāṇaṃ vastu vijñāpayāmi sābhyarthanaṃ vadāmītyarthaḥ/ tat tasmāt santaptarakṣaṇasyaucityādityarthaḥ, kimiti kimarthaṃ nityaṃ sarvadā, dvistrirvā trapā sambhāvitā bhavatu nāma, kadācid vayamapi dayanīyā iti bhāvaḥ, anyathaiva prārthitārthapratilomenaiva māṃ sambhāvayasi satkaroṣīti tvatprātilomyamapi mama hṛdayarasāyanamiti dyotayati/ athavā māmanyathaiva anyaḥ kaścidayaṃ trapāviṣayo na punarasmadīyo dāsa iti gaṇayasi kimarthamityarthaḥ/
vijñāpanaprakāramevāha - niścyotanta ityādi/ niścyotante nitarāṃ galanti/ sutanu śobhanaśarīre ityāmantraṇena svata eva tvaṃ sparśanāmṛtena māmujjīvayituṃ śaktā, kiṃ punarasmin kāle pratyagrasnānaśītaleti prakāśyate/ kabarībindavaḥ snānārdramuktasya keśahastasya salilaśīkarāḥ, yāvad yasmin kālāvadhau la stanamukulayoḥ navāṅkuritayoḥ stanayoḥ madhyo'ntarāladeśaḥ, tasya kiñcinnimnatayā jhaṭiti śoṣābhāvād, ārdrabhāvaṃ na jahāti na muñcatīti dīrghāyuṣyasūcakamuttamalakṣaṇaṃ caitatsūcayati kaviḥ la sāndro nirantaraḥ pratanuḥ sūkṣmaḥ pulakodbhedo romāñcaprarohaḥ tadvatī tadviśiṣṭā, śiśirapavanasamparkād, aṅgayaṣṭiḥ karacaraṇādisanniveśaḥ la tāvat tasmin kālāvadhau, gāḍhaṃ dṛḍhaṃ yathā sakṛdapi ekavāramapi, kriyāsamabhihāra eva mama manorathaḥ sa tāvanna śakyaścenmābhūdityarthaḥ, aṅkapālīmāliṅganaṃ vitara dehi/ vitaretyanena tava na kaścidāyāsaḥ, asmākaṃ tu mahān nidhilābho'yamiti dyotayati/
``āliṅganamapi kroḍīkaraṇaṃ cāṅkapālyapi/''iti vaijayantī/ prasīda kāruṇyaṃ kuru, anantarakṣaṇe'bhilaṣitasya nidāghasantāpātyantaśamanasyānupapatteriti bhāvaḥ/ atrautsukyaṃ vyajyate/ atiśayoktiralaṅkāraḥ//2//
niranukrośe kāruṇyarahite/ ``... ... ... ... karuṇā tu dayā kṛpā/
ghṛṇānukampānukrośaḥ kāruṇyaṃ ca ... ...//'' iti vaijayantī/
pūrvoktasyāśakyatvamāśaṅkya kiñcidarvācitaparvaṇi prārthanāmāviṣkaroti - jīvayannivetyādi/ jīvayan prāṇayitumicchanniti hetau śatā, ivetyutprekṣādyotakaṃ, santāpadagdhatayā momuhyamānaṃ māṃ jīvayitumivetyarthaḥ/ utprekṣaṇe nimittamāha - samūḍhasādhvasasvedabinduḥ samantādūḍho dhṛtaḥ sādhvasena navasaṅgamabhayena janitaśramajalakaṇo yena/ jalabindusekasyāśvāsanasādhanatvājjīvayanniva na tu jīvayantyeveti tava niranukrośatve'pi bāhostāvanmayi dayā dṛśyata eveti dyotayati/ adhikaṇṭhaṃ kaṇṭhe, kaṇṭha eva, tadgatānāṃ prāṇānāṃ nivāraṇīyatvād, arpyatāṃ dīyatāṃ, tvayeti śeṣaḥ/ bāhuḥ bhujalatā, ekavacanena jīvane dvitīyanirapekṣasyaiva tasya paryāptiḥ prakāśyate/ svedabindudarśanadaśāyāmupamimīte - eendavamayūkhacumbitasyandicandramaṇihāravibhramaḥ candrasambandhibhiḥ kiraṇaiḥ saṃśliṣṭatvād jalabindukṣaraṇaśīlasya candrakāntagulikāviracitasya hārasya vilāsa iva vilāso yasya/ hāraśabdo'tra lakṣaṇayā yaṣṭimātramāha, ``hārāvalīva harinīlamayī vibhāti/''ityācāryaprayogāt, ``sūtrikā mauktikaiḥ kṛtā'', ``hāro muktāvalī strī syād'' iti hāraśabdasya mukhyavṛttyā muktāvalyāmeva vṛtteḥ/ masṛṇasnigdhadhavalaśītalatanuvṛttāyatatvādibhiścandramaṇihārasāmyoktiḥ/ atrotprekṣā upamā cālaṅkāraḥ//3//
tatrāpyaśakyatayā nirāśo'rthāntaraṃ prārthayate - athaveti pūrvoktaṃ vyāvartayati/ tatra hetuḥ - dūre tāvadetat asmatkṛtaṃ prārthanaṃ dūre viprakṛṣṭe deśa eva, durlabhaviṣayatvāditi bhāvaḥ/ kathamityāścarye/ ālāpasaṃvibhāgamātrasya vaktavye sthale viśaṅkaṃ sambhāṣaṇadānasya, apīti sparśanamantareṇa dūrasthitayāpi tasya śakyatvāt sulabhatvaṃ prakāśayati, abhājanaṃ apātraṃ ayaṃ jana iti tvatsnehavisrambhayorbhājanatvena loke prasiddha ityarthaḥ/ bhavatyāḥ tava/
ālāpasaṃvibhāgasyāpi paramopakāritvamupapādayati - dagdhaṃ cirāyetyādi/ cirāya bahukālaṃ malayānilacandrapādaiḥ dakṣiṇamārutena candrakiraṇaiśca/ dagdhatvoktirjhaṭiti nirvāpaṇasyaucityādupekṣaṇasyānaucityaṃ dhvanayati/ nirvāpitaṃ śītalīkṛtam/ turbhinnakramo vyāvṛttau/ vapustviti sambandhaḥ/ na nāma naiva, parirabhya āliṅgya, parirambhaṇamantareṇa nirvāpaṇasyāśakyatvāt/ tasya ca trapāvighnitatvāttatra maiva bhūt, sambhāvitameva tadityarthaḥ/ nāmaśabdaḥ sambhāvanāyām/ āmattakokilarutavyathitā samantādamandamākandamakarandapānamattānāṃ kokilānāṃ śabdaiḥ kadarthitā/ malayānilakokilarutagrahaṇaṃ nacirātīte vasantasamaye virahaduḥkhasyānubhūtatvāt/ hṛdyāṃ manoharām/ śrutiḥ śrotrendriyam/ kinnarakaṇṭhi kinnarāṇāṃ aśvamukhānāṃ devagāyakānāṃ kaṇṭha iva kaṇṭho yasyāḥ/ kākitambakīsandaṣṭakapilakākalipramukhadoṣarahitastāvakasnigdharaktaḥ kaṇṭha ityarthaḥ, ``kimidaṃ kinnarakaṇṭhi! supyate'' itivat/ ayaṃ hṛdyatve hetuḥ - śrutistu hṛdyāṃ vācaṃ pibatu āsvādayatviti prārthanāyāṃ loṭ/ śrutistviti tuśabdena sarvendriyāhlādakāriṇo garīyasaḥ parirambhopakārasyākaraṇe'pi śrotramātrasyāpyāhlādanenānugrahaḥ kartavyaḥ, laghīyastayā śakyasyāpyupakārasyākaraṇe nṛśaṃsatvaprasakteriti bhedaprayogaḥ/ atrautsukyaṃ bhāvaḥ prakāśyate/ atiśayoktiralaṅkāraḥ//4//
atha sakhī vaidagdhyānmithyāvacanopanyāsena tāmālāpayitumupāyaṃ prayuṅkte - ayi anirvahaṇaśīle! yadidānīṃ muhūrtāntaritamādhavāpi durmanāyamānā mama purato bhaṇasi - ``cirāyatyāryaputraḥ/ api nāmācirāt taṃ prekṣe/ yena viccharditāśeṣasādhvasaṃ vismṛtavighnamavalokayantī evaṃ bhaṇiṣyāmi, tathā bhaṇiṣyāmi, dviguṇāveṣṭaparirambheṇa sambhāvayiṣyāmī''ti/ tasyāyaṃ pariṇāmaḥ ṛ ayi he ṅa/ anirvahaṇaṃ prakrāntasyāparisamāpanaṃ śīlaṃ yasyāḥ/ tathātvameva samarthayati - idānīmanantarātīte kāle, na punaryugāntare, muhūrtamantaritaḥ sandhyopāsanādyarthaṃ pracalitatvena tirohito mādhavo yasyāḥ, vighaṭitadarśana iti yāvat/ apiśabdo yāmamātrāntaritatve kiṃ punaḥ kathayāma iti dyotayati/ durmanāyamānā śocantī mama purataḥ sannidhau, na tu puruṣāntarasya, bhaṇasi kathayasīti yadā yadā antaritatvaṃ tadā tadā tathoktiḥ sūcyate/ bhaṇanaprakāramāha - cirāyati bahukālaṃ vilambate/ āryaputra iti sādhvīnāṃ bhartṛviṣaya upacāraśabdaḥ/ ``patistvārya āryaputraḥ'' iti vaijayantī/ api nāmeti sambhāvanā/ atisnehasya pāpaśaṅkitatvāt aciradarśane tvayā kiṃ kriyata ityatrāha - yena yasmād viccharditāśeṣasādhvasaṃ parityaktasamagrotkampaṃ vismṛtavighnaṃ ciradarśanābhāvodvegenānirūpito lajjārūpo darśanapratyūho yathā tatheti kriyāviśeṣaṇam, avalokayantī ārjavena paśyantī evaṃ bhaṇiṣyāmi tathā bhaṇiṣyāmīti uktānāṃ prakārāṇāmaśakyavarṇanatvadyotanāya saṅgrahaḥ/ bhaṇiṣyāmītyukteḥ ciravilambāsahatayā serṣyatvāt kvedānīṃ yuṣmābhirgatamityuktermakarandaṃ draṣṭuṃ gato'smītyādi yadi vadati tatastasmin mithyānyatra kutrāpi vinodanārthaṃ gatamityādyuktipratyuktikāviracanāpi dyotyate/ dviguṇāveṣṭaḥ bhujalatayordviguṇitayorāveṣṭaḥ, śṛṅkhalayeva parito bandhanaṃ, tena yaḥ parirambhaḥ āśleṣastena sambhāvayiṣyāmi ciravilambadaṇḍatvena prayuktatvāttasya praṇayabhītasya prasādadyotanena prītiṃ kariṣyāmītyarthaḥ/ iti mama purato bhaṇasītyanvayaḥ/ tasya vacanasya ayamanubhūyamāno maunaparigrahānālokanādirūpaḥ pariṇāmaḥ phalaṃ avasānaṃ vā/
sāsūyaṃ sakopaṃ, ivetyahṛdayapūrvakatvoktiḥ/
apavārya svagatam/ aho iti harṣe/ bhagavatyāḥ kāmandakyāḥ pradhānāntevāsinyāḥ pratibhāguṇādāptaśiṣyāyā ityanena sadgurūpadeśasya pratibhāguṇasya ca sāmagrye kiṃ nāma na sambhāvyata iti dyotayati, sarvatomukhaṃ sarvāsu vidyāsu sakalāsu kalāsu ca mukhamābhimukhyaṃ yasya, vaidagdhyaṃ agrāmyatvam/ akṣayaḥ avasānarahitaḥ subhāṣitaratnakośaḥ śobhanānāṃ avasaropayuktatvādrasāvahānāṃ bhāṣitānāmeva ratnānāṃ, anarghatvācchobhāvahatvācca ratnatvāropaḥ kośo nidhiḥ/ ajānanniva pṛcchati - satyaṃ paramārthaṃ, vadatīti kākvā asatyaṃ vā vadatīti sūcyate/
mūrdhānaṃ śiraḥ cālayati satyatvaniṣedhābhinayena tiryak śiraḥ kampayatītyarthaḥ/
svavacanottaratvena mūrdhacālanasya lābhāt kiñcillabdhāvakāśa āha - śāpitā śāpaṃ pratyayaṃ kāritāsi, mama jīvitena prāṇaiḥ avalokitālavaṅgikayośca, jīviteneti sambandhaḥ, asmāttrayāt parasya snehavisrambhabhājanabhūtasya kasyacidabhāvād yadi na kathayasi satyamidamanayoktamasatyaṃ veti vācā yadi na kathayasi na punarabhinayaiḥ/ tato'smākaṃ jīvitaśāpavyatikramastvayā kṛto bhaviṣyatītyarthaḥ/ jīvitena śāpitāsīti tṛtīyāprayogaḥ, śapathamātre vivakṣaṇāt/ ``ślāghahnuṅsthāśapāṃ jñīpsyamāna'' (1-4-34) iti caturthī na prayuktā jñīpsyamānatvābhāvāt/ ``dardareṇa ca te devi! śape mūlaphalena ca/
malayena ca vindhyena meruṇā mandareṇa ca//'' iti śrīrāmāyaṇe, ``svādhyāyena śape śape paraśunā patyā paśūnāṃ śape/''ityādiprayogadarśanācca/
tadupāyaprayogasya phalaṃ darśayati - nāhaṃ kimapi bhaṇāmīti/ anayā maduktitvena yadupanyastaṃ tatra kiñcidapi mayā na bhaṇitaṃ, mithyaivānayā vijalpitam/ iti vivakṣite'nukte ardhokte ekadeśasya vacane kṛta ityarthāt, lajjāṃ nāṭayatīti pūrvamārjavena tanmithyāvacanāsahatayā jhaṭiti vaktumupakrānte punarmadhye svābhāvikī lajjā dṛḍhamākrāntavatītyarthaḥ/ vihṛtākhyaścāyaṃ bhāvaḥ, ``prāptakālaṃ na yad brūyād vrīḍayā vihṛtaṃ hi tat/''iti vacanāt//
aho iti harṣe/ anavasitārthamantharasya asamāptābhidheyatayānulbaṇasya vacanasya madhuratā/ ``kathamālāpasaṃvibhāgasyāpyabhājanamayaṃ jano bhavatyā'' ityārabhya ``aho anavasitārthamantharasya vacasaścārute''tyantena prakaraṇena idamanusandhātavyaṃ - ``spṛṣṭvā ciraṃ sthitvā nirbadhyamānā śiraḥ kampayet/ saṃstutā cet sakhīmanukūlāmubhayato visrabdhāmantarā kṛtvā kathāyojanam/ tasminnadhomukhī vihaset/ tāṃ cāvivādinīmapanudet vivadecca/ sā tu parihāsārthamidaṃ anayābhihitamityanuktamapi brūyāt/ tatra tāmapanudya naivamahaṃ bravīmītyavyaktākṣaramanavasitārthaṃ brūyāt'' iti kāmasūtroktamālāpayojanamudāhṛtamiti/
atha tasyā mukhe vikṛtimupalakṣya sabhaya āha - sahaseti bhayānubhāvaḥ, nirūpya vilokya/ kimetat kiṃ nimittametaditi/
nirdiṣṭaṃ tasyai darśayati - bāṣpāmbhasetyādi/ mṛgadṛśa iti, na tu mṛgadṛśeti, ṣaṣṭhyā manaso dravībhāvāt svayameva jhaṭiti netrajalasya pravṛttiḥ dyotyate/ vimalaḥ svata eva niṣkalaṅkaḥ/ prakṣālyate dhāvyata iti pratiyatnābhāvāt prakṣālanasya kaimarthakyaṃ prakāśyate/ sapadīti parihāsamadhye prasaktatvādajñāyamānakāraṇatvaṃ dyotayati/ eṣa udayamānaḥ/ gaṇḍūṣapeyaṃ gaṇḍūṣeṇa mukhakuharapūraṇena pātuṃ śakyaṃ, atibahalatayā pānena kapolakuharaṃ pūrayituṃ paryāptamityarthaḥ, ``śruticulukalehyena madhunā'' iti, ``śravaṇāñjalipuṭapeyam'' ityādivat/ ``kṛtyairadhikārthavacane'' (2-1-33) iti samāsaḥ/ kāntyamṛtaṃ lāvaṇyātiśayarūpaṃ pīyūṣaṃ pipāsuḥ pātumicchuḥ/ niveśitamayūkhamṛṇāladaṇḍaḥ niveśitaḥ antarnihitaḥ mayūkhaḥ kiraṇaḥ tadrūpo vṛttāyatavimalakomalamṛṇāladaṇḍo yena, yasmin kapole/ udayadaśāyāmābhimukhyena niveśitamayūkhamṛṇāladaṇḍaḥ indurutprekṣyate/ gaṇḍūṣapeyaṃ kāntyamṛtaṃ pipāsuriveti yathā vyādhyādibhiḥ kṣīṇaḥ kaścit svāpyāyanāya rasāyanaṃ upayuṅkte, evaṃ candro'pi nyūnaguṇaḥ svābhivṛddhaye kāntyamṛtaṃ pipāsatī vetyutprekṣayā candrādadhikalāvaṇyatvaṃ kapolasya dyotyate/ mayūkhe mṛṇālatvāropo vaidyakokteṣu salilapānasādhaneṣu mṛṇālasyānyatamatvāt, prāśastyācceti mantavyam la ``nayananalinīnālānītaṃ pibanti rasaṃ priyāḥ/''ityamarukokteśca//5//
sakhi! kimidānīmuccalitabāṣpotpīḍamantharaṃ rudyate/ pravṛttāśrusamūhaniśśabdamandaṃ ca kiṃ nimittaṃ tvayā rodanaṃ kriyata iti/
tatra nimittamāha - kiyacciraṃ priyasakhyā lavaṅgikāyā asannidhānaduḥkhamanubhaviṣyāmi/ kiṃparimāṇaṃ dīrghakālaṃ asannidhānaduḥkhaṃ dūrāvasthānād adarśanajanitaṃ kleśam/ pravṛttilābho'pyasyā durlabhaḥ, vṛttāntasya kiṃ karotīti rūpasya lābho jñānamapi duṣprāpaṃ, vartata iti śeṣaḥ/
trapayā tatkarṇamūle mandamuktasya vyaktībhāvāya pṛcchati - kiṃ nāma ṛ nimittamuktamiti śeṣaḥ/
vivṛṇoti - tavaivopanyāsena eṣā lavaṅgikāṃ saṃsmṛtya tasyāḥ pravṛttilābhanimittamuttāmyati duḥkhitā bhavati/
``tavaivopanyāsena, ``avalokitālavaṅgikayośca'' iti vacanena nātra khedaḥ kartavya ityāha - nanussammatau, tvayāpi tatpreṣaṇaṃ mayā kṛtaṃ jñātamevetyarthaḥ preṣyamāṇaḥ san dṛṣṭa eva la nanu kimarthaṃ preṣita iti mayā jñātamityatrāha - pracchannaṃ tatratyairaviditaṃ yathā tathā, nandanāvāsaṃ nandanasya gṛhaṃ, pravṛttimityaviśeṣokteḥ pratāritasya nandanasya pratāraṇānāṃ makarandalavaṅgikābuddharakṣitānāṃ ceti siddhyati/ iti evamuktveti śeṣaḥ/ sāśaṃsaṃ saprārthanam/ api nāmeti sambhāvanādyotakamavyayam/ phalodarkaṃ udarke uttarakāle phalaṃ prayojanaṃ yasya/
``udarke uttare kāle yacca syāt phalamuttaram/''iti vaijayantī/ madayantikāṃ prati lakṣīkṛtya, syāditi sambhāvanāyāṃ liṅ/
atha daṇḍāpūpikayā tasya sandehaṃ vaidagdhyānnirākaroti - prathamameva śārdūlanakharaspṛṣṭasya makarandasya mohavicchedapriyanivedikāyā bhagavatīniyuktena bhavatā mālatyāḥ samaṃ jīvitena hṛdayaṃ prasādīkṛtaṃ/ ālukkhiaṃ spṛṣṭam, ``cirasammāṇiaṇiddo virahālukkhiasamuddadiṇṇukkaṇṭho/''ityādisetūktaprayogāt/ sāmprataṃ yadi tasyaiva ko'pi madayantikālābhena vardhayati tasya kimidānīṃ pāritoṣikaṃ bhaviṣyati/ tasyaiva makarandasyaiva ko'pi asmāsu kaścid, vardhayati, ``diṣṭyā vardhase'' iti priyaṃ nivedayiṣyatītyarthaḥ/ vartamānasāmīpyadyotako laṭprayogaḥ/ tasya vardhayituḥ pāritoṣikaṃ prītidāyakam/ ko'pītyuktyā mālatīṃ codayati/
udghaṭṭitajña āha - anuyoktavyaṃ praṣṭuṃ yogyaṃ anuyukto'smi pṛṣṭo'smi/ hṛdayaṃ svavakṣaḥsthalaṃ/ mālatīprathamadarśanābhiṣaṅgasākṣiṇaḥ mālatyāstatpūrve madanodyānakṛte sandarśane yo'bhiṣaṅgaḥ kāmaduḥkhaṃ tasmin sākṣiṇaḥ sākṣātkāravataḥ, tadālavālaparisarāvasthāne sañjātatvād yadi kaścidasminnarthe vivadate tarhi bakulataruḥ praṣṭavya iti dyotayan tadānīmekākinaḥ svasvānubhavaikagamyamavasthāviśeṣamanusandhatte/ kāmakānanālaṅkāriṇaḥ madanodyānaśobhātiśayajanakasya, vṛkṣāntarebhyo viśiṣṭaguṇatvāt, lakṣmīvataḥ daivasampannasya kesarataroḥ bakulapādapasya prasavamālā puṣpamālikā/
lakṣmīvattvamevopapādayati - premṇetyādi/ premṇā snehena/ tatra hetuḥ - madgrathiteti mayā viracitetyanena hetunā yat prema tena priyasakhīhastopanītā priyasakhyā lavaṅgikāyā hastenopanītā samīpaṃ prāpitā/ anayeti mālatyā abhinayena nirdeśaḥ/ vistāristanakumbhakuḍmalabharotsaṅgena vistārituṃ kṣaṇe kṣaṇe vipulībhavituṃ śīlaṃ yayoḥ stanarūpayoḥ kumbhakuḍmalayoḥ kalaśaśiśukayoḥ/ ``stanakalaśakiśorakau kathañcit'' iti māghoktavallākṣaṇikaḥ prayogaḥ/ tathā ca murāriḥ - ``tārakeśvarakiśoraśekharaḥ'' iti/ bharo bhāraḥ, tasyotsaṅgena madhyena, sambhāvitā nirantarodvahanenopalālitā, tasyāḥ prabhavabhūtasya lakṣmīvattve kasya vimatiriti bhāvaḥ/ na tāvadeva la tataḥ paramapi ślāghyatve kāraṇamastītyāha - turviśeṣe, pāṇipīḍanavidhau nandanavivāhārthe'nuṣṭhāne/ pāṇipīḍanaṃ vivāhaḥ, ``pāṇipīḍanavidheranantaraṃ śailarājaduhiturharaṃ prati/'' iti kumārasambhavokteḥ/ māṃ prati māmuddiśya apetāśayā truṭitaprāptyāśayā lavaṅgiketi lavaṅgikeyamiti anena prakāreṇāvagate jñāte, maraṇānumatyai pādapraṇāme kṛte lavaṅgikāsthāne ca mayi sthite ityarthaḥ/ sarvasvadāyaḥ sarvasya svasya dhanasya dānaṃ, yathā mumūrṣuḥ kaścit svayamevārjitaṃ yatrakutracit saṅgṛhītaṃ samagraṃ svavittaṃ putrādiṣu samarpayati apramādenedaṃ rakṣaṇīyamiti tathā/ ``esā vi māladīṇivvisesaṃ daṭhṭhavvā/ savvadā hiaeṇa dhāraṇīe tti'' sādaraṃ samarpitetyarthaḥ/ kṛteti mālāyā uddeśyatvādvidheyasya sarvadāyatvasya tatra viśrānteḥ stryantaḥ pāṭhaḥ/ atra pūrvārdhe snehākhyaḥ, uttarārdhe dainyākhyaśca bhāvaḥ prakāśyate/ aprastutapraśaṃsālaṅkāraḥ, kāryamukhena lokottarasyānurāgasya prakāśanāt//6//
sakhi! vallabhā khalu te iyaṃ bakulamālā yato'vahitā pralokayasi/ vallabhā atipriyā, khaluravadhāraṇe, yataḥ yasmādavahitā ekāgrā pralokayasi prakarṣeṇa paśyasi, imāmityarthāt/ anayoktibhaṅgyā gāḍhāliṅganatṛṣṇayā vallabhasya ca vakṣaḥsthalaṃ mālāvyājena paśyasi/ mama purato lajjāṃ ca nāṭayasi/ aho te pracchannakāmukītvamiti vyajyate/
taduktibhaṅgimavagacchantī āha - sakhi! māmupahasasīti/ upahasasi kimapi hṛdaye nidhāya parihasasi/ kimiti kākvā sūcayati/
caraṇasañcaraṇaśabdākarṇananāṭitakenāha - kathaṃ padaśabdaḥ kṣititale caraṇavinyāsajanito dhvaniḥ/ ivaśabdastarkadyotakaḥ/
tadīyaṃ kāryasiddhidyotakaṃ mukhaprasādādicihnamālokya saharṣa āha - aye iti harṣadyotakamavyayam/ prāptaḥ nandanāvāsādāgataḥ/
priyatamaharṣavacasā kāryasiddhiṃ niścitya harṣavaśatiraskṛtatrapāyantraṇā prāgeva manasyavalokitāvacanena vartamānaṃ diṣṭivṛddhimaṅgalaṃ karoti - diṣṭyā vardhadhve madayantikālābhena, bhāgyena pūrṇamanorathā bhavatha sakhyurmadayantikāprāptyetyarthaḥ/
saharṣamiti sakhīsannidhāvapi harṣādihetukatve pariṣvaṅgasyaucityamāha/ ``pariṣvajya dadāti na punardatvā pariṣvajata'' ityuktyā coreṇeva pramattāvasthāyāṃ paradhanaluṇṭhanasya, cirābhilaṣitasya trapāvighnitasya pariṣvaṅgasya avasaralābhe dākṣyāt jhaṭityanuṣṭhitatvaṃ prakāśayati/ priyaṃ naḥ asmākamabhilaṣitaṃ, siddhamiti śeṣaḥ/ vīpsayā harṣaṃ dyotayati/
bakulamālāmiti pūrvameva tasyāḥ pāritoṣikatvena kalpitatvāt/
buddharakṣitāṃ camatkaroti - nirvyūḍhaḥ khalu bhagavatīsambhāvanābhāro buddharakṣitayā/ bhagavatyāḥ kāmandakyāḥ sambhāvanā etatkāryaṃ sādhayitumiyaṃ pragalbhata ityūhaḥ, ``sāmantasambhāvanayaiva dhīraḥ'' itivat la athavā satkāraḥ, ``sambhāvayāmāsa yathākrameṇa'' itivat la tadrūpo bhāro bhartavyo guruḥ padārthaḥ nirvyūḍhaḥ prāpaṇīyāṃ bhūmiṃ prāpita iti lakṣaṇayā phalaparyantatāṃ nīta ityarthaḥ/
ahnahe ityāścaryadyotakamavyayam/ evamacireṇa darśanasyāsambhāvitatvādāścaryatvam/ uttiṣṭhati pratyudgamanena sambhāvayitumāsanāccalatītyarthaḥ/
sambhrāntaḥ sambhramo vyākulatā, tadvān/ cakāreṇa sambhrāntā iti vipariṇāmena yojanā/
paritrāyatāṃ paritrāyatāṃ mahābhāgaḥ/ vīpsayā bhayasambhramo dyotyate/ kutaḥ kastrātavya ityatrāha - ardhamārga eva nagararakṣipuruṣābhiyogo makarandasya jātaḥ/ ardhamārge mārgasya sameṃ'śe madhye ityarthaḥ/ nagararakṣibhiḥ purarakṣaṇādhikṛtaiḥ puruṣairabhiyogaḥ uparuddhatvaṃ ko'yaṃ keyaṃ kutaḥ kva gamyata iti vicāryamāṇe ayaṃ makarando mālatīveṣeṇa nandanaṃ vipralabhya tanmandiramanupraviśya tadbhaginīmapahṛtya tato mādhavasamīpaṃ niśi prayātīti paramārthasya parijñānāt coraṅkāramākruśyānudrutaḥ tairabhibhūyamāno makarandastebhyo rakṣaṇīyo bhavatetyarthāt/ tarhi kathaṃ bhavatyaḥ sammardāt paribhraśyāgatā ityatrāha - tatkālamilitena kalahaṃsakena saha vayamanupreṣitāḥ/ tatkāle abhiyogasamaye ita āgatya saṅgatena vayaṃ madayantikādayaḥ anupreṣitā makarandena prasthāpitā ityarthāt/
lavaṅgikoktimupodbalayati sāhāyyatvarārtham - yathā itomukhaṃ pravṛttairapi kalakalaḥ śrutaḥ tathā jānīmaḥ anyadapyupagataṃ pādātasainyamiti/ itomukhaṃ imaṃ pradeśamuddiśya pravṛttaiḥ prasthitaiḥ, ahmehiṃ ityanantarokterasmābhiriti siddhyati/ kalahaṃsavacanatvāt pulliṅganirdeśaḥ/ apiśabdena pūrvaṃ kasyacit pādātasainyasya dṛṣṭatvaṃ dyotayati/ yathā yena prakāreṇeti pūrvottarakalakalayorviralāviralatvaviśeṣasya subodhatvāt, tathā tena prakāreṇa jānīmaḥ anumimīmahe/ anyat pūrvāgatavyatirekeṇa upagataṃ rājājñayā prāptam/ pāikkaśabdaḥ padātivācī/ ``rahasandāṇiaturāṃ turaṅgamoratthalakkhaliapāikkaṃ/
pāikkāvaliagāṃ gābhajjantarahasaṃkulaṃ valaï valaṃ//'' iti setuprayogāt/
hā dhik! hā dhik! samameva harṣodvegasambheda upanataḥ/ harṣasya madayantikālābhāt, udvegasya duḥkhakṣobhasya ca rakṣipuruṣābhiyogaśravaṇāt, sambhedo miśratā, upanataḥ prāptaḥ/
dhīratayā vigatasambhramaḥ aucityānullaṅghanāya navavadhūṃ satkaroti sakhīti suhṛdbhāryātvādāmantraṇam la ``tava kṛṣṇa! priyā sakhī'' iti mahābhāratokteḥ/ svāgataṃ śobhanamāgamanaṃ, tavāsīditi śeṣaḥ/ anugṛhītaṃ ślāghyasambandhāyāstavānupraveśena śobhitam, asmadgṛhamasmākaṃ bhavanamityuktiḥ prāṇanirviśeṣasya suhṛdo makarandasyāpi svapitarāveva pitarau svagṛhameva ca gṛhaṃ, svasyāpi tatpitarāveva tadgṛhameva ceti prakāśayitum/ atha tāsāmudvegamupapattyā śamayati - nanuravadhāraṇe/ bhavatyaḥ madayantikādayaḥ svasthā nirvikāracittāḥ/ tāsāmasvāsthyahetumāśaṅkāmudbhāvya pariharati - ekākino'sahāyasya bahubhiḥ viruddhapuruṣairabhiyogaḥ sanniruddhatvamityayaṃ prakāro nanu bhavatīnāmāśaṅkāspadamityarthaḥ/ etadidaṃ vastu/ vayasyasyetyarthāntarasaṅkramitavācyena dhvaninā balavattvaṃ kṛtaśramatvaṃ dhīratvaṃ ca dhvanyate/ yatkiñciditi kṣudratvādavajñāpadam/ ataḥ iyaṃ śaṅkā na kartavyeti bhāvaḥ/
uktamarthaṃ dṛṣṭāntena samarthayati - harerityādi/ hareḥ siṃhasya atulavikramapraṇayalālasasya tulā lakṣaṇayā sādṛśyaṃ tadrahitasya vikramasya paraparibhavasya praṇaye praṇayane, prayoga ityarthaḥ, lālasasya kautukinaḥ āhave yuddhe sahāyatvena yaḥ prasiddhaḥ sa eva nānyaḥ kaścidityarthaḥ, kvaṇatkararuhapracaṇḍaḥ asitapāṣāṇakuṭṭanapravṛttaniśitaṭaṅkasaṅghātaraṇitaśaṅkāvahaṃ śabdāyamānaiḥ nakharairbhayaṅkaraḥ sakhā sahāyaḥ bhavati/ kvaṇatkararuhatvahetumāha - sphurati śobhamāne karaṭakoṭare kapolakuhare/
``karaṭo durdurūṭe syādbilve kākebhagaṇḍayoḥ/''iti vaijayantī/ skhalitena giritaṭa iva nirjhareṇa kaṭhinaviṣamavikaṭatayā aviśramya pravṛttena dānena madajalena/ ``dānaṃ hastimade'pi ca'' iti vaijayantī/ siktānanānāmabhivṛṣṭamukhānāṃ dvipeśvarāṇāṃ gajayūthapatīnāṃ śirasi sthitasya kaṭhinasyāsthno dalane vidāraṇe ekavīraḥ advitīyaḥ vikrāntaḥ, etatkāryaṃ kartuṃ dvitīyasyābhāvāt, karo hastaḥ/ ato'syāpi hastamātra evāpekṣā, na punaḥ sādhanāntare/ bahuṣu ca tṛṇavatpratipattirityarthaḥ/ atra vyatirekamukho dṛṣṭānto'laṅkāraḥ, sarveṣāṃ bimbapratibimbabhāvena nirdeśāt//7//
tad yasmānna sahāyāpekṣā tasmād, ahamapītyapinā sāhāyyāvakāśo na vidyata iti dyotyate/ vikrāntipūtaṃ vikrameṇa śuddhaṃ, nirvyājatvād, vilasataḥ krīḍataḥ, priyasuhṛda iti tathāpi snehakātaratayā tadvikramāvalokanakutūhalācca, pratyanantarībhavāmi samīpavartī bhavāmīti dyotayati/
vikaṭaṃ svabhāvagateḥ parityāgena vikṛtam/
api nāma anaghau nivartiṣyete etau mahānubhāvau/ etau mādhavamakarandau anaghau aghaṃ vyasanaṃ tadrahitau, ``duḥkhainovyasaneṣvagham'' iti vaijayantī/ sulabhāpāyatvāt saṅgrāmasya apāyaśaṅkitvācca snehasyeyaṃ sambhāvanā/
tadvacanena viṣaṇṇā āha - sakhyau! buddharakṣitāvalokite! tvaritaṃ gatvā bhagavatyai imaṃ vṛttāntaṃ nivedayatam/ imaṃ rakṣipuruṣābhiyogarūpam/ kāmandakyāḥ ``śāpādapi śarādapi'' pratikartṛtvaṃ niścityeyamuktiḥ/ tvamapi priyasakhi lavaṅgike! tvaritaṃ vijñāpayāryaputraṃ ``yadi tāvadyuṣmākaṃ vayamanukampanīyāstato'pramattāḥ parākramadhva''miti/ yuṣmākamiti bahuvacanaṃ bhartṛgauravāt/ yadyanukampanīyā rakṣaṇīyāḥ/ vayamiti bahuvacanena bhavadapāye nāhaṃ jīvāmi/ āvayornidhane kuladvayaṃ tatsambandhinaśca vinaṅkṣyantīti dyotayati/ yuṣmākamiti ``kṛtyānāṃ kartari vā'' (2-3-71) iti ṣaṣṭhī/ tatastena hetunā, apramattāḥ avahitāḥ parākramadhvaṃ śatrumadhye śauryaṃ prakāśayateti/ anyathā paraśastrāpātaprasaṅgāditi bhāvaḥ/ atra śaṅkākhyo bhāvo bhayānakarasaśca dyotyate/
sarvā iti avalokitābuddharakṣite lavaṅgikā ca/
niṣkrāntāḥ/ madayantikāmālatyau tiṣṭhata ityarthaḥ/
bhayaśaṅkājanitārativyākulitāha - hā dhik! hā dhik/ na jñāyate kathaṃ velā gamanīyeti kena prakāreṇa kālo nīyatāmiti/ bhavatviti kasyacit kālakṣepopāyasya cintitatvam/ tadevāha - priyasakhyā lavaṅgikāyāḥ pratinivṛttimārgamavalokayantī sthāsyāmi/ priyatamasakāśaṃ preṣitatvāt tadvṛttāntaśravaṇatvarayā lavaṅgikāyā grahaṇam/ pratinivṛttimārgamiti dūrato dattadṛṣṭitvāttatraivāhitacittatayā kiñcidaratyupaśamaṃ sūcayati/ parikrāmantī madayantikāsakāśādanyato gacchantīti/ atra buddhadarakṣitādīnāṃ niṣkrāntatvānmadayantikāyā viprakarṣācca ekākinītvaṃ nāyikāyāḥ kavinā pratipāditaṃ chidrānveṣiṇyā kapālakuṇḍalāyāḥ avakāśalābhārthamiti mantavyam/ atha ``dhīraḥ praśāntaḥ sāpāyadharmakāmārthasādhakaḥ/''iti prakaraṇanāyakasya lakṣitatvād duḥkhaśabalasukhaprāptiṃ mādhavasya pratipādayituṃ priyatamāprāptinirvṛtasyāsya niratiśayaṃ duḥkhahetumavatārayati matibalavijitasuragurumativibhūtirbhavabhūtiḥ/ sāśaṅkamiti kinnu samāpatiṣyatyamaṅgalamityāśaṅkāsahitā, priyatamāpāyaśaṅkāyā manasi prāgeva vartamānatvāt/ kathaṃ sphuritaṃ khalu me avāmalocanena dakṣiṇanayanena sphuritaṃ, bhāvitaṃ spanditaṃ la bhāve niṣṭhā/ kathamiti daivasya jhaṭiti prātikūlyaṃ sambhāvyāścaryatvamanusandhatte/ strīpuṃsayoḥ krameṇa vāmadakṣiṇākṣyādisphuraṇasya śubhasūcakatvādvyatyāse tvaśubhasūcakatvācca avāmagrahaṇam/ upaviśati viṣādavivaśatayā kṣitau niṣīdatītyarthaḥ/
praviśya na tu praviśatītyuktiḥ chidralābhe jhaṭiti praviṣṭatvaṃ dyotayati/ anena ``mādhavāpakāraṃ pratyabhiniviṣṭā bhavāmī''ti pūrvoktaṃ saṅghaṭayati/ ā iti kope/ pāpe iti svaguruvadhapātakamūlatvāt/ tiṣṭha tiṣṭhetyuktyā karālāyātanadṛṣṭāyā duṣṭāyā darśanāt sabhayamapasaraṇodyogaḥ prakāśyate, anyathā upaviṣṭāyāstiṣṭhetyuktyanupapatteruttiṣṭheti vaktavyam/
hā āryaputra/ āryaputreti paritrāṇāya krandanārambhaḥ/ vākstambhaḥ vāco'prasaraṇaṃ, tatprabhāvāt trāsādvā/
sakrodhahāsaṃ krodhena yo hāsaḥ tadīyaceṣṭāvaiyarthyādviḍambanahasitaṃ tatsahitam/ nanuḥ praśne, kimākrandasītyarthaḥ/ tarhi ākrandākranda, patiriti vakṣyamāṇatvād arthāt patimiti siddhyati, āhvayāhvayetyupahāse vīpsā/ vāk tāvanmayā stambhitā, kathamidānīṃ tvayā krandyata iti bhāvaḥ/
svapravṛtteḥ sakāraṇatvakhyāpanāya pūrvavairamudghaṭṭayati - tvadvatsala ityādi/ tvadvatsalaḥ tvayi snigdha iti tvanmūlatvāt madguruvadhasya tvannirasanenaiva tannirasanamapi kṛtaṃ bhaviṣyatīti dyotayati/ tapasvijanasya praśastatapoviśiṣṭasya puruṣasyeti tasya liṅgitvādavadhyatvaṃ dhvanati/ ``brāhmaṇyāḥ striyaḥ kanyāyā mama vadhopakrame hataścet ko'parādhaḥ'' iti cet tatrāha - hanteti/ tathāpi tvadrakṣaṇameva yuktaṃ na punastasya devatopahārarūpasvadharmodyatasya vadha iti bhāvaḥ/ doṣāntaramapi tasya daṇḍyatve heturityāha - kanyāviṭaḥ pitrā svayaṃ aprattāyāḥ kumāryā bhoktā/ viṭa ityanena rasamātraśaraṇatvaṃ dharmānapekṣatvaṃ ca dyotayati/ patiḥ paścāt balātkāreṇa kāmandakyādiyatnaiśca bhartā kṛta ityarthaḥ/ patiḥ kva nu kasmin deśe, vartata iti śeṣaḥ/ asau sa tvāṃ parirakṣatu/ kāmacārakaraṇe sampraśne vā loṭ/ sotprāśaṃ cedaṃ vacanam/ tasyāsannidhānaṃ paricchidyaivāhamāgatā, tat kva nu tvaṃ, kva cāsāviti bhāvaḥ/ tadeva spaṣṭīkaroti - nanurāmantraṇe/ cirād bahoḥ kālāt, evaṃvidho'vakāśaḥ kadā bhaviṣyatīti sadā jāgaraṇena pratīkṣitatvādityarthaḥ/ kabalīkṛtāsi kabalaṃ grāsaḥ kṛtāsi na tu kriyase kariṣyase veti prāṇaparityājane na kaścididānīṃ saṃśaya iti dhvanati/ ataḥ śyenāvapātacakitā suparṇāyā avapātenākramaṇena trastā/ ``vyāghrāṭastu bharadvājaḥ kṣipraḥ śyenaḥ suparṇakaḥ/
śyenāyāṃ prācikā''ṃ... ... ... ...//
iti vaijayantī/ navavartikā bālavartikā/ navagrahaṇaṃ bhīrutvadaurbalyātiśayaṃ sūcayati/ ``vartikā caiva varāṭaśceti viṣkirāḥ'' iti saṅgrahe viṣkirākhyapakṣijātibhedatvenoktā/ ``śyeno vartikāmullāpayate'' iti vṛttāvapyudāhṛtam/ kiṃ ceṣṭase kimarthaṃ vyāpriyase/ upamānena vartikāpi kṣaṇaṃ sphurati, na tu śyenāto mucyate, pratīkārābhāvāt la tathā tvamapīti dyotayati/ atra parikara upamā cālaṅkāraḥ//8//
yāvadvākyālaṅkāre'vadhāraṇe/ śrīparvatamupanīyeti kāmandakyādīnāṃ dūratve nivāraṇāśaktyarthamuktiḥ/ ``siripavvadādo āadassa'' iti śrīparvatasyaiva niyatanivāsasthānatayā pūrvaṃ sūcanācca/ ``sā dāṇiṃ saudāmiṇī samāsādiaccariamantasiddhippahāvā siripavvade kāvālāṃ vidaṃ dhāredi'' iti prathamāṅkoktatvāt mālatīparitrāṇopayuktaṃ saṃvidhatte/ tilaśaḥ tilavat sūkṣmaḥ sūkṣmaḥ khaṇḍo yathā bhavati tathā nikṛtya chitvā/ duḥkhamāriṇī atikṛcchrānubhavena martuṃ śīlaṃ yasyāḥ/ citravadhayogyatvād guruvadhanimittatayeti bhāvaḥ/ mālatyā saheti mālatīmutkṣipya gaganatalotpatananāṭitakena niṣkrāntetyarthaḥ/
ahamapi mālatīmanugamiṣyāmi/ ahamapi mālatī tāvallavaṅgikāmanugatā/ ahamapi mālatīmanugamiṣyāmītyanena mālatīharaṇavṛttāntasya aparijñānatvaṃ dhvanati/ sakhi mālatīti tasyāḥ sannihitatvābhiprāyeṇāmantraṇam/
madayantike! lavaṅgikā khalvaham/
api sambhāvitastvayā mahānubhāvaḥ/ apiḥ praśne/ sambhāvitaḥ mālatīvacanena satkṛtaḥ/ mahānubhāvaḥ mādhavaḥ/
nahi nahi, sambhāvita iti sambadhyate/ vīpsayā viṣādo dhvanyate/ sa khalūdyānāvarohanirgamādeva kalakalaṃ śrutvā sāvakṣepadūranikṣepāviddhavikaṭorudaṇḍanirbharaṃ pradhāvya parānīkaṃ praviṣṭaḥ/ udyānāvarohaḥ udyānasyonnatasthalatvāt tatsopānād yo'varoho'vataraṇaṃ tena yo nirgamo vīthyāṃ niṣkramaṇaṃ tata eva pradhāvya palāyyeti sambandhaḥ/ tasya hetuḥ - kalakalaṃ śrutvā sainyasaṅkuladhvaniṃ śrutveti/ sāvakṣepeṇa cittavaiyyākulīsahitena dūranikṣepeṇa anyonyaviprakṛṣṭena padanyāsena āviddhābhyāṃ kampitābhyāṃ vikaṭābhyāṃ viśālasvabhāvābhyāṃ ūrudaṇḍābhyāṃ, nirbharaṃ gurutaramiti pradhāvanakriyāviśeṣaṇaṃ, parānīkaṃ śatrubalam/ anena suhṛdgatabhāvaparavaśatvaṃ vīrarasaśca dhvanyate/ tataḥ pratinivṛttāsmi mandabhāginī/ tatastatprāpteraśakyatayā/ mandabhāgyeti viṣādaḥ/ śṛṇomi ca gṛhe gṛhe guṇānurāganirbharasya pauralokasya ``hā mādhava! makaranda! sāhasike''ti paridevanāḥ/ mādhavamakarandagatasauśīlyādiguṇaviṣayeṇa snehena pūrṇasya pauralokasya purabhavajanasya, tayoḥ tatra cirasaṃvāsāt/ heti viṣāde, dvayorbahubhirabhiyoge vyasanaṃ niścityetyarthaḥ/ sāhasiketi vyasanāgamahetusūcanam/ mālatīmadayantikāhaṭhaharaṇarūpasya avicāritakāritvasya rājāmātyakopahetutvādapratīkāratvamanarthasyeti bhāvaḥ/ itiśabdaḥ prakāre, evaṃprakārā ityarthaḥ/ paridevanā vilāpavacanāni/ suṇāmi a ghare ghare ityādi varṇasaṃhāraḥ, sarvavarṇavacasā nāyakaguṇastavāt/ mahārājo'pi kila vadhvorvipralambhavṛttāntaṃ śrutvā sañjātamatsarāvegaḥ tatkṣaṇavisarjitānekapādātanivahaḥ candrātapena saudhaśikharasthitaḥ prekṣyata iti mantryate/ mahārājaḥ padmāvatīśvaraḥ/ apiśabdādrājñā vijñāto'yamarthaḥ ato'narthodarka iti dyotayati/ kileti vārtāyām/ vadhvormālatīmadayantikayoḥ vipralambhavṛttāntaṃ pratāraṇarūpāṃ pravṛttiṃ, mālatīveṣabhūṣitena makarandenaiva dvayo kanyayorapahāre dvārīkaraṇāt, sañjātamatsarāvegaḥ udbhūtākṣamākṣobhaḥ, svakṛtasya dānasyānyathākaraṇāt/ visarjitānekapādātanivahaḥ ``gacchata gacchata/ durācārau brahmabandhū ghnate''ti bhūyo bhūyaḥ preṣitā asaṅkhyāḥ pādātasamūhā yena/ ``ātatāyinamāyāntamapi vedāntapāragam/
jighāṃsantaṃ jighāṃsīyānna tena brahmahā bhavet//'' iti vacanād, anayośca dāraharatvena ātatāyitvāditi bhāvaḥ/ candrātapena prekṣaṇe karaṇabhūtena, madhyāhna iva spaṣṭadṛśyasakalavṛttāntatvāt/ mantryate kathyate, pauralokeneti śeṣaḥ/
rājñā parijñātatvādavyabhicaritaṃ vyasanaṃ niścityāha - hā hatāsmi mandabhāginī/
adarśanāt pṛcchati - sakhi! mālatī punaḥ kva/ punaḥśabdo vyāvṛttau, ayaṃ vṛttāntastāvadāstām, idaṃ tu kathayetyarthaḥ/
sā khalu prathamameva te mārgamavalokayituṃ prasṛtā/ paścādahaṃ na ca tāṃ paśyāmi/ prathamameva mamāgrata eveti, anantaritatvamāha/ paścāt tasyā anupadaṃ ahaṃ prasṛtā pravṛtteti sambaddhyate/ cakārastulyakālatvādadarśanasya āścaryatvaṃ dyotayati/ mā nāma udyānagahanaṃ praviṣṭā bhavet ṛ udyānasya gahanaṃ tarulatānibiḍatayā satimiraṃ pradeśaṃ, tvadanugamanamārgāparijñānāditi bhāvaḥ/ praviṣṭā bhavennāmeti kākvā praśna ākṣipyate/ sambhāvanāyāṃ liṅ/ nāmaśabdo'pi sambhāvanādyotakaḥ/ ``mā no nā pratiṣedhe''/
sabhayāha - sakhi tvaritamanviṣyāvaḥ/ tatsambhāvanāmupapattyā nirākaroti - atikātarā me priyasakhī/ upavanasthitimasminnavasare sā na karoti/ atikātarā atyantabhīruḥ/ me priyasakhīti tacchīlaṃ mayaiva jñāyate saṃvāsāt, na tu tvayeti dyotayati/ asminnavasare niśīthe parijanarahite ca kāle ityarthaḥ/ upavanasthitiṃ iti timirabahulatayā bhayajanakatvam/
sakhi mālati! nanu bhaṇāmaḥ sakhi mālatīti/ nanu bhaṇāma iti pūrvasmāduccaiḥśabdenāhvayāvaḥ, tathāpi tvaṃ prativacanaṃ na dadāsīti serṣyaṃ vacanam/
hṛṣṭaḥ harṣaṃ nāṭayanniti yāvat/ diṣṭyā kuśalenāsmi nirgataḥ saṅghaṭṭadurgamāt/ diṣṭyā daivānukūlyeneti hetau tṛtīyā/ kuśalena akṣataśarīratvādinā abhyudayenetyupalakṣaṇe/ saṅghaṭṭadurgamāt janasammardena sañcaritumaśakyāt pradeśāt/ ``hīmāṇahe ṅa'' iti hīnapātrāṇāṃ harṣāścaryavacanena deśīpadam/ paśyāmīva nirmalanirantaroddhūyamānottaraṅgakaravāladhārāpratiphalitacandrakiraṇajālapiñjarībhavanaśīladarśanaṃ madalīlākalitakāmapālavikaṭabhujadaṇḍāviddhahalahelākarṣaṇataralitodvellitataraṅgakalindakanyakāsrotaḥsannibhaṃ viśṛṅkhalāvapatitanirdayāvamardamakarandavyatikarakṣobhavihvalaṃ pratinivartanodgatasamastagaganāvakāśavikasatkalakalaṃ pādātasamūham/ paśyāmīva purato vartamānamanubhavāmīveti/ ivaśabdo'tikrāntatvāt/ nirmalānāṃ śāṇottejitatvena niṣkalaṅkānāṃ nirantaraṃ nirvivaraṃ uddhūyamānānāmutkampyamānānāṃ khāḍgikabāhulyād uttaraṅgāṇāṃ udgatataraṅgāṇāṃ, kampanavegena sphuritavalībhaṅgatvāt, karavālānāṃ khaḍgānāṃ dhārāsu mukhataikṣṇyeṣu pratiphalitena candrakiraṇajālena piñjarībhavanaśīlaṃ darśanaṃ yasya, piñjaravarṇatayā dṛśyamānamityarthaḥ/ nīlasitavarṇayoḥ khaḍgadhārācandrakiraṇayormelanāt piñjaravarṇatvoktiḥ/
``sitanīlasamāyogāt kaḍāro nāma jāyate/''iti divākaraḥ, ``pītaraktastu piñjaraḥ/ vabhruḥ kaḍāraḥ kapilaḥ'' iti vaijayantī/ madalīlākalitasya vāruṇīmadajanitavilāsayuktasya kāmapālasya balabhadrasya, ``revatīramaṇo rāmaḥ kāmapālo halāyudhaḥ/''ityamaraḥ, vikaṭena vistṛtena bhujadaṇḍenāviddhaṃ halaṃ sīraṃ yat, tena halayā anāyāsena yat karṣaṇamākṛṣṭistena taralitaṃ vyākulīkṛtaṃ, ata evodvellitataraṅgaṃ yat kalindakanyāsroto yamunāyāḥ pravāhaḥ, tatsadṛśamityanena balīyaso'pi vyākulatvaṃ bahudhā palāyanaṃ bahalanīlatvena dūrato niśi prakāśanatvaṃ ca dyotyate/ atra ca purāṇakathānusmāryate/ yathā ``samadākrāntigharmāmbhaḥkaṇikāmauktikojjvalaḥ/
āgaccha yamune snātumityāha madavihvalaḥ//
tasya vācaṃ nadī sā tu manvānā mattabhāṣitam/
nājagāma tataḥ kruddho halaṃ jagrāha lāṅgalī//
gṛhītvā tāṃ taṭe tena cakarṣa madavihvalaḥ/
pāpe! nāyāsi nāyāsi gamyatāmicchayānyataḥ//
sā kṛṣṭā tena sahasā mārgaṃ santyajya nimnagā/
yatrāste baladevo'sau plāvayāmāsa tadvanam//'' iti śrīviṣṇupurāṇavacanāt/ viśṛṅkhalāvapatitasya gatyabhāvāt śarīraparitrāṇayantraṇārahitaṃ pratyabhiyuñjānasya, ata eva nirdayaḥ kāruṇyarahitaḥ avamardaḥ śatrujanavimardanaṃ yasya, ``api pañcaśataṃ śūrā mṛdnanti mahatīṃ cabhūm/
api vā pañca ṣaṭ sapta maraṇe kṛtaniścayāḥ//'' iti mahābhāratokteḥ/ makarandasya vyatikarakṣobheṇa vṛttāntajanitena sambhrameṇa vihvalaṃ paravaśam/ anena bhagnasya punaḥ senāpatyādiyatnādvā lajjayā vā punarvartanam/ pratinivartane udgata udbhūtaḥ, samaste gaganāvakāśe vikasan vyāpya vartamānaḥ kalakalaḥ utsāhasūcakassiṃhanādakolāhalo yasya, pādātasamūhaṃ paśyāmīveti/ smarāmi ca bhīṣaṇabhujavajrapañjarajarjaritaparyastasubhaṭasārthavimuktavividhāyudhopamardāpasṛtasainyavikaṭāpasāravyatiriktamārgasañcāranirmitaviṣamasāhasaṃ nāthamādhavam/ bhayaṅkareṇa bhujarūpeṇa vajrapañjareṇa vajraratnaghaṭitakulāyena, paraśastrābhedyatvāt svayaṃ parabalabhedanatvācca vajrapañjararūpeṇa, jarjaritaiḥ prahāraśataśakalitaiḥ paryastairavapātitaiḥ subhaṭasārthairvīrasamūhaiḥ vimuktānāṃ vividhānāṃ āyudhānāṃ khaṅgā[ḍgā]dīnāmupamardena sambādhena apasṛtairdūraṃ palāyitaiḥ sainyaiḥ senācarairvikaṭāpasāre vistṛtanirgamasthale vyatirikte janaśūnye mārge sañcāreṇa niryantraṇapravartanena, pūrvaṃ janasammardena svairavikramasyānavakāśāt, nirmitaṃ viṣamamanyairduṣkaraṃ sāhasaṃ svaśarīrāpekṣāśūnyaṃ vikramaṇaṃ yena/ nāthamādhavaṃ smarāmi anusandadhāmi cetvanvayaḥ/ atra vīraraso dhvanyate/ sātvatī ca vṛttiranusandheyā, ``vīre sātvatī''ti, ``viśokā sātvatī sattvaśauryatyāgadayārjavaiḥ/'' iti ca vacanāt/ evamanyatrāpyanusartavyam/
aho! guṇānurāgo narendrasya/ yadidānīṃ saudhaśikharasthitaḥ prekṣya dattapratihāravinayopanyāsapratiśamitavirodhaḥ saumyaikarasaḥ upanīya nāthamādhavamaravindamukhaṃ ca makarandaṃ vāraṃ vāraṃ nivāritanijalokakalakalo'bhijanaṃ jñātvā nirvṛttabahumānaḥ sphuranmatsaravailakṣyamaṣīmalinitamukhau bhūrivasunandanau madhuravacanopanyāsena ``kimidānīṃ yuvayorbhuvanābhogabhūṣaṇamahānubhāvābhyāṃ navadarśanaguṇābhirāmābhyāṃ jāmātṛbhyāṃ aparitoṣaḥ ṛ'' iti pratibodhya gato'bhyantaraṃ rājā/ aho āścaryabhūtaḥ guṇānurāgaḥ śauryādiṣu guṇeṣu pakṣapātaḥ, kṛtamahāparādhayorapi satkārāditi bhāvaḥ/ satkāramevāha - yadityādinā/ dattasya prahitasya pratihārasya dvārapālasya vinayopanyāsena asmadīyāvetau mahākulīnāvajñānādaparāddhau/ tat kṣamyatāṃ bhavadbhiriti svān prati asmadīyairajñānādyadapakṛtaṃ tanmarṣaṇīyaṃ bhavadbhyāmityādiśati/ devetyevaṃrūpeṇānuddhatavacanena tau pratiśamitaḥ [virodhaḥ] parasparakalaho yena/ saumyaikaraso vipralambhaśravaṇasañjātamatsarāvegavarjanena prasādaikasvabhāvaḥ/ upanīya svasamīpamānīya/ aravindamukhamityanena saukumāryasaundaryopalakṣaṇena tayordarśane dviguṇānurāgatvaṃ sūcayati/ vāraṃ vāraṃ bhūyobhūyaḥ/ nivārito niṣiddho nijalokasya svasainyajanasya kalakalo bahubandhuvadhāmarṣajanito ``vadhyetāṃ vadhyetā''mityādikolāhalo yena/ asya sarvasya hetumāha - abhijanaṃ jñātvā tatrabhavato vidarbharājamantriṇo devarātasyaikaputro'yam, ayaṃ ca tasya samānānvayajāta iti pārśvacaramukhato mahākulaprasūtiṃ jñātvetyanena bhūrivasorupāyaprayogaṃ sūcayati kaviḥ/ nirvṛttabahumānaḥ sambhūtacamatkāraḥ sphuranmatsaravailakṣyamaṣīmalinitamukhau unmiṣadbhyāṃ madanurodhamantareṇa madduhitā hṛteti krodhena bhūrivasoḥ, lokāpahāsyena mithyāpariṇayena māṃ vipralabhya madbhaginī hṛteti lajjayā ca nandanasya vaivarṇyajanakatvāt kajjalarūpābhyāṃ vivarṇīkṛtamukhatvamityarthaḥ/ athavā dvayorapi mātsaryavailakṣye sādhāraṇe, svakanyāharaṇavañcitatvaṃ tayostulyatvāt/ anenāmātyabhūrivasoḥ svahṛdayasammatyabhāvābhinayavaidagdhyaṃ vyañjayati kaviḥ/ ``vilakṣaṃ ceṣṭate cittaṃ yattadvailakṣyamucyate/'' iti bhāvaprakāśaḥ/ madhuravacanopanyāsena hṛdayaprasādanasya vākyasya prastāvena/ tadvacanaprakāramāha - kimidānīmityādi/ bhuvanābhogasya lokavistārasya bhūṣaṇabhūto mahānubhāvo mahābhijanatvādimāhātmyaṃ yayoḥ, navadarśanairīdṛśānāṃ guṇānāmanyatrādṛṣṭapūrvatayā idaṃprathamadarśanaiḥ guṇaiḥ, abhirāmābhyāṃ sundarābhyāṃ, athavā navadarśanābhyāṃ yauvanaviśiṣṭadarśanābhyāṃ, ``guṇābhirāmābhyāṃ ca navā striyaḥ'' ityādivat, jāmātṛbhyāṃ mālatīmadayantikayorvarābhyāṃ aparitoṣo'tṛptiḥ kimartham ṛ iti evaṃrūpeṇa/ ``jāmātā duhituḥ patiḥ'' ityukte'pi nandanasya jāmātṛtvoktiḥ, ``jyeṣṭho bhrātā pitṛsamaḥ'' iti vacanādanujāyāḥ putrīto viśeṣābhāvāditi mantavyam/ pratibodhyamānaḥ kṣobhaśamanajñānavantau kṛtvā abhyantaramantaḥpuraṃ gato yad yasmāttasmādaho guṇānurāgo narendrasyetyanvayaḥ/ sampātākhyaṃ sātvatīvṛttyaṅgaṃ cedam/ ``mantrārthadaivaśaktyādyaiḥ sampātaḥ sandhibhedanam/'' iti vacanāt, daivaśaktyā rājño nandanād bhinnatvokteḥ/ imau ca mādhavamakarandavāgatāviti yāvat/ bhagavatyā imaṃ vṛttāntaṃ nivedayāmi/ tadanugrahādeva tayoḥ samṛddhyāgamāditi bhāvaḥ/
imāviti sūcitatvāt praveśaḥ/ preyasaḥ priyatamasya mādhavasyetyarthāt/ sarvān puruṣānatiśayitumatikramituṃ śīlaṃ yasya/ nirvyājaṃ chalaprayogarahitaṃ, dharmamanatikramya vṛttatvāt/ nyastaśastrasrastavastramuktakeśatyaktavāhaparābhiṣaktādivarjaṃ pravṛttamityarthaḥ/ ūrjitaṃ utsāhaviśiṣṭam/ tejaḥ paraparibhavākṣamaḥ pratāpaḥ/ tathātvaṃ samarthayati - tathāhi/
dorniṣpeṣetyādi - dorniṣpeṣeṇa tvarayā nirāyudhatvenaiva nirgamād bāhurūpeṇa praharaṇena yat sañcūrṇanaṃ tena viśīrṇasañcayaṃ bhinnasaṃhati dalatkaṅkālaṃ truṭaccharīrāsthi ca yathā tathā/ prāk pūrvaṃ samarārambhe vīrānunmathnataḥ śūrān kṣobhayataḥ anupatya paścād dhāvitvetyanena teṣāṃ palāyanārambhaḥ pratīyate, tatpraharaṇāni teṣāmāyudhāni ācchidya haṭhāddhṛtvā vikrāmataḥ abhimukheṣu parākramaṃ prayuñjānasya, preyasa iti pūrvavākyādāyāti/ udvelladbhirnṛtyadbhiḥ ghanairnirantaraiḥ ruṇḍaiḥ kabandhaiḥ khaṇḍaiḥ śiraḥpāṇipādādiśakalairbahubhiḥ kīrṇasya vyāptasya saṅghodadheḥ samarasāgarasya, vipulabhīṣaṇatvāt sāgaratvāropaḥ, dvedhā ubhayapārśvayordvidhā stambhitayā stambhavad bhayānniṣpandaṃ sthitayā pattipaṅktyā padātiśreṇyā vikaṭo vistṛtaḥ panthā mārgaḥ purastāt purobhāge/ purastādityanena yato yato gamyate tatastatastathābhāvaḥ, pṛṣṭhataḥ punasteṣāṃ pratinivartanena sakalakalaṃ militatvaṃ, punaḥ parivṛtya vilokane palāyanaṃ ca dyotyate/ preyasaḥ purastāt saṅghodadheḥ panthā abhūdityanvayaḥ/ saṅghodadherityanena tuṅgataraṅgabhaṅgisaṅkaṭe taraṅgamālininiravagrahaṃ viharatastimiṅgalādeḥ samādhiḥ sūtryate/ atra vīrarasaḥ pratīyate/ atiśayoktiralaṅkāraḥ//9//
nanuścodye/ anuśayasthānaṃ hanta mayaivaṃ na vikrāntamiti paścāttāpasyāspadaḥ/
``paścāttāpe tvanuśayo dīrghadveṣānubandhayoḥ/''iti vaijayantī/ etanmadīyaṃ ceṣṭitam/ paśya nirūpaya/
adyaivetyādi - indumayūkhakhaṇḍakhacitaṃ saudhaśikharāvasthānena maṇicaṣakavartini madhuni pratiphalatāmindumayūkhānāmapi tasmin pīyamāne svayaṃ khaṇḍībhūya pīyamānatvapratīterindormayūkhānāṃ khaṇḍaiḥ khacitaṃ sambaddhamityuktiḥ, ``induṃ caṣakasaṅkrāntamupāyuṅkta yathāmṛtam/''iti bhartṛkāvyoktavat/ niśīthotsave madhyarātrānuṣṭheye ratotsave nimitte, ratyuddīpanatvānmadhupānasya/ ``nimittāt karmasaṃyoge saptamī vaktavyā'' (vā. 2-3-36) iti saptamī/ līlāparirambhadāyinīnāṃ antarāntarā vilāsāliṅganapradānaśīlānāṃ dayitānāṃ priyatamānāṃ gaṇḍūṣāt mukhapūraṇopayuktāt śeṣamanyat adyaiva yaiḥ pītaṃ sampratyeva te kathayantīti tulyakālatvadyotanāyaivakāraḥ/ bhavadbhujārgalayostvadbāhuparighayoḥ/
``kavāṭamararaṃ tulye tadviṣkambho'rgalaṃ na nā/''ityamaraḥ/ guruṇā mahatā vyāpāreṇa niṣpeṣādinā karmaṇā bhagnānyasthīni yeṣāṃ tairgātraiḥ śarīraiḥ karaṇabhūtairhetubhūtairvā asāravidhurān sāro balaṃ tadrahitatayā nityaduḥkhitān, sāravidhurāniti vā pāṭhaḥ, sārarahitānityarthaḥ/ prāyeṇa bāhulyeneti yatrakutracid yadākadācid yaḥ kaścit sāravān bhaviṣyati na veti dyotayati/ saṃsāriṇo jananamaraṇādiprabandhataraṅgite pravṛttipathe vartamānān/ kathayantīti tatsamarthācaraṇe prayogaḥ/ atrāpi vīraraso dhvanyate/ atra virodho nidarśanā cālaṅkāraḥ, harṣadainyayorbhāvayorviruddhayorupanibandhanāt, svasvahetvanvayasya kriyayaiva kathanācca//10//
smartavyaṃ smaraṇīyaṃ, yāvajjīvaṃ manasānusandheyamiti bhāvaḥ/ turvyāvṛttau, asmābhirasaṃśayaṃ mahānaparādhaḥ kṛta eva, tathāpyasya saujanyāt sa tirohita iti dyotayati/ saujanyaṃ pūjitasya janasya bhāvaḥ, anasūyayā guṇānuraktatvam/ aparāddhayoḥ aparādhaṃ aniṣṭaṃ kṛtavatoḥ/ ``rādha sādha saṃsiddhau'' ityasmādapapūrvāt kartari niṣṭhāyāṃ rūpam/ anaparāddhayorityaparādhābhāvamātraṃ na pratipadyate, kintu kṛtopakārayorivetyarthaḥ sāmarthyāt samarpyate, aparādhābhāvamātre pratyupakārasya garīyaso'nupapatteḥ/ āvayorviṣaya ityarthāt siddhyati/ kṛtopasadanaṃ kṛtaprāvaṇyaṃ, ``vidhivadupasannāya śiṣyāya'' ityādiṣūpasadanasya prāvaṇyavācakatvadarśanāt, ceṣṭitavān ācaritavāniti ``abhijaṇaṃ jāṇia ṇivvattia bahumāṇo'' ityādipūrvoktamanusmāryate/ tat yasmādevaṃ nirvighnamanorathāḥ smaḥ tasmādityarthaḥ/ ehīti tvarāṃ dyotayati/ mālatīsamakṣameva mālatyāḥ sannidhāveva madayantikāyā haraṇasya moṣaṇasya vṛttāntamupāyānuṣṭhānarūpapravṛttiṃ vistarataḥ śabdaprapañcena kathyamānaṃ, tvayeti śeṣaḥ, anubhavāmaḥ suṣṭhujānīmaḥ/ bahuvacanena mālatyavalokitādisahita ātmā parāmṛśyate/
mālatīsamakṣamityukteḥ saprayojanatvaṃ niratiśayarasāvahatvādityāha - kathayatītyādi/ kathayati vadati sati sasmitāyāḥ yathā corasya corāntaradarśanena samānayogakṣematvabuddhyā harṣo jāyate tathā svasāhasatulyasāhasatayā hṛṣṭatvānmandahāsaviśiṣṭāyā ityarthaḥ, mālatyā valitaistiraścīnaiḥ lolaiḥ pratinirīkṣaṇaistaralaiḥ kaṭākṣaiḥ parāhataṃ avalepena sopālambhaṃ, patanāddaṇḍairiva tāḍitaṃ, ullasitatrapāstimitadṛṣṭi, pūrvaṃ svayaṃ dhairyabhāvanayā mālatīcāpalopalambhāt paścāt svayaṃ sāhasānuṣṭhānād udbhūtayā lajjayā astimitā cañcalā dṛṣṭiryasya, ``kṣaṇamabhimukhairlajjālolaiḥ'' ityādiṣu lajjānubhāvatvena laulyasya prasiddheḥ/ athavā stimitā mālatyāmasūyayā niścalaṃ nibaddhetyarthaḥ/ sakhīti mitrabhāryātvāduktiḥ/ namayiṣyati adhomukhaṃ kariṣyatīti lajjānubhāvaḥ, ``evaṃvādini devaṣag pārśve pituradhomukhī/''ityādyukteḥ/ atra hāsyaraso vyajyate/ anumānamalaṅkāraḥ//11//
ayaṃ purovartī, asau saḥ yatra mālatī vartata ityarthaḥ/
praviśataḥ praveśamabhinayata ityarthaḥ/ prakṛtaṃ mālatyanveṣaṇamevānusandhatte/
sakhi mālatīti/ vilokyatāmiti śeṣaḥ/ diṣṭyā punarapi mahānubhāvau dṛśyete/ diṣṭyā bhāgyāditi anyathā snehavaśena nirūpitatvāddharṣaḥ/
kva sā mālatī/ seti yā yuvābhyāmanviṣyate, athavā tṛṣitābhyāmivāvābhyāṃ yā didṛkṣitetyarthaḥ/
padaśabdena mandabhāgye vipralabdhe svaḥ/ arthādyuvayoḥ padanyāsadhvaninā mālatī samāyātīti buddhyā vañcite svaḥ, yato mālatīti bhavantāvāhūtavatyāviti bhāvaḥ/
mandabhāgye ityuktyā sāśaṅka āha - he bhavatyau kathaṃkathamapi atiprayatnena sahasradhā bahumukhacintāvyākulatvāt vidhvaṃsate iva niśīryata iva/ eveti vā pāṭhaḥ/ na vidhvaṃsata iti vā pāṭhaḥ/ atiyatnena dhāryate anyathā vidhvaṃsata eveti bhāvaḥ/ yataḥ yasmādevamataḥ spaṣṭaṃ vyaktaṃ tadvṛttāntaḥ [abhidhīyatāṃ] kathyatāmanyatarakoṭinirṇayāyeti yāvat/
atha durnimittenaivāmaṅgalasya sūcitatvāt kiṃ vā bhavatyorabhidhānapunaruktenetyāha - mama hītyādi/ kuvalayākṣīṃ prati mālatīmuddiśya aviratamaniṣṭaikabuddheḥ abhijanarūpaśīlamādhuryaniratiśayaprematvādibhirīdṛśasya tribhuvanaratnasya svapnalabdhasyeva lābhaściramasmākaṃ na bhaviṣyati, tādṛśasya sukṛtasyāsambhāvitatvād ityaniṣṭe apāye yena kenāpi kāraṇenātyantanāśe ekasminneva buddhirmano nityaṃ yasya, antarātmā hṛdayaṃ anubandhotkampaḥ avicchinna udbhūtaḥ kampaḥ adya patiṣyatyadya patiṣyatīti pratītijanakaṃ calanam, eveti tatphalasyāmaṅgalasyāvyabhicāramavadhārayati, ``satāṃ hi sandehapadeṣu vastuṣu pramāṇamantaḥkaraṇapravṛttayaḥ/'' iti mahākavivacanāt/ vāmaṃ cakṣuśca sphuratīti puruṣasya vāmākṣispandanasyāmaṅgalasūcakatvāt/ anena śārīramapi durnimittamastītyuktam/ etacca mandabhāgye vipralabdhe ityevaṃrūpaṃ bhavatyorvacanaṃ ca kaṣṭaṃ duḥśravam/ iha asmin viṣaye sarvathā sarvaprakāreṇa mānasena śārīreṇa cānimittena tadanuguṇena ca bhavatyorvacanenetyarthaḥ, hato'smi, naṣṭo'smi, tādṛśaratnabhraṃśāditi bhāvaḥ/ vyasanāt priyāviraharūpād garbhanirbhinnabījārthāmimarśanarūpo'vamarśasandhirayaṃ, spaṣṭamabhidhīyatāmityukteḥ//12//
spaṣṭamabhidhatte - tayā khalvito nirgate mahānubhāve avalokitāṃ buddharakṣitāṃ ca bhagavatīsakāśaṃ visṛjya, apramādanimittamāryaputraṃ vijñāpayeti lavaṅgikānupreṣitā/ tata uttāmyantī tasyā mārgamavalokayitumagrataḥ prasṛtā/ paścādahaṃ na ca tāṃ paśyāmi/ tata āvābhyāmatra viṭapāntarāṇi vicitāni tāvad yūyaṃ dṛṣṭā iti/ tāvat tasmin kālāvadhau, spaṣṭābhidhānāt/
nirṇītatadapāyaḥ paridevayate - hā priye mālatītyākāśe lakṣaṃ baddhvoktiḥ/
kimapītyādi - kimapi kimapi anākhyeyaṃ tadvastu śaṅke cintayāmi/ vīpsayā vyasanahetūnāṃ divyānāṃ mānuṣīṇāṃ ca vipadāṃ śaṅkanīyatvamāha/ kimityanākhyeyatvamityāha/ maṅgalebhyo'nyaditi, amaṅgalasyāśubhasya jhaṭiti tattvamavijñāya vaktumayuktatvāt/ ``anyārād'' (2-1-21) ityādinā pañcamī/ uttaravākye yacchabdopādānāt tatkimapi kimapīti pūrvasmin tacchabdaḥ sāmarthyādāyāti/ śaṅka iti mama snehādāśaṅkāmātrametat/ tava tu kalyāṇyāstanna sambhavatīti dyotyate/ tarhi kathamadarśana iti cettatrāha - parihāsaḥ krīḍā ātmāntardhānarūpā viramatu nivartatāmiti prārthane loṭ/ prasaktasyaiva pratiṣedhyatvaṃ tu matto'ntardhāya parihasasi/ na vañcanāvasaro'yamiti bhāvaḥ/ ``vyāṅparibhyo ramaḥ'' (1-3-83) iti parasmaipadam/ caṇḍi! kopane iti ``cirāyita''miti tava mayīrṣyā vidyate'' iti parihāsasya heturdhvanyate/ ``caṇḍī tu kopanā'' ityamaraḥ/ atha viramaṇasya hetumāha - paryutsuko'smi kṣaṇāntaritena tvaddarśanenotsuko'smi yataḥ ato viramatvityarthaḥ/ punaḥ prakārāntareṇa vikalpayati - kalayasi madadarśane kimayaṃ kariṣyatīti jijñāsase/ kākvā kimiti praśna ākṣipyate/ tatkalanamapi nedānīṃ kartavyamityāha - kalitaḥ yāvān yaścāsmi tāvān sa ca tvayā jñāto'ham/ bhūtanirdeśena mahāmāṃsavikrayādipravṛttāvātmanirapekṣastvaddarśanaikadhana iti pūrvameva tvayā ahaṃ paricchinnaḥ/ tat kimidānīṃ piṣṭapeṣaṇenetyarthaḥ prakāśyate/ dehi vācaṃ darśanadānāt pūrvameva sakaladuḥkhanirvāpaṇīṃ sudhāvṛṣṭimiva ``atrāhaṃ sthitā/ mā bhaiṣṭe''ti vācaṃ vitareti/ vāco'pyadānāt sodvega upālabhate - antaḥ śarīrābhyantare vihvalaṃ paravaśaṃ hṛdayaṃ bhramati kiṃkartavyatāmūḍhaṃ sañcarati/ imāṃ madavasthāṃ jñātvāpi vāṅmātreṇāpi māṃ na sambhāvayasi/ ataḥ kimanyat/ nirdayāsi ārtaviṣame'nukampārahitāsīti/ atra karuṇaraso vyajyate/ aprastutapraśaṃsālaṅkāraḥ, adarśanarūpakāraṇamukhena kāryasya svajīvitaparityāgasya sūcitatvāt//13//
hā priyasakhi! kva gatāsi/
kimiti kimarthaṃ avijñāya, tattvamiti śeṣaḥ, vaiklavyaṃ viklavasyādhīrasya bhāvaṃ avalambase aṅgīkaroṣi/
kathaṃ vaiklavyaṃ nāvalamba ityāha - tvamapīti nagaradevatāgarbhagṛhe yenāparokṣīkṛtāni sa tvamapītyarthaḥ/ mādhavasnehaduḥsthitāyāḥ nandanapariṇayaprastāve madviṣayeṇa snehena vivaśahṛdayāyāḥ/ kātaryaceṣṭitāni aprāptibhayajanitāni maraṇādhyavasāyakaraṇaparidevitalavaṅgikāpraṇāmādīni karmāṇi/ atastāni smarato me kutaḥ śāntiriti bhāvaḥ/
astyetat/ etattvayoktaṃ vastviti sarvaṃ mayā pratyakṣīkṛtam/ kintu viśeṣo'pyasti/ bhagavatīpādamūlagamanamapyāśaṅkyate/ bhagavatyāḥ kāmandakyāḥ pādamūlaṃ prati gamanaṃ parabalābhiyuktayorāvayorvijayāśāsananimittaṃ tasyopapatterāśaṅkyate/ tatrāpi na niścayaḥ, tathāpi sarvathā vicāraṇīyamiti bhāvaḥ/ vihārodyānavartinyā bhagavatīvihārasyāsannatvāttadāśaṅkopapattiḥ/ tat tasmād ehi asambhrānta āgaccha/ tatra bhagavatīpādamūla, tāvadavadhāraṇe, paśyāma eva, tāmiti śeṣaḥ/ āśvāsanārthamavadhāraṇam/
etadapi sambhāvyate/ etanmakarandoktaṃ vastu sambhāvyate utprekṣyate/ gatyantarasyāsambhāvyatvāditi bhāvaḥ/
kiñcidāśvastatvāt tatsambhāvayannāha - evaṃ bhavatviti/
vicintyeti manaḥkṣobhakaramanimittamanusandhāyetyarthaḥ/
yātetyādi - yātā gatā bhavet, sambhāvanāyāṃ liṅ/ naḥ sakhī mālatī/ atheti pakṣavyāvṛttau/ yātā bhavatu mā vā, jīvantī eṣyati naiṣyati vā iti/ asmin prakāratrayaṃ - kiṃ bhagavatyā bhavanaṃ yātā bhaved, atha jīvantī atrāgamiṣyati, na veti/ asminnarthe abhiśaṅkito'smi atyantaśaṅkākulahṛdayo'smi/ na punastatra gataiveti vā sukhenāgamiṣyatīti vā manaso me niścaya ityarthaḥ/ kimeṣyatīti kiṃ na vaiṣyatīti kimiti sarvatra kākvā vitarka ākṣipyate/ manaḥkṣobheṇaiva kimapyamaṅgalaṃ niścitya vidhivilasitasya vaiṣamyamutprekṣate - prāyeṇeti, bāhulyena ekāntato'tyantataśca sukhānubhūteḥ kvacideva kasyacideva niravadhikasukṛtarāśeḥ sambhāvyatvamiti bhāvaḥ/ bāndhavasuhṛtpriyasaṅgamādi bāndhavā mātāpitṛsambandhāḥ suhṛdo mitrāṇi priyā bhartṛbhāryādayaḥ taiḥ saṅgamaḥ sahāvasthānaṃ, kārye kāraṇopacārastatkāryamityarthaḥ, sa ādiḥ prakāro yasya, kāraṇaṃ vā/ ādiśabdena gṛhakṣetravittādisaṅgrahaḥ/ saukhyaṃ sukhaṃ svārthe taddhitapratyayaḥ/ saudāminīsphuraṇacañcalaṃ saudāminī vidyuta'' tasyā vilasitamivāsthiramiti lokasvabhāvakathanenāsmākamapīyaṃ daśā bhavati cet kathaṃ nivāryatāmiti matiḥ prakāśyate/ atrārthāntaranyāso'laṅkāraḥ, sāmānyena viśeṣasya samarthyamānatvāt/ saudāminīsphuraṇacañcalamityanena ``nāsūcitasya praveśaḥ'' iti nyāyādanantarāṅke viṣkambhapātratvena praviśantyāḥ saudāminīsaṃjñāyāḥ pūrvaprastutāyāḥ kāmandakīśiṣyāyā yoginyāḥ praveśamapi sūcayati rasasaṃvidhānaprapañcodañcanacañcuḥ kaviviriñca ityaśeṣamatimaṅgalam//14//
mālatīmādhavasyetthamaṣṭamāṅkārthacarcanam/
pūrṇajyotiḥprasādena cakre pūrṇasarasvatī// //aṣṭamo'ṅkaḥ//
//atha navamo'ṅkaḥ//
atha nirvahaṇasandhyupayoginīṃ yoginīṃ viṣkambhapātratvena praveśayati, ``bījavanto mukhādyarthā viprakīrṇā yathāyatham/
ajakyārthamupanīyante yatra nirvahaṇaṃ tu tat//'' iti/ tasya ca sandhyādīni caturdaśāṅgāni/ tataḥ praviśati saudāminīti/
eṣāsmi saudāminī/ asmītyahaṃśabdaparyāyo'vyayaṃ, ``tvāmasmi vacmi viduṣām'' ityādiprayogāt/ saudāminīti nāmakathanaṃ svasyāḥ kāmandakīsambandhena mālatīmādhavānugrahasyāvaśyakartavyatvaṃ dyotayitum/ bhagavata iti parameśvaraparigraheṇa siddhikṣetratayā copacāraśabdaprayogaḥ/ athavā bhagavataḥ parameśvarasyeti sambandhe ṣaṣṭhī/ śrīparvatāt pūrvaprastutāt, ``siripavvade kābālāṃ vidaṃ dhāredi'' iti vacanaṃ saṅghaṭayati/ tatra padmāvatyāṃ saṃstutapradeśadarśanāsahiṣṇoḥ saṃstutānāṃ priyatamāsāhityenānubhūtānāṃ madanodyānādīnāṃ darśanaṃ soḍhumaśaktasya taddarśanasya kṣatakṣāravad aruntudatvāditi bhāvaḥ/ suhṛdvargeṇa makarandādibandhusamūhena/ bṛhaddroṇīti kasyacit padmāvatīsannikṛṣṭasya deśasya saṃjñā, tatratyaḥ śailo bṛhaddroṇīśailaḥ, tasya kāntāro durgaṃ vanaṃ - ``kāntāro vartma durgamam'' ityamaraḥ - tasya praveśaḥ bhṛgupatanādibhiḥ śarīraparityāgahetave ityarthaḥ, praveśamupaśrutya lokataḥ śrutvā tadantikaṃ mādhavasya samīpaṃ anuprayāmi uddiśya gacchāmītyanena taddarśanaikavyagratāṃ pratipādayati/ bho iti lokoktyanusāro vismayadyotakaḥ/ tathā tena prakāreṇa utpatitā gaganaśikharamuḍḍīnā yathā yena prakāreṇa/ eṣa iti yāvadarthaṃ pravṛtteḥ svajigamiṣitapradeśavartitvasyābhinayaḥ, na tu bhūmaṇḍalamātragatatvasya, samudradvīpādyaprasaṅgāt/ giriḥ bṛhaddroṇīśailādiḥ, nagaraṃ padmāvatī, grāmaḥ tatsamīpagato'grahāraḥ, saritaḥ pārāsindhulavaṇādayaḥ, araṇyaṃ bṛhaddroṇīvanādi, vyatikaraḥ teṣāṃ vṛttāntaḥ, parikṣipyate kabalīkriyate karatalāmalakavat, ``gaṅgāsrotaḥparikṣiptam'' ityādiprayogāt/ anena bubhutsitasya mādhavavṛttāntasya tadantaḥpātitvāt kaimutikanyāyena subodhatvaṃ dyotayati/
parikṣepaphalamāha - paścādvilokyeti/ purastādvegena pratiṣṭhamānatvāt paścādityuktiḥ, pṛṣṭhataḥ parivṛtyāvalokyetyarthaḥ/
padmāvatītyādi - padmāvatī nagarī vimalavāryoḥ svacchasalilayoḥ viśālayoḥ vistṛtayoḥ sindhupārayoḥ saritoḥ parikaraḥ tābhyāṃ gātrikābandhaṃ, ``vivekaḥ syāt parikaraḥ paryastiparivārayoḥ/
pragāḍhagātrikābandhe samūhārambhayorapi//'' iti vaijayantī/ tadvyājena uttuṅgānāṃ su[sū]cchritānām saudhānāṃ u[su]dhayā śvetānāṃ mālikānāṃ suramandirāṇāṃ hariharahiraṇyagarbhādidevatāprāsādānāṃ gopuradvārāṇāṃ puradvārāṇāṃ aṭṭānāmaṭṭālayasa[saṃ]jñānāṃ mañcaviśeṣāṇāṃ ca/ ``saudho'strī sudhayā śvetam, ``gopuraṃ syāt puradvāram'', ``aṭṭālayo'ṭṭaḥ kṣaumo'strī'' iti ca vaijayantī, saṅghaṭṭena saṃbhūya dṛḍhādhā[ghā]tena pāṭitaṃ khaṇḍitaṃ ata eva vimuktaṃ svasthānabhraṃśāt paritaḥ pātitaṃ antarikṣaṃ ākāśam/ ākāśasya vibhudravyatvāt sarvamūrtadravyasya saṃyuktatve'pyatrāntarikṣaśabdena bālaistalamalinatādyadhyāsena gṛhyamāṇamupari dūrato dṛśyamānaṃ nabho vivakṣyate/ anyathottuṅgatvavacanavaiyarthyādvarṇanānupayogācca, ``nabhaḥspṛśaṃ dīptamudāravarṇamuvāca cainaṃ gaganaspṛśā raghuḥ/'' ityādiprayogāt/ vimalavāritvaviśālatve utprekṣānimittam, ``svacchavipulatvānnabhasaḥ'', ``śaradgaganatalamiva vilīnam'' ityādiprayogāt/ saudhābhyantareṇordhvamantarikṣasyādarśanaṃ ca vyaṅgyam/ sāpahnavotprekṣātrālaṃkāraḥ, chalaśabdenāpahnavasya ivaśabdenotprekṣāyāśca pratipādanāt, ``yatrollasatphenataticchalenaṣṭamuktāṭṭahāseva vibhāti siprā/'' itivat//1//
anyato vilokyāha - saiṣetyādi/ seti prasiddhiṃ parāmṛśati/ eṣeti purovartitvaṃ, lavaṇeti kācinnadī, lalitāḥ śobhanāḥ ūrmipaṅktayaḥ taraṅgamālā yasyāḥ/ anena jhaṃjhāmārutāvatārataralitasalilatvaṃ dyotyate/ atra hetuḥ - abhrāgame abhrāṇāṃ meghānāmāgamanakāle, prāvṛḍārambha ityarthaḥ/ anena pūrvaprastutasyānantaraṃ prāvṛṭkālārambhaḥ sūcyate, ``bhavanti kakubhaḥ kādambinīśyāmalāḥ'' iti vakṣyamāṇasya ghaṭanārtham/ janapadapramadāya rāṣṭrasya harṣaṃ kartum ``deśe jane janapadaḥ'' iti vaijayantī/ ``pramadasammadau harṣe'' (3-3-68) iti nipātanam/ ``kriyārthopapadasya ca karmaṇi sthāninaḥ'' (2-3-14) iti caturthī/ tatra hetumāha - gogarbhiṇīpriyanavolapamālabhārisevyopakaṇṭhavipināvalaya gavāṃ garbhiṇyaḥ āpannasatvāḥ/ ``catuṣpādo garbhiṇyā'' (2-1-71) iti tatpuruṣasamāsaḥ/ tāsāṃ garbhadauhṛdatvena priyā navolapāḥ vāladarbhāḥ/ ``ulūkastūlapo darbhaḥ'' iti vaijayantī/ sarasasukumāratvānnavolapagrahaṇam/ teṣāṃ mālā ubhayataṭakaccharekhayoḥ prarūḍhā rājiḥ, tāṃ bhartuṃ śīlaṃ yāsām/ ``iṣṭakeṣīkāmālānāṃ citatūlabhāriṣu'' (6-3-65) iti hrasvaḥ/ sevyāḥ ṛtusambandhitvāt grīṣmoṣmaṇo vṛṣṭipātodvegasya viraheṇa nātiśītoṣṇatayā vilāsibhirupāsyāḥ/ upakaṇṭhavipināvalayaḥ samīpavanarekhāḥ ityanena gogarbhiṇīpoṣaṇena bhaviṣyatpuṣṭisūcakatvāt tadātvasukhasevyatvācca janapadapramadahetutvam/ atra svabhāvoktiralaṅkāraḥ, samṛddhimadvastuvarṇanamudāttaṃ vā//2//
saḥ pāvanatvena prasiddhaḥ, bhagavatyā iti mahānadītvena pūjāśabdaprayogaḥ, sindhoḥ sindhupāreti prastutāyāḥ/ dāritarasātalaḥ līlāpātavidalitadharaṇitalaḥ, prapatatyasminniti prapātaḥ, svaprabhavabhūtād gireradhobhāgapatanapradeśaḥ, ``gaṅgāprapātāntavirūḍhaśaṣpam'' itivat/
jalapatanavegaśabdasya bhuvanabhīṣaṇatvamāha - yatratya ityādi/ yatratyaḥ yasmin pradeśe jātaḥ, ``amehakvatāsitrebhya eva'' iti tyap, tumuladhvaniḥ saṅkulaśabdaḥ ambugarbhatayā antargatajalatayā gambhīraṃ gurutaraṃ nūtanasya navasya dhanasya meghasya stanitaṃ garjitaṃ tadvat pracaṇḍaḥ krūraḥ/ paryantabhūdharanikuñjavijṛmbhaṇena samīpagatānāṃ parvatānāṃ gahvareṣu pratidhvanirūpeṇa vyāptatvāt, herambo gajānanaḥ tasya kaṇṭharasitena kaṇṭhagarjitena, kaṇṭharasitasya (vā) pratimānaṃ sāmyam/ ``pratimānaṃ pratikṛtiṃ praticchāyam'' iti halāyudhaḥ/ atra bhagavato gaṇapaterasurasamarasaṃrambhādiṣu pravartamānānāṃ kaṇṭhagarjitānāmupamānatvena mahānadīprapātadhvanerapi tribhuvanavivarapūrakatvamakhilamaṅgalasādhanatvaṃ ca dhvanyate/ upamātrālaṅkāraḥ//3//
``sarjo'śvakarṇaḥ'', ``sarale pūtikāṣṭhakam'' iti vaijayantī/ etadbahulaistarubhiranyaiśca vanyaiḥ gahanā nibiḍāḥ pariṇatamālūrasurabhayaḥ pakvairbilvaphalaivi[rvi]kasitairbilvapuṣpairvā sugandhayaḥ/ ``bilve śāṇḍilyaśailūṣau mālūraśrīphalau'' ityamaraḥ/ araṇyabhūmayaḥ vanasthalyaḥ smarayanti buddhisthān kurvanti/ avanaddhāndhakāreṣu anaśyattimireṣu guruṣu mahatsu nikuñjeṣu latāgahvareṣu guñjat pratidhvanibahalanirhrādamāno gambhīro guruḥ gadgado vikaṭataṭaśilāsphālaskhalananiruddhanirgamaghoṣasrotaḥprasaro yasyāstayā godāvaryā mukharitā vācālitā viśālā vistīrṇā mekhalābhuvastaṭapradeśā yeṣāṃ tān/ dakṣiṇāraṇyabhūdharān vindhyadakṣiṇabhāgarūpadakṣiṇāpathavartitvāddakṣiṇāraṇyamiti daṇḍakāraṇyamucyate, ``tasyāṃ tu daṇḍakāraṇyāntaḥpātī''ti vindhyāṭavīsambandhitvena daṇḍakāraṇyasya kādambaryādiprasiddheḥ la ``pratyudvrajantīva khamutpatantyoṣṭagodāvarīsārasapaṅktayastvām/'', ``atrānugodam'' ityādibhirdaṇḍakāraṇyasambandhitvena ca godāvaryāḥ pratipādanāt tatsambandhino vindhyamālyavadṛśyamūkān parvatān/ madhumatīsindhusambhedapāvanaḥ madhumatīti kācinnadī, sindhuḥ prastutā, tayoḥ sambhedaḥ saṅgamapradeśaḥ prayāgavat, tasya pāvanaḥ śuddhihetuḥ/ bhavānīpatiḥ pārvatīvallabhaḥ ityanena devyāḥ sakalapuruṣārthamātuḥ sāṅgatyena bhuktimuktipradatvaṃ tasya kṣetrasya dyotyate/ bhavānīpatirityatra patyantarapratītiriti yat kaiściduktaṃ tadavicāritābhidhānam la ``śivā bhavānī rudrāṇī śarvāṇī sarvamaṅgalā'' iti naighaṇṭukairumāgauryādipadavad yogarūḍhyā saṃjñātvena paṭhitatvāt, mahākavibhiḥ śatakṛtvaḥ tatra tatra prayuktatvāt, ``nṛttārambhe hara paśupaterārdranāgājinecchāṃṣṭaśāntodvegastimitanayanaṃ dṛṣṭabhaktirbhavānyā/'' ityādāvatiprasaṅgāt/ tathāhi bhavasya patnīti, ``indravaruṇabhavaśarva'' (4-1-49) ityādisūtreṇa ānuki, ``puṃyogādākhyāyām'' (5.1.48) iti ṅīṣi ca bhavānīśabdasiddhiḥ/ ato ``bhavānyā dṛṣṭabhaktiḥ paśupate''rityatrāpi patyantarapratīterdurvāratvād bhavasyetyeva vaktavyāduttaraṅgo'tiprasaṅgaḥ, ``bhaginīpatiḥ'', ``duhituḥ patiḥ'' ityādiprayogabhaṅgaprasaṅgāt la bhavānīpatirityatra bhavasya patnyāḥ patirbhava eveti sāmañjasyena pratīteravāritatvāt, saṃyogādyairarthaviśeṣasmaraṇasya svoktasya vaiyarthyāpātācca/ ``bhavānījāraḥ'' ityukte hi patyantarapratītirityalamativistareṇa/ apauruṣeye puruṣeṇa kṛtatvamantareṇa bhaktānugrahāya svayamāvirbhūte liṅge pratiṣṭhā sannidhānaṃ yasya, ``vanaparvatanadyabdhitīrthakṣetragatānyapi/
darśanasparśanārcābhiryeṣāṃ siddhiranuttamā/
vidyāt svayambhuliṅgāni yeṣu nityaṃ sthitaḥ śivaḥ//'' iti siddhāntasārokteḥ/ suvarṇabinduriti nāmnā kanakavarṇatvāt, sūkṣmatvācca, ``atha svayambhuliṅgāni jharjharāṇi kṛśāni ca/
hrasvāni vātidīrghāṇi nānāvarṇākṛtīni ca''ṃ//
iti tatraivokteḥ, ākhyāyate purāvidbhiḥ kīrtyate/
prastutasya bandhukāryasyāvighnaparisamāpanāya parameśvaraṃ sapraṇāmamāryayā stauti- ``pratibadhnāti hi śreyaḥ pūjyapūjāvyatikramaḥ/'' ityukteḥ/ praṇamya vāṅmanaḥkāyaiḥ prahvībhūya/
jayetyādi - deva! krīḍādīnāṃ dīvyatyarthānāṃ samavāyasthalabhūta! tadeva vivṛṇoti- bhuvanabhāvana! bhuvanānāṃ sattāprada! sadrūpe hyasataḥ kalpitatvamiti bhāvaḥ/ bhagavan! niratiśayajñānaiśvaryādiguṇetyanena sarvajñatvādiko bhuvanabhāvanatve heturuktaḥ/ akhilavarada! vriyante prārthyanta iti varāḥ puruṣārthāḥ, akhilān samastān dharmārthakāmamokṣān dātuṃ śīlaṃ yasya/ anena sakalaniṣkalābhyāṃ svarūpābhyāṃ sarvānugrāhakatvamuktam/ tatra hetuḥ - nigamanidhe iti/ nigamānāṃ vedānāṃ nidhānabhūta! svājñābhūtavedārthānuṣṭhāne hi parameśvarasya prasādo varadatvaṃ ceti bhāvaḥ, ``varṇāśramācāravatā puruṣeṇa paraḥ pumān/
viṣṇurārādhyate la panthā nānyastattoṣakārakaḥ//''ṃ ``veda eva dvijātīnāṃ niśreyasakaraḥ paraḥ/'' ityādismṛtibhyaḥ/ rucira! līlāvigraheṇa manohara! candraśekhara! candraḥ śekharaḥ āpīḍamālā yasya la madanāntaka! netrānalena kāmasyāntakara la ityetābhyāmagnīṣomābhyāṃ nijāśrayābhyāṃ jagadāpyāyanaśoṣaṇahetutvaṃ dyotyate, bhaktābhaktaviṣayamanugrahanigrahaparatvaṃ ca/ ādiguro! brahmādīnāmapi sarvavidyopadeśācāryetyanena ``yo brahmāṇaṃ vidadhāti pūrvam'' ityādikāṃ śrutiṃ, ``aṣṭādaśānāmetāsāṃ vidyānāṃ bhinnavartmanām/
ādikartā kaviḥ sākṣāt śūlapāṇiriti śrutiḥ//'' iti smṛtiñcānusandhatte/ anena pravṛttinivṛttirūpamārgadvayapravartakaśāstrapravaktṛtvena sarvavyavahārahetutvaṃ sarvalokavandyatvaṃ ca dhvanayati/ jayeti prārthane loṭprayogo bhaktiparādhīnatvaṃ dyotayati/ anyathā svata eva sarvotkarṣeṇa vartamānaṃ parameśvaraṃ pratyakiñcitkaratvādanucitatvācca//4//
ayamabhinavetyādi/ ``sānuḥ prasthastaṭaṃ bhṛguḥ'' ityamaraḥ/ navameghadarśanajanitena madena harṣeṇa mukharābhirvācālābhiḥ mayūrībhiḥ śikhināṃ strībhiḥ muktāḥ pravartitāḥ saṃsaktāḥ avicchinnāḥ kekā yasmin/ ``kekā vāṇī mayūrasya'' ityamaraḥ/ śakunibhiḥ pakṣibhiḥ śabalā nānāvarṇāḥ, śakunīnāṃ nānāvarṇatvādvarṣārambhe nīḍārambhasaṃrambhācca, nīḍāḥ kulāyā yeṣu taiḥ anokahaiḥ vṛkṣaiḥ snigdho varṣmā deho yasya/ ``varṣma na strī śubhākāre saumye dehapramāṇayoḥ/'' iti vaijayantī/ bṛhado[ddro]ṇīparvataḥ bṛhaddroṇīdeśavartī giriḥ pūrvaprastutaḥ/ prītiṃ vitarati dadāti, anviṣyamāṇamādhavadarśanopayuktatvādramaṇīyatvāccetyarthaḥ/ svabhāvoktiralaṅkāraḥ//5//
punarvarṇayati - dadhatītyādi/ kuharabhājāṃ kandaravartināṃ atra asmin parvate bhallūkayūnāṃ taruṇatayā dṛptānāmṛkṣāṇāṃ anurasitagurūṇi pratidhvanibahalībhūtāni/ styānaṃ sāndratāṃ, ``styai ṣṭyai saṅghātaśabdayoḥ'' iti dhātorlyuṭ/ ambūkṛtāni saniṣṭhīvāni, (khanitāni hitā ityarthaḥ ṛ), tajjātisvabhāvāt la ``kuharaviharamāṇaprauḍhabhallūkahikvācayacakitakirātasrastaśastrā vanāntāḥ/'' iti murāryuktavat/ ``ambūkṛtaṃ saniṣṭhīvaṃ'' iti vaijayantī/ śiśirakaṭukaṣāyaḥ śiśiraḥ śītalaḥ, anugraḥ kaṭuḥ, surabhiḥ kaṣāyaḥ tuvararasadyotakaśca/ styāyate sāndrībhavati/ sallakīnāṃ latāviśeṣāṇāṃ, ``sallakī tu gajapriyā'' ityamaraḥ/ ibhadalitavikīrṇagranthiniṣyandagandhaḥ gajaiḥ kabalārthaṃ bhagnānāṃ prabhūtatvānmadhye'rdhajagdhamuktānāṃ granthīnāṃ, sāmarthyāt pallavāṅkuraparvaṇāṃ, ``paruḥ parvaḥ pumān granthiḥ'' ityukteḥ, rasasruteḥ parimalaḥ/ vākyadvayena krūratvaṃ hṛdyatvaṃ cāha/ atra svabhāvoktiralaṅkāraḥ//6//
kathaṃ madhyāhnaḥ/ kathamiti sādhyasādhanavyagratayā mārgagatavicitravastudarśanavyākṣepācca kālātikramo na jñāta iti vismayatvaṃ dyotayati/
madhyāhnatvamevopapādayati - tathāhi samprati - kārṣmaryādityādi/ ``kārṣmarye gopabhadrā syāt kārṣmarī kṛṣṇavṛntikā/'' iti vaijayantī/ kārṣmaryāt pūrvāhne sevitād, grīṣmocitasya prāvṛṣi viralitadalasañcayatvād viralacchāyatayeti bhāvaḥ/ kṛtamālaṃ āragvadham/ ``āragvadho rājavṛkṣaḥ śamyākacaturaṅgulāḥ/
ārevatavyādhighātakṛtamālasuparṇakāḥ//'' ityamaraḥ/ tatra hetuḥ - udgatadalaṃ sarvataḥ pallavitam/ koyaṣṭikaḥ śikharyākhyaḥ pakṣī, jalacaraḥ/ ``koyaṣṭiḥ śikharī samau'' iti vaijayantī/ ṭīkate gacchati, ravikaratāpaśāntaye ityarthaḥ, ``tapati prāvṛṣi sutarāmabhyarṇaghanāgamo divasaḥ'' ityukteḥ/ ``ṭīkṛ gatau'' iti dhātuḥ/ tīrāśmantakaśimbicumbanamukhāḥ apa iti jalāśayasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt taṭagatānāṃ aśmantakānāṃ āmroṭākhyavṛkṣaviśeṣāṇāṃ, ``...........śapharyāṃ ślakṣṇapatrakaḥ/
śikhīndrāśmantakāmroṭā... ... ...'' iti vaijayantī, śimbiḥ phalakośī tāṃ cumbati dhārayati paścād bhakṣaṇāya mukhatroṭī yeṣām/ ``śimbikā mudgamaṅgalyavanamudgamakuṣṭhakāḥ/'' iti vāhaṭaḥ/ dhāvanti śīghraṃ vrajanti, apaḥ nadyādijalāni, pūrṇikāḥ pakṣiviśeṣāḥ/ dātyūhaiḥ kālakaṇṭhaiḥ, ``dātyūhe kālakaṇṭhakaḥ'' iti vaijayantī/ timiśasya, ``... ....... nemīye tvatimuktakaḥ/
citrakṛt timiśo nemī... ...'' iti vaijayantī/ koṭaravati vikaṭarandhraviśiṣṭe/ ``niṣkuṭaḥ koṭaro na strī'' iti vaijayantī/ skandhe śākhāprarohasthāne/ ``astrī prakāṇḍaḥ skandhaḥ syānmūlācchākhāvadhistaroḥ/'' ityamaraḥ/ nilīya saṃśliṣya, ātmānaṃ ravikiraṇebhyo'ntardhāyetyarthaḥ/ sthitamiti bhāve niṣṭhā, sthitirgatinivṛttiḥ kṛtetyarthaḥ/ vīrudhi nīḍaṃ yasya tasya kapotasya kūjitamanu śabdasyānantaraṃ, lakṣīkṛtya vā, madhyāhne teṣāṃ kūjanasvabhāvāt, [krandanti] kūjanti śabdāyante, adhaḥ adhobhāge sthitāḥ/
``latā pratāninī vīrudgulminyulapamityapi/'' ityamaraḥ/ ``pārāvataḥ kalaravaḥ kapotaḥ'' iti teṣāṃ viśeṣaḥ/ ``... ... ... hārīte madguḥ kāraṇḍavaḥ plavaḥ/
tittiriḥ kukkuṭo lāvo ... ... ... ...'' iti cāmaraḥ//7//
bhavatviti kāmacārakaraṇe loṭ, kimasmākaṃ kāladausthyāpekṣayeti bhāvaḥ/ tatra hetumāha - yathā yathāvat suṣṭhu ityarthaḥ, prastutaṃ prakṛtamarthaṃ, mālatīvṛttāntakathanena samāśvāsanādirūpamiti yāvat/ ``tadbhavatu/ mādhavamakarandāvanviṣya yathāprastutaṃ sādhayāmī''ti sandhiḥ, punaḥprastutabījāgamānāṃ viṣkambhakāryasiddheḥ tāṃ samāpayati - niṣkrānteti viṣkambhakaḥ/ //iti viṣkambhakaḥ//
athāṅkamārabhamāṇo viṣkambhasūcitasya bṛhaddroṇīśailakāntārapraviṣṭasya makarandasahitasya mādhavasya praveśanamāha - tata ityādi/ sakaruṇaṃ saśokam/
suhṛdavasthādarśanād anubhūyamānamavasthāviśeṣamanusandhāyāha - na yatretyādi/ yatra yasyāṃ pratyāśāṃ adya śvaḥ paraśvo vā drakṣyata iti mālatīviṣayāmāśāṃ nānubhavati (naśabdādivadeva labhai ṛ), kasyacit pramāṇasyāsiddheriti bhāvaḥ/ rahayati no vā athavā na tyajati/ viparyaye viniścayaḥ/ śeṣe etāvadevātra viśramasthānamityarthaḥ/ mohāndhatamasaṃ mūrcchārūpaṃ gahanaṃ tamaḥ, ``dhvānte gāḍhe'ndhatamasam'' ityamaraḥ, praviśati avagāhate/ kiñcidekaṃ, apyartho'dhyāhāryaḥ, guruṃ laghuṃ vopāyamakurvāṇā aprayuñjānāḥ, agocaratvāt/ ``akiñcidapi kurvāṇaḥ saukhyerduḥkhānyapohati/'' iti uttararāmacaritoktavat/ samastapadaṃ caitat/ paśava iva yathā gavādayaḥ kūpādipatitāḥ uttaraṇopāyāparijñānāttatraiva duḥkhamanubhavanto vivartante tathetyarthaḥ la ``paśvādayo'nye vikhyātāstamaḥprāyā hyavedinaḥ/
utpathagrāhiṇaścaiva te'jñāne jñānamāninaḥ//'' iti śrīviṣṇupurāṇavacanāt/ ``paśvādibhiścāviśeṣāt'' iti sukhaprepsāduḥkhaparijihīrṣayostadupāyāparijñānasya ca paśvādiṣvasyācāryaiḥ pratipādanāt/ aho ityasya svapne'pyacintitasya vastuna āpatitatve vismayaṃ dyotayati/ tatra hetuḥ - vidhāturvāmatvād daivasya prātikūlyāt, na punaḥ pauruṣāparādhād, vipadi vyasane parivartāmahe sarvato vartāmahe, āvartanena tiṣṭhāma iti vā/ ime iti draṣṭṛṇāṃ spaṣṭaṃ dṛśyavaivarṇyādikatvamabhinayati/ atra virodha upamātiśayoktiścālaṅkāraḥ//8//
ākāśe priyatamāmabhimukhīkṛtyāha - hā priye! kvāsi ṛ kasmin deśe vartase ṛ avijñātatattvaṃ apasāraṇakāraṇapāramārthyamaviditaṃ yathā, ata evādbhutatamamatyāścaryaṃ yathā tathā ceti kriyāviśeṣaṇam/ jhaṭiti śīghraṃ adattapratīkārakālaṃ apasṛtā ito deśāt satvaraiva palāyitā kathaṃ kena prakāreṇa/ nanuḥ praśne/ akaruṇe/ dayārahite! prasīda dayāṃ kuru, sambhāvaya satkuru, tvaddarśanasyaiva sambhāvanātiśayatvāt//
atha karuṇāspadatvamātmanaḥ samarthayati - priyamādhave ityādi/ priyo mādhavo yasyāḥ iti lokaprasiddha eva tava madanurāga iti dyotayati/ kiṃ kimarthaṃ, mayīti tvadekaśaraṇe niraparādhe cetyarthāntarasaṅkramitavācyena dhvaninā prakāśyate, avatsalā ananurāgiṇī, adarśanapradānādanumāyoktiḥ/ priyamādhavatvamevopapādayati - nanussaṃvāde/ evakāro bhinnakramaḥ/ ahaṃ sa eveti sambandhaḥ/ anandayat samṛddhamakarot/ purā pūrvasmin kāle, svayaṃ pitrādyanapekṣamityakṛtrimasnehatvaṃ dhvanati/ āgṛhītakamanīyakaṅkaṇaḥ svīkṛto ramaṇīyaḥ kaṅkaṇo vivāhakautukaṃ yena, kāmandakīvihārikodyāna ityarthaḥ/ mūrtimān gṛhītaśarīro mahotsavaḥ niratiśaya utsavaḥ kalyāṇam/ mahotsavaśabdena tatkāryaṃ sukhaṃ lakṣyate/ utprekṣayā cirābhilaṣitagrahaṇatvaṃ paramānandahetutvaṃ ca karasya prakāśyate/ utprekṣālaṅkāraḥ//9//
na kevalamanurāgaḥ, kṛtajñatāpi māṃ vyākulayatītyāha - tāvataḥ tatparimāṇasya, yatparimāṇo mālatyāḥ/ madgata iti tacchabdenānubhāvaḥ prakāśyate/ sambhava utpattiḥ/
uktaṃ tasyāḥ snehamupapādayati - sarasetyādi/ sarasamamlānaṃ kusumaṃ tadvat kṣāmaiḥ, kṣāmatvena durbalatvaṃ lakṣyate, anaṅgamahājvaraḥ kāmajanito mahān santāpaḥ, aviratonmāthī avicchinnamunmathanaśīlaḥ, pratikṣaṇadāruṇaḥ kṣaṇe kṣaṇe vardhamānatvānmohādijanakatvācca krūraḥ, soḍhaḥ anubhūtaḥ, matprāptipratyāśayetyarthaḥ/ tataḥ nandanapradānaprasaṅgādāśācchede jāta ityarthaḥ/ prāṇāniti sarvasyāpi prāṇebhyaḥ priyābhāvāt tānapi, tṛṇamiveti teṣu dayālavasyāpyabhāvaṃ dyotayati, mano vidhṛtaṃ hṛdaye sthāpitaṃ, na tu vāṅmātrāḍambareṇa nāṭitamityarthaḥ/ uktaṃ sarvamāstām/ ataḥ paramasmāt kāryādadhikamanyat kimasti/ nirvyūḍhamanuṣṭhitaṃ karārpaṇasāhasaṃ pitrādiṣu mahatsu bandhuṣu samīpato vartamāneṣu tadanumatimantareṇa karasya dānarūpaṃ sāhasaṃ nirvyūḍhamiti yadvastu, ataḥ paraṃ kimiti sambandhaḥ/ yacchabdo vākyārthaṃ parāmṛśati//10//
