punaḥ prakārāntareṇa tadanurāgātiśayaṃ samarthayati - mayītyādi/ māye madviṣaye vigalitapratyāśatvād viśeṣeṇa dhvastā pratyāśā yasyāḥ tadbhāvād, vivāhavidhau nandanavivāhaprastāve, vikalakaraṇaiḥ vikalāni paravaśāni karaṇāni bāhyāntarāṇīndriyāṇi yeṣu, marmacchedavyathāvidhuraiḥ marmāṇi prāṇavāyoḥ viśeṣataḥ sphuraṇasthānāni, teṣāṃ dvaidhīkaraṇe yā vyathā vedanā tathā paravaśaiḥ ivetyāntaratvamātyantikatvaṃ ca duḥkhasya prakāśyate/ ruditairaśruvimokṣaṇasahitairākrandaiḥ/ vikalakaraṇatvaṃ vidhuratve kartṛdharmaḥ ``payo dahatī''tivat kārye uccāryate/ athavā vidhuraśabdo'tra vaidhuryavācakaḥ/ dhīragabhīravidhurādiśabdānāṃ guṇe guṇinyapi vṛtteḥ hetau tṛtīyā/ vyathāvaidhuryairhetubhūtairivetyutprekṣā/ ruditairiti karaṇe tṛtīyā/ snehākūtaṃ snehataḥ kriyamāṇaṃ maraṇābhiprāyaṃ, vyatanod vistāritavatī loke/ ahamapi yastava darśanena kṛtakṛtyammanyatayā sammadasyaiva yogyaḥ so'hamapītyapirvirodhe, pīḍātaraṅgitasammadaḥ duḥkhena sañjātataraṅgaḥ, antarāntarā śabalita ityarthaḥ, sammado harṣo yasya abhūvaṃ āsam/ dayālutvādapāyaśaṅkayā ca pīḍā, svābhilaṣitānulomyācca sammada iti vibhāgaḥ/ tat smarasi nanviti nagaradevatāgarbhagṛhe tvatsākṣika evāyaṃ sarvo vṛttānta iti sūcayati/ dvayoraprastutapraśaṃsālaṅkāraḥ, kāryamukhenakāraṇasya snehātiśayasya prakāśanāt//11//
virodhena vartamānāmavasthāmanusandadhāna āha - aho ityāścarye/ nuḥ praśne/ bho ityākāśe'bhimukhīkṛtya lokamāha/
dalati hṛdayamityādi - gāḍhodvegamantargambhīraduḥkhātiśayaṃ dalati śīryate/ turviśeṣe/ na punardvidhā bhidyate ubhayathā vidīrya na punaḥ patatītyarthaḥ/ vikalaḥ anyadīyavadavaśaḥ, kāyaḥ śarīraṃ, mohaṃ kṛtyākṛtyapratipattirūpāṃ mūrcchāa, vrajati gacchati/ turvākyatraye'pyanukarṣaṇīyaḥ/ vedanāṃ duḥkhānubhavaṃ tu na muñcatītyuktyā kiñcitprabodhaviśiṣṭatvamāha, anyathā sarvendriyavṛttyāghātarūpatvānmohasya sukhaduḥkhānubhavatiraskṛteḥ/ ``tīvrābhiṣaṅgaprabhavena vṛttiṃ mohena sraṃstambhayatendriyāṇām/
ajñātabhartṛvyasanā muhūrtaṃ kṛtopakāreva ratirbabhūva//'' ityukteḥ/ ``kāyo mohaṃ na muñcatī''tyuktiḥ mohaphalasya vaikalyasya jhaṭiti manasa ādhārabhūte kāye sphuraṇāt, ``śokamohau manasaḥ'' iti manomohasya śrutyā pratipādanāt/ jvalayati dīptaṃ karoti, tanūṃ śarīraṃ, ūkārāntastanūśabdo'yam, antardāhaḥ ābhyantaro jvaraḥ/ bhasmasāt kārtsyena bhasitaṃ, ``vibhāṣā sāti kārtsnye'' (5-4-52) iti sātiḥ, na tu karoti/ sarvasyāsya hetumāha - praharati bādhate marmacchedī jīvitaṃ prāṇānna tu kṛntati chinatti/ hṛdayasya dvidhā bhede kāyasya vedanāmocane dāhasya bhasmasātkaraṇe vidherjīvitakṛntane ca duḥkhasyocchedādupakāraśaktatve'pi teṣāmanupakārakatvāt tān pratyasūyā vyajyate/ atrānuktanimittā viśeṣoktiralaṅkāraḥ, dalanādikāraṇasāmagrye'pi dvidhā bhedādikāryānu (pā ṛtpā)dokteḥ//12//
tadāśvāsanavinodanābhiprāyeṇāha - niravagrahaṃ apratibandhaṃ pratikārābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ, daivamiveti sahoktiḥ, daivaṃ yathāsmān dahati tathā tena saha vivasvān sūryo'pi dahatītyarthaḥ/ dāruṇa iti prāvṛḍārambhamadhyāhnavartitvāduktiḥ/ anena viṣkambhasūcitaṃ madhyāhnatvamanusandadhāti/ iyamityabhinayena kālāntarākṣamatvaṃ dyotayati/ padmasarasaḥ padmaviśiṣṭasya jalāśayasya, śākapārthivatvāt samāsaḥ/ parisare arthāt taṭatarucchāyāyām/ hirhetau/
unnāletyādi - unnālasya jalāduparinirgatadaṇḍasya, grīṣmaśoṣitajalatvād, ``uddaṇḍapadmaṃ gṛhadīrghikāṇāṃ'' ityuktavad, bālasyājaraṭhatvāt komalasya kamalākarasya padmaṣaṇḍasya, yadyapyākaraśabda utpattisthānavācakaḥ tathāpi samūhamatra lakṣayati, ``marudullāsitasaurabhakamalākarahāsakṛdravirjayati/'' ityādiprayogāt, mākarandena makarandasambandhinā niṣyandena dhārayā yat saṃvalanaṃ miśraṇaṃ, tato hetormāṃsalasya bahalasya gandhasya bandhurmitrabhūtaḥ/ prāṇayiṣyati āśvāsayiṣyati, mohagrastamiti śeṣaḥ/ puraḥ agre parivartamānaiḥ paritaḥ prasaradbhiḥ, athavā puraḥ prācyāṃ diśi parivartamānaḥ - parito vījamānaḥ iti vyastaḥ pāṭhaḥ prāvṛḍārambhasūcakaḥ paurastya ityarthaḥ/ kallolānāṃ mahatāṃ taraṅgāṇāṃ śīkaratuṣārairjalabindukaṇaiḥ/ ``śīkaro'mbukaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ'' ityamaraḥ/ tuṣāraśabdo'pi binduvācakaḥ, ``vṛttastuṣārairgirinirjharāṇām'' ityādiprayogāt/ tatra sthūlā bindavaḥ śīkarāḥ, sūkṣmāḥ tuṣārā iti vivekaḥ/ jaḍaḥ śītalaḥ/ atra kāvyaliṅgamalaṅkāraḥ, śiśiraparimalāghrāṇasya salilaśīkarasparśasya jīvanahetoḥ padārthatayopādānāt! svabhāvoktistu sphuṭaiva//13//
bhavatviti āśvāsanopāyastāvat kṛto bhavatu/ evamanena prakāreṇa tāvat prathamaṃ, ākṣipāmi anyacittaṃ karomītyarthaḥ/
etasminnityādi - etasmin padmasarasi/ ``kṣīrāśaścāpyasau rājahaṃso raktaiḥ padānanaiḥ/
malinairmallikākṣāste dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ sitetaraiḥ/'' iti vaijayantī/ mallikākṣāṇāṃ pakṣairvyādhūtāni kampitāni sphuradurudaṇḍāni calanmahānālāni puṇḍarīkāṇi sitāmbujāni yeṣu/ bāṣpāmbhaḥparipatanodgamāntarāle netrayoḥ pūrvamāvirbhūtasyāśrujalasya yat paripatanaṃ galanaṃ, paścādudeṣyato yaścodgamo bhāvī tayorantarāle madhyakāle, tadānīṃ netrayordarśanaśaktatvāt pūrvottarakṣaṇayostu bāṣpapihitatvāditi bhāvaḥ/ avirahitaśriyaḥ apṛthagbhūtaśobhāḥ iti darśane hetuḥ/ vibhāgāḥ pradeśaviśeṣāḥ/ samṛddhimadvastuvarṇanādudāttamalaṅkāraḥ//14//
tadukteruddīpanavastupradarśanaparatvāt pratyuta sāvegaṃ manaḥkṣobhasahitamityarthaḥ/
apratipattiḥ maduktamarthamabahumanyamānaḥ ananusandadhāna iti vā/ śūnyamahṛdayaṃ, kiñcidanabhisandhāyetyarthaḥ/ anyataḥ anyasmin pradeśe/ niśvasyeti karuṇānubhāvaḥ/
punarvyākṣeptukāma āha - vānīretyādi/ vānīraprasavaiḥ vetasapuṣpaiḥ/
``śīte'bhrapuṣpo vānīro vañculo vetaso rathaḥ/''iti vaijayantī/ nikuñjasaritāṃ vanyatvād vanalatāmaṇḍapatirohitasrotasāṃ nadīnāṃ āsaktavāsaṃ ābaddhādhivāsanaṃ, surabhīkṛtamityarthaḥ, payaḥ jalaṃ, vartata iti śeṣaḥ/ paryanteṣu tattaṭapradeśeṣu yūthikāsumanasāṃ jātiviśeṣapuṣpāṇām/
``mālatyāṃ revatī jātiryūthikāyāṃ manojjvalā/''iti vaijayantī/ ``striyāṃ sumanasaḥ puṣpaṃ'' ityamaraḥ/ ujjṛmbhitaṃ vikasitaṃ, iti bhāve niṣṭhā/ jālakaiḥ samūhaiḥ, korakairvā/ jālaṃ tu jālakam/ kalikā korakaśca iti vaijayantī/ unmīlatkuṭacaprahāsiṣu vikasadbhiḥ kuṭacapuṣpairdhavalatayā prakṛṣṭahāsaśīleṣu/ ``kuṭaco girimallikā'' ityamaraḥ/ itaḥ prāgbhāgeṣu asmāt pūrvapradeśeṣu gireḥ sānūn taṭānālambya āśritya/ ``snuḥ prasthaḥ sānurastriyāṃ'' ityamaraḥ/ salilātibhārasamudvahanakhedād viśramārthaṃ taṭeṣvavakīrṇairityarthaḥ/ śikhaṇḍitāṇḍavavidhau parimaṇḍalitapiñchabhāratayā ramaṇīyataratvakathanāya śikhaṇḍigrahaṇaṃ, ``viśeṣaṇamātraprayogo viśeṣyapratipattau'' iti vacanādviśeṣyamayūrāgrahaṇaṃ, śikhaṇḍināṃ harṣavaśāduddhatanṛttārambhe naṭānāmiva raṅgapraviṣṭānāṃ, vitānāyyate vitānairupari badhyamānaiḥ vitataiśca dayākhyairvastraviśeṣairiva bhūyaḥ/ kyaṣi yak/ atra svabhāvoktirupamopakramotprekṣā cālaṅkāraḥ//15//
jṛmbhājarjaretyādi - jṛmbhā jṛmbhaṇaṃ vikāsaḥ tayā jarjarāṇāṃ viśīrṇadalānāṃ ḍimbānāṃ mukulānāṃ ḍambareṇa śobhādhikyena/ ``ḍimbaḥ plīhakhagāṇḍayoḥ'' iti vaijayantī/ atra khagāṇḍasāmyāllakṣaṇayā mukulamucyate, ``kadambagolākṛtiṃ'' ityādiṣu golaśabdavat/ ḍimbheti vā pāṭhaḥ la ḍimbhaśabdena śiśuvācinā mukulaṃ lakṣyate/ ghanaśrīmantaḥ sāndralakṣmīviśiṣṭāḥ, kadambapuṣpā yāsu/ śailābhogabhuvaḥ parvatavistārabhūmayaḥ kakubhaḥ diśaḥ, kādambinīśyāmalāḥ, ``kādambinī meghamālā'' ityamaraḥ, tayā nīlavarṇāḥ/ udyatkandalakāntaketakabhṛtaḥ prarohanti kandalāni kandalīkusumāni kāntāni ramaṇīyāni ketakāni ca bhartuṃ śīlaṃ yeṣām/
``jalaprāyamanūpaṃ syāt puṃsi kacchastathāvidhaḥ/''ityamaraḥ/ kacchāstaṭasamīpabhuvaḥ/ āvirgandhasilindhralodhrakusumasmerāḥ āvirbhūtaparimalaiḥ silindhrāṇāṃ lodhrāṇāṃ ca kusumairhāsaśīlāḥ, teṣāṃ pāṭaladhavalasvabhāvatvād adharadantaprabhāvyatikarasādṛśyamiti/ silindhralodhrau vṛkṣaviśeṣau/ na tu silindhraśabdena bhūkandamatrocyate/ ``alināramatālinī silindhreṣṭaṣṭasaha sāyantanadīpapāṭalābhe/''ṃ, ``adhipurandhri silindhrasugandhibhiḥ/'' ityādimahākaviprayogeṣu pāṭalavarṇatvasya parimalatvabahalatvasya ca pratipādanāt/ ``chatrākaśca silindhraśca'' iti vaijayantyāmapi la sa evocyate, anekārthatvācchabdānām/ ``site lodhre mahālodhraḥ śambaraśca'' iti vaijayantī/ tatirvistāraḥ/ bhavatīti prativākyaṃ yojanīyam/ atra svabhāvoktiralaṅkāraḥ, vānīraprasavādīnāṃ varṣāsvabhāvatvokteḥ//16//
atha tadabhipretavyākṣepāgocaramavasthāntaramavagāḍha āha - sakhe paśyāmi, purovartināṃ darśanamavaśyaṃbhāvyevetyarthaḥ/ kintviti pakṣavyāvṛttau/ durālokāḥ ālokayitumaśakyāḥ, tatra hetuḥ - ramaṇīyāḥ pūrvāvasthātaḥ śobhanāḥ, prāvṛḍārambhasambhṛtaśobhātiśayatvāt, tarhi ramyeṣu doṣo guṇeṣvajñānaṃ veti bhāvaḥ, ``yāni sma ramaraṇīyāni tayā saha bhavanti me/
tānyevāramaṇīyāni jāyante me tayā vinā//'' iti śrīrāmāyaṇoktavat/ tat tasmāt kimetat samprati ramaṇīyānāṃ durālokatvarūpaṃ vastu kiṃ, kiṃ nimittamiti na jāne iti vitarkaḥ/ cintitamarthaṃ niścityāha - kimanyat/ anyad vakṣyamāṇādaparanimittaṃ kiṃ, tadevetyarthaḥ/
tadevāha - utphullārjunetyādi/ utphullairvikasitaiḥ arjunaiḥ kakubhai[ḥ] sarjairaśvakarṇaiśca/
``nadīsarjo vīrataruḥ indradruḥ kakubho'rjunaḥ/''ityamaraḥ, ``sarjo'śvakarṇaḥ'' iti vaijayantī/ vāsitasya surabhīkṛtasya, vahataḥ vījamānasya, paurastyasya purastāt pūrvasyāṃ diśi bhavasya, jhaṃjhāvātasya vṛṣṭisahitasya vāyoḥ, ``jhaṃjhāvātaḥ savṛṣṭiḥ syāt'' iti vaijayantī, preṅkholena prakampanena, marudāyattapravṛttitvānmeghānāṃ, skhalitāḥ vyākulitāḥ, indranīlaśakalavat snigdhāḥ, ityupamānenārūkṣanailyaviśiṣṭatvaṃ prakāśyate, ambudaśreṇayaḥ meghamālā yeṣu/ dhārāsiktayā varṣadhārākṣālitayā vasundharayā bhūmyā surabhayaḥ ghrāṇatarpaṇagandhaviśiṣṭāḥ grīṣmoṣmataptāyā bhuvaḥ prathamapatitajaladharapṛṣataseke saurabhodgārasya prasiddhatvāt, ``gandhaśca dhārāhatapalvalānāṃ''ṃ, ``sadyaḥ sīrotkaṣaṇasurabhiḥ'' ityādivacanaiḥ/ prāptā āgatāḥ/ te virahijanaprāṇaharatvena prasiddhāḥ/ ete svalakṣaṇairidānīmabhivyajyamānāḥ, adhuneti cirādipratyayāsādhāraṇakāraṇasya vyāpino nityadravyasya kālasyāvayavitvena sthiratvādavayavānāṃ divasaviśeṣāṇāmāgamāpāyitvenoktiḥ/ gharmāmbhovigamāgamavyatikaraśrīvāhinaḥ gharmasya grīṣmakālasya yo vigamaḥ ambhasaḥ jalopalakṣitasya jaladakālasya ca ya āgamo'vatāraḥ tayorvyatikaraḥ sandhiḥ tena yā śrīḥ śobhā tadvahanaśīlāḥ, athavā śaityoṣṇayoḥ ṛtusandhijanyayordussahatayā varṣātapayoḥ paryāyeṇa sambhavād gharmāmbhasaḥ svedajalasya vigamāgamavyatikareṇa yā bhogyatālakṣaṇā śobhā tadvāhina ityarthaḥ/ atra svabhāvoktiḥ yathāsaṃkhyaṃ cālaṅkāraḥ//17//
uddīpanavibhāvaparipoṣikaluṣitadhṛtiḥ smṛtvāha - taruṇetyādi/ taruṇatamālo bālatvāt snigdhavarṇastamālataruḥ, tadvannīlā bahalā nirantarā unnamanto na tūnnatā, ityanena nānārthasyārambha upari cirakālānuvṛttiśca dyotyate, ambudharā meghā yāsu/ śiśireṇa meghodaravinirmuktatayā śītalena samīreṇa dhutāḥ kampitāḥ vikīrṇā ityarthaḥ, ghanāḥ sāndrāḥ nūtanasya navābhivṛṣṭasya vāriṇaḥ kaṇā yāsu/ avalokayeyaṃ paśyeyamityanavaklṛptau liṅ/ tatra hetuḥ - adhunā tvadvirahavirase'smin kāle, harihetimatīḥ haririndrastasya hetirāyudhaḥ, indradhanurityarthaḥ, athavā vajraṃ, taddhoṣasyāpi virahijanadussahatvāt tadvatīḥ/ madakalānāṃ garvavaśāt sundarāṇāṃ nīlakaṇṭhānāṃ mayūrāṇāṃ kalahaiḥ kalaho yuddhaḥ tadupalakṣitaiḥ parasparaspardhābaddhoddhuraiḥ kekākolāhalaiḥ mukharā vācālāḥ kakubhaḥ diśaḥ, bahuvacanena ``dṛṣṭiṃ pathikaḥ kva pātayatu'' iti nyāyena sarvapathīnatvamāpadaḥ prakāśyate/ ``unnamadambudharā'', ``harihetimatī''riti ca cakṣurdāhadāyitvaṃ, ``ghananūtanavārikaṇāḥ'' iti sparśendriyopatāpitvaṃ, ``nīlakaṇṭhakalahai''riti karṇajvarahetutvaṃ ca prakāśayan ``kathamavalokayeya''mityanena sarvendriyaduḥkhadāyinīnāmāsāmavalokanameva rauravapatanabhairavaṃ, kiṃ punaranubhavanamiti dyotayati/ atra vitarko dainyaṃ ca dhvanyate/ svabhāvoktiralaṅkāraḥ//18//
śokārtiṃ ``abhīṣṭavirahācchāpāt putravittādināśataḥ/
sarvendriyaparikleśaḥ śoka ityabhidhīyate//'' iti bhāvaprakāśaḥ, tanmūlāmārtim/ ``aśrupāto mukhe śoṣassvarabhedo vivarṇatā/
niśvāsaḥ smṛtilopaśca vilāpaḥ stabdhagātratā/
mohāgamo'bhidhātaśca bhūpātaḥ paridevitam/'' ityādyuktavatkāryaprasaramityarthaḥ/
taddaśāṃ nirvarṇyāha - ko'pi anirdeśyaḥ daśāvipākaḥ avasthāyāḥ parā kāṣṭhā/ punaḥśabdo viśeṣe/ ajānatā asyā daśāyā etāvattvamavicārayatā vajramayena etaddarśane'tighṛtavilāyaṃ, vilīnatvābhāvāt/ kuśilanirmitenetyatiśayoktiḥ/ kiletyaparamārthe/ vinodaḥ vyākṣepaḥ/ vinodaḥ kila na tu vinodo noda evetyarthaḥ/ ārabdhaḥ ``ākṣipāmi - etasminmadakale''tyādibhirupakrāntaḥ/ evamanena vartamānena prakāreṇa/ castvarthe/ paryavasitaprāyā samāptakalpā mādhavapakṣapātināṃ sarveṣāmasmākaṃ mādhavapratyāśā/ ``strīnīcādiṣu śoko'yaṃ maraṇavyavasāyadaḥ/
madhyamānāṃ bhavecchoko mumūrṣā mṛtireva vā//
uttamānāmatiprauḍho vivekenaiva śāmyate//'' ityuktanītyā uttamaprakṛterasya śokaḥ kālato vivekena nirvāpayiṣyati/ ataduritairmālatyalābhe'pi mādhavo'smākaṃ pariśiṣyate iti yā pratyāśā setyarthaḥ/ uttamaprakṛterapi kāraṇagauravācchokādīnāṃ asahyatvam/ ``kamavaśamaparaṃ na viprakuryuṣṭarvibhumapi taṃ yadamī spṛśanti bhāvāḥ/'' iti prāmāṇikavacanād, ajādiṣu tathādarśanācceti bhāvaḥ/ sabhayaṃ pāpaśaṅkayā bhayaviśiṣṭam/ pramugdhāṃ mālatīṃ mūlabhūtāmākāśe'bhimukhīkṛtyopālabheta - kimaparaṃ anyat kiṃ, brūma iti śeṣaḥ, niranukrośā nirastadayāsi/
apahastitabāndhava ityādi - apahastaḥ hastasya pṛṣṭhabhāgaḥ, tena prahāro'pahastatvena prasiddhaḥ, ``apahastena prahṛto'pahastitaḥ'' iti lakṣaṇayā paribhūte vartate, avajñātā bāndhavāḥ pitrādayo yayā/ tatra hetuḥ - vihitaṃ kṛtamadyeti ayātayāmatvenāparādhānavakāśaḥ prakāśyate tadevāha - tat tasmāt iha īdṛgavasthe asminnityabhinayaḥ, anaparādhini praṇayabhaṅgarahite priye svayaṃvṛtavallabheti/ sakhīti visrambhabhūmitvāt svena vineyatvaṃ tasyāḥ prakāśayati/ kiṃśabdaḥ kṣepe la ayamiti tatpūrvatvaṃ dyotayati, karuṇojjhitaḥ kṛpayā rahitaḥ, ityanena ``priyatama iti snehena bhavitavyaṃ, sa tāvat tvayi na dṛṣṭaḥ la tad bhavatu nāma la duḥkhita iti karuṇāpi na kriyata ityaho tava nṛśaṃsatva''miti pratīyate/ atra viṣamamalaṅkāraḥ, sāhasakaraṇaniṣkaruṇatvayoraghaṭamānayorekatropanibandhāt la vibhāvanā ca, aparādhākhyakāraṇavirahe'pi karuṇojjhanasya kāryasya pratipādanāt//19//
adyāpīti ciraṃ tathāvasthānāt, nocchrava[cchva]siti na śvāsaṃ muñcati, tasya stabdhatvāt/ muṣitaḥ hṛtasarvasvaḥ, mādhavasyaiva sarvasvatvenābhimatatvāt/
svāvasthāmanusandadhāna āha - mātarmātarityādi/ sarvasyāpi jantorāṃrtisamaye mātṛsmaraṇasyāvaśyambhāvādākāśe svajananīmabhimukhīkṛtyāha mātarmātariti la vīpsayā duḥkhasambhramo vyajyate, athavā mātariti mādhavasya mātaraṃ, punarmātariti svasya cābhimukhayati/ dalati bhidyate/ dhvaṃsate śithilībhavati dehabandhaḥ śarīrasya sandhibandhaḥ, athavā śarīriṇā svena śarīrasya sambandhaḥ, aratyā marmaṇāṃ tudyamānatvāt/ śūnyaṃ nirjanaṃ jagad araṇyaprakhyaṃ aviratajvālaṃ avicchinnadīptakaṃ, ``jvalitikasanta[te]bhyo ṇaḥ'' (3-1-140) iti ṇaḥ, antaḥ dehābhyantare jvalāmi dahanacuṃbitajaratkāṣṭhamiva dīpye/ sīdat klāmyat andhe gāḍhe, ``dhvānte gāḍhe'ndhatamasam'' iti vacanāt, tamasi timire vidhuraḥ paravaśaḥ majjati samudre plava ivāntarnipatati, antarātmā jīvaḥ mano vā/ viśvaṃ sarvaṃ kartavyaṃ jagadvā, mohaḥ cittavyākulatā sthagayati tiraskaroti/ mandabhāgyaḥ īdṛśaṃ suhṛdaṃ labdhvā ciramanena saha sukhamanubhavituṃ yasya daivena na dattaṃ so'lpapuṇya ityarthaḥ, kathaṃ karomi kaṃ prakāramasya prakāratvenānutiṣṭhāmi/ atra ``śūnyaṃ manye jagadi''ti, ``sīdannandhe tamasī''ti, ``viśvaṃ mohaḥ sthagayatī''ti ca vākyatraye phalaikye'pi prakāravaicitryāt, karuṇarasākrāntasya vakturvacanatvācca na paunaruktadoṣaḥ/ atiśayoktiralaṅkāraḥ//20//
``dāho'mbhaḥprasṛtiṃpacaḥ'' ityādivat punarmeroriva patanaṃ tasya nidhanamāśaṅkamāna āha - bho ityākāśe/ lokamabhimukhīkṛtyāha - kaṣṭaṃ ayuktam/ vīpsayā tataḥ parasya kaṣṭasyābhāvaṃ dhvanati/
bandhutetyādi - bandhutā bandhūnāṃ pitrādīnāṃ samūhaḥ/ ``grāmajanabandhusahāyebhyastal'' (4-2-43) iti samūhārthe talpratyayaḥ, talantatvāt nityastrīliṅgatā ca/ tasyā hṛdayasya kaumudīmahaḥ āśvayujapaurṇamāsīprayuktaḥ utsavaḥ, samagraguṇatayā paramānandahetutvāt mālatīnayanamugdhacandramāḥ mālatyā nayanayormugdho navoditaścandraḥ, athavā mugdhaḥ nityakomala iti vyatirekaḥ/ prasiddhasya candrasya mugdhatāyāḥ kādācitkatvāt śaityātiśayahetutvācca rūpaṇam/ makarandanandanaḥ makarandasya nandano yo yaḥ padārthaḥ samṛddhihetuḥ sa sarva evetyarthaḥ/ ``nadi[ndi]grahipacādibhyo lyuṇinyacaḥ'' (3-1-134) iti lyuḥ/ jīvalokatilakaḥ jīvantīti jīvāḥ śarīriṇasteṣāṃ loka ādhārabhūtaṃ bhuvanaṃ, manuṣyaloka ityarthaḥ, tasya tilakaḥ lalāmaḥ uttamāṅgabhūṣaṇatvāt tilakasya bhūṣaṇāntarebhyaścūḍāmaṇivadvaiśiṣṭyāt tadbhāvāropaḥ/ pratīyate astamayate, ataḥ paraṃ kiṃ kaṣṭamityarthaḥ/ atrollekho'laṅkāraḥ, ekasya nimittavaśādanekadhā grahaṇāt//21//
āsatāṃ tāvadanye, mamaivaikasya sarvasvaṃ devenāpahṛtamityāha - gātreṣvityādi/ gātreṣu aṅgeṣu candanarasaḥ candanasya paṅkaḥ, atiśītalasparśasukhajananāt la dṛśi cakṣurindriye śāradenduḥ śaratkālabhavatvādapagatameghāvaraṇaścandraḥ, amṛtavarṣaṇāt la hṛdaya ānanda eva mūrtaṃ sukhameva, na punaḥ sukhasādhanamātraṃ la āsīriti bhūtakālanirdeśāt sā daśā kathāvaśeṣā jāteti dyotyate, ``ramaṇīyaḥ kṣatriyakumāra āsīd'' itivat/ nikāmakamanīyaṃ niratiśayapremāspadam/ tatropamānamāha - jīvitamiveti/ jīvitaṃ prāṇātparaṃ premāspadatayā ``mānabhūyamahaṃ sadā bhūyāsaṃ'' iti sarvasyāpi svajīvite āśaṃsayā tadapekṣayaiva putramitrakalatrādiṣu snehād, ``ātmanastu kāmāya sarvaṃ priyaṃ bhavati, ityādiśrutyā/ akāṇḍe anucite samaye, ``śatāyurvai puruṣaḥ'' iti śrutivihitasya puruṣāyuṣasya parisamāptāvapi samagraguṇānāṃ nidhanaṃ na lokena sahyate, kimuta navayauvana ityarthaḥ/ uddharatā balātkārato haratā viluṇṭhayatā kālena sarvasaṃhartrā parameśvareṇa, kālagrahaṇaṃ durlaṅghaprabhāvatvasūcanārthaṃ, ``kālo'smi lokakṣayakṛt pravṛddhaḥ'', ``kālo hi duratikramaḥ'', ``kālasya hi vaśo lokaḥ'' ityādivacanāt, hataḥ hiṃsitaḥ//22//
jīvitoddharaṇe śavatvāt spṛṣṭvā kareṇa saṃspṛśya/
snehonmādādupālabhate - akaruṇetyādi/ akaruṇa dayārahita, duḥkhite'pi mayyabhyavapattyabhāvāt, vitara arpaya smitojjvālāṃ pūrvavanmandasmitena śobhitāṃ dṛśaṃ dṛṣṭim/ atidāruṇa aparimitasvajanaprāṇaparityāgahetubhūta, durvyavasāyatvāt, giraṃ ``bhoḥ priyavayasya! kimevaṃ vaiklabyamavalambase/ nanu svastho'smī''ti vācaṃ dehi/ me iti vākyadvaye'pi sambadhyate/ sahacaraṃ kadācidapyananubhūtavirahaṃ, anuraktacetasaṃ sneharañjitaṃ mano yasya, na punarvācārambhaṇamātrasneham/ priyamakaranda priyaḥ premabhūmiḥ makarando yasyetyanena lokaprasiddhatvamāha/ sahacaramenamanuraktacetasaṃ kathaṃ na manyase kena prakāreṇa nāvagacchasi, kvacit kadācit kathañcit kiñcit kṛtrimasnehatvaṃ yadi mayi tvayānvabhāvi tarhyevāyaṃ tava dāruṇakarmārambhaḥ śubhaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ//23//
saṃjñāṃ mūrcchāvicchedajanitaṃ prabodham/ socchvāsaṃ āśvāsasahitam/ aciradhautaḥ pratyagrakṣālitaḥ, aciradhautatvoktiḥ snigdhatātiśayapratipādanārthaṃ, rājapaṭṭaḥ nīlavarṇaḥ paṭṭāṃśukaviśeṣaḥ tadvad rucirā śobhanā māṃsalā bahalā chaviḥ kāntiryasya/ toyaśīkarāsāreṇa jalabindūnāṃ vegavatāṃ varṣeṇa/
``āsāraḥ syāt prasaraṇe vegavṛṣṭau suhṛdvale/''iti vaijayantī/ me priyavayasyamiti aho anena me paramopakāraḥ kṛta iti dyotayati, sañjīvayati, atra navajaladhareṇa sañjīvanaṃ yoginīprabhāvajanitaṃ, na tu yādṛcchikamityaho mantavyam, uparyapi ``nūnamasyāyaṃ'' iti, ``jhaṭiti pāṭyamānādivāmbudāt'' iti ca samayopapannatvapratipādanāt/ ucchvasitastāvat prathamaṃ sañjīvitaḥ, tāvadgrahaṇaṃ ucchvasitasya mālatīlābhamantareṇa yādṛcchikatvenāviśvasanīyatvāt, ``kiyānalābho na vilābha eva'' iti nyāyāt ``idānīṃ tāvadetat sukhamanubhavāmaḥ, paścādyadbhāvi tadbhavatvi''ti santoṣaṃ dyotayati/
atha - ``madhukalanīlakaṇṭhakalahairmukharāḥ kakubhaḥ/''iti prāvṛḍārambhasya dussahatāmanusandhāyonmādyataḥ priyādūtānveṣaṇavyagrasyaiva mūrcchitatvamāsūtrayan prabuddhasya tatsaṃskāravaśenoktimāha - taditi/ tat tasmāt, priyāmantareṇa kakubho duṣprekṣāḥ, sā ca virahavidhuritā samāśvāsanīyetyarthaḥ/ kaṃ janaṃ, kimiti pāṭhe kiṃ vastu, atra asmin vipine vane/
``aṭavyaraṇyaṃ vipinaṃ gahanaṃ kānanaṃ vanam/''ityamaraḥ/ vipina iti, pure janapade ca parijanabāhulyādananveṣyatvaṃ vipinasya tu aparicitasthalatvādanveṣaṇīyatvamāha/ priyāvārtāharaṃ priyāyā dūtaṃ, vārtāṃ sandeśaṃ harati nayatīti vārtāharaḥ/ sādhu sādhviti svābhimatasampatteḥ saharṣaṃ vacanaṃ, samīcīnaṃ, sampannamiti śeṣaḥ/
tatra hetumāha - phalabharetyādi/ phalabharasya phalasamṛddheḥ pariṇāmena vipākena śyāmeṣu nīlavarṇeṣu, phalānāṃ nīlavarṇatayā, jambūnikuñjeṣu jambūlatāvalayeṣu skhalitāḥ pratihatavegāḥ tanavaḥ kṛśāḥ taraṅgā yasyām/ jambūgrahaṇaṃ prāvṛṣi tasyāḥ phalitatvaprasiddheḥ/ ``aṅgāracūrṇotkarasannikāśaiḥṣṭaṣṭaphalaiḥ suparyāptarasaiḥ samṛddhaiḥ/
jambūdrumāṇāṃ pratibhānti śākhāṣṭaṣṭanilīyamānā iva ṣaṭpadaughaiḥ//'' iti śrīrāmāyaṇe prāvṛṅvarṇane/ sravantīṃ vakṣyamāṇāṃ pāṭalāvatīṃ uttareṇa tasyā uttarasyāṃ diśyadūre/ ``enavanyatarasyāmadūre'pañcamyāḥ'' (5-3-35) ityenap, ``enapā dvitīyā'' (2-3-31) iti dvitīyā/ upari ūrdhvabhāge, svasyetyarthāt, vighaṭamānaprauḍhatāpiñcchanīlaḥ prārabdhavikāsaṃ prauḍhaṃ kālapakvaṃ tāpiñcchaṃ tamālapuṣpaṃ, tadvannīlaḥ snigdhaśca, sāhacaryāt/ ``kālaskandhastamālaḥ syāttāpiñccho'pi'' ityamaraḥ/ kṛṣṇagirikarṇikā vā/ śrayati viśramārthamālambate/ śikharaṃ śṛṅgaṃ adreḥ parvatasya nūtanaḥ navoditaḥ toyavāhaḥ meghaḥ/ amuṃ priyāvārtāharaṃ karomīti vipariṇāmeṇa[na] yojanā//24//
sarabhasaṃ savegaṃ saharṣaṃ vā/ ``rabhaso vegaharṣayoḥ'' iti vaijayantī/ unmukhaḥ unnamitavadanaḥ, tasyādhobhāgavartitvāt/ kṛtāñjaliḥ pūjārthaṃ hastau samānīya, tasya divyatvāt svayaṃ sāpekṣatvācca/
svavivakṣitavacanābhimukhyāya kuśalaṃ pṛcchati - kaccidityādi/ kaccit sānunaye praśne/ saumya! adāruṇasvabhāva ṅa, sarvānugrāhakatvād, ityuktiḥ svābhimatapravṛttyākhyānasyābhyupagamārtham/ priyasahacarī iṣṭā sahasañcāraṇaśīlā ca, priyatamā ca dharmapatnī cetyapi sphurati, vidyut taṭid āliṅgati svayaṃ sarāgā samāśliṣyati/ anurāgasyobhayagatatve hi rasāvahatvamiti bhāvaḥ/ āvirbhūtapraṇayasumukhāḥ āvirbhūtaḥ sambhramādibhiḥ svayameva sphuritaḥ, natvāviṣkṛta ityakṛtrimatvaṃ dyotayati, praṇayaḥ sauhṛdaṃ tena prasannamukhāḥ, cātakāḥ dhārāṭākhyāḥ pakṣiṇaḥ, teṣāṃ tadekopajīvināṃ ananyasādhāraṇasauhārdadravārdratayā tadgrahaṇam, bhajante sevante/ paurastyaḥ purastāt pūrvasyāṃ diśi bhavaḥ, tasyaiva prāvṛṭsambandhitvāt, ``prabalapurovātatāḍitaśikhaṇḍaḥ'' ityādiprayogāt, sukhayati sukhitaṃ karoti sādhusaṃvāhanābhiḥ samīcīnaiḥ śarīrābādhaparihārāt tattadaWbhimatadeśaprāpaṇaiḥ/ viṣvak sarvatodikkaṃ bibhrad dhārayan, marudadhīnasañcaraṇatvāt meghānāṃ, surapatidhanurindradhanuḥ, vetyatrāpyanuṣajyate, lakṣma cihnabhūtaṃ lakṣmīṃ śobhāṃ tanoti vistārayati, tavetyarthāt/ kaccicchabdo vākyatraye'pyanukṛṣyate/ tanoṣīti vā pāṭhaḥ/ vākyatrayaṃ praśnarūpaṃ, caturthaṃ tu vākyaṃ cāṭurūpam/ surapatidhanurlakṣma bibhrat tvaṃ viṣvak lakṣmīṃ tanoṣītyaho te saundaryasaubhāgyasampaditi dyotyate/ vāśabdābhāvaścāsyārthasya sādhakaḥ/ atrāprastutapraśaṃsālaṅkāraḥ, aprastutānmeghavṛttāntāt prastutasya dūtavṛttāntasya gamyamānatvāt/ acetanena saha praśnottarakānupapattervācyasyāsambhave'pi prastute tātparyāt, pramukha eva tadadhyāropaṇapratīterunmattavacanatvācca yujyata etat/ samāsoktiścātrānusandheṣā, vidyudādīnāṃ nāyikāditvena pratītaiḥ/ asminnunmattavacanaprakaraṇe prāyo'prastutapraśaṃsānusaraṇīyā//25//
atha tadgarjitaṃ svapraśnottaraṃ parikalpya saharṣamāha - aye iti harṣadyotakamavyayam/ pratiravabharitābhiḥ pratidhvanipūritābhiḥ kandarābhiḥ giridarībhiḥ ānanditā harṣitāḥ, ``viśeṣaṇe ( ṛviśiṣṭe) vidhiniṣedhau viśeṣaṇamupasaṅkrāmataḥ'' iti nyāyāt kandararandhrānubandhibhiḥ pratiravairānanditā ityarthaḥ, utkaṇṭhitāḥ kadā nu khalu priyasuhṛdo garjitaṃ śroṣyāma iti cirakālotsukāḥ, athavā unnamitakaṇṭhāḥ kṛtā nīlakaṇṭhā mayūrā yena/ kāntena śravaṇasubhagena mandrahuṅkṛtena gambhīreṇa garjitena, ``mandro gambhīra ucyate'' iti halāyudhaḥ, māṃ anumanyate pṛcchantaṃ māṃ prativacanenānumodata ityarthaḥ/ tatsaumukhyena vivakṣitavacanāvakāśaṃ labdhvāha - yāvadvākyālaṅkāre'vadhāraṇe vā, abhyarthaye yāce, prārthitamarthamamumiti śeṣaḥ/ bhagavanniti samagraiśvaryādisampannatayā kāmarūpatvaṃ ca sarvatrāpratihatagatitvaṃ ca svābhimatānuguṇamāha jīmūta megha ṅaṣṭaṣṭaprārthanāmāha - daivādityādi/ daivāt madbhāgyāt/ jagatītyaniyatadeśatvaṃ vicaraṇasyāha/ vicaranniti śatrā tācchīlyaṃ dyotayati/ matpriyāṃ mameti vartamānadaśāviśiṣṭasya ātmano'bhinayena pradarśanaṃ, īdṛśasya tadvirahānmama preyasīṃ paśyeścediti sambhāvanāyāṃ liṅ/ cedgrahaṇena tribhuvanamānyaṃ bhavantamasmin kṛtye nājñāpayāmi kintu yadṛcchayopapadyate cettadānīmevamanugrāhyo'smīti prārthanāmeva karomīti vyañjayati/ ādāvāśvāsya ``vatse mā śucaḥ/ tvatsahacareṇa tvāṃ ghaṭayiṣyāmī''ti vigatodvegāṃ kṛtvā, tadanu tasyāḥ samāśvāsanasyānantaraṃ, mādhavasthāṃ mādhave sthitāṃ, matpriyāmityatrābhinayena darśitatvāt siddhatvenoktiḥ, avasthāṃ svalpāvaśeṣajīvitāṃ daśāṃ, kathayeḥ iti prārthane liṅ/ āśātantuḥ sūtravat sūkṣmā āśā, kathayatā avasthāmācakṣāṇena, kathayeriti prārthitasya kathanasyānuvādaḥ, atyantaṃ niśśeṣaṃ [na] ucchedanīyaḥ khaṇḍayituṃ yogyaḥ/ tvaddarśanāt pūrvameva sa nūnaṃ parityaktajīvito bhaviṣyatītyukte nairāśyāttasyāḥ prāṇā jhaṭiti prayāsyanti/ tvaddarśanaṃ yāvat sa yathā jīviṣyati tathā mayā samāśvāsita ityukte sāśatvāt sāpi jīviṣyatītyarthaḥ, ``jīvaïsīe tti māruī uvaūḍho/''iti setūktavat/ tadevāha - prāṇatrāṇaṃ prāṇānāṃ rakṣāṃ, anapāyamityarthaḥ, kathamapi kṛcchreṇa/ āyatākṣyāḥ tvadvacanena saharṣavismayatvād vikasitanayanāyā iti tatkālaviśeṣaṇam/ sa āśātantureva/ atra dainyamautsukyaṃ ca bhāvau vyajyete/ kāvyaliṅgamalaṅkāraḥ, hetorvākyārthatvenokteḥ//26//
saharṣamiti - svataḥ prayātaṃ meghaṃ svaprārthitārthasādhanāya prasthitaṃ matvā pramodayuktamityarthaḥ/ aye iti saujanyacamatkāram/ pracalitaḥ prasthitaḥ/ anyataḥ parasmin deśe/
sodvegaṃ unmādasya mūrcchāmaraṇayoḥ pūrvarūpatvāt sabhayamityarthaḥ/ unmādoparāgaḥ unmādarūpaṃ rāhugrahaṇam/
``uparāgo graho rāhugraste tvindau ca pūṣṇi ca/''ityamaraḥ/ ``jyeṣṭhasyābhīṣṭavirahānmadhyasyeṣṭavighātanāt/
nīcānāṃ dhananāśādyairunmādo nāma jāyate//'' iti lakṣita unmādākhyo bhāvaḥ/ mādhavenduṃ mādhavarūpaṃ candraṃ, indutvāropāduparāgatvāropaṇaṃ ca, yathā sakalajagadāhlādinaḥ sampūrṇamaṇḍalasya candramasaḥ saXhikeyopaghātaḥ sahṛdayahṛdayasantāpāya, tathāsyonmāda iti dyotayituṃ, āskandati abhibhavati, ``anavasthitaśayyāsthopaveśotthitirodanaiḥ/
asatpralāpaskhalitakātaryādyaiḥ sa varṇyate//''ityukteḥ, svakāryavijṛmbhaṇenākrāmatītyarthaḥ/ tāteti devarāta āmantryate, ambeti mādhavasya mātā/ bhagavatīti kāmandakī, paritrāyasva rakṣeti tasyāḥ paritrāṇasāmarthyāduktiḥ/ mādhavasyeti yastava tādṛśasnehabhūmistasyeti dhvaninā dyotyate/ avasthāmunmādarūpām/
sadṛśaguṇadarśanavimohita āha - dhik kaṣṭaṃ, pramādaḥ asmākamanavadhānajanito'narthaḥ/
tadevāha - naveṣvityādi/ naveṣu tatkālavikasiteṣu lodhraprasaveṣu lodhravṛkṣapuṣpeṣu/
``nītā lodhraprasavarajasā pāṇḍutāmānanaśrīḥ/''iti, ``abhiṣiṣeṇayiṣuṃ bhuvanāni yaḥ smaramivākhyata lodhrarajaśca yaḥ/''ityādibhiḥ śiśirasambandhitvena lodhrasya pratipādane'pi, atra ``āvirgandhasilindhralodhrakusumasmerā vanānāṃ tatiḥ/''iti, ``naveṣu lodhraprasaveṣu kāntiḥ'' iti ca prāvṛṣeṇyatvoktiḥ keṣāñcid vṛkṣaviśeṣāṇāṃ vatsare'pi dvistrirvā puṣpitatvānubhavāt, kāntiḥ lāvaṇyātiśayaḥ, tasyāḥ smarapāṇḍutvāt la lodhraprasavagrahaṇaṃ ``viśadaṃ kapolabhuvi lodhrarajaḥ'', ``lodhradrumaṃ sānumataḥ praphullam'' ityādibhistasya dhāvalyaprasiddheḥ la dṛśaḥ dṛṣṭivyāpārāḥ kuraṅgeṣu hariṇeṣu la gataṃ gamanaṃ gajeṣu nitambādigauravādyauvanamadanagarvācca līlālasatvācca la latāsu aśokalatikādiṣu namratvaṃ namanaśīlatvaṃ, stanastabakāvarjitatvāt, ``āvarjitā kiñcidiva stanābhyām''iti, ``stanābhirāmastabakāvanamrām'' ityādiprayogāt la dṛśyata iti śeṣaḥ/ iti anena hetunā pramathya hiṃsitvā vyaktaṃ niścitaṃ vibhaktā bahubhiraṃśīkṛtā/ vipine iti bandhujanavirahānnivārakābhāvaḥ prakāśyate, acetanatayā tadguṇāparijñānena nirdayatvaṃ ca/ me priyetyaho mamādhanyatvaṃ, sā tāvadvibhaktā ahaṃ tu jīvāmyeveti dhvanyate/ atrānumānamalaṅkāraḥ//27//
vibhaktatāṃ niścitya śocati - hā priye mālatīti/
udvelamunmādaṃ nirīkṣya viṣaṇṇa āha - suhṛdīti viśeṣanirdeśaḥ guṇanivāse guṇānāṃ vinayamādhuryādīnāmādhārabhūte, preyasi tava priyāntarebhyo'tipriye, prāṇanāthe prāṇānāṃ svāmini, teṣāṃ tadanvayavyatirekānuvidhānāt, sahapāṃsukrīḍanaprauḍhasakhye saha samaṃ kṛtena pāṃsukrīḍanena pāṃsubhirbhūreṇubhirvedikādirūpeṇa nirmitena yat krīḍanaṃ vihāraḥ tena prauḍhaṃ pariṇataṃ sakhyaṃ mitrabhāvo yasmin/ sakhyamiti yadanenāśaiśavātsodarayoriva pravṛttasnehatvamucyate/ priyajanavirahādhivyādhivegaṃ priyasya janasya vallabhāyā viraheṇa ya ādhiḥ manaḥpīḍā tadrūpasya tanmūlasya vā vyādhervegaṃ rogasyojjṛmbhaṇam/ vegaṃ dadhāna ityanenoparyaupari vijṛmbhaṇamapratīkāratvāt prakāśyate/ hatahṛdaya! he naṣṭamanaḥ! dvidhā vidīrya ubhayathā bhinnaṃ bhūtvā, kathamiva na prayāsi/ atra hṛdayaṃ pratyasūyā vyajyate/ parikaro'laṅkāraḥ//28//
``naveṣu lodhraprasaveṣvi''tyuktaṃ pratikṣipatyupapattyā - sulabhānukāraḥ suprāpo'nukāraḥ sadṛśatayā tattadanusaraṇaṃ yasya, khalviti prasiddhyanubhavayoḥ pratipādanaṃ, gogavayādiṣu tathābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ, vedhaso brahmaṇa ityacintyaśaktitvādīśvarasyānāścaryatvamāha, nirmāṇasanniveśaḥ nirmāṇasya sṛṣṭerākāraviśeṣaḥ/ bhavatu tathā/ tena priyāvibhāgaśaṅkā na kartavyeti svābhimataṃ priyājīvitaṃ nirṇīyāha - evaṃ tāvat itthameva vakṣyāmīti kartavyaparāmarśaḥ/ praṇipatya prasādanāya namaskṛtya/ ayamahamityabhinayena svāvasthāṃ pradarśayannātmano dayāviṣayatvaṃ sūcayati/ bho ityabhimukhīkaraṇam/ bhūdharāraṇyacāriṇaḥ parvatavanasañcaraṇaśīlān, bhūdharāraṇyagrahaṇaṃ deśasya vaipulyena sattvānāmapi bāhulyapratipādanārtham/ sattvān prāṇinaḥ/ ``sattvo'strī jantuṣu klībe vyavasāye parākrame'' iti vaijayantī/ aviśeṣoktyā yatrakutracit sthito yaḥ kaścid yadākadācid yatkiñcit priyāsambandhaṃ jñāsyatīti sāmānyataḥ prārthanaṃ sūcayitum/ vijñāpayāmi nivedayāmi/ praṇipātavijñāpane pūjyaviṣaye prayojye duḥsthatayā sāpekṣatvācca dainyaṃ dyotayitumiha prayukte veditavye, yathā mālatyā lavaṅgikāyāḥ pādayoḥ patitam/ sattvān vijñāpayāmīti bahumānadyotakaḥ pārokṣyanirdeśaḥ, ``devaḥ pramāṇami''ti, ``yathājñāpayati devaḥ'' ityādivat/ te ye mayārtena śaraṇīkṛtāḥ, bhavantaḥ mānyāḥ avadhānadānena yathāsvavyāpāraviramaṇena vijñāpyamāne'rthe iti prastutatvādaikāgryamavalambya anugṛhṇantu anukampantām/
vijñāpanamevāha - bhavadbhirityādi/ sarvāṅgaprakṛtiramaṇīyā sarveṣvaṅgeṣu sarvairvāṅgaiḥ prakṛtyā svabhāvato hṛdayaṅgamā/ divyāṅganādidarśanena lakṣaṇasyātivyāptimāśaṅkya pariharati - kulavadhūḥ kulapāliketi tasyā api sītādīnāmiva parabandigrahādikāraṇenehāgamanopapattiriti bhāvaḥ/ ihasthaiḥ asmin vipulottuṅge girinotsaṅge ṛśyamūka iva sthitairiti darśanasya sambhāvitatvam/ dṛṣṭā kiṃ veti sambandhaḥ/ athavā iti darśanavyāvṛttiḥ, darśanaṃ mā nāma bhūḥ, draṣṭṛṇāṃ vacanena karṇākarṇikayāpyasyāḥ sambandhi vṛttaṃ viditamabhavat kimiti/ punaravyabhicaritalakṣaṇamāha - vayovasthāṃ vayaso jīvanakālasya viśeṣaṃ śṛṇuta niśamayata/ kulavadhūvṛttāntaḥ kathamasmābhiravadhīyatāmanaucityādityāśaṅkyāha - he suhṛdaḥ śobhanahṛdayā iti jitendriyatvānmitratvācca bhrātaṛṇāmiva na kadācidanaucitiriti bhāvaḥ/ yatra yasyāṃ pragalbhavyāpāraḥ pariṇatasvapravṛttikaḥ saṅkalpādisvakāryasāmrājyasampādanena hṛdi carati anavarataṃ vyāpriyate/ mugdhaḥ apariṇataḥ, mṛdubhūta ityarthaḥ, atyudāraprakṛtitvāt kaumārakānuvṛtteśca bahirniyantritasvakāryaprasara ityarthaḥ, anatinirbharayauvanopagūḍheti yāvat/ athavā rasasaṃrambhitvaṃ manasaḥ sadayopabhogyatvaṃ ca vapuṣaḥ pratipādyate/ aprastutapraśaṃsālaṅkāraḥ acetaneṣu cetanatvāropeṇa vyavahārāt//29//
āśāpratighātena nirviṇṇa āha - kaṣṭamiti/ bhoḥ he janāḥ, idamayuktaṃ paśyateti śeṣaḥ/ vīpsayā kvacidanyatredṛśamanucitamasmābhirnānubhūtamiti dyotayati/
tatra hetumāha - kekābhirityādi/ ``kekā vāṇī mayūrasya, ityamaraḥ/ bahuvacanena paunaḥpunyaṃ prakāśyate/ nīlakaṇṭhaḥ mayūraḥ tirayati antarhitaṃ karoti/ vacanaṃ madīyavijñāpanavākyam/ tāṇḍavāya uddhatanṛtyaṃ kartuṃ, ``kriyārthopapadasya ca karmaṇi sthāninaḥ'' (2-3-14) iti caturthī, ucchikhaṇḍaḥ unnamitapicchabhāraḥ/ kāntāṃ priyāṃ antaḥpramodāmantargataharṣāṃ, tadanubhāvaprakāśanād, abhisarati svayamabhigacchati, madabhrāntatāraḥ madhujanitena smarajanitena vā madena ghūrṇitā akṣikanīnikā yasya, [cakoraḥ] ``cakorastu calaccañcurutpibaścandrikāpriyaḥ'' iti vaijayantī/ ``golāṅgūla iti proktaḥ kṛṣṇavaktrastu markaṭaḥ/'' iti halāyudhaḥ, churayati miśrayati kausumena nānāvidhapuṣpasambandhinā rajasā reṇunā, tasya parabhāgaśobhājanakatvāt, ``viśadaṃ kapolabhuvi lodhrarajaḥ'' ityādivat/ evaṃ vividhasvakāryavyagrāṇāmeteṣāṃ madhye kaṃ yāce na kaścidasmadyācñāmādriyata ityarthaḥ/ svāvasthayānyasyāpyarthino'vadhīraṇāspadatvamutprekṣate - yatratatra yasminkasmiṃścit, sarvasminnityarthaḥ, yadātadā yasyatasyetyādivad deśe puruṣe vā viṣaye/ dhruvamiti vitarkadyotakamavyayam/ arthibhāvaḥ yācakatvaṃ anavasaragrasta eva arthyamānasya puruṣasyāvajñājanitenāsamayena grastaḥ kabalīkṛtaḥ, paribhūta iti yāvat la ``bhikṣuḥ śivo'pi paribhūtipadaṃ janasya''ityādivacanaiḥ/ athavā tatra yatreti pāṭhaḥ, tatra deśe kaṃ yāce yatrārthibhāvo madīyo'navasaragrasta eva vartata ityarthaḥ/ atra svabhāvoktiḥ kāvyaliṅgamarthāntaranyāsaścālaṅkāraḥ//30//
anyato'valokya/ ayaṃ ca - dantacchadetyādi/ dantacchadasya adharasyāruṇimnā raktatayā tāmbūlarāgeṇeva rañjitā rūṣitāḥ/ kāntāḥ snigdhadhavalasūkṣmaniśitanirvivaratayā ramaṇīyā dantā daśanā yasya/ unnāmya agrahastenordhvīkṛtya/ balīvadanaḥ balīmukha iti raktamukho hemavarṇaḥ kapiviśeṣa iṣyate/
``kāmpilyaḥ karkaśaścandro raktāṃśo rocanītyapi/''ityamaraḥ/ kāmpilyasya prasavaḥ puṣpaṃ tadvat pāṭalā gaṇḍapāliḥ kapolasthalī yasya, ``śvetaraktastu pāṭalaḥ'' iti vaijayantī/ pākāruṇasphuritadāḍimakānti kālapākatayā aruṇaṃ raktavarṇaṃ sphuritaṃ vikasitaṃ ravikaradīpitaṃ vā dāḍimapuṣpamiva kāntiryasya, arthāt kapolavyatirikte pradeśe/ ``karako dāḍimī trayī'' iti vaijayantī/ ayaṃ ceti nīlakaṇṭhādibhiḥ samuccinoti/ atra svabhāvoktiralaṅkāraḥ//31//
punaranyato vilokyāha - aye iti tasya svasyeva śṛṅgārarasikatayā harṣaṃ dyotayati/ ayaṃ ceti pūrvoktaiḥ samuccinoti/ rohiṇānokahaścandanavṛkṣaḥ tasya śaityātiśayāt skandhe prakāṇḍe deśe viśrāntā nyastabhāratayā śramarahitā kandharā kaṇṭhakāṇḍaṃ yasya, karī gajaḥ, vartata iti śeṣaḥ/ atrāsmin, apiśabdo balīvadanavaditi dyotayati/ anavasaraḥ asmadvivakṣitasyāsamayaḥ/
tatra hetuḥ - kaṇḍūkuḍmalitetyādi/ ``kaṇḍūḥ kharjuśca kaṇḍūyaḥ'' ityamaraḥ/ kaṇḍvā hetubhūtayā kuḍmalite, arthād dantakoṭilekhanasukhānubhūtyā mukulite īkṣaṇe nayane yasyāḥ/ sahacarīṃ kṣaṇamapi virahāsahāṃ priyāmiti viśeṣaṇenaiva viśeṣyaṃ siddhyati, dantasya na punardantayorityanena parasparasaṃśliṣṭapārśvayordvayorghaṭitamukhatvena sthitiḥ sūcyate, koṭyā agreṇa likhan kaṇḍūyamānaḥ/ likhanniti nakhavilekhanapadavyathanena yathāsukhaṃ kaṇḍūyanaṃ vyajyate/ paryāyavyatikīrṇayoḥ kramavalitayoḥ karṇayoḥ pavanairāhlādibhirmṛduśiśiratayā pramodanaśīlaiḥ vījayan tālavṛntakṛtyamanutiṣṭhan/ jagdhārdhaiḥ svayaṃ carvitaikadeśairiti svādiṣṭhaṃ svādiṣṭhaṃ nirūpyeti dyotyate, navaiḥ sallakyāḥ pallavaiḥ, ``sallakī tu gajapriyā'' ityamaraḥ, asyāḥ sahacaryāḥ sthitiṃ śarīrasthitiṃ bhuktimityarthaḥ kalpayan sampādayan/ śatṛtrayaṃ hetau/ dhanyaḥ bhāgyaśālītyanena kevalamahamevādhanya iti vyatirekeṇa dyotyate/ dhanyatve hetuḥ - vanyamataṅgaja iti vanyaḥ vane bhava iti niryantraṇavilasitatvaṃ khyāpyate, ``sasmāra vāraṇapatiḥ parimīlitākṣaṣṭamicchāvihāravanavāsamahotsavānām/'' ityukteḥ/ mataṅgajaḥ mataṅgādrau jāyata iti yogarūḍhyā gajaḥ, ``saptamyāṃ janerḍaḥ'' (3-2-97), paricaya āvarjanaṃ tasya prārambhamupakramaṃ abhyasyati āvartayati/ abhyasyatītyanena kalabhatvāt navapravṛttasambhogatvamāha/ atra harṣākhyo bhāvaḥ, sambhogaśṛṅgāraśca pratīyate/ svabhāvoktiralaṅkāraḥ//32//
tuḥ pūrvasmādvyāvṛttau/
nāntarityādi - antaḥ kaṇṭhakuhare, antarityanenāmarṣādudbhinnatvaṃ, prabhutvād bahiḥ pravṛttiśca dyotyate/ vartayati pravartayati/ āmandraṃ īṣadgambhīraṃ udgarjitaṃ svata udāttaṃ garjitaṃ āsannāt savidhavartina iti sukaratve'pyaudāsīnyaṃ prakāśyate/ āvarjitaiḥ āhṛtaiḥ/ ``śaivalo jalaśūkaḥ syāt'' iti vaijayantī/ stamberamaḥ gajaḥ, ``stambakarṇayo ramijapoḥ'' (3-2-13) ityap, ``hastisūcakayoriti vaktavyami''ti hastinyabhidheye ``tatpuruṣe kṛti bahulam'' (6-3-14) ityaluk/ tāmyati glāno vartate//33//
svayamanubhūtavirahavedanatayā tasya samānavyasanasya dayate - alamiti pratiṣedhe, āyāsitena praśnādibhiḥ kadarthitena/ ``prakṛtyādibhya upasaṅkhyānam'' (vā. 2-3-8) iti tṛtīyā, asyāyāso māsma bhūdityarthaḥ/ anyato vilokya sabahumānamāha - eṣa ityādi/ sānandayā tacchravaṇādāhlāditayā sahacaryā samākarṇyamāna uttambhitakarṇavālīkaṃ sādaraṃ śrūyamāṇo madhuraścārurūpatvād gambhīro mahattvācca kaṇṭhagarjitadhvaniḥ kaṇṭhakuhare kuhūkuhūkāreṇa vartamānaḥ/ stanitaśabdo yasya, aparaḥ pūrvasmād duḥkhitādatyantavilakṣaṇaḥ mattaḥ pravṛttamadaḥ, ``nirvṛtirhi manaso madahetuḥ'' ityuktakrameṇa nirvṛtatvāt, mātaṅgavargasya gajayūthasya pālo rakṣitā, gajendra ityarthaḥ/ pratyagravikasitaiḥ tatkālapraphullaiḥ kadambakusumaiḥ saṃvādinā sadṛśībhavanaśīlena/ ``vikacakadambasaṃvādimadhurasaurabhabharitabhuvanaṃ'' iti harṣacarite/ tatra hetuḥ - surabhiśītalāmodabahaleneti surabhiṇā ghrāṇatarpaṇena śītalenānugraheṇāmodena parimalena bahalaḥ sāndro yastena saṅgalitena samyaganavarataṃ pravṛttena māṃsalena ghanena kapolaniṣyandena karaṭataṭatruṭanakṣaritena madajalanirjhareṇa kardamitaṃ paṅkilīkṛtaṃ, kaluṣitamityarthaḥ la uddalitādunmūlitāt kamalinīṣaṇḍāt padminīsamudāyād viprakīrṇāni itastato vikṣiptāni kamalinīkesarāṇi tatkiñjalkāni mṛṇālāni bisavalayāni kandalāḥ patrodgamāḥ aṅkurāḥ atibālāni mukulāni ca yasmin, anavaratapravṛttena avicchinnapravṛttena kamanīyatālena manoharaśabdamānalayena tāṇḍavenoddhatanṛttena pracalābhyāṃ karṇābhyāṃ jarjariteṣu tāḍitatvāt śakaliteṣu jalataraṅgeṣu salilavīciṣu vitato vistṛto nīhāro himānī yasmin/ nīhāraśabdena sūkṣmaśiśiravimalabahalatayā salilaśīkaranikaro'tiśayoktyādhyavasīyate/ uttrastāḥ atiśayena bhītāḥ kurarāḥ sārasāśca yasminnityetāni tatkālaviśeṣaṇāni/ evaṃ yathātatheti krīḍanakriyāviśeṣaṇāni vā/
``krauñcastu kruṅṅadhotkrośaḥ kuraro matsyanāśanaḥ'', ``sāraso maithunī kāmī'' iti, ``ādhārastu taṭāko'strī kāsāraḥ sarasī saraḥ''iti vaijayantī/ avagāhya praviśya krīḍati ramate/ bhavatviti tasya dhanyatvānumodanam/ enamiti nirvṛtatayā niścitatvāt praśnādyavakāśaḥ pratīyate/ ābhāṣe cāṭuvacanairabhimukhīkaromi, ``samābhāṣyedamabravīt'', ``kati samāsādya sādaraṃ'' ityādivat/ mahābhāga! bhāgyaśālin, nāgapate! gajayūthanātha, ślāghyayauvanaḥ sahṛdayacamatkaraṇīyatāruṇyaḥ/ khaluravadhāraṇe viśiṣṭasambhogaphalatvāt yauvanasya, tatrāpi na kevalaṃ paśuceṣṭayā pravṛttiḥ, kintu vaidagdhyāt sarasatvāpādane (ne)tyāha, kusumasadharmāṇāṃ yoṣitāmupalālanavidheyatvāt/ kāntānuvṛtticāturyaṃ priyāyāḥ kariṇyāḥ anuvṛtau cittānusaraṇe cāturyaṃ caturasya vidagdhasya bhāvaḥ/ tatra viśeṣamāha - sāpavādaṃ tviti/ turviśeṣe, apavādaḥ sūkṣmadṛṣṭervacanīyatvaṃ, tatsahitaṃ cāturyamityarthaḥ/
tatra hetumāha - līlotkhātetyādi/ līlotkhātaiḥ vilāsenonmūlitaiḥ mṛṇālakāṇḍairbisadaṇḍaiḥ, ``āsvādavadbhiḥ kabalaistṛṇānāṃ'' ityādivat ye kabalāḥ grāsāḥ, arthāt svena tasyāḥ saṃpāditāsteṣāṃ chedeṣu carvaṇāvasāneṣu puṣpyadbhiḥ vikasadbhiḥ, ``puṣpa vikāse'' iti dhātuḥ śyanvikaraṇī, puṣkaraiḥ padmairvāsitasya parimalitasya payaso jalasya gaṇḍūṣāḥ svamukhaniveśitā aṃśāḥ teṣāṃ saṅkrāntayastasyā mukhe samarpaṇāni/
``dadau saraḥpaṅkajareṇugandhi gajāya gaṇḍūṣajalaṃ kareṇuḥ''/
ityuktatvāt/ seka ārdrīkaraṇaṃ madhyāhnatāpaśamanāya, śīkariṇā jalabinduvarṣaṇaśīlena vihitaḥ anuṣṭhitaḥ/ kāmamityavadhāraṇe, etatsarvaṃ samīcīnamevetyarthaḥ/ vākyadvayena cāturyaṃ samarthitam/ sāpavādatvamidānīṃ samarthayati - virāme sekāvasāne, punaḥśabdo vyāvṛttau, anarālanālanalinīpatrātapatraṃ akuṭilitadaṇḍamiti dhāraṇayogyatvamāha, padminīdalarūpaṃ chatraṃ na dhṛtaṃ hastena tasyā mūrdhnyātapanivāraṇāya, hasto'pyasti, nalinīpatramapi samīpe vartate, ātapabādhāpi tasyā vidyate, sneho'pi tasyāmudvelo bhavataḥ la tathāpyevaṃ na kṛtaṃ iti sahṛdayānāmapavaditumavakāśo dṛśyata iti suhṛdbuddhyā saparihāsaṃ vacanam/ atra kāvyaliṅgamalaṅkāraḥ, sāpavādacāturyayorvākyārthatayā pratipādanāt//34//
kathamityāścarye, svena priyasuhṛttayā kalpite tasmin nīrasatvasyānāśaṅkitatvāt avadhīraṇā nīrasaṃ maduktāvavajñayā śuṣkaṃ nirastasnehaṃ vrajati svecchayānyato gacchati/ tato nirviṇṇa āha - hanteti viṣāde/ mūḍhaḥ yogyāyogyavivekaśūnyaḥ/ yad yasmād, asminniti madavaśādardhanimīlitalocanatvādikaṃ durvilasitaśatamabhinayena nirdiśati, vanacara iti sajjanasaṃsargavandhyatvaṃ dhvanati, vayasyamakarandocitaṃ suhṛdi makarande yaducitaṃ yuktaṃ tathetyarthaḥ, vyavaharāmi ācarāmi/ tasmānmūḍha evāsmīti sambandhaḥ/ unmatto'pi san mattahastivṛttāntena prasaṅgato makarandasya smārita āha - heti/
unmādakalmāṣitasmṛtitvād sannihitameva taṃ manvāna āha - dhigucchvasitetyādi/ ucchvasitavaiśasaṃ prāṇasandhāraṇarūpaṃ duḥkhānubhavaṃ, ``śasu hiṃsāyāṃ'' ityasmādvipūrvādaci viśasa iti rūpaṃ, svārthe taddhitaḥ la viśiṣṭā hiṃsetyarthaḥ/
``vidhinā kṛtamardhavaiśasaṃ nanu māṃ kāmavadhe vimuñcatā/''ityādiprayogāt/ ``dhiguparyādiṣu'' (vā. 1-4-48) ityādinā dhigyoge dvitīyā/ mameti yaḥ svapne'pi tvayā kṣaṇamavirahitastasya mameti dyotyate/ tadityākṣipyate/ yadekākinaḥ yuvayoḥ sāhacaryarahitasya itthamanena prakāreṇa yuṣmadvirahaduḥkhataptatayā yadvartate tadityarthaḥ, maraṇameva varaṃ na punarīdṛśaṃ jīvanamiti bhāvaḥ/ tatra hetuḥ - viśeṣaramaṇīyavastvanubhavād atiśayena hṛdayaṅgamānāṃ vastūnāṃ, girisaridaraṇyagocarāṇāṃ padārthānāṃ pratyakṣīkaraṇāt, vṛthābhāvino vyarthībhavanaśīlāddhetoryuvābhyāṃ sahānubhava eva ramaṇīyānāṃ ramaṇīyatā, anyathā pratyuta santāpakāritvameveti bhāvaḥ/ kālavaśājjāyamāne virahe kathamucchvasitaṃ jugupsyata ityatrāha tvayeti/ makarandeti sambodhya tvayetyuktau tayā ca sahetyuktiḥ aṅgino nāyikāyāḥ sadānusandhīyamānatvādityavagantavyam/ tvayā tayā mālatyā ca saha yo nānubhūyate sa divaso'pi vidhvaṃsatāṃ atyantābhāvamanubhavatu/ atastanmūlo viraho'pi na bhaviṣyatīti bhāvaḥ/ pramohamṛgatṛṣṇikāṃ ayaṃ me suhṛd, iyaṃ me priyetyanyathājñānarūpāṃ marīcikāṃ, marīcikātvāropaṇaṃ jalabuddhyā vilubhitasya tṛṣitasya marudharaṇipatitāsu madhyāhnamihiramarīcikāvīcikāsu mudhāpravṛttiriva mamāpi vanacareṣu gandhasindhurādiṣu bandhubuddhibandhanamiti dyotayati/ aparatra yuṣmadvyatirikte mānuṣe manoḥ prajāpateḥ svāyambhuvasyāpatyavarge, prāṇijāte ityarthaḥ/ ``manorjātāvañyatau ṣukca'' (4-1-161) iti ṣukca/ ``tapastaptvāsṛjadyaṃ tu sa svayaṃ puruṣo virāṭ/
taṃ māṃ vittāsya sarvasya sraṣṭāraṃ dvijasattamāḥ//'' iti manuvacanāt mānuṣaśabdaḥ prāṇimātropalakṣaṇaḥ, gajādiviraktasyoktitvāt, aparatra mānuṣe yā bhavati tāṃ pramohamṛgatṛṣṇikāṃ dhigiti sambandhaḥ/ atra suhṛdgato bhāvaḥ prakāśyate/ aprastutapraśaṃsālaṅkāraḥ//35//
aye iti harṣe, unmādamohāntaritaḥ unmādajanitena vaicittyena tiraskṛtaḥ, māṃ prati māmuddiśya, ``pratiyogeṣu ca dṛśyate'' iti dvitīyā, kutaścit kasmāccid, dviradavṛttāntāderityarthaḥ, vyañjanāt vyajyate'nena prakāśyata iti vyañjanaṃ nimittaṃ, tasmāddhetoḥ, prabuddhaḥ unmīlitaḥ sahajaḥ svābhāviko manasi sthitaḥ snehasaṃskāraḥ premavāsanā/ tat tasmāt kāraṇāt asannihitaṃ parokṣadeśagataṃ manyate avagacchati, ``ucchvasitavaiśasaṃ mama yaditthamekākinaḥ'' ityādyukteriti bhāvaḥ/ purataḥ agrataḥ/ eṣa iti sannidhiṃ dyotayati, pārśvacaraḥ samīpe vartamānaḥ, sa yastvayānusmṛtya prastutaḥ, mandabhāgyaḥ īdṛśīṃ tava daśāṃ draṣṭuṃ svalpapuṇyatayādyāpi jīvannityarthaḥ/
purataḥ sthitetyukteśca phalamāha - samālokyeti/ heti muhūrtādarśanajanite viṣāde/ sambhāvaya sammānaya/ sammānanaprakāramāha - pariṣvajasva āliṅgeti/ turvyāvṛttau, ``tvayā saha na yastayā ce''ti sahagaṇitayormadhye tvamapi tāvaddiṣṭyā dṛṣṭaḥ, priyāṃ mālatīṃ prati tu nirāśo nirastadarśanāśaḥ, etāvatā kālena vārtāmātrasyāpyaśravaṇāditi bhāvaḥ/
saharṣamiti svābhilaṣitasyaiva tenāpi prārthitatvāddharṣasahitam/ sambhāvayāmi pariṣvaje ityarthaḥ jīviteśvaramiti prāṇānāṃ svāminaṃ, tadanvayavyatirekānuvidhānājjīvitasya/ sakaruṇaṃ saśokam/ āvirbhūtamatpariṣvaṅgotkaṇṭhaḥ prakāśitā sasambhramabhujam/ tat idānīmanyasyāṃ daśāyāṃ dṛṣṭāyāṃ, āśāvyasanena priyavayasyaḥ kālena sthiracitto bhaviṣyatītya (bhidhāna ṛnena) rūpeṇa nibandhena duḥkhena vā/ tatra hetuḥ - sarvathā sarveṇa prakāreṇa, mālatyā adarśanādasya daśayā kālasyoddīpanatayetyevamādibhiḥ samastaiḥ prakāraiḥ, nāsti na jīviṣyatīti ``vartamānasāmīpye vartamānavadvā'' (3-3-131) iti laṭ/ yukta upapannaḥ paricchedaḥ nirṇayaḥ/
tadabhāvaṃ nirṇīya paridevayate - yat snehetyādi/ snehasañjvaravatā snehāvegasaṃsāraduḥkhajanitatvāt mahārogeṇa nityayuktaṃ yat tena, nityayoge matup, hṛdayena manasā ābaddhavepathu samantāt saṃśliṣṭakampaṃ yathā nimittayogāt kāraṇasambandhādvināpi surakṣitatayā prabhutvācca sambhāvanīyavyasanahetuvirahe'pītyarthaḥ/ ``pṛthagvine'' (2-3-32)tyādinā pañcamī/ tvayyadhikaraṇe, āpado vyasanāni, bahuvacanena śaṅkāyā vaividhyācchaṅkanīyānāmāpadāmapi vaicitryaṃ prakāśayati, śaṅkamānena svayaṃ prakṛtyā svena vā anvabhāvi etāvantaṃ kālaṃ anubhūtaṃ tacchaṅkājanitaduḥkhaṃ sarvaṃ kṛtsnaṃ ekapade ekasmin padanyāse ekapadanyāsa ityarthaḥ/ praśāntaṃ prakarṣeṇa samāptaṃ śaṅkitasya prāptau śaṅkamānāvasthāduḥkhasya avasthānaṃ siddhameva, yathā jhaṭiti paṭu raṭati jaladharapaṭale sphuṭamaśaniḥ śanairmama śirasi patiṣyatīti śaṅkamānasya patite tasmiṃstadduḥkhānubhūtireveti bhāvaḥ/ ``bahuduḥkho nirduḥkhaḥ'' iti lokavādaṃ cānusandhatte/ atrāvego dhvanyate/ atiśayoktiralaṅkāraḥ//36//
varaṃ īṣatpriyam, ``daivād vṛte varaḥ śreṣṭhe varaṃ klībe manākpriye'' ityamaraḥ, atikrāntāḥ apanītāḥ, muhūrtāḥ ``aṣṭādaśa nimeṣā syuḥ kāṣṭhā triṃśat tu tāḥ kalāḥ/
tāstu triṃśat kṣaṇaste tu muhūrto dvādaśāstriyām//''iti lakṣitāvayavarūpāḥ kālāṃśāḥ, yeṣu muhūrteṣu tathāvidhamunmādena paśuvadayathātathaṃ ceṣṭamānaṃ, apirvirodhe, tathāvidhasyāpi vastuto'sahyatvāt, cetayamānaṃ jānānaṃ, viśeṣavijñānābhāve vijñānasāmānyasya paśuvadvidyamānatvāt kāṣṭhaloṣṭasadṛśāvasthāto varamityuktiḥ, ``citī saṃjñāne'' iti dhātuḥ, anubhūtatvāt pratyakṣīkṛtatvāt/ idānīmasmin kāle, turviśeṣe/
bhāraḥ kāya ityādi - bhāraḥ durbalasya durvahaṃ vastu kāyaḥ śarīraṃ, jīvitaṃ prāṇāḥ vajrakīlaḥ vajrākhyaratnakṛtaḥ kīlo'ṇiḥ, tasya lohādyabhedyatayā vajragrahaṇaṃ, ``vajrapañjaramiti śaraṇāgatai''rityādivad atidṛḍhamantaḥśalyamityarthaḥ/ kāṣṭhā diśaḥ śūnyāḥ sarvabandhurāhityena nirjanavanatulyāḥ la [indriyāṇi] niṣphalāni śobhanarūpamadhuraśabdādidarśanaśravaṇābhāvāt la śāntālokaḥ astamitaprakāśaḥ, sarvataḥ sarvatra jīvalokaḥ/ atra kāyo bhāra ityādivākyaiḥ kramāt tatkāryakaraṇapravṛttereva dehadhāraṇaprayojanatvaṃ sarvajanapreṣṭhānāṃ tatsannidhāveva sukhāvahatvaṃ, tasyaiva samastabandhutākāryakaraṇatvaṃ, tasyaiva sarvendriyāhlādakatvaṃ, tasyaiva sarvakalāśobhanatvaṃ, tasyaiva śokamohādisakalatamonirāsakatvaṃ ca prakāśyate/ atra rūpakamatiśayoktiścālaṅkāraḥ//37//
yasmādayamantyocchvāso vartate tasmāt mādhavāstamayasākṣiṇā mādhavasya nidhane sākṣiṇā sākṣāddraṣṭrā mayā bhavitavyaṃ bhāvyamiti prakāre/ ato'smātprakārāddhetoḥ kinnu jīvāmi tadarthaṃ kiṃ mama jīvanamityarthaḥ/ tarhi kathaṃ kriyatāmityatrāha - tat yasmāt sākṣitvamasahyaṃ tasmādasmātsamīpavartino giriśikharāt bṛhaddroṇīśailaśṛṅgāt pāṭalāvatīṃ nāma tatratyāṃ nadīṃ nipatya āplutyetyanena patanakriyāyā apādānabhūtasya giriśikharasya karmabhūtāyāśca nadyāḥ pāvanatvād bhṛgupatanasya ca puṇyatvasmaraṇādadurmaraṇatvaṃ pratipādyate, ``evaṃ gobrāhmaṇārthaṃ vā dīnārthaṃ vā tyajet tanum/
so'pi puṇyamavāpnoti ānṛśaṃsyavyapekṣayā//
khyāte puṇyatame tīrthe nimajjet svakṛtaṃ smaran/
so'pi puṇyakṛtān lokān sapadi pratipadyate//'' iti viśveśvaravacanāt, ``kṛtvā puṃvat pātamuccairbhṛgubhyaḥ'' ityādimāghokteśca, mādhavāgresaro mādhavasya parasminnapyasminniva loke mārgadarśako bhavāmītyarthaḥ/ kiñcit parikramya svalpadeśaṃ gatvā snehapāśena punarnivṛtya parivṛtya/
tadityādi - tat tathā pūrvamanubhūtaṃ etat idānīṃ niścetanatayā dharaṇipāṃsuṣu patitamiti bhāvaḥ, asitotpaladyuti nīlendīvaraprabham/ anubhavaprakāramevāha - asmin śarīre abhūditi tathābhāvasya bhūtatvoktiḥ/ atidṛḍhapīḍitaiḥ aṅgānyanuprāśadbhirivāṅgaiścirakālaṃ kṛtavimardanairityarthaḥ, mama na tṛptiḥ santoṣaḥ, amṛtāvagāhasyeva tatsparśasya niratiśayanirvṛtijanakatvāt/ atha lokottarasaundaryasaubhāgyāspadatvamāha - ullasitavismayāt adṛṣṭapūrvalāvaṇyādidarśanajanitāyā āścaryabuddherhetoḥ, atanu analpamiti kriyāviśeṣaṇaṃ, atṛpteḥ navatvoktiḥ praṇayasya durvāratvakhyāpanārthaṃ nūtanapremajanitaiḥ vilāsairākulā vividhabhaṅgitaraṅgitāḥ mālatyāḥ dṛṣṭayaḥ vilokanaprakārāḥ yaccharīraṃ pītavatyaḥ āgrahāt kabalitavatyaḥ/ atra makarandasya suhṛdviṣayo bhāvo nāyikāyā autsukyākhyaśca vyajyate/ preyo'laṅkāraḥ, sādṛśyavyatiriktanimittotthāpitatvāt smṛte, ``aho kope'pi kāntaṃ mukhaṃ'' ityādivat tasya lokottarasukṛtaśālitvaṃ camatkaroti//38//
ekasyāṃ tanau ekasmin śarīre ityanena, ``prāyeṇa sāmagryavidhau guṇānāṃṣṭaṣṭaparāṅmukhī viśvasṛjaḥ pravṛttiḥ/''iti nyāyāt kvacit kasyacideva guṇasya sadbhāva iti bhāvaḥ/ etāvata ityanubhavābhinayanābhijātyasaundaryasaujanyavaidagdhyasaubhāgyaiśvaryādīnāṃ prakāśanaṃ, guṇasamāhārasya guṇānāṃ samudāyasya sanniveśaḥ samyaṅnidhānaṃ kathamivābhūt kena prakāreṇāsīt/ kiṃnāmnastapasa idaṃ phalaṃ tadasmābhirapi yatnato'nveṣyamiti bhāvaḥ/
atha tādṛśasya guṇarāśeḥ sahṛdayaśalyamakāṇḍa eva jīvitakhaṇḍanamāśaṅkaya śocati - āpūrṇetyādi/ āpūrṇaḥ samagraḥ kalābhiḥ bhāgaiḥ, arthāt pañcadaśabhiḥ, kṣayavṛddhirahitā sarvādhārabhūtā ṣoḍaśī kalā induḥ amalaḥ tuhinajaladharādyāvārakarahitaḥ yātaḥ prāptā rāhorvidhuntudasya/ sañjātaḥ nivṛttaḥ/ ``ghanāghano mattagaje vāsave varṣakāmbude/'' iti vaijayantī, kuvalayadalanīlena gaganatalavyāpinā vapuṣā taṭidindracāpamaṇḍito mahāvarṣonmukhaḥ saṃvṛtta ityarthaḥ/ jaladharaḥ meghamātraṃ śīrṇaḥ śālmalītūlavaditastataḥ śakalīkṛtya vikṣiptaḥ, javāt caṇḍavegatayā, ``syādavandhyaḥ phalegrahiḥ'' ityamaraḥ, phalāni gṛhṇāti sadā phalatīti ``phalegrahirātmambhariśca'' (3-2-26) iti nipātanādinpratyayaḥ etvaṃ ca, drumavaraḥ sahakārādivṛkṣaśreṣṭhaḥ/ ``davadāvau vanāraṇyavahnī'' ityamaraḥ, vanavahninā jagato lokasya lokavartināṃ janānāṃ, cūḍāmaṇitāṃ śirobhūṣaṇaratnatvamiti lakṣaṇayā śirasā vāhyatvamiti siddhyati, gataḥ prāptaḥ, sahajānāṃ sāṃskārikāṇāṃ ca guṇānāṃ kālavaśāt kamalānāmiva divasamukhādabhivyaktaparimalatvopapatteḥ, mṛtyorantakasya vaśamāyattatāṃ, na tu mṛtyumityanenāśāvatā[]maṅgaloktiparihāraḥ/ atropamānatrayeṇa sakalajagannayanāhlādakatvaṃ svata eva paropakāraparatvaṃ sarasajanaślāghyopakāraramaṇīyatvaṃ ca prakāśyate/ prativastūpamālaṅkāraḥ, sāmānyadharmasyekasyaiva prakārabhedena prativākyamavasthānāt/ cakārābhyāṃ ca prativākyaṃ kriyāyaugapadyapratipādanādekādhikaraṇaviṣayaḥ samuccayālaṅkāro'pyatrānusandheyaḥ//39//
tanmṛtyuvaśaprāptyā punardurlabhapariṣvaṅgatvāt, pariṣvaje āliṅgāmi tāvaditi ayameva paramo lābha ityarthaḥ, evaṃgataṃ itthaṃbhūtāvasthaṃ arthitaḥ yācitaḥ anena mādhavena ayamarthaḥ pariṣvaṅgarūpaḥ padārthaḥ prayojanaṃ vā/ hā priyavayasya! makaranda sambhāvaya ``pariṣvajasva mā''mityanantaramevoktatvāt/ pariṣvajyedānīmapi nissaṃjñatayā tadabhāvaṃ niścitya paridevayate - vimalavidyānidhe! saṃśayaviparyāsarahitajñānanidhānasthalabhūta guṇaguro guṇairvinayamādhuryādibhiralaghiṣṭha athavā guṇeṣu lokasyācāryabhūta, parairapi spṛhaṇīyaguṇetyarthaḥ/ mālatyā svayaṃgrāheṇa svayaṃvaraṇena sampāditaprāṇanātha! kāmandakyā makarandasya ca viśeṣādānande candraḥ/ atra asmin janmani janane apaścimaḥ asmāt paścimaḥ paścādbhāvī na vidyate pariṣvaṅgaḥ svasyaiva paścimatvāditi bhāvaḥ/ paścimāvasthāṃ prārthitaḥ paścimasyāmantyāyāṃ daśāyāṃ tvayaiva nāthitaḥ/ atra ``janmanyapaścimaḥ'' ityukterjanmāntare tvavaśyaṃ bhaviṣyatīti dyotitam/ tat kathamityāśaṅkya āha - samprati tvayi paraiṣyati mā maṃsthāḥ mā vidāṃkuru/ ``manu avabodhane'' ityasmālluṅi māṅyoge madhyamaikavacanasya rūpamidam/ evakāraḥ saṃśayanivṛttyarthaḥ/ avadhāraṇamupapattyā samarthayati - kutaḥ kasmāddhetoriti cet asmādityarthaḥ/
ā janmana ityādi - janmanaḥ prabhṛti sahanivāsitayā apṛthaksañcaraṇatayā, evakāro bhinnakramaḥ, mayā samaṃ sahaiva mātustvajjananyāḥ payodharapayaḥ stanakṣīraṃ, apiśabdenānyeṣāṃ bhogyānāṃ sādhāraṇye kaimutikanyāyo'vatāryate, payaḥ purā pītvā la puṇḍarīkamukha vikasitakamalavat prasannamukhetyanena yathā yathā mayā haṭhātkāreṇa bhogyavastujātaṃ gṛhyate tathā tathā tvaṃ prahṛṣyasi/ atastādṛśaṃ tava mukhamapaśyato me kathaṃ jīvanaṃ bhavatviti dyotayati/ bandhutayā pitrādisamūhena ``grāmajanabandhusahāyebhyastal'' (4-2-43) iti samūhārthe tal pratyayaḥ/ nirastaṃ śokanighnatayā śāstrārthalaṅghanabhayādabuddhipūrvaṃ kṣiptaṃ akālapravṛttatayānaucityāt, ``na ca sma vṛddhā bālānāṃ pretakāryāṇi kurvata/''iti rāmāyaṇokteḥ/ ekaḥ mayā rahitaḥ nivāpaḥ, ``nivāpaḥ pitṛtarpaṇaṃ'' ityamaraḥ, tarpaṇodakaṃ, arthāt paralokopanatamityarthaḥ, pibasi idānīṃ pāsyasi, vartamānasāmīpye laṭ, itiḥ prakāre ayuktaṃ ayaṃ prakāro'nabhyāsādanupapanna ityarthaḥ/ atrārthāpattiḥ kāvyaliṅgaṃ cālaṅkāraḥ//40//
vimucya mādhavaṃ visṛjya/ adhastāt adhodeśe ityanena giriśikharārūḍhatvaṃ siddhyati/ mahānadyāḥ saṅkalpitavaradānasāmarthyāttāmabhimukhīkṛtya svābhimatamāśāste - bhagavati samagraiśvaryādiguṇaviśiṣṭe āpage hi nadi/
priyasyetyādi - ``iṣṭasya yatra yasmin deśe sambhavo janma, etad dehāvasāna ityarthāt, ``jātasya hi dhruvo mṛtyuḥ dhruvaṃ janma mṛtasya ca/''iti bhagavadvacanāt, ``naitadasti mahābhāge jarāmṛtyunivartakam/
sarvalokeṣu jānīhi mokṣādanyatra suvrate//'' iti maheśvaravacanāt, mokṣasya ca ``tameva viditvā atimṛtyumeti'', ``nānyaḥ panthā ayanāya vidyate'' iti, ``karmaṇā badhyate janturvidyayā ca vimucyate/''iti śrutismṛtiśatairjñānaikasādhyatvanirṇayāttattvajñānamantareṇa śarīraṃ tyajataḥ sarvathā śarīrāntaraparigrahaṃ niścitya sambhava ityuktiḥ/ tatraiva mamāpītyapiḥ atrāpyāsañjanīyaḥ, tasminneva deśe mamāpi sambhavo bhūyāt/ evakāreṇa karmavaicitryavaśāt sa yadi narake sambhavet sa eva me svarga iti dyotyate/ bhūyo'pi tasminnapi janmani anusañcaraḥ anu paścāt sañcarati tatsāhacaryamanubhavatītyanusañcaraḥ, āśiṣi liṅ/ atrautsukyaṃ bhāvo vyajyate āśīralaṅkāraḥ//41//
itissamāptau, patituṃ giriśikharādadhodeśavartinīṃ nadīmāskandituṃ icchati parikarabandhādi karotītyarthaḥ/
sahasā acintitameveti tasyā anugrahe'bhiyogaṃ vyañjayati/ saudāminī prakṛtā yoginī/ vārayitvā agrahastena gṛhītvā niṣiddhya/
vatseti putrasnehaṃ sūcayantī mātṛvatsvasyālaṅghyavacanatvaṃ vyanakti/ kṛtamalaṃ sāhasena avicāritakāritayā/ prakṛtyādi tṛtīyā/
athaśabdaḥ pakṣavyāvṛttau/ mayā sāhasaṃ kriyatāṃ mā vā, tvaṃ tu kāsi asmākaṃ kāmandakīvad gurubhūtā kvacidetāvantaṃ kālamajñātā sthitā, athavā mātāpitṛsambandhinī liṅginītvamavalambasa ityarthaḥ/ kimarthaṃ kasmai prayojanāya pratiṣiddhaḥ sāhasādvāritaḥ/ kiṃśabdaḥ kṣepe/ mālatīvṛttāntaparijñānasukhamantareṇa mādhavo na jīviṣyati/ tasmin na jīvati nāhaṃ jīviṣyāmi/ ato viśalyakaraṇīṃ mālatīpravṛttiṃ vinā kimanena vāraṇasnānadeśīyena nivāraṇavyasaneneti bhāvaḥ/
atha tadabhiprāyānuguṇaṃ mumukṣuruttaraṃ vivakṣurmālatīkathitairlakṣaṇairanumitamapi praśnatastannirṇinīṣuḥ pṛcchati -apiḥ praśne tvamiti pratītamātrasya parāmarśaḥ, āyuṣmān makarandaḥ mādhavapriyasuhṛttayā mānanīyatvena mālatyā nirdiṣṭo makarandanāmā kimasītyarthaḥ/
punarapi sāhase vartamāna āha - muñca, hastarodhamityarthāt/ sa makarandaḥ, mandabhāgyaḥ kṣīṇapuṇya iti suhṛdvyasanasākṣitvanissahatāmātmanaḥ sūcayati/
tannāmanirṇayenottaramāha - yoginīti mantrauṣadhādisādhanasiddhiprabhāvatayā śraddheyavacanatvaṃ svasyāḥ prakāśayati la ``kāsī''ti praśnasya uttaraṃ cedam/ mālatyabhijñānaṃ mālatyā svajīvanapratyayāya dattaṃ cihnaṃ, ``aṅkaṃ cihnamabhijñānam'' iti vaijayantī/ mālatyabhijñānamityuktyā svasyā[ḥ] sāhasakaraṇāt pitrādibhyo bhayena pitṛgṛhagamanasyāśaṅkyatvāt svādarśane'sau kiṃ karoti kva vartate iti priyatamavṛttāntasyāparijñānācca sarvasyāsya vṛttāntasyāvagamāya yoginīṃ prathamaṃ preṣitavatī mālatī tayā saha svayaṃ nāgatavatīti gamyate, anyathā kalpanāgauravaprasaṅgāt/ dhārayāmi hastena vahāmi, na tu yatkiñcidvadāmīti nissaṃśayatvamāha/ anena ``kimartha''mityākṣepagarbhasya pratikṣepaḥ praśnasya kṛtaḥ/
bakulamālādarśane'pyasantuṣṭaḥ pṛcchati, tasya jīvanamaraṇasādhāraṇatvāt/ apiḥ praśne, jīvati prāṇān dhārayatīti praśnaḥ, prathamamatyantāsambhāvitamya jīvitasya nirṇaye viśeṣapraśnasya paścādapi sukaratvāt/
atha kiṃ tathaivetyarthaḥ/ svānugrahasyānavakāśatvāpātamāśaṅkya viṣaṇṇā āha - atyāhitam atiśayitaṃ duḥkham/ aniṣṭamapriyaṃ prāṇaparityāgamityarthaḥ/ sarvasyāpi prāṇebhya iṣṭatamābhāvāt/ vyavasitaḥ kartuṃ niścitavān/ kartari niṣṭhā/ utkampitā bhītyā taralahṛdayā aniṣṭamadhyavasito'si yat tatkimatyāhitaṃ mādhavasyetyutkampitāsmītyanvayaḥ, tadatyāhitamantareṇa tvadaniṣṭādhyavasāyasyānupapatterityarthaḥ/
pramugdhaḥ mūcrXchitaḥ/ evetyanena niśvāsaśeṣa eva tasmin pūrvameva svasya maraṇodyogaḥ prakāśyate/ vairāgyāt śarīrādiṣvanityatādarśanena nirvedād āgataḥ, imaṃ deśamiti śeṣaḥ/ tūrṇaṃ śīghraṃ sambhāvayāvaḥ samāśvāsayāvaḥ/
diṣṭyā asmākaṃ bhāgyavaśāt, pratyāpannacetanaḥ, ``prekṣopalabdhiścitsaṃvitpratipajjñapticetanāḥ/''ityamaraḥ, svarūpāt pracyutā punastatprāptā cetanā jñānaṃ yasya/
saṃvadati na vyabhicarati, ubhayormādhavamakarandayoḥ mālatīniveditaḥ mālatyā varṇādilakṣaṇairvyutpāditaḥ śarīrākāro dehasya saṃsthānaviśeṣaḥ/
aye iti nirvede, pratibodhitaḥ saṃjñāṃ lambhitaḥ, ivetyadyāpi mūrcchāvāsanānuvṛtteḥ pratibodhakasya prayāsavaiyarthyamiti bhāvaḥ, kenāpīti viśeṣāparijñānāt tasya dveṣyatvāccoktiḥ/ sāmānyato'numitaṃ tarkeṇa viśeṣe sthāpayati - asyeti/ vījamānatvāt navajaladharadhārāsāravāhino nūtanameghadhārāvarṣaṃ sarvato netuṃ śīlaṃ yasyeti prabodhanasamagratvoktiḥ/ prabhañjanasya prakarṣeṇa bhanakti āmardayati lokamiti sādhikṣepaṃ vacanam/ kartari lyuṭ/ anavekṣitāsmadavasthaḥ anālocitā kathañcillabdhā asmākaṃ mūrcchāsukhānubhūtyavasthā yena, athavā virahāvasthā, vyāpāraḥ pratibodhanarūpā pravṛttiḥ/
tamabhimukhīkṛtyopālabhate - bhagavan niratiśayajñānaviśiṣṭeti na punarajñānāt tvayedaṃ kṛtaṃ kevalaṃ niṣkṛpatayetyarthaḥ/ ata evoparyakaruṇetyāmantraṇam/
bhramayetyādi - bhramaya sañcāraya ambhogarbhān jalamudare yeṣāmiti bhāragauravāt svayaṃ sañcaraṇāśaktirdyotyate/ pramodaya prakṛṣṭān kuru, vāridharāvāraṇahetutvāt, cātakān dhārāṭapakṣiṇaḥ, teṣāmapi tvadekaśaraṇatvāt/ kokilāniti vā pāṭhaḥ/ teṣāmapi vasantavadvarṣāsvapi harṣasya mahākaviprasiddheḥ/ yathā prāvṛḍvarṇane bhāraviḥ ``vyathitamapi bhṛśaṃ mano harantīṣṭaṣṭapariṇatajamburasopayogahṛṣṭā/
parabhṛtayuvatī svanaṃ vicakreṣṭaṣṭanavanavayojitakaṇṭharāgaramyam//'' iti/ madaya tṛptān kuru, nartayetyarthaḥ, madātiśayakāryatvānnartanasya, śikhino mayūrān/ kekotkaṇṭhān kekānādena svāgatīkṛtenonnamitakandharān, teṣāmapi nisargasauhṛdāt/ kaṭhoraya kaṭhorān pacelimān kuru, vikāsayetyarthaḥ, ketakān ketakīkusumāni, jaladagarjite taṭitsphuraṇe codbhinnānāṃ teṣāmapi tvadadhīnaparipākatvāt/ ketakāniti pulliṅgatve pramāṇaṃ mṛgyam, ``dviradadantavalarkṣamalakṣyata sphuritabhṛṅgamṛgacchavi ketakam/'' ityādiṣu ṣaṇḍatvenaiva prayogadarśanāt/ ketakīriti ketakamiti ca vā pāṭhaḥ/ āmantraṇe nimantraṇe vā loṭ/ virahiṇi priyajanaviśleṣaviśiṣṭe jane iti na punarmayīti sarvasyāpi virahiṇo janasya sādhāraṇīyaṃ pravṛttiriti dyotayati/ mūrcchā mohaṃ labdhveti ciraprārthitāyāstasyā lābho mahānidhilābha iveti vyañjayati/ tatra hetuḥ - vinodayati aye iti tameva gamayati/ vyathāṃ analakuharaluṭhanavat kaṭhināṃ vedanāṃ punarbhūyo'pi saṃjñāvyādhiṃ prabodharūpaṃ rogaṃ, antaritavyathodbodhanāt, vidhāya sampādya kimīhase kiṃ prayojanamabhipraiṣi, na kiṃñcit prayojanaṃ tava setsyatītyarthaḥ/ jaladabhramaṇādīnāṃ tu lokopakārakatvāt suhṛtkāryatvāt svadharmatvācca saprayojanatvam/ asya tu vyāpārasya paropadravarūpatvāt aniṣṭaphalatvameveti bhāvaḥ/ atra pavanaṃ pratyasūyā vyajyate, upakārabuddhyā prayuktasya na kevalamupakāra (ka)tvābhāvaḥ, api tvanarthāvahatvaṃ ceti dyotanāt/ viṣamālaṅkāro vyaṅgyaḥ//42//
sukṛtaṃ śobhanamanuṣṭhitaṃ, sakalajantujīvanena sarvaprāṇiprāṇaneneti harṣāt stutiḥ, mātariśvanā vāyunā/
deveti samīhitasādhanasāmarthyaṃ dyotayati/ tathāpīti yadyapi bhavatā pratikūlamācaritaṃ tathāpi, gatyantarābhāvādityarthaḥ/
vikasadityādi/ kadambanikurumbasya kadambakusumasamūhasya pāṃsubhiḥ parāgaiḥ/
``samudāyassamudayo nikurumbaṃ kadambakam/''iti vaijayantī/ saheti haraṇe'nāyāsa (tva ṛ)māha/ hara naya/ priyā yataḥ yasmin deśe tasminniti/ athaveti prāṇaharaṇaṃ dayayā na kriyate cet tadaṅgaparivāsaśītalaṃ tasyā aṅgaiḥ parivāso'dhivāsitvamaṅgeṣu vā paritassthitiḥ tena śītalaṃ santāpaharam, aṅgānāṃ śītalatvena tatsaṃsṛṣṭasyāpi śītalatvasyopapatteḥ, kiñcidityaviśeṣoktiḥ, tathāvidhasya sarvasyāpi santāpaharatvāt, īraya prakṣipa/ tathāpītyuktasya hetumāha - turvyāvṛttau, asmin kṛtye nānyasya sāmatharyamiti bhāvaḥ/ gatirūpāyaḥ śaraṇaṃ vā/ atra dainyaṃ vyajyate/ aprastutapraśaṃsālaṅkāraḥ, kāryamukhena kāraṇasya virahasantāpasya prakāśanāt//43//
kṛtāñjalirghaṭitahastadvayaḥ praṇamati tanmārge daṇḍavat patati/
susamāhitaḥ suṣṭhu saṅghaṭitaḥ, vidhineti śeṣaḥ/ kavinetyapi sphurati/ abhijñānārpaṇasya mālatīcihnabhūtabakulamālāpradānasya avasaraḥ samayaḥ/
muñcatyaspaṣṭameva pātayatītyarthaḥ/
sākūtaṃ sābhiprāyaṃ, priyājīvitasūcakatvaṃ abhipretyetyarthaḥ/ savismayaharṣaṃ vismayaḥ prārthanānantarameva pavanena dattatvāt, harṣaḥ priyāsattānumāpakatvāt, tābhyāṃ sahitaṃ, tasyā vināśe bhagavatā mārutena tadabhijñānasya bakulamālāyāḥ samarpaṇaṃ aruntudaṃ nopapadyate ityabhiprāyaḥ/ kathamityāścarye/ iyaṃ dṛśyamānā sā anubhūtacarī stanodvāhadurlalitamūrtiḥ stanābhyāmudvahanena durlalitā dṛptā mūrtiḥ saṃsthānaṃ yasyāḥ, anaṅgamandirāṅkaṇabakulapādapakusumamālā kāmadevāyatanacatvaravartino bakulavṛkṣasya puṣpaiḥ kṛtā mālā/
samyaṅnirūpya atyantāsambhāvitaprāptatayā punaḥ sūkṣmaṃ nirīkṣya ityarthaḥ/ kiṃśabdaḥ kṣepe, sandehasya nāvakāśa ityarthaḥ/ tathātvamevopapādayati - sa eva ayamasyā vibhāga ityanvayaḥ/
mugdhendvityādi - mugdhaṃ komalaminduvat sundaraṃ lāvaṇyaśāli ca tadīyaṃ tasyāḥ sambandhi yanmukhaṃ tasyāvalokahelāyāṃ darśanalīlāyāṃ viśṛṅkhalasya niryantraṇasya kutūhalasya kautukasya nihnavāya chādanārthaṃ durnyastapuṣparacanaḥ akramakṛtakusumasanniveśaḥ, ata eva viṣamagrathitaḥ uccāvacasandarbhaḥ apītyupakramānirvāhādasantoṣaviṣayatve'pītyapinā virodho vyajyate/ vibhāgaḥ darśanāt pūrvaṃ grathitāt bhāgādvibhaktaḥ pradeśaḥ, toṣaṃ prītiṃ tatāna cakāra/ ``tanu karaṇe'' iti dhātuḥ/ atra ca mālatīmukhāvalokanavihastatayā viṣamaviracitaikabhāgāmapi bahumanyamāna iti pūrvoktamanusmārayati/ atra virodhaḥ preyaścālaṅkāraḥ//44//
saharṣonmādaṃ harṣo'bhijñānalābhāt, unmādastvanuvartata eva, atastābhyāṃ sahitaṃ yathā tathā, utthāya/ mālāmañjalau nikṣipya parihāsārthaṃ svayaṃ tirohitāṃ priyatamāṃ manyamāna āha - mālati mālatīti vīpsayā harṣasambhramo vyajyate/ iyamiti purovartinī kathaṃ na dṛśyasa ityarthaḥ/ vīkṣyase kimantardhānaprayāseneti bhāvaḥ/ sakopamiveti svoktāvapi tasyā anāvirbhāvāt kopasahitam/ ivaśabdaḥ paramārthataḥ kopasyābhāvāt tadviṣaye tasya praṇayapravṛttatvādaparamārthatvamāha/ madavasthānabhijñe madīyāmavasthāmatikleśaduḥsthāmajānāne/
svāvasthānivedanapurassaraṃ tasyāḥ parihāsamupālabhate - prayāntīvetyādi/ prayāntī gacchantīva, sarvamarmaṇāṃ tudyamānatvāt/ dhvaṃsate sthānāt patatīva, samastavastvaparijñānāt/ jvalanti vahninā dīpyanta iva durvāradāruṇajvaragrastatvāt/ samantāt sarvataḥ tamo'ndhakāraṃ prasarati pravartata iva, mūrcchāyā avicchedāt/ tvarāprastāvaḥ tvarayā jhaṭiti pravṛtteravasaraḥ/ parihāsasya krīḍāyā viṣayaḥ avakāśaḥ/ tat tasmāt akṣṇornetrayorānandaṃ vitara dehi, prakāśībhāvāt/ mayi ya evaṃ gatastasmin mayīti sarvathā dayanīyatvaṃ dyotyate, akaruṇā dayārahitā mā bhūḥ/ atrotprekṣālaṅkāraḥ, todanādeḥ prāṇaprayāṇādirūpeṇa sambhāvanāt ``limpatīva tamo'ṅgānī''tyādivat la atiśayoktiśca, duḥkhātiśayasya bhaṅgyā pratipādanāt//45//
sarvataḥ latākuñjādiṣu tirodhānaśaṅkayā nirīkṣya/ sanirvedaṃ adarśanādudvegasahitam/ atra asmin deśe kutaḥ kasmāddhetoḥ, mama vyāmoha eva tadvitarkamūlamityarthaḥ/ anenāñjalau bakulamālāṃ muktvā kimayaṃ kariṣyatīti jijñāsayā saudāminīmakarandayorantarhitatvamavagamyate, upari mūrcchāvasare tayorupasaraṇasya vakṣyamāṇatvācca/
paramopakāritvamanusmṛtya śocati - niṣpratyūhā ityādi/ ``vighno'ntarāyaḥ pratyūhaḥ'' ityamaraḥ/ madanurāgaparijñānāt pūrvaṃ nirvighnā nivārakābhāvād durvārā ityarthaḥ/ priyasakhīti priyāyā iṣṭā, sakhyāḥ kāryasya prāṇasamāsamāśvāsanasya karaṇāt, sambuddhiḥ/ yadā yasmin kāle dussahāḥ soḍhumaśakyāḥ tīvravedanatvāt saṃbabhūvuḥ daivāt sambhūtāḥ dehoddāhavyasanaguravaḥ na kevalamantaḥ bahirapi śarīrasyotkaṭena dāhaduḥkhena durbharāḥ, manmathasyonmātho niratiśayo bādhaḥ tasya vegāḥ mūrcchādijanakāḥ prasarāḥ/ tvatsamāśleṣaḥ lavaṅgikayā maddhastādādāyopahṛtāyāstava hṛdi vinyāsaḥ, evakāreṇa trāṇāntarābhāvamāha, prāṇatrāṇaṃ prāṇānāṃ rakṣaṇamauṣadhaṃ, ``kṛtyalyuṭorbahulam'' (3-3-113) iti karaṇe lyuṭ, madanurāgasūcakatvāt, praguṇamṛju sākṣādityarthaḥ, priyatamasvahastakṛtatvāt praguṇatvamāha, matpariṣvaṅgakalpa madāliṅganādīṣadasamāptaḥ, tvāṃ madhyekṛtya mayaivāśliṣṭamiti tasyāḥ saṅkalpāditi bhāvaḥ/ abhavaditi bhūtatvamāha/ anadyatanavyañjakatvāllaṅ/ sedānīṃ na dṛśyate tvamevaikā dṛśyase iti bhāvaḥ//46//
sakaruṇaṃ saśokaṃ nirvarṇya nipuṇaṃ nirīkṣya/ pūrvānubhavamanusandhāyāha - ānandanānītyādi/ paramasukhajananāni, ``nandigrahipacādibhyo lyuṇinyacaḥ'' (3-1-134) iti kartari lyuḥ/ madanajvaradīpanāni kāmadāhasya poṣakāṇi, gāḍhānurāgarasavanti antaḥprarūḍhānurāgarasabhūyiṣṭhāni, tadā tadā ca teṣu teṣu kāleṣu, kadācit pāritoṣikatvena, kadācidalaṅkāratvena, kadācid dyūtādiglahatvena, kadācinnikṣepatvena ityādibhiḥ prakārairityarthaḥ, snehāṅkanāni snehasya cihnāni, tāni anubhūtāni gatāgatāni gamanānyāgamanāni ca smarāmi/ idānīṃ smaraṇagocarībhūtāni tāni la ataḥ paraṃ kiṃ kaṣṭamityarthaḥ/ atra smṛtirvyajyate/ preyaścālaṅkāraḥ//47//
hṛdaye vakṣasi/
kṛto'pi ajñātādapādānāt mālatīsvahastasya mālatyāḥ sākṣādabhijñānasya svahastalikhitavācakasya, svahastaśabdo'tra lakṣaṇayā cihnamātramāha/ ``kiṃ mithyā bhavato hṛtena dayitāsnehasvahastena me/'' iti vikramorvaśīyokteḥ/ tat tasmāt etat lābharūpaṃ vastu kiṃ paramārtharūpaṃ māyādikaṃ vā rūpamiti manyase tarkayasi/ kathaṃ kena prakāreṇeti manyase/ itīti śabda āvartanīyaḥ, kiṃrūpaṃ manyase, kuto janādāpatitaṃ manyasa ityarthaḥ//
tasya saṃśayaṃ chinatti - iyamiti purasthitāyā abhinayaḥ/ āryā kalyāṇī akāraṇopakāritvāt, yogeśvarī iti pūjyatvamupakārasāmarthyaṃ ca dyotayati, mālatyabhijñānasyeti na māyādikaṃ, tadevedaṃ tvadanubhūtamiti kimityasyottaram/ upanetrī etadasmatsamīpamupanītavatī, kṛdyoge karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī, ``niyamavidhijalānāṃ barhiṣāṃ copanetrī/'' iti kumārasambhavoktavat/ iyamupanetrīti kathamiti praśnasyottaram/
vilokya tāṃ dṛṣṭvā/ sakaruṇamiti viśiṣṭabandhudarśanāt kimiyaṃ vakṣyatītyāśaṅkayā vivṛddhaśokamityarthaḥ/ liṅginītvādañjalibandhaḥ/ kiṃ jīvatīti viśeṣapraśnasya jīvanamūlatvāt praśnaḥ/ prāṇeśvarī tajjīvanāyattatvādasmajjīvitasya tajjīvitoktyaiva asmajjīvitatrāṇamapi kṛtaṃ bhaviṣyatīti vyañjayati/
tadāśayajñā vaidagdhyāduttaramāha - samāśvasihi viśvasto bhava, tajjīvanaṃ pratītyarthaḥ/ vīpsayā sandehaṃ nivartayati/ atha samāśvāsanayā sthirīkṛtahṛdaye tasmin sphuṭamāha - diṣṭyā te daivasampannatvāttava sā yā tvayānyathā śaṅkitā sā kalyāṇinī maṅgalavatī/ kalyāṇañca jīvitamakṣataśarīratvamāsannasamāgamatvaṃ ca/
samucchvasya tadāptatayā prasannahṛdayau bhūtvā āhatuḥ - evaṃ yadi jīvati cet, sarvataḥ sarvaprakāreṇa, vistarata ityarthaḥ/ eṣa prastutaḥ vṛttāntaḥ kaḥ mālatyā vṛttaṃ kiṃrūpamiti/
asti idamiti śeṣaḥ/ asyārthasya bhavadbhyāṃ pūrvameva viditatvādataḥ parameva vaktavyamiti bhāvaḥ/ kapālapāṇiḥ kapālaṃ pāṇau yasya, kāpālika iti yāvat/ vyāpāditaḥ māritaḥ/
``vyāpādanaṃ ca hiṃsā'' iti vaijayantī/'' vacanopakrama eva vakṣyamāṇamūhato jñātvā sāvegaṃ samanaḥkṣobhamāha - virama nivartasva, ataḥ paraṃ vacanāditi śeṣaḥ/ vīpsayā duḥśravatvaṃ sūcyate/ niṣedhe hetuḥ - jñāto vṛttāntaḥ tvadupanyāsādeva mayānumānena vidita ityarthaḥ/
sphuṭamajānānaḥ pṛcchati - ka iva tvayā jñāto vṛttāntaḥ kīdṛśa iva saṃkṣipyottaramāha - anyadvastu kiṃ nānyadvastvityākṣepe kiṃśabdaḥ/ sakāmā pūrṇo asmatpratīkārarūpaḥ kāmo manoratho yasyāḥ/
taduktamarthaṃ draḍhayituṃ pṛcchati - apiḥ praśne, evamitthaṃ kimityarthaḥ/
evaṃ tathā, yathā yena prakāreṇa viditaṃ jñātaṃ vatsena mādhavena/
nirṇītavṛttānto vidhimupālabhate - kaṣṭamayuktamidam/ bho ityākāśe mahājanasyābhimukhyakaraṇam/ vīpsayātyantāyuktatvaṃ vyajyate/
tathātvamevopapādayati - kumudākareṇetyādi/ kumudākareṇa kumudaṣaṇḍenetyanena prasiddhaṃ vimalakomalaśītalādikatvaṃ dyotyate, śaradinducandrikā meghādyāvaraṇarāhityena samagraguṇasyendorjyotsnetyanena bahalavimalatvādibhirjagadāhlādakatvaṃ prakāśyate, rāmaṇīyakaguṇāya sadṛśasamāgamatvāt parasparasya niratiśayasaundaryaguṇaṃ labdhuṃ, kumudākarasya candrikāsandarśane vikāsāt tasyāśca tatsamāgame lāvaṇyamūrcchanāt saṅgatā saṃśliṣṭā yadi, tat sukṛtaṃ suṣṭā samācaritamanenetyarthāt/ turvyāvṛttau/ ayantu vidhirdaivaṃ katamaḥ kīdṛśaḥ akālameghavitatiṃ śaratsambandhitvokteḥ śaradi ca meghasambandhasyānupapatteḥ, akāle viruddhe kāle, naño'tra vipakṣo'rthaḥ/
``pratiṣedhe ca sattāyāmanyatve sadṛśe'pi ca/
kutsālpavirahārtheṣu vipakṣe cāpi nañ smṛtaḥ//'' iti vacanāt, meghānāṃ vitatiḥ vistāraṃ, ayūyujat yojitavān, anyonyamadarśanāya, tayormadhye iti prasiddherlabhyate/ ``yujir yoge'' ityasmālluṅicaṅi ca rūpam/ yat yasmāt tasmāt pūrvaṃ paravyāhatakaraṇādunmattavadupālambhanīya evāyaṃ vidhirityarthaḥ/ kiṃśabdena kṣepavācinā pratipādyate/ atra aprastutapraśaṃsālaṅkāraḥ, aprastutādarthāt parasparānurūpaguṇayornāyakayoḥ samāgamaḥ prāk samupapādya paścāttadvighātāya svayameva pravartamānasya vidheḥ prastutasyārthasya sārūpyataḥ pratīteḥ la atiśayoktirvā, prakṛtasyārthasya samenārthena nigīryādhyavasānāt//48//
atha guruvadhāmarṣitayā kapālakuṇḍalayā tasyā vyāpāditatvameva niścitya premaparavaśaḥ paridevayate - heti/ kaṣṭaṃ kṛcchraṃ atibībhatsaṃ atyantajugupsitaṃ, mahābhāgyarāśestava kapilāyā iva vyāghrīmukhāt kāpālikīsakāśāt nidhanasyātigarhitatvamiti bhāvaḥ/ ``badherdhātoḥ sanantasya bībhatsārūpasambhavaḥ/
yatpadārthe tu bībhatsā sa bībhatsa itīritaḥ//
garhaṇīyaśca nindyaśca kutsanīyaśca yo bhavet/
sa bhāvaḥ kathyate sadbhirvībhatsa iti saṃjñayā//'' iti bhāvaprakāśaḥ/ āpannāsi prāptāsi/
tadavasthādausthyamutprekṣyāha - kathamivetyādi/ kamalamukhīti tattādṛśaprasādalāvaṇyaviśiṣṭaṃ mukhaṃ tava niratiśaye bhaye pratyupasthite taralataranayanatvādibhirviśiṣṭatvenotprekṣyamāṇaṃ māṃ dahatīti dyotayati/ kapālakuṇḍalayā grastā kabalīkartumākrāntā tadā tasmin kāle kathamivābhavaḥ kena prakāreṇāvartiṣṭhāḥ, sa prakāro na vāṅmanasagocaraḥ, kevalaṃ tvayānubhūta iti bhāvaḥ/ utpātadhūmalekhākrāntā jagadupadravasūcakadhūmaketulekhā/
``... ... ... tiraskṛtāṣṭadhūmagraheṇa vimalā śaśinaḥ kaleva/'' iti pūrvamapyuktam/ athavā bhuvanasaṃhārajvalitakālānaladhūmakabalitetyarthaḥ/
``parimaṭṭhamerusiharo sūrāhimuho vva palādhūmuppīḍo/'' iti setūktavat/ upamayā sarvajanodvegahetutvaṃ kāpālikyāḥ, sakalasahṛdayadayanīyatvaṃ ca nāyikāyaḥ pratīyate/ atra śaṅkākhyo bhāvaḥ prakāśyate/ upamālaṅkāraḥ//49//
ākāśe abhimukhīkṛtya priyatamājīvitāśayā prārthayate - bhavati pūjye iti/
tavedamanucitamiti tāmāvarjayati - nirmāṇamityādi/ nirmāṇaṃ vidhātuḥ sṛṣṭiḥ/ taditi samagraguṇatvānubhavaparāmarśaḥ/ evakāreṇa svabhāvato darśanamātre ādareṇa lālanīyatvaṃ bahumānena sambhāvyatvaṃ prakāśyate/ athavā evakāro bhinnakramaḥ, vayaṃ bhavatīviṣaye aparāddhā nāma, pratīkāraśca bhavatyāḥ kartavyo bhavatu nāma/ tathāpi tannirmāṇamādaralālanīyameva, padārthasvābhāvyāt/
``padaṃ hi sarvatra guṇairnidhīyate/'' iti nyāyenāsmatsambandho na tatra nirūpaṇīya iti bhāvaḥ/ ataḥ pūtanātvaṃ mopagāḥ viśeṣavedinī yat tvaṃ aviśeṣajñānāṃ kravyādānāṃ piśācīnāṃ bhāvaṃ gantuṃ nārhasi/ śivatātiḥ tasyāḥ kalyāṇadāyinī, ``śivatātiḥ śivaṅkaraḥ'' iti halāyudhaḥ, edhi bhava/ asterloṭi madhyamapuruṣaikavacane ``ghvasoreddhāvabhyāsalopaśca'' (6-4-119) ityetvaṃ, ``hujhalbhyo herdhiḥ'' (6-4-102) iti herdhirādeśaśca/ hiśabdasūcitāṃ prasiddhimeva samarthayati - nisargaḥ svabhāvastatra bhavā naisargikī, surabhiṇaḥ ghrāṇatarpaṇagandhasya [kusumasya] siddhā loke prasiddhā mūrdhni sthitiḥ śirasi dhāraṇam/ musalaiḥ vrīhyādyavahananasādhanairdaṇḍaiḥ avatāḍanāni gāḍhaprahārāḥ/ kusumasya svecchopabhogaśeṣatve'pi na kaścidanunmattaḥ śirasi dhāraṇamantareṇa musaladaṇḍaiḥ tat khaṇḍayatīti bhāvaḥ/ siddhānīti liṅgavacanavipariṇāmaḥ/ bahuvacanena tāḍanasyaivānaucitye kiṃ punastāḍanānāmiti vyajyate/ atrārthāntaranyāso'laṅkāraḥ viśeṣasya sāmānyena samarthanāt//50//
tadāśaṅkāmupapattyā nivartayati - āvegena tannidhanāśaṅkājanitena manaḥkṣobheṇālam/
akariṣyadityādi - akariṣyat kariṣyati asau iyaṃ prastutā sā tathāvidhavairapratīkārakāṅkṣiṇī, pāpamaniṣṭaṃ atiniṣkaruṇā atiśayena nirastakāruṇyā, evakāreṇa tācchīlyaṃ dhvanyate, nābhaviṣyaṃ na sannihitā bhaviṣyāmi, tatra śrīparvate tatparipanthinī tasya pāpakāraṇasya pratipakṣabhūtā/ atra liṅnimitte lṛṅ kriyātipattau liṅnimittaṃ hetuhetumattādi kriyāyā atipattiranirvṛttiḥ viruddhakriyopanipātanāt/ atra ca pāpakaraṇasya hetumataḥ svasannidhānābhāvarūpahetuvaiguṇyādatipattiḥ prakāśyate/ atra kāvyaliṅgamalaṅkāraḥ, āveganiṣedhahetorvākyārthatvenopanyāsāt//51//
praṇamyeti/ pūrvaṃ liṅginītve'pyāvegavaśāt samudācārasyānanuṣṭhitatvādidānīṃ manasaḥ svasthatayā bahumānātiśayācca namaskṛtyetyarthaḥ/ āryāpādaiḥ pūjyayā āryayā/ pādā iti nāmānte ``devo bhaṭṭārako vāpi'' iti pādaśabdasya pūjyavācitvāt/ prasannamasmadviṣaye'nugrahaḥ kṛta iti bhāve niṣṭhā/ tat tarhi punaśśabdo vyāvṛttau, asminnavasare nānyaḥ kaścidāvāsako dṛṣṭaḥ tvaṃ tu kā kīdṛśaṃ sambandhamavalambya vartase, vidyayā janmanā vā sambandha ityarthaḥ/ etatpraśne hetuḥ - ekabandhuradvitīyo mukhyo bandhuḥ, tatkāryakaraṇāditi bhāvaḥ/
mantripratijñāparijñānasahitasya kāmandakīsambandhasya tatsannidhāveva vyaktībhaviṣyataścamatkārātiśayahetutvād idānīṃ prakāśane rasabhaṅgamāśaṅkya bhaṅgyā chādayati, ``sa pṛṣṭaḥ sarvato vārtamākhyadrājñe na santatim/
prakhyāpayiṣyataḥ kāle kaverādyasya śāsanāt//'' iti raghuvaṃśokteḥ/ etat jñāsyate jñātaṃ bhaviṣyati, mattatvarūpaṃ vastu/ atha vidyābalāt tatsamīpaṃ nītena mādhavena mālatīmāśvāsya tatsahitena tenānītena bandhujanamāśvāsayitumāśayenāha - utthāya gaganaṃ samutpatya/ iyaṃ yā bhavatsnehayantritā/
gurucaryetyādi - guruṣu tattadvidyāguruṣu prayuktā śuśrūṣā gurucaryā, tapaḥ kṛcchracāndrāyaṇādibhiḥ śarīrapariśodhanaṃ, tantraṃ auṣadhaṃ, mantrā pañcākṣarādayaḥ yogo yamādyaṣṭāṅgacittavṛttinirodhopāyaprayogaḥ, teṣvabhiyogo nirbandhastato jātāṃ, samagrībhūtāmiti yāvat/ tapaḥprabhṛtīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ gurucaryāmūlatve'pi tasyāḥ pṛthaggrahaṇaṃ tairvināpi guruprasādādeva niratiśayaprabhāvasampattirekalavyādivat, kimuta tatsāhacaryāditi dyotayitum/ ``tantraṃ pradhāne siddhānte tantuvāne paricchade/
śāstrauṣadhāntramukhyeṣu prayoge'dhvarakarmaṇām//'' iti vaijayantī/ imāmiti idānīmeva dṛśyaphalatvamāha, ākṣepiṇīṃ ākarṣiṇīṃ deśāt deśāntaraprāptikāriṇīmiti yāvat, siddhiṃ vidyāphalaprāptiṃ ātanomi samantādvistārayāmi, vaḥ śivāya mālatīmādhavasambandhināṃ sarveṣāṃ vyasanaśāntaye/ atra aprastutapraśaṃsālaṅkāraḥ, snehakāruṇyayoḥ kāraṇayoḥ kāryamukhena prakāśanāt//52//
samādhavā mādhavasahitā niṣkrāntā śrīparvatābhigamanāyetyarthāt/
tadā tadvidyāprabhāvadarśanād vismayamāna āha - vyatikara ivetyādi/ vyatikaraḥ sammiśritaḥ bhīmaḥ bhayaṅkaraḥ, tāmasaḥ timirasambandhī, aspaṣṭarūpatvāt, vaidyutaḥ vidyutsambandhī ca, tejaḥpuñjasphuraṇamātropalabdheḥ, kṣaṇaṃ kālakalāṃ upahatacakṣurvṛttiḥ pratihatā cakṣuṣo vṛttirvyāpāro yena, udbhūya udgato bhūtvā śāntaḥ, tirohitaḥ, tamovidyutorvyatikara iva kaścit padārtha iti śeṣaḥ/ sabhayaṃ apāyaśaṅkayā bhayasahitam/ iha asmin sthāne na vayasyaḥ suhṛnna dṛśyate, kathamityāścarye/ tat tasmāt kimetat idaṃ vartamānaṃ vastu kimiti vikalpe, kiṃ svapnaḥ uta māyā athavā pūrvamasaṃstutayānayā yoginyā vañcanaṃ prayuktamityarthaḥ/ vicintya nirūpya/ kimanyat/ kiṃśabdaḥ kṣepe, anyadasmadvikalpitaṃ na kiñcidityarthaḥ/ kasmādanyadityapekṣāyāmāha - prabhavati prabhuḥ sarvotkṛṣṭā vartate/ svena ananyasāmānyena mahimnā vidyāprabhāvena yogeśvarī karmajñānarūpasya yogasya svāminītyāptatvaṃ dhvanyate, iyamiti mālatyabhijñānopanayanādibhiḥ pratyakṣānugrahatvaṃ viśvasanīyākāratvaṃ ca dyotyate/ atra bhayacintāmatayo bhāvāḥ pratīyante/ utprekṣālaṅkāraḥ, astradevatāyā ivākarṣaṇadevatāyā duṣprekṣasya jhaṭiti nāyakākarṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā tirohitasya svarūpasya tamovidyudvyatikaratvenotprekṣaṇāt/ ``vyatikara iva bhīma'' ityādi citrābhinayavat, hastādhyeyopāṅgādhyeyayoḥ kathitatvāt//53//
savitarkaṃ punarapi suhṛtsnehakātaratayā vicārasahitamityarthaḥ/ tat tasmāt, yasmādiha vayasyo na dṛśyate asyāścāptatvamanumīyate tasmāt, ayaṃ vartamāno vṛttāntaḥ arthaḥ prayojanaḥ anarthaḥ arthaviruddha iti asmin prakāre mūḍho nirṇetumaśakto'smi/
mohavaśāt manasaḥ kṣobhamanusandhāyāha - api ca - astokavismayamityādi/ astokavismayaṃ analpo vidyāprabhāvadarśanena vismayo'dbhutabuddhiryasya, avismṛtaṃ buddhyārūḍhaṃ pūrvavṛttaṃ mālatyapāyānmādhavasyonmādādikaṃ svapnavṛttāntavañcintyamānaṃ yena la udbhūtena pravṛddheṣa[na] nūtanena mādhavatirodhānānantaraṃ jātena bhayajvareṇa kiṃ bhaviṣyatītyāśaṅkārūpeṇa mahāvyādhinā jarjaraṃ sahasradhā viśīrṇaṃ la ekasminneva kṣaṇe truṭitaḥ khaṇḍitaḥ la kuśalyāyāsyatīti mananena saṅghaṭitaḥ saṃśleṣitaḥ punarapāyaśaṅkayā ca pramoho mūrcchā yasmin la ānandenāntyāvasthāyāṃ vartamānāyāṃ svayoracintitopanatayā yoginyā samāśvāsanānmālatyānayanāya mādhavasya nītatvācca, śokena suhṛdvirahaduḥkhena śabalatvaṃ nānāvarṇatvamiti lakṣaṇayā vividhavikāravikṣiptatvaṃ prakāśyate/ atra bhāvaśabalatvamalaṅkāraḥ//54//
tat yasmād bandhusannidhau saṃvibhāgāt sahyaduḥkhatvaṃ manaso bhaviṣyati tasmāt, atra bṛhaddroṇīśailasamīpavartini kāntāragahane, ``kāntāro vartmadurgamam'' ityamaraḥ, durgasya vanasya gahvare asmadvargeṇa lavaṅgikādināsmadbandhusamūhena saha bhagavatīṃ kāmandakīmanusṛtya anveṣaṇena prāpyeti tasyā vicārakṣamatvādarthānarthanirṇayapramāṇatvaṃ prakāśayati, evaṃ yoginyāgamanamādhavanayanarūpaṃ, kathayāmītyanenānantarāṅkādau kāmandakyādīnāpi praveśaṃ sūcayati kavikulatilaka ityaśeṣamatimaṅgalam//
mālatīmādhavasyetthaṃ navamāṅkārthacarcanam/
pūrṇajyotiḥprasādena cakre pūrṇasarasvatī// //iti navamo'ṅkaḥ//
atha daśamo'ṅkaḥ/
atha mahākaviḥ - ``aṅkāntapātrairaṅkāsyaṃ chinnāṅkārthasya sūcanāt'' iti lakṣitenāṅkāsyena sūcitānāṃ pātrāṇāṃ praveśamāha - tataḥ praviśatītyādinā/
rasadoṣaparihārāyāṅginamanusandadhāti - hā vatse ityādinā/ madaṅkālaṅkārakāriṇi madutsaṅgaśobhāsampādini, satatasannidhānāt saundaryaviśeṣajanakatvācca, kvāsi kasmin deśe vartase/ prativacanaṃ vilapantyā mama samāśvāsanarūpamuttaram/
ā janmana ityādi/ ā janmanaḥ janmakālādārabhya pratimuhūrtaviśeṣaramyāṇi kṣaṇe kṣaṇe guṇātiśayaprakāśanena manoharāṇi āceṣṭitāni śārīrān vyāpārān gatihasitādīn, tāni tāni ityaśakyavarṇanatvamanubhavagocaratvaṃ ca dyotyate/ cāṭūni krīḍāyojanādiprārthanayā priyavacanāni cārumadhurāṇi hṛdyānyanulbaṇāni ca samprati saṃsmṛtāni smaraṇagocarībhūtāni/ dehaṃ śarīram dahanti mahājvarajanakatvena/ tatra hetuḥ - hṛdayaṃ mano vidārayanti krakacavat pāṭayanti/ ato hṛdayasantāpamūlatvaṃ dehadāhasya/ atrātiśayoktiḥ preyaścālaṅkāraḥ//1//
punaḥ prakārāntareṇa smarantyāha - aniyatetyādi/ aniyataruditasmitaṃ anabhisandhipūrvakatvād bālasvabhāvenāntarāntarā saṅkīrṇatvādaniyataṃ niyamarahitaṃ ruditaṃ kranditaṃ smitaṃ hāsaśca yasmin, virājanti śobhamānāni katipayānāṃ parimitānāṃ komalānāṃ mṛdūnāṃ dantakuḍmalānāṃ daśanāṅkurāṇāṃ agrāṇi asamagraprarūḍhatvācchikharāṇi yasmin, vadanakamalakaṃ mukharūpaṃ bālakamalaṃ, alpārthe'nukampāyāṃ vā kapratyayaḥ, śiśoḥ stanandhayāvasthāyāḥ/ skhalad anyasmin vivakṣite'nyathāpravartamānākṣaraṃ asamañjasaṃ svaparikalpitasaṅketavaśāt ghaṭe paṭaḥ puṣpe phalamityādirūpatvāllaukikavyavahārottīrṇaṃ mañju madhuraṃ ca jalpitaṃ bhāṣitaṃ yasmin/ atra rūpakaṃ preyaścālaṅkāraḥ//2//
itare madayantikālavaṅgike/ hā suprasannamukhacandrasundari kvāsi ṛ ko vā te śarīraratnasya daivadurvilāsapariṇāmaḥ ekākinyā upanataḥ/ suprasannena kadācidapi roṣādivikārarāhityāt mukhacandreṇa ,sundari ṅa
śobhane! vāśabdo vikalpe/ śarīrarūpasya ratnasya sarvaśarīrebhya utkṛṣṭatvāt/ daivasya duṣṭo vyāpāro durvilāsaḥ tasya pariṇāmaḥ paripākaḥ/ ko vā kiṃprakāro vā/ etāvatā kālenādarśanādvināśastāvanniścita eva/ sa kiṃprakāra ādhidaivika ādhibhautiko vetyarthaḥ/ ekākinyā iti asmābhissahānubhūtaścettathā na duḥkhāyeti bhāvaḥ/ mahābhāga mādhava! upasthitāstamitamahotsavaste jīvalokassaṃvṛttaḥ/ mahābhāgeti bhāgyaśālī, mādhava iti lokasyodghoṣaṇāpi mṛṣā jāteti bhāvaḥ/ upasthitaḥ prāptaḥ tadānīmevāstamito naṣṭaśca, na tu kañcitkālaṃ sthitaḥ, mahotsavaḥ priyatamāprāptilakṣaṇaṃ niratiśayaṃ kalyāṇaṃ yasmin/ jīvalokaḥ manuṣyalokaḥ/
hā vatsau! mālatīmādhavau ṅaṣṭābhinavetyādi/ abhinavaḥ aparyuṣitatvānnirargalaḥ anyatrādṛṣṭapūrvo vā rāgarasaḥ parasparapremāsvādo yasmin/ ``rāgo'nurāge lākṣādau/''ṃ ``raso rāge viṣe vīrye tiktādau pārade drave/
retasyāsvādane hemni niryāse'mṛtaśabdayoḥ//'' iti vaijayantī/ ayamasmākaṃ buddhisthaḥ bhavatoḥ bhavatyāḥ bhavataśca kṛtakautukaḥ kadā bhaviṣyatīti janitotkaṇṭhaḥ pariṣvaṅgaḥ āśleṣaḥ/ ``atha śyāmalake lālā lavalī lāvalī phalā/'' iti, ``lavaṅgaṃ devakusumaṃ śrīsaṃjñaṃ ca varālakam/'' iti ca vaijayantī/ tayoriveti viśleṣasya sahṛdayahṛdayaśalyatvamupamāne prakāśyate/ niyatirdaivaṃ mahatyā vātyayā maṇḍalīvāyuneva niyatyā abhihata haṭhātpīḍitaḥ/ atra dainyaṃ vyajyate/ upamālaṅkāraḥ//3//
hatāśa! vajramaya hṛdaya ṅa ,vajramayahṛdaya ṅa ṛ
sarvathā nṛśaṃsamasi/ hatā niṣphalā itaḥ paraṃ jīviṣyāmītyāśā yasya, vajramaya kuliśopādāna atikāṭhinyāt/ sarvathā sarvaprakāreṇa ciraparicayasatkārasatatasāhacaryādiṣvanyataramapi na gaṇayasīti bhāvaḥ/ nṛśaṃsaṃ bandhuvātsalyarahitaṃ nirdayamityarthaḥ/
hṛdayaṃ vakṣaḥ āhatya hastābhyāṃ tāḍayitvā patati bhuvi luṭhanāya daṇḍavat prapatati/
lavaṅgike nanu bhaṇāmi kṣaṇamātramapi tāvat samāśvasihi/ kṣaṇamātramapīti kṣaṇāntare tattvaṃ niścitya paścāt sarvāḥ prāṇāneva parityakṣyāma ityabhiprāyaḥ/ samāśvasihi āhananādikaṃ mā kṛthā ityarthaḥ/
