mātaḥ! kiṃ karomi ṛ dṛḍhavajralepapratibandhaniścalaṃ jīvitaṃ na māṃ parityajati/ mātaḥ! ambeti sadainyamāmantraṇam/ kiṃ āhananādibhyo'nyat kiṃ karomi, ayameva jīvitaparityāgopāyaḥ prayatnato'nuṣṭheya ityarthaḥ/ tatra hetuḥ - dṛḍhena vajralepena bandhadravyaviśeṣeṇa yaḥ pratibandhaḥ saṅghaṭanaṃ tena niścalaṃ svasthānato galanarahitaṃ jīvitaṃ na parityajati svayaṃ na muñcati/
ujjihānajīvitāṃ utkrāmatprāṇāṃ ``āhāṅ gatau'' ityasmācchānac, varākīṃ śocyāṃ, nānukampase svātmaprakāśanena sthirajīvitāṃ na karoṣi/ śocyatāmevopapādayati - iyaṃ lavaṅgikā hiryasmādarthe/
ujjvaletyādi/ ujjvalālokayā dīptalāvaṇyayā prabhāmahatyā ca snigdhā dṛḍhānurāgā tailasiktā ca, malīmasamukhī viṣādavivarṇavadanā maṣīmalināgrā ca, vartirdaśā, pradīpaśikhayā dīpajvālayā yathāśabda ivārthe/ atrārthaśleṣo'laṅkāraḥ//8//
kathaṃ ceti/ cakāro'pyarthe/ kāmandakīmapi kathaṃ parityajasi ``lavaṅgikādiṣu sakhīsnehamātrameva, mayi tu mātṛtvagurutvasakhītvānāṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyāt snehabahumānavisrambhabhājanatvaṃ tābhyo viśeṣo'styeva/ ataḥ svapne'pi matparityāgo'nutprekṣaṇīyaḥ'' ityarthaḥ/ kāmandakīmiti na punarmāmiti tattādṛśaviśiṣṭasnehatvenānubhavaṃ vyañjayati/ tadevopapādayati - nanuḥ saṃvāde/ akaruṇe! ārtānukampārahite/ madīyacīvarāñcaloṣmaṇā matsambandhinaścīvarāñcalo daśā tasyoṣmā, utsaṅge'navarataṃ niveśya dhāritatvāt, tena sammṛjya sveditatayetyarthaḥ/ praguṇīkṛtāni mañjūkṛtāni, bālya eva śiśūnāṃ gātrasauṣṭhavasya jñātijanena vidheyatvāt/ tathā daśakumāracarite - ``yad duhiturjanmanaḥ prabhṛtyaṅgakriye''ti la ``svedo mārdavakarāṇām'' iti saṃgrahokteśca/
punarapi svasnehaprakāśanena svaparityāgānaucityamāha - stanyanyāsāditi/ stanyasya mātṛstanapayasaḥ parityāgādārabhyetyanena stanyadānamātrameva dhātryeva mātrā kṛtamiti dyotayati/ ``pāñcālikā putrikā syād'' ityamaraḥ/ dantaḥ karidantaḥ prasiddhyā, ``dantaśapharukadhāriṇyā'', ``dantaputrikā'' ityādiprayogād, dantanirmitaputrikādibhiḥ/ ādiśabdāt kandukagarīyakaguḍaghaṭīkelanādikaṃ gṛhyate, taiḥ yā krīḍā ramaṇaṃ tatra yogaṃ jayasādhanamupāyaprayogam/ tato'nantaraṃ śaiśavamatītya kaumārakāvataraṇa ityarthaḥ/ vinayaṃ strīratnatvāt nṛttagītavādyādikāsu catuṣṣaṣṭyāṃ, kāmasūtrāṅgavidyāsu, kāmasūtre ca, brāhmaṇītvādamātyaputrītvācca dharmārthaśāstrayośca śikṣāṃ la ``vininyurenaṃ guravo gurupriyam'' iti raghuvaṃśokteḥ, ``vinayaḥ śāstraniścayaḥ'' iti kāmandakavacanācca/ prāpitā lambhitetyubhayatrāpi sambadhyate/ ``kāmasūtraṃ tadaṅgavidyāśca puruṣo'dhīyeta, prāgyauvanādyuvatiḥ, prattā ca patyurabhiprāyād yoṣitāṃ śāstragrahaṇāsambhavādanarthakamiha śāstre strīśāsanam'' ityācāryāḥ/ ``prayogagrahaṇādāsāṃ prayogasya ca śāstrapūrvatvāt'' iti vātsyāyanaḥ/ ``ācāryastu kanyakānāṃ dhātreyikā vṛddhadāsī bhikṣukī svase''ti, ``santyeva hi śāstraprahatabuddhayo gaṇikā rājaputryo mahāmātṛduhitaraśce''ti ca kāmasūtrokteḥ/ tasyāśśāstre svasyāścācāryake'dhikāro'nena pradarśitaḥ/ vardhitā rūpalāvaṇyamārdavabalamedhāsaubhāgyādijanakairāhārairauṣadhaviśeṣaiśca poṣitāsi/ lokaśreṣṭhe lokato loke vā utkṛṣṭe/ tatra hetuḥ - guṇavati praśastābhijanādiguṇe, prāśassye[stye] matup, vare bhartari sthāpitā śāstropāyaprayogapūrvakamanurāgavardhanādājīvitāntaṃ nirvikāraṃ niveśitā/ mayaiveti sarvatra kṛtye pitrādyapekṣāpi mayā na kṛtā, teṣāṃ manniyogamātrakiṅkaratvāditi dyotyate/ tena tacchabdo vākyārthe sākalyena parāmṛśati/ evamevaṃ ca mayā kṛtamiti yat tena hetunā tavāpi mayi mātuḥ samadhikaḥ mātuḥ svajananyā api saviśeṣaḥ, mātṛviṣayātsnehādapyatirikta ityarthaḥ/ ``pañcamī vibhakte'' (2-2-42) iti pañcamī/ sneho vibhakta ucitaḥ yukta ityanena svaviṣaye snigdheṣu snehasyaucityaṃ na ca dveṣasya/ atastvamakṛtajñāsītyupālambho vyajyate/ ataḥ kāmandakīmapi kathaṃ parityajasīti sambandhaḥ/ atrāprastutapraśaṃsālaṅkāraḥ, kāryamukhena kāraṇasya snehātiśayasya prakāśanāt, kāvyaliṅgaṃ ca, aparityāgahetoḥ bhaṅgyopādānāt//5//
savaiklavyaṃ nairāśyabhāvanayā nirastadhairyam/ yathā samprati vārtāmātrasyāpyanupalambhāt/ nirāśā purā kṛteṣu manoratheṣu nirastavāñcchā/
ke te manorathā ityāha - akāraṇetyādi/ akāraṇena anabhisandhipūrvakeṇa, aviditasnehaśokatayā sumanoharatvācchaiśavasya, athavā sahajena, snehena madviṣayeṇa manoharaṃ mandasmitādibhiḥ prakaṭitaprasādamānanaṃ yasya/ śikhāyāṃ śirasi lalāṭe ca arpitā rakṣārthaṃ nihitā gaurāḥ kanakavarṇāḥ sarṣapāḥ siddhārthā yasya, ``deve cottamāṅganihitarakṣāsarṣape samunmiṣatpratāpānalasphuliṅganikara ive''ti irṣacaritoktavat/ aṅkaśāyī urasi śayanaśīlaḥ, ``aṅkaścihne'ntikoraso''riti vaijayantī, utsaṅgavartī vā, ``aṅkādaṅkaṃ sañcarantī'' ityādiprayogāt/ parivṛttabhāgyayā anyathābhūtasukṛtayā na tu bhāgyahīnayeti, itaḥ pūrvaṃ bhavatyā janmanaḥ prabhṛti pariṇayanāvasānasya mahotsavasyānubhūtatvādidānīmeva duṣkṛtaphalaṃ duḥkhamabhijñāyata iti bhāvaḥ/ tanayaḥ putraḥ stanandhayaḥ stanyapāyī/ ``nāsikāstanayordhmādheṭoḥ'' (3-2-29), iti khaś/ atra prathamaṃ tanayasyaiva darśane manorathaḥ, tatastadavasthāvaśena tadviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭasyetyanuvādamukhena manorathānāṃ bāhuvidhyaṃ prakāśayati, ``putrā me saghṛtakṣīraṃ bhuñjīranni''ti vṛddhakumārīvaraprārthanavat/ atra svabhāvoktiralaṅkāraḥ//6//
bhagavati! prasīda/ nissahāsmi sāmprataṃ jīvitodvahane/ tadahamasmād giriprapātādātmānamavadhūya nirvṛtā bhaviṣyāmi/ prasīda anujñayānugṛhāṇa/ nissahā aśaktā sāmprataṃ duḥkhasyātibhūmigamanād jīvitodvahane prāṇasandhāraṇe tad yasmānnissahā tasmāt puraḥ samīpe vartamānād giriprapātāt śailataṭāt/ ``prapātastu taṭo bhṛguḥ'' iti vaijayantī/ lyablope pañcamī/ prapātamāruhyetyarthaḥ/ ātmānamavadhūya dehaṃ parityajya, patanenetyarthāt/ athavā apādānamātre pañcamī, giriprapātādātmānamavadhūya nipātyetyarthaḥ/ nirvṛtā sukhitā/
saharṣamiti tasyā api pratiṣedhamanumatiṃ parikalpya santoṣasahitam/
sadayaṃ ārtiviśeṣadarśanāt kṛpāsahitaṃ vīkṣya, lavaṅgikāmityarthāt/ vatse iti vārayaināmiti vivakṣayā sambuddhiḥ/
tadvivakṣitamanyathā svābhimatānuguṇaṃ parikalpyāha - kimājñāpayatha agresarī bhaveti/ avahitāsmīti/ agresarī svayamapi maraṇāya tasyāḥ puraḥ pravṛttā bhaveti/ kimājñāpayatha kiṃśabdaḥ praśne niyuṅdhvamitītyarthaḥ/ bahuvacanaṃ guruviṣayatvāt/ avahitā ājñāpite'rthe sādarā/
tayāpi maraṇe vyavasite tāṃ nivārayantyāha - sakhi prasīda, madvacanakaraṇāya/ viramāsmādātmano vadhāt/ virama nivartasva/ ``vyāṅparibhyo ramaḥ'' (1-3-43) iti parasmaipadam/ ātmano vadhāditi pratyavāyabahulatvaṃ smārayati/ ``prāyaścittaṃ na paśyāmi yena śuddhyet saha'' iti smṛteḥ/ ātmavacanakaraṇāya tasyā jīvitaṃ niścityāha - mā caitañjanaṃ vismara/ etañjanaṃ mālatīṃ māṃ ca/
tadabhiprāyaṃ jñātvāha - sakopaṃ īrṣyāsahitaṃ, svayamātmavadhāyodyacchamānā māṃ kathaṃ nivārayati, sakhīsnehasya dvayostulyatvāt/ ``yatrobhayossamo doṣaḥ parihāro'pi vā samaḥ/
naikaḥ paryanuyoktavyastādṛgarthavicāraṇe//'' iti nyāyāditi bhāvaḥ/ ivaśabdaḥ praṇayakṛtatvāt kopasyātāttvikatvaṃ dhvanati/ apehi/ nāsmi te vaśaṃ gatā/ apehi apasara/ vaśamāyattatāṃ gatā nāhamasmi tvadvacanaṃ na karomītyarthaḥ/
hanteti viṣāde, vyavasitaṃ maraṇāya niścitaṃ varākyā śocyayā, sakhīsnehāt/ anena ``ekkaṇārāhivāseṇa sahapaṃsukkīlaṇādihī tumaṃ piasahībhaṇiā a'' iti pūrvoktaṃ sauhārdātiśayaṃ sūcayati/
atha bhaṅgyā kaviḥ prastutaṃ rasamanusandhatte - nātha makaranda namaste/ ākāśe lakṣyaṃ baddhvoktiḥ/ mādhavaṃ tvamanumriyase, ahaṃ ca mālatīm/ atastvayyajīvati na mayā jīvyata ityato mayā mriyate/ tasmāt svātantryadoṣo yathā me na svāt tathā prasādayāmītyarthaḥ/
bhagavati! ayameva madhumatīsrotassampātapavitramekhalo mahīdharaviṭaṅkaḥ/ ayamityāsa (kti ṛtti)māha/ madhumatīti pūrvaprastutā mahānadī, tasyāḥ pravāhapravartanena pavitrā mekhalā taṭo yasya, mahīdharaviṭaṅkaḥ parvatasya viṣamonnatapradeśaḥ, viṣamaṣṭaṅko viṭaṅkaḥ, ``himādriṭaṅkādiva bhānti yasyāṃṣṭagaṅgāmbupātapratimā gṛhebhyaḥ/'' iti bhartṛkāvyaprayogāt/
idānīṃ niṣpratīkāratvādāśvāsanasya, śakyatayā prastutasya lavaṅgikāmadayantikābhyāmupakrāntasyātmatyāgasyetyarthaḥ/ antarāyeṇa vighnena na nivārayāma iti bhāvaḥ/ sarvā api kāmandakyā api samānaduḥkhatayā maraṇādhyavasāya ucyate/ icchanti jhaṭiti parikarabandhaṃ kṛtvā giriśikharamārohantītyarthaḥ/
vidyāprabhāvānnītasya mādhavasya punarmālatyā sahānayanāya yoginyā vidyāprayogaḥ kṛta iti naipathyapātreṇa sūcayati - āścaryamāścaryam/
vyatikara ( ṛ X 53) ivetyādi (pṛṣṭha. 538)/
tacchrutvā tatomukhaṃ kimidamityavalokyāha - sādbhutaharṣaṃ adṛṣṭapūrvavidyāprabhāvadarśanādacintitamālatīmādhavasamāgamadarśanācca vismayānandayuktam/ iha asmin pradeśe mama vatsau mamāpatye mālatīmādhavau, dṛśyete iti śeṣaḥ/ kathamityāścarye/ tat tasmād etad vartamānaṃ vastu kimiti cintā/
taccintāṃ bhaṅgyā nirākaroti/ praviśya makarandaḥ - kimanyadityādi/ anena naipathyoktirapi makarandoktirityarthāt sūcyate/ ``tadatra kāntāragahane sahāsmadvargeṇa praviṣṭāṃ bhagavatīmanusṛtya vṛttāntamenaṃ kathayāmī''tyuktaṃ ca saṅghaṭṭayati/ vakturekatvāt prayogasya cābhedāt pūrvokta eva śloko gṛhītaḥ//7//
atha niratiśayaṃ sukhamupapādayiṣyaṃstadrasāpādanāya duḥkhasya parāṃ kāṣṭhāṃ darśayitumanarthāntaramavatārayati kaviḥ, prakaraṇanāyakasya sāpāyasukhasiddhitvāt - naipathye iti/
janavādaḥ kiṃvadantī/
janavādasvarūpameva darśayati - mālatyapāyamityādi/ mālatyā apāyamapamagamaṃ nāśamityarthaḥ, adhigamya jñātvā viraktacetāḥ niḥsnehahṛdayaḥ anityatvaduḥkhodarkatvādyanusandhānena nirviṇṇa iti yāvat/ sāṃsārikeṣu saṃsārasambandhiṣvityaihikatvamatrārthāt pratipādyate, anyathā jīvitaviraktyanupapatteḥ/ mumukṣutve jñānārthameva pravartitavyam/ agnipraveśasya tu kvacinmokṣasādhanatvāśravaṇāt, vidhikṛtasya tasya svargasādhanatvaśravaṇācca/ tatra tu pramāṇamupari vakṣyamāṇam/ viṣayeṣu śabdādyupabhogeṣu, jīvite ca bandhuvināśaduḥkhānubhavād bhārabhūte śarīradhāraṇe, vipadgehatvāddehasya/ atha jīvitāpāye viṣayāpāyastāvat bhavatu nāma, jīvitaṃ punaḥ kathaṃ balāt parityajyate ātmahatyāyāḥ paralokaviruddhatvādityāha - niścitya paralokāviruddhatvaṃ dharmaśāstrairnirṇīya, śiśo rogādipīḍāyāṃ paradevatāsannidhāvupoṣitasya japahomadānādibhiḥ saṃskṛtātmano bhṛguvahnitīrthapatanādibhiḥ śarīraparityāge svargaprāptismaraṇāt, ``tasmācchāstraṃ pramāṇaṃ te kāryākāryavyavasthitau/'' iti bhagavadvacanāccodanālakṣaṇatvācca dharmasyetyarthaḥ/ vahnipatanāya mantrapūte pavitrahavirbhūte'gnau patituṃ, ``tumarthācca bhāvavacanāt'' (2-3-15) iti caturthī/ suvarṇabindusaṃjñaṃ ``madhumatīsindhusambhedapāvana'' ityapauruṣeyapratiṣṭhite liṅge satatasannihitatvenoktaṃ prāk parameśvaraṃ, abhyetītyanena sthānaviśeṣācca puruṣārthasādhanatvamāha/ umāmaheśvarasaṃvāde maheśvaravacanamasminnarthe pramāṇam/ yathā - ``agnipraveśanaṃ cecchet tenaiva vidhinā śubhe/
kṛtvā kāṣṭhamayaṃ cityaṃ puṇyakṣetranadīṣu vā//
devatābhyo namaskṛtya kṛtvā cāgniṃ pradakṣiṇam/
bhūtvā śucirvyavasitaḥ praviśedagnisaṃstaram//
so'pi lokān yathānyāyaṃ prāpnuyāt puṇyakarmaṇām//'' iti/ kalyaśarīrasyāpi snehādibhiryatnajasya maraṇasya nirdoṣatvaṃ agnipraveśādibhistatraivoktam/ iti janavādo vartata iti yojyam/ ato'dhunā hatāḥ smaḥ naṣṭāḥ smo vayam/ īdṛśasya puruṣaratnasya vināśe varṇāśramarakṣakābhāvāt sacivāyattasiddhitvācca padmāvatīśvarasyeti bhāvaḥ/ munijanavacanamiti grāhyaṃ, ``karuṇavanecaravacanādanantaraṃ tāṃ na paśyāmi'' iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt/ atrāmātyagato nirvedo vyajyate/ vanecaragataśca tadviṣayo bhāvaḥ/ karuṇarasastu vyāpakaḥ/ aprastutapraśaṃsālaṅkāraḥ, duhitṛsnehasya kāryamukhena prakāśanāt//8//
jhaṭiti mālatīmādhavayordarśanābhyudayaḥ, jhaṭityatyāhitam/ jhaṭitibhyāṃ tulyakālatvaṃ sūcyate/ atyāhitamamātyamaraṇārambharūpā mahatī vipattiḥ/
diṣṭyā daivavaśādāścaryaṃ dṛṣṭamatyantāsambhāvitasya mālatīdarśanasya prāpteḥ/
atha dṛṣṭamāścaryaṃ śrutenārthena bahulatvādutprekṣate - kimayamityādi/ ayamartha ityadhyāhāryaṃ, athavāvapātavarṣayoḥ kaṭākṣyamāṇatvāt/ ayamiti pulliṅganirdeśaḥ/ anyathedamiti sāmānyenoddeśyatvāt/ asipatrāḥ khaḍgākāradalā narakaviśeṣavṛkṣāḥ, ``asipatravanaṃ cograṃ kālasūtramapivat ( ṛ)'' iti vacanāt/ teṣāṃ candanarasasya ca chaṭā samūhastayorāsāro vegavān varṣaḥ, tasya yugapadavapātaḥ ekodvegena saha nipātanam/ atrāpyanabhra iti sambadhyate, analasphuliṅgakalilaḥ agnikaṇaissaṅkīrṇaḥ anabhraḥ megharahitaḥ, meghasyaiva vṛṣṭikartṛtvāt, sudhāvarṣaḥ amṛtasekaḥ/ atra hṛdayavidāraṇaśiśirīkaraṇaye[yo]ḥ dehadāhāhlādanayośca yaugapadyaṃ vākyadvayena pratipādyate/ utprekṣā virodho vibhāvanā cālaṅkāraḥ//9//
atha pūrvānusaṃhitaviruddhakāryayaugapadyakaraṇanipuṇaṃ daivaṃ sacamatkāramanusandhatte - sañjīvanauṣadhītyādi/ sañjīvanaṃ prāṇanaṃ tadarthā āṣadhī mṛtasañjīvanyādiḥ, viṣaṃ kālakūṭādi tayoḥ, ālokatimirayoḥ prakāśatamasoḥ, aśaniśaśadharamayūkhayoḥ vajracandrakiraṇayoḥ, vyatikarasambhedasaṃvalanaśabdā miśraṇaparyāyāḥ/ vidhiḥ daivamanukurute anugacchati/ āśvāsanasantāpayoḥ prakāśāprakāśayoḥ vidāraṇāpyāyanayośca tatkāryāṇāṃ sukhaduḥkhānubhavayaugapadyasampādanena karaṇāt śaśadharamayūkhāśanīti prakramānuguṇyena vaktavye vyatyāsena kathanamaniyamena sukhaduḥkhayoḥ duḥkhasukhayoścānubhūtiṃ vyañjayati/ atropamālaṅkāraḥ, anukaraṇasādṛśyaparyāyatvāt//10//
atha ``kathamiha mama vatsā''viti naipathyavartitvena dṛśyamānayoḥ mālatīmādhavayoḥ sūcanāṃ ``mālatyapāyamadhigamye''ti prakāśitabhūrivasumaraṇasya vyavasāyaśravaṇakātarayormālatyā vacanaṃ naipathyagatatvena nibadhnāti - naipathye hā tātetyādi/ hā tāta virama virama/ asmādvyavasāyāditi anuktistvarādyotikā, praviśa piṇḍīmityatra gṛhaṃ bhakṣayetivat/ utsukāsmi te vadanakamaladarśanena tava mukhapadmasya darśanaṃ pratyutkaṇṭhitāsmi/ ``prasitotsukābhyāṃ tṛtīyā ca'' (2.3.44) iti tṛtīyā/ prasīda sambhāvaya māṃ anugrahaṃ kuru māmupalālaya āliṅganāṅkopaveśanamūrdhnyāghrāṇādibhiriti bhāvaḥ/ kathaṃ ca mama kāraṇāt samastalokālokāntarālaviṣkambhanirmalaikamaṅgalapradīpabhūtamātmānaṃ parityajasi/ cakāro vākyārthasamuccaye, tvarthe vā/ mametyarthāntarasaṅkramitavācyena dhvaninā svasyāḥ kṣudratvaṃ prakāśyate/ kāraṇāditi hetvarthatayā ṣaṣṭhīyoge pañcamī/ samastasya niravaśeṣasya cakravālagirimadhyapradeśavistārabhūmaṇḍalasyaivetyarthaḥ/ ``ravicandramasoryāvanmayūkhairavabhāsyate/
sasamudrasaricchailā tāvatī pṛthivī smṛtā//'' iti bhāgavatokteḥ, ``abhāskaramamaryādaṃ na jānīma tataḥ param/'' iti śrīrāmāyaṇavacanāt/ ``lokālokaścakravālaḥ'' ityamaraḥ/ ``viṣkambho vistārapratibandhayo''riti vaijayantī/ nirmalaṃ kajjalarahitaṃ, ekaṃ advitīyaṃ iti viśeṣaṇadvayaṃ dvīpāntarebhyo vyatirekārthaṃ la maṅgalaṃ abhyudayārthaṃ pradīpaṃ bhūta[taṃ] jātaṃ samastārthaprakāśakatvād, ātmānaṃ svaśarīraṃ kathaṃ parityajasi kena prakāreṇa muñcasi/ matimatāmapyaho vyāmohaḥ, yat kācasya hetoḥ kaustubhaṃ vikrīṇīta iti bhāvaḥ/ mayā punaralajjayā niranukrośā yūyamiti sambhāvitamāsīt/ punaḥśabdo vyāvṛttau/ alajjayeti madvirahe yūyaṃ prāṇatyāgāyodyatāḥ, ahaṃ tu yuṣmadviyukto'dyāpi prāṇimītyaho me nirlajjateti bhāvaḥ/ yūyamiti yādṛśasnehamohitāste yūyaṃ niranukrośāḥ kāruṇyarahitāḥ iti sambhāvitaṃ sambhāvitacittamāsīt, ``uvahārīkadahni rāiṇo tādeṇa/ rāārāhaṇaṃ kkhu tādassa garuaṃ ṇa uṇa mālaī'' ityādivacanairupālabdhavatvāt/
atha karuṇataramālatīvacanaśravaṇakātarā kāmandakī tāṃ śocati - janmāntarādivetyādi/ janmāntarāt bhūrivasujaṭharasambhūtivyatiriktād bhavaviśeṣād etāvantaṃ kālamatyantādarśanādadya darśanācca/ iveti na vastutaḥ pūrvajanma eva vartamānatvādutprekṣā dyotyate/ kathamapi kṛcchreṇa pauruṣasya gocaratayā daivānugrahamātreṇetyarthaḥ/ punarlabdhāsi bhūyaḥ prāptāsi asmābhiriti śeṣaḥ/ yāvacchabdo vākyālaṅkāre avadhāraṇe vā, athavā avadhau la yatkālāvadhau labdhāsi tāvadityāyāti/ tāvatkālāvadhāviti tulyakālatvaṃ dyotayati/ ayaṃ vartamānaḥ aparaḥ tvadadarśanādanarthādanyaḥ, athavā yasmāt paro'dhiko anartho nāsti so'paraḥ/
``uparāgo graho rāhugraste tvindau ca pūṣṇi ca/'' ityamaraḥ/ labdhāsīti madhyamaprayogādaprayujyamānasyāpi tvamiti sthāninaḥ svarasata evāpatitatvāttasya ca vikalayitumiti sakarmakakriyāprayogasāmarthyāt svāmiti vipariṇāmena siddhiḥ/ anyathā śaśikalāmiti dvitīyāntasyaivopamānasyāsambandhāt mahākaviprayogasāmarthyasiddheṣvartheṣu codyasyāpodyatvāt``tiṣṭhet kopavaśāt prabhāvapihitā dīrghaṃ na sā kupyati/'' ityādau la athavā śokākule vaktari na nyūnapadatvaṃ doṣaḥ, pratyuta guṇa eva/ yathā harṣākule vaktari ``mā mā mānada māti māmala''mityādau/ vikalayituṃ vikalāṃ vivaśāṃ kartum/ ``tatkaroti'' iti ṇic/ upasthitaḥ prāpta anarthaḥ prayojanasya vipakṣabhūto vipatprakāraḥ/ atrotprekṣāmūlātiśayoktirūpamā cālaṅkāraḥ//11//
itare madayantikālavaṅgike/ hā priyasakhi ṅaṣṭamugdhāṃ mūcrXchitāṃ dhārayan kṣititalapatanabhayena svavakṣasā bhujābhyāṃ cāvaṣṭambhayan/
acintitopanatamanarthāntaramanusandadhānaḥ niṣpratīkāradāruṇāyaḥ[ya] daivāyāsūyannāha - bhā iti lokoktyanusāreṇākāśe janamabhimukhīkṛtyoktiḥ/ kaṣṭaṃ mahat kṛcchram/ vīpsayā muktakaṇṭhaṃ paridevitaṃ vyajyate/
eṣetyādi/ eṣeti bhāgyavaśādaparokṣitatvaṃ prakāśyate pravāsaṃ deśāntaragamanaṃ kathamapi daivavaśāt atītya nistīrya/ anyathā prakārāntareṇa pitṛnidhanaśaṅkārūpeṇa/ punaśśabdena pūrvavyasananivṛttyā kṣaṇamātraṃ kṛtakṛtyammanyatvamajarāmaratvamānitvaṃ ca svayoḥ prakāśyate/ saṃśayaṃ jīviṣyati vā na veti prāṇasandeham/ evakāro bhinnakramaḥ/ saṃśayameva na tu kathamayamasmadviraheṇa kṛśībhūtā vivarṇatāṃ gatetyādiśokāspadatvaṃ, yātā prāptā pākābhimukhasya śālyāderiva śaradādināsmin kāle phalamidaṃ sukhaduḥkharūpamayamanubhavitavyaṃ iti kālavaśena phaladānodyatasya daivasya pūrvajanmakṛtasya karmaṇaḥ/ ``pūrvajanmakṛtaṃ karma daivaṃ pauruṣamaihikam'' ityācāryavacanāt janmāntaropārjiteṣu puṇyāpuṇyarūpeṣu bahuṣu karmasu balavatoreva dehaprārambhakayoḥ phaladānasāmarthyāt tayośca bhogamantareṇa kṣayānupapatteḥ, ``vartamānamidaṃ yābhyāṃ śarīraṃ sukhaduḥkhayoḥ/
prārabdhaṃ puṇyapāpābhyāṃ bhogādeva tayoḥ kṣayaḥ//'' iti prāmāṇikavacanāt/ dvārāṇi anupraveśamārgān/ bahuvacanena dvāraikye sarvātmanā pidhātuṃ prayatnaḥ kriyeta'' api sarvato dvāratve kā pratīkārapratyāśeti dyotyate/
``athavā bhavitavyānāṃ dvārāṇi bhavanti sarvatra/'' ityuktavat/ pidhātuṃ ``vaṣṭi bhāgurirallopamavāpyorupasargayoḥ/
dhāñkṛñostaninahyośca bahulatvena śaunaki//'' iti vacanāt, aperallopaḥ/
``apidhānatirodhānapidhānācchādanāni ca/'' ityamaraḥ/ ka īṣṭe kiṃśabdaḥ kṣepe, na kaścitsamartha ityarthaḥ/ ``nāma iti prākāśye'' prasiddho'yamartha ityarthaḥ/ niravagrahasya sarvanāmno'tiprasañjakatvamāśaṅkya pariharati janturjananamaraṇayoḥ karmaparatantraḥ, suranarādiriti bhāvaḥ la parameśvarasyaiva karmapāratantryavirahāt/ ``aśuddhāḥ sarva evaite devādyāḥ karmayonayaḥ/ ``na tasya kāryaṃ karaṇaṃ ca vidyate'' ``jagatāmupakārāya na sā karmanimittajā'' ityādiśrutismṛtivacanāt/ īṣṭa iti ``īśa ajaśvarye'' ityasyātmanepadino laṭi prathamapuruṣaikavacane rūpam/ ka īṣṭa iti śaktyabhāvamevāha, śaktau satyāṃ hi pravṛttiśaṅkā, saiva nāstītyarthaḥ/ atrārthantaranyāso'laṅkāraḥ sāmānyena viśeṣasya samarthyamānatvāt daivasya durnivāratvoktyā ca tasya nidhane svasya dvayośca nāśe kuladvayasambandhānāṃ sarveṣāṃ mahāpralayakalpasya pradhvaṃsasya daivena cikīrṣitatvena kiṃ nirarthakena pauruṣeṇeti dyotyate//12//
athaśabdaḥ prastutavyāvṛttau/ āstāmatratyo vṛttānta ityarthaḥ/ setyanubhūtaṃ mahāprabhāvatvaṃ karuṇārdrāntaḥkaraṇatvamityādyaśeṣatvaṃ dhvanyate/
śrīparvatādityādi/ āvāmahaṃ mālatī ca, tayā yoginyā sahaiva iha asmin deśe anvāyātau pūjyatayā tāmanugacchantāvāgatau, sva iti śeṣaḥ/ sadyastatkṣaṇa eveti tatprabhāvānnimeṣamātreṇāgamanaṃ prakāśyate/ karuṇavanecaravacanāt karuṇā dayā sātrāstīti karuṇaḥ, arśa āditvādac/ ``karuḥ kleśa iti proktaḥ kleśaṃ na sahate yataḥ/
yasya dhīḥ karuṇā sā syāt pratyaye karuṇo bhavet//'' iti bhāvaprakāśaḥ/ karuṇānāṃ dayālūnāṃ, athavā karuṇād vanecarāṇāṃ araṇyavāsināṃ munīnāmityarthaḥ/ ``tatpuruṣe kṛti bahulam'' (6-3-14) ityaluk/ vacanāt ``mālatyapāyamadhigamya viraktacetāḥ'' ityādervākyāt/ tasya naipathyoktamunivacanatvaṃ bhaṅgyā prakāśayati/ anantaraṃ anveva na paśyāmītyantardhāya gatatvamāha/ karuṇavanecaravacanādanantaramityuktyā bhūrivasuparitrāṇatvarayā sā dhāviteti sūcayati kaviḥ//13//
ākāśe yoginīmabhimukhīkṛtyāhatuḥ - mahābhāge iti/ mahābhāge mahānniratiśayo bhāgo bhāgyaṃ yasyā, anyairaśakyabahujanaprāṇatrāṇasya niṣkāraṇaṃ kṛtatvāt/ punariti pūrvaṃ mālatīparitrāṇadvāreṇa trātatvāt idānīmapyanarthāntarasyāpatitatvādito'pi naḥ paritrātuṃ tvameva śakto nānyaḥ kaścidityarthaḥ/ paritrāyasva sarvato rakṣa/ kimiti kuto hetoḥ antarhitā vidyayā channā puṇyarāśestava darśane vayaṃ kimayogyā iti, athavā kāraṇāntareṇetyarthaḥ/
mugdhāyāḥ prabodhanāyāhatuḥ - sakhi mālati/ sakṛdukte prabodhamadṛṣṭvā punaḥ sanirbandhamāhatuḥ - nanu bhaṇāvaḥ/ nanuḥ saṃvāde/ kiṃ tvayā na śrūyate, sakhi mālatītyāvāṃ nanu vadāva ityarthaḥ/ dirukte'pi tasyāḥ prabodhamadṛṣṭvā sotkampaṃ apāyaśaṅkayā sasādhvasamāhatuḥ - bhagavati paritrāyasva/ ciraniruddhaniśvāsaniścalamasyā hṛdayam/ paritrāyasva jīvanopāyānuṣṭhānena rakṣetyarthaḥ/ ciraniruddhena bahukṣaṇastabdhena niśvāsena hetunā niścalaṃ niṣkampam/ niśvāsocchvāsapraveśanirgamasamaye hi tadanuguṇaṃ calati vakṣaḥsthalam/ hṛdayaspandanābhāve ca mṛtabhrāntijanakatvād bhayopapattirāvayoriti bhāvaḥ/ hā amātya! hā priyasakhi! dvāvapi yuvāṃ parasparasyāvasānasya kāraṇaṃ jātau/ mālatyapāyādhigamenāmātyasya maraṇādhyavasāyāt, tadadhyavasāyaśravaṇena mālatyā mohācca parasparasyānyonyasyāvasānaṃ maraṇaṃ, tasya kāraṇaṃ heturjātāvityuktiḥ/
atha nirvighnasamāgamena nāyakayorniratiśayaṃ sukhamupapādayiṣyan kavīśvarastasya svādutamatvāpādanāya duḥkhasya parāṃ koṭiṃ prakāśayati - hā! vatsa ityādinā/ mālatyāḥ sañjīvanābhāvaṃ niścitya sarveṣāṃ paridevitam/
itare madayantikālavaṅgike/ hā priyasakhi/
upagamyeti lyapā saṃjñālābhasya jhāṭityaṃ prakāśayaṃstasya yoginīprabhāvajanitatvaṃ dyotayati kaviḥ la ``sā[sa]mānakartṛkayoḥ pūrvakālaḥ[la] (3-4-21) iti ktvo vidhānāt/
tadeva kāmandakīvacanabhaṅgyā sphuṭīkaroti - kimetadāścaryametat kiṃmūlamityarthaḥ pāṭyamānāt kenacidvidāryamāṇādiveti bāhalyādutprekṣā/ pariskhalan sarvataḥ patan/
socchvāsaṃ mohastambhavirahāducchvāsaṃ muktvetyarthaḥ/ aye ityāścarye, asambhāvitatvāttasyārthasya/ pratyāpannacetanā punaḥprāptaprabodhā/ tathātvamevopapādayati - tathāhyasyāḥ/
bhavati vitatetyādi/ vitatasya ciraniruddhatayā nadīsrotasa iva sampiṇḍitasya śvāsasya prāṇavāyorunnāhenordhvaprasaraṇena praṇunnau prakarṣeṇa preritau, kampitāviti yāvat, payodharau stanau yasmin, ``adyāpi stanavepathuṃ janayati śvāsaḥ pramāṇādhikaḥ/'' itivat/ hṛdayaṃ vakṣaḥ/ atha anantaraṃ, snigdhaṃ snehaguṇaviśiṣṭaṃ bhūtvā, pūrvaṃ kiñcidraukṣyaṃ sparśāt, nijaprakṛtau svasvabhāve vipulāyataraktanīladhavalatvādiguṇayogitve sthitaṃ sthairyaṃ gatamityarthaḥ, cakṣuritīndriyatvābhiprāyeṇa jātyekavacanatvena vā vivakṣyate/ tadanu tasmādanantaraṃ vadanaṃ mukham, mūrcchācchedāt mohasya nivṛttatvāt prasādi prasādo nairmalyaṃ, tadviśiṣṭaṃ, pūrvaṃ vaivarṇyaprasaṅgāt/ ahnaḥ prārambhe divasasyādau prabhātakāle śriyā śobhayā parigataṃ sarvataḥ prāptaṃ ,sarasīruhamiva . pūrvamapi sūkṣmarūpāyāstasyā avasthānāt prātaḥ parigatamityuktiḥ/ atra svabhāvato vadanasyāpi mūrcchāsamaye'pyamuktaśobhatvaṃ prabodhasamaye punarvistīrṇaśobhatvaṃ ca prakāśyate/ hṛdayaṃ bhavati, atha cakṣuḥ sthitaṃ, tadanu vadanaṃ virājata iti mūrcchācchedakramoktiḥ/ atra svabhāvoktirupamā cālaṅkāraḥ//14//
atha - ``karuṇavanecaravacanādanantaraṃ tāṃ na paśyāmi'' iti sūcitayoginyantardhānaprayojanaṃ naipathyapātreṇa tayaiva prakāśayati - naipathye/
avigaṇayyetyādi/ avigaṇayya tṛṇāyāpi na matveti pūrvoktaviraktiparipāko vyajyate/ ``nispṛhasya tṛṇaṃ jagat'' iti nyāyāt/ nṛpamiti kopaprasādayornigrahānugrahasamarthasyollaṅghane mahadaho sāhasikyamiti dyotyate/ nṛpamityanena jagatparipālanādhikṛtasya vasundharābhārasandhāraṇakṣamatkandhamantriratnāyattasiddhitvāt tadapāye rājyanāśamāśaṅkya dainyaṃ ca vyajyate/ ata eva caraṇayornatamityuktiḥ, na tu vācā nivārayantamiti/ sahanandanamamātyanandanasahitaṃ, tasyāpi rājacittānuvartanaparatvādetadguṇagaṇavaśīkṛtatvācca nṛpasamānamiti duḥkhatvamiti bhāvaḥ/ caraṇayoḥ praṇataṃ caraṇagrahaṇāt pādau karābhyāṃ gṛhītvāṃ bhūmaṇḍale daṇḍavat patitatvaṃ prakāśyate, natimātrasya dūrato'pi śakyatvāt/ agnicaye prabhūtendhanacite'gnau patan na tu patiṣyanniti daivayogāt svasyāḥ samayopasthānaṃ vyañjayati/ sapadi padupasaraṇāt prāgeva śīghraṃ nivartitaḥ, patanādarthāt/ kathaṃ sapadi nivartita ityatrāha - mama girā na tu mayeti, anena gaganaśṛṅgasaṅginyā mama darśanāt prāgeva gambhīramadhurayā dūrato vācaiva ``jīvati mālatī, kuśalinī ca, mā kaṣṭaṃ kaṣṭaṃ sāhasa''mityevaṃrūpayetyarthaḥ/ gurusammadavismayaḥ guruḥ nirbharaḥ sammado harṣaḥ mālatīkuśalaśravaṇotsavāt vismayaḥ āścaryabuddhiḥ, acintitameva samaye samupasthānāt/ atrādbhutaraso dhvanyate/ bhāvodayo'laṅkāraḥ, sammadavismayayorbhāvayorudayapratipādanāt//15//
atha ``mahābhāge kimityantarhitāsī''ti taddarśanautsukyaduḥkhāsikākheditāṃ kāmandakīmāhlādayataḥ - sā yoginīyamityādi/ sā yā niṣkāraṇaparamopakārakaraṇaprakāśitasaujanyā iyaṃ purovartinī, atirayavighaṭitajaladā asmadanugrahatvarayā atiśayitena gaganagamanavegena vighaṭitā parasparaviśleṣitā, vegamārutodbhūtatvāt, jaladā meghā yayā, naḥ abhyupaiti asmān lakṣīkṛtyāyāti/ viprakṛṣṭāntare viyati taḍita iva jhaṭiti jaladapaṭalapāṭanena dhāvantyā spaṣṭadṛṣṭābhāvatvāt kathaṃ saiveti niścīyata ityatrāha - yasyā vāgamṛtajalāsāro vacanarasasya pīyūṣarasasya vegavān varṣaḥ/ mṛtadeśīyānāṃ sveṣāṃ sañjīvanādamṛtatvāropaḥ/ jaladajalāsāraṃ ``jhaṭiti pāṭyamānādivāmbudā''dityādinā prāṇanena pratipāditameghajalavarṣamatiśete svaguṇairadhaḥkaroti, jaladajalāsārasya pravṛttamohamātranivartakatvāt, vāgamṛtajalāsārasya tu nivṛttajātīyasyāsya punarutthānāya jāgarūkatvena, tamantareṇa pūrvasya gajasnānatulyatvāt/ atra rūpakaṃ vyatirekaścālaṅkāraḥ//16//
atha sampūrṇamanorathā āha - priyaṃ naḥ asmākamabhimataṃ, sampannamiti śeṣaḥ/ vīpsā harṣadyotikā/
diṣṭyā cirasya pratyujjīvitāsmi daivavaśāt bahoḥ kālāt pratiṣṭhāpitaprāṇāsmi, cirakālānubhūtasya duḥkhasāgarasya nistīrṇaprāyatvāt/
saharṣabāṣpaṃ pratyujjīvitāyā darśanāddharṣeṇa nivṛttaduḥkhasmaraṇādīdṛśasya mama vatsayā kathaṃ tādṛgduḥkhamanubhūtamiti bāṣpeṇa ca sahitam/ ehyehi āgacchāgacchetyāliṅganatvarayā vīpsā/
kathaṃ bhagavatī, dṛśyata iti śeṣaḥ/ kathamityāścarye, evaṃ punardarśanasya svapne'pyacintitatvād gurutvāt tatsambandhasañjīvitatvācca/
pādapatanaṃ śirīṣamṛdvyāḥ kṣititale patanamamṛṣyantī sapadyutthāpya virahataptasvaśarīranirvāpaṇāyāliṅgya duhitṛvātsalyānmūrdhni cāghrāyetyarthaḥ/
āśiṣaṃ prayuṅkte - jīvetyādi/ jīva ciramāyuravāpnuhi/ jīvitasamāya prāṇasamāya mādhavāya, jīvitaṃ dehi/ suhṛjjanaṃ makarandādikaṃ jīvaya dhṛtaprāṇaṃ kuru/ aṅgakaiḥ saukumāryātiśayādanukampanīyairaṅgaiḥ tuhinasaṅgaśītalaiḥ himajalāvagāhācchaityadāyibhiḥ/ priyasakhīḥ lavaṅgikāmadayantikāvalokitādikāḥ/ prathamaṃ jīvetyuktiḥ sakalajīvitamūlabhūtatvāt tajjīvitasya, paścājjīvitasamāhlādijīvitadānādyuktiretajjīvitāyattatvādanvayavyatirekāditi mantavyam/ atrāśīrnāmālaṅkāraḥ//17//
samprati mālatījīvitanirṇaye upādeyaḥ svīkāryaḥ, pūrvamudvegajanakatvena jihāsitatvāt, mādhavasyeti mālatīmayajīvitatvenātmaprasiddhiṃ dyotayati, jīvalokaḥ manuṣyalokaḥ/
evametadityasmin vastuni svānubhavasaṃvādaṃ darśayati/
itare madayantikālavaṅgike/ priyasakhi! manorathātiriktadarśane sambhāvayāsmān pariṣvaṅgeṇa/ manoratho nāma svābhimatasya durlabhasya vastunaḥ saṅkalpaḥ, api nāmaivaṃ bhaviṣyati bhāgyavaśādasmākamidamiti, tasya darśanaṃ tathātvena sākṣātkāraḥ, sa hi parā kāṣṭhā jagati manonirvṛteḥ/
``aṣṭāvimāni harṣasya navanītāni bhārata/'' ityupakramya ``abhipretasya lābhaṃ ca pūjā ca janasaṃsadi/'' iti mahābhāratokteḥ tato'pi atiriktamatiśayitaṃ tava darśanamidānīmityatiśayaḥ pratipādaya[dya]te/
hā priyasakhyau/ heti ``svajanasya hi duḥkhamagrato vivṛtadvāramivopajāyate/'' iti nyāyāt sakhīdarśane'tītaduḥkhasmaraṇaviṣādadyotakam/ ubhe yugapadāliṅgatītyarthaḥ/ ubhe āliṅgatīti duḥkhanirgamāt samayaḥ/ ``jīva jīvitasame''tyādinā ``hā! piasahīā'' ityantenānyonyabhāṣaṇātparibhāṣaṇam/
mālatīvyasanasya mūlamajānānā pṛcchati - vatsau he putrau, kimetat ṛ mālatīvyasanarūpametadvastu kiṃ kimmūlamityarthaḥ/
tasyottaramāhatuḥ - kapālakuṇḍaletyādi/ kapālakuṇḍalāyāḥ koparūpeṇa duṣkṛtena sampāditavyasanāḥ, mālatīvyasanasya sarvabandhusādhāraṇatvāt vayamiti sarveṣāṃ sveṣāṃ saṅgrahaḥ abhyuddhṛtāḥ abhimukhībhūyottaritāḥ, kṛcchrādasmādvyasanāt, paṅkātaṅkādiva mataṅgajāḥ, nirbandhāt nirbandhaṃ abhyuddharaṇe mahāntaṃ saṃrambhaṃ kṛtvā/ lyablope pañcamī/ āryayā niratiśayasaujanyayā/ ``na cāvadadbharturavarṇamāryā'', ``kulodgataṃ satyamāryami''tyādivat/ anayā puro dṛśyamānayā yogeśvaryā/ atrātiśayoktyalaṅkāraḥ, parirakṣaṇasyābhyuddharaṇatvenādhyavasitatvāt//18//
``kapālakuṇḍalākope''tyuktasya tatkopasya kāraṇamanumānena sampādayati aghoraghaṇṭavadhasya mādhavakartṛkasya vijṛmbhitaṃ phalaparipākaḥ/ kathamityāścarye/ ``agneḥ śeṣamṛṇāccheṣaṃ śatroḥ śeṣaṃ na śeṣayet/'' iti vacanādanādaropekṣitasya śatruśeṣasyāho pariṇāmadāruṇatvamiti bhāvaḥ/
aho āścaryam! punaruktadāruṇasya pariṇāmaramaṇīyatvaṃ vidheḥ/ punaruktadāruṇasya uparyupari krūrasya, vipatparamparāsampādanāt, pariṇāmaramaṇīyatvamudarke śobhanatvaṃ, nirvighnasukhaparyantatvāt, vidherdaivasya/
niśśeṣaduḥkhanirasanena kṛtakṛtyāṃ yoginīṃ samaye praveśayati - praviśya saudāminīti/ sa iti ciramaskhalitopacārabhaktinighnatayā yaḥ prasādātiśayabhūmiḥ sa ityarthaḥ, eṣa idānīṃ puro vartamānaḥ, vaḥ iti guruṣu bahuvacanaṃ, cirantanaḥ purāṇa ityanenādhunikīnāṃ vyāvṛttiḥ, ``sāyaṃciraṃprāhṇeprage'vyayebhyaṣṭyuṭyulo tuṭ ca'' (4-3-23) iti ṭyutuṭau, antevāsī śiṣyaḥ, ``śayavāsavāsiṣvakālāt'' (6-3-18) ityaluk, janaḥ prāṇimātramityanuddhatisūcakaṃ vacanam/
aye iti acintitadarśanāt prārthitadarśanācca harṣaḥ prakāśyate/ bhadrā kalyāṇī, guruprasādasampannatvāt/
yoginīkartṛkasya svaviṣayaparamopakārasaṃrambhasya kāraṇaṃ prāg bahudhā vicintyāpyapaśyantau samprati tannāmaśravaṇādvītasandehāvāhatuḥ - kathamiti saharṣādbhutamuktiḥ/ seti kathāprasaṅgeṣu sasnehabahumānaṃ bhagavatyā kṣaṇe kṣaṇe purā kathitatvāt svabuddhyārūḍhatvaṃ dhvanati/ kathanasiddhamarthaṃ bhaṅgyā sūcayati - pakṣapātasthānaṃ snehātiśayaviṣayaḥ/ ādyaśiṣyā prathamaśiṣyā pradhānabhūtā vā, saudāminīti saṃjñā tāvatpuraiva mantravadāvartitā, idānīṃ tasyāḥ saṃjñinaḥ sambandho diṣṭyā gṛhīta iti bhāvaḥ/ yataḥ yasmādiyaṃ saudāminī tata ityāyāti, adhunā sāmprataṃ sarvaṃ mālatīparitrāṇaṃ mādhavāśvāsanaṃ bhūrivasusañjīvanamityādikaṃ sarvaṃ vastu, saṅgacchate saṅgataṃ upapannaṃ, kāraṇasya bhagavatīsambandhasya mahato vidyamānatvāditi bhāvaḥ/ saṅgacchata iti ``samo gamyṛcchipracchisvaratyartiśruvidibhya'' (1-3-29) iti saṃpūrvādakarmakād gamerātmanepadam/
pūrvaṃ śuśrūṣātiśayāt vidyāgrahaṇasāmarthyācca pakṣapātamātraviśiṣṭedānīṃ paramopakārakaraṇādacintyamantrasiddhiprabhāvasamagratayā ca bahuguṇasnehabahumānaśālinyāha - ehyehītyādi/ āgacchāgaccheti praṇāmasya kṣaṇamāliṅganavighātatvāttadakṣamayoktiḥ/ pādaparamāṇau mayi ko'yamatyādara ityatrāha bhūrijanajīvitadānapuṇyasambhāradhāriṇīti bhūrīṇāṃ bahūnāṃ janānāṃ jīvitadānena prāṇapradānena yat puṇyaṃ tasya sambhāraṃ sañcayaṃ dhārayituṃ śīlaṃ yasyāḥ/ ``ekataḥ kratavassarve samāptavaradakṣiṇāḥ/
ekato bhayabhītasya prāṇinaḥ prāṇarakṣaṇam//'' iti mahābhāratokterekasya prāṇinaḥ prāṇapradāne mahat puṇyaṃ, bahūnāṃ punaḥ kimucyatāmiti sambhāraśabdena prakāśyate/ hanteti harṣe/ cirād bahoḥ kālād dṛṣṭāsi/ dattapramodaṃ darśanādeva janitaharṣaṃ iṣṭatamasya vastuno darśanamātrādeva śarīrasyāpyāyamānatvāt/ apīti tāvanmātreṇa tṛptyabhāvaṃ sūcayati/ āliṅgya nandaya bahupulakotkampādibhiḥ kṛtārthaya/ me śarīramiti pūrvānubhūtasya tvatsparśasukhasya ciravicchedena nikāmamuṣitamiti dyotayati/ sauhṛdanidhe bandhujanavātsalyasya jalasya jalanidhivannidhe sākalyaniveśasthānabhūte/ praṇāmād āliṅganasallāpādisukhavyavadhāyakād virama nivartasva/ atra sambhāradhāriṇītyatiśayoktiḥ/ ``viśeṣo'sti na satāṃ putraśiṣyayoḥ'' iti vacanāt sacchiṣyāviṣayo bhāvaścātra prakāśyate//19//
atha ``bhūrijanajīvitadānapuṇyasambhāradhāriṇī''ti, ``sauhṛdanidhe'' iti ca sūcitamarthaṃ spaṣṭīkaroti - api ca vandyā tvamevetyādi/ vandyā abhivādyā stutyā ca/ evakāreṇa na mādṛśyaḥ īdṛśyāṃ vipadi niṣpratīkārāḥ, pratyuta tvameveti dyotayati/ jagataḥ na katipayānāṃ, api tu sarvasyāpi lokasyetyarthaḥ/ kṛtyānāṃ kartari vā'' (2-3-71) iti ṣaṣṭhī/ tatra hetuḥ - spṛhaṇīyasiddhiḥ sarvairanyaistapasvibhirasmākamīdṛśī siddhiḥ kathamāpādanīyetyabhilakṣaṇīyā mantrasādhanādijanitā phalaprāptiryasyāḥ/ siddhirbhavatu nāma tathāpi niṣkṛpāḥ kecana tatphalakṣayabhayena prāṇināṃ vyasaneṣu tānna viniyuñjate, tathā kāṭhinyamapi tava nāstītyāha - evaṃvidhaiḥ evamityanubhavābhinayaḥ, anubhūtasyāsmadanugrahasyaivaṃvidhaḥ prakāro yeṣāmityanena sadavidhurajanatrāṇatācchīlyamanumāyoktiḥ/ vilasitaiḥ krīḍitairityayatnasādhyatvamupakārasyābhimānābhāvaśca dyotyate/ parābhyavapattau na copamānaṃ tavetyāha - atibodhisattvaiḥ bodhisattvaṃ jinamunimatikrāntaiḥ/ ``atyādayaḥ krāntādyarthe dvitīyayā'' (vā. 1-4-79) iti samāsaḥ/ tasya paramakāruṇikatvena prasiddhāvapi śaṅkhacūḍādīnāṃ rakṣaṇe svātmatyāgarūpasya mahataḥ pātakasyānuṣṭhīyamānatvāt sukṛtaduṣkṛtayostulyaphalatvaṃ tadātvaduḥkhānubhūtiśca vidyate/ tava tu dīnarakṣaṇaphalamavaśiṣyate, na cātmā kadarthyata ityaho taccaritebhyastvaccaritāni dūrāddavīyāṃsi dyotanta iti bhāvaḥ/
``buddhastu śrīghanaśśāstā bodhisattvo vināyakaḥ/'' iti vaijayantī/ purā paricayapratibandhabījaṃ atīte kāle yaḥ paricayaḥ saṃstavaḥ tasya pratibandhaḥ dṛḍhībhāvaḥ tadrūpaṃ bījaṃ śālyādibījavat/ udbhūtabhūriphalaśāli paktrimaiḥ pracuraiḥ phalaiḥ prāṇatrāṇādibhiḥ viśiṣṭaṃ vijṛmbhate loke khyāyate, athavā vardhate, uparyupari maṅgalaprasādhakatvāt/ naḥ asmākam/ ``ehyehī''tyādinā ``vandyā tvameva''tyādinā ca ślokābhyāmiṣṭaprāptijanitasambhramarūpa āvego dhvanyate/ kramollaṅghanasyāpi cikīrṣitatvādubhayatra kāvyaliṅgamalaṅkāraḥ/ ``purā paricayapratibandhabījamudbhūtabhūriphalaśāli vijṛmbhate'' ityanena ``stokoddiṣṭastu taddhetubījaṃ vistāryanekadhā/'' iti lakṣitaṃ prakaraṇaṃ, bījamapi kavinā vaidagdhyād bhaṅgyā prakāśitamiti veditavyam la ``api nāma kalyāṇino''rityādinopakṣiptasya bījasya ``asmatsaudāminīsamakṣaṃ pravṛtteyaṃ pratijñe''tyādinā parikareṇa bahulīkṛtatvāt la saudāminīmukhena pratijñāyāḥ prakāśayiṣyamāṇatvācca//20//
iyaṃ sā āryā saudāminī ṛ kākvā praśna ākṣipyate/
tasyottaramāha - bāḍhaṃ dṛḍhaṃ, na sandeha ityarthaḥ/ anayā khalu bhagavatīsambandhapakṣapātena nirbhartsya kapālakuṇḍalāṃ ātmanaḥ āvasathamupanīya bhagavatīnirviśeṣaṃ samāśvāsitāsmi/ khaluḥ avadhāraṇe/ bhagavatīsambandhaḥ kāmandakyāḥ suhṛtputrī niratiśayapremabhūmiḥ iti yaḥ, taṃ śrutvā yaḥ pakṣapātaḥ, sā hi sarvathāsmākamupalālanīyeti svatvabuddhiḥ, tena hetunā/ nirbhartsya dhiṅ mūrkhe/ asmadapatyeṣu gandhamapyāghrātuṃ tava kā śaktirityādibhiḥ santarjyetyanena tasyāḥ svaviśasanārambho dyotyate/ [ātmana āvasathamupanīya] svasyā gṛhaṃ prāpayya/ bhagavatīnirviśeṣaṃ kāmandakīto yathā na kaścidbheda upalabhyate tatheti kriyāviśeṣaṇam/ āliṅganāṅkāropaṇamūrdhāghrāṇādibhiḥ ``vatse! mā bhaiṣīḥ/ ahaṃ bhagavatyantevāsinī saudāminī/ tanmayi jīvantyāṃ kastavāparādhe prabhavet/ pitrādibhiśca tvāmadyaiva saṃyojayiṣyāmī''ti sāntvitāsmītyarthaḥ/ na kevalaṃ vāṅmātreṇa pravṛttyā cānugṛhītavatītyāha - kesarāvalīsābhijñānahastayā ihāgatya sarve yūyaṃ sandhāritāḥ/ kesarāvalyā bakulamālayā sābhijñānacihnasahito hasto yasyāḥ, viśvāsyavacanatvāyeti bhāvaḥ/ ihāgatyeti śrīparvatādasya deśasya davīyastvamabhinīyāha/ sarvaśabdena mādhavādīnāṃ sākalyena grahaṇam/ sandhāritāḥ samyagavasthāpitāḥ prāṇitā ityupakārasya parā koṭirdyotyate/ ``dhṛṅ avasthāne'' iti dhātuḥ/
suprasannā naḥ kaniṣṭhā bhagavatī/ kāmandakyā vṛddhatvādasyā yuvatvācca kaniṣṭhātvavyapadeśaḥ, śiṣyatvāt kiñcinnyūnatvena vā/
``kaniṣṭhakanīyāṃsau nyūne'tyalpe'nuje'pi ca/'' iti vaijayantī/ asmākaṃ suṣṭhu prasādasumukhī, diṣṭyā jāteti śeṣaḥ/
athedṛśasya paritrāṇasaṃrambhasyānupapatteriti ``pratyakṣe guravasstutyā'' iti nyāyāt tadīyamupakāraṃ camatkṛtyāhatuḥ - aho nu khalu bhoḥ iti savismayaṃ tatrasthān sarvānabhimukhīkurutaḥ/
api cintāmaṇirityādi/ cintāgocaravastudānāccintāmaṇiriti prasiddho ratnaviśeṣaḥ/ apiśabdenaitadāha - kalpatarustāvanmanasā saṅkalpaṃ, saṅkalpitasya manasā bhūyo bhūyo yācanaṃ cāpekṣate la ``kṣuṇṇaṃ yadantaḥkaraṇena vṛkṣāḥ phalanti kalpopapadāstadeva/'' ityādimahākavivacanāt/ kāmadhenustu manasā saṅkalpaṃ, vācā yācanaṃ, śarīreṇa paricaryāñca, dilīpādiṣu tathā darśanāt/ kālameghaḥ punaryācito'pi kadāciddadāti, kadācinna dadāti, kadācidyācitāramupekṣyānyato dadātītyataḥ sarvebhyaḥ etebhyaḥ prekṣāvadbhiḥ cintāmātrasāpekṣasya cintāmaṇerdātṛtve parāṃ koṭimāropitatvāt/ tasyāpi nirūpyamāṇe sāpavādamaudāryamiti sāpavādatvamevāha - cintāpariśramaṃ cintā manovyāpāraviśeṣaḥ/ kimasmādahaṃ prārthaye iti prathamaṃ nirūpya paścānmamedamapekṣitaṃ vastviti kasmiṃścidarthe svaprārthanāmavasthāpya tato mahyamidamāyuṣmatā dīyatāmiti manovṛttirūpayā yācituryācñāpariśramaḥ khedastamapekṣate/ tadanantarameva phalati/ yadā cintāmaṇeriyaṃ śailī tadā kā vārtā kalpavṛkṣādīnām/ ataḥ idaṃ anubhūtaṃ, turviśeṣe, anyena svavyatiriktena kenacit akṛtamananuṣṭhitaṃ, pūrvaṃ duṣkaratvāt/ duṣkaratve'pi kṣudraṃ bhavatvityāśaṅkya tathā netyāha - āścaryaṃ mahāphalatvādacintitatvācca vismayajananam/ āryayā pūjyayā, anayā yogeśvaryeti śeṣaḥ/ kṛtamanuṣṭhitaṃ, idaṃ, vastviti śeṣaḥ/ vyatireko'trālaṅkāraḥ, ``aho nu khalu bhoḥ'', ``api cintāmaṇi''rityādinādbhutaprāpterūpagūhanam//21//
atha ``stūyamānassa jihrāya stutyameva samācaranni''ti nyāyāt mahātmatayā parotkarṣabhāvanāniratiśayayā ca pratyakṣastutyā lajjitāha - hanteti viṣāde/ lajjayati trapāparavaśāṃ karoti/ atyantasaujanyaṃ atiśayitaṃ sujanatvaṃ, kṛtajñatā hi sujanānāṃ jīvitamiti bhāvaḥ/ pūrvaṃ ``phurantamaccharaveêlakkhamasīmalaṇimuhe bhūrivasuṇandaṇe kiṃ dāṇiṃ tuhmāṇaṃ jāmāduehiṃ aparitoso tti paḍibohia gāa abbhantaraṃ rāā'' iti rājaprasādasyaiva pratipāditatvādrājapratibodhitayorapi paribhūtayoḥ prabhūtayoramātyayoḥ prasādānabhivyaktestau kinnu kariṣyata ityāśaṅkā/ tamantaḥprarūḍhaṃ patrikāmukhenedānīṃ pariharati kaviḥ, tatparihārasyaivāvaśiṣṭatvāt - bhagavatītyādi/ prahṛṣṭanandanābhinanditena pratyakṣaṃ bhūrivasoriti cānena bhūrivasujīvanānantaraṃ prasādasumukhena rājñā``yuṣmate mādhavāya yogeśvarīhaste'smatsaṃprītisūcakaṃ patraṃ preṣayitumicchāmī''tyamātyayoranuyuktatvaṃ tābhyāṃ ca sādhu nirūpitaṃ devenetyanumoditatvaṃ ca prakāśyate/ abhilikhya natvabhilekhyeti svahastanyastākṣaratayā paramapramāṇatvaṃ vyajyate/ patraṃ tālīdalaṃ āyuṣmata iti putraviṣayatvād vyavahāraḥ/ preṣitaṃ prahitaṃ, mama hasta ityarthāt/ lekhaṃ likhitapatram/
ślāghyānāmityādi/ ślāghyānāṃ sahṛdayacamatkāragocarāṇām/ tatra hetuḥ - guṇināṃ śrutaśīlādibhiḥ guṇairnityayuktānāmiti/ dhuri kāryabhāre viṣaye sthitavati pratiṣṭhite, ``avighnamastu te stheyāḥ piteva dhuri putriṇām/'' iti raghuvaṃśoktavat, anabhijātavartināṃ guṇānāmaraṇyacandrikāvadanuśocyatvādabhijātagatānāṃ punarabhinavajāmbūnadakanakaghaṭitānāṃ anargharatnānāmiva niratiśayaśobhājanakatvaṃ, tacca tavaivāstītyāha - śreṣṭhānvavāye praśasyavaṃśe/ ``praśasyasya śraḥ'' (5-3-60) iti iṣṭhan/ mahīyasi vittamitrakṣetrādisampatsāmagryeṇa mahadantarebhyo'tirikte, jāmātarītyanuvādena ``prabhavati nijasya kanyakājanasya mahārājaḥ'' ityamātyavacanādanumānena svaputrītvenābhimatāyā mālatyā anurūpeṇa vareṇa tvayā vayaṃ vardhāmaha iti mādayati/ tvayi pratyastavyasane nivṛttaṃ bhāgyavaśānmālatyadarśanarūpaṃ vyasanamāpad yasya tathābhūte sati, paramatyantaṃ prīto'smi/ idānīṃ rājyasyaiva susthitatvāditi bhāvaḥ/ tena prītatvena hetunā, iyamiti buddhisannihitatvāduktiḥ, madayantikāpītyapiśabdena yathā mālatī sarvathāsmākamupalālanīyā tathā madayantikāpi nāṇumātramapi nyūneti sveṣāṃ snehabhūmitvaṃ samagraguṇatvaṃ sukhasambandhitvaṃ ca dyotyate/ tādṛśī kathaṃ dīyata ityatrāha - bhavataḥ prītyai pūjyasya tava jīvitasarvasvenāpi samārādhyatvamiti bhāvaḥ/ tava preyase prāṇebhyo'pi garīyase premāspadāya mitrāya, ``samānaśīlavyasaneṣu sakhyam'', ``sadbhirvivādaṃ maitrīṃ ca nāsadbhiḥ kiñcidācaret'' ityādivacanāt mahātmanastava tulyābhijanādiguṇa eva maitrī pravartate nānyatreti vacanameva nastadābhijātyādiṣu pramāṇamiti prakāśyate// prathamānurāgaghaṭitā prathamena lokottaratvādagragaṇyena bhavena vā anurāgeṇa premṇā ghaṭitā saṃśleṣitā, tathāvidhasyānurāgasyaiva bandhujananairapekṣyeṇa samagrabharasahiṣṇutvamiti bhāvaḥ/ apiśabdena evametattathāpi dharmācāryaduśceṣṭitaiḥ pitrādīnāmasmākamapi kanyādāne kiyānapyadhikāro'styeveti sotprāśaṃ vacanaṃ sūcyate/ apirbhinnakramaḥ, asmābhirnandanādibhirapītyarthaḥ/ utsṛjyate dīyate/ parikaro'trālaṅkāraḥ, viśeṣaṇānāṃ sābhiprāyatvena niveśanāt/ ``etatprahṛṣṭanandanābhinanditene''tyādinā ``ślāghyānāṃ guṇināmi''tyantena padmāvatīśvareṇa mādhavasya paryupāsanāt prasādaḥ//22//
uddiśya abhimukhīkṛtya/ kiṃ śrutaṃ lekhārthagauravamavadhānena gṛhītaṃ kimityarthaḥ/
saharṣaṃ ānandabāṣpādiharṣalakṣaṇaviśiṣṭam/ śrutaṃ avadhāya gṛhītamityarthaḥ/ lekhārthasyāvadhānena gṛhītasya phalitāṃśamāha - idānīmetallekhārthānusandhāne kṛte sarvataḥ sarvaprakāreṇa, priyatamāprāptyā suhṛtkāryasampatyā śaṅkitānarthaśamanena cetyarthaḥ/ kṛtārthaḥ kṛtaṃ paryāptaṃ prayojanaṃ yasya, kṛbhvastīnāṃ kriyāsāmānyavācitvāt/ ``kiṃ śrutaṃ'', ``śrutamidānī''mityādinā vāñcchitāvāpterānandaḥ/
pūrvamāśaṅkitatvena vyākhyātamamātyakopanigadena prakāśayati kaviḥ - diṣṭyā etadapi gataṃ hṛdayasya naḥ āśaṅkāśalyam/ etadapīti sadānusandhīyamānatvāduktiḥ/ apiśabdo rājakopāśaṅkāyāḥ pūrvameva nivṛttatvaṃ vyañjayati/ gataṃ naṣṭaṃ no hṛdayasyeti mādhavādīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ sadāntarvartitvamāha/ āśaṅkāśalyaṃ cintārūpaśalyaṃ śaraphalaṃ aruntudatvāt jhaṭityapanetumanīṣatkaratvācca/
sāmprataṃ niravaśeyaṃ mādhavasya pūritā manorathāḥ/ sāmpratamidānīṃ lekhāgamanādanantaramityarthaḥ/ niravaśeṣaṃ avaśeṣaḥ pūraṇīyatvenāsamāptaoṃ'śassa nirasto yathā tatheti kriyāviśeṣaṇam/ pūritāḥ svārthe ṇic, pūrṇāḥ/ athavā daivenetyāyāti/ manorathāḥ prāpyatvena saṅkalpitā arthāḥ/
atha rasasaṃvidhānaratnanidhānabhūto mahākaviḥ pātratvena supraviṣṭānāmaṅgānāmapyananusandhānaṃ rasavighātāya, kiṃ punaraṅgina ityupadiśan bhaṅgyāṅgānāṃ kṣaṇāntaritānāmanusandhānaṃ karoti - purataḥ sthitān samuditān nirvighnaṃ samāgatānasmān mālatīmādhavādikān harṣanirbharaṃ pramodena pūrṇaṃ yathā tatheti/ tālalayādyullaṅghanena hāsyapravṛttiḥ sūcyate - pranṛttāḥ nartitumārabdhāḥ/
hāsyasya phalamāha - sasmitaṃ paśyantīti/
ko vā asminmahotsave na nṛtyati/ vāśabdo vikalpe/ tādṛśaṃ kamapi janaṃ na paśyāmītyarthaḥ/
tadvacanamanumodamānāha - evametat/ tvaduktaṃ satyameva, ninartiṣayā asmākamapi manaḥ sphuritamiti bhāvaḥ/ tatra hetuḥ - kvacit kasmiṃściddeśe evambhūtaṃ evamityanubhūyamānamālatīmādhavavṛttāntābhinayaḥ, etatprakāraviśiṣṭam/ ko'yaṃ prakāra ityatrāha - atyantacitraṃ prakāmamāścaryabhūtamiti vṛttakuṭilatayā acintitopanamatsukhaduḥkhaśabalatayā niratiśayasukhāvasānatvāccetyarthaḥ/ prakaraṇaṃ prastāvaḥ kāryasyetyarthāt/ ``arthaḥ prakaraṇaṃ liṅgami''ti, ``śrutiliṅgavākyaprakaraṇasthānasamākhyānāṃ pāradaurbalyamarthaviprakarṣād'' ityādivacanāt/ anayā coktibhaṅgyā ``yasya deve parā bhaktiryathā deve tathā gurau/
tasyaite kathitā hyarthāḥ prakāśante mahātmanaḥ//'' iti śrutivacananītyā devatāguruprasādaparimṛditakaṣāyatayā prādurbhūtaśabdabrahmasāmrājyaṃ svahṛdayānurūpaṃ parisamāpitaprāyaḥ prārabdhaprakaraṇaḥ paṇḍitavidagdhamaṇḍalamuṇḍamaṇḍanamahāmaṇirmahākavirātmanaḥ prakaraṇākhyarūpakaviśeṣasaṃvidhānacāturīṃ sahṛdayān prati prakāśayati/ evambhūtaṃ mālatīmādhavākhyaprakaraṇaprakārayuktaṃ, evambhūtaṃ punarevaṃkṛtamityuktyā prakaraṇanirmāṇāya svasmin saṃrambhiṇi gurudevatāprasādapauruṣeyasyeva tasyāyatnataḥ prādurbhūtatvamātmanastatrāhaṃmamābhimānarāhityādavikatthanatāṃ ca vyañjayati/ atyantacitraṃ aṣṭādaśavidyāsthānacatuṣṣaṣṭhikalāsamudāyasudhāsāgarasarvasvasya tatra tatra prasaṅgānuguṇyena niveśanāt prapañcakarturviriñcasyāpi vismayakaramityarthaḥ/ ``nāṭakaṃ saprakaraṇaṃ bhāṇaḥ prahasanaṃ ḍimaḥ/
vyāyogasamavākārau vīthyaṅkehāmṛgā iti//'' ityuddiṣṭaṃ, ``atha prakaraṇe vṛttamutpādyaṃ lokasaṃśrayam'' ityādinā lakṣitaśca rūpakabhedaḥ prakaraṇam/
athaitāvantaṃ kālaṃ gopitamarthaṃ pūrvavṛttasākṣiṇyā yoginyā mukhena samaye kavirudghāṭayati - idamityādi/ idaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ atra prakaraṇe, rāmaṇīyakaṃ saundaryaṃ, sahṛdayānāṃ niratiśayacamatkāramityarthaḥ/ idaṃ nānyadyuṣmadvivakṣitaṃ dharmajātaṃ tasmāt sarvasmādapyasya sutarāṃ manoharatvāditi bhāvaḥ/ tat kimityatrāha - yadityādi/ cirāt bahoḥ kālāt, gurucaryākālataḥ prabhṛti pravṛttatvāt sampūrṇaḥ sampannaphalo jātaḥ/ ayamidānīṃ sarvairasmābhiranubhūyamānaḥ itaretarāpatyasambandhāmṛtamanorathaḥ anyonyasyāpatyābhyāṃ duhitrā putreṇa ca dvārīkṛtābhyāṃ yassambandhassamīcīnaśleṣaḥ/ samānasambandhatvāttadrūpe'mṛte yo manorathaḥ kadā prāpsyāva iti saṅkalpaḥ/ prayatnasādhyatvāt siddhikṣaṇa eva paranirvṛtijanakatvādāyatyāṃ nirupamahitasādhanatvāccāmṛtatvāropaḥ/
aviditatvānmālatī savismayakautukaṃ tarkayati - kathamiva kena prakareṇāsyā vacanamidamityarthaḥ/
sakautukaṃ tattattvaśravaṇautsukyayuktam/ anyathā prakārāntareṇa vṛttaṃ vastu vṛttamanuṣṭhitakāryatattvamamātyabhūrivasumatyullaṅghanena pravṛttamityarthaḥ/ anyathā tadviruddhaprakārāntaraprakāśanaparaṃ amātyamatipūrvakapravṛttipratipādanayuktamityarthaḥ/ vacanaṃ ``yadāmātyayo''rityādi/ āryāyāḥ pūjyāyā yoginyāḥ/ ``idamatra rāmanīyaka''mityādinā ``anyathā vastu vṛtta''mityantena kāryamārgaṇādvirodhaḥ/
atha viditavṛttāntā lavaṅgikā tattvakathane rājanandanayoḥ punarvikāramāśaṅkyāha - bhagavati! kimiti pratipattavyam/ kimiti kiṃ vastu, etadbubhutsitasyārthasya prakāśanamaprakāśanaṃ vāsmābhiraṅgīkartavyamityarthaḥ/
tadīyāmāśaṅkāmupapattyā nirākurvāṇā prakāśanameva pratipattavyamityāha - samprati rājāmātyaprasādasūcikāṃ patrikāṃ prāptetyarthaḥ, madayantikāsambandhena madayantikānimittena saṃśleṣeṇa nandanopagrahāt amātyanandanasyāsmatpakṣyāpādanāt pratyastaśaṅkāḥ dūrīkṛtavikāraśaṅkāḥ/ khaluravadhāraṇe/ anena bhaginyāmasmadgṛhavartinyāṃ tasya vikṛtirnopapadyate/ tatkimarthamadyāpyapahnutivyasanamanubhūyata iti darśitam/ vipakṣe bādhakabhāvaṃ niścitya tattvaṃ prakāśayati - vatsau na khalva[lvi]ti/ vatsāviti bālatvādyathādṛṣṭagrāhiṇo yūyaṃ, paramārthastu tathā neti dyotayati/ na khalvanyathā vastu vṛttamiti/ bījopakṣepād grathanam/ tarhi kaḥ paramārtha ityatrāha - yata ityādi/ śrāvakāvasthāyāṃ śrāvakau guruśuśrūṣayā śiṣyau bhūtvā yadā tāvavartiṣātāṃ tasyāṃ daśāyāṃ, brahmacaryāśramālambanakāla evetyarthaḥ/ āvābhyāmapatyasambandhaḥ kartavyaḥ itīyaṃ pratijñā vṛtteti yataḥ tasmāt na khalvanyathā vastu vṛttamanyathā vacanamasyā iti sambandhaḥ/ atra prathamata evopakṣiptasyāmātyapratijñārūpasya mukhyabījasya kṛtakāryatvena nigamanaṃ kṛtamiti veditavyam/ ``yataḥ śrāvakāvasthāyā''mityādinānubhūtākhyānānnirṇayaḥ, amātyavṛttipūrvakatve svapravṛtteḥ/ kimarthamevaṃ mahatā prayāsena coravacceṣṭitaṃ anāyāsena sākṣādeva sambandhakāryasya śakyatvādityāśaṅkyāha - pradhānaprakṛtikopastvevaṃ parihṛta iti/ pradhānabhūtāyāḥ mukhyāyāḥ prakṛte rājyāṅgasya, purohitādibhyo'mātyasyāntaraṅgatvāt/ ``svāmyamātyasuhṛtkośarāṣṭradurgabalāni ca/
rājyāṅgāni prakṛtayaḥ paurāṇāṃ śreṇayo'pi ca//'' iti vaijayantī/ nandanasyetyarthaḥ/ kopamanyasmai mālatyāḥ sākṣāddāne'pi kṛtatvāt, taddvārā rājño'pi kopaprasaṅgāt/ evamanuṣṭhitena caurikāvivāharūpeṇa prakāreṇa parihṛtaṃ nirākṛtam/
viditatvātsavismayamāha - ahno saṃvaraṇam/ āścaryaṃ tātasya mantragopanamityarthaḥ/ anena saṃvaraṇaṃ taditi pūrvoktamanusmārayati/
savismayāvāhatuḥ - āścaryaṃ vismayabuddhiṃ, janayanti khalu utpādayantyeva, mahatāṃ bhūrivasuprabhṛtīnāmapi saṃvādinyaḥ visaṃvādo niṣkṛṣṭaprakārādanyathābhāvaḥ, tadrahitā avyabhicārā ityarthaḥ, kalyāṇyaḥ śobhitopakramatayā ca maṅgalabhūtāḥ, nītayaḥ upāyaprayogāḥ/ ``ahmo saṃvaraṇaṃ'' ityādinā ``kalyāṇyo nītaya'' ityantenārthadarśanāt pūrvabhāvaḥ/
atha ``kṛtārthā bhūyāsaṃ priyasuhṛdi yatnairabhimataiḥ/'' ityādyāśāsitaprakāreṇa siṣādhayiṣitasakalārthasampattyā nirvṛtahṛdayā sampannakāryajātānukramaṇapūrvakaṃ nāyakasya daivasampannatvaṃ svasyā nītiprayoganaipuṇaṃ ca bhaṅgyā camatkurvāṇā tamāhlādayati - yatprāgevetyādi/ prāgeva yuvayorjananāt pūrvameva manorathairvṛtaṃ saṅkalpaiḥ prārthitaṃ, asmābhiriti śeṣaḥ/ bahuvacanena bahumukhatvaṃ manorathasya vyajyate, amātyayoḥ kadā nu duhitā putraścotpatsyete, kadā ca tatsambandhapratijñā tayoḥ pūrayiṣyate, kadā nu tayoḥ samṛddhīrdrakṣyāma ityādiprakārabāhulyāt/ kalyāṇaṃ parasparasamāgamādisādhanaṃ maṅgalaṃ āyuṣmatoḥ āyuṣmatyā āyuṣmataśceti sopalālanaṃ vacanaṃ, puṇyaiḥ yuvayoḥ purākṛtaiḥ pacelimaiḥ sukṛtaiḥ madupakramairmamopāyaprayogaiḥ/ cakāreṇa daivapauruṣayoravirodhena samuditatve phalaprāpteḥ kaḥ sandeha iti dyotyate/ phalitaṃ sañjātaphalaṃ jātaṃ, nirvighnasamāgamādikāryasampatteḥ/ ata eva macchiṣyayoravalokitāsaudāminyoḥ parasparadarśanādyupāyānuṣṭhānena kapālakuṇḍalānirbhartsanādibhiśca yaḥ kleśo manovākkāyavyāpārabāhulyapariśramaḥ, so'pi phalita iti liṅgavipariṇāmena yojyam/ anena ``arthaṃ sapratibandhaṃ prabhuradhigantuṃ sahāyavāneva'' iti nyāyāt mamāpi sacchiṣyāsāhāyyata eva saphalapariśramatvaṃ jātamiti, tadabhinandanaṃ kriyate, ``karmānte dāsabhṛtyāśce''ti vacanāddāsatulyānāṃ śiṣyāṇāmapi pravṛttiphalasiddhau stutyatvāt/ niṣṇātaḥ vidagdhopāyasādhitatvāt/ niṣṇātamiti vā pāṭhaḥ, nipuṇamiti kriyāviśeṣaṇam/ ``ninadībhyāṃ snāteḥ kauśale'' (4-3-49) iti ṣatvam/ abhivihitaḥ sampāditaḥ/ tvatpreyasaḥ tvatprāṇebhyo'pi priyatamasya makarandasyetyanena svakāryalābhāt tatkāryalābhasyābhinandanīyatvaṃ dyotayati/ kāntayā priyatamayā madayantikayetyarthaḥ/ anena buddharakṣitāyāḥ śramo'pi phalita iti sūcayati/ ato'pi priyatamaṃ kāryaṃ niṣpannamityāha - samprītau samyak tvadviṣaye prasannau nṛpanandanau padmāvatīśvaro'mātyanandanaśca/ tayossaṃprītyabhāve niṣpannasya sarvasyāpi kāryasya vyasanodarkatvena gajasnānakalpatvamiti bhāvaḥ/ ataḥ paramasmādanyat preyaḥ priyatamaṃ vastu yat lipsitamityarthāt, tadapītyapinā siddhakāryavattasyāpyayatnasādhyatvaṃ svasyāḥ tatpriyānuṣṭhānaikatānatvaṃ ca dyotyate, ucyatāṃ kathyatām/ na punarupakramyatāmityanena mamedaṃ spṛhāyā viṣaya iti tadvacanānantarameva tatsiddhiṃ drakṣyasīti prakāśyate/ ``yatprāgeve''tyādinā labdhārthasthirīkaraṇāt kṛtiḥ/ ``yadaparaṃ preyastadapyucyatā''miti kāryārthasaṃharaṇāt kāryasaṃhāraḥ/ atra ca ``api nāma kalyāṇino''rityādinopakṣiptasya mālatīmādhavapāṇigrahaṇasya ``so vi saha aro māhavassa bālamittaṃ māraṃdo ṇaṃdaṇassa bhaïṇiaṃ madāntiaṃ jaï samuvvahaï takkhu māhavassa ahiaṃ piaṃ hoi''ti/ madayantikāmakarandapariṇayasya cādhikṛtatvādubhayasyāpi sādhitatvāt prakaraṇārthaparisamāptiḥ pratipāditā//23//
atha mālatīprāptyaiva paramapuruṣārthasya trivargasya sādhitatvāttataḥ parasya lipsāviṣayasyābhāvāttadanuyuktamarthaṃ pratikṣipati - ataḥ paramapi priyamastīti/ ataḥ siddhādarthāt paramutkṛṣṭaṃ priyaṃ vastu, apirvirodhe, astīti kākvā praśnarūpayā na kiñcidastītyākṣepaḥ prakāśyate/ ``ataḥ paramapi priyamastī''ti vāñchitārthaprāptikathanād bhāṣaṇam/ tathāpi ataḥ parasya vastuno lipsāyā viṣayasyābhāve'pītyarthaḥ/ idaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ vastu/ astviti prārthanāyāṃ loṭ/ anena ca lipsābhāve'pi mahāpuruṣānugrahasya sarvathā svīkartavyatvaṃ śreyassādhanatvāditi dyotayati/ nāṭakanyāyācceyamuktiḥ/ bharatavākyamiti/ prakaraṇasya sākalyenābhinīya parisamāpitatvāt mādhavabhūmikāṃ parityaktavataḥ svaprakṛtimātraniṣṭhasya vacanam/ idaṃ vakṣyamāṇamityarthaḥ/ prārthanāprakāramāha - śivamastvityādi/ śivam abhyudayaḥ/ ajahikaviṣayānubhavasampattirityarthaḥ/ sarvajagatāṃ sarveṣāṃ śarīriṇām/ tatra hetuḥ - parahitaniratāḥ paraśabdena svakāryatvāt kāraṇabhūtebhyaḥ svebhyo'nyeṣāmityucyate/ ``tathāhi sarve tasyāsan parārthaikaphalā guṇāḥ/'' itivat/ teṣāṃ hite śreyasi niratāḥ nitarāṃ ratā udyuktāḥ/ svaguṇaiḥ śabdādibhiḥ parahitaikaniṣṭhā iti yāvat/ teṣāṃ nyūnātireke jagatkṣobhasyāvaśyaṃbhāvāt/ bhūtagaṇāḥ ākāśādīnāṃ mahatāṃ bhūtānāṃ saṅghāḥ/ ``pañcānāmapi bhūtānāmutkarṣaṃ pupuṣurguṇāḥ'' ityuktam/ doṣā rāgadveṣalobhādayaḥ/ ``pravartamānalakṣaṇāḥ syurdoṣā rāgādayaśca te'' iti vacanāt/ nāśaṃ prayāntu dhīdhairyātmajñānādibhirapunarutthānāya vilayaṃ gacchantu/ ``dhīdhairyātmādivijñānaṃ manodoṣauṣadhaṃ param'' iti vacanāt/ sarvatra sarvadeśeṣu sarvāvasthāsu vā sukhī niśśeṣaduḥkhanivṛttyā niratiśayānandānubhavaviśiṣṭo bhavatu/ mithyājñānamūlasya rāgādeḥ samyak[j]jñānena nivṛttatvāt rāgādimūlasya ca duḥkharāśestannirasanenaiva nirastatvāt/ ``yadā sarve pramucyante kāmā ye'sya hṛdi sthitāḥ/
atha martyo'mṛto bhavatyatra brahma samaśnute'' ``abhayaṃ vai janaka prāpto'si'' ``tarati śokamātmavit'' ityādiśrutivacanaiḥ/ asyāstvāryāyāḥ pūrvārdhena abhyudayaprārthanā uttarārdhena niḥśreyasaprārthanā cāryasya parameśvaraṃ prati paramakāruṇikena kavinā kṛteti veditavyam/ ``tathāpīdamastu/ śivamastu sarvajagatā''mityādinā śubhaśaṃsanāt praśastiḥ/ evamete pañca sandhayaścatuṣṣaṣṭyaṅgaiḥ pratipāditāḥ/ atra prakaraṇa ādau ``sānandami''ti, madhye ``vidhātā bhadranna'' iti, ante ``śivamastu sarvajagatāmi''ti ca prayogāt maṅgalopakramatvānmaṅgalamadhyatvānmaṅgalāntatvāccaitacchīlanaparāṇāṃ sakalasamīhitasampattiḥ prakāśitā/ atra mādhava iti sākṣāllakṣmīpatirnārāyaṇa ucyate, ``śṛṅgāro viṣṇudaivatya''iti vacanāt śṛṅgāradevatā bhagavānevātra nāyaka ityanusandhānārtham/ mālatī tu saukumāryasaurabhyādiyogāllakṣmīḥ/ devarāta iti devaiḥ bhagavadavatāritārthaṃ bhūmāvavatāritatvāt kāśyapaḥ/ bhūrivasuriti anantaratnākaratvāt kṣīrasāgaraḥ/ makaranda iti ``raso vai saḥ'' ityādivacanāt paramānandarūpaḥ parameśvaraḥ/ madayantiketi mahāmāyātvena jaganmohanād bhavānī/ kāmandakīti kāmitārthadānasāmarthyād bhaktiḥ/ buddharakṣiteti buddhairvidvadbhiḥ paripālitatvāt sarasvatī/ avalokiteti prekṣāvadbhiḥ samyagālocitattvāt nītiḥ/ lavaṅkiketi parimalabahalatvāt kīrtiḥ/ kalahaṃsa iti madhurāvyaktoccāraḥ paramātmamantraḥ/ aghoraghaṇṭa iti aśāstravihitahiṃsāparatvādadharmaḥ/ kapālakuṇḍaleti hiṃsā/ saudāminīti prakāśātmikā jhaṭiti sphuraṇena sakalāndhakārapaṭalavighaṭanapaṭīyasī vidyetyādirupāsanopayuktā vāsanāpi mahākaverdaiṣṭikairanusandheyeti sakalamatimaṅgalam//24//
mālatīmādhavasyetthaṃ daśamāṅkārthacarcanam/
pūrṇajyotiḥprasādena cakre pūrṇasarasvatī// //iti daśamo'ṅkaḥ// //śubhamastu//
